teaching_sense.en_definition: You use 'l hawn to indicate movement this way or towards the place where you are.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指示朝说话者所在的位置移动，意为“往这边”或“到这里”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'l hawn tindika moviment lejn in-naħa jew il-post fejn jinsab min qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 往这边，朝说话者所指的这一方向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'l hawn tindika moviment f'din id-direzzjoni, lejn in-naħa ta' min qed jitkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say this way when directing someone towards the side or direction where you are.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到这里，朝说话者所在的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni 'l hawn tfisser lejn il-post fejn jinsab min qed jitkellem, speċjalment meta jistieden lil xi ħadd jersaq lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use here with a movement verb to indicate the place where you are.

formal.mt: Il-gwida qalet lill-viżitaturi: "Jekk jogħġobkom, imxu 'l hawn biex taraw il-wirja."
formal.en: The guide told the visitors, "Please walk this way to see the exhibition."
formal.zh: 导览员对参观者说：“请往这边走，参观展览。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejja 'l hawn, hemm post ħdejja. Mark: Ġej! Nista' npoġġi l-borża hawn ukoll?
colloquial.en: Maja: Come here, there's a seat next to me. Mark: Coming! Can I put my bag here too?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：到这边来，我旁边有个位子。马克：来了！我也可以把包放在这里吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja 'l hawn, hemm post ħdejja.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja 'l hawn, hemm post ħdejja.
messages.zh: 到这边来，我旁边有个位子。
messages.en: Come here, there's a seat next to me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġej! Nista' npoġġi l-borża hawn ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Ġej! Nista' npoġġi l-borża hawn ukoll?
messages.zh: 来了！我也可以把包放在这里吗？
messages.en: Coming! Can I put my bag here too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友向你招手说 ejja 'l hawn，把整个短语和“朝我这边来”的动作绑定，记住它指向这里的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: You use 'l hemm to indicate a direction towards a place away from where you are, or to refer to that place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指示离说话者有一定距离的方向，表示“往那边”，也可指“在那边”的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika direzzjoni lejn post imbiegħed minn fejn ikun il-kelliem, jew biex tirreferi għal dak il-post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 往那边；朝所指的方向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fid-direzzjoni li jindika l-kelliem, lejn post imbiegħed minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you go 'l hemm, you move in the direction that someone is indicating.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在那边；指离说话者有一定距离的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dak il-post imbiegħed minn fejn ikun il-kelliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use 'l hemm to refer to a place some distance from where you are.

formal.mt: Biex taslu fil-ġnien, imxu 'l hemm u mbagħad duru lejn ix-xellug.
formal.en: To reach the garden, walk that way and then turn left.
formal.zh: 要到花园，请往那边走，然后左转。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ħanut? Pawlu: 'L hemm, ħdejn il-bank. Maja: Sewwa, immur minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the shop? Pawlu: Over there, next to the bank. Maja: Right, I'll go that way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店在哪里？保罗：在那边，银行旁边。玛雅：好，我往那边走。

messages.speaker: Maja (问路者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ħanut?
messages.zh: 商店在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (路人)
messages.mt_spoken: 'L hemm, ħdejn il-bank.
messages.mt_standard: 'L hemm, ħdejn il-bank.
messages.zh: 在那边，银行旁边。
messages.en: Over there, next to the bank.

messages.speaker: Maja (问路者)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, immur minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, immur minn hemm.
messages.zh: 好，我往那边走。
messages.en: Right, I'll go that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象伸手指向远处：配合“走”记成“往那边”，回答位置时记成“在那边”；用指路动作串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Towards the inside of a place or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示移动的方向朝向某个地方或物体的内部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fid-direzzjoni tal-parti ta' ġewwa ta' post jew oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向内；朝里面，强调移动或朝向内部的方向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'moviment jew b'direzzjoni lejn il-parti ta' ġewwa ta' post jew oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something moves inwards, it moves towards the inside of a place or object.

formal.mt: Dan il-bieb jinfetaħ 'l ġewwa, għalhekk l-ispazju warajh għandu jinżamm ħieles.
formal.en: This door opens inwards, so the space behind it must be kept clear.
formal.zh: 这扇门向内开启，因此门后的空间必须保持畅通。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi s-siġġu? Mark: Mexxih ftit 'l ġewwa, ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put the chair? Mark: Move it a little further in, next to the table.
colloquial.zh: Lara：椅子放在哪里？Mark：把它往里面挪一点，放到桌子旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi s-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi s-siġġu?
messages.zh: 椅子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the chair?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mexxih ftit 'l ġewwa, ħdejn il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Mexxih ftit 'l ġewwa, ħdejn il-mejda.
messages.zh: 把它往里面挪一点，放到桌子旁边。
messages.en: Move it a little further in, next to the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门上的箭头指向房间内部，把 'l ġewwa 整体记成“往里面”；配合推门动作，突出方向而非静止位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chapel is a small building or a room used for Christian prayer and worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于基督宗教祈祷和礼拜的小型建筑，或建筑内专设的礼拜空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kappella hija binja żgħira jew kamra ddedikata għat-talb u għall-qima Nisranija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小教堂；供基督宗教祈祷和礼拜使用的小型建筑或专用房间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kappella hija post żgħir ta' qima Nisranija, li jista' jkun binja għalih jew kamra f'binja oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chapel is a small Christian place of worship, either in a separate building or within a larger one.

formal.mt: Il-kappella tkun miftuħa għall-viżitaturi kull filgħodu, iżda għandu jinżamm is-skiet waqt it-talb.
formal.en: The chapel is open to visitors every morning, but silence must be maintained during prayer.
formal.zh: 礼拜堂每天上午向访客开放，但祈祷期间须保持安静。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Ħdejn il-kappella żgħira fil-pjazza. Maja: Sewwa, nistenna ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: By the small chapel in the square. Maja: All right, I'll wait by the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里见面？Mark：在广场上的小礼拜堂旁边。Maja：好，我在门边等。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-kappella żgħira fil-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-kappella żgħira fil-pjazza.
messages.zh: 在广场上的小礼拜堂旁边。
messages.en: By the small chapel in the square.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nistenna ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nistenna ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 好，我在门边等。
messages.en: All right, I'll wait by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kappella 与“广场旁的小礼拜堂”画面绑定，再用 fil-kappella“在礼拜堂里”记住实际用法；这是场景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun listed as Kappestru whose meaning is not established by the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将 Kappestru 标为名词，但未提供可确定其所指的释义，因此暂不赋予具体中文词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kappestru huwa mniżżel bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, iżda t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未确定；问号表示所给材料没有明确说明该名词的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sinjal tal-mistoqsija juri li l-materjal mogħti ma jagħtix tifsira ċara għal dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry marks this noun's meaning as unknown, so a specific lexical definition cannot be established.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'Kappestru' hija mniżżla bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'Kappestru' is listed as a noun, but the supplied material does not specify its meaning.
formal.zh: “Kappestru”一词被列为名词，但所给材料未说明其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'Kappestru'? Pawlu: Hawn hemm biss sinjal tal-mistoqsija; it-tifsira mhix mogħtija. Lara: Mela nħalli t-tifsira vojta għalissa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'Kappestru' mean? Pawlu: There is only a question mark here; the meaning isn't given. Lara: Then I'll leave the meaning blank for now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“Kappestru”这个词是什么意思？Pawlu：这里只有一个问号，没有给出词义。Lara：那我暂时把释义留空。

gloss_zh: 堂区主任司铎；机构或团体的随任司铎

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kappillan is a priest responsible for a parish or a priest who provides religious care within an institution or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责堂区牧灵事务的司铎，或为医院、军队等机构及团体提供宗教服务的司铎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kappillan huwa saċerdot responsabbli minn parroċċa, jew saċerdot li jieħu ħsieb il-ħtiġijiet reliġjużi ta' nies f'istituzzjoni jew fi grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堂区主任司铎；负责一个堂区的宗教礼仪及教友牧灵事务的神父。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kappillan huwa saċerdot li għandu r-responsabbiltà ta' parroċċa u jieħu ħsieb il-ħajja reliġjuża tal-membri tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A parish priest is a priest who is responsible for the worship and spiritual care of a particular parish.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机构或团体的随任司铎；为医院、军队等特定机构或群体提供宗教服务的神父。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kappillan huwa saċerdot li jagħti servizz reliġjuż u appoġġ spiritwali lil nies f'istituzzjoni, bħal sptar, jew fi grupp, bħall-armata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chaplain is a priest who provides religious services and spiritual support for people in a particular institution or group.

formal.mt: Il-kappillan tal-parroċċa se jippresiedi ċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-Ħadd, filwaqt li l-kappillan tal-isptar se jżur lill-pazjenti.
formal.en: The parish priest will preside over Sunday's celebration, while the hospital chaplain will visit the patients.
formal.zh: 堂区主任司铎将主持星期日的礼仪庆典，医院的随任司铎则将探望病人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nixtieq nitkellem ma' saċerdot. Hemm kappillan fl-isptar? Rita: Iva, nista' nistaqsi meta jista' jiġi. Anna: Grazzi, nixtieq nitlob miegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'd like to speak to a priest. Is there a chaplain at the hospital? Rita: Yes, I can ask when he can come. Anna: Thank you, I'd like to pray with him.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我想和神父谈谈。医院里有随任司铎吗？Rita：有，我可以问问他什么时候能来。Anna：谢谢，我想和他一起祈祷。

messages.speaker: Anna (病人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nitkellem ma' saċerdot. Hemm kappillan fl-isptar?
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nitkellem ma' saċerdot. Hemm kappillan fl-isptar?
messages.zh: 我想和神父谈谈。医院里有随任司铎吗？
messages.en: I'd like to speak to a priest. Is there a chaplain at the hospital?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nista' nistaqsi meta jista' jiġi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nista' nistaqsi meta jista' jiġi.
messages.zh: 有，我可以问问他什么时候能来。
messages.en: Yes, I can ask when he can come.

messages.speaker: Anna (病人)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, nixtieq nitlob miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, nixtieq nitlob miegħu.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我想和他一起祈祷。
messages.en: Thank you, I'd like to pray with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁负责宗教关怀”记 kappillan：接 tal-parroċċa 想到堂区主任司铎，接 tal-isptar 想到医院随任司铎，靠服务对象区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 任性念头；反复无常的变化；一时兴起

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kapriċċ is a sudden wish or an unpredictable change in behaviour or circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然产生、未必经过理性考虑的愿望，也可指行为或境况中难以预料的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kapriċċ huwa xewqa li tqum għal għarrieda u mhux dejjem tkun ibbażata fuq raġuni ċara, jew bidla mhux mistennija fl-imġiba jew fiċ-ċirkostanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任性念头；缺乏稳定理由、可能随时改变的欲望或决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kapriċċ huwa xewqa jew deċiżjoni arbitrarja li tista' tinbidel malajr u ma tkunx ibbażata fuq raġuni soda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A caprice is a sudden desire or decision that is guided by changing feelings rather than a consistent reason.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复无常的变化；行为、天气或境况中出乎意料、难以预测的表现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kapriċċ huwa bidla jew ġrajja mhux mistennija li turi kemm l-imġiba, it-temp jew iċ-ċirkostanzi jistgħu jkunu imprevedibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vagary is an unexpected change or occurrence that shows how unpredictable behaviour or circumstances can be.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一时兴起；未经事先计划而突然产生的想法或愿望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kapriċċ huwa ħsieb jew xewqa li tqum f'daqqa, mingħajr ma tkun ġiet ippjanata jew ikkunsidrata fit-tul.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A whim is a sudden wish to do or have something without much thought or previous planning.

formal.mt: Deċiżjoni dwar l-użu tal-fondi pubbliċi għandha tkun ibbażata fuq ħtiġijiet ċari, mhux fuq kapriċċ personali.
formal.en: A decision about the use of public funds should be based on clear needs, not on a personal caprice.
formal.zh: 关于公共资金用途的决定应以明确需求为依据，而不应出于个人的任性念头。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex xtrajt dak il-kappell aħmar? Mark: Kien kapriċċ tal-mument; rajtu u għoġobni. Maja: Jekk jogħġbok, ilbsu għada!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you buy that red hat? Mark: It was a momentary whim; I saw it and liked it. Maja: If you like it, wear it tomorrow!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么买了那顶红帽子？Mark：一时兴起；我看见它，觉得挺喜欢。Maja：既然喜欢，明天就戴上吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xtrajt dak il-kappell aħmar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xtrajt dak il-kappell aħmar?
messages.zh: 你为什么买了那顶红帽子？
messages.en: Why did you buy that red hat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien kapriċċ tal-mument; rajtu u għoġobni.
messages.mt_standard: Kien kapriċċ tal-mument; rajtu u għoġobni.
messages.zh: 一时兴起；我看见它，觉得挺喜欢。
messages.en: It was a momentary whim; I saw it and liked it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk jogħġbok, ilbsu għada!
messages.mt_standard: Jekk jogħġbok, ilbsu għada!
messages.zh: 既然喜欢，明天就戴上吧！
messages.en: If you like it, wear it tomorrow!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“忽然想买帽子”的画面记 kapriċċ：强调任性决定是 caprice，强调难以预测的变化是 vagary，强调临时冒出的愿望是 whim；三者共享“说变就变”的联想。

gloss_zh: 一张扑克牌；一张游戏牌

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single card used in a card game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于纸牌游戏的一张牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karta waħda li tintuża biex tintlagħab logħba bil-karti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于纸牌游戏的一张牌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karta minn sett ta' karti li jintużaw f'logħba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A playing card is one of a set of cards used to play games.

collocations.mt: tqassam karta tal-logħob lil kull plejer
collocations.en: deal one playing card to each player

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-attività, kull parteċipant għandu jiġbed karta tal-logħob u jżommha moħbija.
formal.en: At the beginning of the activity, each participant should draw a playing card and keep it hidden.
formal.zh: 活动开始时，每位参与者应抽取一张游戏牌，并将牌面保密。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi niġbed karta tal-logħob oħra? Pawlu: Iva, iġbed waħda u turihiex lili.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I draw another playing card? Pawlu: Yes, draw one and don't show it to me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我该再抽一张牌吗？保罗：对，抽一张，别给我看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi niġbed karta tal-logħob oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi niġbed karta tal-logħob oħra?
messages.zh: 我该再抽一张牌吗？
messages.en: Should I draw another playing card?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iġbed waħda u turihiex lili.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iġbed waħda u turihiex lili.
messages.zh: 对，抽一张，别给我看。
messages.en: Yes, draw one and don't show it to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从一副牌中抽出一张，借这个画面把 karta tal-logħob 记成单张游戏牌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A game played with cards according to a set of rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照一定规则使用纸牌进行的游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba li tintlagħab bil-karti skont sett ta' regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以纸牌为主要用具、按照特定规则进行的游戏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħba li fiha l-plejers jużaw il-karti u jsegwu regoli li jiddeterminaw kif tintlagħab u kif jintgħażel ir-rebbieħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A card game is a game in which players use cards and follow particular rules.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru se jorganizza serata ta' karti tal-logħob, u r-regoli ta' kull logħba se jiġu spjegati qabel tibda.
formal.en: The centre will organise an evening of card games, and the rules of each game will be explained before it begins.
formal.zh: 活动中心将举办纸牌游戏之夜，每场游戏开始前都会讲解规则。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Illejla nagħmlu serata ta' karti tal-logħob? Toni: Iva! Imma l-ewwel spjegali r-regoli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we have an evening of card games tonight? Toni: Yes! But explain the rules to me first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今晚我们一起玩纸牌游戏吧？托尼：好啊！不过先给我讲讲规则。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illejla nagħmlu serata ta' karti tal-logħob?
messages.mt_standard: Illejla nagħmlu serata ta' karti tal-logħob?
messages.zh: 今晚我们一起玩纸牌游戏吧？
messages.en: Shall we have an evening of card games tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Imma l-ewwel spjegali r-regoli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Imma l-ewwel spjegali r-regoli.
messages.zh: 好啊！不过先给我讲讲规则。
messages.en: Yes! But explain the rules to me first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本词条的纸牌游戏义放进朋友围桌、讲规则、轮流出牌的完整场景中记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A digital wallet on a mobile device used to store payment details and make payments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在手机等移动设备上使用的数字钱包，用于保存支付信息和进行付款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kartiera diġitali fuq apparat mobbli li tintuża biex jinżammu d-dettalji tal-ħlas u jsiru pagamenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在移动设备上保存支付信息并用于付款的数字钱包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda diġitali fuq mowbajl jew apparat mobbli ieħor li żżomm informazzjoni għall-ħlas u tippermetti li jsiru pagamenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mobile wallet is a digital service on a mobile device that stores payment information and allows you to make payments.

collocations.en: add a card to a mobile wallet
collocations.zh: 将银行卡添加到手机钱包

formal.mt: Qabel ma tuża l-kartiera mobbli għall-ewwel darba, ivverifika li d-dettalji tal-karta huma korretti.
formal.en: Before using the mobile wallet for the first time, verify that the card details are correct.
formal.zh: 首次使用手机钱包前，请核实银行卡信息是否正确。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nħallas bil-kartiera mobbli? Lara: Iva, ressaq il-mowbajl lejn it-terminal.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I pay with my mobile wallet? Lara: Yes, hold your phone near the terminal.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我可以用手机钱包付款吗？拉拉：可以，把手机靠近支付终端。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nħallas bil-kartiera mobbli?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nħallas bil-kartiera mobbli?
messages.zh: 我可以用手机钱包付款吗？
messages.en: Can I pay with my mobile wallet?

messages.speaker: Lara (收银员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ressaq il-mowbajl lejn it-terminal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ressaq il-mowbajl lejn it-terminal.
messages.zh: 可以，把手机靠近支付终端。
messages.en: Yes, hold your phone near the terminal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象付款时拿出手机，屏幕里的钱包完成支付，用这个场景记住 kartiera mobbli。

gloss_zh: 纸袋；一种略多于一升、容量随所量液体而异的液量单位

teaching_sense.en_definition: A paper bag, or a measure of liquid equivalent to just over a litre, with the amount varying according to the liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指盛放物品的纸袋，也可指一种略多于一升的液量单位，其具体容量随所量液体而异。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża tal-karti biex jinżammu fiha oġġetti, jew miżura għal-likwidi ta' ftit aktar minn litru, li l-kapaċità tagħha tvarja skont il-likwidu mkejjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用纸制成、用于盛放或携带物品的袋子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża magħmula mill-karti li tintuża biex jinżammu jew jinġarru fiha oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A paper bag is a bag made of paper that you use to hold or carry things.

sense_translations.en_definition: measure for liquids (equivalent to just over a litre, though varying depending on the liquid measured)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种用于计量液体的容量单位，约略多于一升，但具体容量因所量液体而异。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura ta' kapaċità għal-likwidi li tikkorrispondi għal ftit aktar minn litru, iżda li l-valur tagħha jvarja skont il-likwidu li jkun qed jitkejjel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kartoċċ is a measure of liquid equivalent to slightly more than a litre, although its exact volume varies according to the liquid being measured.

collocations.en: fill a paper bag with sweets

collocations.zh: 一卡尔托奇的油，容量略多于一升

formal.mt: Il-kelma kartoċċ tista' tfisser borża tal-karti. Meta tintuża bħala miżura għal-likwidi, tindika ftit aktar minn litru, iżda l-kapaċità tvarja skont il-likwidu mkejjel.
formal.en: The word kartoċċ can mean a paper bag. When used as a measure of liquid, it indicates slightly more than a litre, but the volume varies according to the liquid measured.
formal.zh: kartoċċ 一词可表示纸袋。用作液量单位时，它表示略多于一升的量，但具体容量随所量液体而异。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tini kartoċċ għall-ħelu, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Żgur. Taf li kartoċċ jista' jfisser ukoll miżura għal-likwidi? Maja: Le! Kemm ikun? Pawlu: Ftit aktar minn litru, imma jiddependi mil-likwidu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Could you give me a paper bag for the sweets, please? Pawlu: Of course. Did you know that kartoċċ can also mean a measure of liquid? Maja: No! How much is it? Pawlu: Slightly more than a litre, but it depends on the liquid.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请给我一个装糖果的纸袋，好吗？保罗：当然。你知道 kartoċċ 也能表示一种液量单位吗？玛雅：不知道！是多少呢？保罗：略多于一升，不过要看量的是什么液体。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tini kartoċċ għall-ħelu, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tini kartoċċ għall-ħelu, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一个装糖果的纸袋，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me a paper bag for the sweets, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Taf li kartoċċ jista' jfisser ukoll miżura għal-likwidi?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Taf li kartoċċ jista' jfisser ukoll miżura għal-likwidi?
messages.zh: 当然。你知道 kartoċċ 也能表示一种液量单位吗？
messages.en: Of course. Did you know that kartoċċ can also mean a measure of liquid?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Le! Kemm ikun?
messages.mt_standard: Le! Kemm ikun?
messages.zh: 不知道！是多少呢？
messages.en: No! How much is it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit aktar minn litru, imma jiddependi mil-likwidu.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit aktar minn litru, imma jiddependi mil-likwidu.
messages.zh: 略多于一升，不过要看量的是什么液体。
messages.en: Slightly more than a litre, but it depends on the liquid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅分开的画面记忆：糖果装进纸袋；油按液量单位计量。遇到 kartoċċ 先看语境，液量义只记略多于一升且随液体变化。

gloss_zh: 卡斯蒂利亚；瓦莱塔的卡斯蒂利亚骑士旅舍（首相办公室所在地的俗称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Castille, or, in colloquial Maltese usage, the Auberge de Castille in Valletta, which houses the Office of the Prime Minister.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地名“卡斯蒂利亚”；在马耳他口语中，也指瓦莱塔的卡斯蒂利亚骑士旅舍，即首相办公室所在地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem tar-reġjun ta' Kastilija; fil-Malti mitkellem jintuża wkoll għall-Berġa ta' Kastilija fil-Belt Valletta, fejn jinsab l-Uffiċċju tal-Prim Ministru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卡斯蒂利亚，西班牙的一个地区名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kastilija hija reġjun fi Spanja li jissemma b'dan l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Castille is a region of Spain referred to by this geographical name.

sense_translations.en_definition: Colloquial name for the Auberge de Castille in Valletta, housing the Office of the Prime Minister
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他口语中对瓦莱塔卡斯蒂利亚骑士旅舍的称呼，该建筑是首相办公室所在地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-lingwa mitkellma, Kastilija hija l-isem li jintuża għall-Berġa ta' Kastilija fil-Belt Valletta, il-binja fejn jinsab l-Uffiċċju tal-Prim Ministru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In colloquial Maltese, Kastilija refers to the Auberge de Castille in Valletta, where the Office of the Prime Minister is located.

collocations.en: in front of the Auberge de Castille
collocations.zh: 在卡斯蒂利亚骑士旅舍前

formal.mt: Il-Berġa ta' Kastilija fil-Belt Valletta tospita l-Uffiċċju tal-Prim Ministru.
formal.en: The Auberge de Castille in Valletta houses the Office of the Prime Minister.
formal.zh: 瓦莱塔的卡斯蒂利亚骑士旅舍是首相办公室所在地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niltaqgħu quddiem Kastilija fis-sitta? Mark: Iva, narak hemm fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet in front of the Auberge de Castille at six? Mark: Yes, I'll see you there at six.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们六点在卡斯蒂利亚骑士旅舍前见面好吗？马克：好，六点在那里见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Niltaqgħu quddiem Kastilija fis-sitta?
messages.mt_standard: Niltaqgħu quddiem Kastilija fis-sitta?
messages.zh: 我们六点在卡斯蒂利亚骑士旅舍前见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet in front of the Auberge de Castille at six?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, narak hemm fis-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, narak hemm fis-sitta.
messages.zh: 好，六点在那里见。
messages.en: Yes, I'll see you there at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kastilija 配成两张记忆卡：地图上写“卡斯蒂利亚地区”，瓦莱塔街景上写“首相办公室所在的骑士旅舍”；遇到“在门前见面”这样的语境，就想到建筑义。

gloss_zh: 卡斯蒂利亚的；来自卡斯蒂利亚的；西班牙语卡斯蒂利亚变体的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to or coming from Castille, or describing the Castilian variety of Spanish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容与卡斯蒂利亚有关或来自该地区的事物，也用于描述西班牙语的卡斯蒂利亚变体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa marbuta ma' Kastilija jew li ġejja minn hemm, jew li tirreferi għall-varjetà tal-Ispanjol ta' Kastilija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卡斯蒂利亚的，表示具有该地区的关联或特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa bħala marbuta ma' Kastilija jew mal-karatteristiċi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as Castilian has a connection with Castille or its characteristics.

sense_translations.en_definition: related to or coming from Castille
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与卡斯蒂利亚有关的，或来自卡斯蒂利亚的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa għandha rabta ma' Kastilija jew li l-oriġini tagħha hija f'dak ir-reġjun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Castilian is associated with Castille or comes from that region.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于描述西班牙语的卡斯蒂利亚变体或属于这一变体的语言表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta jintuża dwar il-lingwa, jiddeskrivi l-varjetà tal-Ispanjol ta' Kastilija jew kliem u testi f'dik il-varjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a language context, Castilian describes the variety of Spanish associated with Castille.

collocations.zh: 一篇用卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语写成的文本

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi qari ta' testi bl-Ispanjol kastiljan u diskussjoni dwar il-kultura kastiljana.
formal.en: The course includes reading texts in Castilian Spanish and discussing Castilian culture.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括阅读卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语文本，以及讨论卡斯蒂利亚文化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-test huwa bl-Ispanjol kastiljan? Pawlu: Iva, se naqrawh flimkien fil-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this text in Castilian Spanish? Pawlu: Yes, we're going to read it together in class.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文本用的是卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语吗？保罗：是的，我们会在课上一起读。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-test huwa bl-Ispanjol kastiljan?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-test huwa bl-Ispanjol kastiljan?
messages.zh: 这篇文本用的是卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语吗？
messages.en: Is this text in Castilian Spanish?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se naqrawh flimkien fil-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se naqrawh flimkien fil-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，我们会在课上一起读。
messages.en: Yes, we're going to read it together in class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kastiljan 记成贴在名词旁的“卡斯蒂利亚的”标签：贴在文化上表示地区关联，贴在西班牙语上表示语言变体；用 test kastiljan 与 kultura kastiljana 成对记忆词形搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Underground burial chambers or passages used for burying the dead.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于地下、用于安葬死者的墓室或通道，常指相连的地下墓穴群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kmamar jew passaġġi taħt l-art li kienu jintużaw għad-dfin tal-mejtin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于安葬死者的地下墓室或墓道；该词形可指地下墓穴群。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post tad-dfin taħt l-art li jista' jinkludi kmamar u passaġġi fejn kienu jitqiegħdu l-mejtin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A catacomb is an underground chamber or passage used as a burial place.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-katakombi, il-gwida spjegat kif il-kmamar ta' taħt l-art kienu jintużaw għad-dfin.
formal.en: During the visit to the catacombs, the guide explained how the underground chambers were used for burials.
formal.zh: 参观地下墓穴时，导游解释了这些地下墓室过去如何用于安葬死者。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi d-daħla tal-katakombi? David: Hemm ħdejn it-taraġ; ejja mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the entrance to the catacombs? David: Over there by the steps; let's go together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：地下墓穴的入口在哪里？戴维：在那边台阶旁，我们一起过去吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi d-daħla tal-katakombi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi d-daħla tal-katakombi?
messages.zh: 地下墓穴的入口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the entrance to the catacombs?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħdejn it-taraġ; ejja mmorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħdejn it-taraġ; ejja mmorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 在那边台阶旁，我们一起过去吧。
messages.en: Over there by the steps; let's go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 katakombi 时想象沿台阶走入地下，通道两侧连着安葬死者的墓室；把“地下、墓室、相连通道”三幅画面绑在一起，区别于普通洞穴。

gloss_zh: 目录；商品目录；分类编目清单

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized list of items, often with descriptions, used to show what is available or held in a collection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一定次序编排的项目清单，常附有说明，用于展示可供选择的商品或某个收藏中的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lista organizzata ta' oġġetti, spiss b'deskrizzjonijiet, li turi x'hemm għall-bejgħ jew x'hemm f'kollezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按一定次序编排的目录或清单，列出商品、书籍或其他项目，并可附有相关说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lista mqassma b'ordni li fiha jiġu elenkati prodotti, kotba jew oġġetti oħra, kultant flimkien ma' tagħrif dwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A catalog is an organized list that gives information about products, books, or other items.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-librerija jippermetti lill-qarrejja jfittxu l-kotba skont l-awtur jew it-titlu.
formal.en: The library catalog allows readers to search for books by author or title.
formal.zh: 图书馆目录让读者可以按作者或书名查找图书。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom katalgu tal-prodotti? Rita: Iva, hawn wieħed; il-prezzijiet jinsabu ħdejn ir-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a product catalog? Rita: Yes, here's one; the prices are next to the pictures.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有商品目录吗？丽塔：有，这里有一本，价格就在图片旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom katalgu tal-prodotti?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom katalgu tal-prodotti?
messages.zh: 你们有商品目录吗？
messages.en: Do you have a product catalog?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed; il-prezzijiet jinsabu ħdejn ir-ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed; il-prezzijiet jinsabu ħdejn ir-ritratti.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一本，价格就在图片旁边。
messages.en: Yes, here's one; the prices are next to the pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 katalgu 和英语 catalog 并排写在记忆卡上，再画一本按顺序列出商品图片与价格的小册子；记住核心是“有序列出项目的目录”，也能用于图书馆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A catalogue in digital form that users can browse to find items and information about them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以数字形式呈现、供使用者浏览查找条目及其相关信息的目录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lista organizzata f'format diġitali li tippermetti lill-utenti jfittxu oġġetti u informazzjoni dwarhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子目录，供使用者通过电子设备浏览条目和相关资料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Katalogu f'format diġitali li wieħed jista' juża biex jara lista ta' oġġetti u tagħrif dwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-catalogue is a digital list that people browse to find items and information about them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子形式的目录，将物品、出版物等条目及其资料有序列出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra organizzata ta' entrati u informazzjoni dwar oġġetti jew pubblikazzjonijiet, ippreżentata f'forma elettronika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic catalogue presents an organized collection of entries and their details in a digital format.

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jużaw il-katalogu elettroniku tal-librerija biex ifittxu kotba skont l-awtur jew it-titlu.
formal.en: Students can use the library's electronic catalogue to search for books by author or title.
formal.zh: 学生可以使用图书馆的电子目录，按作者或书名检索图书。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nista' nsib dan il-ktieb? Mark: Fittex it-titlu fil-katalogu elettroniku. Lara: Tajjeb, se nipprova issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I find this book? Mark: Search for the title in the electronic catalogue. Lara: All right, I'll try now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我怎么才能找到这本书？马克：在电子目录里搜一下书名。拉拉：好，我现在试试。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nsib dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nsib dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 我怎么才能找到这本书？
messages.en: How can I find this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittex it-titlu fil-katalogu elettroniku.
messages.mt_standard: Fittex it-titlu fil-katalogu elettroniku.
messages.zh: 在电子目录里搜一下书名。
messages.en: Search for the title in the electronic catalogue.

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nipprova issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nipprova issa.
messages.zh: 好，我现在试试。
messages.en: All right, I'll try now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在图书馆电脑上输入书名：屏幕上可检索的目录就是 katalogu elettroniku，把整个词组与这个操作画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 灾难性的；造成极严重后果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing extremely serious damage, suffering, or failure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成极其严重的破坏、痛苦或失败的；灾难性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża ħsara kbira ħafna, tbatija serja jew falliment kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灾难性的，指造成极严重破坏、损失或失败的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jwassal għal diżastru jew għal konsegwenzi gravi ħafna, bħal ħsara estensiva jew telf kbir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something catastrophic causes extremely serious damage or leads to a disastrous result.

collocations.zh: 造成极严重后果的错误

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iwissi li nuqqas ta' manutenzjoni jista' jkollu effett katastrofiku fuq is-sigurtà tal-bini.
formal.en: The report warns that a lack of maintenance could have a catastrophic effect on the building's safety.
formal.zh: 报告警告，缺乏维护可能对建筑物的安全造成灾难性的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar il-proġett? Daniel: Ir-riżultat kien katastrofiku; tlifna x-xogħol kollu li konna għamilna. Maja: Kemm hi ħasra! Kellkom kopja oħra?
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the project go? Daniel: The result was catastrophic; we lost all the work we had done. Maja: What a shame! Did you have another copy?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：项目进行得怎么样？丹尼尔：结果太惨了，我们做好的东西全丢了。玛雅：太可惜了！你们还有别的副本吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar il-proġett?
messages.zh: 项目进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the project go?

messages.speaker: Daniel (项目成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riżultat kien katastrofiku; tlifna x-xogħol kollu li konna għamilna.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riżultat kien katastrofiku; tlifna x-xogħol kollu li konna għamilna.
messages.zh: 结果太惨了，我们做好的东西全丢了。
messages.en: The result was catastrophic; we lost all the work we had done.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi ħasra! Kellkom kopja oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi ħasra! Kellkom kopja oħra?
messages.zh: 太可惜了！你们还有别的副本吗？
messages.en: What a shame! Did you have another copy?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“全部成果毁于一旦”的画面记住 katastrofiku，并搭配 riżultat 一起读，突出后果极其严重的程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The body of a person who has died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经死亡的人的身体；尸体或遗体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人的尸体，即人死亡后留下的身体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġisem ta' bniedem wara li jkun miet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corpse is the body of a person who is dead.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tal-pulizija, instab katavru f'bini abbandunat u għadha għaddejja l-investigazzjoni.
formal.en: According to the police report, a body was found in an abandoned building and the investigation is still ongoing.
formal.zh: 据警方报告，一栋废弃建筑内发现了一具尸体，调查仍在进行中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt li sabu katavru fil-bini l-antik. Pawlu: Jafu min kienet il-persuna? Sara: Għadhom ma qalux.
colloquial.en: Sara: I read that they found a body in the old building. Pawlu: Do they know who the person was? Sara: They haven't said yet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我看到消息说，他们在那栋旧楼里发现了一具尸体。保罗：知道死者是谁了吗？萨拉：他们还没公布。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt li sabu katavru fil-bini l-antik.
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt li sabu katavru fil-bini l-antik.
messages.zh: 我看到消息说，他们在那栋旧楼里发现了一具尸体。
messages.en: I read that they found a body in the old building.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jafu min kienet il-persuna?
messages.mt_standard: Jafu min kienet il-persuna?
messages.zh: 知道死者是谁了吗？
messages.en: Do they know who the person was?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadhom ma qalux.
messages.mt_standard: Għadhom ma qalux.
messages.zh: 他们还没公布。
messages.en: They haven't said yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 katavru 放进“警方发现一具尸体”的新闻句中记忆，牢记它指人死亡后的身体，中文可依语境译为尸体或遗体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people or things classified together because they share particular characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因具有某些共同特征而划分在一起的一组人或事物；类别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies jew affarijiet miġbura flimkien għax għandhom ċerti karatteristiċi komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 类别，按共同特征对人或事物进行划分后形成的一类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klassi jew grupp li fih jitqiegħdu nies jew affarijiet skont karatteristiċi li għandhom komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A category is a group whose members share characteristics used to classify them together.

formal.mt: Kull prodott għandu jitqiegħed fil-kategorija xierqa skont il-funzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: Each product should be placed in the appropriate category according to its function.
formal.zh: 每件产品都应根据其功能归入适当的类别。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn insib il-kotba tat-tisjir? Lara: Taħt il-kategorija 'Ikel u xorb', fuq dik l-ixkaffa. Anna: Grazzi, issa naf fejn infittex.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where can I find the cookbooks? Lara: Under the category 'Food and drink', on that shelf. Anna: Thanks, now I know where to look.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：烹饪书在哪里？拉拉：在“饮食”类别下面，就在那个书架上。安娜：谢谢，现在我知道去哪里找了。

messages.speaker: Anna (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib il-kotba tat-tisjir?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib il-kotba tat-tisjir?
messages.zh: 烹饪书在哪里？
messages.en: Where can I find the cookbooks?

messages.speaker: Lara (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt il-kategorija 'Ikel u xorb', fuq dik l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt il-kategorija 'Ikel u xorb', fuq dik l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 在“饮食”类别下面，就在那个书架上。
messages.en: Under the category 'Food and drink', on that shelf.

messages.speaker: Anna (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, issa naf fejn infittex.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, issa naf fejn infittex.
messages.zh: 谢谢，现在我知道去哪里找了。
messages.en: Thanks, now I know where to look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给书架贴上“饮食、历史、文学”等分类标签：每一个标签代表一个 kategorija，用分类整理的动作帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 断然的；明确而不容置疑的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clear, definite, and expressed without qualification or room for doubt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指说法、回答或立场明确而坚定，没有保留，不留下怀疑或含糊的余地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi tweġiba, stqarrija jew pożizzjoni b'mod ċar u deċiż, mingħajr riżervi jew lok għal dubju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 断然的；明确坚定、毫无保留或不容置疑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ċar u deċiż u ma jħalli ebda dubju dwar dak li jkun qed jingħad jew jiġi deċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a statement or response is categorical, it is expressed firmly and leaves no room for doubt.

collocations.zh: 明确而毫无保留的回答

formal.mt: Il-kumitat esprima rifjut kategoriku tal-proposta u spjega r-raġunijiet tiegħu bil-miktub.
formal.en: The committee expressed a categorical rejection of the proposal and explained its reasons in writing.
formal.zh: 委员会明确否决了该提案，并以书面形式说明了理由。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qallek li forsi jaċċetta? Pawlu: Le, ir-rifjut tiegħu kien kategoriku. Qal li żgur mhux se jaċċetta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he say he might accept? Pawlu: No, his refusal was categorical. He said he definitely wouldn't accept.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他说有可能接受吗？Pawlu：没有，他拒绝得很坚决。他说肯定不会接受。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qallek li forsi jaċċetta?
messages.mt_standard: Qallek li forsi jaċċetta?
messages.zh: 他说有可能接受吗？
messages.en: Did he say he might accept?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ir-rifjut tiegħu kien kategoriku. Qal li żgur mhux se jaċċetta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ir-rifjut tiegħu kien kategoriku. Qal li żgur mhux se jaċċetta.
messages.zh: 没有，他拒绝得很坚决。他说肯定不会接受。
messages.en: No, his refusal was categorical. He said he definitely wouldn't accept.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kategoriku 和“斩钉截铁的回答”绑定记忆：想象对方明确说“不”，没有任何“也许”；搭配 rifjut kategoriku 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book or collection of basic Christian teachings, often presented as questions and answers for religious instruction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于宗教教育、介绍基督教基本信仰和教义的书籍或教理汇编，常采用问答形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb jew ġabra tat-tagħlim bażiku tal-fidi Nisranija, spiss f'għamla ta' mistoqsijiet u tweġibiet, għall-edukazzjoni reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教理问答；系统介绍基督教基本信仰与教义、常以问答形式编写的教材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb jew ġabra li tispjega l-prinċipji ewlenin tal-fidi Nisranija, ħafna drabi permezz ta' mistoqsijiet u tweġibiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A catechism is a book explaining the basic beliefs of Christianity, often through questions and answers.

collocations.en: questions and answers in the catechism
collocations.zh: 教理问答中的问题与回答

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema użat il-katekiżmu biex tispjega t-tagħlim bażiku tal-fidi Nisranija.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher used the catechism to explain the basic teachings of the Christian faith.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师使用教理问答教材讲解了基督教信仰的基本教义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed taqra? Mark: Qed naqra l-katekiżmu biex nifhem aħjar it-tagħlim tal-Knisja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading? Mark: I'm reading the catechism to understand the Church's teachings better.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你在读什么？Mark：我在读教理问答，好更清楚地理解教会的教义。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra l-katekiżmu biex nifhem aħjar it-tagħlim tal-Knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra l-katekiżmu biex nifhem aħjar it-tagħlim tal-Knisja.
messages.zh: 我在读教理问答，好更清楚地理解教会的教义。
messages.en: I'm reading the catechism to understand the Church's teachings better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本摊开的宗教教材：左边提出信仰问题，右边解释教义。用这个“教理一问一答”的画面记住 katekiżmu。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The principal church of a diocese, containing the bishop's official seat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个教区的主要教堂，内设主教的正式座位，是主教座堂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-knisja ewlenija ta' djoċesi, li fiha jinsab is-siġġu uffiċjali tal-isqof.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主教座堂；设有主教正式座位的教区主要教堂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Knisja li sservi bħala l-knisja ewlenija ta' djoċesi u li fiha jinsab is-siġġu tal-isqof.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cathedral is the principal church of a diocese and contains the bishop's official seat.

formal.mt: Il-gwida spjegat li l-katidral huwa l-knisja ewlenija tad-djoċesi u li fih jinsab is-siġġu tal-isqof.
formal.en: The guide explained that the cathedral is the principal church of the diocese and contains the bishop's seat.
formal.zh: 导游解释说，主教座堂是该教区的主要教堂，里面设有主教座位。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se niltaqgħu? David: Quddiem il-katidral, ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we meet? David: In front of the cathedral, beside the main entrance.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们在哪里见面？David：在主教座堂前面，正门旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Quddiem il-katidral, ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali.
messages.mt_standard: Quddiem il-katidral, ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali.
messages.zh: 在主教座堂前面，正门旁边。
messages.en: In front of the cathedral, beside the main entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 katidral 时想象教堂里主教的正式座位，把“主教有座位”与“主教座堂”连起来；判断重点是主教座位，而不是建筑大小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A network of people, organizations, and activities involved in supplying a product to its final customer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将产品供应给最终客户所涉及的人员、组织和活动构成的网络。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' persuni, organizzazzjonijiet u attivitajiet involuti biex prodott jasal għand il-klijent finali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涵盖原料供应、生产、储存、运输和交付等环节，使产品到达最终客户的供应网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' fornituri, produtturi u distributuri, flimkien mal-attivitajiet tal-ħżin u t-trasport, li jwassal prodott għand il-klijent finali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supply chain includes the organizations and activities needed to produce a product and deliver it to customers.

collocations.zh: 供应链中的中断或紊乱

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tirrevedi l-katina ta' provvista tagħha biex tnaqqas id-dewmien bejn l-ordni tal-materja prima u l-kunsinna tal-prodotti.
formal.en: The company is reviewing its supply chain to reduce delays between ordering raw materials and delivering products.
formal.zh: 公司正在审查其供应链，以减少从订购原料到交付产品之间的延误。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għadha ma waslitx il-mejda li ordnajt? David: Kien hemm dewmien fil-katina ta' provvista; il-fabbrika għadha qed tistenna l-injam.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why hasn't the table I ordered arrived yet? David: There has been a delay in the supply chain; the factory is still waiting for the wood.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我订的桌子为什么还没到？戴维：供应链出现了延误，工厂还在等木材。

messages.speaker: 丽塔（顾客）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadha ma waslitx il-mejda li ordnajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadha ma waslitx il-mejda li ordnajt?
messages.zh: 我订的桌子为什么还没到？
messages.en: Why hasn't the table I ordered arrived yet?

messages.speaker: 戴维（店员）
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm dewmien fil-katina ta' provvista; il-fabbrika għadha qed tistenna l-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm dewmien fil-katina ta' provvista; il-fabbrika għadha qed tistenna l-injam.
messages.zh: 供应链出现了延误，工厂还在等木材。
messages.en: There has been a delay in the supply chain; the factory is still waiting for the wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把原料商、工厂、仓库、运输和买家依次连起来，想象产品沿着这些环节到你手中，就能记住“供应链”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supply chain that uses connected digital systems and shared data to coordinate suppliers, production, and delivery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用相互连接的数字系统和共享数据，协调供应商、生产及交付等环节的供应链。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Katina ta' provvista li tuża sistemi diġitali konnessi u data kondiviża biex tikkoordina l-fornituri, il-produzzjoni u l-kunsinna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数字供应链；通过互联的数字系统及数据共享来管理和协调供应、生产及交付流程的供应链。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' attivitajiet ta' provvista, produzzjoni u kunsinna li huma marbuta u kkoordinati permezz ta' teknoloġiji diġitali u qsim tad-data.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A digital supply chain uses connected technologies and shared data to manage the movement of goods and coordinate supply activities.

formal.mt: L-intrapriża tuża katina tal-provvista diġitali biex issegwi l-prodotti mill-fornitur sal-klijent u taqsam id-data dwar il-kunsinni.
formal.en: The company uses a digital supply chain to track products from supplier to customer and share delivery data.
formal.zh: 该企业使用数字供应链追踪产品从供应商到客户的流转，并共享交付数据。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif taf li l-ordni għadha għand il-fornitur? Toni: Għandna katina tal-provvista diġitali. Nista' nara l-istat tal-ordni fis-sistema.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you know the order is still with the supplier? Toni: We have a digital supply chain. I can see the order's status in the system.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么知道订单还在供应商那边？Toni：我们有数字供应链。我能在系统里查看订单状态。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif taf li l-ordni għadha għand il-fornitur?
messages.mt_standard: Kif taf li l-ordni għadha għand il-fornitur?
messages.zh: 你怎么知道订单还在供应商那边？
messages.en: How do you know the order is still with the supplier?

messages.speaker: Toni (物流专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna katina tal-provvista diġitali. Nista' nara l-istat tal-ordni fis-sistema.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna katina tal-provvista diġitali. Nista' nara l-istat tal-ordni fis-sistema.
messages.zh: 我们有数字供应链。我能在系统里查看订单状态。
messages.en: We have a digital supply chain. I can see the order's status in the system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语画成“供应商→生产→配送→客户”的链条，每一环旁边都有共享数据的屏幕，用这幅图记住“数字供应链”。

gloss_zh: 短供应链；中间环节较少的供应链

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supply chain with few or no intermediaries between producers and consumers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产者与消费者之间仅有少量中间商或没有中间商的供应链。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Katina ta' provvista li fiha jkun hemm ftit intermedjarji jew ma jkun hemm ebda intermedjarju bejn il-produtturi u l-konsumaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产者与消费者之间中间环节较少或没有中间商的短供应链。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' provvista li twassal il-prodotti mingħand il-produtturi għand il-konsumaturi permezz ta' ftit intermedjarji jew mingħajr intermedjarji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A short supply chain connects producers with consumers through few intermediaries or through direct sales.

formal.mt: Il-proġett jippromwovi katina tal-provvista qasira billi jgħin lill-bdiewa jbigħu direttament lill-konsumaturi.
formal.en: The project promotes a short supply chain by helping farmers sell directly to consumers.
formal.zh: 该项目帮助农民直接向消费者销售，以此推动短供应链的发展。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex tixtri l-ħaxix direttament mingħand il-bidwi? Pawlu: Għax hekk nappoġġja katina tal-provvista qasira, bi ftit intermedjarji.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why do you buy vegetables directly from the farmer? Pawlu: Because that way I support a short supply chain with few intermediaries.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么直接向农民买蔬菜？保罗：因为这样能支持中间商较少的短供应链。

messages.speaker: 玛丽亚（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tixtri l-ħaxix direttament mingħand il-bidwi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tixtri l-ħaxix direttament mingħand il-bidwi?
messages.zh: 你为什么直接向农民买蔬菜？
messages.en: Why do you buy vegetables directly from the farmer?

messages.speaker: 保罗（消费者）
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hekk nappoġġja katina tal-provvista qasira, bi ftit intermedjarji.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hekk nappoġġja katina tal-provvista qasira, bi ftit intermedjarji.
messages.zh: 因为这样能支持中间商较少的短供应链。
messages.en: Because that way I support a short supply chain with few intermediaries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把供应链画成农民到买家的连线，中间少画几个环节，就能记住这里的“短”主要指中间环节少。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A connected series of activities that contribute value to a product or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 共同为产品或服务创造价值的一系列相互关联的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet marbuta ma' xulxin li jikkontribwixxu għall-valur ta' prodott jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过相互衔接的活动为产品或服务增加价值的增值链。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet marbuta ma' xulxin li jżidu l-valur ta' prodott jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An added value chain links activities that each contribute additional value to a product or service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从开发、生产到销售等环节中，共同为产品或服务创造价值的一系列关联活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet, bħall-iżvilupp, il-produzzjoni u l-bejgħ, li flimkien joħolqu valur fi prodott jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A value chain consists of connected activities through which a business creates value for its customers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多个增值环节相互连接而成、使产品或服务逐步增加价值的活动链。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Katina ta' attivitajiet li fihom il-valur ta' prodott jew servizz jiżdied permezz tal-kontribut ta' kull stadju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A value-added chain describes linked stages that progressively increase the value of a product or service.

formal.mt: L-analiżi tal-katina tal-valur turi kif id-disinn, il-produzzjoni u s-servizz lill-klijenti jikkontribwixxu għall-valur tal-prodott.
formal.en: The value chain analysis shows how design, production, and customer service contribute to the product's value.
formal.zh: 价值链分析展示了设计、生产和客户服务如何为产品创造价值。

colloquial.mt: Anna: L-ippakkjar ukoll jagħmel parti mill-katina tal-valur? Mark: Iva, għax jipproteġi l-prodott u jagħmilha aktar faċli biex jintuża.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is packaging also part of the value chain? Mark: Yes, because it protects the product and makes it easier to use.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：包装也属于价值链的一部分吗？马克：是的，因为它能保护产品，并让产品更方便使用。

messages.speaker: 安娜（新员工）
messages.mt_spoken: L-ippakkjar ukoll jagħmel parti mill-katina tal-valur?
messages.mt_standard: L-ippakkjar ukoll jagħmel parti mill-katina tal-valur?
messages.zh: 包装也属于价值链的一部分吗？
messages.en: Is packaging also part of the value chain?

messages.speaker: 马克（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax jipproteġi l-prodott u jagħmilha aktar faċli biex jintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax jipproteġi l-prodott u jagħmilha aktar faċli biex jintuża.
messages.zh: 是的，因为它能保护产品，并让产品更方便使用。
messages.en: Yes, because it protects the product and makes it easier to use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象设计、生产、包装和售后串成一条链，每个环节都为顾客增加一点用处，便能记住“价值链”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A series of linked activities that add value to a product or service at successive stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在连续的不同阶段为产品或服务增加价值的一系列关联活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet marbuta ma' xulxin li jżidu l-valur ta' prodott jew servizz fi stadji suċċessivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多个关联活动构成、在各阶段为产品或服务增加价值的增值链。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet li jikkontribwixxu, stadju wara ieħor, biex jiżdied il-valur ta' prodott jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An added value chain comprises connected activities that increase the value offered by a product or service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由各个价值创造环节连接而成、共同提升产品或服务价值的活动链。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Katina ta' attivitajiet li flimkien joħolqu u jżidu l-valur ta' prodott jew servizz għall-klijent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A value chain links the activities that together create and increase value for the customer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使产品或服务通过连续环节逐步增值的一系列相互关联的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' stadji marbuta ma' xulxin li permezz tagħhom prodott jew servizz jikseb valur addizzjonali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A value-added chain follows successive stages through which a product or service gains additional value.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-katina tal-valur miżjud tal-ħalib, mill-ipproċessar sal-ippakkjar u l-bejgħ tal-ġobon.
formal.en: The report examines the value-added chain for milk, from processing to the packaging and sale of cheese.
formal.zh: 该报告考察了牛奶的增值链，涵盖从加工到奶酪包装和销售的各个环节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jidħol il-ġobon fil-katina tal-valur miżjud tal-ħalib? Ġużeppi: Meta nagħmlu l-ġobon, inżidu l-valur tal-ħalib permezz tal-ipproċessar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does cheese fit into the value-added chain for milk? Ġużeppi: When we make cheese, we add value to the milk through processing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：奶酪在牛奶的增值链中起什么作用？朱塞佩：制作奶酪时，我们通过加工为牛奶增加价值。

messages.speaker: 拉拉（学生）
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jidħol il-ġobon fil-katina tal-valur miżjud tal-ħalib?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jidħol il-ġobon fil-katina tal-valur miżjud tal-ħalib?
messages.zh: 奶酪在牛奶的增值链中起什么作用？
messages.en: How does cheese fit into the value-added chain for milk?

messages.speaker: 朱塞佩（奶酪制作师）
messages.mt_spoken: Meta nagħmlu l-ġobon, inżidu l-valur tal-ħalib permezz tal-ipproċessar.
messages.mt_standard: Meta nagħmlu l-ġobon, inżidu l-valur tal-ħalib permezz tal-ipproċessar.
messages.zh: 制作奶酪时，我们通过加工为牛奶增加价值。
messages.en: When we make cheese, we add value to the milk through processing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“牛奶加工成奶酪，再包装销售”的画面记忆：每经过一个环节都增加价值，连起来就是增值链。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chains consisting of connected links, used to secure, fasten, or pull things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一系列相互连接的链环组成、用于固定、锁住或牵拉物体的链条；本词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti magħmulin minn ħoloq imqabbda ma' xulxin, li jintużaw biex iżommu, jorbtu jew jiġbdu affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多个链环相连而成的链条或锁链；此处词形表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' ħoloq imqabbda ma' xulxin, ġeneralment tal-metall, li tintuża biex torbot jew iżżomm xi ħaġa; il-kelma hawnhekk hija fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Chains are lengths of connected links that you use to secure, fasten, or pull something.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema użaw katini tal-ħadid biex iżommu l-bieb magħluq.
formal.en: The workers used iron chains to keep the gate closed.
formal.zh: 工人们用铁链把大门锁住。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn qegħdin il-katini? Lara: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb. Għandek bżonnhom issa?
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are the chains? Lara: In the box beside the door. Do you need them now?
colloquial.zh: 马克：链条放在哪里？劳拉：在门旁边的箱子里。你现在要用吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qegħdin il-katini?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qegħdin il-katini?
messages.zh: 链条放在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the chains?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb. Għandek bżonnhom issa?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb. Għandek bżonnhom issa?
messages.zh: 在门旁边的箱子里。你现在要用吗？
messages.en: In the box beside the door. Do you need them now?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 katini 配上一幅多条铁链的图来记：每条链都由圆环相扣，并提醒自己这里是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable lock with a curved metal bar that closes through a chain, ring, or fitting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有可开合金属锁梁、能够穿过链条、锁环或锁扣来锁住物品的便携式挂锁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serratura li tista' tinġarr u li għandha ħadida mgħawġa li tinfetaħ u tingħalaq biex tgħaddi minn ħolqa, katina jew qafla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挂锁，具有可开合锁梁、可挂在锁扣或链条上的独立锁具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serratura separata b'ħadida mgħawġa li tinfetaħ u tingħalaq, u li tintuża biex tissakkar katina, bieb jew kaxxa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A padlock is a portable lock that you attach to a chain or fitting to keep something closed.

formal.mt: Wara l-ispezzjoni, il-ħaddiem sakkar il-bieb tal-maħżen b'katnazz.
formal.en: After the inspection, the worker secured the storeroom door with a padlock.
formal.zh: 检查结束后，工人用挂锁锁好了储藏室的门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek iċ-ċavetta tal-katnazz? Pawlu: Iva, hawn qiegħda. Trid tiftaħ il-bieb?
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got the padlock key? Pawlu: Yes, here it is. Do you want to open the gate?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：挂锁的钥匙在你那里吗？保罗：在，这就是。你要打开大门吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek iċ-ċavetta tal-katnazz?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek iċ-ċavetta tal-katnazz?
messages.zh: 挂锁的钥匙在你那里吗？
messages.en: Have you got the padlock key?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn qiegħda. Trid tiftaħ il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn qiegħda. Trid tiftaħ il-bieb?
messages.zh: 在，这就是。你要打开大门吗？
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Do you want to open the gate?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 katnazz 时想象一把挂在铁链上的小锁，再连着记“挂锁的钥匙”，把物品和使用场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel behaviour or an attitude that deliberately causes suffering or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意让他人或动物遭受痛苦的残忍行为，或表现出恶毒的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba jew attitudni krudili li biha xi ħadd iweġġa' lil ħaddieħor jew lil annimal apposta, jew iġiegħlu jbati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 残忍，指故意造成他人或动物痛苦的行为或心态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-imġiba ta' min ikun krudili u jikkawża tbatija jew uġigħ lil ħaddieħor jew lill-annimali apposta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cruelty is behaviour that deliberately causes pain or suffering to other people or animals.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva l-kattiverija li biha kienu ġew trattati l-annimali.
formal.en: The report described the cruelty with which the animals had been treated.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这些动物所遭受的残忍对待。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex daħqu bih meta waqa'? Mark: Dik kienet kattiverija. Messhom għenuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did they laugh at him when he fell? Mark: That was cruel. They should have helped him.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：他摔倒时，他们为什么嘲笑他？马克：那太恶毒了。他们本该帮他的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex daħqu bih meta waqa'?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex daħqu bih meta waqa'?
messages.zh: 他摔倒时，他们为什么嘲笑他？
messages.en: Why did they laugh at him when he fell?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik kienet kattiverija. Messhom għenuh.
messages.mt_standard: Dik kienet kattiverija. Messhom għenuh.
messages.zh: 那太恶毒了。他们本该帮他的。
messages.en: That was cruel. They should have helped him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kattiverija 放进“别人摔倒却故意嘲笑”的情境：记住它强调残忍或恶毒，而不是普通的不友好。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who belongs to the Catholic Church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于天主教会、信奉天主教的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappartjeni għall-Knisja Kattolika u tħaddan il-fidi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天主教徒，即属于天主教会的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li hija membru tal-Knisja Kattolika u temmen fit-tagħlim tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Catholic is someone who belongs to the Catholic Church.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天主教的；与天主教会、信仰或教义有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Knisja Kattolika, mal-fidi tagħha jew mat-tagħlim tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is catholic relates to the Catholic Church, its beliefs, or its practices.

collocations.zh: 恪守宗教生活的天主教徒

formal.mt: Fl-esej tiegħu, Pawlu jispjega xi jfisser għalih li jkun Kattoliku u kif il-fidi tinfluwenza l-ħajja tiegħu.
formal.en: In his essay, Paul explains what being a Catholic means to him and how faith influences his life.
formal.zh: 保罗在文章中解释了身为天主教徒对他意味着什么，以及信仰如何影响他的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Kattoliku? Pawlu: Iva, jien Kattoliku u mmur il-quddies kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you a Catholic? Paul: Yes, I'm a Catholic, and I go to Mass every Sunday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是天主教徒吗？保罗：是的，我是天主教徒，每个星期日都去参加弥撒。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int Kattoliku?
messages.mt_standard: Int Kattoliku?
messages.zh: 你是天主教徒吗？
messages.en: Are you a Catholic?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien Kattoliku u mmur il-quddies kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien Kattoliku u mmur il-quddies kull nhar ta' Ħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，我是天主教徒，每个星期日都去参加弥撒。
messages.en: Yes, I'm a Catholic, and I go to Mass every Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片区分词性：人物卡写 Kattoliku，记“天主教徒”；教义卡写 tagħlim kattoliku，记“天主教的教义”。

gloss_zh: 天主教；天主教信仰体系

teaching_sense.en_definition: The religious beliefs, teachings, and practices of the Catholic Church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天主教会所持守的宗教信仰、教义及宗教实践的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twemmin reliġjuż, it-tagħlim u l-prattiki tal-Knisja Kattolika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天主教，指天主教会的信仰、教义和宗教实践体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-reliġjon tal-Knisja Kattolika, flimkien mat-twemmin, it-tagħlim u l-prattiki tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Catholicism is the religion expressed in the beliefs, teachings, and practices of the Catholic Church.

formal.mt: L-istudenti studjaw it-twemmin u l-prattiki tal-kattoliċiżmu fil-lezzjoni tar-reliġjon.
formal.en: The students studied the beliefs and practices of Catholicism in their religion lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在宗教课上学习了天主教的信仰和宗教实践。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'qed taqra? Maja: Qed naqra ktieb dwar il-kattoliċiżmu. Jispjega t-twemmin u l-prattiki tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What are you reading? Maja: I'm reading a book about Catholicism. It explains its beliefs and practices.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你在读什么？玛雅：我在读一本介绍天主教的书。书里解释了它的信仰和宗教实践。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra ktieb dwar il-kattoliċiżmu. Jispjega t-twemmin u l-prattiki tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra ktieb dwar il-kattoliċiżmu. Jispjega t-twemmin u l-prattiki tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我在读一本介绍天主教的书。书里解释了它的信仰和宗教实践。
messages.en: I'm reading a book about Catholicism. It explains its beliefs and practices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kattoliċiżmu 想成一本写着“天主教”的宗教介绍书，书中有信仰、教义和实践，帮助记住它指整套宗教体系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea fish with a striped back and oily flesh, often eaten as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种背部有条纹、鱼肉富含油脂的海鱼，常供食用，称为鲭鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar b'daharha mmarkat bi strixxi u b'laħam żejtni, li tittiekel bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲭鱼，一种背部有条纹、肉质富含油脂的食用海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar li għandha strixxi fuq daharha u laħam żejtni u li tintuża fl-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mackerel is a sea fish with a striped back and oily flesh that people eat.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob kavall frisk, li jitħawwar bil-melħ u bil-bżar qabel ma jissajjar fil-forn.
formal.en: The recipe calls for fresh mackerel, seasoned with salt and pepper before being cooked in the oven.
formal.zh: 这份食谱需要新鲜鲭鱼，先用盐和胡椒调味，再放入烤箱烹制。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek kavall frisk illum? Rita: Iva, kemm trid? Mark: Tnejn, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh mackerel today? Rita: Yes, how many would you like? Mark: Two, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天有新鲜鲭鱼吗？丽塔：有，你要几条？马克：请给我两条。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek kavall frisk illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek kavall frisk illum?
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜鲭鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh mackerel today?

messages.speaker: Rita (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kemm trid?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kemm trid?
messages.zh: 有，你要几条？
messages.en: Yes, how many would you like?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnejn, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Tnejn, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我两条。
messages.en: Two, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kavall 放进鱼摊画面记忆：看见条纹鱼背就想“鲭鱼”，再用 kavall frisk 和 kavall mixwi 串起购买与烹饪场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stand that holds a canvas or picture upright while someone paints or displays it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于支撑画布或画板，使其保持直立或倾斜位置，方便绘画或展示的架子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qafas li jżomm tila jew stampa wieqfa jew immejla biex wieħed ikun jista' jpinġi fuqha jew juriha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 画架，用于支撑画布、画板或画作，以便绘画或展示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qafas li fuqu titqiegħed tila jew stampa biex tinżamm f'pożizzjoni xierqa għall-pittura jew għall-wiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An easel is a stand used to support a canvas or picture while it is painted or displayed.

collocations.en: to place the canvas on the easel

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet tpinġi, l-artista poġġiet it-tila fuq il-kavallett u aġġustat l-għoli tiegħu.
formal.en: Before she began painting, the artist placed the canvas on the easel and adjusted its height.
formal.zh: 开始绘画前，画家把画布放在画架上，并调整了画架的高度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi din it-tila? Lara: Fuq il-kavallett ħdejn it-tieqa. Hemmhekk għandek dawl tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put this canvas? Lara: On the easel next to the window. You have good light there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块画布放在哪里？拉拉：放在窗边的画架上。那里光线很好。

messages.speaker: Nina (绘画学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi din it-tila?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi din it-tila?
messages.zh: 这块画布放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this canvas?

messages.speaker: Lara (绘画老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-kavallett ħdejn it-tieqa. Hemmhekk għandek dawl tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-kavallett ħdejn it-tieqa. Hemmhekk għandek dawl tajjeb.
messages.zh: 放在窗边的画架上。那里光线很好。
messages.en: On the easel next to the window. You have good light there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗边一块画布被架子稳稳托住，把 kavallett 贴在架子上；连读 fuq il-kavallett，记住“在画架上”的位置关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man with the rank of knight, especially one portrayed as an armed warrior in stories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有骑士身份的男子，尤其指故事中身穿盔甲、携带武器的骑士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li għandu l-grad ta' kavallier, speċjalment wieħed li jidher fl-istejjer bħala ġellied bl-armatura u bl-armi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑士，具有骑士身份的男子；故事中常描写为身穿盔甲的武士。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raġel li jġorr it-titlu ta' kavallier u li fl-istejjer spiss jiġi deskritt bħala ġellied liebes l-armatura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A knight is a man who holds the rank of knight, often depicted in stories as a warrior wearing armour.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kavallier qalbieni joqgħod quddiem il-bieb tal-kastell biex jipproteġi lin-nies ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: In the story, the brave knight stands in front of the castle gate to protect the people inside.
formal.zh: 故事中，勇敢的骑士守在城堡大门前，保护里面的人。

colloquial.mt: Leo: Min hu dak bl-armatura fl-istampa? Sara: Dak hu kavallier. Fl-istorja, jgħin lin-nies tal-villaġġ.
colloquial.en: Leo: Who is that wearing armour in the picture? Sara: That's a knight. In the story, he helps the villagers.
colloquial.zh: 利奥：图里那个穿盔甲的人是谁？萨拉：那是一位骑士。故事里，他帮助村民。

messages.speaker: Leo (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak bl-armatura fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak bl-armatura fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图里那个穿盔甲的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that wearing armour in the picture?

messages.speaker: Sara (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu kavallier. Fl-istorja, jgħin lin-nies tal-villaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu kavallier. Fl-istorja, jgħin lin-nies tal-villaġġ.
messages.zh: 那是一位骑士。故事里，他帮助村民。
messages.en: That's a knight. In the story, he helps the villagers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kavallier 配一幅城堡门前的盔甲人物图，记作“骑士”；再加 qalbieni 组成“勇敢的骑士”，用人物和品质一起巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pin used to join parts, or a wooden or plastic plug into which a screw is tightened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于连接部件的小销钉，或供螺钉旋入并拧紧的木制或塑料固定塞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira li tiddaħħal f'toqba biex tgħaqqad partijiet, jew biċċa tal-injam jew tal-plastik li fiha jissikka kamin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嵌入配合孔中，用于连接或定位部件的销钉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira, ġeneralment ċilindrika, li tiddaħħal f'toqob f'żewġ partijiet biex tgħaqqadhom jew iżżommhom f'posthom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dowel is a small pin fitted into matching holes to join parts or hold them in position.

sense_translations.en_definition: wooden or plastic plug into which a screw is tightened
sense_translations.zh_definition: 放入孔中、供螺钉旋入并拧紧以固定物件的木制或塑料塞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira tal-injam jew tal-plastik li titqiegħed f'toqba u li fiha jiddaħħal u jissikka kamin biex jinżamm oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This kind of plug fits into a hole and holds a screw firmly when it is tightened.

collocations.en: insert a dowel or plug into the hole
collocations.zh: 把销钉或固定塞插入孔中

formal.mt: Biex jitwaħħal l-ixkaffar mal-ħajt, għandha tiddaħħal kavilja tal-plastik fit-toqba qabel ma jissikka l-kamin.
formal.en: To attach the shelving to the wall, a plastic plug should be inserted into the hole before the screw is tightened.
formal.zh: 把置物架固定到墙上时，应先在孔中放入塑料固定塞，再拧紧螺钉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kamin mhux qed iżomm fil-ħajt. Rita: Daħħal kavilja tal-plastik fit-toqba, imbagħad erġa' ssikka l-kamin.
colloquial.en: Mark: The screw isn't holding in the wall. Rita: Put a plastic plug into the hole, then tighten the screw again.
colloquial.zh: Mark：螺钉在墙里固定不住。Rita：先在孔里放一个塑料固定塞，然后再把螺钉拧紧。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kamin mhux qed iżomm fil-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kamin mhux qed iżomm fil-ħajt.
messages.zh: 螺钉在墙里固定不住。
messages.en: The screw isn't holding in the wall.

messages.speaker: Rita (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħħal kavilja tal-plastik fit-toqba, imbagħad erġa' ssikka l-kamin.
messages.mt_standard: Daħħal kavilja tal-plastik fit-toqba, imbagħad erġa' ssikka l-kamin.
messages.zh: 先在孔里放一个塑料固定塞，然后再把螺钉拧紧。
messages.en: Put a plastic plug into the hole, then tighten the screw again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kavilja 和“孔里的小帮手”联系起来：连接木件时是销钉，固定螺钉时是塞子；用两幅安装画面区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reddish-brown hardwood used for furniture and other wooden objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种呈红褐色的硬木，常用于制作家具等木制品，即桃花心木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Injam iebes ta' lewn kannella fl-aħmar, li jintuża biex isiru għamara u oġġetti oħra tal-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桃花心木，一种呈红褐色、用于制作家具等物品的硬木。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Injam iebes ta' lewn kannella fl-aħmar li jintuża għall-għamara u għal xogħol ieħor tal-injam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mahogany is a reddish-brown hardwood that is used to make furniture and other wooden objects.

formal.mt: Il-mejda tal-kawba għandha wiċċ lixx u lewn kannella fl-aħmar.
formal.en: The mahogany table has a smooth surface and a reddish-brown colour.
formal.zh: 这张桃花心木桌表面光滑，呈红褐色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-mejda minn liema injam hi magħmula? Pawlu: Mill-kawba. Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-lewn tagħha!
colloquial.en: Lara: What wood is this table made of? Pawlu: Mahogany. Look how lovely its colour is!
colloquial.zh: Lara：这张桌子是什么木头做的？Pawlu：桃花心木。你看它的颜色多漂亮！

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-mejda minn liema injam hi magħmula?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-mejda minn liema injam hi magħmula?
messages.zh: 这张桌子是什么木头做的？
messages.en: What wood is this table made of?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家具店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-kawba. Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-lewn tagħha!
messages.mt_standard: Mill-kawba. Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-lewn tagħha!
messages.zh: 桃花心木。你看它的颜色多漂亮！
messages.en: Mahogany. Look how lovely its colour is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kawba 时想象一张红褐色的桃花心木桌，并连读 mejda tal-kawba，把木材名称和具体家具一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Care taken to avoid danger, mistakes, or unwanted consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为避免危险、错误或不良后果而采取的谨慎态度或小心做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attenzjoni u ħsieb fl-aġir biex jiġu evitati perikli, żbalji jew konsegwenzi mhux mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为防止危险、错误或不良后果而表现出的谨慎、小心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attenzjoni li persuna tuża meta taġixxi jew tiddeċiedi, sabiex tevita periklu, żball jew ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Caution is the care you take when acting or deciding in order to avoid danger or mistakes.

formal.mt: Ir-riżultati għandhom jiġu interpretati bil-kawtela, għax l-istudju jinkludi biss għadd żgħir ta' parteċipanti.
formal.en: The results should be interpreted with caution because the study includes only a small number of participants.
formal.zh: 由于这项研究的参与人数很少，应谨慎解读其结果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' ninżel minn dan it-taraġ? Samwel: Iva, imma niżel bil-kawtela għax hu mxarrab.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I go down these stairs? Samwel: Yes, but go down carefully because they're wet.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我可以从这个楼梯下去吗？Samwel：可以，不过楼梯湿了，下去时要小心。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ninżel minn dan it-taraġ?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ninżel minn dan it-taraġ?
messages.zh: 我可以从这个楼梯下去吗？
messages.en: Can I go down these stairs?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma niżel bil-kawtela għax hu mxarrab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma niżel bil-kawtela għax hu mxarrab.
messages.zh: 可以，不过楼梯湿了，下去时要小心。
messages.en: Yes, but go down carefully because they're wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“湿楼梯上放慢脚步”的画面记 kawtela：它表示谨慎；把 bil-kawtela 整体记成“小心地”，方便直接造句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reason or factor that makes something happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某件事情发生的原因或因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġuni jew fattur li jwassal biex tiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致某种事件、情况或结果发生的原因。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li jwassal biex iseħħ avveniment jew biex tinħoloq sitwazzjoni jew konsegwenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The cause of an event is the reason or factor that makes it happen.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika n-nuqqas ta' manutenzjoni bħala l-kawza ewlenija tal-ħsara.
formal.en: The report identifies the lack of maintenance as the main cause of the damage.
formal.zh: 报告指出，缺乏维护是造成损坏的主要原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt il-kawza tal-problema? Mark: Iva, il-kejbil ma kienx imqabbad sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you find the cause of the problem? Mark: Yes, the cable was not connected properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你找到问题的原因了吗？马克：找到了，电缆没有接好。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt il-kawza tal-problema?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt il-kawza tal-problema?
messages.zh: 你找到问题的原因了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the cause of the problem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kejbil ma kienx imqabbad sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kejbil ma kienx imqabbad sew.
messages.zh: 找到了，电缆没有接好。
messages.en: Yes, the cable was not connected properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把问题画成结果，再用箭头往前寻找原因；将 kawza 和“为什么会发生”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that brings about or explains an event, or a legal case heard in court.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引起某事的原因、解释某事的理由，或由法院审理的诉讼案件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jwassal għal ġrajja jew jispjegaha, jew tilwima legali li tinstema' quddiem qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致某个事件、情况或结果发生的原因。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li twassal biex isseħħ ġrajja jew tinħoloq sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The cause of an event is something that makes that event happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释某种行为、感受或情况的理由或缘由。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raġuni li tispjega għaliex persuna taġixxi jew tħossha b'ċertu mod, jew għaliex teżisti sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reason explains why someone acts or feels a certain way, or why a situation exists.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在法院审理的诉讼案件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tilwima jew kwistjoni legali li tkun qed tinstema' quddiem qorti sabiex tingħata deċiżjoni dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A court case is a legal matter being heard by a court so that a decision can be made.

collocations.en: the case is heard in court

formal.mt: Il-qorti semgħet ix-xhieda fil-kawża dwar il-ħsara fil-bini, iżda l-kawża tal-ħsara għadha mhix ċara.
formal.en: The court heard the witnesses in the case concerning the damage to the building, but the cause of the damage is still unclear.
formal.zh: 法院听取了建筑物损坏案件中证人的证言，但损坏的原因仍不清楚。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Sabu l-kawża tal-ħsara fil-karozza? David: Iva, kien hemm problema fil-magna. Marta: Mela issa nafu għaliex waqfet.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did they find the cause of the problem with the car? David: Yes, there was a problem with the engine. Marta: So now we know why it stopped.
colloquial.zh: Marta：他们找到汽车故障的原因了吗？David：找到了，是发动机出了问题。Marta：那现在就知道车为什么停下来了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabu l-kawża tal-ħsara fil-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Sabu l-kawża tal-ħsara fil-karozza?
messages.zh: 他们找到汽车故障的原因了吗？
messages.en: Did they find the cause of the problem with the car?

messages.speaker: David (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm problema fil-magna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm problema fil-magna.
messages.zh: 找到了，是发动机出了问题。
messages.en: Yes, there was a problem with the engine.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela issa nafu għaliex waqfet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela issa nafu għaliex waqfet.
messages.zh: 那现在就知道车为什么停下来了。
messages.en: So now we know why it stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kawża 配三张情境卡：事故追查“原因”、担忧说明“理由”、法庭审理“案件”。看到搭配再选义，尤其用 tiftaħ kawża 记“提起诉讼”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A box used for receiving letters or collecting letters to be posted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于接收来信，或收集待寄信件的箱子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa fejn jitħallew l-ittri li jaslu jew fejn jintefgħu l-ittri biex jintbagħtu bil-posta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人投放待寄信件的邮筒，或供住户接收信件的信箱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kaxxa li fiha n-nies jitfgħu ittri biex jintbagħtu bil-posta, jew li fiha jitħallew l-ittri għal min joqgħod f'dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A letter box is a container where letters are posted or delivered.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于接收和存放投递邮件的实体信箱，也可指收集待寄邮件的邮筒。
