sense_translations.mt_definition: Kaxxa fiżika li fiha jitħallew ittri u posta oħra għal min jirċevihom, jew li tintuża biex tinġabar posta li se tintbagħat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mailbox is a physical container used to receive mail or collect it for posting.

collocations.en: to put a letter in the letter box

formal.mt: Ir-residenti għandhom jiktbu isimhom b'mod ċar fuq il-kaxxa tal-ittri tagħhom.
formal.en: Residents should write their names clearly on their mailboxes.
formal.zh: 住户应在自己的信箱上清楚地写明姓名。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tiċċekkja l-kaxxa tal-ittri? Pawlu: Iva, hemm ittra għalik.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you check the mailbox? Pawlu: Yes, there is a letter for you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能看看信箱吗？保罗：可以，里面有你的一封信。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiċċekkja l-kaxxa tal-ittri?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiċċekkja l-kaxxa tal-ittri?
messages.zh: 你能看看信箱吗？
messages.en: Can you check the mailbox?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ittra għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ittra għalik.
messages.zh: 可以，里面有你的一封信。
messages.en: Yes, there is a letter for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口装信的箱子，把整个短语 kaxxa tal-ittri 与每天查看来信的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular situation or matter considered individually, especially one requiring attention or investigation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 单独加以考虑的某种情况或事项，尤其指需要处理或调查的个案、案件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni jew kwistjoni partikolari li titqies għaliha waħedha, speċjalment meta tkun teħtieġ attenzjoni jew investigazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为独立事项来考虑或处理的情况、个案，也可指接受调查或审理的案件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni jew kwistjoni li titqies jew tiġi ttrattata waħedha, inkluża waħda li tkun qed tiġi investigata jew mismugħa fil-qorti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A case is a particular situation or matter that is considered, dealt with, or investigated individually.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jeżamina kull każ separatament qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee will examine each case separately before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会将在作出决定前逐一审查每个个案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-karozza għadha għand il-mekkanik. David: F'dan il-każ, ejja mmorru bil-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Lara: The car is still at the mechanic's. David: In that case, let's take the bus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：车还在修车师傅那里。戴维：既然这样，我们坐公交车去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza għadha għand il-mekkanik.
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza għadha għand il-mekkanik.
messages.zh: 车还在修车师傅那里。
messages.en: The car is still at the mechanic's.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-każ, ejja mmorru bil-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-każ, ejja mmorru bil-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 既然这样，我们坐公交车去吧。
messages.en: In that case, let's take the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 każ 想成桌上单独摆放的一份个案；再整块记住 f'dan il-każ，表示“在这种情况下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A case concerning the alleged sale of exported goods below their normal value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及出口商品涉嫌以低于正常价值的价格出售的案件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Każ dwar allegazzjoni li prodotti esportati nbiegħu bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及商品涉嫌倾销的案件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Każ li fih jiġi eżaminat jekk prodotti esportati nbiegħux bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dumping case concerns whether exported goods have been sold below their normal value.

collocations.mt: każ ta' dumping li jinvolvi prodotti importati
collocations.en: a dumping case involving imported products
collocations.zh: 涉及进口产品的倾销案件

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' dumping li jinvolvi prodotti importati.
formal.en: The report describes a dumping case involving imported products.
formal.zh: 该报告描述了一起涉及进口产品的倾销案件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex qed taqra? Mark: Qed naqra dwar każ ta' dumping li jinvolvi azzar importat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading about? Mark: I'm reading about a dumping case involving imported steel.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读什么方面的内容？Mark：我在读一起涉及进口钢材的倾销案件。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么方面的内容？
messages.en: What are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra dwar każ ta' dumping li jinvolvi azzar importat.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra dwar każ ta' dumping li jinvolvi azzar importat.
messages.zh: 我在读一起涉及进口钢材的倾销案件。
messages.en: I'm reading about a dumping case involving imported steel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成贸易报告上的案件标题：każ 是案件，ta' 连接所涉事项，dumping 提示倾销。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A club or meeting place where members gather for shared interests and social activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成员因共同兴趣或社交活动而聚集的俱乐部或会所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda jew post fejn il-membri jiltaqgħu għal interessi komuni u attivitajiet soċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由具有共同兴趣的人组成的俱乐部，也指其成员聚会和开展活动的会所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' nies b'interessi komuni, jew il-post fejn il-membri tagħha jiltaqgħu u jieħdu sehem f'attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A club is an organization for people with shared interests, or the place where its members meet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设有赌博游戏，供人以金钱下注的赌场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jistgħu jieħdu sehem f'logħob tal-azzard u jilagħbu għall-flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A casino is a place where people play games of chance for money.

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-każin se jiltaqgħu nhar il-Ġimgħa biex jiddiskutu l-programm ta' attivitajiet għas-sena li ġejja.
formal.en: The club members will meet on Friday to discuss the programme of activities for the coming year.
formal.zh: 俱乐部成员将于星期五开会，讨论下一年度的活动安排。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tmur il-każin illejla? Toni: Iva, se niltaqa' mal-ħbieb hemm wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you going to the club tonight? Toni: Yes, I am meeting my friends there after work.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今晚去俱乐部吗？托尼：去，我下班后会在那里和朋友见面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur il-każin illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur il-każin illejla?
messages.zh: 你今晚去俱乐部吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the club tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niltaqa' mal-ħbieb hemm wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niltaqa' mal-ħbieb hemm wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 去，我下班后会在那里和朋友见面。
messages.en: Yes, I am meeting my friends there after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景区分 każin：看到成员聚会，记“俱乐部”；看到下注游戏，记“赌场”，结合上下文选择词义。

gloss_zh: 随意的；休闲的；不拘礼节的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relaxed and informal in style, clothing, or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指风格、衣着或举止轻松随意、不拘正式礼节的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sempliċi, rilassat u mhux formali fl-ilbies, fl-istil jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻松随意、非正式的，尤用于衣着、风格或举止。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx formali jew ċerimonjuż, speċjalment fl-ilbies, fl-istil jew fl-imġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is casual has a relaxed style and does not follow formal conventions.

formal.mt: Għall-attività ta' nhar is-Sibt, ġie rakkomandat ilbies każwali.
formal.en: Casual clothing was recommended for Saturday's event.
formal.zh: 周六的活动建议穿着休闲服装。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' niġi b'ilbies każwali? Maja: Iva, qmis u jeans huma tajbin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I come in casual clothes? Maja: Yes, a shirt and jeans are fine.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我可以穿休闲装来吗？Maja：可以，衬衫配牛仔裤就行。

messages.speaker: Sara (受邀朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' niġi b'ilbies każwali?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' niġi b'ilbies każwali?
messages.zh: 我可以穿休闲装来吗？
messages.en: Can I come in casual clothes?

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qmis u jeans huma tajbin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qmis u jeans huma tajbin.
messages.zh: 可以，衬衫配牛仔裤就行。
messages.en: Yes, a shirt and jeans are fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 każwali 配上周末穿牛仔裤的画面，连同 ilbies każwali 一起记住“休闲、随意”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet baked food typically made with flour, sugar, eggs, and fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常用面粉、糖、鸡蛋和油脂等原料烘焙而成的甜食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelu moħmi li ġeneralment isir bid-dqiq, iz-zokkor, il-bajd u x-xaħam, u li jista' jkollu mili jew tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛋糕，通常由面粉、糖、鸡蛋和油脂等原料烘焙制成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħelu moħmi, ġeneralment magħmul mid-dqiq, iz-zokkor, il-bajd u l-butir jew iż-żejt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cake is a sweet baked food that is often cut into slices and served at celebrations.

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew kejk taċ-ċikkulata għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-iskola.
formal.en: The students prepared a chocolate cake for the school celebration.
formal.zh: 学生们为学校庆祝活动制作了一个巧克力蛋糕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid biċċa kejk? Mark: Iva, grazzi! Għamiltu int?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a piece of cake? Mark: Yes, thanks! Did you make it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想吃一块蛋糕吗？Mark：想，谢谢！是你做的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (招待朋友的主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid biċċa kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Trid biċċa kejk?
messages.zh: 你想吃一块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (来访朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi! Għamiltu int?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi! Għamiltu int?
messages.zh: 想，谢谢！是你做的吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks! Did you make it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 cake 的读音联想 kejk，再想象切下一块蛋糕，把 biċċa kejk 连成一个画面来记忆。

gloss_zh: 他有过；他当时有；他不得不；他拥有过

teaching_sense.en_definition: A past-tense form meaning that he had or possessed something, or had to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于第三人称阳性单数的过去表达，表示他当时有、拥有某物，或必须做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-passat għat-tielet persuna singular maskil, li tindika pussess, stat jew ħtieġa; quddiem verb ieħor tista' tindika obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示他过去有某物、处于某种状态，或有某种需要、感受或可用资源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li fil-passat hu kien f'ċerta qagħda, ħass xi ħaġa jew kien hemm xi ħaġa disponibbli għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he had something, it was available to him or formed part of his situation at a past time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示他当时必须或不得不做某事，通常后接动词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li fil-passat kien meħtieġ jew obbligatorju għalih li jagħmel xi ħaġa, u tintuża quddiem verb ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he had to do something, circumstances or an obligation made that action necessary at the time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示他过去拥有某物，或某物当时归他所有、受他掌控。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li fil-passat xi ħaġa kienet tiegħu jew kienet taħt il-kontroll tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he possessed something, it belonged to him or was under his control at a past time.

formal.mt: Pawlu kellu dar fir-raħal, iżda kellu jitlaq minnha meta beda jaħdem fil-belt.
formal.en: Pawlu owned a house in the village, but he had to leave it when he started working in the city.
formal.zh: Pawlu在村里拥有一所房子，但开始在城里工作后，他不得不搬离那里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex telaq Mark? Maja: Kellu appuntament u kellu jasal fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark leave? Maja: He had an appointment and had to arrive on time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark为什么走了？Maja：他有个预约，必须准时到。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex telaq Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex telaq Mark?
messages.zh: Mark为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu appuntament u kellu jasal fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu appuntament u kellu jasal fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 他有个预约，必须准时到。
messages.en: He had an appointment and had to arrive on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 kellu 记成过去的“他有”：后接名词看作有或拥有，后接动作常看作“他当时必须做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question expression used to ask about the physical length or height of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问某人或某物的实际长度或高度，如道路有多长、一个人有多高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni interrogattiva li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar it-tul ta' persuna jew oġġett, bħal triq, mejda jew raġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有多长；询问实际长度，谈论人的身高时可译为“有多高”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tistaqsi x'inhu t-tul ta' xi ħadd jew ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to ask about physical length, or about a person's height.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-kejl, l-istudenti għandhom iwieġbu din il-mistoqsija: "Kemm hu twil il-kuritur f'metri?"
formal.en: In the measurement exercise, students must answer this question: "How long is the corridor in metres?"
formal.zh: 在测量练习中，学生须回答这个问题：“这条走廊长多少米？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu twil dan il-kejbil? Mark: Żewġ metri. Maja: Tajjeb, għandu jkun biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long is this cable? Mark: Two metres. Maja: Good, that should be enough.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这根线有多长？Mark：两米。Maja：好，应该够用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu twil dan il-kejbil?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu twil dan il-kejbil?
messages.zh: 这根线有多长？
messages.en: How long is this cable?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ metri.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ metri.
messages.zh: 两米。
messages.en: Two metres.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, għandu jkun biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, għandu jkun biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 好，应该够用了。
messages.en: Good, that should be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿尺子量桥、线缆或身高，把 kemm hu twil 记成“尺子量出的多长、多高”；回答时可联想厘米或米。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question expression used to ask how many people or things there are.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问人或事物数量的疑问表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni interrogattiva li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar l-għadd ta' persuni jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多少个；用于询问人或事物的数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tistaqsi x'inhu l-għadd ta' persuni jew affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to ask about the number of people or things.

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju hemm din il-mistoqsija: "Kemm huma l-persuni li jgħixu f'din id-dar?"
formal.en: The questionnaire includes this question: "How many people live in this house?"
formal.zh: 问卷中有这样一个问题：“这所房子里住着多少人？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm huma l-mistednin illejla? Mark: Għaxra. Maja: Mela għandna bżonn għaxar siġġijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many guests are there tonight? Mark: Ten. Maja: Then we need ten chairs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚有多少位客人？Mark：十位。Maja：那我们需要十把椅子。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm huma l-mistednin illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm huma l-mistednin illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚有多少位客人？
messages.en: How many guests are there tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxra.
messages.zh: 十位。
messages.en: Ten.

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għandna bżonn għaxar siġġijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għandna bżonn għaxar siġġijiet.
messages.zh: 那我们需要十把椅子。
messages.en: Then we need ten chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kemm huma 和数人数、数物件的画面绑定：看到一群人或一排东西，就练习问“有多少个”，再用具体数字回答。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question expression used to ask how much time an activity, event, or process takes or lasts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问活动、事件或过程所需或持续的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni interrogattiva li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar iż-żmien li jieħu jew li jdum avveniment, proċess jew xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多久；多长时间；询问所需时间或持续时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tistaqsi kemm żmien jieħu jew idum xi ħaġa, bħal vjaġġ, film jew xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to ask how much time something takes or lasts.

collocations.en: How long does the journey take?
How long does the film last?
collocations.zh: 这部电影放映多长时间？

formal.mt: Qabel ma jibbukkjaw, il-parteċipanti għandhom jistaqsu: "Kemm idum il-kors u meta jibda?"
formal.en: Before booking, participants should ask: "How long does the course last, and when does it start?"
formal.zh: 报名之前，参加者应询问：“课程持续多久，什么时候开始？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm idum il-vjaġġ sal-belt? Mark: Madwar nofs siegħa. Maja: Mela nitilqu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long does the journey to the city take? Mark: About half an hour. Maja: Then let's leave now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：去城里的路程要多久？Mark：大约半小时。Maja：那我们现在出发吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm idum il-vjaġġ sal-belt?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm idum il-vjaġġ sal-belt?
messages.zh: 去城里的路程要多久？
messages.en: How long does the journey to the city take?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar nofs siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar nofs siegħa.
messages.zh: 大约半小时。
messages.en: About half an hour.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nitilqu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nitilqu issa.
messages.zh: 那我们现在出发吧。
messages.en: Then let's leave now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kemm idum 和秒表配对：出发时按下，结束时停住，问的就是中间经过多久；用分钟、小时等时间单位回答。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question expression used to ask the price of an item or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问商品或服务的价格，即需要支付多少钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni interrogattiva li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar il-prezz ta' oġġett jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多少钱；在此用于询问价格或所需支付的金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tistaqsi kemm flus trid tħallas għal oġġett jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to ask how much money an item or service costs.

collocations.en: How much does this book cost?
How much does a ticket cost?

formal.mt: Qabel ma jikkonferma x-xiri, il-klijent għandu jistaqsi: "Kemm iqum il-kompjuter bit-taxxa inkluża?"
formal.en: Before confirming the purchase, the customer should ask: "How much does the computer cost, including tax?"
formal.zh: 确认购买之前，顾客应询问：“这台电脑含税多少钱？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm iqum dan il-ktieb? Mark: Għaxar ewro. Maja: Tajjeb, nieħu wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much does this book cost? Mark: Ten euros. Maja: All right, I'll take one.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stone hearth where a fire is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用石头砌成、供生火使用的炉灶或炉床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fuklar magħmul mill-ġebel fejn jitqabbad in-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用石头砌成、用于生火的炉灶或炉床。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kenur huwa fuklar tal-ġebel li jintuża biex jitqabbad in-nar fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stone hearth is a structure made of stone in which a fire is built.

collocations.en: to light a fire in the stone hearth

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-kamra ssemmi kenur tal-ġebel ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: The description of the room mentions a stone hearth beside the wall.
formal.zh: 房间描述中提到墙边有一座石砌炉灶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se nqabbdu n-nar? Pawlu: Fil-kenur, ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we light the fire? Pawlu: In the stone hearth, beside the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里生火？保罗：在墙边的石砌炉灶里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se nqabbdu n-nar?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se nqabbdu n-nar?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里生火？
messages.en: Where shall we light the fire?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kenur, ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kenur, ħdejn il-ħajt.

messages.en: In the stone hearth, beside the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kenur 和一幅石砌炉灶里燃着火的图配对记忆，再用 fil-kenur 表达“在炉灶里”。这是场景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sweeps floors or other surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用扫帚等工具清扫地面或其他表面的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiknes l-art jew uċuħ oħra biex tneħħi t-trab u l-ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责扫地、清除地面灰尘和垃圾的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kenura hija persuna li tiknes u tiġbor it-trab u l-ħmieġ mill-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sweeper is someone who removes dust and rubbish by sweeping an area.

formal.mt: Il-kenura bdiet tiknes il-bitħa qabel ma waslu l-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The sweeper began sweeping the courtyard before the visitors arrived.
formal.zh: 清扫者在访客到来之前开始打扫庭院。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min qed jiknes il-bitħa? Rita: Il-kenura; qed tiġbor il-weraq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is sweeping the courtyard? Rita: The sweeper; she is gathering the leaves.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁在扫庭院？丽塔：清扫员，她正在把落叶扫到一起。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qed jiknes il-bitħa?
messages.mt_standard: Min qed jiknes il-bitħa?

messages.en: Who is sweeping the courtyard?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kenura; qed tiġbor il-weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kenura; qed tiġbor il-weraq.
messages.zh: 清扫员，她正在把落叶扫到一起。
messages.en: The sweeper; she is gathering the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kenura 时想象一个拿扫帚清扫落叶的人，并把“人、扫帚、清扫动作”一起记住；与表示石砌炉灶的 kenur 分开制作词卡。

gloss_zh: 凯尔切姆，戈佐岛上的一个村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village on Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戈佐岛上一个村庄的名称，作地名使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kerċem huwa l-isem ta' raħal f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凯尔切姆，位于戈佐岛的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kerċem huwa raħal li jinsab fil-gżira ta' Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Kerċem is the name of a village situated on the island of Gozo.

collocations.zh: 到凯尔切姆的一次访问

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara fir-raħal ta' Kerċem f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to the village of Kerċem on Gozo.
formal.zh: 旅行安排包括参观戈佐岛上的凯尔切姆村。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejrin illum? Pawlu: Se nżuru Kerċem, raħal f'Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going today? Pawlu: We are going to visit Kerċem, a village on Gozo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天去哪里？保罗：我们要去参观凯尔切姆，那是戈佐岛上的一个村庄。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejrin illum?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejrin illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nżuru Kerċem, raħal f'Għawdex.
messages.mt_standard: Se nżuru Kerċem, raħal f'Għawdex.
messages.zh: 我们要去参观凯尔切姆，那是戈佐岛上的一个村庄。
messages.en: We are going to visit Kerċem, a village on Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kerċem 写在标着“戈佐岛村庄”的地图词卡上，整组记忆 Kerċem—Gozo—村庄；作为地名，例句中保留首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 保留于姓氏 Chetcuti 写法中的形容词形式，具体词义未提供

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective preserved in the family surname written Chetcuti, with no descriptive meaning specified here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个保留于姓氏 Chetcuti 写法中的形容词；所给资料未说明它具体描述什么性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li għadu jidher fil-kunjom miktub Chetcuti, iżda li t-tifsira deskrittiva tiegħu mhijiex mogħtija hawn.

sense_translations.en_definition: This adjective survives in family surname written Chetcuti
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这个形容词保留于写作 Chetcuti 的姓氏中；资料未提供其具体形容词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv ketkuti għadu jidher fil-kunjom li jinkiteb Chetcuti; it-tagħrif mogħti ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira deskrittiva tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The adjective ketkuti is preserved in the surname written Chetcuti, although its descriptive meaning is not specified here.

collocations.en: the form ketkuti in the surname Chetcuti
collocations.zh: 姓氏 Chetcuti 中保留的 ketkuti 形式

formal.mt: In-nota lingwistika tgħid li l-aġġettiv ketkuti għadu jidher fil-kunjom miktub Chetcuti, iżda ma tagħtix it-tifsira deskrittiva tiegħu.
formal.en: The linguistic note states that the adjective ketkuti is preserved in the surname written Chetcuti, but does not give its descriptive meaning.
formal.zh: 语言学说明指出，形容词 ketkuti 保留于写作 Chetcuti 的姓氏中，但没有给出它的具体形容词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tgħid in-nota dwar ketkuti? Mark: Li huwa aġġettiv li għadu jidher fil-kunjom Chetcuti; ma tagħtix it-tifsira tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the note say about ketkuti? Mark: That it is an adjective preserved in the surname Chetcuti; it does not give its meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说明里怎么介绍 ketkuti？马克：说它是保留于姓氏 Chetcuti 中的形容词，没有给出它的具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small ring or chain used to hold keys together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来把多把钥匙串在一起的小圈或链子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir, bħal ċirku jew katina, li jżomm diversi ċwievet flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于把钥匙串在一起、方便携带的钥匙圈或钥匙链。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċirku jew katina żgħira li magħha jitwaħħlu ċ-ċwievet biex jinżammu flimkien u jinġarru faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A keychain is a small ring or chain that you attach keys to so that you can keep them together.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċwievet tal-uffiċċju għandhom jinżammu fuq keychain wieħed biex ikun aktar faċli li jinstabu.
formal.en: The office keys should be kept on one keychain so that they are easier to find.
formal.zh: 办公室的钥匙应串在同一个钥匙圈上，以便寻找。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-keychain tiegħi? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda biċ-ċwievet tad-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen my keychain? Mark: Yes, it's on the table with the house keys attached.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到我的钥匙圈了吗？Mark：看到了，在桌上，上面串着家里的钥匙。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把几把钥匙串在一个圈上，将 keychain 与“钥匙集中、不易丢散”的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form identified as a verb whose meaning is not specified in the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料将 Kidd 标为动词，但未提供可确定其具体意义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma 'Kidd' hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda l-pakkett ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体词义未注明；问号表示资料未提供明确释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan il-verb mhijiex speċifikata fil-pakkett, fejn tidher biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This item is identified as a verb, but the supplied packet does not establish what it means.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'Kidd' hija kklassifikata bħala verb fil-pakkett, iżda ma tingħatax definizzjoni li tispjega t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The form 'Kidd' is classified as a verb in the packet, but no definition explaining its meaning is provided.
formal.zh: 资料将“Kidd”归为动词，但没有提供解释其词义的定义。

gloss_zh: 曾苦苦思念；曾热切渴望

teaching_sense.en_definition: Felt a strong and persistent longing for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过去曾因强烈思念某人或渴望某事物而难以释怀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kellu xewqa qawwija u dejjiema għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa li kienet nieqsa minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苦苦思念某人，或因无法得到所渴望的事物而持续惆怅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħoss nuqqas kbir ta' xi ħadd jew ta' xi ħaġa u jibqa' jixtieqhom b'ħerqa u b'diqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone pines after a person or thing, they keep longing for them and feel unhappy because they cannot be with them or have them.

collocations.en: he was pining for his home
collocations.zh: 他曾深切思念自己的家

formal.mt: Matul iż-żmien li għex barra minn Malta, kien imlebleb għal daru u kien jikteb lill-familja tiegħu kull ġimgħa.
formal.en: During the time he lived outside Malta, he was pining for his home and wrote to his family every week.
formal.zh: 在马耳他以外生活的那段时间里，他深切思念自己的家，每周都会给家人写信。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kien iħares lejn ir-ritratt tagħha kuljum? Mark: Għax kien imlebleb għaliha u kien jittama li jerġa' jaraha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he look at her photo every day? Mark: Because he was pining after her and hoped to see her again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么每天都看她的照片？Mark：因为他苦苦思念她，希望能再见到她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kien iħares lejn ir-ritratt tagħha kuljum?
messages.zh: 他为什么每天都看她的照片？

gloss_zh: 当时由……组成；当时由……制成

teaching_sense.en_definition: Was composed of particular parts, members, or materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物或某个整体在过去由特定部分、成员或材料构成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kien jikkonsisti f'ċerti partijiet, membri jew materjali li flimkien kienu jiffurmaw ħaġa sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由特定部分、成员或要素组成；所给马耳他语短语表达过去的构成情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun iffurmat minn partijiet, membri jew elementi li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa; il-frażi mogħtija tirreferi għall-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something consists of particular parts or members, those parts or members together form the whole.

collocations.zh: 它当时由三个部分组成
它当时由五名成员组成

formal.mt: Il-kumitat kien magħmul minn ħames membri, li kull wieħed minnhom kien jirrappreżenta dipartiment differenti.
formal.en: The committee consisted of five members, each of whom represented a different department.
formal.zh: 该委员会当时由五名成员组成，每人代表一个不同的部门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm kien hemm nies fit-tim tagħkom? Mark: It-tim kien magħmul minn erba' studenti u għalliem wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many people were on your team? Mark: The team consisted of four students and one teacher.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们队当时有多少人？Mark：队伍当时由四名学生和一位老师组成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used to ask one person how they are feeling or doing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于向一个人问候并询问其近况或身体、心情如何的表达，相当于“你好吗？”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' tislima li tintuża biex tistaqsi lil persuna waħda kif qed tħossha jew kif sejra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你好吗？用于向一个人问候或询问近况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mistoqsija ta' tislima indirizzata lil persuna waħda biex tistaqsi dwar saħħitha, il-burdata tagħha jew kif sejra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say 'Kif int?' when greeting one person and asking how they are feeling or doing.

collocations.en: How are you after the journey?
collocations.zh: 旅途结束后，你感觉怎么样？

formal.mt: Fil-bidu ta' ittra personali, tista' tuża l-mistoqsija "Kif int?" biex tistaqsi dwar il-persuna li qed tikteb lilha.
formal.en: At the beginning of a personal letter, you can use the question 'Kif int?' to ask how the person you are writing to is doing.
formal.zh: 在私人信件开头，可以用“Kif int?”询问收信人的近况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bonġu, Mark! Kif int? Mark: Tajjeb, grazzi! U int?
colloquial.en: Maja: Good morning, Mark! How are you? Mark: I'm well, thanks! And you?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：早上好，马克！你好吗？马克：我很好，谢谢！你呢？
