messages.zh: 现在我明白了，我们没有把那一部分拿出来单独讨论。
messages.en: Now I understand; we did not discuss that part on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份预先写好的合同，其中某一条从未被双方拿出来单独商量；把整个短语记成“条款＋没有＋个别协商”。

gloss_zh: 社会条款；涉及劳动或社会标准的条款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clause in an agreement that sets out requirements or commitments concerning social matters, such as working conditions or workers' rights.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 协议中规定社会事务方面的要求或承诺的条款，例如涉及工作条件或劳动者权利的条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Klawsola fi ftehim li tistabbilixxi rekwiżiti jew impenji dwar kwistjonijiet soċjali, bħall-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol jew id-drittijiet tal-ħaddiema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协议中涉及社会标准、工作条件或劳动者权利等事项的条款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni fi ftehim li tittratta standards soċjali jew kwistjonijiet bħall-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol u l-ħarsien tad-drittijiet tal-ħaddiema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A social clause is a provision in an agreement that addresses social standards or obligations, often concerning workers and their working conditions.

collocations.en: include a social clause in the agreement
collocations.zh: 在协议中纳入社会条款

collocations.en: a social clause concerning working conditions
collocations.zh: 涉及工作条件的社会条款

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jinkludi klawsola soċjali li titlob lill-fornitur jipprovdi kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol sikuri għall-ħaddiema tiegħu.
formal.en: The agreement includes a social clause requiring the supplier to provide safe working conditions for its workers.
formal.zh: 该协议包含一项社会条款，要求供应商为其劳动者提供安全的工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-klawsola soċjali dwar xiex titkellem? David: Dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol tal-ħaddiema tal-fornitur. Sara: Tajjeb, mela naqraw x'titlob eżatt.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does this social clause cover? David: The working conditions of the supplier's workers. Sara: All right, let's read exactly what it requires.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这项社会条款涉及什么？David：供应商员工的工作条件。Sara：好，那我们看看它具体有什么要求。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-klawsola soċjali dwar xiex titkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-klawsola soċjali dwar xiex titkellem?
messages.zh: 这项社会条款涉及什么？
messages.en: What does this social clause cover?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol tal-ħaddiema tal-fornitur.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol tal-ħaddiema tal-fornitur.
messages.zh: 供应商员工的工作条件。
messages.en: The working conditions of the supplier's workers.

messages.speaker: Sara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela naqraw x'titlob eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela naqraw x'titlob eżatt.
messages.zh: 好，那我们看看它具体有什么要求。
messages.en: All right, let's read exactly what it requires.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这项条款旁边画上劳动者和安全工作场所，借助“社会标准进入协议”的画面，记住它关注工作条件与社会责任等事项。

gloss_zh: 日落条款；规定到期失效的条款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clause providing that a law, agreement, or provision ceases to have effect at a specified time unless it is extended or renewed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定法律、协议或某项规定在指定时间失效，除非获得延期或续期的条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Klawsola li tipprovdi li liġi, ftehim jew dispożizzjoni ma jibqax fis-seħħ fi żmien speċifikat, sakemm ma jiġix estiż jew imġedded.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定法律、协议或某项规定在指定日期或期限届满时停止生效，除非获延期或续期的条款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni li tistabbilixxi data jew perjodu li warajh liġi, ftehim jew dispożizzjoni oħra ma jibqax fis-seħħ, sakemm il-validità tiegħu ma tiġix estiża jew imġedda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sunset clause states when a law, agreement, or provision will cease to have effect unless action is taken to extend or renew it.

collocations.en: include a sunset clause in the law
collocations.zh: 在法律中纳入日落条款

collocations.en: the date specified in the sunset clause

formal.mt: Il-klawsola ta' estinzjoni tipprovdi li din id-dispożizzjoni ma tibqax fis-seħħ fil-31 ta' Diċembru, sakemm il-validità tagħha ma tiġix estiża.
formal.en: The sunset clause provides that this provision will cease to have effect on 31 December unless its validity is extended.
formal.zh: 日落条款规定，这项规定将于12月31日失效，除非其有效期获得延长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din ir-regola tibqa' fis-seħħ is-sena d-dieħla? Anton: Skont il-klawsola ta' estinzjoni, tieqaf tapplika fl-aħħar ta' Diċembru jekk ma tiġix estiża. Lara: Mela rridu niċċekkjaw jekk estendewhiex.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will this rule still be in force next year? Anton: Under the sunset clause, it stops applying at the end of December if it is not extended. Lara: Then we need to check whether they have extended it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这项规则明年还有效吗？Anton：根据日落条款，如果没有延期，它到12月底就不再适用了。Lara：那我们得查一下它有没有获得延期。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ir-regola tibqa' fis-seħħ is-sena d-dieħla?
messages.mt_standard: Din ir-regola tibqa' fis-seħħ is-sena d-dieħla?
messages.zh: 这项规则明年还有效吗？
messages.en: Will this rule still be in force next year?

messages.speaker: Anton (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont il-klawsola ta' estinzjoni, tieqaf tapplika fl-aħħar ta' Diċembru jekk ma tiġix estiża.
messages.mt_standard: Skont il-klawsola ta' estinzjoni, tieqaf tapplika fl-aħħar ta' Diċembru jekk ma tiġix estiża.
messages.zh: 根据日落条款，如果没有延期，它到12月底就不再适用了。
messages.en: Under the sunset clause, it stops applying at the end of December if it is not extended.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rridu niċċekkjaw jekk estendewhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rridu niċċekkjaw jekk estendewhiex.
messages.zh: 那我们得查一下它有没有获得延期。
messages.en: Then we need to check whether they have extended it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上的截止日配着落日：日期一到，规定的效力就像太阳落下；把“到期失效，延期则继续”作为记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contractual provision setting out how events beyond the parties' control affect their obligations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 合同中规定当事人无法控制的事件如何影响其履行义务的条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni f'kuntratt li tistabbilixxi kif ġrajjiet li l-partijiet ma jistgħux jikkontrollaw jaffettwaw l-obbligi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可抗力条款，规定当事人在发生其无法控制的事件时，履约义务及相关责任如何处理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klawżola f'kuntratt li tispeċifika kif jiġu ttrattati l-obbligi u r-responsabbiltajiet tal-partijiet meta jseħħu ġrajjiet li ma jistgħux jikkontrollaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A force majeure clause explains how contractual duties are affected when events beyond the parties' control prevent or disrupt performance.

collocations.mt: tinkludi klawżola ta' force majeure fil-kuntratt
collocations.en: include a force majeure clause in the contract
collocations.zh: 在合同中加入不可抗力条款

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jinkludi klawżola ta' force majeure li tistabbilixxi x'għandhom jagħmlu l-partijiet jekk ġrajja barra mill-kontroll tagħhom twaqqaf il-kunsinna.
formal.en: The contract includes a force majeure clause setting out what the parties must do if an event beyond their control prevents delivery.
formal.zh: 合同包含不可抗力条款，规定当双方无法控制的事件导致无法交货时，各方应采取哪些措施。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-tempesta waqqfet il-kunsinna. Hemm klawżola ta' force majeure fil-kuntratt? Pawlu: Iva, ejja naqrawha biex naraw x'tgħid dwar din is-sitwazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marta: The storm has prevented delivery. Is there a force majeure clause in the contract? Pawlu: Yes, let's read it to see what it says about this situation.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：暴风雨导致无法交货。合同里有不可抗力条款吗？保罗：有，我们读一下，看看条款对这种情况怎么规定。

messages.speaker: Marta (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tempesta waqqfet il-kunsinna. Hemm klawżola ta' force majeure fil-kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: It-tempesta waqqfet il-kunsinna. Hemm klawżola ta' force majeure fil-kuntratt?
messages.zh: 暴风雨导致无法交货。合同里有不可抗力条款吗？
messages.en: The storm has prevented delivery. Is there a force majeure clause in the contract?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja naqrawha biex naraw x'tgħid dwar din is-sitwazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja naqrawha biex naraw x'tgħid dwar din is-sitwazzjoni.
messages.zh: 有，我们读一下，看看条款对这种情况怎么规定。
messages.en: Yes, let's read it to see what it says about this situation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“暴风雨阻断交货，先查合同条款”的画面中，记住这是处理不可控事件对履约影响的条款。

gloss_zh: 和平条款；相互克制条款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A provision requiring parties to maintain peace or exercise restraint in taking action against one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求各方维持和平，或在针对彼此采取行动时保持克制的条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni li titlob lill-partijiet iżommu l-paċi jew irażżnu l-azzjonijiet tagħhom kontra xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适当克制条款，要求各方在针对彼此采取某些行动时保持适当克制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klawżola li titlob lill-partijiet jeżerċitaw trażżin xieraq meta jieħdu ċerti azzjonijiet kontra xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Due Restraint Clause requires parties to exercise appropriate restraint when taking specified action against one another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和平条款，要求各方维持和平关系，或避免协议所规定的对抗行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klawżola li titlob lill-partijiet iżommu relazzjonijiet paċifiċi jew jevitaw l-azzjonijiet ta' konfrontazzjoni speċifikati fil-ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A peace clause commits parties to maintaining peaceful relations or avoiding forms of confrontation specified in an agreement.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim fih klawżola ta' paċi li titlob liż-żewġ partijiet jevitaw l-azzjonijiet ta' konfrontazzjoni elenkati fit-test.
formal.en: The agreement contains a peace clause requiring both parties to avoid the confrontational actions listed in the text.
formal.zh: 协议包含一项和平条款，要求双方避免采取文本中列明的对抗行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex żiedu klawżola ta' paċi fil-ftehim? David: Biex iż-żewġ naħat iżommu l-paċi u jevitaw l-azzjonijiet imsemmija fiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did they add a peace clause to the agreement? David: So that both sides maintain peace and avoid the actions mentioned in it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他们为什么在协议里加入和平条款？戴维：为了让双方维持和平，避免采取条款里提到的那些行动。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex żiedu klawżola ta' paċi fil-ftehim?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex żiedu klawżola ta' paċi fil-ftehim?
messages.zh: 他们为什么在协议里加入和平条款？
messages.en: Why did they add a peace clause to the agreement?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex iż-żewġ naħat iżommu l-paċi u jevitaw l-azzjonijiet imsemmija fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Biex iż-żewġ naħat iżommu l-paċi u jevitaw l-azzjonijiet imsemmija fiha.
messages.zh: 为了让双方维持和平，避免采取条款里提到的那些行动。
messages.en: So that both sides maintain peace and avoid the actions mentioned in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双方把“保持和平、行动克制”写进协议：和平条款重在维持关系，适当克制义重在约束指定行动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A provision specifying when certain rules of an agreement do not apply to particular parties or relations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定协议中的某些规则在何种情况下不适用于特定当事方或相互关系的条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni li tispeċifika meta ċerti regoli ta' ftehim ma japplikawx għal partijiet partikolari jew għar-relazzjonijiet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱离条款，规定在指定情形下，协议的某些规定不适用于特定当事方之间的关系，并可由其他规则规范。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klawżola li tistabbilixxi li, f'ċirkostanzi speċifikati, ċerti dispożizzjonijiet ta' ftehim ma japplikawx għar-relazzjonijiet bejn partijiet partikolari, li jistgħu jkunu rregolati minn regoli oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disconnection clause excludes specified relations between parties from certain provisions of an agreement, sometimes allowing other rules to govern those relations.

collocations.en: insert a disconnection clause into the agreement
collocations.zh: 在协议中加入脱离条款

collocations.en: the scope of the disconnection clause

formal.mt: Il-klawżola ta' skonnessjoni tispeċifika liema dispożizzjonijiet tal-ftehim ma japplikawx għar-relazzjonijiet bejn il-partijiet imsemmija.
formal.en: The disconnection clause specifies which provisions of the agreement do not apply to relations between the named parties.
formal.zh: 脱离条款明确列出协议中哪些规定不适用于所列当事方之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din ir-regola tapplika bejn il-partijiet kollha? Mark: Mhux bilfors. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-klawżola ta' skonnessjoni biex naraw fejn ma tapplikax.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this rule apply between all the parties? Mark: Not necessarily. Let's check the disconnection clause to see where it does not apply.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条规则适用于所有当事方之间吗？马克：不一定。我们查一下脱离条款，看看哪些情况下不适用。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ir-regola tapplika bejn il-partijiet kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Din ir-regola tapplika bejn il-partijiet kollha?
messages.zh: 这条规则适用于所有当事方之间吗？
messages.en: Does this rule apply between all the parties?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-klawżola ta' skonnessjoni biex naraw fejn ma tapplikax.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-klawżola ta' skonnessjoni biex naraw fejn ma tapplikax.
messages.zh: 不一定。我们查一下脱离条款，看看哪些情况下不适用。
messages.en: Not necessarily. Let's check the disconnection clause to see where it does not apply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“规则连线被按条件断开”的示意图记忆：脱离条款说明某些关系何时脱离某些规定的适用范围。

gloss_zh: 维持现状条款；冻结条款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A provision requiring specified conditions to remain unchanged or specified action to be withheld for a period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求在一定时期内维持指定条件不变，或暂不采取指定行动的条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispożizzjoni li titlob li ċerti kundizzjonijiet jibqgħu kif inhuma jew li ċerti azzjonijiet ma jittiħdux għal perjodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 维持现状条款，规定在指定时期内不得改变某些现有条件，或不得采取某些行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klawżola li tistabbilixxi li, matul perjodu speċifikat, ċerti kundizzjonijiet eżistenti ma jinbidlux jew ċerti azzjonijiet ma jittiħdux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A standstill clause requires parties to preserve specified existing conditions or refrain from specified action during an agreed period.

collocations.zh: 就维持现状条款达成一致

collocations.en: the period specified in the standstill clause
collocations.zh: 维持现状条款规定的期限

formal.mt: Il-klawżola ta' sospensjoni tipprevedi li l-kundizzjonijiet imsemmija fil-ftehim jibqgħu kif inhuma għal tliet xhur.
formal.en: The standstill clause provides that the conditions specified in the agreement must remain unchanged for three months.
formal.zh: 维持现状条款规定，协议中列明的条件须在三个月内保持不变。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nbiddlu dawn il-kundizzjonijiet issa? Ġorġ: Għadna ma nistgħux. Il-klawżola ta' sospensjoni tgħid li jridu jibqgħu kif inhuma sa tmiem ix-xahar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we change these conditions now? Ġorġ: We cannot yet. The standstill clause says they must remain unchanged until the end of the month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们现在能修改这些条件吗？乔治：还不能。维持现状条款规定，这些条件必须保持不变，直到月底。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nbiddlu dawn il-kundizzjonijiet issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nbiddlu dawn il-kundizzjonijiet issa?
messages.zh: 我们现在能修改这些条件吗？
messages.en: Can we change these conditions now?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma nistgħux. Il-klawżola ta' sospensjoni tgħid li jridu jibqgħu kif inhuma sa tmiem ix-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma nistgħux. Il-klawżola ta' sospensjoni tgħid li jridu jibqgħu kif inhuma sa tmiem ix-xahar.
messages.zh: 还不能。维持现状条款规定，这些条件必须保持不变，直到月底。
messages.en: We cannot yet. The standstill clause says they must remain unchanged until the end of the month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给协议条件按下“暂停修改”键，旁边标明截止日期：记住本条目的重点是在约定期间维持现状或暂缓指定行动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Contract terms that unfairly favour one party at the expense of the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不公平地偏向合同一方、使另一方处于不利地位的合同条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Klawżoli f'kuntratt li jiffavorixxu b'mod inġust lil parti waħda għad-detriment tal-parti l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在合同中不公平地偏向一方、损害另一方利益的条款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dispożizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt li jagħtu vantaġġ inġust lil parti waħda u jqiegħdu lill-parti l-oħra fi żvantaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Unfair contract terms are conditions in an agreement that unfairly benefit one party at the expense of the other.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不公平的条款或条件；本词组特指合同中的此类条款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjonijiet li jittrattaw lil parti waħda b'mod inġust; f'din l-espressjoni, dawn huma kundizzjonijiet f'kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Unfair terms are conditions that treat one party unfairly, particularly within a contractual agreement.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika klawżoli kuntrattwali inġusti u jipproponi tibdil biex il-ftehim ikun aktar bilanċjat.
formal.en: The report identifies unfair contract terms and proposes changes to make the agreement more balanced.
formal.zh: 报告指出了不公平合同条款，并提出修改建议，使协议更加平衡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt il-kuntratt? Naħseb li fih klawżoli kuntrattwali inġusti. Mark: Liema klawżoli qed tgħid? Maja: Dawk li jippermettu lill-kumpanija tbiddel il-prezz meta trid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you read the contract? I think it contains unfair contract terms. Mark: Which terms do you mean? Maja: The ones that let the company change the price whenever it wants.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看过合同了吗？我觉得里面有不公平合同条款。Mark：你指哪些条款？Maja：那些允许公司随时更改价格的条款。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kuntratt? Naħseb li fih klawżoli kuntrattwali inġusti.
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kuntratt? Naħseb li fih klawżoli kuntrattwali inġusti.
messages.zh: 你看过合同了吗？我觉得里面有不公平合同条款。
messages.en: Have you read the contract? I think it contains unfair contract terms.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema klawżoli qed tgħid?
messages.mt_standard: Liema klawżoli qed tgħid?
messages.zh: 你指哪些条款？
messages.en: Which terms do you mean?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk li jippermettu lill-kumpanija tbiddel il-prezz meta trid.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk li jippermettu lill-kumpanija tbiddel il-prezz meta trid.
messages.zh: 那些允许公司随时更改价格的条款。
messages.en: The ones that let the company change the price whenever it wants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“条款 klawżoli＋合同的 kuntrattwali＋不公平的 inġusti”分段记忆，想象合同上被圈出的不公平条款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the clergy or to their religious role and activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与神职人员及其宗教身份、职责或活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kleru jew mar-rwol u l-ħidma reliġjuża tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神职人员的；与教士的身份、职责或活动有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda lill-membri tal-kleru, l-istat tagħhom jew il-ħidma reliġjuża tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is clerical relates to members of the clergy or to their religious role and activities.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-formazzjoni klerikali u r-rwol tagħha fit-tħejjija għas-saċerdozju.
formal.en: The study examines clerical formation and its role in preparation for the priesthood.
formal.zh: 该研究探讨神职人员培育及其在准备担任司铎过程中所起的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-ilbies fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Huwa lbies klerikali; ir-raġel fir-ritratt huwa qassis.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that clothing in the photo? Pawlu: It is clerical clothing; the man in the photo is a priest.
colloquial.zh: Lara：照片里那是什么服装？Pawlu：那是神职人员服装；照片里的男子是一位神父。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak l-ilbies fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak l-ilbies fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 照片里那是什么服装？
messages.en: What is that clothing in the photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa lbies klerikali; ir-raġel fir-ritratt huwa qassis.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa lbies klerikali; ir-raġel fir-ritratt huwa qassis.
messages.zh: 那是神职人员服装；照片里的男子是一位神父。
messages.en: It is clerical clothing; the man in the photo is a priest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klerikali 放进 ilbies klerikali“神职人员服装”一起记，看到衣领便联想“与神职人员有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The members of a religious community who hold recognised religious offices, considered as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教团体中担任正式宗教职务的人员的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-membri ta' komunità reliġjuża li għandhom karigi reliġjużi rikonoxxuti, meqjusa bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神职人员的集体称谓，指担任正式宗教职务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' persuni li għandhom karigi reliġjużi rikonoxxuti fi ħdan komunità reliġjuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The clergy are the people who hold recognised religious offices within a religious community.

formal.mt: Membri tal-kleru lokali ħadu sehem f'laqgħa dwar il-ħtiġijiet tal-komunità.
formal.en: Members of the local clergy took part in a meeting about the needs of the community.
formal.zh: 当地神职人员参加了一场讨论社区需求的会议。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jkun fil-laqgħa llejla? Ġużeppi: Se jkun hemm membri tal-kleru u nies mill-komunità.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will be at the meeting tonight? Ġużeppi: There will be members of the clergy and people from the community.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今晚谁会来开会？Ġużeppi：会有神职人员和社区居民参加。

messages.speaker: Marija (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun fil-laqgħa llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun fil-laqgħa llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚谁会来开会？
messages.en: Who will be at the meeting tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jkun hemm membri tal-kleru u nies mill-komunità.
messages.mt_standard: Se jkun hemm membri tal-kleru u nies mill-komunità.
messages.zh: 会有神职人员和社区居民参加。
messages.en: There will be members of the clergy and people from the community.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kleru 想成神职人员的集体合照：它指整个群体；要说其中的成员，可以记 membri tal-kleru。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who shops for goods or uses a business's services through the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过互联网选购商品或使用商家服务的顾客。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tixtri prodotti jew tuża s-servizzi ta' negozju permezz tal-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网浏览和选购商品的网购者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tfittex u tagħżel prodotti biex tixtrihom permezz tal-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-shopper is someone who browses and shops for products through the internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网购买商品或服务的买家，侧重购买行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tixtri prodotti jew servizzi permezz tal-internet, b'enfasi fuq l-att tax-xiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An online buyer is a person who purchases goods or services through the internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网与商家交易或使用其服务的客户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tixtri mingħand negozju jew tuża s-servizzi tiegħu permezz tal-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An online customer is someone who buys from a business or uses its services over the internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在网上浏览、挑选或购买商品的消费者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħares lejn prodotti, tagħżilhom jew tixtrihom fuq l-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An online shopper is someone who looks for, selects, or buys products on the internet.

collocations.en: an order from an online customer

formal.mt: Kull klijent online jirċievi konferma tal-ordni permezz tal-email wara li jtemm ix-xiri.
formal.en: Every online customer receives an order confirmation by email after completing the purchase.
formal.zh: 每位线上客户完成购买后，都会通过电子邮件收到订单确认。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien klijent online ġdid. Kif nista' nsegwi l-ordni tiegħi? Sara: Iftaħ l-email ta' konferma u agħfas fuq il-link biex tara fejn waslet.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm a new online customer. How can I track my order? Sara: Open the confirmation email and click the link to see how far it has progressed.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我是新的线上客户，怎么追踪我的订单？Sara：打开确认邮件，点击链接就能查看订单进度。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien klijent online ġdid. Kif nista' nsegwi l-ordni tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Jien klijent online ġdid. Kif nista' nsegwi l-ordni tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我是新的线上客户，怎么追踪我的订单？
messages.en: I'm a new online customer. How can I track my order?

messages.speaker: Sara (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iftaħ l-email ta' konferma u agħfas fuq il-link biex tara fejn waslet.
messages.mt_standard: Iftaħ l-email ta' konferma u agħfas fuq il-link biex tara fejn waslet.
messages.zh: 打开确认邮件，点击链接就能查看订单进度。
messages.en: Open the confirmation email and click the link to see how far it has progressed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按 klijent“顾客”加 online“在线”记忆，想象顾客通过屏幕下单，就能联想到“线上客户、网购者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, close group of people who tend to exclude others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关系紧密、往往不愿接纳外人的小群体，通常带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp żgħir ta' nies magħqudin bejniethom li spiss ma jħallux lil ħaddieħor jidħol fil-grupp tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内部关系密切、往往排斥其他人加入的小圈子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp żgħir ta' persuni li jżommu ħafna ma' xulxin u li għandhom it-tendenza li jeskludu lil persuni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clique is a small group of people who spend time together and often do not welcome others.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota li klikka magħluqa fl-uffiċċju tista' tagħmilha diffiċli għall-impjegati l-ġodda biex iħossuhom milqugħa.
formal.en: The report notes that a closed clique in the office can make it difficult for new employees to feel welcome.
formal.zh: 报告指出，办公室里封闭的小圈子可能使新员工难以感到自己受到欢迎。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dejjem joqogħdu flimkien u ma jistidnux lil ħaddieħor? Rita: Qishom klikka. Ejja nistiednu lit-tifla l-ġdida toqgħod magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do they always sit together and never invite anyone else? Rita: They seem like a clique. Let's invite the new girl to sit with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么总坐在一起，也不邀请别人？丽塔：他们像个小圈子。我们邀请新来的女孩跟我们坐吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem joqogħdu flimkien u ma jistidnux lil ħaddieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem joqogħdu flimkien u ma jistidnux lil ħaddieħor?
messages.zh: 他们为什么总坐在一起，也不邀请别人？
messages.en: Why do they always sit together and never invite anyone else?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qishom klikka. Ejja nistiednu lit-tifla l-ġdida toqgħod magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Qishom klikka. Ejja nistiednu lit-tifla l-ġdida toqgħod magħna.
messages.zh: 他们像个小圈子。我们邀请新来的女孩跟我们坐吧。
messages.en: They seem like a clique. Let's invite the new girl to sit with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klikka 联想成课间只顾自己聊天、不让别人加入的几个人，记住它常含“小圈子、排外”的贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The usual weather conditions in a place over a long period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地区在较长时期内通常具有的气温、降水等天气状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjonijiet tat-temp li normalment ikun hemm f'post fuq medda twila ta' żmien, bħat-temperatura u x-xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个地区长期呈现的总体天气特征，包括温度、降水等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-karatteristiċi ġenerali tat-temp f'reġjun fuq ħafna snin, inklużi t-temperatura, ix-xita u l-varjazzjonijiet staġjonali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The climate of a place is the general pattern of weather it experiences over many years.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-klima tar-reġjun billi jqabbel it-temperaturi u x-xita fuq perjodu ta' tletin sena.
formal.en: The study describes the region's climate by comparing temperatures and rainfall over a period of thirty years.
formal.zh: 该研究通过比较三十年间的气温和降水来描述这一地区的气候。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif inhi l-klima fejn toqgħod? Lara: Il-klima hi sħuna u niexfa, imma llum qed tagħmel ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is the climate like where you live? Lara: The climate is warm and dry, but it's raining today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你住的地方气候怎么样？拉拉：气候温暖干燥，不过今天在下雨。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhi l-klima fejn toqgħod?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhi l-klima fejn toqgħod?
messages.zh: 你住的地方气候怎么样？
messages.en: What is the climate like where you live?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-klima hi sħuna u niexfa, imma llum qed tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Il-klima hi sħuna u niexfa, imma llum qed tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.zh: 气候温暖干燥，不过今天在下雨。
messages.en: The climate is warm and dry, but it's raining today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 klima 时想象一张记录多年气温和雨量的图：它表示长期气候，今天下不下雨则属于当天的天气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people receive medical consultations, examinations, or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人们接受医疗咨询、检查或治疗的诊所或门诊机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn il-pazjenti jmorru għal konsultazzjonijiet, eżamijiet jew kura medika, normalment mingħajr ma joqogħdu hemm matul il-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供医疗诊察或治疗服务的诊所或门诊机构，患者通常无需留宿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità medika fejn il-pazjenti jiġu eżaminati jew jingħataw kura, ġeneralment mingħajr il-ħtieġa li jibqgħu hemm matul il-lejl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clinic is a place where patients receive medical advice, examinations, or treatment, usually without staying overnight.

formal.mt: Il-klinika titlob lill-pazjenti jaslu għaxar minuti qabel l-appuntament tagħhom u jġibu magħhom dokument ta' identifikazzjoni.
formal.en: The clinic asks patients to arrive ten minutes before their appointment and bring an identification document.
formal.zh: 诊所要求患者在预约时间前十分钟到达，并携带身份证明文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu? Pawlu: Għandi appuntament fil-klinika fid-disgħa. Sara: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu wara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going this morning? Pawlu: I have an appointment at the clinic at nine. Sara: All right, see you afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天早上要去哪里？保罗：我九点在诊所有个就诊预约。萨拉：好，之后见。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你今天早上要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi appuntament fil-klinika fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi appuntament fil-klinika fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 我九点在诊所有个就诊预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment at the clinic at nine.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu wara.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu wara.
messages.zh: 好，之后见。
messages.en: All right, see you afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klinika 配上一幅诊所门口有人拿着预约单的画面，并整块记住 fil-klinika，表示“在诊所”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the examination and treatment of patients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与直接检查、诊断和治疗患者有关的；临床的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-eżami, id-dijanjożi u l-kura tal-pazjenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及对患者进行实际诊察、诊断或治疗的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marbut max-xogħol mediku li jinvolvi l-osservazzjoni, l-eżami, id-dijanjożi jew it-trattament tal-pazjenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is clinical relates to the examination, diagnosis, or treatment of patients.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi taħriġ kliniku li fih l-istudenti jeżaminaw pazjenti taħt is-superviżjoni ta' tobba b'esperjenza.
formal.en: The programme includes clinical training in which students examine patients under the supervision of experienced doctors.
formal.zh: 该课程包括临床培训，学生在经验丰富的医生指导下检查患者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum għandkom lezzjoni fl-università? Mark: Le, illum għandna taħriġ kliniku fl-isptar. Maja: Mela se tkunu mal-pazjenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a class at university today? Mark: No, today we have clinical training at the hospital. Maja: So you'll be working with patients.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们今天在大学上课吗？马克：不，今天我们在医院接受临床培训。玛雅：那你们会接触患者了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandkom lezzjoni fl-università?
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandkom lezzjoni fl-università?
messages.zh: 你们今天在大学上课吗？
messages.en: Do you have a class at university today?

messages.speaker: Mark (医学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum għandna taħriġ kliniku fl-isptar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum għandna taħriġ kliniku fl-isptar.
messages.zh: 不，今天我们在医院接受临床培训。
messages.en: No, today we have clinical training at the hospital.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se tkunu mal-pazjenti.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se tkunu mal-pazjenti.
messages.zh: 那你们会接触患者了。
messages.en: So you'll be working with patients.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 eżami kliniku“临床检查”来记：想象医生正在检查患者，kliniku 在这个词组里说明检查属于临床诊疗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short section of a film or video that can be watched separately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从电影或视频中截取、可以单独观看的一小段内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Silta qasira minn film jew vidjo li tista' tintwera u taraha separatament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电影、视频等视听内容中的短片段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klipp huwa silta qasira minn film jew vidjo, magħżula biex tintwera separatament mill-bqija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clip is a short section of a film or video that is shown separately.

formal.mt: L-għalliema wriet klipp qasir mid-dokumentarju biex tibda d-diskussjoni fil-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher showed a short clip from the documentary to begin the classroom discussion.
formal.zh: 老师播放了纪录片中的一小段内容，以此展开课堂讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-klipp li bgħattlek? Mark: Iva, imma nixtieq nara l-film kollu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you watch the clip I sent you? Mark: Yes, but I'd like to watch the whole film!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看了我发给你的片段吗？马克：看了，不过我想看整部电影！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-klipp li bgħattlek?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-klipp li bgħattlek?
messages.zh: 你看了我发给你的片段吗？
messages.en: Did you watch the clip I sent you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nixtieq nara l-film kollu!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nixtieq nara l-film kollu!
messages.zh: 看了，不过我想看整部电影！
messages.en: Yes, but I'd like to watch the whole film!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klipp 配上一段十秒电影画面来记：看到这个词，就想到可单独播放的短片段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enclosed space inside a building, used for sleeping, working, or other activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物内由墙壁等围成、用于睡眠、工作或其他活动的空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju magħluq ġewwa bini, imdawwar bil-ħitan u maħsub għall-irqad, għax-xogħol jew għal attivitajiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物内隔出的房间，可供居住、工作或其他活动使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra hija spazju separat ġewwa bini, imdawwar bil-ħitan, fejn in-nies jistgħu jorqdu, jaħdmu jew jagħmlu attivitajiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A room is a separate space inside a building where people sleep, work, or carry out other activities.

formal.mt: Wara l-attività, it-tfal daħlu f'kmarthom biex jistrieħu.
formal.en: After the activity, the children went into the room to rest.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，孩子们走进房间休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qegħdin it-tfal? Mark: Qegħdin f'kmarthom, jaqraw ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the children? Mark: They're in the room, reading a book.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子们在哪儿？马克：他们在房间里看书。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qegħdin it-tfal?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qegħdin it-tfal?
messages.zh: 孩子们在哪儿？
messages.en: Where are the children?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qegħdin f'kmarthom, jaqraw ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin f'kmarthom, jaqraw ktieb.
messages.zh: 他们在房间里看书。
messages.en: They're in the room, reading a book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kmarthom 整体写在房间图片旁，再联想进门、休息和看书三个场景，帮助记住房间这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alliance of parties or groups that cooperate to achieve a shared aim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多个政党或团体为实现共同目标而组成的合作联盟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' partiti jew gruppi li jaħdmu flimkien biex jilħqu għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由不同政党、组织或团体为共同目标组成的联盟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Koalizzjoni hija għaqda bejn partiti, organizzazzjonijiet jew gruppi differenti li jiftiehmu biex jaħdmu flimkien għal għan komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coalition is an alliance of different parties or groups that agree to work together for a shared purpose.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif diversi organizzazzjonijiet iffurmaw koalizzjoni biex jipproteġu l-ambjent.
formal.en: The report describes how several organizations formed a coalition to protect the environment.
formal.zh: 报告说明了几个组织如何组建联盟，共同保护环境。

colloquial.en: Maja: Why did these groups form a coalition? Mark: To work together and have a stronger voice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些团体为什么组建联盟？马克：为了共同开展工作，让自己的声音更有分量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formally organized body of laws governing commerce and business activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将规范商业及经营活动的法律系统编纂而成的法典。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra organizzata ta' liġijiet li jirregolaw il-kummerċ u l-attivitajiet tan-negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商法典，即系统编纂、规范商业及经营活动的法律总集。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kodiċi kummerċjali huwa ġabra sistematika ta' liġijiet li jistabbilixxu regoli għall-kummerċ u għall-attivitajiet tan-negozju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Commercial Code is an organized body of laws that sets out rules governing commerce and business activities.

collocations.en: the provisions of the Commercial Code

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw silta mill-kodiċi kummerċjali bħala parti mill-kors tagħhom fil-liġi.
formal.en: The students analyzed an excerpt from the Commercial Code as part of their law course.
formal.zh: 学生们在法律课程中分析了商法典的一段节选。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra għall-lezzjoni ta' għada? Mark: Silta mill-kodiċi kummerċjali; irrid nifhem it-termini qabel il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading for tomorrow's lesson? Mark: An excerpt from the Commercial Code; I want to understand the terms before the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在为明天的课读什么？马克：商法典的一段节选；我想在上课前弄懂其中的术语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of laws governing commerce and commercial activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集中规定商业活动及相关法律关系的法典。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' liġijiet li jirregolaw il-kummerċ u l-attivitajiet kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商法典，即规范商业活动及相关法律关系的成文法律汇编。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kodiċi li jiġbor fih il-liġijiet dwar il-kummerċ u r-relazzjonijiet marbuta mal-attivitajiet kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Commercial Code is a collection of laws that governs commerce and the legal relationships arising from commercial activities.

collocations.en: the provisions of the Commercial Code

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tagħha, l-istudenta analizzat diversi dispożizzjonijiet tal-Kodiċi tal-Kummerċ.
formal.en: In her study, the student analysed several provisions of the Commercial Code.
formal.zh: 这名学生在研究中分析了商法典的若干条款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with a rounded, swollen stem that can be eaten raw or cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种具有圆球状膨大茎部的蔬菜，膨大的茎可以生吃或煮熟食用，称为苤蓝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'zokk minfuħ u tond li jista' jittiekel nej jew imsajjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苤蓝，又称球茎甘蓝，以圆球状膨大的茎部供食用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħaxixa li għandha zokk minfuħ f'għamla ta' ballun u li jittiekel nej jew imsajjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Kohlrabi is a vegetable with a swollen, rounded stem that people eat either raw or cooked.

formal.mt: Biex tipprepara l-insalata, qaxxar il-kohlrabi u qattgħu f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: To prepare the salad, peel the kohlrabi and cut it into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作这道沙拉时，先将苤蓝去皮，再切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se nagħmlu b'dan il-kohlrabi? Pawlu: Nistgħu nqattgħuh irqiq u nżiduh mal-insalata. Lara: Tajjeb, jien naħsel il-ħass.
colloquial.en: Lara: What shall we do with this kohlrabi? Pawlu: We can slice it thinly and add it to the salad. Lara: Good, I will wash the lettuce.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个苤蓝我们怎么吃？保罗：可以切成薄片，加到沙拉里。拉拉：好，那我来洗生菜。

messages.en: What shall we do with this kohlrabi?

gloss_zh: 同义词（具体对应词未指明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term described as a synonym, with its specific equivalent left unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被描述为同义词的词语；同义词指意义相同或相近的词，但此处未指明具体对应词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma deskritta bħala sinonimu, jiġifieri kelma b'tifsira l-istess jew qrib dik ta' kelma oħra, mingħajr ma tiġi speċifikata l-kelma l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同义词，即与另一词意义相同或相近的词；具体与哪个词同义未予指明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li għandha tifsira l-istess jew qrib ħafna ta' dik ta' kelma oħra; hawnhekk il-kelma l-oħra mhijiex speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synonym is a word with the same or nearly the same meaning as another word, although the particular equivalent is unspecified here.

collocations.en: the use of the word 'Kohol' in context

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-kelma 'Kohol' bħala sinonimu, iċċekkja li t-tifsira tagħha taqbel mal-kuntest.
formal.en: Before using the word 'Kohol' as a synonym, check that its meaning fits the context.
formal.zh: 将“Kohol”一词作为同义词使用之前，应先核实其含义是否符合语境。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nuża 'Kohol' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ejja naraw il-kuntest qabel nagħżlu l-kelma. Nina: Sewwa, naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I use 'Kohol' in this sentence? Mark: Let us look at the context before choosing the word. Nina: All right, let us read the whole sentence.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个句子里可以用“Kohol”吗？马克：我们先看看语境，再选词。妮娜：好，我们把整句读一遍。

messages.en: Can I use 'Kohol' in this sentence?

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unexpected connection between events that happens by chance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两件或多件事情偶然发生联系、同时出现或彼此吻合的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qbil mhux mistenni bejn żewġ ġrajjiet jew aktar li jseħħ b'kumbinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巧合，指原本没有安排或明显因果联系的事情偶然同时发生或彼此吻合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn żewġ ġrajjiet jew aktar jaqblu jew iseħħu fl-istess ħin b'kumbinazzjoni, mingħajr ma jkunu ġew ippjanati flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coincidence occurs when events unexpectedly happen together or resemble one another without having been deliberately arranged.

formal.mt: Kienet koinċidenza li ż-żewġ studenti għażlu l-istess suġġett mingħajr ma tkellmu bejniethom.
formal.en: It was a coincidence that the two students chose the same topic without discussing it with each other.
formal.zh: 两名学生事先没有商量，却选择了同一个题目，这纯属巧合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int ukoll hawn? X'koinċidenza! David: Iva, ġejt nixtri ktieb. Sara: Jien ukoll! Għażilna l-istess ħanut.
colloquial.en: Sara: You are here too? What a coincidence! David: Yes, I came to buy a book. Sara: Me too! We chose the same shop.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你也在这里？真巧！戴维：是啊，我来买本书。萨拉：我也是！我们选了同一家店。

messages.en: You are here too? What a coincidence!

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contraceptive device placed inside the uterus to help prevent pregnancy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放置在子宫内、用于预防怀孕的避孕装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat għall-kontraċezzjoni li jitqiegħed fl-utru biex jgħin jipprevjeni t-tqala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宫内节育器，即放置在子宫内以预防怀孕的避孕装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kojl huwa apparat għall-kontraċezzjoni li jitqiegħed fl-utru biex jgħin jipprevjeni t-tqala.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An IUD is a contraceptive device that is placed inside the uterus to help prevent pregnancy.

collocations.zh: 用于避孕的宫内节育器

formal.mt: It-tabib spjega li l-kojl huwa apparat għall-kontraċezzjoni li jitqiegħed fl-utru.
formal.en: The doctor explained that an IUD is a contraceptive device placed inside the uterus.
formal.zh: 医生解释说，宫内节育器是一种放置在子宫内的避孕装置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-kojl? Lara: Huwa apparat żgħir li jitqiegħed fl-utru biex jgħin jipprevjeni t-tqala.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is an IUD? Lara: It is a small device placed inside the uterus to help prevent pregnancy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：宫内节育器是什么？拉拉：它是一种放置在子宫内、帮助预防怀孕的小装置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A powerful stimulant drug that can cause addiction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种具有强烈兴奋作用、可能导致成瘾的毒品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Droga stimulanti qawwija li tista' tikkawża dipendenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可卡因，一种具有强烈兴奋作用并可能导致成瘾的毒品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kokaina hija droga stimulanti qawwija li tista' tikkawża dipendenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cocaine is a powerful stimulant drug that can cause a person to become addicted.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-riskji għas-saħħa marbuta mal-użu tal-kokaina.
formal.en: The report describes the health risks associated with cocaine use.
formal.zh: 报告描述了使用可卡因所带来的健康风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex kien l-artiklu li qrajt? Lara: Fuq il-kokaina u r-riskji tagħha għas-saħħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the article you read about? Lara: About cocaine and its health risks.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你读的那篇文章讲什么？拉拉：讲可卡因及其健康风险。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex kien l-artiklu li qrajt?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex kien l-artiklu li qrajt?

messages.en: What was the article you read about?

messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-kokaina u r-riskji tagħha għas-saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-kokaina u r-riskji tagħha għas-saħħa.
messages.zh: 讲可卡因及其健康风险。
messages.en: About cocaine and its health risks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kokaina 与中文“可卡因”对照朗读，利用声音上的相近帮助记忆；再把 l-użu tal-kokaina 整体记作“使用可卡因”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meal eaten late in the morning that combines breakfast and lunch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常在上午较晚时吃、合并早餐和午餐的一餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla li normalment tittiekel tard filgħodu u tgħaqqad il-kolazzjon u l-ikla ta' nofsinhar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早午餐，即通常在上午较晚时吃、兼作早餐和午餐的一餐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kolazranzu huwa ikla li normalment tittiekel tard filgħodu u tgħaqqad il-kolazzjon u l-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brunch is a meal eaten late in the morning that takes the place of both breakfast and lunch.

formal.mt: Il-kolazranzu se jsir il-Ħadd fil-ħdax ta' filgħodu fil-kafetterija tal-mużew.
formal.en: Brunch will take place on Sunday at eleven in the morning in the museum café.
formal.zh: 早午餐将于周日上午十一点在博物馆咖啡馆举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nieħdu kolazranzu flimkien għada? Lara: Iva, niltaqgħu fil-ħdax fil-kafetterija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to have brunch together tomorrow? Lara: Yes, let's meet at eleven at the café.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天一起吃早午餐吗？拉拉：好，我们十一点在咖啡馆见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nieħdu kolazranzu flimkien għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nieħdu kolazranzu flimkien għada?
messages.zh: 明天一起吃早午餐吗？
messages.en: Do you want to have brunch together tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niltaqgħu fil-ħdax fil-kafetterija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niltaqgħu fil-ħdax fil-kafetterija.
messages.zh: 好，我们十一点在咖啡馆见。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet at eleven at the café.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象周日十一点与朋友一起吃一餐，同时解决早餐和午餐，把这个场景与 kolazranzu 配对；用“十一点的早午餐”提示词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一天中的第一餐，通常在早晨吃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel ikla tal-ġurnata, li normalment tittiekel filgħodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早餐，即一天中的第一餐，通常在早晨吃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kolazzjon huwa l-ewwel ikla tal-ġurnata u normalment jittiekel filgħodu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Breakfast is the first meal you eat in the day, usually during the morning.

formal.mt: Il-lukanda sservi l-kolazzjon kuljum mis-sebgħa sad-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The hotel serves breakfast every day from seven to nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 酒店每天早上七点至九点供应早餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà ħadt il-kolazzjon? Lara: Le, se nieħu ftit ħobż u kikkra te.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you had breakfast already? Lara: No, I'm going to have some bread and a cup of tea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你已经吃过早餐了吗？拉拉：还没，我打算吃点面包，喝杯茶。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà ħadt il-kolazzjon?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà ħadt il-kolazzjon?
messages.zh: 你已经吃过早餐了吗？
messages.en: Have you had breakfast already?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nieħu ftit ħobż u kikkra te.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nieħu ftit ħobż u kikkra te.
messages.zh: 还没，我打算吃点面包，喝杯茶。
messages.en: No, I'm going to have some bread and a cup of tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早晨起床后桌上的面包和茶，把 kolazzjon 与“早餐”一起记；再朗读 nieħu l-kolazzjon，形成“吃早餐”的完整表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving people working together and sharing ideas or tasks to achieve a common aim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人们通过共同参与、分享想法或分担任务来实现共同目标的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi nies jaħdmu flimkien u jaqsmu ideat jew kompiti biex jilħqu għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合作的；通过多人共同参与和分工完成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsir permezz ta' ħidma flimkien, fejn il-parteċipanti jaqsmu l-ideat u r-responsabbiltajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A collaborative activity involves people working together and contributing their ideas or effort towards a shared result.

formal.mt: Il-proġett kollaborattiv jippermetti lill-istudenti jaqsmu l-ideat u jfasslu soluzzjoni flimkien.
formal.en: The collaborative project allows students to share ideas and develop a solution together.
formal.zh: 这个合作项目让学生能够分享想法，并共同设计解决方案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan hu proġett kollaborattiv? Mark: Iva, int tikteb it-test u jien inħejji l-istampi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a collaborative project? Mark: Yes, you write the text and I'll prepare the pictures.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是一个合作项目吗？马克：是的，你写文字，我来准备图片。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu proġett kollaborattiv?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu proġett kollaborattiv?
messages.zh: 这是一个合作项目吗？
messages.en: Is this a collaborative project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, int tikteb it-test u jien inħejji l-istampi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, int tikteb it-test u jien inħejji l-istampi.
messages.zh: 是的，你写文字，我来准备图片。
messages.en: Yes, you write the text and I'll prepare the pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proġett kollaborattiv 和“两个人分工完成一个项目”的画面绑定：一人写文字，一人配图片，突出共同参与。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person you work with, especially in the same organization or profession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与你一起工作的人，尤其指同一机构或同一职业中的同事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem miegħek, speċjalment fl-istess organizzazzjoni jew fl-istess professjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同事；与你在同一机构工作或从事同一职业的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem magħha jew li għandha l-istess professjoni tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your colleague is someone you work with, particularly someone in the same organization or profession as you.

formal.mt: Il-kollega tiegħi ħejja r-rapport u ppreżenta r-riżultati waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: My colleague prepared the report and presented the results during the meeting.
formal.zh: 我的同事准备了报告，并在会议上介绍了结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejk fir-ritratt? Mark: Dak hu kollega tiegħi; naħdmu fl-istess uffiċċju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that next to you in the photo? Mark: That's a colleague of mine; we work in the same office.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里你旁边那个人是谁？马克：那是我的一位同事，我们在同一个办公室工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ħdejk fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ħdejk fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 照片里你旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that next to you in the photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu kollega tiegħi; naħdmu fl-istess uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu kollega tiegħi; naħdmu fl-istess uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 那是我的一位同事，我们在同一个办公室工作。
messages.en: That's a colleague of mine; we work in the same office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kollega 就想象办公室合照中站在自己旁边的人，配合 kollega tiegħi“我的同事”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exceptional greatness in size, amount, or scale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极大的体量、数量或规模，强调超出一般程度的巨大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kobor eċċezzjonali fid-daqs, fil-kwantità jew fl-iskala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巨大；极其庞大的体量、数量或规模。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kobor jew skala li jaqbżu bil-kbir dak li jitqies normali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe something as colossal, you mean that its size, amount, or scale is exceptionally great.

formal.mt: Ir-restawr tal-bini kien jeħtieġ sforz kollosali minħabba l-ħsara estensiva.
formal.en: Restoring the building required a colossal effort because of the extensive damage.
formal.zh: 由于损坏范围很广，修复这座建筑需要付出极大的努力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mort bix-xogħol fuq id-dar? Mark: Kien sforz kollosali, imma fl-aħħar lestejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the work on the house go? Mark: It was a colossal effort, but we finally finished.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：房子的工程进行得怎么样？马克：费了极大的力气，不过我们终于完成了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mort bix-xogħol fuq id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mort bix-xogħol fuq id-dar?
messages.zh: 房子的工程进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the work on the house go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien sforz kollosali, imma fl-aħħar lestejna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien sforz kollosali, imma fl-aħħar lestejna.
messages.zh: 费了极大的力气，不过我们终于完成了。
messages.en: It was a colossal effort, but we finally finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kollosali 放进 sforz kollosali，想象修复整座大楼所需的巨大努力，用夸张的规模感记住含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Upright pillars that support a building or form part of its architectural design.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑中竖立的柱子，可用于承重，也可构成建筑的装饰或布局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pilastri weqfin li jwieżnu parti minn bini jew jiffurmaw parti mid-disinn arkitettoniku tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柱子；建筑中用于支撑或装饰的多根立柱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pilastri vertikali li jintużaw biex isostnu struttura jew biex iżejnu bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Columns are upright pillars that support parts of a building or serve as architectural features.

formal.mt: Il-koloni tal-ġebel isostnu s-saqaf u jagħtu dehra eleganti lid-daħla tal-bini.
formal.en: The stone columns support the roof and give the building's entrance an elegant appearance.
formal.zh: 这些石柱支撑着屋顶，并使建筑入口显得典雅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nistennew lill-oħrajn? Mark: Ħdejn il-koloni tad-daħla; hemm id-dell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we wait for the others? Mark: By the columns at the entrance; there's shade there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里等其他人？马克：在入口的柱子旁边吧，那里有阴凉。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nistennew lill-oħrajn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nistennew lill-oħrajn?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里等其他人？
messages.en: Where shall we wait for the others?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-koloni tad-daħla; hemm id-dell.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-koloni tad-daħla; hemm id-dell.
messages.zh: 在入口的柱子旁边吧，那里有阴凉。
messages.en: By the columns at the entrance; there's shade there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ringiela ta' koloni“一排柱子”建立画面，想象几根石柱并排支撑屋顶，特别记住这里表示多根柱子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A column is an upright supporting structure or a vertical arrangement of information on a page.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指建筑中直立的支撑柱，也指页面或表格中纵向排列的一栏或一列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kolonna hija struttura wieqfa li ssostni parti minn bini, jew tqassim vertikali ta' kitba jew informazzjoni fuq paġna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物中直立、用于支撑屋顶或其他结构的柱子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kolonna hija struttura wieqfa u soda li ssostni saqaf jew parti oħra ta' bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pillar is a strong upright structure that supports a roof or another part of a building.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 页面中纵向编排的文字栏，或表格中上下排列的一列数据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kolonna hija sezzjoni vertikali ta' kitba fuq paġna jew sensiela ta' elementi mqiegħda wieħed taħt l-ieħor f'tabella.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A column is a vertical section of text or a set of entries arranged one below another.

formal.mt: L-inġinier eżamina l-kolonna tal-ġebel biex jivverifika jekk kinitx għadha ssostni s-saqaf sew.
formal.en: The engineer examined the stone pillar to check whether it was still supporting the roof properly.
formal.zh: 工程师检查了那根石柱，以确认它是否仍能稳固地支撑屋顶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema kolonna nikteb il-prezz? Mark: Ikteb il-prezz fit-tieni kolonna, ħdejn l-isem tal-prodott.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which column should I write the price in? Mark: Write the price in the second column, next to the product name.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：价格写在哪一列？马克：把价格写在第二列，产品名称旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema kolonna nikteb il-prezz?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema kolonna nikteb il-prezz?
messages.zh: 价格写在哪一列？
messages.en: Which column should I write the price in?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb il-prezz fit-tieni kolonna, ħdejn l-isem tal-prodott.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb il-prezz fit-tieni kolonna, ħdejn l-isem tal-prodott.
messages.zh: 把价格写在第二列，产品名称旁边。
messages.en: Write the price in the second column, next to the product name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把石柱和表格竖列并排想象：两者都从上向下延伸，帮助记住 kolonna 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coup is a sudden seizure of political power by a group acting outside the normal legal process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个集团绕过正常法律程序，突然夺取国家政权的行动；常见于短语 kolp ta' stat。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kolp, fl-espressjoni kolp ta' stat, huwa teħid f'daqqa tal-poter politiku minn grupp li jaġixxi barra mill-proċess legali normali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某个集团以不符合正常法律程序的方式突然夺取国家政权的政变。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kolp ta' stat huwa azzjoni li biha grupp jieħu f'idejh il-poter tal-istat f'daqqa u mingħajr ma jsegwi l-proċess legali normali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coup occurs when a group suddenly takes control of a state through means outside the normal legal process.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza kif kolp ta' stat jista' jaffettwa l-istabbiltà politika ta' pajjiż.
formal.en: The report analyses how a coup can affect a country's political stability.
formal.zh: 该报告分析了政变可能如何影响一个国家的政治稳定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu kolp ta' stat? Pawlu: Huwa meta grupp jieħu l-poter f'daqqa mingħajr ma jsegwi l-proċess legali normali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a coup? Pawlu: It is when a group suddenly takes power without following the normal legal process.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是政变？保罗：就是某个集团不按正常法律程序，突然夺取政权。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu kolp ta' stat?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu kolp ta' stat?
messages.zh: 什么是政变？
messages.en: What is a coup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta grupp jieħu l-poter f'daqqa mingħajr ma jsegwi l-proċess legali normali.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta grupp jieħu l-poter f'daqqa mingħajr ma jsegwi l-proċess legali normali.
messages.zh: 就是某个集团不按正常法律程序，突然夺取政权。
messages.en: It is when a group suddenly takes power without following the normal legal process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kolp ta' stat 整组记成“突然夺取国家政权”，再用“发动政变”和“政变企图”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is komdu is convenient for your needs or makes you feel comfortable and relaxed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容时间、地点或安排适合需要、使用方便，也形容地方或物品让人感到舒适放松。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun komda meta tkun adattata għall-ħtiġijiet tiegħek u faċli biex tużaha, jew meta tagħtik sens ta' kumdità u mistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在时间、地点或使用方式上适合需要，能减少麻烦的；方便的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun komda meta l-ħin, il-post jew il-mod kif tintuża jkunu adattati għall-ħtiġijiet ta' persuna u ma joħolqux diffikultà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is convenient if it suits your needs and allows you to do something without unnecessary difficulty.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让人感到舒适、温馨而放松的，常用于描述房间或休息的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post ikun komdu meta jkun pjaċevoli u jġiegħlek tħossok rilassat u għall-kwiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cosy place feels pleasant and comfortable, allowing you to relax and feel at ease.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok agħżel ħin komdu għalik sabiex inkunu nistgħu norganizzaw il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Please choose a time that is convenient for you so that we can arrange the meeting.
formal.zh: 请选择一个您方便的时间，以便我们安排会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu komdu dan is-salott! Mark: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nieħdu kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: This living room is so cosy! Mark: Yes, let's sit here and have a coffee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个客厅真舒服！马克：是啊，我们坐在这里喝杯咖啡吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu komdu dan is-salott!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu komdu dan is-salott!
messages.zh: 这个客厅真舒服！
messages.en: This living room is so cosy!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nieħdu kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nieħdu kafè.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们坐在这里喝杯咖啡吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit here and have a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一次约会：时间安排很方便，客厅坐着很舒服；用这两个场景分别记住 komdu 的两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Comfort is a state of physical ease, while welfare concerns a person's well-being and living conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体或生活上的舒适安适，也可指一个人的福祉，即基本需要得到照顾、生活状况良好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kumdità u l-benesseri ta' persuna, kemm fis-sens ta' mistrieħ fiżiku kif ukoll fis-sens ta' kundizzjonijiet tajbin tal-ħajja u ħtiġijiet bażiċi sodisfatti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体得到放松、没有明显不适，或生活环境令人安适的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kumdità li tħoss meta ġismek ikun mistrieħ u l-ambjent ta' madwarek ma jikkawżalekx skumdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Comfort is the feeling of physical ease you experience when your body and surroundings allow you to relax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人的福祉或整体生活安好，尤其指生活条件及基本需要受到照顾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-benesseri ta' persuna, speċjalment meta jkollha kundizzjonijiet tajbin tal-ħajja u l-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tagħha jkunu sodisfatti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person's welfare is their general well-being, especially in relation to their living conditions and basic needs.

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jieħu ħsieb il-komfort tal-pazjenti billi jiżgura ambjent kwiet u jwieġeb għall-ħtiġijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: Staff should attend to patients' comfort and well-being by ensuring a quiet environment and responding to their needs.
formal.zh: 工作人员应确保环境安静，并回应病人的需要，以照顾他们的舒适与福祉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt din il-lukanda? Pawlu: Għall-komfort. Is-sodda hija komda u l-kamra hija kwieta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this hotel? Pawlu: For the comfort. The bed is comfortable and the room is quiet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么选这家酒店？保罗：因为住着舒服。床很舒适，房间也安静。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt din il-lukanda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt din il-lukanda?
messages.zh: 你为什么选这家酒店？
messages.en: Why did you choose this hotel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-komfort. Is-sodda hija komda u l-kamra hija kwieta.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-komfort. Is-sodda hija komda u l-kamra hija kwieta.
messages.zh: 因为住着舒服。床很舒适，房间也安静。
messages.en: For the comfort. The bed is comfortable and the room is quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想舒服的床，再想生活需要受到照顾：从身体的“舒适”扩展到生活的“福祉”，帮助区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Funny or amusing, especially because something makes people laugh or seems ridiculous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 好笑的、逗人发笑的，也可形容事物滑稽可笑的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lin-nies jidħku jew jitbissmu, jew li jidher redikolu b'mod li jqanqal id-daħk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好笑的；能够逗人发笑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqanqal id-daħk jew id-divertiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is funny makes people laugh or feel amused.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑稽的；因外表、举止或情境显得可笑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher jew iseħħ b'mod stramb jew redikolu li jġiegħel lin-nies jidħku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is comical seems amusing because of its appearance, behaviour, or circumstances.

formal.mt: L-awtur joħloq effett komiku permezz tad-djalogu bejn iż-żewġ karattri.
formal.en: The author creates a comical effect through the dialogue between the two characters.
formal.zh: 作者通过两个角色之间的对话营造滑稽效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-film? Mark: Iva, kien komiku ħafna. Dħakt mill-bidu sal-aħħar!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the film? Mark: Yes, it was very funny. I laughed from beginning to end!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这部电影吗？Mark：喜欢，太好笑了。我从头笑到尾！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbok il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbok il-film?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien komiku ħafna. Dħakt mill-bidu sal-aħħar!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien komiku ħafna. Dħakt mill-bidu sal-aħħar!
messages.zh: 喜欢，太好笑了。我从头笑到尾！
messages.en: Yes, it was very funny. I laughed from beginning to end!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komiku 和电影里令人发笑的片段一起记：film komiku 是好笑的电影，effett komiku 是滑稽效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of a garment that covers all or part of an arm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣服上包住手臂全部或一部分的部分，即衣袖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' libsa li tgħatti d-driegħ kollu jew parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣袖；衣服上覆盖手臂全部或一部分的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' qmis, ġakketta jew libsa oħra li tgħatti d-driegħ kollu jew parti minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sleeve is the part of a garment that covers all or part of your arm.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-uniformi, instabet tebgħa fuq il-komma tal-qmis.
formal.en: During the uniform inspection, a stain was found on the sleeve of the shirt.
formal.zh: 检查制服时，发现衬衫袖子上有一处污渍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi tebgħa fuq il-komma. Tista' tgħinni nneħħiha? Nina: Iva, ġib ftit ilma u sapun.
colloquial.en: Lara: I've got a stain on my sleeve. Can you help me remove it? Nina: Yes, get some water and soap.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我袖子上有块污渍。你能帮我弄掉吗？Nina：可以，拿点水和肥皂来。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tebgħa fuq il-komma. Tista' tgħinni nneħħiha?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tebgħa fuq il-komma. Tista' tgħinni nneħħiha?
messages.zh: 我袖子上有块污渍。你能帮我弄掉吗？
messages.en: I've got a stain on my sleeve. Can you help me remove it?

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġib ftit ilma u sapun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġib ftit ilma u sapun.
messages.zh: 可以，拿点水和肥皂来。
messages.en: Yes, get some water and soap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衬衫袖子上沾了一滴水，把 il-komma tal-qmis 与这个画面绑定；看到 komma 就想到包住手臂的衣袖。

gloss_zh: 词义未明；所给选择器为“什么意思”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry whose supplied selector asks what it means without identifying a lexical meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条目按所给默认词性列为名词，但选择器仅为马耳他语提问“什么意思”，没有提供可确定的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-frażi mogħtija, 'Xi tfisser', tistaqsi dwar it-tifsira u ma tagħtix tifsira speċifika tal-kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给文字意为“什么意思”，是询问含义的表达；此名词选择器未说明词条的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-frażi 'Xi tfisser' tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa; hawnhekk ma tispeċifikax it-tifsira tal-entrata mmarkata bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied phrase asks what something means but does not establish a noun meaning for this headword.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给文字意为“什么意思”，是询问含义的表达；此 sym 选择器未说明任何具体的符号含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-frażi 'Xi tfisser' tistaqsi dwar it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa; l-entrata mmarkata bħala 'sym' ma tagħtix tifsira speċifika ta' simbolu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied phrase asks about meaning but does not identify any specific symbolic use of this headword.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'kommosjoni' tinkludi l-frażi 'Xi tfisser', iżda din il-frażi waħedha ma tipprovdix definizzjoni tal-kelma.
formal.en: The entry 'kommosjoni' includes the phrase 'Xi tfisser', but that phrase alone does not provide a definition of the word.
formal.zh: “kommosjoni”条目包含“Xi tfisser”这一表达，但仅凭该表达无法确定这个词的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kommosjoni'? Pawlu: Hawn għandna biss il-mistoqsija 'Xi tfisser'. Ma għandniex definizzjoni tal-kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'kommosjoni' mean? Pawlu: All we have here is the question 'What does it mean?' We don't have a definition of the word.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“kommosjoni”这个词是什么意思？Pawlu：这里只有“什么意思”这个问题。我们没有这个词的定义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kommosjoni'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kommosjoni'?
messages.zh: “kommosjoni”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'kommosjoni' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn għandna biss il-mistoqsija 'Xi tfisser'. Ma għandniex definizzjoni tal-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn għandna biss il-mistoqsija 'Xi tfisser'. Ma għandniex definizzjoni tal-kelma.
messages.zh: 这里只有“什么意思”这个问题。我们没有这个词的定义。
messages.en: All we have here is the question 'What does it mean?' We don't have a definition of the word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kommosjoni 暂贴一个问号：Xi tfisser 是“什么意思”的提问，不能当作该词的答案；先记清拼写和词义待明的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of excitement or pleasure caused by an experience or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种经历或事件引起的强烈兴奋、激动或愉悦感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni qawwija ta' eċċitament jew pjaċir li titqanqal minn esperjenza jew ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的兴奋感或激动感；某种经历带来的振奋与愉悦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Emozzjoni qawwija ta' eċċitament jew pjaċir li persuna tħoss minħabba xi esperjenza jew ġrajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thrill is a strong feeling of excitement or pleasure that an experience gives you.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanta ddeskriviet il-kommozzjoni li ħasset meta telgħet fuq il-palk għall-ewwel darba.
formal.en: The participant described the thrill she felt when she went on stage for the first time.
formal.zh: 这位参与者描述了自己第一次登台时感受到的激动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ħassejtek meta tlajt fuq il-palk? Mark: Ħassejt kommozzjoni kbira! Kienet l-ewwel darba tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you feel when you went on stage? Mark: I felt such a thrill! It was my first time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你登台时感觉怎么样？Mark：我特别激动！那是我第一次登台。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta tlajt fuq il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta tlajt fuq il-palk?
messages.zh: 你登台时感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel when you went on stage?

messages.speaker: Mark (表演者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt kommozzjoni kbira! Kienet l-ewwel darba tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt kommozzjoni kbira! Kienet l-ewwel darba tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我特别激动！那是我第一次登台。
messages.en: I felt such a thrill! It was my first time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象第一次站上舞台时心中涌起的兴奋，把那一阵激动与 kommozzjoni 连起来；搭配 kommozzjoni kbira 记住强烈的激动感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Electrical switchgear used to control connections in a high-voltage system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于控制高压电力系统中电路连接或断开的开关设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat elettriku li jintuża biex jikkontrolla l-konnessjoni jew il-qtugħ taċ-ċirkwiti f'sistema ta' voltaġġ għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于高压电路连接、断开和控制的开关设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat ta' swiċċjar li jintuża għall-konnessjoni, il-qtugħ u l-kontroll taċ-ċirkwiti ta' voltaġġ għoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: High-voltage switchgear is electrical equipment used to control the connection and disconnection of high-voltage circuits.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi r-riżultati tal-ispezzjoni tal-kommutatur ta' voltaġġ għoli.
formal.en: The report includes the results of the inspection of the high-voltage switchgear.
formal.zh: 报告包含高压开关设备的检查结果。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu r-rapport dwar il-kommutatur ta' voltaġġ għoli? Pawlu: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-pjanta tas-sistema.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is the report on the high-voltage switchgear? Pawlu: On the table, next to the system diagram.
colloquial.zh: Marta：高压开关设备的报告在哪里？Pawlu：在桌上，系统图旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu r-rapport dwar il-kommutatur ta' voltaġġ għoli?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu r-rapport dwar il-kommutatur ta' voltaġġ għoli?
messages.zh: 高压开关设备的报告在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the report on the high-voltage switchgear?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-pjanta tas-sistema.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-pjanta tas-sistema.
messages.zh: 在桌上，系统图旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the system diagram.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成设备名称 kommutatur 和限定语 ta' voltaġġ għoli；看到 voltaġġ għoli 就联想“高电压”，整组记为“高压开关设备”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of furniture beside a bed, used for keeping everyday items within reach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在床边、方便存放或摆放日常小物件的小柜子，即床头柜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamara żgħira ħdejn is-sodda li tintuża biex jitqiegħdu jew jinżammu oġġetti ta' kuljum li jkunu jistgħu jintlaħqu faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 床头柜，即摆在床边供放置灯具、书本等物品的小柜子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamara żgħira li titqiegħed ħdejn is-sodda u tintuża biex jitqiegħdu fuqha lampa, kotba jew oġġetti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bedside table is a small piece of furniture beside a bed where you can keep a lamp, books, or other personal items.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橱柜，即带有柜门、用于收纳物品的柜子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa għamara bil-bibien li tintuża biex jinżammu fiha oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors in which you keep various items.

collocations.en: a bedside table next to the bed

formal.mt: Il-kamra għandha sodda waħda u komodina b'lampa żgħira fuqha.
formal.en: The room has one bed and a bedside table with a small lamp on it.
formal.zh: 房间里有一张床和一个床头柜，柜上放着一盏小灯。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ħallejt il-ktieb tiegħi? Luqa: Fuq il-komodina, ħdejn il-lampa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you leave my book? Luqa: On the bedside table, next to the lamp.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你把我的书放在哪里了？Luqa：在床头柜上，小灯旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn ħallejt il-ktieb tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn ħallejt il-ktieb tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你把我的书放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you leave my book?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-komodina, ħdejn il-lampa.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-komodina, ħdejn il-lampa.
messages.zh: 在床头柜上，小灯旁边。
messages.en: On the bedside table, next to the lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象睡前把书放在 komodina 上：床边的小柜帮助记住“床头柜”；再用柜门和收纳物品的画面联系“橱柜”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agricultural product grown or produced for sale and trade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供买卖和交易的农业产品，在商品分类语境中称为软商品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott agrikolu li jitkabbar jew jiġi prodott biex jinbiegħ u jiġi nnegozjat fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软商品，指咖啡、可可、棉花等通过农业生产获得并用于交易的商品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jinkiseb mill-agrikoltura, bħall-kafè, il-kawkaw jew il-qoton, u li jinbiegħ u jiġi nnegozjat bħala komodità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A soft commodity is an agricultural product, such as coffee, cocoa, or cotton, that is bought and sold in markets.

collocations.en: the price of an agricultural commodity
collocations.zh: 一种农产品商品的价格

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel il-prezz ta' din il-komodità agrikola f'żewġ swieq differenti.
formal.en: The study compares the price of this agricultural commodity in two different markets.
formal.zh: 该研究比较了这种农产品商品在两个不同市场的价格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kafè huwa komodità agrikola? Mark: Iva, jitkabbar u jinbiegħ fis-suq bħala prodott agrikolu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is coffee an agricultural commodity? Mark: Yes, it is grown and sold on the market as an agricultural product.
colloquial.zh: Nina：咖啡属于农产品商品吗？Mark：是的，它经过种植，并作为农产品在市场上出售。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kafè huwa komodità agrikola?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kafè huwa komodità agrikola?
messages.zh: 咖啡属于农产品商品吗？
messages.en: Is coffee an agricultural commodity?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jitkabbar u jinbiegħ fis-suq bħala prodott agrikolu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jitkabbar u jinbiegħ fis-suq bħala prodott agrikolu.
messages.zh: 是的，它经过种植，并作为农产品在市场上出售。
messages.en: Yes, it is grown and sold on the market as an agricultural product.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“农田里的作物进入交易市场”这幅画面记 komodità agrikola；“软商品”是商品类别名称，不表示摸起来一定柔软。

exact_key: kompartiment tal-kalibrar b'marki tal-kejl minn ġewwa
gloss_zh: 内壁带测量刻度的校准腔

teaching_sense.en_definition: A calibration chamber with measurement graduations marked on its inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内部标有测量刻度、供校准使用的腔室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompartiment li jintuża għall-kalibrar u li għandu marki tal-kejl fuq in-naħa ta' ġewwa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内壁设有测量刻度的校准腔室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompartiment għall-kalibrar li għandu skala magħmula minn marki tal-kejl fuq il-wiċċ ta' ġewwa tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An internally graduated calibration chamber is a chamber used for calibration that has measurement markings on its inner surface.

collocations.mt: spezzjoni tal-kompartiment tal-kalibrar b'marki tal-kejl minn ġewwa
collocations.en: inspection of the internally graduated calibration chamber
collocations.zh: 内壁带测量刻度的校准腔检查

collocations.mt: tindif tal-kompartiment tal-kalibrar b'marki tal-kejl minn ġewwa
collocations.en: cleaning of the internally graduated calibration chamber
collocations.zh: 内壁带测量刻度的校准腔清洁

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni kkonfermat li l-marki fil-kompartiment tal-kalibrar b'marki tal-kejl minn ġewwa kienu ċari u faċli biex jinqraw.
formal.en: The inspection confirmed that the markings in the internally graduated calibration chamber were clear and easy to read.
formal.zh: 检查确认，内壁带测量刻度的校准腔中的刻度清晰易读。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan hu l-kompartiment tal-kalibrar b'marki tal-kejl minn ġewwa? David: Iva, ara l-marki fuq in-naħa ta' ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is this the internally graduated calibration chamber? David: Yes, look at the markings on the inside.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这就是内壁带测量刻度的校准腔吗？David：是的，看里面的刻度。

messages.speaker: Elena (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-kompartiment tal-kalibrar b'marki tal-kejl minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-kompartiment tal-kalibrar b'marki tal-kejl minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 这就是内壁带测量刻度的校准腔吗？
messages.en: Is this the internally graduated calibration chamber?

messages.speaker: David (实验室技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-marki fuq in-naħa ta' ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-marki fuq in-naħa ta' ġewwa.
messages.zh: 是的，看里面的刻度。
messages.en: Yes, look at the markings on the inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“腔室—校准用途—带测量刻度—位于内部”四步联想：kompartiment、tal-kalibrar、b'marki tal-kejl、minn ġewwa，逐段拼出完整含义。

gloss_zh: 紧凑的；小巧而结构紧密的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small or closely arranged, with little space wasted between its parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积小巧或各部分排列紧密、占用空间少的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu daqs żgħir jew partijiet qrib xulxin, b'mod li jieħu ftit spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧凑的；各部分排列紧密而占用空间少的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-partijiet tiegħu mqiegħda qrib xulxin jew daqs żgħir li jippermettilu jieħu ftit spazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is compact takes up little space because it is small or its parts are arranged closely together.

formal.mt: Dan l-apparat għandu disinn kompatt u jista' jitqiegħed fuq skrivanija żgħira.
formal.en: This equipment has a compact design and can be placed on a small desk.
formal.zh: 这台设备设计紧凑，可以放在小书桌上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan il-mudell? Pawlu: Għax hu kompatt u joqgħod sew fil-borża tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this model? Pawlu: Because it's compact and fits nicely in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这个型号？保罗：因为它小巧，放进我的包里正合适。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt dan il-mudell?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt dan il-mudell?
messages.zh: 你为什么选这个型号？
messages.en: Why did you choose this model?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu kompatt u joqgħod sew fil-borża tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu kompatt u joqgħod sew fil-borża tiegħi.
messages.zh: 因为它小巧，放进我的包里正合适。
messages.en: Because it's compact and fits nicely in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台能轻松装进包里的小设备，把 kompatt 和“小巧紧凑、省空间”联系起来；修饰阴性名词 karozza 时，用 kompatta。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the knowledge and skills needed to do a task properly.
