teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备完成某项任务所需的知识和技能，能够妥善胜任的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għarfien u l-ħiliet meħtieġa biex iwettaq xogħol jew kompitu kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能胜任的；具备妥善完成工作所需的能力、知识和技能的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu biżżejjed għarfien, ħila u kapaċità biex jagħmel xogħol jew iwettaq kompitu tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is competent has the knowledge and skills necessary to carry out a particular task properly.

formal.mt: Il-proġett jeħtieġ tim kompetenti li jkun jista' jsolvi problemi tekniċi u jlesti x-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The project requires a competent team that can solve technical problems and complete the work on time.
formal.zh: 这个项目需要一支有能力的团队，能够解决技术问题并按时完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li Mark jista' jsewwi l-kompjuter? Luqa: Iva, hu kompetenti ħafna u diġà sewwa tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think Mark can fix the computer? Luqa: Yes, he's very competent and has already fixed mine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得马克能修好这台电脑吗？卢卡：能，他很在行，之前已经修好了我的电脑。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark jista' jsewwi l-kompjuter?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark jista' jsewwi l-kompjuter?
messages.zh: 你觉得马克能修好这台电脑吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark can fix the computer?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu kompetenti ħafna u diġà sewwa tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu kompetenti ħafna u diġà sewwa tiegħi.
messages.zh: 能，他很在行，之前已经修好了我的电脑。
messages.en: Yes, he's very competent and has already fixed mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“任务交给他，他能做好”的场景：kompetenti 描述一个人能胜任工作。可与英语 competent 对照拼写，帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The knowledge and practical ability needed to perform a task well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 妥善完成某项任务所需的知识、技能和实际能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għarfien, il-ħiliet u l-kapaċità li persuna teħtieġ biex twettaq xogħol jew kompitu tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胜任能力；能够妥善完成工作或任务的知识与技能。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità ta' persuna li twettaq kompitu kif suppost bis-saħħa tal-għarfien u l-ħiliet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Competence is the ability to perform a task properly by using the knowledge and skills it requires.

formal.mt: Matul it-taħriġ, il-parteċipanti jridu juru kompetenza fl-użu tat-tagħmir.
formal.en: During the training, participants must demonstrate competence in using the equipment.
formal.zh: 培训期间，参与者必须展示熟练使用设备的能力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif marret il-prova tax-xogħol? David: Tajjeb! Qaluli li wrejt kompetenza fl-użu tal-programm.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did the work trial go? David: Well! They told me I demonstrated competence in using the program.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：工作试做怎么样？戴维：挺好！他们说我展现了使用这个程序的能力。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif marret il-prova tax-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif marret il-prova tax-xogħol?
messages.zh: 工作试做怎么样？
messages.en: How did the work trial go?

messages.speaker: David (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Qaluli li wrejt kompetenza fl-użu tal-programm.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Qaluli li wrejt kompetenza fl-użu tal-programm.
messages.zh: 挺好！他们说我展现了使用这个程序的能力。
messages.en: Well! They told me I demonstrated competence in using the program.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一对词区分词性：kompetenti 是“能胜任的”，kompetenza 是“胜任能力”。想象技能考核表上记录着你的专业能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving competition, or able to compete successfully with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及竞争的，或具备与他人、其他产品或其他服务竞争的实力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi kompetizzjoni, jew li għandu l-kwalitajiet meħtieġa biex jikkompeti b'suċċess ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞争性的；具有竞争力、能够与其他人或事物竞争的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi kompetizzjoni bejn persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet, jew li jista' jikkompeti tajjeb ma' oħrajn minħabba l-kwalità, il-prezz jew il-kapaċità tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is competitive involves competition or has qualities that allow it to compete successfully with others.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija toffri servizz ta' kwalità bi prezz kompetittiv biex tattira klijenti ġodda.
formal.en: The company offers a quality service at a competitive price to attract new customers.
formal.zh: 这家公司以有竞争力的价格提供优质服务，以吸引新客户。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-prezz hu kompetittiv? Rita: Iva, qabblitu mal-prezzijiet ta' tliet ħwienet oħra u hu l-aħjar wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this price competitive? Rita: Yes, I compared it with the prices at three other shops, and it's the best one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个价格有竞争力吗？丽塔：有，我拿它和另外三家店的价格比过了，这个最划算。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prezz hu kompetittiv?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prezz hu kompetittiv?
messages.zh: 这个价格有竞争力吗？
messages.en: Is this price competitive?

messages.speaker: Rita (购物同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qabblitu mal-prezzijiet ta' tliet ħwienet oħra u hu l-aħjar wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qabblitu mal-prezzijiet ta' tliet ħwienet oħra u hu l-aħjar wieħed.
messages.zh: 有，我拿它和另外三家店的价格比过了，这个最划算。
messages.en: Yes, I compared it with the prices at three other shops, and it's the best one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比较几家商店报价的场景：prezz kompetittiv 就是能在比较中吸引顾客的价格。把 kompetittiv 与“参与竞争、有竞争力”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that competes with another for the same goal or advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为同一目标、机会或优势而与他人竞争的人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tikkompeti ma' oħra biex tikseb l-istess għan jew vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在同一领域争取相同目标或优势的竞争对手。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tikkompeti ma' persuna jew organizzazzjoni oħra għall-istess għan jew vantaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your rival is someone who competes with you for the same goal, position, or advantage.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-kumpanija bħala l-kompetitur ewlieni tagħna fis-suq lokali.
formal.en: The report identifies the company as our main rival in the local market.
formal.zh: 报告将该公司列为我们在本地市场的主要竞争对手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-kompetitur ewlieni tiegħek fit-tellieqa? Pawlu: Mark, għax jiġri malajr ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is your main rival in the race? Pawlu: Mark, because he runs very fast.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这场赛跑中谁是你的主要竞争对手？保罗：马克，因为他跑得非常快。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-kompetitur ewlieni tiegħek fit-tellieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-kompetitur ewlieni tiegħek fit-tellieqa?
messages.zh: 这场赛跑中谁是你的主要竞争对手？
messages.en: Who is your main rival in the race?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark, għax jiġri malajr ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Mark, għax jiġri malajr ħafna.
messages.zh: 马克，因为他跑得非常快。
messages.en: Mark, because he runs very fast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kompetitur 记成赛道上与你争第一的那个人；它指竞争者本人，学习时配着“主要竞争对手”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation in which people or organizations compete, or an organized event in which participants try to win.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或机构为取得优势而相互竞争的情况，也指参加者争取获胜的有组织比赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet jikkompetu bejniethom, jew avveniment organizzat li fih il-parteċipanti jippruvaw jirbħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为取得优势或胜利而进行的竞争，也可指有组织的比赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isforz ta' persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet biex jiksbu vantaġġ fuq oħrajn, jew avveniment organizzat li fih il-parteċipanti jippruvaw jirbħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Competition is a situation in which people try to outperform one another, or an organized event in which they try to win.

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza kompetizzjoni tal-kitba biex tħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw il-ħiliet tagħhom.
formal.en: The school will organize a writing competition to encourage students to develop their skills.
formal.zh: 学校将举办写作比赛，鼓励学生提升写作能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni tal-kant? Luka: Iva, imma għadni qed nagħżel il-kanzunetta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going to take part in the singing competition? Luka: Yes, but I'm still choosing the song.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要参加歌唱比赛吗？卢卡：要，不过我还在选歌。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni tal-kant?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni tal-kant?
messages.zh: 你要参加歌唱比赛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to take part in the singing competition?

messages.speaker: Luka (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni qed nagħżel il-kanzunetta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni qed nagħżel il-kanzunetta.
messages.zh: 要，不过我还在选歌。
messages.en: Yes, but I'm still choosing the song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海报上写着 kompetizzjoni，下面站着一群参赛者：这个词指比赛或竞争这件事，可用“参加比赛”来联想记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized contest in which participants submit designs to be judged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加者提交设计作品，由评审进行评选的有组织竞赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni organizzata li fiha l-parteċipanti jissottomettu disinji biex jiġu evalwati minn ġurija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加者通过展示作品或能力来争取获胜的比赛；本词组中指设计方面的比赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avveniment li fih il-parteċipanti jippruvaw jirbħu billi juru xogħol jew ħila; f'din il-frażi, ix-xogħol ikun marbut mad-disinn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contest is an organized event in which participants compete to win, here by presenting design work.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以设计作品为参赛内容，并按规定标准评选优胜作品的竞赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li fiha l-parteċipanti jippreżentaw disinji u jintgħażlu l-aħjar xogħlijiet skont kriterji stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A design contest is a competition in which submitted designs are judged to choose the best entries.

collocations.en: take part in a design contest

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ħabbar kompetizzjoni dwar id-disinn ta' logo ġdid, u l-proposti se jiġu evalwati minn ġurija indipendenti.
formal.en: The council announced a contest to design a new logo, and the proposals will be assessed by an independent jury.
formal.zh: 议会宣布举办新标志设计竞赛，参赛方案将由独立评审团评审。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt il-kompetizzjoni dwar id-disinn ta' kartellun għall-festival? Ben: Iva! Ejja nieħdu sehem flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you seen the contest to design a poster for the festival? Ben: Yes! Let's enter together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看到那个为节庆设计海报的比赛了吗？本：看到了！我们一起参加吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-kompetizzjoni dwar id-disinn ta' kartellun għall-festival?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-kompetizzjoni dwar id-disinn ta' kartellun għall-festival?
messages.zh: 你看到那个为节庆设计海报的比赛了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the contest to design a poster for the festival?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Ejja nieħdu sehem flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Ejja nieħdu sehem flimkien.
messages.zh: 看到了！我们一起参加吧。
messages.en: Yes! Let's enter together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语画面记忆：kompetizzjoni 是比赛，dwar 表示关于，id-disinn 是设计；想象大家交上海报设计稿供评委打分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rivalry between businesses or countries seeking to sell goods or services in foreign markets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业或国家为向国外市场销售商品或服务、争取客户与订单而展开的竞争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni bejn negozji jew pajjiżi li jfittxu li jbigħu prodotti jew servizzi fi swieq barranin u jiksbu klijenti u ordnijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业或国家在向国外销售商品或服务时，为争夺海外客户、订单或市场份额而进行的竞争。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni bejn negozji jew pajjiżi biex jiksbu klijenti, ordnijiet jew sehem akbar fi swieq barranin permezz tal-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Export competition occurs when businesses or countries compete to sell their goods or services in foreign markets.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota żieda fil-kompetizzjoni fl-esportazzjoni u jirrakkomanda titjib fil-kwalità tal-prodotti.
formal.en: The report notes an increase in export competition and recommends improvements in product quality.
formal.zh: 报告指出出口竞争加剧，并建议提高产品质量。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed intejbu l-ippakkjar għall-klijenti barra minn Malta? Ġużeppi: Għax hemm aktar kompetizzjoni fl-esportazzjoni, u rridu li l-prodotti tagħna jispikkaw.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are we improving the packaging for customers outside Malta? Ġużeppi: Because there is more export competition, and we want our products to stand out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们为什么要改进面向马耳他以外客户的包装？朱塞佩：因为出口竞争更激烈了，我们希望自己的产品更突出。

messages.speaker: Marija (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed intejbu l-ippakkjar għall-klijenti barra minn Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed intejbu l-ippakkjar għall-klijenti barra minn Malta?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要改进面向马耳他以外客户的包装？
messages.en: Why are we improving the packaging for customers outside Malta?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (出口业务经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm aktar kompetizzjoni fl-esportazzjoni, u rridu li l-prodotti tagħna jispikkaw.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm aktar kompetizzjoni fl-esportazzjoni, u rridu li l-prodotti tagħna jispikkaw.
messages.zh: 因为出口竞争更激烈了，我们希望自己的产品更突出。
messages.en: Because there is more export competition, and we want our products to stand out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几家企业把货物运往同一个海外市场，争取同一批订单；用这个场景把整个短语和“出口竞争”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An economic market model with many buyers and sellers, identical products, full information, and free entry and exit, in which no individual participant controls the market price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种经济学市场模型：买卖双方众多、产品同质、信息充分且可自由进入和退出，单个参与者无法控制市场价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mudell ekonomiku ta' suq b'ħafna xerrejja u bejjiegħa, prodotti identiċi, informazzjoni sħiħa u dħul u ħruġ ħielsa, fejn ebda parteċipant waħdu ma jista' jikkontrolla l-prezz tas-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完全竞争；买卖双方众多、产品同质、信息充分且进出自由，单个买方或卖方均无法控制市场价格的理论市场状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni teoretika tas-suq fejn hemm ħafna xerrejja u bejjiegħa, il-prodotti huma identiċi, kulħadd għandu informazzjoni sħiħa u jista' jidħol fis-suq jew joħroġ minnu liberament, u ħadd waħdu ma jista' jikkontrolla l-prezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Perfect competition is a theoretical market situation in which numerous buyers and sellers trade identical products with full information and free entry and exit, so no individual participant can control the price.

formal.mt: Fil-mudell ta' kompetizzjoni perfetta, kull bejjiegħ jaċċetta l-prezz tas-suq għax ma jistax jikkontrollah waħdu.
formal.en: In the model of perfect competition, each seller accepts the market price because they cannot control it individually.
formal.zh: 在完全竞争模型中，每个卖方都接受市场价格，因为任何卖方都无法单独控制这一价格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'suq b'kompetizzjoni perfetta, bejjiegħ wieħed jista' jikkontrolla l-prezz? Pawlu: Le, f'dan il-mudell hemm ħafna bejjiegħa u kull wieħed jaċċetta l-prezz tas-suq.
colloquial.en: Sara: In a perfectly competitive market, can one seller control the price? Pawlu: No, this model has many sellers, and each one accepts the market price.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：在完全竞争市场中，一个卖方能控制价格吗？保罗：不能，这个模型中有很多卖方，每个卖方都接受市场价格。

messages.speaker: Sara (经济学学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'suq b'kompetizzjoni perfetta, bejjiegħ wieħed jista' jikkontrolla l-prezz?
messages.mt_standard: F'suq b'kompetizzjoni perfetta, bejjiegħ wieħed jista' jikkontrolla l-prezz?
messages.zh: 在完全竞争市场中，一个卖方能控制价格吗？
messages.en: In a perfectly competitive market, can one seller control the price?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (经济学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'dan il-mudell hemm ħafna bejjiegħa u kull wieħed jaċċetta l-prezz tas-suq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'dan il-mudell hemm ħafna bejjiegħa u kull wieħed jaċċetta l-prezz tas-suq.
messages.zh: 不能，这个模型中有很多卖方，每个卖方都接受市场价格。
messages.en: No, this model has many sellers, and each one accepts the market price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“很多买卖者、同样产品、无人定价”的画面记住kompetizzjoni perfetta；这是经济学术语“完全竞争”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized competition in which participants submit designs to be judged according to stated criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与者提交设计作品，并依据规定标准接受评审的竞赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni organizzata li fiha l-parteċipanti jissottomettu disinni biex jiġu evalwati skont kriterji stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞赛；参与者依照规定规则较量，并通过评审或成绩确定优胜者的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività organizzata li fiha l-parteċipanti jikkompetu skont regoli stabbiliti u jintgħażel rebbieħ permezz ta' ġudizzju jew riżultati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contest is an organized event in which participants compete under stated rules and a winner is chosen by judging or results.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计竞赛；参与者提交设计方案或作品，由评审按照规定标准选出优胜者的比赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li fiha l-parteċipanti jippreżentaw disinni jew proposti ta' disinn u ġurija tagħżel ir-rebbieħ skont kriterji stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A design contest is a competition in which participants submit designs or design proposals for judges to assess and select a winner.

collocations.en: take part in a design contest

formal.mt: Il-mużew ħabbar kompetizzjoni ta' disinn biex jagħżel logo ġdid, u l-proposti se jiġu evalwati minn ġurija indipendenti.
formal.en: The museum announced a design contest to select a new logo, and the proposals will be assessed by an independent jury.
formal.zh: 博物馆宣布举办设计竞赛以选出新标志，参赛方案将由独立评审团评估。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni ta' disinn? David: Iva, qed inħejji disinn għal siġġu u nibagħtu għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to take part in the design contest? David: Yes, I am preparing a chair design and will send it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你会参加这次设计竞赛吗？戴维：会，我正在准备一份椅子设计，明天就提交。

messages.speaker: Lara (设计专业同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni ta' disinn?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni ta' disinn?
messages.zh: 你会参加这次设计竞赛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to take part in the design contest?

messages.speaker: David (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed inħejji disinn għal siġġu u nibagħtu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed inħejji disinn għal siġġu u nibagħtu għada.
messages.zh: 会，我正在准备一份椅子设计，明天就提交。
messages.en: Yes, I am preparing a chair design and will send it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组分成kompetizzjoni“竞赛”和ta' disinn“设计方面的”来记，想象把设计图交给评委的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Competition in which participants follow fair rules and no one receives an improper advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与者遵守公平规则，任何一方都不享有不当优势的竞争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li fiha l-parteċipanti jimxu ma' regoli ġusti u ħadd ma jingħata vantaġġ mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各方依照公平规则参与、没有任何一方获得不当优势的竞争。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni bejn persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet li sseħħ skont regoli ġusti, mingħajr ma xi parteċipant jingħata vantaġġ mhux xieraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fair competition is a situation in which people or organizations compete under fair rules without receiving improper advantages.

formal.mt: Ir-regoli għandhom japplikaw bl-istess mod għal kull parteċipant sabiex jiżguraw kompetizzjoni ġusta.
formal.en: The rules should apply equally to every participant to ensure fair competition.
formal.zh: 规则应当平等地适用于每位参与者，以确保公平竞争。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd għandu l-istess ħin biex ilesti? Mark: Biex ikun hemm kompetizzjoni ġusta u ħadd ma jkollu vantaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone have the same amount of time to finish? Mark: So that there is fair competition and nobody has an advantage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么每个人完成任务的时间都一样？马克：这样才能公平竞争，谁也不会占便宜。

messages.speaker: Maja (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd għandu l-istess ħin biex ilesti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd għandu l-istess ħin biex ilesti?
messages.zh: 为什么每个人完成任务的时间都一样？
messages.en: Why does everyone have the same amount of time to finish?

messages.speaker: Mark (赛事组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikun hemm kompetizzjoni ġusta u ħadd ma jkollu vantaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikun hemm kompetizzjoni ġusta u ħadd ma jkollu vantaġġ.
messages.zh: 这样才能公平竞争，谁也不会占便宜。
messages.en: So that there is fair competition and nobody has an advantage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġusta与“公平”一起记，想象所有参赛者站在同一起跑线上：kompetizzjoni ġusta就是公平竞争。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electronic device that follows programs to process and store information and perform tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照程序处理和储存信息、执行各种任务的电子设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat elettroniku li jsegwi programmi biex jipproċessa u jaħżen informazzjoni u jwettaq diversi kompiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计算机；按照程序接收、处理、储存和输出信息的电子设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat elettroniku li jirċievi, jipproċessa, jaħżen u joħroġ informazzjoni skont l-istruzzjonijiet ta' programmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A computer is an electronic device that uses programs to receive, process, store, and output information.

formal.mt: Kull student għandu juża l-kompjuter biex jikteb ir-rapport u jsalva kopja tax-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: Each student should use the computer to write the report and save a copy of their work.
formal.zh: 每位学生都应使用电脑撰写报告，并保存一份自己的作业副本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nuża l-kompjuter tiegħek għal ftit? Mark: Iva, ixgħelu u tista' tibda tikteb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I use your computer for a little while? Mark: Yes, turn it on and you can start typing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我能用一下你的电脑吗？马克：可以，打开就能开始打字了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża l-kompjuter tiegħek għal ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża l-kompjuter tiegħek għal ftit?
messages.zh: 我能用一下你的电脑吗？
messages.en: Can I use your computer for a little while?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ixgħelu u tista' tibda tikteb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ixgħelu u tista' tibda tikteb.
messages.zh: 可以，打开就能开始打字了。
messages.en: Yes, turn it on and you can start typing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kompjuter和桌上的电脑图像一起记，再连读tixgħel il-kompjuter“打开电脑”，用日常动作巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 复杂的；难以理解或处理的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficult to understand or deal with because it involves many connected parts or details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于涉及许多相互关联的部分或细节而难以理解或处理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun diffiċli biex tifhmu jew tittratta miegħu għax jinvolvi ħafna partijiet jew dettalji marbutin ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复杂的；因环节或细节较多而难以理解或处理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu ħafna dettalji jew aspetti marbutin ma' xulxin u għalhekk ikun diffiċli biex tifhmu jew issolvih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is complicated has many connected parts or details that make it difficult to understand or manage.

formal.mt: Il-proċess huwa komplikat għax kull applikazzjoni trid tiġi eżaminata minn diversi uffiċċji.
formal.en: The process is complicated because each application must be examined by several offices.
formal.zh: 这个流程很复杂，因为每份申请都必须由多个部门审查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżerċizzju jidher komplikat. Mark: Ejja naqrawh flimkien u nagħmluh pass pass.
colloquial.en: Maja: This exercise looks complicated. Mark: Let's read it together and do it step by step.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习看起来很复杂。马克：我们一起读一读，一步一步做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-eżerċizzju jidher komplikat.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-eżerċizzju jidher komplikat.
messages.zh: 这道练习看起来很复杂。
messages.en: This exercise looks complicated.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqrawh flimkien u nagħmluh pass pass.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqrawh flimkien u nagħmluh pass pass.
messages.zh: 我们一起读一读，一步一步做。
messages.en: Let's read it together and do it step by step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komplikat 联想成一张线条交错的流程图：环节越多、越难理清，就越“复杂”。

gloss_zh: 阴谋；密谋；秘密策划的诡计

teaching_sense.en_definition: A secret plan or scheme intended to harm someone or gain an advantage through deception.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为伤害他人或通过欺骗取得利益而秘密策划的阴谋或诡计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjan jew manuvra sigrieta maħsuba biex tagħmel ħsara lil xi ħadd jew tikseb vantaġġ permezz tal-qerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴谋；为实施有害或不正当行为而秘密制定的计划。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjan sigriet biex jitwettaq att ta' ħsara jew biex jintlaħaq għan b'mezzi qarrieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plot is a secret plan to carry out a harmful or dishonest action.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 密谋；为操控局势或谋取利益而暗中安排的诡计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Manuvra sigrieta u qarrieqa maħsuba biex tinfluwenza sitwazzjoni jew tikseb vantaġġ fuq ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intrigue is a secret scheme involving deception to influence events or gain an advantage.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi komplott biex jiġu ffalsifikati d-dokumenti u tinħeba l-verità.
formal.en: The report describes a plot to falsify the documents and conceal the truth.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一项伪造文件并掩盖真相的阴谋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kixef il-komplott fil-film? Mark: Il-ġurnalista, meta sabet l-ittra moħbija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who uncovered the plot in the film? Mark: The journalist, when she found the hidden letter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里是谁揭露了那个阴谋？马克：是那位女记者，她发现了藏起来的信。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kixef il-komplott fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min kixef il-komplott fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里是谁揭露了那个阴谋？
messages.en: Who uncovered the plot in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġurnalista, meta sabet l-ittra moħbija.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġurnalista, meta sabet l-ittra moħbija.
messages.zh: 是那位女记者，她发现了藏起来的信。
messages.en: The journalist, when she found the hidden letter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 komplott 时，想象几个人关门低声策划坏事；核心画面是“秘密计划加欺骗”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual part that combines with other parts to form a larger object or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他部分共同构成较大物体或系统的一个组成部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti individwali li flimkien ma' partijiet oħra tifforma oġġett jew sistema akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组成部分；构成机器、设备或系统的一个部件或元件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti minn magna, apparat jew sistema li taħdem flimkien ma' partijiet oħra biex tifforma ħaġa sħiħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A component is one of the separate parts that together make up a larger object or system.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jinbidel komponent elettroniku, l-apparat għandu jiġi skonnettjat mill-provvista tal-elettriku.
formal.en: Before an electronic component is replaced, the device must be disconnected from the electricity supply.
formal.zh: 更换电子元件之前，必须断开设备的电源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irrid nibdel l-apparat kollu? Mark: Le, hemm komponent wieħed biss li ma jaħdimx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I need to replace the whole device? Mark: No, only one component isn't working.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我需要更换整台设备吗？马克：不用，只有一个部件坏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nibdel l-apparat kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nibdel l-apparat kollu?
messages.zh: 我需要更换整台设备吗？
messages.en: Do I need to replace the whole device?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm komponent wieħed biss li ma jaħdimx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm komponent wieħed biss li ma jaħdimx.
messages.zh: 不用，只有一个部件坏了。
messages.en: No, only one component isn't working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komponent 想成拼装机器时手中的一个零件：它是整体中的“一部分”，多个部件一起工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of writing that develops ideas about a subject, often written as a school exercise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某个主题展开思想的文章，常指作为学校练习而写的作文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba li fiha l-awtur jiżviluppa ideat dwar suġġett, spiss bħala eżerċizzju għall-iskola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作文；围绕特定主题展开说明、讨论或表达观点的文章。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kitba dwar suġġett partikolari li fiha l-awtur jispjega ideat, jiddiskuti kwistjoni jew jesprimi l-fehmiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An essay is a piece of writing in which someone develops ideas or arguments about a particular subject.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书面创作；将思想组织成连贯文字的作品，尤指作文练习。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol miktub li fih l-ideat jiġu organizzati f'test koerenti, speċjalment bħala eżerċizzju fil-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A composition is a written work that organizes ideas into a connected text, often as a learning exercise.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiktbu komponiment ta' tliet mitt kelma dwar l-importanza tal-qari.
formal.en: The students should write a three-hundred-word essay about the importance of reading.
formal.zh: 学生应写一篇三百词的作文，讨论阅读的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex se tikteb il-komponiment? Mark: Fuq vaganza mal-familja. Għandi ħafna x'nirrakkonta!
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to write your composition about? Mark: A holiday with my family. I've got lots to tell!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的作文准备写什么？马克：和家人一起度假的事。我有好多事情可以写！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex se tikteb il-komponiment?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex se tikteb il-komponiment?
messages.zh: 你的作文准备写什么？
messages.en: What are you going to write your composition about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq vaganza mal-familja. Għandi ħafna x'nirrakkonta!
messages.mt_standard: Fuq vaganza mal-familja. Għandi ħafna x'nirrakkonta!
messages.zh: 和家人一起度假的事。我有好多事情可以写！
messages.en: A holiday with my family. I've got lots to tell!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komponiment 与作文课的画面连起来：先定主题，再把想法写成连贯文章，就是一篇作文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone who remains calm, or something formed from particular parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人保持镇定，或形容某物由特定部分组成；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tibqa' kalma, jew ħaġa magħmula minn partijiet partikolari, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉着的；镇定自若的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tibqa' kalma u tikkontrolla r-reazzjonijiet tagħha, anki f'sitwazzjoni diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is composed remains calm and controls their reactions in a difficult situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由所说明的成员、材料或部分组成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi ħaġa li hija magħmula mill-membri, mill-materjali jew mill-partijiet imsemmija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something made up of particular parts consists of those parts considered together.

collocations.en: a team made up of five members
collocations.zh: 由五名成员组成的团队

formal.mt: Il-kumitat huwa kompost minn ħames membri, u l-president tiegħu baqa' kompost waqt id-diskussjoni diffiċli.
formal.en: The committee is made up of five members, and its chair remained composed during the difficult discussion.
formal.zh: 委员会由五名成员组成，其主席在艰难的讨论中始终保持镇定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif bqajt daqshekk kompost waqt l-intervista? Mark: Ħadt nifs u ħsibt qabel weġibt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you stay so composed during the interview? Mark: I took a breath and thought before answering.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面试时你怎么能这么镇定？马克：我先吸了口气，想清楚再回答。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif bqajt daqshekk kompost waqt l-intervista?
messages.mt_standard: Kif bqajt daqshekk kompost waqt l-intervista?
messages.zh: 面试时你怎么能这么镇定？
messages.en: How did you stay so composed during the interview?

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt nifs u ħsibt qabel weġibt.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt nifs u ħsibt qabel weġibt.
messages.zh: 我先吸了口气，想清楚再回答。
messages.en: I took a breath and thought before answering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分开记：人遇事不慌是 kompost；看到 kompost minn，则联想一个整体由哪些部分组成。

gloss_zh: 词义待核实（所给释义标签为 blacj）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied label 'blacj'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条按所给资料标为名词，但释义标签 blacj 无法提供可确定的词义，因此暂不赋予具体中文含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-kelma hija mmarkata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, iżda t-tikketta 'blacj' ma tipprovdix tifsira ċara li tista' tiġi stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给标签 blacj 的含义不明，无法据此确定该名词的中文释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta mogħtija hija 'blacj', iżda minnha ma tistax tiġi stabbilita tifsira ċara għal dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label 'blacj' does not establish a clear meaning for this noun.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'kompozizzjonijiet' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tikketta 'blacj' ma tiċċarax it-tifsira tagħha; għalhekk hemm bżonn ta' aktar informazzjoni qabel ma tingħata traduzzjoni.
formal.en: The word 'kompozizzjonijiet' is marked as a noun, but the label 'blacj' does not clarify its meaning; further information is therefore needed before a translation can be given.
formal.zh: 词语 kompozizzjonijiet 被标为名词，但标签 blacj 未能说明其含义，因此需要更多信息才能给出翻译。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kompozizzjonijiet' f'din il-lista? Lara: It-tikketta hi 'blacj', u minnha ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'kompozizzjonijiet' mean in this list? Lara: The label is 'blacj', and we cannot determine the meaning from it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张表里的 kompozizzjonijiet 是什么意思？拉拉：标签写的是 blacj，单凭它无法确定词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kompozizzjonijiet' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kompozizzjonijiet' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这张表里的 kompozizzjonijiet 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'kompozizzjonijiet' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tikketta hi 'blacj', u minnha ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: It-tikketta hi 'blacj', u minnha ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira.
messages.zh: 标签写的是 blacj，单凭它无法确定词义。
messages.en: The label is 'blacj', and we cannot determine the meaning from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把原拼写与“释义待核实”一起记在词卡上；blacj 仅是所给标签，不凭字形猜词义，也不把标签当作译文背诵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who creates music by writing original musical works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创作音乐作品的人，可以指职业作曲家，也可以指某部作品的作曲者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħloq il-mużika billi tikteb xogħlijiet mużikali oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作曲家；创作音乐作品的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tikteb il-mużika għal kanzunetti, biċċiet strumentali jew xogħlijiet mużikali oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A composer is someone who creates music, including songs and instrumental works.

formal.mt: Il-kompożitur kiteb biċċa ġdida għall-orkestra, li se tindaqq għall-ewwel darba fil-kunċert ta' nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The composer wrote a new piece for the orchestra, which will be performed for the first time at Friday's concert.
formal.zh: 这位作曲家为管弦乐团创作了一首新曲，将在星期五的音乐会上首次演奏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kiteb il-mużika ta' dan il-film? Pawlu: Kompożitur żagħżugħ li ltqajt miegħu fil-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who wrote the music for this film? Pawlu: A young composer I met at the concert.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这部电影的音乐是谁写的？保罗：一位年轻作曲家，我在音乐会上认识了他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kiteb il-mużika ta' dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min kiteb il-mużika ta' dan il-film?
messages.zh: 这部电影的音乐是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote the music for this film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kompożitur żagħżugħ li ltqajt miegħu fil-kunċert.
messages.mt_standard: Kompożitur żagħżugħ li ltqajt miegħu fil-kunċert.
messages.zh: 一位年轻作曲家，我在音乐会上认识了他。
messages.en: A young composer I met at the concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kompożitur 与五线谱前写旋律的人绑定记忆：重点是创作音乐的人，学习时配对英文 composer。

gloss_zh: 全面的；详尽的（阴性形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes something that covers all or nearly all relevant aspects of a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容内容涵盖某主题所有或几乎所有相关方面，全面而详尽；此处为阴性形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi ħaġa li tkopri l-aspetti rilevanti kollha, jew kważi kollha, ta' suġġett; din hija l-forma femminili tal-aġġettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全面的；涵盖所有或几乎所有相关方面的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi ħaġa li tinkludi l-aspetti kollha, jew kważi kollha, meħtieġa biex suġġett jiġi ttrattat b'mod sħiħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something comprehensive covers all or nearly all the relevant aspects of a subject.

formal.mt: L-istudju jippreżenta analiżi komprensiva tal-problema, li tinkludi l-kawżi, l-effetti u s-soluzzjonijiet possibbli.
formal.en: The study presents a comprehensive analysis of the problem, including its causes, effects and possible solutions.
formal.zh: 该研究对问题进行了全面分析，涵盖其原因、影响及可能的解决方案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-gwida tispjega kollox għall-vjaġġ? Mark: Iva, hi komprensiva; fiha t-trasport, il-postijiet fejn norqdu u l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this guide explain everything for the trip? Mark: Yes, it is comprehensive; it covers transport, places to stay and costs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本指南把旅行要用的信息都讲了吗？马克：是的，很全面；交通、住宿和费用都有。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-gwida tispjega kollox għall-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-gwida tispjega kollox għall-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 这本指南把旅行要用的信息都讲了吗？
messages.en: Does this guide explain everything for the trip?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hi komprensiva; fiha t-trasport, il-postijiet fejn norqdu u l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hi komprensiva; fiha t-trasport, il-postijiet fejn norqdu u l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 是的，很全面；交通、住宿和费用都有。
messages.en: Yes, it is comprehensive; it covers transport, places to stay and costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本把交通、住宿、费用都讲全的指南，整组记住 gwida komprensiva；用“内容覆盖全面”抓住核心含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability or process of understanding the meaning of something read, heard, or explained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 理解所读、所听或所解释内容的意义的能力或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila jew il-proċess li wieħed jifhem it-tifsira ta' dak li jaqra, jisma' jew jiġi spjegat lilu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对文字、言语、说明或事物意义的理解与领会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fehim tat-tifsira ta' kliem, testi, spjegazzjonijiet jew ideat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Comprehension is the ability to understand what something means, especially when you read or hear it.

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jkejjel il-komprenzjoni tal-qari permezz ta' mistoqsijiet dwar it-test.
formal.en: The exercise measures reading comprehension through questions about the text.
formal.zh: 这项练习通过针对文章的问题来测量阅读理解能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar l-eżerċizzju tal-komprenzjoni? Mark: Mhux ħażin, imma l-aħħar mistoqsija kienet diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the comprehension exercise go? Mark: Not badly, but the last question was difficult.
colloquial.zh: Maja：理解练习做得怎么样？Mark：还不错，不过最后一道题很难。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar l-eżerċizzju tal-komprenzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar l-eżerċizzju tal-komprenzjoni?
messages.zh: 理解练习做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the comprehension exercise go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux ħażin, imma l-aħħar mistoqsija kienet diffiċli.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux ħażin, imma l-aħħar mistoqsija kienet diffiċli.
messages.zh: 还不错，不过最后一道题很难。
messages.en: Not badly, but the last question was difficult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“阅读后回答问题”的画面里记：能说出文章意思，就是 komprenzjoni。搭配 tal-qari 一起记，更容易联想到“阅读理解”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement reached when opposing sides each give up part of what they want.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意见相对的各方分别作出部分让步后达成的协议或折中安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jintlaħaq meta naħat b'fehmiet jew xewqat differenti jċedu parti minn dak li jridu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过各方让步而达成的妥协、折中办法或协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Soluzzjoni jew ftehim li fih kull naħa tagħmel xi konċessjonijiet biex jintlaħaq qbil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A compromise is an agreement in which each side accepts less than it originally wanted.

formal.mt: Wara diskussjoni twila, iż-żewġ naħat laħqu kompromess dwar il-ħinijiet tax-xogħol.
formal.en: After a long discussion, the two sides reached a compromise on working hours.
formal.zh: 经过长时间讨论，双方就工作时间达成了折中协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int trid titlaq fit-tmienja u jien fid-disgħa. Nagħmlu kompromess u nitilqu fit-tmienja u nofs? Mark: Iva, tajjeb għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: You want to leave at eight and I want to leave at nine. Shall we compromise and leave at half past eight? Mark: Yes, that works for me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想八点走，我想九点走。我们折中一下，八点半走好吗？Mark：好，我可以。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int trid titlaq fit-tmienja u jien fid-disgħa. Nagħmlu kompromess u nitilqu fit-tmienja u nofs?
messages.mt_standard: Int trid titlaq fit-tmienja u jien fid-disgħa. Nagħmlu kompromess u nitilqu fit-tmienja u nofs?
messages.zh: 你想八点走，我想九点走。我们折中一下，八点半走好吗？
messages.en: You want to leave at eight and I want to leave at nine. Shall we compromise and leave at half past eight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajjeb għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajjeb għalija.
messages.zh: 好，我可以。
messages.en: Yes, that works for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人分别指着八点和九点，最后一起指向八点半：双方各让一步达成的安排，就是 kompromess。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frequently found or occurring, or shared by two or more people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常出现或普遍存在的；也指由两个或更多人或事物共同具有、使用或分享的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinstab jew jiġri ta' spiss, jew li jkun maqsum jew jintuża minn żewġ persuni jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 常见、普遍的；共同具有或共同使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mifrux jew jiġri ta' spiss, jew li żewġ persuni jew aktar ikollhom jew jużaw flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something common is found frequently or is shared by two or more people or things.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika problema komuni f'diversi skejjel u jipproponi soluzzjoni.
formal.en: The report identifies a common problem in several schools and proposes a solution.
formal.zh: 报告指出了多所学校普遍存在的一个问题，并提出了解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int ukoll tħobb timxi fil-kampanja? Mark: Iva! Mela għandna interess komuni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you also enjoy walking in the countryside? Mark: Yes! So we have a shared interest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你也喜欢在乡间散步吗？Mark：喜欢！那我们有共同兴趣了。

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int ukoll tħobb timxi fil-kampanja?
messages.mt_standard: Int ukoll tħobb timxi fil-kampanja?
messages.zh: 你也喜欢在乡间散步吗？
messages.en: Do you also enjoy walking in the countryside?

messages.speaker: Mark (新朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Mela għandna interess komuni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Mela għandna interess komuni.
messages.zh: 喜欢！那我们有共同兴趣了。
messages.en: Yes! So we have a shared interest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 komuni：许多练习里都出现的错误是“常见的”，两个人都喜欢的活动是“共同的”。看到名词后再判断是哪一种意思。

gloss_zh: 负担分担；共同承担责任或成本

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sharing of costs, responsibilities, or other burdens among several people or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由多个人或群体共同承担费用、责任或其他负担。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqassim tal-ispejjeż, tar-responsabbiltajiet jew ta' piżijiet oħra bejn diversi persuni jew gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多个参与方分担费用、责任或其他负担。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li bih diversi persuni jew gruppi jaqsmu bejniethom l-ispejjeż, ir-responsabbiltajiet jew piżijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Burden sharing is an arrangement in which several people or groups each take on part of a cost, responsibility, or difficulty.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi l-kondiviżjoni tal-piżijiet bejn l-organizzazzjonijiet li jieħdu sehem fil-proġett.
formal.en: The agreement establishes burden sharing among the organisations participating in the project.
formal.zh: 该协议规定了参与项目的各组织如何分担负担。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se naqsmu x-xogħol u l-ispejjeż? Pawlu: Ejja nagħmlu lista biex il-kondiviżjoni tal-piżijiet tkun ġusta.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we going to divide the work and the costs? Pawlu: Let's make a list so that burden sharing is fair.
colloquial.zh: Maja：工作和费用要怎么分？Pawlu：我们列张清单吧，这样大家分担起来才公平。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se naqsmu x-xogħol u l-ispejjeż?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se naqsmu x-xogħol u l-ispejjeż?
messages.zh: 工作和费用要怎么分？
messages.en: How are we going to divide the work and the costs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħmlu lista biex il-kondiviżjoni tal-piżijiet tkun ġusta.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħmlu lista biex il-kondiviżjoni tal-piżijiet tkun ġusta.
messages.zh: 我们列张清单吧，这样大家分担起来才公平。
messages.en: Let's make a list so that burden sharing is fair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人一起抬重箱：每人承担一部分，就像共同分担费用和责任，用这个画面记住整个短语。

gloss_zh: 储备共享；共同使用储备资源

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sharing among several parties of resources kept in reserve for future needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多个参与方共享为未来需要而保留的资金、物资或其他储备资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qsim bejn diversi partijiet ta' flus, provvisti jew riżorsi oħra miżmuma għal ħtiġijiet futuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多个参与方之间对储备资金、物资或其他储备资源的共享。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li jippermetti lil diversi partijiet jużaw bejniethom riżorsi miżmuma bħala riserva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The sharing of reserves allows several parties to use resources that have been set aside for future needs.

collocations.en: an agreement on the sharing of reserves
the sharing of reserves between countries

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipprevedi l-kondiviżjoni tar-riservi tal-ikel bejn il-komunitajiet f'każ ta' emerġenza.
formal.en: The plan provides for the sharing of food reserves among communities in an emergency.
formal.zh: 该计划规定，各社区在紧急情况下共享粮食储备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jekk il-provvisti tagħna jispiċċaw, nistgħu nużaw xi wħud minn tagħkom? Pawlu: Iva, il-ftehim tagħna jippermetti l-kondiviżjoni tar-riservi.
colloquial.en: Maja: If our supplies run out, can we use some of yours? Pawlu: Yes, our agreement allows the sharing of reserves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：如果我们的物资用完了，可以用一些你们的吗？Pawlu：可以，我们的协议允许共享储备。

messages.speaker: Maja (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk il-provvisti tagħna jispiċċaw, nistgħu nużaw xi wħud minn tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk il-provvisti tagħna jispiċċaw, nistgħu nużaw xi wħud minn tagħkom?
messages.zh: 如果我们的物资用完了，可以用一些你们的吗？
messages.en: If our supplies run out, can we use some of yours?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻区协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ftehim tagħna jippermetti l-kondiviżjoni tar-riservi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ftehim tagħna jippermetti l-kondiviżjoni tar-riservi.
messages.zh: 可以，我们的协议允许共享储备。
messages.en: Yes, our agreement allows the sharing of reserves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个社区共用一个应急仓库：需要时共享里面预留的物资，由此记住“储备共享”的整体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular requirement or condition that applies in a specific situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种特定情况下适用的特殊条件或特别要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rekwiżit jew kundizzjoni partikolari li tapplika f'sitwazzjoni speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对特定情况而设定的特殊条件或特别要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjonijiet jew rekwiżiti partikolari li japplikaw għal każ speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Special conditions are particular requirements that apply to a specific situation or arrangement.

collocations.en: a special condition in the contract
collocations.zh: 合同中的一项特殊条件

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jinkludi kondizzjoni speċjali li teħtieġ il-ħlas qabel il-kunsinna.
formal.en: The contract includes a special condition requiring payment before delivery.
formal.zh: 合同包含一项特殊条件，要求在交货前付款。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Hemm xi kondizzjoni speċjali biex nibbukkja l-kamra? Pawlu: Iva, trid tħallas bil-quddiem.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there any special condition for booking the room? Pawlu: Yes, you need to pay in advance.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：预订房间有什么特殊条件吗？保罗：有，需要提前付款。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi kondizzjoni speċjali biex nibbukkja l-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi kondizzjoni speċjali biex nibbukkja l-kamra?
messages.zh: 预订房间有什么特殊条件吗？
messages.en: Is there any special condition for booking the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅馆接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid tħallas bil-quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid tħallas bil-quddiem.
messages.zh: 有，需要提前付款。
messages.en: Yes, you need to pay in advance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进订房情境：先问有没有特殊条件，再记住提前付款这个具体要求。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The general rules, requirements, or circumstances that apply to an agreement, activity, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 普遍适用于某项协议、活动或情境的规则、要求或条件；在合同语境中常指通用条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-regoli, ir-rekwiżiti jew iċ-ċirkostanzi li japplikaw b'mod ġenerali għal ftehim, attività jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适用于整体安排的一般条件或要求；在合同等文件中指通用条款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kondizzjonijiet li japplikaw għall-ftehim, għall-attività jew għas-sitwazzjoni kollha, aktar milli għal każ partikolari biss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: General conditions are the rules, requirements, or circumstances that apply broadly to an agreement, activity, or situation.

collocations.en: the general conditions of the contract

formal.mt: Il-kondizzjonijiet ġenerali tal-kuntratt jispjegaw l-obbligi taż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The general conditions of the contract explain the obligations of both parties.
formal.zh: 合同的通用条款说明了双方的义务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' niffirma hawn? Pawlu: Iva, imma aqra l-kondizzjonijiet ġenerali qabel tiffirma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I sign here? Pawlu: Yes, but read the general conditions before you sign.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以在这里签字吗？Pawlu：可以，不过签字前先读一下通用条款。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' niffirma hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' niffirma hawn?
messages.zh: 我可以在这里签字吗？
messages.en: Can I sign here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aqra l-kondizzjonijiet ġenerali qabel tiffirma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aqra l-kondizzjonijiet ġenerali qabel tiffirma.
messages.zh: 可以，不过签字前先读一下通用条款。
messages.en: Yes, but read the general conditions before you sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语放进签合同的画面：签名前先读适用于整份合同的通用条款，就能记住它的常见用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of sympathy for someone whose relative or friend has died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向亲友去世的人表达同情、哀悼和慰问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' simpatija u sogħba lil persuna li tilfet qarib jew ħabib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某人亲友去世而向其表达的哀悼与慰问。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem jew ġest ta' simpatija u sogħba lejn xi ħadd minħabba l-mewt ta' persuna għażiża għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Condolence is sympathy expressed to someone after the death of a person close to them.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat bagħat ittra ta' kondoljanza lill-familja wara l-mewt ta' membru għażiż.
formal.en: The committee sent a letter of condolence to the family following the death of a valued member.
formal.zh: 一位深受珍视的成员去世后，委员会向其家属寄送了一封吊唁慰问信。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Bgħattlek messaġġ ta' kondoljanza meta smajt b'missierek. Ġużeppi: Grazzi, il-kliem tiegħek kien ta' faraġ għalija.
colloquial.en: Marija: I sent you a message of condolence when I heard about your father. Ġużeppi: Thank you, your words were a comfort to me.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：听说你父亲去世后，我给你发了一则慰问信息。约瑟夫：谢谢，你的话给了我安慰。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bgħattlek messaġġ ta' kondoljanza meta smajt b'missierek.
messages.mt_standard: Bgħattlek messaġġ ta' kondoljanza meta smajt b'missierek.
messages.zh: 听说你父亲去世后，我给你发了一则慰问信息。
messages.en: I sent you a message of condolence when I heard about your father.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (丧亲的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, il-kliem tiegħek kien ta' faraġ għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, il-kliem tiegħek kien ta' faraġ għalija.
messages.zh: 谢谢，你的话给了我安慰。
messages.en: Thank you, your words were a comfort to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想写给丧亲朋友的一封慰问信，把这个词与哀悼、同情和安慰连在一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 安全套；避孕套；避孕用品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin protective covering worn on the penis during sex as a barrier method of contraception.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性交时戴在阴茎上的薄套，作为屏障式避孕用品使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata rqiqa li tintlibes fuq il-pene waqt is-sess u tintuża bħala mezz ta' kontraċezzjoni permezz ta' barriera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安全套；性交时戴在阴茎上的薄套，用作屏障式避孕用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata rqiqa li tintlibes fuq il-pene waqt is-sess biex tifforma barriera u tgħin fil-prevenzjoni tat-tqala.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A condom is a thin covering worn on the penis during sex to provide a contraceptive barrier.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 避孕用品；本词具体指作为避孕手段使用的安全套。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mezz li jintuża biex jgħin fil-prevenzjoni tat-tqala; f'dan il-każ, għata rqiqa li tintlibes fuq il-pene.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contraceptive is something used to help prevent pregnancy, and this word specifically refers to a condom.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jiddeskrivi l-kondom bħala mezz ta' kontraċezzjoni li jaħdem permezz ta' barriera.
formal.en: The leaflet describes the condom as a contraceptive method that works by providing a barrier.
formal.zh: 宣传册将安全套描述为通过形成屏障发挥作用的避孕用品。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom pakkett kondoms? Sara: Iva, liema pakkett tixtieq?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a packet of condoms? Sara: Yes, which packet would you like?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有整包的安全套吗？萨拉：有，你想要哪一包？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom pakkett kondoms?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom pakkett kondoms?
messages.zh: 你们有整包的安全套吗？
messages.en: Do you have a packet of condoms?

messages.speaker: Sara (药店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, liema pakkett tixtieq?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, liema pakkett tixtieq?
messages.zh: 有，你想要哪一包？
messages.en: Yes, which packet would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把单个安全套与药店里的一包安全套配成画面，同时记住具体物品和避孕用品这一类别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's behaviour, or an official certificate recording information about that person's criminal record.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人的行为或品行；也可指记载其犯罪记录情况的官方品行证明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imġiba ta' persuna, jew ċertifikat uffiċjali li jagħti informazzjoni dwar ir-rekord kriminali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为；品行，指一个人的举止及其待人处事的表现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna ġġib ruħha u taġixxi ma' ħaddieħor jew f'sitwazzjonijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's conduct is the way they behave towards other people or in particular situations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品行证明；说明某人犯罪记录情况的官方证明文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jagħti informazzjoni dwar ir-rekord kriminali ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A certificate of conduct is an official document providing information about a person's criminal record.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ifaħħar il-kondotta tajba tal-impjegat, filwaqt li l-applikazzjoni titlob kopja taċ-ċertifikat tal-kondotta tiegħu.
formal.en: The report praises the employee's good conduct, while the application requires a copy of his certificate of conduct.
formal.zh: 报告赞扬了该员工的良好品行，而申请则要求提供其品行证明的副本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qaluli nġib il-kondotta għall-applikazzjoni tax-xogħol. David: Jiġifieri ċ-ċertifikat tal-kondotta? Lara: Iva, dak id-dokument.
colloquial.en: Lara: They told me to bring my certificate of conduct for the job application. David: You mean the official certificate of conduct? Lara: Yes, that document.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们让我为求职申请带上品行证明。戴维：你是说那份官方的品行证明吗？拉拉：对，就是那份文件。

messages.speaker: Lara (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli nġib il-kondotta għall-applikazzjoni tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli nġib il-kondotta għall-applikazzjoni tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 他们让我为求职申请带上品行证明。
messages.en: They told me to bring my certificate of conduct for the job application.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri ċ-ċertifikat tal-kondotta?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri ċ-ċertifikat tal-kondotta?
messages.zh: 你是说那份官方的品行证明吗？
messages.en: You mean the official certificate of conduct?

messages.speaker: Lara (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak id-dokument.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak id-dokument.
messages.zh: 对，就是那份文件。
messages.en: Yes, that document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分词义：日常表现对应品行，求职时递交的官方文件对应品行证明。

gloss_zh: 良好的商业行为；诚信经营

teaching_sense.en_definition: Honest, fair and responsible behaviour in business dealings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在商业往来中表现出的诚实、公平和负责任的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba onesta, ġusta u responsabbli fir-relazzjonijiet kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业活动中诚实、公平、负责任的良好行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kondotta kummerċjali tajba hija mġiba onesta u ġusta fin-negozju, li turi rispett lejn il-klijenti u s-sħab kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Good business conduct is honest, fair and responsible behaviour towards customers and other people in business.

collocations.en: the principles of good business conduct

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tippromwovi kondotta kummerċjali tajba billi tipprovdi informazzjoni ċara dwar il-prezzijiet u tirrispetta l-ftehimiet mal-klijenti.
formal.en: The company promotes good business conduct by providing clear pricing information and respecting its agreements with customers.
formal.zh: 公司通过提供清晰的价格信息并遵守与客户的约定，倡导良好的商业行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut talabni nħallas aktar mill-prezz li kien fuq it-tikketta. Dan jgħodd bħala kondotta kummerċjali tajba? Mark: Le, il-prezz għandu jkun ċar qabel ma tixtri.
colloquial.en: Maja: The shop asked me to pay more than the price on the label. Does that count as good business conduct? Mark: No, the price should be clear before you buy.
colloquial.zh: Maja：商店要我付的钱比标签上的价格高。这算良好的商业行为吗？Mark：不算，购买之前就应该把价格说明白。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut talabni nħallas aktar mill-prezz li kien fuq it-tikketta. Dan jgħodd bħala kondotta kummerċjali tajba?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut talabni nħallas aktar mill-prezz li kien fuq it-tikketta. Dan jgħodd bħala kondotta kummerċjali tajba?
messages.zh: 商店要我付的钱比标签上的价格高。这算良好的商业行为吗？
messages.en: The shop asked me to pay more than the price on the label. Does that count as good business conduct?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-prezz għandu jkun ċar qabel ma tixtri.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-prezz għandu jkun ċar qabel ma tixtri.
messages.zh: 不算，购买之前就应该把价格说明白。
messages.en: No, the price should be clear before you buy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组短语配上“明码标价、遵守约定”的商店画面来记：不是泛指生意好，而是经营行为诚实、公平、负责。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who directs an orchestra or another group of musicians during a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在演奏中通过手势等方式引导演奏者、协调速度和表现的指挥人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi orkestra jew grupp ta' mużiċisti waqt eżekuzzjoni mużikali permezz ta' sinjali u ġesti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指挥，即在演奏时引导和协调乐队或其他音乐团体的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konduttur huwa persuna li tmexxi grupp ta' mużiċisti u tagħtihom sinjali dwar il-ħin, ir-ritmu u l-espressjoni waqt id-daqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conductor directs a group of musicians and uses gestures to guide the timing and expression of their performance.

formal.mt: Il-konduttur ta sinjal lill-mużiċisti biex jibdew idoqqu flimkien.
formal.en: The conductor gave the musicians a signal to begin playing together.
formal.zh: 指挥向演奏者发出信号，让他们一起开始演奏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-mużiċisti kollha qed iħarsu lejn il-konduttur? Pawlu: Għax qed jurihom meta għandhom jidħlu u kemm għandhom idoqqu malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are all the musicians looking at the conductor? Pawlu: Because he is showing them when to come in and how fast to play.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么所有演奏者都看着指挥？Pawlu：因为他在示意他们何时加入演奏，以及应该演奏多快。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-mużiċisti kollha qed iħarsu lejn il-konduttur?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-mużiċisti kollha qed iħarsu lejn il-konduttur?
messages.zh: 为什么所有演奏者都看着指挥？
messages.en: Why are all the musicians looking at the conductor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed jurihom meta għandhom jidħlu u kemm għandhom idoqqu malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed jurihom meta għandhom jidħlu u kemm għandhom idoqqu malajr.
messages.zh: 因为他在示意他们何时加入演奏，以及应该演奏多快。
messages.en: Because he is showing them when to come in and how fast to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆本条音乐义时，想象台前一人抬手、全体乐手同时起奏；把 konduttur 与“看手势、跟节奏”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An association of states or organizations that cooperate while retaining their separate identities and substantial independence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由多个国家或组织组成、成员在保有各自身份和较大独立性的同时开展合作的联合体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' stati jew organizzazzjonijiet li jikkooperaw għal skopijiet komuni filwaqt li jżommu l-identità tagħhom u grad għoli ta' indipendenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邦联或联盟，指成员国家或组织保有较大独立性、为共同目标而结成的联合体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konfederazzjoni hija għaqda ta' stati jew organizzazzjonijiet li jaħdmu flimkien għal għanijiet komuni filwaqt li kull membru jibqa' fil-biċċa l-kbira indipendenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A confederation is a group of states or organizations that cooperate for shared purposes while remaining largely independent.

collocations.zh: 由多个国家组成的邦联

formal.mt: L-għaqdiet waqqfu konfederazzjoni biex jirrappreżentaw l-interessi komuni tagħhom, filwaqt li kull għaqda żammet it-tmexxija tagħha.
formal.en: The associations formed a confederation to represent their common interests, while each association retained its own leadership.
formal.zh: 这些协会成立了一个联盟，以代表它们的共同利益，同时各协会保留自己的领导机构。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Jekk l-għaqda tagħna tidħol fil-konfederazzjoni, xorta jkollna l-kumitat tagħna? David: Iva, nibqgħu mmexxu l-għaqda tagħna u naħdmu mal-oħrajn fuq affarijiet komuni.
colloquial.en: Nina: If our association joins the confederation, will we still have our own committee? David: Yes, we will keep running our association and work with the others on shared matters.
colloquial.zh: Nina：如果我们的协会加入这个联盟，还会保留自己的委员会吗？David：会，我们继续管理自己的协会，并与其他成员合作处理共同事务。

messages.speaker: Nina (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk l-għaqda tagħna tidħol fil-konfederazzjoni, xorta jkollna l-kumitat tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk l-għaqda tagħna tidħol fil-konfederazzjoni, xorta jkollna l-kumitat tagħna?
messages.zh: 如果我们的协会加入这个联盟，还会保留自己的委员会吗？
messages.en: If our association joins the confederation, will we still have our own committee?

messages.speaker: David (协会负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibqgħu mmexxu l-għaqda tagħna u naħdmu mal-oħrajn fuq affarijiet komuni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibqgħu mmexxu l-għaqda tagħna u naħdmu mal-oħrajn fuq affarijiet komuni.
messages.zh: 会，我们继续管理自己的协会，并与其他成员合作处理共同事务。
messages.en: Yes, we will keep running our association and work with the others on shared matters.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几支队伍各自保留队旗，却围桌协商共同事务；用“各有自主、共同合作”的画面记住 konfederazzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An association of shipping companies that operate regular liner services and agree on freight rates or other conditions on particular routes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经营定期班轮运输的航运公司为特定航线的运价或其他运输条件达成协议而组成的联合组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' kumpaniji tat-tbaħħir li joffru servizzi regolari fuq rotot partikolari u jiftiehmu dwar ir-rati tal-merkanzija jew kundizzjonijiet oħra tat-trasport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 班轮公会，指在特定航线上经营定期班轮运输、就运价或其他运输条件达成协议的航运公司联合组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konferenza marittima hija għaqda ta' kumpaniji li joperaw servizzi regolari ta' trasport bil-baħar fuq rotot partikolari u jiftiehmu dwar ir-rati għall-ġarr tal-merkanzija jew kundizzjonijiet oħra tas-servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A liner conference is an association of shipping companies that agree on freight rates or service conditions for regular sailings on particular routes.

collocations.en: the members of a liner conference

collocations.mt: ir-rati tal-merkanzija miftiehma minn konferenza marittima
collocations.en: the freight rates agreed by a liner conference
collocations.zh: 班轮公会商定的货物运价

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi kif il-kumpaniji membri tal-konferenza marittima qablu dwar ir-rati għall-ġarr tal-merkanzija fuq ir-rotta speċifikata.
formal.en: The study describes how the member companies of the liner conference agreed on freight rates for the specified route.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了班轮公会的成员公司如何就指定航线的货物运价达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn miktub konferenza marittima. Qed jitkellmu dwar laqgħa? Toni: Le, hawn ifissru għaqda ta' kumpaniji tat-tbaħħir li jiftiehmu dwar ir-rati jew il-kundizzjonijiet tas-servizz.
colloquial.en: Sara: It says liner conference here. Are they talking about a meeting? Toni: No, here they mean an association of shipping companies that agree on rates or service conditions.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里写着 konferenza marittima。他们是在说一次会议吗？Toni：不是，这里指的是就运价或服务条件达成协议的航运公司联合组织，也就是班轮公会。

messages.speaker: Sara (物流实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub konferenza marittima. Qed jitkellmu dwar laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub konferenza marittima. Qed jitkellmu dwar laqgħa?
messages.zh: 这里写着 konferenza marittima。他们是在说一次会议吗？
messages.en: It says liner conference here. Are they talking about a meeting?

messages.speaker: Toni (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn ifissru għaqda ta' kumpaniji tat-tbaħħir li jiftiehmu dwar ir-rati jew il-kundizzjonijiet tas-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn ifissru għaqda ta' kumpaniji tat-tbaħħir li jiftiehmu dwar ir-rati jew il-kundizzjonijiet tas-servizz.
messages.zh: 不是，这里指的是就运价或服务条件达成协议的航运公司联合组织，也就是班轮公会。
messages.en: No, here they mean an association of shipping companies that agree on rates or service conditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组术语记成“几家班轮公司围桌商定运价”的画面；本条指班轮公会这一组织，不能仅按字面理解为海事会议。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Citron peel cooked in sugar and used as a sweet ingredient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用糖煮制或糖渍的香橼果皮，可作为甜食或烘焙配料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoxra taċ-ċedru msajra biz-zokkor, li tintuża bħala ingredjent ħelu fil-kejkijiet u f'deżerti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用糖煮制、保存并食用的香橼果皮。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qoxra tal-frotta taċ-ċedru li tkun ġiet imsajra biz-zokkor biex issir ħelwa u tintuża fl-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Konfettura is citron peel that has been preserved in sugar and can be added to cakes or other sweet foods.

formal.mt: Żid il-konfettura mqattgħa mat-taħlita tal-kejk u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add the chopped candied citron peel to the cake mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 将切碎的糖渍香橼皮加入蛋糕混合料中，充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi nżid il-konfettura issa? Marija: Iva, imma qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I add the candied citron peel now? Marija: Yes, but cut it into small pieces first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：现在要加糖渍香橼皮了吗？玛丽娅：对，不过先把它切成小块。

messages.speaker: Lara (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nżid il-konfettura issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nżid il-konfettura issa?
messages.zh: 现在要加糖渍香橼皮了吗？
messages.en: Should I add the candied citron peel now?

messages.speaker: Marija (糕点师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 对，不过先把它切成小块。
messages.en: Yes, but cut it into small pieces first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konfettura 和蛋糕里的甜香橼皮小块一起记：看到这个词，就想起切碎后拌入面糊的糖渍果皮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The boundary marking the geographical limits of a bidding zone in a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在市场划分中，标示某一报价区地理范围的边界。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linja li timmarka l-limiti ġeografiċi ta' żona ddefinita għall-offerti f'suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划定报价区范围、将其与相邻区域分开的边界。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-linja ta' separazzjoni li tiddetermina fejn tispiċċa żona tal-offerti u fejn tibda żona ġirien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bidding zone border is the boundary that separates a bidding zone from a neighbouring area.

collocations.en: the bidding zone border on the map
a review of the bidding zone border

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi mappa li turi l-konfini taż-żona tal-offerti u ż-żoni ġirien.
formal.en: The report includes a map showing the bidding zone border and the neighbouring zones.
formal.zh: 报告附有一张地图，标示报价区边界及相邻区域。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn nista' nara l-konfini taż-żona tal-offerti? Pawlu: Fuq din il-mappa; segwi l-linja ħamra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where can I see the bidding zone border? Pawlu: On this map; follow the red line.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：在哪里能看到报价区边界？保罗：在这张地图上，沿着红线看就行。

messages.speaker: Anna (新入职分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nara l-konfini taż-żona tal-offerti?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nara l-konfini taż-żona tal-offerti?
messages.zh: 在哪里能看到报价区边界？
messages.en: Where can I see the bidding zone border?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (分析员同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq din il-mappa; segwi l-linja ħamra.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq din il-mappa; segwi l-linja ħamra.
messages.zh: 在这张地图上，沿着红线看就行。
messages.en: On this map; follow the red line.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组分块记忆：konfini 是边界，taż-żona 是区域的，tal-offerti 是报价的；再想象地图上圈出报价区的红线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serious disagreement or opposition between people, groups, interests, or ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人、群体、利益或观念之间较强烈的分歧、对立或冲突。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' qbil serju jew oppożizzjoni bejn persuni, gruppi, interessi jew ideat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因意见、目标、利益或立场不一致而产生的对立或冲突。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha persuni jew gruppi jkunu kontra xulxin, jew li fiha interessi, għanijiet jew ideat ma jaqblux bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conflict occurs when people, groups, interests, or ideas are opposed to one another.

formal.mt: Il-medjatur għen liż-żewġ naħat isolvu l-konflitt permezz tad-djalogu.
formal.en: The mediator helped both sides resolve the conflict through dialogue.
formal.zh: 调解员帮助双方通过对话解决了冲突。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm konflitt bejni u bejn ħija dwar min se juża l-karozza. Sara: Tkellmu bil-kalma u ppruvaw issibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: My brother and I have a conflict over who will use the car. Sara: Talk calmly and try to find a solution.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我和兄弟为了谁用车起了冲突。萨拉：你们平静地谈谈，试着找个解决办法。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm konflitt bejni u bejn ħija dwar min se juża l-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm konflitt bejni u bejn ħija dwar min se juża l-karozza.
messages.zh: 我和兄弟为了谁用车起了冲突。
messages.en: My brother and I have a conflict over who will use the car.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkellmu bil-kalma u ppruvaw issibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tkellmu bil-kalma u ppruvaw issibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 你们平静地谈谈，试着找个解决办法。
messages.en: Talk calmly and try to find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konflitt 与英语 conflict 对照记形，再想象两个人争用同一辆车；意见或利益相撞，就是冲突。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Secret scheming or a concealed plan intended to gain an advantage or harm someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了谋取利益或损害他人而进行的秘密策划，也指由此形成的阴谋计划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħidma moħbija jew pjan sigriet biex jinkiseb vantaġġ jew issir ħsara lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为谋取优势或损害他人而进行的秘密运作、勾结或阴谋活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività moħbija li tinvolvi manuvri u ftehimiet sigrieti biex jinkiseb vantaġġ jew tiddgħajjef il-pożizzjoni ta' xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intrigue is secret scheming through which people try to gain an advantage or undermine someone else.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘密制定、旨在实施有害行为或损害他人的阴谋计划。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjan sigriet imħejji biex jitwettaq xi att ta' ħsara jew biex xi ħadd jitneħħa minn pożizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plot is a secret plan to carry out a harmful act or achieve an improper aim.

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni kixfet konfoffa biex jinxterdu akkużi foloz kontra d-direttur.
formal.en: The investigation uncovered a plot to spread false accusations against the director.
formal.zh: 调查揭露了一项散布针对主管的虚假指控的阴谋。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taħseb li hemm konfoffa biex ineħħu lil Lara mit-tim? David: Ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw il-fatti qabel nemmnu dan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you think there is a plot to remove Lara from the team? David: I don't know; let's check the facts before believing that.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得有人密谋把拉拉赶出团队吗？戴维：我不知道，先核实事实再相信这种说法吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li hemm konfoffa biex ineħħu lil Lara mit-tim?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li hemm konfoffa biex ineħħu lil Lara mit-tim?
messages.zh: 你觉得有人密谋把拉拉赶出团队吗？
messages.en: Do you think there is a plot to remove Lara from the team?

messages.speaker: David (团队同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw il-fatti qabel nemmnu dan.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw il-fatti qabel nemmnu dan.
messages.zh: 我不知道，先核实事实再相信这种说法吧。
messages.en: I don't know; let's check the facts before believing that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人关门低声谋划：konfoffa 可以指暗中运作的阴谋活动，也可以指已经拟好的秘密害人计划。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fulfilment of the terms, conditions, and obligations set out in a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遵守合同规定的条款、条件和义务，按约定履行责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq tal-obbligi u l-ħarsien tat-termini u tal-kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti f'kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对合同条款和约定义务的遵守与履行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien tat-termini u tal-kundizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt u t-twettiq tal-obbligi li jistabbilixxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Contract compliance is the act or state of meeting the requirements and obligations specified in a contract.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jivverifika l-konformità mal-kuntratt, b'attenzjoni partikolari għall-kwalità tax-xogħol u għad-dati tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The report verifies compliance with the contract, paying particular attention to the quality of the work and the delivery dates.
formal.zh: 该报告核查合同履行情况，特别关注工作质量和交付日期。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja d-dati kollha? Pawlu: Biex niżgura l-konformità mal-kuntratt. Irridu nwasslu kollox sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you checking all the dates? Pawlu: To make sure we comply with the contract. We have to deliver everything by Friday.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么在核对所有日期？保罗：为了确保按合同履行。我们必须在星期五之前把所有东西交付。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja d-dati kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja d-dati kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么在核对所有日期？
messages.en: Why are you checking all the dates?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niżgura l-konformità mal-kuntratt. Irridu nwasslu kollox sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niżgura l-konformità mal-kuntratt. Irridu nwasslu kollox sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 为了确保按合同履行。我们必须在星期五之前把所有东西交付。
messages.en: To make sure we comply with the contract. We have to deliver everything by Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和“拿着合同逐项打勾”的画面绑定：质量、期限、义务全部符合约定，就是依约履行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A direct encounter in which people or groups openly oppose or challenge each other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体直接面对彼此，公开表达对立或相互挑战的冲突场面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha persuni jew gruppi jiffaċċjaw lil xulxin u jesprimu oppożizzjoni jew nuqqas ta' qbil b'mod dirett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双方直接面对彼此、公开发生争执或表现出对立的冲突。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqgħa jew sitwazzjoni ta' kunflitt dirett bejn persuni jew gruppi li jkunu kontra xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A confrontation is a situation in which people or groups openly oppose or challenge one another.

formal.mt: Il-medjatur ippropona laqgħa privata biex jevita konfront dirett bejn iż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The mediator proposed a private meeting to avoid a direct confrontation between the two parties.
formal.zh: 调解员提议举行一次私下会面，以避免双方直接对峙。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tkellmu issa, quddiem kulħadd? Mark: Le, ma rridx konfront. Nitkellem miegħu waħdu aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to speak to him now, in front of everyone? Mark: No, I don't want a confrontation. I'll speak to him privately later.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要现在当着所有人的面找他谈吗？马克：不，我不想发生正面冲突。我晚点单独跟他谈。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tkellmu issa, quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Se tkellmu issa, quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 你要现在当着所有人的面找他谈吗？
messages.en: Are you going to speak to him now, in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma rridx konfront. Nitkellem miegħu waħdu aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma rridx konfront. Nitkellem miegħu waħdu aktar tard.
messages.zh: 不，我不想发生正面冲突。我晚点单独跟他谈。
messages.en: No, I don't want a confrontation. I'll speak to him privately later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人面对面争执的画面，把 konfront 记成“正面对峙”；再用“避免冲突”这一搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state in which understanding is unclear or people and things are not properly organized.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于理解不清、信息不明确或安排无序而产生的困惑或混乱状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih persuna ma tifhimx ċar xi ħaġa, jew li fih l-affarijiet jew l-attivitajiet ma jkunux organizzati sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对事情理解不清的困惑，或信息、安排和活动杂乱无序的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ċarezza fil-fehim jew fl-informazzjoni, jew stat ta' diżordni fl-affarijiet u fl-attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Confusion is a state in which people cannot understand something clearly or events and arrangements become disorganized.

collocations.zh: 澄清混乱之处；消除困惑

formal.mt: Biex tiġi evitata l-konfużjoni, l-avviż il-ġdid jispeċifika d-data, il-ħin u l-post tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: To avoid confusion, the new notice specifies the date, time, and location of the meeting.
formal.zh: 为避免混淆，新通知明确列出了会议的日期、时间和地点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-laqgħa fl-erbgħa jew fil-ħamsa? Għandi żewġ messaġġi differenti. Ġanni: Fl-erbgħa. Skużani għall-konfużjoni; il-ħin fil-messaġġ ta' qabel kien ħażin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the meeting at four or five? I have two different messages. Ġanni: At four. Sorry for the confusion; the time in the earlier message was wrong.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：会议是四点还是五点？我收到的两条消息不一样。詹尼：四点。抱歉让你困惑了，之前那条消息里的时间写错了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-laqgħa fl-erbgħa jew fil-ħamsa? Għandi żewġ messaġġi differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Il-laqgħa fl-erbgħa jew fil-ħamsa? Għandi żewġ messaġġi differenti.
messages.zh: 会议是四点还是五点？我收到的两条消息不一样。
messages.en: Is the meeting at four or five? I have two different messages.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-erbgħa. Skużani għall-konfużjoni; il-ħin fil-messaġġ ta' qabel kien ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-erbgħa. Skużani għall-konfużjoni; il-ħin fil-messaġġ ta' qabel kien ħażin.
messages.zh: 四点。抱歉让你困惑了，之前那条消息里的时间写错了。
messages.en: At four. Sorry for the confusion; the time in the earlier message was wrong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两条通知写着不同时间”的场景记忆：脑中拿不准是困惑，现场安排乱了是混乱，都可联系 konfużjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person to whom someone is married.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人结为婚姻关系的人，即其丈夫或妻子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna li magħha xi ħadd ikun miżżewweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配偶；与某人有婚姻关系的丈夫或妻子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konjuġi huwa r-raġel jew il-mara li magħhom persuna tkun marbuta biż-żwieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your spouse is the person you are married to.

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob l-isem sħiħ tal-konjuġi u n-numru tat-telefon tiegħu jew tagħha.
formal.en: The form asks for the spouse's full name and his or her telephone number.
formal.zh: 表格要求填写配偶的全名及其电话号码。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn miktub 'isem il-konjuġi'. Nikteb isem żewġi? Lara: Iva, eżatt. 'Konjuġi' tfisser ir-raġel jew il-mara li tkun miżżewġa magħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says 'spouse's name' here. Should I write my husband's name? Lara: Yes, exactly. 'Spouse' means the husband or wife you are married to.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里写着“配偶姓名”。我要填我丈夫的名字吗？Lara：对，正是这样。“配偶”指与你结婚的丈夫或妻子。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'isem il-konjuġi'. Nikteb isem żewġi?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'isem il-konjuġi'. Nikteb isem żewġi?
messages.zh: 这里写着“配偶姓名”。我要填我丈夫的名字吗？
