messages.en: It says 'spouse's name' here. Should I write my husband's name?

messages.speaker: Lara (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżatt. 'Konjuġi' tfisser ir-raġel jew il-mara li tkun miżżewġa magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżatt. 'Konjuġi' tfisser ir-raġel jew il-mara li tkun miżżewġa magħhom.
messages.zh: 对，正是这样。“配偶”指与你结婚的丈夫或妻子。
messages.en: Yes, exactly. 'Spouse' means the husband or wife you are married to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象表格上的“配偶姓名”一栏，看到 konjuġi 就想到与自己结婚的那个人，丈夫或妻子都适用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cathedral that shares the function of a bishop's seat with another cathedral in the same diocese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与同一教区内另一座主教座堂共同承担主教座堂职能的教堂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Knisja li taqsam ma' katidral ieħor fl-istess djoċesi l-funzjoni ta' sede tal-isqof.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同主教座堂；在同一教区内与另一座主教座堂共享主教座堂地位和职能的教堂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konkatidral huwa knisja li għandha d-dinjità ta' katidral u taqsam il-funzjoni ta' sede tal-isqof ma' katidral ieħor fl-istess djoċesi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A co-cathedral is a church that shares cathedral status and the function of a bishop's seat with another church in the same diocese.

collocations.zh: 共同主教座堂的正立面

formal.mt: Il-gwida tispjega li l-konkatidral jaqsam il-funzjoni ta' sede tal-isqof ma' katidral ieħor fl-istess djoċesi.
formal.en: The guide explains that the co-cathedral shares the function of a bishop's seat with another cathedral in the same diocese.
formal.zh: 导览资料说明，这座共同主教座堂与同一教区的另一座主教座堂共同承担主教座堂职能。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex din il-knisja tissejjaħ konkatidral? Lara: Għax taqsam il-funzjoni ta' sede tal-isqof ma' katidral ieħor fl-istess djoċesi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is this church called a co-cathedral? Lara: Because it shares the function of a bishop's seat with another cathedral in the same diocese.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这座教堂为什么叫共同主教座堂？Lara：因为它与同一教区的另一座主教座堂共同承担主教座堂职能。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-knisja tissejjaħ konkatidral?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-knisja tissejjaħ konkatidral?
messages.zh: 这座教堂为什么叫共同主教座堂？
messages.en: Why is this church called a co-cathedral?

messages.speaker: Lara (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax taqsam il-funzjoni ta' sede tal-isqof ma' katidral ieħor fl-istess djoċesi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax taqsam il-funzjoni ta' sede tal-isqof ma' katidral ieħor fl-istess djoċesi.
messages.zh: 因为它与同一教区的另一座主教座堂共同承担主教座堂职能。
messages.en: Because it shares the function of a bishop's seat with another cathedral in the same diocese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出同一教区里的两座教堂，并给两座都标上主教座堂身份；用“共同承担”这个画面记住 konkatidral。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized competition in which participants try to win by demonstrating skill or producing the best entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参赛者通过展示技能或提交作品来争取优胜的有组织竞赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni organizzata li fiha l-parteċipanti jippruvaw jirbħu billi juru l-ħila tagħhom jew jippreżentaw l-aħjar xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比赛；竞赛，尤指参赛者凭技能、表现或作品争取优胜的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konkors huwa kompetizzjoni li fiha persuni jew gruppi jikkompetu skont regoli stabbiliti sabiex jintgħażel rebbieħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contest is an organized event in which people compete to win through their skills, performances, or entries.

formal.mt: L-iskola ħabbret konkors tal-kitba u stiednet lill-istudenti jibagħtu storja qasira sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The school announced a writing contest and invited students to submit a short story by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 学校宣布举办写作比赛，并邀请学生在月底前提交一篇短篇故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tieħu sehem fil-konkors tal-kitba? Mark: Iva! Diġà ktibt storja, imma għad irrid naqraha darba oħra qabel nibgħatha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to take part in the writing contest? Mark: Yes! I've already written a story, but I still need to read it again before I send it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要参加写作比赛吗？Mark：要！我已经写好一篇故事，不过提交前还得再读一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fil-konkors tal-kitba?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fil-konkors tal-kitba?
messages.zh: 你要参加写作比赛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to take part in the writing contest?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Diġà ktibt storja, imma għad irrid naqraha darba oħra qabel nibgħatha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Diġà ktibt storja, imma għad irrid naqraha darba oħra qabel nibgħatha.
messages.zh: 要！我已经写好一篇故事，不过提交前还得再读一遍。
messages.en: Yes! I've already written a story, but I still need to read it again before I send it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konkors 放进“报名、交作品、评出优胜者”的连续画面中，连同“参加比赛”和“赢得比赛”两个搭配一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A competition in which participants submit designs to be judged and a winner is selected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参赛者提交设计作品，由评审比较并选出优胜者的比赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li fiha l-parteċipanti jippreżentaw disinni biex jiġu evalwati u jintgħażel rebbieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞赛；参赛者相互竞争并接受评选的活动，此处指设计方面的比赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li fiha l-parteċipanti jikkompetu bejniethom u jiġu evalwati biex jintgħażel rebbieħ, f'dan il-każ fil-qasam tad-disinn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contest is an organized competition in which people compete to win, here by presenting designs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计竞赛；通过评审参赛设计作品来选出优胜者的比赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li fiha jiġu ppreżentati u evalwati xogħlijiet ta' disinn biex jintgħażel l-aħjar wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A design contest is a competition in which submitted designs are judged to choose a winner.

collocations.en: take part in a design contest

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat konkors ta' disinn biex tagħżel logo ġdid għall-librerija.
formal.en: The school organized a design contest to choose a new logo for the library.
formal.zh: 学校举办了一场设计竞赛，为图书馆选出新的标志。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tieħu sehem fil-konkors ta' disinn? Ben: Iva, se nippreżenta disinn għal siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you entering the design contest? Ben: Yes, I'm going to submit a design for a chair.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要参加设计竞赛吗？本：要，我打算提交一份椅子的设计。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fil-konkors ta' disinn?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fil-konkors ta' disinn?
messages.zh: 你要参加设计竞赛吗？
messages.en: Are you entering the design contest?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nippreżenta disinn għal siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nippreżenta disinn għal siġġu.
messages.zh: 要，我打算提交一份椅子的设计。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to submit a design for a chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成“交设计、等评奖”的场景：konkors 对应竞赛，disinn 对应设计，合起来记作设计竞赛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Specific, definite, and based on actual things or facts rather than abstract ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具体明确、涉及实际事物或事实而非抽象概念的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu speċifiku u ċar u jirreferi għal affarijiet jew fatti reali aktar milli għal ideat astratti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体的；明确而有实际内容的，与抽象或笼统相对。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu kontenut speċifiku u ċar jew bażi fil-fatti u fir-realtà, aktar milli jkun astratt jew vag.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something concrete is specific and definite, so that you can understand or identify it clearly.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta pjan konkret biex jitnaqqas il-ħin ta' stennija għall-pazjenti.
formal.en: The report presents a concrete plan to reduce waiting times for patients.
formal.zh: 报告提出了一项缩短患者等候时间的具体计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini eżempju konkret? Pawlu: Iva, aħseb f'ħanut li jnaqqas il-prezzijiet biex ibigħ aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you give me a concrete example? Pawlu: Yes, think of a shop that lowers its prices to sell more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能给我举个具体的例子吗？保罗：可以，想想一家为了增加销量而降价的商店。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini eżempju konkret?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini eżempju konkret?
messages.zh: 你能给我举个具体的例子吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a concrete example?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aħseb f'ħanut li jnaqqas il-prezzijiet biex ibigħ aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aħseb f'ħanut li jnaqqas il-prezzijiet biex ibigħ aktar.
messages.zh: 可以，想想一家为了增加销量而降价的商店。
messages.en: Yes, think of a shop that lowers its prices to sell more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“说清楚、举实例”来记 konkret：遇到 eżempju konkret，就想成能讲明白的具体例子；这里学习的是形容词。

gloss_zh: 淫欲；强烈的肉欲；贪欲（宗教或道德语境）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong sexual or sensual desire, especially when discussed as morally wrong in religious or ethical contexts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈的性欲或感官欲望，尤用于宗教或道德讨论，指被视为不当的肉欲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa sesswali jew senswali qawwija, speċjalment meta titqies bħala ħażina f'kuntest reliġjuż jew morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫欲；强烈的性欲，常带有道德上的贬义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xewqa sesswali qawwija li spiss titqies b'mod negattiv minn perspettiva morali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lust is a strong sexual desire, especially when it is regarded as morally wrong or excessive.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪欲；私欲；尤指宗教或道德语境中被视为导向罪的肉欲或感官欲望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija għall-pjaċiri tal-ġisem jew tas-sensi li, f'diskors reliġjuż jew morali, titqies bħala waħda li tista' twassal għad-dnub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Concupiscence is strong sensual desire, discussed especially in religious or moral writing as an inclination towards sin.

formal.mt: F'dan it-test reliġjuż, il-konkupixxenza hija deskritta bħala xewqa li tista' twassal lill-bniedem għad-dnub.
formal.en: In this religious text, concupiscence is described as a desire that can lead a person into sin.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，贪欲被描述为一种可能使人陷入罪的欲望。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser konkupixxenza f'din is-silta? Mark: Hawn tfisser xewqa sesswali qawwija li l-awtur iqis bħala ħażina.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does concupiscence mean in this passage? Mark: Here it means strong sexual desire that the author regards as wrong.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这段文字里的 konkupixxenza 是什么意思？马克：这里指作者认为不当的强烈性欲。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser konkupixxenza f'din is-silta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser konkupixxenza f'din is-silta?
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 konkupixxenza 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does concupiscence mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser xewqa sesswali qawwija li l-awtur iqis bħala ħażina.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser xewqa sesswali qawwija li l-awtur iqis bħala ħażina.
messages.zh: 这里指作者认为不当的强烈性欲。
messages.en: Here it means strong sexual desire that the author regards as wrong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个较长的词放进“宗教文本讨论肉欲”的阅读场景来记；用“强烈欲望加道德评价”抓住含义，避免当作普通的想要。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of taking control of a country or territory by military force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过军事力量取得对某个国家或地区控制权的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih pajjiż jew territorju jittieħed taħt il-kontroll ta' qawwa oħra permezz tal-forza militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 征服；通过武力夺取并控制一个国家或地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-teħid ta' pajjiż jew territorju taħt kontroll permezz tal-forza militari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conquest is the act of gaining control of a country or territory by military force.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi l-konkwista tat-territorju u l-bidliet amministrattivi li seħħew warajha.
formal.en: The chapter describes the conquest of the territory and the administrative changes that followed it.
formal.zh: 这一章描述了对该地区的征服，以及随后发生的行政变革。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara wara l-konkwista tal-belt fl-istorja? Toni: L-armata ħadet il-kontroll u nħatar mexxej ġdid.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened after the conquest of the city in the story? Toni: The army took control and a new leader was appointed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：故事里，城市被攻占之后发生了什么？托尼：军队取得了控制权，随后任命了一位新领导人。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara wara l-konkwista tal-belt fl-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara wara l-konkwista tal-belt fl-istorja?
messages.zh: 故事里，城市被攻占之后发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened after the conquest of the city in the story?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-armata ħadet il-kontroll u nħatar mexxej ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: L-armata ħadet il-kontroll u nħatar mexxej ġdid.
messages.zh: 军队取得了控制权，随后任命了一位新领导人。
messages.en: The army took control and a new leader was appointed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“攻进去，再控制住”的连续画面：konkwista 强调通过武力取得控制，可与 konkwista militari“军事征服”一起记。

gloss_zh: 我们曾是朋友；我们当时是朋友

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning that we were friends at a time in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示我们在过去某个时期是朋友；是否至今仍是朋友，要看上下文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li aħna kellna relazzjoni ta' ħbiberija fi żmien fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 曾是朋友；在此短语中，具体表示我们过去是朋友。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li aħna konna f'relazzjoni ta' ħbiberija fi żmien fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say that we were friends, you mean that a friendship existed between us at a particular time in the past.

formal.mt: Meta konna studenti fl-istess skola, konna ħbieb u konna naħdmu flimkien fuq proġetti.
formal.en: When we were students at the same school, we were friends and worked together on projects.
formal.zh: 我们在同一所学校读书时是朋友，也一起做项目。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tiftakar kemm konna ħbieb fl-iskola? Pawlu: Mela le! Konna nqattgħu kull brejk flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you remember how close we were as friends at school? Pawlu: Of course! We used to spend every break together.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你还记得我们上学时有多要好吗？保罗：当然记得！我们每次课间都在一起。

messages.speaker: Marija (老同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiftakar kemm konna ħbieb fl-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Tiftakar kemm konna ħbieb fl-iskola?
messages.zh: 你还记得我们上学时有多要好吗？
messages.en: Do you remember how close we were as friends at school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela le! Konna nqattgħu kull brejk flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Mela le! Konna nqattgħu kull brejk flimkien.
messages.zh: 当然记得！我们每次课间都在一起。
messages.en: Of course! We used to spend every break together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konna ħbieb 配上一张两人学生时代的合照，整句记作“我们当时是朋友”；过去的说法本身不说明现在是否仍是朋友。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Joined or linked to something else, especially a device, network, or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他事物相连的，尤其指设备已接入网络或系统的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li hija magħquda jew marbuta ma' xi ħaġa oħra, speċjalment ma' apparat, netwerk jew sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连接着的；与其他事物、设备、网络或系统相连的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun konnessa meta tkun magħquda jew marbuta ma' xi ħaġa oħra, bħal apparat jew netwerk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is connected to another thing, it is joined or linked to it so that they can function together or communicate.

formal.mt: Il-kompjuter għandu jkun konness man-netwerk tal-uffiċċju qabel ma jibda t-trasferiment tad-data.
formal.en: The computer must be connected to the office network before the data transfer begins.
formal.zh: 开始传输数据之前，计算机必须连接到办公室网络。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kompjuter konness mal-internet? Lara: Iva, tista' tiftaħ il-paġna issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the computer connected to the internet? Lara: Yes, you can open the page now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：电脑连上互联网了吗？拉拉：连上了，你现在可以打开网页了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kompjuter konness mal-internet?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kompjuter konness mal-internet?
messages.zh: 电脑连上互联网了吗？
messages.en: Is the computer connected to the internet?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tiftaħ il-paġna issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tiftaħ il-paġna issa.
messages.zh: 连上了，你现在可以打开网页了。
messages.en: Yes, you can open the page now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电脑旁亮起连接指示灯，用 konness 描述“已经连上的”状态；搭配 il-kompjuter konness mal-internet 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A link or relationship between things, including a link that allows devices or systems to communicate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物之间的连接或联系，也可指使设备或系统能够通信的连接。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta jew relazzjoni bejn affarijiet, inkluża rabta li tippermetti lil apparat jew sistemi jikkomunikaw bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连接；联系；使两个或多个事物相互关联或能够通信的关系或通道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konnessjoni hija rabta bejn żewġ affarijiet jew aktar, li tista' tkun fiżika, teknika jew relazzjoni ta' tip ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A connection is a link between two or more things that relates them to each other or allows communication between them.

formal.mt: Biex jieħdu sehem fil-laqgħa online, il-parteċipanti jeħtieġu konnessjoni tal-internet stabbli.
formal.en: To take part in the online meeting, participants need a stable internet connection.
formal.zh: 参加线上会议时，与会者需要稳定的互联网连接。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek konnessjoni tajba hemm? David: Iva, nista' nisma' kollox ċar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a good connection there? David: Yes, I can hear everything clearly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你那边连接好吗？戴维：好，我听得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek konnessjoni tajba hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek konnessjoni tajba hemm?
messages.zh: 你那边连接好吗？
messages.en: Do you have a good connection there?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nista' nisma' kollox ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nista' nisma' kollox ċar.
messages.zh: 好，我听得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, I can hear everything clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konnessjoni 想成两台设备之间的一条连接线：它是可以谈论好坏、稳定与否的“连接”，搭配 konnessjoni stabbli 记作“稳定连接”。

gloss_zh: 不同运输方式之间的衔接；联运接驳

teaching_sense.en_definition: A transport link that allows passengers or goods to transfer between different modes of transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使乘客或货物能够在不同运输方式之间转移的交通衔接，例如轮渡与公交之间的接驳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta fit-trasport li tippermetti lill-passiġġieri jew lill-merkanzija jgħaddu minn mezz ta' trasport għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同运输方式之间的衔接或接驳，使乘客能够换乘或货物能够转运。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konnessjoni intermodali hija rabta bejn mezzi differenti ta' trasport li tiffaċilita l-bidla minn mezz għal ieħor għall-passiġġieri jew għall-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intermodal connection is a transport link that enables passengers or goods to move from one mode of transport to another.

collocations.mt: konnessjoni intermodali bejn il-lanċa u l-karozza tal-linja
collocations.en: an intermodal connection between the ferry and the bus
collocations.zh: 轮渡与公交车之间的接驳
不同运输方式之间衔接的改善

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi konnessjoni intermodali bejn is-servizzi tal-laneċ u dawk tal-karozzi tal-linja biex jiffaċilita l-vjaġġi tal-passiġġieri.
formal.en: The plan proposes an intermodal connection between ferry and bus services to make passenger journeys easier.
formal.zh: 该计划提出衔接轮渡与公交服务，以方便乘客出行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi konnessjoni intermodali? Toni: Bħal meta tinżel mil-lanċa u taqbad karozza tal-linja minn ħdejn il-moll.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is an intermodal connection? Toni: It's like getting off the ferry and catching a bus beside the quay.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：什么是不同运输方式之间的接驳？托尼：比如下了轮渡，就在码头旁坐上公交车。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi konnessjoni intermodali?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi konnessjoni intermodali?
messages.zh: 什么是不同运输方式之间的接驳？
messages.en: What is an intermodal connection?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħal meta tinżel mil-lanċa u taqbad karozza tal-linja minn ħdejn il-moll.
messages.mt_standard: Bħal meta tinżel mil-lanċa u taqbad karozza tal-linja minn ħdejn il-moll.
messages.zh: 比如下了轮渡，就在码头旁坐上公交车。
messages.en: It's like getting off the ferry and catching a bus beside the quay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画出“轮渡下船→公交上车”的连续路线，把 konnessjoni intermodali 整体记成“不同运输方式之间的衔接”，关键是换了运输方式。

exact_key: konnessjoni ta' operatur tas-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa
gloss_zh: 封闭配电系统运营商的连接；与该运营商相关的接入

teaching_sense.en_definition: A connection involving the operator of a closed distribution system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及封闭配电系统运营商的连接或接入，具体连接关系须结合技术语境理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konnessjoni li tinvolvi operatur ta' sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa, bid-dettalji tar-rabta jiddependu mill-kuntest tekniku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封闭配电系统运营商（CDSO）的连接或接入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-konnessjoni li tinvolvi operatur ta' sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa, imsemmi bl-abbrevjazzjoni CDSO.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression refers to a connection involving a closed distribution system operator, abbreviated as CDSO.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及封闭配电系统运营商的连接或接入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-konnessjoni li tinvolvi l-operatur responsabbli minn sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression describes a connection involving the operator responsible for a closed distribution system.

collocations.mt: pjan għall-konnessjoni ta' operatur tas-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa
collocations.en: a plan for connecting a closed distribution system operator
collocations.zh: 封闭配电系统运营商的连接方案

collocations.mt: dettalji dwar il-konnessjoni ta' operatur tas-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa
collocations.en: details about connecting a closed distribution system operator
collocations.zh: 有关封闭配电系统运营商连接的详细信息

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-konnessjoni ta' operatur tas-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa u jispjega l-passi proposti biex titwettaq.
formal.en: The report describes the connection involving a closed distribution system operator and explains the proposed steps for carrying it out.
formal.zh: 报告描述了涉及封闭配电系统运营商的连接，并说明了实施这一连接的拟议步骤。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu s-suġġett ta' din it-taqsima? Pawlu: Il-konnessjoni ta' operatur tas-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa. Marija: Tista' tispjegaha b'mod aktar sempliċi? Pawlu: Iva, ejja nħarsu lejn id-dijagramma flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is this section about? Pawlu: The connection involving a closed distribution system operator. Marija: Can you explain it more simply? Pawlu: Yes, let's look at the diagram together.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这一节讲什么？Pawlu：涉及封闭配电系统运营商的连接。Marija：你能解释得简单一点吗？Pawlu：可以，我们一起看这张示意图。

messages.speaker: Marija (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu s-suġġett ta' din it-taqsima?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu s-suġġett ta' din it-taqsima?
messages.zh: 这一节讲什么？
messages.en: What is this section about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-konnessjoni ta' operatur tas-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-konnessjoni ta' operatur tas-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa.
messages.zh: 涉及封闭配电系统运营商的连接。
messages.en: The connection involving a closed distribution system operator.

messages.speaker: Marija (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tispjegaha b'mod aktar sempliċi?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tispjegaha b'mod aktar sempliċi?
messages.zh: 你能解释得简单一点吗？
messages.en: Can you explain it more simply?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nħarsu lejn id-dijagramma flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nħarsu lejn id-dijagramma flimkien.
messages.zh: 可以，我们一起看这张示意图。
messages.en: Yes, let's look at the diagram together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成四块记：konnessjoni 是连接，operatur 是运营商，sistema ta' distribuzzjoni 是配电系统，magħluqa 表示封闭。想象示意图中的运营商连接，再按顺序拼回整句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Knowledge or awareness of a subject, fact, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个领域、事实或情况所具有的知识、了解或知晓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li persuna taf dwar suġġett, fatt jew sitwazzjoni, jew l-għarfien li xi ħaġa teżisti jew qed isseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对事物的知识或了解；对某一事实或情况的知晓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-informazzjoni u l-fehim li persuna għandha dwar xi ħaġa, jew il-fatt li tkun taf b'ċirkostanza jew ġrajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your knowledge or awareness of something is what you know or understand about it.

collocations.zh: 对马耳他语的良好掌握

collocations.en: with full knowledge of the facts
collocations.zh: 在充分了解事实的情况下

collocations.en: a basic knowledge of the subject

formal.mt: Għal dan il-kors hija meħtieġa konoxxenza bażika tal-Malti sabiex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jsegwu l-ispjegazzjonijiet.
formal.en: A basic knowledge of Maltese is required for this course so that students can follow the explanations.
formal.zh: 本课程要求学生具备基本的马耳他语知识，以便能够听懂讲解。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek konoxxenza tal-Malti? Mark: Ftit biss, imma nifhem kliem sempliċi. Anna: Mela nistgħu nibdew b'konversazzjoni qasira.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have any knowledge of Maltese? Mark: Only a little, but I understand simple words. Anna: Then we can start with a short conversation.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你懂一些马耳他语吗？Mark：只懂一点，不过我能理解简单的词。Anna：那我们可以先来一段简短的对话。

messages.speaker: Anna (语言老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek konoxxenza tal-Malti?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek konoxxenza tal-Malti?
messages.zh: 你懂一些马耳他语吗？
messages.en: Do you have any knowledge of Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss, imma nifhem kliem sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss, imma nifhem kliem sempliċi.
messages.zh: 只懂一点，不过我能理解简单的词。
messages.en: Only a little, but I understand simple words.

messages.speaker: Anna (语言老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistgħu nibdew b'konversazzjoni qasira.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistgħu nibdew b'konversazzjoni qasira.
messages.zh: 那我们可以先来一段简短的对话。
messages.en: Then we can start with a short conversation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konoxxenza 记成脑中的知识卡片：学会一个词，就添一张卡；知道一件事，也添一张卡。这样同时联想到“知识”和“知晓”两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A result or effect that follows from an action, event, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由某种行为、事件或情况引起的结果、后果或影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riżultat jew effett li jseħħ minħabba azzjoni, ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种行为、事件或情况所带来的结果或后果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżultat li joħroġ minn azzjoni, deċiżjoni jew ġrajja u li jista' jkun tajjeb jew ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consequence is something that happens as a result of an action, decision, or event.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某个原因所产生的影响、作用或结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bidla jew riżultat li xi ħaġa tikkawża f'persuna, oġġett jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An effect is a change or result that something causes in a person, thing, or situation.

formal.mt: Id-dewmien fit-twassil tal-materjal kien konsegwenza diretta tal-għeluq tat-triq.
formal.en: The delay in delivering the material was a direct consequence of the road closure.
formal.zh: 材料交付延误是道路封闭造成的直接后果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex wasalt tard? David: Tlaqt tard u tlift il-karozza tal-linja. Lara: Dik kienet il-konsegwenza li tlaqt fl-aħħar minuta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you arrive late? David: I left late and missed the bus. Lara: That was the consequence of leaving at the last minute.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么迟到了？David：我出门晚了，没赶上公交车。Lara：这就是拖到最后一刻才出门的后果。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlaqt tard u tlift il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Tlaqt tard u tlift il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我出门晚了，没赶上公交车。
messages.en: I left late and missed the bus.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik kienet il-konsegwenza li tlaqt fl-aħħar minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Dik kienet il-konsegwenza li tlaqt fl-aħħar minuta.
messages.zh: 这就是拖到最后一刻才出门的后果。
messages.en: That was the consequence of leaving at the last minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排多米诺骨牌：推倒第一块是原因，后面倒下的牌就是 konsegwenza。用“原因在前，后果在后”的画面记住它，也提醒自己结果可以是好是坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Following one after another without a break or an intervening item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在时间、次序或一系列项目中一个接着一个，中间没有中断或插入其他项目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi wara ieħor fl-istess sekwenza, mingħajr waqfa jew element ieħor bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在时间或次序上连续相接、中间没有间断的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsegwi direttament lil dak ta' qablu f'sensiela ta' ġranet, numri, ġrajjiet jew elementi oħra, mingħajr interruzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consecutive events, periods, or numbers follow one another without a break or anything coming between them.

formal.mt: Il-librerija baqgħet magħluqa għal tliet ijiem konsekuttivi minħabba xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The library remained closed for three consecutive days because of maintenance work.
formal.zh: 图书馆因维护工程连续关闭了三天。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din it-tieni darba li ġejt timxi din il-ġimgħa? Ġorġ: Iva, u għat-tieni jum konsekuttiv! Nina: Mela ġejt ilbieraħ ukoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the second time you've come for a walk this week? Ġorġ: Yes, and for the second consecutive day! Nina: So you came yesterday too.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这是你这周第二次来散步吗？Ġorġ：对，而且已经连续第二天了！Nina：那你昨天也来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tieni darba li ġejt timxi din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tieni darba li ġejt timxi din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 这是你这周第二次来散步吗？
messages.en: Is this the second time you've come for a walk this week?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għat-tieni jum konsekuttiv!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għat-tieni jum konsekuttiv!
messages.zh: 对，而且已经连续第二天了！
messages.en: Yes, and for the second consecutive day!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ġejt ilbieraħ ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ġejt ilbieraħ ukoll.
messages.zh: 那你昨天也来了。
messages.en: So you came yesterday too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上把周一、周二、周三连着打勾，想成 tliet ijiem konsekuttivi。关键是中间不能空一天；搭配多个日子时，例句中用复数形式 konsekuttivi。

gloss_zh: 交付；发运；货物路线安排；货运批次

teaching_sense.en_definition: The delivery or dispatch of goods, the arrangement of their route, or a shipment of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指货物的交付、发运或运输路线安排，也可指一批运送的货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti jew it-tluq ta' merkanzija lejn min għandu jirċeviha, l-arranġament tar-rotta tagħha, jew il-merkanzija mibgħuta f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将货物送达并交给收货人的交付行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li twassal merkanzija u tagħtiha lill-persuna li għandha tirċeviha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A delivery is the act of taking goods to the person who is meant to receive them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将货物发出，使其开始运往目的地的发运行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tibgħat merkanzija minn fejn tkun sabiex tibda l-vjaġġ lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dispatching is the process of sending goods out so that they begin their journey to a destination.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为货物确定运输路径并安排其沿该路径运送。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għażla u l-arranġament tar-rotta li minnha għandha tgħaddi l-merkanzija biex tasal fid-destinazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Routing is the arrangement of the path that goods will follow to reach their destination.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为一个货运批次一起发送或运输的一批货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità ta' merkanzija li tintbagħat jew tiġi ttrasportata flimkien bħala lott wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shipment is a quantity of goods sent together as a single consignment.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kkonfermat li l-konsenja tal-merkanzija se ssir nhar it-Tnejn fl-indirizz indikat mill-klijent.
formal.en: The company confirmed that delivery of the goods will take place on Monday at the address specified by the customer.
formal.zh: 公司确认，货物将于星期一送达客户指定的地址。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Taf meta tasal il-konsenja? Pawlu: Iva, għada filgħodu. Marija: Tajjeb, inkun id-dar biex nirċeviha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you know when the delivery will arrive? Pawlu: Yes, tomorrow morning. Marija: Good, I'll be home to receive it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你知道货什么时候送到吗？保罗：知道，明天上午。玛丽娅：好，我会在家收货。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf meta tasal il-konsenja?
messages.mt_standard: Taf meta tasal il-konsenja?
messages.zh: 你知道货什么时候送到吗？
messages.en: Do you know when the delivery will arrive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (配送员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 知道，明天上午。
messages.en: Yes, tomorrow morning.

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inkun id-dar biex nirċeviha.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inkun id-dar biex nirċeviha.
messages.zh: 好，我会在家收货。
messages.en: Good, I'll be home to receive it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一批货从仓库发出、安排路线、最后交到手中：konsenja 可表示这些运输环节，也可表示运送的那批货，具体看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delivery arrangement in which the seller delivers goods to an agreed destination without paying the import duty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 卖方将货物运至约定目的地，但不支付进口关税的交货安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' konsenja li fih il-bejjiegħ iwassal il-merkanzija fid-destinazzjoni miftiehma mingħajr ma jħallas id-dazju tal-importazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “未完税交货”的英文缩写，表示卖方交货时不支付进口关税的交货安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-abbrevjazzjoni Ingliża għal arranġament li fih il-bejjiegħ iwassal il-merkanzija fid-destinazzjoni miftiehma mingħajr ma jħallas id-dazju tal-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: DDU is an abbreviation for a delivery arrangement in which the seller delivers goods without paying the import duty.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未完税交货：货物运至约定目的地时，进口关税由买方承担。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li fih il-merkanzija titwassal fid-destinazzjoni miftiehma u x-xerrej ikun responsabbli għall-ħlas tad-dazju tal-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delivered duty unpaid describes an arrangement in which goods reach an agreed destination and the buyer pays the import duty.

collocations.mt: kundizzjonijiet ta' konsenja bid-dazju mhux imħallas
ftehim dwar konsenja bid-dazju mhux imħallas
collocations.zh: 关于未完税交货的协议

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jipprevedi konsenja bid-dazju mhux imħallas fid-destinazzjoni miftiehma u jispeċifika li x-xerrej għandu jħallas id-dazju tal-importazzjoni.
formal.en: The contract provides for delivery duty unpaid to the agreed destination and specifies that the buyer must pay the import duty.
formal.zh: 合同约定按未完税交货方式将货物送至约定目的地，并明确进口关税由买方支付。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'tfisser konsenja bid-dazju mhux imħallas? Rita: Il-bejjiegħ iwassal il-merkanzija fil-post miftiehem, imma int tħallas id-dazju tal-importazzjoni. Mark: Mela rrid inqis dak il-ħlas ukoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does delivery duty unpaid mean? Rita: The seller delivers the goods to the agreed place, but you pay the import duty. Mark: Then I need to allow for that payment too.
colloquial.zh: 马克：未完税交货是什么意思？丽塔：卖方把货送到约定地点，但进口关税由你支付。马克：那我也得把这笔费用算进去。

messages.speaker: Mark (买方)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser konsenja bid-dazju mhux imħallas?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser konsenja bid-dazju mhux imħallas?
messages.zh: 未完税交货是什么意思？
messages.en: What does delivery duty unpaid mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (物流顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ iwassal il-merkanzija fil-post miftiehem, imma int tħallas id-dazju tal-importazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ iwassal il-merkanzija fil-post miftiehem, imma int tħallas id-dazju tal-importazzjoni.
messages.zh: 卖方把货送到约定地点，但进口关税由你支付。
messages.en: The seller delivers the goods to the agreed place, but you pay the import duty.

messages.speaker: Mark (买方)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid inqis dak il-ħlas ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid inqis dak il-ħlas ukoll.
messages.zh: 那我也得把这笔费用算进去。
messages.en: Then I need to allow for that payment too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语记成“交货＋关税尚未支付”：看到 mhux imħallas 就提醒自己，交货安排中还有进口关税需要由买方支付。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delivery arrangement in which goods are brought to an agreed place at a frontier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将货物运至边境约定地点进行交付的交货安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' konsenja li fih il-merkanzija titwassal f'post miftiehem fil-fruntiera biex tiġi kkonsenjata hemmhekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “边境交货”的英文缩写，表示在边境约定地点交付货物的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-abbrevjazzjoni Ingliża għal arranġament ta' konsenja li fih il-merkanzija titwassal u tiġi kkonsenjata f'post miftiehem fil-fruntiera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: DAF is an abbreviation for a delivery arrangement in which goods are delivered at an agreed frontier location.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 边境交货：以边境的约定地点作为货物交付地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li jistabbilixxi post miftiehem fil-fruntiera bħala l-post fejn għandha tiġi kkonsenjata l-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delivered at frontier describes an arrangement in which an agreed place at a border serves as the delivery point.

collocations.en: agreed location for delivery at frontier

formal.mt: Il-ftehim dwar il-konsenja sal-fruntiera għandu jindika b'mod ċar il-post eżatt fejn se tiġi kkonsenjata l-merkanzija.
formal.en: The agreement on delivery at frontier should clearly identify the exact location where the goods will be delivered.
formal.zh: 边境交货协议应明确注明货物交付的具体地点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tfisser konsenja sal-fruntiera? David: Tfisser li l-merkanzija titwassal fil-post miftiehem fil-fruntiera. Sara: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw liema post hemm miktub fil-ftehim.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does delivery at frontier mean? David: It means the goods are brought to the agreed place at the border. Sara: Then let's check which place is written in the agreement.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：边境交货是什么意思？戴维：意思是货物会送到边境的约定地点。萨拉：那我们看看协议里写的是哪个地点。

messages.speaker: Sara (买方)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser konsenja sal-fruntiera?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser konsenja sal-fruntiera?
messages.zh: 边境交货是什么意思？
messages.en: What does delivery at frontier mean?

messages.speaker: David (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-merkanzija titwassal fil-post miftiehem fil-fruntiera.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-merkanzija titwassal fil-post miftiehem fil-fruntiera.
messages.zh: 意思是货物会送到边境的约定地点。
messages.en: It means the goods are brought to the agreed place at the border.

messages.speaker: Sara (买方)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw liema post hemm miktub fil-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw liema post hemm miktub fil-ftehim.
messages.zh: 那我们看看协议里写的是哪个地点。
messages.en: Then let's check which place is written in the agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条边境线，把交货点标在线上的约定位置：konsenja sal-fruntiera 的记忆重点就是“货送到边境约定地点”。

exact_key: konsenja żgħira ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali
gloss_zh: 非商业性质的小批寄送货物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small consignment sent for personal or other non-commercial purposes rather than for sale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为个人用途或其他非商业目的寄送，而非用于销售的一小批货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konsenja żgħira mibgħuta għal użu personali jew għal skop ieħor mhux kummerċjali, u mhux għall-bejgħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: small consignment of a non-commercial character
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不以销售或其他商业活动为目的的小批寄送货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konsenja ta' ammont żgħir ta' oġġetti li ma tintbagħatx għall-bejgħ jew għal attività kummerċjali oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small consignment of a non-commercial character contains a limited quantity of goods sent for purposes other than trade.

collocations.mt: jibgħat konsenja żgħira ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali
collocations.en: send a small consignment of a non-commercial character
collocations.zh: 寄送一小批非商业性质的货物

collocations.mt: jiddikjara konsenja żgħira ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali
collocations.en: declare a small consignment of a non-commercial character
collocations.zh: 申报一小批非商业性质的货物

formal.mt: Id-dikjarazzjoni tiddeskrivi l-pakkett bħala konsenja żgħira ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali li fiha rigali għal membru tal-familja.
formal.en: The declaration describes the parcel as a small consignment of a non-commercial character containing gifts for a family member.
formal.zh: 申报单将该包裹描述为非商业性质的小批寄送货物，内装送给一位家庭成员的礼物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser fuq il-formola 'konsenja żgħira ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali'? Mark: Jiġifieri ftit oġġetti li jintbagħtu għal skop mhux kummerċjali, bħal rigali għall-familja.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'small consignment of a non-commercial character' mean on the form? Mark: It means a few items sent for a non-commercial purpose, such as gifts for family.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：表格上的“非商业性质的小批寄送货物”是什么意思？马克：就是为非商业目的寄送的少量物品，比如送给家人的礼物。

messages.speaker: Nina (寄件人)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser fuq il-formola 'konsenja żgħira ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser fuq il-formola 'konsenja żgħira ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali'?
messages.zh: 表格上的“非商业性质的小批寄送货物”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'small consignment of a non-commercial character' mean on the form?

messages.speaker: Mark (邮局职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri ftit oġġetti li jintbagħtu għal skop mhux kummerċjali, bħal rigali għall-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri ftit oġġetti li jintbagħtu għal skop mhux kummerċjali, bħal rigali għall-familja.
messages.zh: 就是为非商业目的寄送的少量物品，比如送给家人的礼物。
messages.en: It means a few items sent for a non-commercial purpose, such as gifts for family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三段记忆这个长短语：konsenja 是寄送的一批货，żgħira 表示小，ta' karattru mhux kummerċjali 表示具有非商业性质；脑中想象一小包寄给家人的礼物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation officially authorised to receive goods under the relevant customs arrangements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获得正式授权，可依照有关海关安排接收货物的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li għandha awtorizzazzjoni uffiċjali biex tirċievi merkanzija skont l-arranġamenti doganali rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经正式授权，能够按照有关海关安排接收货物的收货人，可为个人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni maħtura biex tirċievi merkanzija u li għandha l-awtorizzazzjoni uffiċjali meħtieġa skont l-arranġamenti doganali rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An authorised consignee is a person or organisation officially permitted to receive goods under the relevant customs arrangements.

collocations.zh: 作为经授权收货人的许可

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija għandha tivverifika li l-awtorizzazzjoni tagħha bħala konsenjatarju awtorizzat tkopri l-operazzjoni ppjanata.
formal.en: The company should verify that its authorisation as an authorised consignee covers the planned operation.
formal.zh: 公司应核实，其经授权收货人许可是否涵盖计划开展的业务。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jirċievi l-merkanzija? Joseph: Il-kumpanija tagħna, bħala konsenjatarju awtorizzat. Anna: Tajjeb, ejja niċċekkjaw id-dettalji tal-awtorizzazzjoni qabel tasal.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will receive the goods? Joseph: Our company, as an authorised consignee. Anna: Good, let's check the authorisation details before they arrive.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来接收这批货？约瑟夫：我们公司，以经授权收货人的身份接收。安娜：好，我们在货到之前核对一下授权详情。

messages.speaker: Anna (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jirċievi l-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jirċievi l-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 谁来接收这批货？
messages.en: Who will receive the goods?

messages.speaker: Joseph (收货公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tagħna, bħala konsenjatarju awtorizzat.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tagħna, bħala konsenjatarju awtorizzat.
messages.zh: 我们公司，以经授权收货人的身份接收。
messages.en: Our company, as an authorised consignee.

messages.speaker: Anna (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ejja niċċekkjaw id-dettalji tal-awtorizzazzjoni qabel tasal.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ejja niċċekkjaw id-dettalji tal-awtorizzazzjoni qabel tasal.
messages.zh: 好，我们在货到之前核对一下授权详情。
messages.en: Good, let's check the authorisation details before they arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收货人手里拿着正式授权书：前半部分记“收货人”，awtorizzat 记“已获授权”，两部分合起来就是经授权的收货人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or business authorised to dispatch goods under specified customs procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获准按照特定海关程序发运货物的个人或企业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li għandu awtorizzazzjoni biex jibgħat merkanzija skont proċeduri doganali speċifiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获海关授权、可按规定程序发运货物的发货人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju awtorizzat mid-dwana biex jibgħat merkanzija skont il-proċeduri stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An authorised consignor is a person or business permitted by customs authorities to dispatch goods under specified procedures.

collocations.zh: 申请获授权发货人资格

collocations.en: the obligations of an authorised consignor

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tapplika għall-istatus ta' konsenjatur awtorizzat u qed tħejji d-dokumenti meħtieġa.
formal.en: The company is applying for authorised consignor status and is preparing the required documents.
formal.zh: 该公司正在申请获授权发货人资格，并准备所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-kumpanija għandha l-istatus ta' konsenjatur awtorizzat? Pawlu: Iva, imma rridu niċċekkjaw liema proċeduri tkopri l-awtorizzazzjoni tagħha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does this company have authorised consignor status? Pawlu: Yes, but we need to check which procedures its authorisation covers.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这家公司具有获授权发货人资格吗？保罗：有，但我们得核实它的授权涵盖哪些程序。

messages.speaker: Marta (物流职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kumpanija għandha l-istatus ta' konsenjatur awtorizzat?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kumpanija għandha l-istatus ta' konsenjatur awtorizzat?
messages.zh: 这家公司具有获授权发货人资格吗？
messages.en: Does this company have authorised consignor status?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu niċċekkjaw liema proċeduri tkopri l-awtorizzazzjoni tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu niċċekkjaw liema proċeduri tkopri l-awtorizzazzjoni tagħha.
messages.zh: 有，但我们得核实它的授权涵盖哪些程序。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to check which procedures its authorisation covers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成“拿着授权文件的发货人”：konsenjatur 对应发货人，awtorizzat 提醒你其资格已经获得授权。

gloss_zh: 保存的；保存完好的；经保藏的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kept in good condition or treated so that it does not decay or spoil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被妥善保存而保持良好状态的，或经过处理以防腐坏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżmum f'kundizzjoni tajba jew ittrattat biex ma jitħassarx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到保存、保持原有状态的；经处理而不易腐坏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li nżamm fi stat tajjeb jew li ġie ttrattat biex ikun protett mit-taħsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is preserved has been kept in good condition or treated to prevent it from spoiling.

formal.mt: Il-manuskritt huwa konservat tajjeb, u l-kitba tiegħu għadha tinqara b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The manuscript is well preserved, and its writing can still be read clearly.
formal.zh: 这份手稿保存完好，上面的字迹至今仍清晰可读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ktieb antik għadu konservat tajjeb! Toni: Iva, żammejtu f'post niexef u 'l bogħod mix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Lara: This old book is still well preserved! Toni: Yes, I kept it in a dry place away from sunlight.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本旧书还保存得这么好！托尼：是啊，我一直把它放在干燥、避光的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb antik għadu konservat tajjeb!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb antik għadu konservat tajjeb!
messages.zh: 这本旧书还保存得这么好！
messages.en: This old book is still well preserved!

messages.speaker: Toni (藏书者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żammejtu f'post niexef u 'l bogħod mix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żammejtu f'post niexef u 'l bogħod mix-xemx.
messages.zh: 是啊，我一直把它放在干燥、避光的地方。
messages.en: Yes, I kept it in a dry place away from sunlight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“旧手稿仍清晰可读”的画面记 konservat；再把 konservat tajjeb 整体读成“保存得好”，将词义与物品的保存状态联系起来。

gloss_zh: 保守的；倾向维持传统的；谨慎的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Preferring established customs or methods and showing caution about change or risk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向遵循既有习俗或方法，对改变或风险持谨慎态度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jippreferi drawwiet jew metodi stabbiliti u joqgħod attent meta jkun hemm bidla jew riskju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向维护传统、对变革持保留态度的；在判断或行动上谨慎的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jżomm ma' ideat, drawwiet jew metodi tradizzjonali, jew li jagħżel li jaġixxi b'kawtela.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something conservative favours established ways or takes a cautious approach to change and risk.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda approċċ konservattiv għall-bidla, b'passi żgħar u valutazzjoni wara kull stadju.
formal.en: The report recommends a conservative approach to change, with small steps and an assessment after each stage.
formal.zh: 报告建议以谨慎的方式推进变革，采取小步骤，并在每个阶段结束后进行评估。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex trid iżżomm il-metodu l-antik? David: Għandi approċċ konservattiv; nippreferi nippruvaw il-metodu l-ġdid fuq skala żgħira l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you want to keep the old method? David: I have a conservative approach; I would rather we tried the new method on a small scale first.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么想保留旧方法？戴维：我的做法比较谨慎；我更希望我们先小范围试用新方法。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid iżżomm il-metodu l-antik?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid iżżomm il-metodu l-antik?
messages.zh: 你为什么想保留旧方法？
messages.en: Why do you want to keep the old method?

messages.speaker: David (项目主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi approċċ konservattiv; nippreferi nippruvaw il-metodu l-ġdid fuq skala żgħira l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi approċċ konservattiv; nippreferi nippruvaw il-metodu l-ġdid fuq skala żgħira l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我的做法比较谨慎；我更希望我们先小范围试用新方法。
messages.en: I have a conservative approach; I would rather we tried the new method on a small scale first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konservattiv 配上“先沿用旧方法，再小范围尝试”的人物画面，记住保守或谨慎的态度；同时与表示物品保存状态的 konservat 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 一致性；稳定一致的程度

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of remaining similar or following the same principles across different occasions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在不同时间或情形下保持相同标准、特征或表现的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li xi ħaġa tibqa' simili jew issegwi l-istess prinċipji f'okkażjonijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物在不同时间、场合或部分之间保持相同标准或相近表现的一致性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li l-imġiba, il-ħidma jew il-karatteristiċi ta' xi ħaġa jibqgħu simili minn darba għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consistency is the quality of behaving or performing in a similar way on different occasions.

formal.mt: Il-konsistenza fir-riżultati turi li l-metodu jagħti prestazzjoni stabbli minn prova għal oħra.
formal.en: The consistency in the results shows that the method performs reliably from one trial to another.
formal.zh: 结果的一致性表明，这种方法在各次试验中的表现都很稳定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tiċċekkja kull rapport bl-istess mod? Lara: Biex inżomm il-konsistenza u ma nħalli xejn barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you check every report in the same way? Lara: To maintain consistency and avoid leaving anything out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么用同样的方法检查每份报告？拉拉：为了保持一致，也避免漏掉任何内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tiċċekkja kull rapport bl-istess mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tiċċekkja kull rapport bl-istess mod?
messages.zh: 你为什么用同样的方法检查每份报告？
messages.en: Why do you check every report in the same way?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inżomm il-konsistenza u ma nħalli xejn barra.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inżomm il-konsistenza u ma nħalli xejn barra.
messages.zh: 为了保持一致，也避免漏掉任何内容。
messages.en: To maintain consistency and avoid leaving anything out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把每次检查都使用同一张清单的画面与 konsistenza 联系起来：每次标准相同，就是“一致性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official who represents a country in a foreign city and assists its citizens there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外国城市代表本国，并为当地本国公民提供协助的官员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li jirrappreżenta lil pajjiżu f'belt barranija u jgħin liċ-ċittadini ta' pajjiżu hemmhekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由一国派驻外国城市，代表本国并处理本国公民有关事务的领事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċjal mibgħut minn pajjiż biex jirrappreżentah f'belt barranija u jieħu ħsieb affarijiet li jolqtu liċ-ċittadini tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consul is an official who represents their country abroad and helps its citizens with relevant affairs.

formal.mt: Il-konslu laqa' liċ-ċittadini u spjegalhom kif setgħu jiksbu l-għajnuna meħtieġa.
formal.en: The consul received the citizens and explained how they could obtain the assistance they needed.
formal.zh: 领事接待了这些公民，并向他们说明如何获得所需的协助。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ma' min għandek il-laqgħa llum? Rita: Mal-konslu. Se nitkellmu dwar l-attività għall-komunità Maltija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who are you meeting today? Rita: The consul. We are going to discuss the event for the Maltese community.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你今天要和谁见面？丽塔：领事。我们要讨论为马耳他社群举办的活动。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min għandek il-laqgħa llum?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min għandek il-laqgħa llum?
messages.zh: 你今天要和谁见面？
messages.en: Who are you meeting today?

messages.speaker: Rita (社群活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-konslu. Se nitkellmu dwar l-attività għall-komunità Maltija.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-konslu. Se nitkellmu dwar l-attività għall-komunità Maltija.
messages.zh: 领事。我们要讨论为马耳他社群举办的活动。
messages.en: The consul. We are going to discuss the event for the Maltese community.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象身在国外时与领事会面的场景，把 konslu 和“代表本国、协助公民的领事”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speech sounds produced with a partial or complete obstruction of the airflow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发音时气流受到部分或完全阻碍的语音，即辅音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsejjes tad-diskors li jiġu prodotti meta l-fluss tal-arja jiġi mfixkel parzjalment jew għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辅音的复数，指发音时气流受到部分或完全阻碍的一类语音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħsejjes tad-diskors li waqt il-produzzjoni tagħhom il-fluss tal-arja jiġi mfixkel parzjalment jew għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consonants are speech sounds made by partly or completely obstructing the flow of air.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个辅音，即发音时气流受到部分或完全阻碍的语音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħoss tad-diskors li jiġi prodott meta l-fluss tal-arja jiġi mfixkel parzjalment jew għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consonant is a speech sound produced with some obstruction to the flow of air.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jiddistingwu bejn il-vokali u l-konsonanti u jagħtu eżempji ta' kull tip.
formal.en: In the exercise, students should distinguish between vowels and consonants and give examples of each type.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应区分元音和辅音，并分别举例。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm hemm konsonanti fil-kelma 'kelb'? Pawlu: Hemm tlieta: k, l u b.
colloquial.en: Nina: How many consonants are there in the word 'kelb'? Pawlu: There are three: k, l and b.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：kelb 这个词里有几个辅音？保罗：有三个：k、l 和 b。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hemm konsonanti fil-kelma 'kelb'?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hemm konsonanti fil-kelma 'kelb'?
messages.zh: kelb 这个词里有几个辅音？
messages.en: How many consonants are there in the word 'kelb'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tlieta: k, l u b.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tlieta: k, l u b.
messages.zh: 有三个：k、l 和 b。
messages.en: There are three: k, l and b.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 kelb 做记忆练习：圈出元音 e，再读出 k、l、b 这三个辅音，把它们与 konsonanti 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having difficulty passing stools or passing them less often than usual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于排便困难或排便次数比平时减少的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi stat fejn persuna ssibha diffiċli tipporga jew tipporga inqas ta' spiss mis-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便秘的；排便困难或排便次数较平时减少的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta persuna tkun konstipata, issibha diffiċli tipporga jew tipporga inqas ta' spiss milli tagħmel is-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is constipated, they have difficulty passing stools or do so less often than usual.

collocations.en: he has been constipated for three days

formal.mt: Waqt il-konsultazzjoni, ir-raġel qal lit-tabib li kien ilu konstipat għal tlett ijiem.
formal.en: During the consultation, the man told the doctor that he had been constipated for three days.
formal.zh: 在问诊时，这名男子告诉医生，他已经便秘三天了。

colloquial.mt: David: Illum ma tantx inħossni tajjeb; inħossni konstipat. Mark: Trid tazza ilma? David: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: David: I don't feel very well today; I feel constipated. Mark: Would you like a glass of water? David: Yes, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：我今天不太舒服，感觉便秘了。马克：你要一杯水吗？戴维：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum ma tantx inħossni tajjeb; inħossni konstipat.
messages.mt_standard: Illum ma tantx inħossni tajjeb; inħossni konstipat.
messages.zh: 我今天不太舒服，感觉便秘了。
messages.en: I don't feel very well today; I feel constipated.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tazza ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tazza ilma?
messages.zh: 你要一杯水吗？
messages.en: Would you like a glass of water?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konstipat 放进整句 inħossni konstipat，记作“我感觉便秘了”；通过身体状态的完整表达来记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meeting or process in which advice, information, or opinions are sought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向专业人士寻求建议，或向有关人员征求信息、意见的会谈或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqgħa jew proċess li fih jintalbu pariri, informazzjoni jew opinjonijiet mingħand persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为获得建议、信息或意见而进行的咨询、会谈或征询过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konsultazzjoni hija laqgħa jew proċess li fih persuna titlob parir jew jinġabru l-opinjonijiet ta' persuni oħra dwar suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consultation is a meeting or process in which someone seeks advice, information, or other people's views.

formal.mt: Wara l-konsultazzjoni, it-tabib spjega lill-pazjent liema trattament kien adattat għalih.
formal.en: After the consultation, the doctor explained to the patient which treatment was suitable for him.
formal.zh: 咨询结束后，医生向患者解释了哪种治疗适合他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għamilt appuntament għal konsultazzjoni mat-tabib? Pawlu: Iva, se mmur għada biex niddiskuti r-riżultati.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you made an appointment for a consultation with the doctor? Pawlu: Yes, I'm going tomorrow to discuss the results.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你预约好向医生咨询了吗？保罗：预约好了，我明天去讨论检查结果。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt appuntament għal konsultazzjoni mat-tabib?
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt appuntament għal konsultazzjoni mat-tabib?
messages.zh: 你预约好向医生咨询了吗？
messages.en: Have you made an appointment for a consultation with the doctor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se mmur għada biex niddiskuti r-riżultati.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se mmur għada biex niddiskuti r-riżultati.
messages.zh: 预约好了，我明天去讨论检查结果。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going tomorrow to discuss the results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“先向别人咨询，再作决定”的情景记忆：找医生问建议、向公众征求意见，都可以用它。

gloss_zh: 初步市场咨询；市场前期意见征询

teaching_sense.en_definition: Consultations held at an early stage to gather information about the goods or services available in a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在前期阶段开展的市场咨询活动，用于了解市场上可提供的商品或服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konsultazzjonijiet li jsiru fi stadju bikri biex tinġabar informazzjoni dwar l-oġġetti jew is-servizzi disponibbli fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在作出相关决定前，为了解市场供应情况而开展的初步咨询。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-konsultazzjonijiet preliminari tas-suq huma konsultazzjonijiet li jsiru fil-bidu biex jinġabru tagħrif u opinjonijiet dwar dak li jistgħu joffru l-fornituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Preliminary market consultation is an early process of seeking information from suppliers to understand what the market can offer.

collocations.en: to carry out preliminary market consultations
to take part in preliminary market consultations
the results of the preliminary market consultations

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni wettqet konsultazzjonijiet preliminari tas-suq biex tifhem aħjar liema servizzi kienu disponibbli.
formal.en: The organisation carried out preliminary market consultations to gain a better understanding of which services were available.
formal.zh: 该组织开展了初步市场咨询，以更好地了解市场上有哪些服务可供选择。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex se nagħmlu konsultazzjonijiet preliminari tas-suq? Mark: Biex nifhmu x'joffru l-fornituri qabel nagħżlu s-servizz.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we going to hold preliminary market consultations? Mark: To understand what suppliers offer before we choose the service.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们为什么要开展初步市场咨询？马克：为了在选择服务之前，了解供应商能提供什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se nagħmlu konsultazzjonijiet preliminari tas-suq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se nagħmlu konsultazzjonijiet preliminari tas-suq?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要开展初步市场咨询？
messages.en: Why are we going to hold preliminary market consultations?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nifhmu x'joffru l-fornituri qabel nagħżlu s-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nifhmu x'joffru l-fornituri qabel nagħżlu s-servizz.
messages.zh: 为了在选择服务之前，了解供应商能提供什么。
messages.en: To understand what suppliers offer before we choose the service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分成三块记：“咨询活动＋初步的＋市场的”。想象先向市场问一圈，再决定选择哪种服务；原词组用的是复数形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of goods or resources, or the eating and drinking of food and beverages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商品或资源的使用、消耗，也指食物和饮料的食用或摄入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-konsum huwa l-użu ta' prodotti jew riżorsi, jew it-teħid ta' ikel u xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对商品、能源等资源的消费或消耗，或对食物、饮料的摄入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-konsum huwa l-użu ta' oġġetti jew riżorsi, jew it-teħid ta' ikel u xorb, u jista' jirreferi wkoll għall-kwantità użata jew meħuda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumption is the use of goods or resources, or the amount of food and drink that people take in.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-konsum tal-elettriku fil-bini naqas matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: The report shows that electricity consumption in the building decreased over the past year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，该建筑在过去一年中的用电量有所下降。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed titfi d-dwal kollha? Ben: Biex innaqqsu l-konsum tal-elettriku u nħallsu inqas.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you turning off all the lights? Ben: To reduce our electricity consumption and pay less.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把灯都关掉？本：为了减少用电量，少付点电费。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titfi d-dwal kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titfi d-dwal kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么把灯都关掉？
messages.en: Why are you turning off all the lights?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex innaqqsu l-konsum tal-elettriku u nħallsu inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Biex innaqqsu l-konsum tal-elettriku u nħallsu inqas.
messages.zh: 为了减少用电量，少付点电费。
messages.en: To reduce our electricity consumption and pay less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“电表、水表、糖摄入”三个画面记忆：电和水是消耗，糖是摄入，核心都是用了多少或吃喝了多少。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods and services used up or transformed during production, excluding fixed assets used over a longer period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产过程中被消耗或转化的商品与服务，不包括长期用于生产的固定资产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prodotti u s-servizzi li jiġu kkunsmati jew mibdula waqt il-produzzjoni, mingħajr ma jinkludu assi fissi użati għal żmien itwal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中间消耗；生产过程中被消耗或转化的商品与服务，不包括固定资产本身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prodotti u s-servizzi li jintużaw u jiġu kkunsmati jew mibdula fil-proċess tal-produzzjoni, iżda mhux l-assi fissi nfushom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intermediate consumption consists of goods and services that are used up or transformed in producing other goods and services.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-forn, id-dqiq u l-elettriku użati biex isir il-ħobż ġew inklużi fil-konsum intermedju.
formal.en: In the bakery's report, the flour and electricity used to make bread were included in intermediate consumption.
formal.zh: 面包店的报告将制作面包所用的面粉和电力计入中间消耗。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Id-dqiq li nużaw għall-ħobż jgħodd bħala konsum intermedju? Ġorġ: Iva, għax jintuża fil-produzzjoni; il-ħobż li nixtri biex niekol id-dar huwa għall-konsum finali.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does the flour we use for bread count as intermediate consumption? Ġorġ: Yes, because it is used in production; the bread I buy to eat at home is for final consumption.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们做面包用的面粉算中间消耗吗？Ġorġ：算，因为它用于生产；我买回家吃的面包则用于最终消费。

messages.speaker: Marta (面包店学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dqiq li nużaw għall-ħobż jgħodd bħala konsum intermedju?
messages.mt_standard: Id-dqiq li nużaw għall-ħobż jgħodd bħala konsum intermedju?
messages.zh: 我们做面包用的面粉算中间消耗吗？
messages.en: Does the flour we use for bread count as intermediate consumption?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax jintuża fil-produzzjoni; il-ħobż li nixtri biex niekol id-dar huwa għall-konsum finali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax jintuża fil-produzzjoni; il-ħobż li nixtri biex niekol id-dar huwa għall-konsum finali.
messages.zh: 算，因为它用于生产；我买回家吃的面包则用于最终消费。
messages.en: Yes, because it is used in production; the bread I buy to eat at home is for final consumption.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面粉进入烤炉变成面包：生产途中被用掉或转化的投入，就是中间消耗；买回家吃的面包帮助你对照最终消费。

gloss_zh: 协作消费；协作经济；共享经济

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement in which people share, lend, rent, or exchange goods and services to make use of resources together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们通过共享、出借、租用或交换商品与服务，共同利用资源的消费方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' konsum li fih in-nies jaqsmu, jisilfu, jikru jew ipartu prodotti u servizzi biex jużaw ir-riżorsi flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协作消费；通过共享、借用、租用或交换商品与服务来满足需求的消费方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod ta' konsum li fih in-nies jissodisfaw il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom billi jaqsmu, jissellfu, jikru jew ipartu prodotti u servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Collaborative consumption occurs when people obtain or use goods and services through sharing, borrowing, renting, or exchanging them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协作经济；个人或组织通过合作，共同提供、交换或使用商品、服务与资源的经济活动体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' attivitajiet ekonomiċi li fiha persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet jikkooperaw biex jipprovdu, jiskambjaw jew jużaw prodotti, servizzi u riżorsi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A collaborative economy is a system in which people or organizations cooperate to provide, exchange, or use goods, services, and resources.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共享经济；通过安排他人临时使用现有物品、空间或其他资源而开展经济活动的模式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mudell ta' attività ekonomika li fih in-nies jagħtu lil oħrajn aċċess temporanju għal oġġetti, spazji jew riżorsi oħra li diġà għandhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sharing economy enables people to give others temporary access to existing goods, spaces, or other resources, sometimes in return for payment.

formal.mt: Il-kunsill nieda inizjattiva ta' konsum kollaborattiv li tippermetti lir-residenti jissellfu għodod għal żmien qasir minflok jixtru waħda kull wieħed.
formal.en: The council launched a collaborative consumption initiative that allows residents to borrow tools for short periods instead of each buying their own.
formal.zh: 地方议会推出了一项协作消费计划，让居民可以短期借用工具，免去每人各买一件的需要。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi bżonn sellum għal siegħa biss. Fejn nista' nsib wieħed? David: Tista' tissellef tiegħi. Il-grupp tagħna jħeġġeġ il-konsum kollaborattiv billi jgħin lill-ġirien jaqsmu l-għodod.
colloquial.en: Nina: I need a ladder for just an hour. Where can I find one? David: You can borrow mine. Our group encourages collaborative consumption by helping neighbors share tools.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我只需要用一个小时的梯子，哪里能找到？David：你可以借我的。我们的小组帮助邻居共享工具，鼓励协作消费。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn sellum għal siegħa biss. Fejn nista' nsib wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn sellum għal siegħa biss. Fejn nista' nsib wieħed?
messages.zh: 我只需要用一个小时的梯子，哪里能找到？
messages.en: I need a ladder for just an hour. Where can I find one?

messages.speaker: David (邻里小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tissellef tiegħi. Il-grupp tagħna jħeġġeġ il-konsum kollaborattiv billi jgħin lill-ġirien jaqsmu l-għodod.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tissellef tiegħi. Il-grupp tagħna jħeġġeġ il-konsum kollaborattiv billi jgħin lill-ġirien jaqsmu l-għodod.
messages.zh: 你可以借我的。我们的小组帮助邻居共享工具，鼓励协作消费。
messages.en: You can borrow mine. Our group encourages collaborative consumption by helping neighbors share tools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条街的邻居轮流借用同一架梯子：从一次借用记住协作消费，再扩大到组织合作的协作经济与临时使用资源的共享经济。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who buys or uses goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购买或使用商品、服务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konsumatur huwa persuna li tixtri jew tuża prodotti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购买或使用商品、服务的消费者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konsumatur huwa persuna li tixtri prodotti jew servizzi jew li tużahom biex tissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer is someone who buys or uses goods or services to meet their needs.

collocations.zh: 了解相关信息的消费者

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jagħti lill-konsumatur informazzjoni ċara dwar il-prezz u l-karatteristiċi tal-prodott.
formal.en: The leaflet gives the consumer clear information about the product's price and features.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册向消费者清楚地介绍了产品的价格和特点。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tqabbel il-prezzijiet ta' dawn il-prodotti? David: Bħala konsumatur, irrid inkun naf liema wieħed jaqbilli l-aktar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you comparing the prices of these products? David: As a consumer, I want to know which one offers me the best value.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在比较这些产品的价格？戴维：作为消费者，我想知道哪一个最划算。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tqabbel il-prezzijiet ta' dawn il-prodotti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tqabbel il-prezzijiet ta' dawn il-prodotti?
messages.zh: 你为什么在比较这些产品的价格？
messages.en: Why are you comparing the prices of these products?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala konsumatur, irrid inkun naf liema wieħed jaqbilli l-aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Bħala konsumatur, irrid inkun naf liema wieħed jaqbilli l-aktar.
messages.zh: 作为消费者，我想知道哪一个最划算。
messages.en: As a consumer, I want to know which one offers me the best value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konsum 和 konsumatur 配对记：前者是“消费、消耗”这件事，后者是购买或使用商品服务的“消费者”；想象一个正在比价的人。

gloss_zh: 消费者（依所给义项 consumer）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the supplied sense, a person or organization that buys or uses goods and services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按所给的 consumer 义项，指购买或使用商品及服务的个人或组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fis-sens mogħti, persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tixtri jew tuża prodotti u servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者；购买或使用商品及服务的个人或组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tixtri jew tuża prodotti u servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer is a person or organization that buys or uses goods and services.

collocations.en: the explanation of 'konsumeriżmu' in the glossary

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'konsumeriżmu' jingħata bit-tifsira Ingliża 'consumer', jiġifieri persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tixtri jew tuża prodotti u servizzi.
formal.en: In this list, 'konsumeriżmu' is assigned the English meaning 'consumer', referring to a person or organization that buys or uses goods and services.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“konsumeriżmu”被赋予英语 consumer 这一义项，指购买或使用商品及服务的个人或组织。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tifsira tagħti din il-lista lil 'konsumeriżmu'? Pawlu: Tagħti 'consumer': persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tixtri jew tuża prodotti u servizzi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What meaning does this list give for 'konsumeriżmu'? Pawlu: It gives 'consumer': a person or organization that buys or uses goods and services.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份词表给“konsumeriżmu”列的是什么义项？Pawlu：列的是 consumer，也就是购买或使用商品及服务的个人或组织。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tifsira tagħti din il-lista lil 'konsumeriżmu'?
messages.mt_standard: X'tifsira tagħti din il-lista lil 'konsumeriżmu'?
messages.zh: 这份词表给“konsumeriżmu”列的是什么义项？
messages.en: What meaning does this list give for 'konsumeriżmu'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tagħti 'consumer': persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tixtri jew tuża prodotti u servizzi.
messages.mt_standard: Tagħti 'consumer': persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tixtri jew tuża prodotti u servizzi.
messages.zh: 列的是 consumer，也就是购买或使用商品及服务的个人或组织。
messages.en: It gives 'consumer': a person or organization that buys or uses goods and services.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本包按 consumer 义项学习：想象买东西、用服务的消费者；把这个给定义项单独记在词卡上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A player account is an account that identifies a player and gives access to a game or gaming service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于识别玩家身份并让玩家使用游戏或游戏服务的账户。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kont li jidentifika lil ġugatur u jippermettilu juża logħba jew servizz tal-logħob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩家用于登录游戏或游戏服务，并保存相关个人资料的账户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kont personali li ġugatur juża biex jidħol f'logħba jew f'servizz tal-logħob u li jista' jżomm id-dettalji tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A player account allows a person to access a game and may store their profile and progress.

collocations.en: to log into a player account
the password for a player account

formal.mt: Biex tipparteċipa fit-turnew online, trid toħloq kont ta' ġugatur u tikkonferma l-indirizz tal-email tiegħek.
formal.en: To participate in the online tournament, you must create a player account and confirm your email address.
formal.zh: 要参加线上锦标赛，你必须创建玩家账户并确认你的电子邮箱地址。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi bżonn kont ta' ġugatur biex nilgħab miegħek? Ben: Iva, oħloq wieħed u mbagħad ibgħatli l-isem li tuża fil-logħba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do I need a player account to play with you? Ben: Yes, create one and then send me the name you use in the game.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我需要玩家账户才能和你一起玩吗？Ben：对，创建一个，然后把你在游戏里用的名字发给我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn kont ta' ġugatur biex nilgħab miegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn kont ta' ġugatur biex nilgħab miegħek?
messages.zh: 我需要玩家账户才能和你一起玩吗？
messages.en: Do I need a player account to play with you?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oħloq wieħed u mbagħad ibgħatli l-isem li tuża fil-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oħloq wieħed u mbagħad ibgħatli l-isem li tuża fil-logħba.
messages.zh: 对，创建一个，然后把你在游戏里用的名字发给我。
messages.en: Yes, create one and then send me the name you use in the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“登录游戏、显示玩家资料”的画面绑定：kont ta' ġugatur 是玩家账户，记住的是账户而不是游戏本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An email account is an account with an email service that lets you send, receive, and manage electronic messages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在电子邮件服务中开设、用于发送、接收和管理电子邮件的账户。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kont ma' servizz tal-email li jippermettilek tibgħat, tirċievi u timmaniġġja messaġġi elettroniċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于登录电子邮件服务、收发邮件并管理邮箱内容的账户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kont li tuża biex tidħol f'servizz tal-email, tibgħat u tirċievi messaġġi, u żżommhom organizzati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An email account gives you access to a service through which you send, receive, and manage electronic messages.

collocations.en: to log into an email account
to change the password for an email account
collocations.zh: 更改电子邮箱账户的密码

formal.mt: Kull student jingħata kont tal-email biex jirċievi avviżi uffiċjali mill-università.
formal.en: Each student is given an email account to receive official notices from the university.
formal.zh: 每位学生都会获得一个电子邮箱账户，用于接收大学的正式通知。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Daħalt fil-kont tal-email tiegħek illum? Pawlu: Għadni le. Qed nistenna xi messaġġ? Anna: Iva, bgħattlek ir-ritratti tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you logged into your email account today? Pawlu: Not yet. Am I expecting a message? Anna: Yes, I sent you yesterday's photos.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你今天登录过电子邮箱账户吗？Pawlu：还没有。有人给我发消息了吗？Anna：有啊，我把昨天的照片发给你了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħalt fil-kont tal-email tiegħek illum?
messages.mt_standard: Daħalt fil-kont tal-email tiegħek illum?
messages.zh: 你今天登录过电子邮箱账户吗？
messages.en: Have you logged into your email account today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Qed nistenna xi messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Qed nistenna xi messaġġ?
messages.zh: 还没有。有人给我发消息了吗？
messages.en: Not yet. Am I expecting a message?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bgħattlek ir-ritratti tal-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bgħattlek ir-ritratti tal-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 有啊，我把昨天的照片发给你了。
messages.en: Yes, I sent you yesterday's photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 kont tal-email，就想象输入密码后进入收件箱：它指可登录、可收发邮件的账户，不是单独一封邮件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of accounting in which each transaction affects at least two accounts and total debits equal total credits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每笔交易涉及至少两个账户，且借方合计与贷方合计相等的会计核算制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' kontabilità li fiha kull tranżazzjoni taffettwa mill-inqas żewġ kontijiet u t-total tad-debiti jkun daqs it-total tal-krediti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复式会计；以每笔交易的借贷双方金额相等为基础，在至少两个账户中反映其影响的会计制度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' kontabilità li tirreġistra l-effett ta' kull tranżazzjoni f'mill-inqas żewġ kontijiet, b'total ta' debiti ugwali għat-total ta' krediti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Double entry accounting is a system in which every transaction affects at least two accounts, with equal total debits and credits.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复式记账；将每笔交易的借方与贷方影响记入至少两个账户，并保持借贷合计相等的记账方法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Metodu ta' żamma tal-kotba li bih kull tranżazzjoni tiddaħħal f'mill-inqas żewġ kontijiet, b'ammonti totali ugwali fuq in-naħa tad-debitu u fuq in-naħa tal-kreditu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Double entry bookkeeping means recording each transaction in at least two accounts so that total debits and total credits are equal.

collocations.en: the principles of double entry accounting

formal.mt: Skont il-kontabilità tal-kontraentrati, meta l-kumpanija tixtri tagħmir u tħallas mill-kont bankarju tagħha, tirreġistra debitu fil-kont tat-tagħmir u kreditu tal-istess ammont fil-kont tal-bank.
formal.en: Under double entry accounting, when the company buys equipment and pays from its bank account, it records a debit in the equipment account and an equal credit in the bank account.
formal.zh: 按照复式会计，公司从银行账户付款购买设备时，在设备账户记入借方，同时在银行存款账户记入等额贷方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xtrajna tagħmir għal mitejn ewro u ħallasna mill-bank. Kif inniżżilha? Mark: Bil-kontabilità tal-kontraentrati, niżżel debitu ta' mitejn ewro fil-kont tat-tagħmir u kreditu ta' mitejn ewro fil-kont tal-bank.
colloquial.en: Sara: We bought equipment for two hundred euros and paid through the bank. How do I record it? Mark: Using double entry bookkeeping, record a two-hundred-euro debit in the equipment account and a two-hundred-euro credit in the bank account.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们买了两百欧元的设备，从银行付款，这笔怎么记？Mark：用复式记账，在设备账户借记两百欧元，在银行存款账户贷记两百欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (记账员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtrajna tagħmir għal mitejn ewro u ħallasna mill-bank. Kif inniżżilha?
messages.mt_standard: Xtrajna tagħmir għal mitejn ewro u ħallasna mill-bank. Kif inniżżilha?
messages.zh: 我们买了两百欧元的设备，从银行付款，这笔怎么记？
messages.en: We bought equipment for two hundred euros and paid through the bank. How do I record it?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-kontabilità tal-kontraentrati, niżżel debitu ta' mitejn ewro fil-kont tat-tagħmir u kreditu ta' mitejn ewro fil-kont tal-bank.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-kontabilità tal-kontraentrati, niżżel debitu ta' mitejn ewro fil-kont tat-tagħmir u kreditu ta' mitejn ewro fil-kont tal-bank.
messages.zh: 用复式记账，在设备账户借记两百欧元，在银行存款账户贷记两百欧元。
