messages.en: Using double entry bookkeeping, record a two-hundred-euro debit in the equipment account and a two-hundred-euro credit in the bank account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一笔交易想成平衡天平：借方总额与贷方总额必须一样重；记住至少涉及两个账户，而不是把同一条记录简单抄写两遍。

gloss_zh: 有传染性的；具有感染力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to spread from one person to another, especially through infection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够从一个人传播给另一个人的，通常指疾病；也可形容容易感染他人的情绪或表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra, speċjalment meta jkun mard; jista' jingħad ukoll għal daħk jew emozzjoni li tqanqal l-istess reazzjoni f'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有传染性的，指疾病能够在人与人之间传播；也可比喻笑声或情绪容易感染他人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi mard li jista' jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra, jew daħk u emozzjonijiet li jqanqlu reazzjoni simili f'persuni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is contagious can spread between people, either as an infection or as a shared feeling or reaction.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-mard kontaġġuż jista' jinfirex f'komunità.
formal.en: The report describes how contagious disease can spread within a community.
formal.zh: 报告描述了传染性疾病如何在社区内传播。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tidħaq ukoll? Mark: Għax id-daħk tiegħek kontaġġuż!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you laughing too? Mark: Because your laughter is contagious!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么也笑起来了？马克：因为你的笑声太有感染力了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tidħaq ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tidħaq ukoll?
messages.zh: 你怎么也笑起来了？
messages.en: Why are you laughing too?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax id-daħk tiegħek kontaġġuż!
messages.mt_standard: Għax id-daħk tiegħek kontaġġuż!
messages.zh: 因为你的笑声太有感染力了！
messages.en: Because your laughter is contagious!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontaġġuż 和“一人笑，大家跟着笑”的画面联结：疾病可以传染，笑声也可以有感染力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belonging to the present time or to the same period as someone or something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于当代的，或与某个人、事物处于同一时代的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għaż-żmien tal-lum, jew li jeżisti jew kien jeżisti fl-istess żmien bħal persuna jew ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当代的，指属于现今时代的；同时代的，指与另一人或事物处于同一时期的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa taż-żmien preżenti, jew persuna jew ħaġa li tappartjeni għall-istess perjodu bħal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is contemporary belongs to the present time or to the same historical period as another.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif kittieb kontemporanju jittratta t-tema tal-identità fir-rumanzi tiegħu.
formal.en: The study examines how a contemporary writer addresses the theme of identity in his novels.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察一位当代作家如何在其小说中探讨身份认同这一主题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb ta' kittieb kontemporanju? Mark: Iva, u għadu kemm ħareġ rumanz ġdid tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this book by a contemporary writer? Mark: Yes, and a new novel of his has just come out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书是当代作家写的吗？马克：是的，而且他刚出版了一部新小说。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb ta' kittieb kontemporanju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb ta' kittieb kontemporanju?
messages.zh: 这本书是当代作家写的吗？
messages.en: Is this book by a contemporary writer?

messages.speaker: Mark (书店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għadu kemm ħareġ rumanz ġdid tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għadu kemm ħareġ rumanz ġdid tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，而且他刚出版了一部新小说。
messages.en: Yes, and a new novel of his has just come out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kontemporanju 配一条时间轴：落在今天就是“当代的”，与另一人并排落在同一时期就是“同时代的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container holding a quantity of a product intended for one dose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装有供一次给药或一次剂量使用的产品量的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li fih kwantità ta' prodott maħsuba biex tintuża bħala doża waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单剂量容器，即所装内容物的量供一个剂量使用的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenitur li jżomm kwantità ta' prodott għal doża waħda, aktar milli għal diversi dożi separati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single-dose container holds an amount of a product intended to provide one dose.

collocations.en: a label on a single-dose container
the contents of a single-dose container
collocations.zh: 单剂量容器内的内容物

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-kontenitur b'doża waħda u jagħti informazzjoni dwar il-prodott li fih.
formal.en: The document describes the single-dose container and provides information about the product inside it.
formal.zh: 该文件介绍了这一单剂量容器，并提供了有关其所装产品的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan kontenitur b'doża waħda? Mark: Iva, fih kwantità għal doża waħda biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a single-dose container? Mark: Yes, it contains enough for just one dose.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是单剂量容器吗？马克：是的，里面的量只供一个剂量使用。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan kontenitur b'doża waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Dan kontenitur b'doża waħda?
messages.zh: 这是单剂量容器吗？
messages.en: Is this a single-dose container?

messages.speaker: Mark (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih kwantità għal doża waħda biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih kwantità għal doża waħda biss.
messages.zh: 是的，里面的量只供一个剂量使用。
messages.en: Yes, it contains enough for just one dose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语逐块记忆：kontenitur 是容器，b'doża waħda 表示带有一个剂量；想象容器标签上醒目的数字一。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A closed container that holds gas or another substance under high pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内部以高压储存气体或其他物质的密闭容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent magħluq li fih jinżamm gass jew sustanza oħra taħt pressjoni għolja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加压容器，指内部物质在压力下储存的密闭容器；本词组明确表示压力较高。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenitur magħluq li jżomm il-kontenut tiegħu taħt pressjoni għolja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pressurised container is a sealed vessel whose contents are kept under pressure.

collocations.mt: tikketta ta' twissija fuq kontenitur b'pressjoni għolja
collocations.en: a warning label on a high-pressure container
collocations.zh: 高压容器上的警告标签

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-ispezzjoni jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjoni tal-kontenitur b'pressjoni għolja u t-tikketti mwaħħla miegħu.
formal.en: The inspection report describes the condition of the high-pressure container and the labels attached to it.
formal.zh: 检查报告描述了该高压容器的状况及其所贴标签。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm tikketta ta' twissija fuq dan? Mark: Għax dan kontenitur b'pressjoni għolja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a warning label on this? Mark: Because this is a high-pressure container.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个上面为什么有警告标签？马克：因为这是一个高压容器。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tikketta ta' twissija fuq dan?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tikketta ta' twissija fuq dan?
messages.zh: 这个上面为什么有警告标签？
messages.en: Why is there a warning label on this?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan kontenitur b'pressjoni għolja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan kontenitur b'pressjoni għolja.
messages.zh: 因为这是一个高压容器。
messages.en: Because this is a high-pressure container.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontenitur 想成容器，把 pressjoni għolja 联结到压力表的高读数：合起来记作内部承受高压的容器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container designed to hold liquid and dispense it in drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛装液体并将液体逐滴滴出的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur maħsub biex iżomm likwidu u jippermetti li dan joħroġ qatra qatra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够将所盛液体逐滴滴出的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenitur li jżomm likwidu u għandu mezz biex iqattar ammonti żgħar minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dropper container holds a liquid and allows you to dispense it one drop at a time.

formal.mt: Għall-attività, uża kontenitur għat-taqtir biex iżżid il-kulur mal-ilma qatra qatra.
formal.en: For the activity, use a dropper container to add the colouring to the water one drop at a time.
formal.zh: 进行这项活动时，使用滴液容器将色素逐滴加入水中。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-kontenitur għat-taqtir? Pawlu: Ħdejn it-tazza. Trid iżżid il-kulur? Marija: Iva, irrid inżid żewġ qatriet biss.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the dropper container? Pawlu: Next to the glass. Do you want to add the colouring? Marija: Yes, I only want to add two drops.
colloquial.zh: Marija：滴液容器在哪里？Pawlu：在玻璃杯旁边。你要加色素吗？Marija：对，我只想加两滴。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-kontenitur għat-taqtir?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-kontenitur għat-taqtir?
messages.zh: 滴液容器在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the dropper container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn it-tazza. Trid iżżid il-kulur?
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn it-tazza. Trid iżżid il-kulur?
messages.zh: 在玻璃杯旁边。你要加色素吗？
messages.en: Next to the glass. Do you want to add the colouring?

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid inżid żewġ qatriet biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid inżid żewġ qatriet biss.
messages.zh: 对，我只想加两滴。
messages.en: Yes, I only want to add two drops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一幅小瓶逐滴滴出色素的画面，重点记住“一滴一滴控制用量”的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to hold or store tablets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放或保存药片的容器，例如药瓶或药片盒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur li jintuża biex jinżammu jew jinħażnu l-pilloli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于盛装药片的盒子、瓶子或其他容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kaxxa, flixkun jew reċipjent ieħor li fih jinżammu l-pilloli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tablet container is a box, bottle, or other receptacle in which tablets are kept.

collocations.en: a tablet container with a lid

formal.mt: L-isem tal-prodott u d-data ta' skadenza għandhom ikunu jidhru b'mod ċar fuq il-kontenitur tal-pilloli.
formal.en: The product name and expiry date should be clearly visible on the tablet container.
formal.zh: 药片容器上的产品名称和有效期应当清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt il-kontenitur tal-pilloli tiegħi? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża tiegħek. Rita: Grazzi, se npoġġih fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you seen my tablet container? Mark: Yes, it is on the table, next to your bag. Rita: Thanks, I will put it in my bag.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你见到我的药片盒了吗？Mark：见到了，在桌上，就在你的包旁边。Rita：谢谢，我把它放进包里。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-kontenitur tal-pilloli tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-kontenitur tal-pilloli tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你见到我的药片盒了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my tablet container?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża tiegħek.
messages.zh: 见到了，在桌上，就在你的包旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it is on the table, next to your bag.

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, se npoġġih fil-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, se npoġġih fil-borża.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我把它放进包里。
messages.en: Thanks, I will put it in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把药片盒放进包里的动作，将整个短语与“盛放药片的小容器”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The information, ideas, or material contained in a text, programme, or other work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文章、节目或其他作品中包含的信息、思想或材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-informazzjoni, l-ideat jew il-materjal li jkun hemm f'test, fi programm jew f'xogħol ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文本、节目等所包含或表达的信息、思想及其他内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li jkun fih jew jesprimi test, programm jew xogħol ieħor, bħall-informazzjoni u l-ideat tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The content of a text or programme is the information and ideas that it contains.

formal.mt: Il-kontenut tar-rapport huwa maqsum fi tliet taqsimiet, u kull taqsima tindirizza tema differenti.
formal.en: The content of the report is divided into three sections, and each section addresses a different topic.
formal.zh: 报告内容分为三个部分，每个部分讨论一个不同的主题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok il-filmat? Luqa: Iva, il-kontenut kien interessanti, imma kien twil wisq. Sara: Naqbel, speċjalment l-aħħar parti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the video? Luqa: Yes, the content was interesting, but it was too long. Sara: I agree, especially the last part.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你喜欢那个视频吗？Luqa：喜欢，内容很有意思，不过太长了。Sara：我同意，尤其是最后一部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbok il-filmat?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbok il-filmat?
messages.zh: 你喜欢那个视频吗？
messages.en: Did you like the video?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kontenut kien interessanti, imma kien twil wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kontenut kien interessanti, imma kien twil wisq.
messages.zh: 喜欢，内容很有意思，不过太长了。
messages.en: Yes, the content was interesting, but it was too long.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel, speċjalment l-aħħar parti.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel, speċjalment l-aħħar parti.
messages.zh: 我同意，尤其是最后一部分。
messages.en: I agree, especially the last part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到一本书或一段视频时，问自己“里面讲了什么”，再用 kontenut 指向其中的信息和思想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Amounts owed to a business by customers that have not yet been paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 客户尚未向企业支付、企业有待收取的款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammonti li l-klijenti għandhom jagħtu lil negozju u li għadhom ma tħallsux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业因已向客户提供商品或服务而有权收取、但尚未收到的账款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammonti dovuti lil negozju minn klijenti għal oġġetti jew servizzi li diġà ngħataw iżda li għadhom ma tħallsux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A business's accounts receivable are the amounts that customers still owe it for goods or services already supplied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业或机构有权向他方收取、目前尚未收到的各项款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somom ta' flus li negozju jew organizzazzjoni għandu dritt jirċievi mingħand ħaddieħor iżda li għadu ma rċeviex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Receivables are sums of money that a business or organization is entitled to collect but has not yet received.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-kontijiet pagabbli jelenka l-ammonti li għad iridu jitħallsu mill-klijenti u d-data meta kull ħlas ikun dovut.
formal.en: The accounts receivable report lists the amounts still to be paid by customers and the date when each payment is due.
formal.zh: 应收账款报告列明客户尚需支付的金额，以及每笔付款的到期日。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħejjejt ir-rapport dwar il-kontijiet pagabbli? David: Iva, imma għadni rrid inneħħi l-ammont li ħallas il-klijent dalgħodu. Nina: Sewwa, imbagħad inkunu nafu kemm għad irridu nirċievu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you prepared the report on receivables? David: Yes, but I still need to deduct the amount the customer paid this morning. Nina: Good, then we will know how much we still have to receive.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你准备好应收款项报告了吗？David：准备好了，不过我还要扣除客户今天早上已经支付的金额。Nina：好，这样我们就知道还有多少钱待收了。

messages.speaker: Nina (财务主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħejjejt ir-rapport dwar il-kontijiet pagabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Ħejjejt ir-rapport dwar il-kontijiet pagabbli?
messages.zh: 你准备好应收款项报告了吗？
messages.en: Have you prepared the report on receivables?

messages.speaker: David (财务助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni rrid inneħħi l-ammont li ħallas il-klijent dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni rrid inneħħi l-ammont li ħallas il-klijent dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 准备好了，不过我还要扣除客户今天早上已经支付的金额。
messages.en: Yes, but I still need to deduct the amount the customer paid this morning.

messages.speaker: Nina (财务主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, imbagħad inkunu nafu kemm għad irridu nirċievu.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, imbagħad inkunu nafu kemm għad irridu nirċievu.
messages.zh: 好，这样我们就知道还有多少钱待收了。
messages.en: Good, then we will know how much we still have to receive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定的应收义学习：想象客户尚未付款的清单，并用“客户付款后，待收余额减少”的情景巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The main accounts used to organize or present financial information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于组织或呈现财务信息的主要账户或账目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kontijiet ewlenin li jintużaw biex tiġi organizzata jew ippreżentata l-informazzjoni finanzjarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在一套账目或财务记录中占主要地位的账户。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kontijiet li għandhom rwol ewlieni f'sett ta' rekords finanzjarji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The main accounts are the principal accounts within a set of financial records.

collocations.en: the balances of the main accounts

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju jippreżenta l-bilanċi tal-kontijiet prinċipali fl-aħħar tas-sena.
formal.en: The financial report presents the balances of the main accounts at the end of the year.
formal.zh: 财务报告列示了年末主要账户的余额。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema kontijiet se niċċekkjaw l-ewwel? Pawlu: Nibdew bil-kontijiet prinċipali u mbagħad naraw il-bqija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which accounts shall we check first? Pawlu: Let's start with the main accounts and then look at the rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们先检查哪些账户？保罗：先从主要账户开始，再看其余的。

messages.speaker: Marija (财务助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kontijiet se niċċekkjaw l-ewwel?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kontijiet se niċċekkjaw l-ewwel?
messages.zh: 我们先检查哪些账户？
messages.en: Which accounts shall we check first?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew bil-kontijiet prinċipali u mbagħad naraw il-bqija.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew bil-kontijiet prinċipali u mbagħad naraw il-bqija.
messages.zh: 先从主要账户开始，再看其余的。
messages.en: Let's start with the main accounts and then look at the rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词记成账本里标上星号的几项：kontijiet 对应账户，prinċipali 提醒你这些是主要的账户。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Amounts owed to a business, especially by customers who have not yet paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业有权收取但尚未收到的款项，尤其指客户尚未支付的货款或服务费。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammonti li negozju għandu dritt jirċievi iżda li għadhom ma tħallsux, speċjalment minn klijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应收账款，指企业因已提供商品或服务而应向客户收取、但尚未收到的款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammonti dovuti minn klijenti lil negozju għal oġġetti jew servizzi li diġà ġew ipprovduti iżda li għadhom ma tħallsux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Accounts receivable are amounts customers owe a business for goods or services already supplied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应收款项，指企业或个人有权向他人收取但尚未收到的金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammonti dovuti lil persuna jew lil negozju minn oħrajn li għadhom ma ġewx riċevuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Receivables are amounts of money owed to a person or business that have yet to be received.

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tax-xahar, il-kontijiet riċevibbli ammontaw għal għaxart elef ewro għal servizzi li kienu diġà ġew ipprovduti lill-klijenti.
formal.en: At the end of the month, accounts receivable amounted to ten thousand euros for services already provided to customers.
formal.zh: 月末，因已向客户提供服务而产生的应收账款共计一万欧元。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn il-flus diġà daħlu fil-bank? Mark: Le, għadhom fil-kontijiet riċevibbli għax il-klijenti għadhom ma ħallsux.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has this money already reached the bank account? Mark: No, it is still in accounts receivable because the customers have not paid yet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这笔钱已经到账了吗？马克：没有，还记在应收账款里，因为客户尚未付款。

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-flus diġà daħlu fil-bank?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-flus diġà daħlu fil-bank?
messages.zh: 这笔钱已经到账了吗？
messages.en: Has this money already reached the bank account?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadhom fil-kontijiet riċevibbli għax il-klijenti għadhom ma ħallsux.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadhom fil-kontijiet riċevibbli għax il-klijenti għadhom ma ħallsux.
messages.zh: 没有，还记在应收账款里，因为客户尚未付款。
messages.en: No, it is still in accounts receivable because the customers have not paid yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张已经交货却尚未收钱的发票，把整组词贴在上面：应当收到、目前未收，就是应收款项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the Earth's major geographical divisions, consisting of a very large land area and associated islands.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地球上主要的地理分区之一，由大面积陆地及其相关岛屿构成，如非洲或欧洲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mid-diviżjonijiet ġeografiċi ewlenin tad-Dinja, magħmula minn medda kbira ta' art u l-gżejjer assoċjati magħha, bħall-Afrika jew l-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洲，大陆级别的主要地理区域，如非洲、亚洲或欧洲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reġjun ġeografiku ewlieni tad-Dinja li jinkludi medda kbira ta' art, bħall-Afrika, l-Asja jew l-Ewropa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A continent is one of the major geographical divisions of the Earth's land surface.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel il-klima ta' diversi reġjuni fil-kontinent Afrikan.
formal.en: The study compares the climates of several regions on the African continent.
formal.zh: 该研究比较了非洲大陆上多个地区的气候。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fuq liema kontinent jinsab il-Kenja? David: Fl-Afrika; ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Anna: On which continent is Kenya? David: In Africa; let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：肯尼亚在哪个洲？戴维：在非洲，我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq liema kontinent jinsab il-Kenja?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq liema kontinent jinsab il-Kenja?
messages.zh: 肯尼亚在哪个洲？
messages.en: On which continent is Kenya?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika; ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika; ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲，我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: In Africa; let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontinent 和英语 continent 并排写在世界地图旁，借相近拼写记住洲，并用非洲大陆作具体画面。

gloss_zh: 连续不断地；反复不断地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without stopping, or repeatedly over a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示动作或状态持续而不中断，也可表示某事在一段时间内反复发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jibqa' għaddej mingħajr waqfien, jew li jerġa' jseħħ ta' spiss matul perjodu ta' żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连续地，不间断地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li jibqa' għaddej mingħajr waqfien jew interruzzjoni matul il-perjodu msemmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens continuously, it carries on throughout a period without stopping.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不断地，反复地，表示某事在一段时间内频繁发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li jerġa' jseħħ ħafna drabi matul perjodu ta' żmien, għalkemm jista' jkun hemm waqfiet bejn darba u oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens continually, it happens repeatedly over time, often with short intervals between occurrences.

collocations.zh: 连续不停地运转或工作

formal.mt: Il-pompa ħadmet kontinwament għal sitt sigħat mingħajr ma waqfet.
formal.en: The pump operated continuously for six hours without stopping.
formal.zh: 水泵连续运转了六个小时，没有停机。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-telefon tiegħek qed idoqq kontinwament? Ġanni: Il-grupp qed jibgħat messaġġ wara ieħor; se nitfi l-ħoss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does your phone keep ringing? Ġanni: The group is sending one message after another; I'll turn the sound off.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的手机怎么一直响个不停？Ġanni：群里一条接一条地发消息；我这就把声音关掉。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-telefon tiegħek qed idoqq kontinwament?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-telefon tiegħek qed idoqq kontinwament?
messages.zh: 你的手机怎么一直响个不停？
messages.en: Why does your phone keep ringing?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp qed jibgħat messaġġ wara ieħor; se nitfi l-ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp qed jibgħat messaġġ wara ieħor; se nitfi l-ħoss.
messages.zh: 群里一条接一条地发消息；我这就把声音关掉。
messages.en: The group is sending one message after another; I'll turn the sound off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记忆：水泵不停转是一条连续线，手机反复响是一串密集点；这个副词可表达这两种持续感。

gloss_zh: 可能发生的意外情况；不测事件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A possible future event or situation, especially an unexpected one that may require preparation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未来可能发生但尚不确定的事件或情况，尤其指需要预先准备应对的意外情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni li tista' sseħħ fil-futur iżda mhix ċerta, speċjalment waħda mhux mistennija li teħtieġ tħejjija minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能发生但并不确定的情况，尤指需要提前制定应对措施的不测事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċirkostanza jew ġrajja possibbli iżda mhux ċerta li għaliha jista' jkun meħtieġ li wieħed iħejji miżuri minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contingency is a possible future event or situation that you prepare for because it may cause difficulties.

formal.mt: L-organizzaturi ħejjew pjan ta' kontinġenza biex l-attività tkun tista' ssir ġewwa jekk tagħmel ix-xita.
formal.en: The organizers prepared a contingency plan so that the event could take place indoors if it rained.
formal.zh: 组织者制定了应急预案，以便下雨时活动仍可在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: U jekk il-karozza ma tistartjax għada? Ġanni: Għandna pjan ta' kontinġenza: nieħdu t-taxi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What if the car won't start tomorrow? Ġanni: We have a contingency plan: we'll take a taxi.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：如果明天汽车发动不了怎么办？詹尼：我们有备用方案：坐出租车。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U jekk il-karozza ma tistartjax għada?
messages.mt_standard: U jekk il-karozza ma tistartjax għada?
messages.zh: 如果明天汽车发动不了怎么办？
messages.en: What if the car won't start tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna pjan ta' kontinġenza: nieħdu t-taxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna pjan ta' kontinġenza: nieħdu t-taxi.
messages.zh: 我们有备用方案：坐出租车。
messages.en: We have a contingency plan: we'll take a taxi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用万一下雨就转到室内的画面记忆：kontinġenza 是那个可能出现的万一，pjan ta' kontinġenza 是为它准备的应急方案。

gloss_zh: 常规范围内的或有情况

teaching_sense.en_definition: A possible event or circumstance that falls within the normal range considered in planning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规划时考虑到的、处于通常范围内的可能事件或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avveniment jew ċirkostanza possibbli li taqa' fil-firxa normali meqjusa waqt l-ippjanar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 属于通常预期或常规规划范围的或有情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċirkostanza possibbli li titqies bħala parti mill-firxa normali ta' sitwazzjonijiet li wieħed jippjana għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ordinary contingency is a possible circumstance that falls within the normal range allowed for in a plan.

collocations.zh: 为常规范围内的或有情况作规划
处理常规范围内的或有情况

formal.mt: Il-pjan iqis dewmien qasir fil-kunsinna bħala kontinġenza ordinarja u jipprovdi żmien addizzjonali biex ix-xogħol jitlesta.
formal.en: The plan treats a short delivery delay as an ordinary contingency and allows additional time for the work to be completed.
formal.zh: 该计划把交货短暂延迟视为常规范围内的或有情况，并预留额外时间完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jekk il-kunsinna tasal siegħa tard, x'nagħmlu? Mark: Dik kontinġenza ordinarja; diġà ħallejna siegħa żejda fil-pjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do we do if the delivery arrives an hour late? Mark: That's an ordinary contingency; we've already allowed an extra hour in the plan.
colloquial.zh: Maja：如果货晚到一小时，我们怎么办？Mark：那属于常规范围内的或有情况；我们已经在计划里多留了一小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk il-kunsinna tasal siegħa tard, x'nagħmlu?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk il-kunsinna tasal siegħa tard, x'nagħmlu?
messages.zh: 如果货晚到一小时，我们怎么办？
messages.en: What do we do if the delivery arrives an hour late?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik kontinġenza ordinarja; diġà ħallejna siegħa żejda fil-pjan.
messages.mt_standard: Dik kontinġenza ordinarja; diġà ħallejna siegħa żejda fil-pjan.
messages.zh: 那属于常规范围内的或有情况；我们已经在计划里多留了一小时。
messages.en: That's an ordinary contingency; we've already allowed an extra hour in the plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成计划表里预留的普通备用格：情况可能发生，但仍在常规考虑范围之内。

gloss_zh: 超出常规范围的或有情况

teaching_sense.en_definition: A possible event or circumstance that falls outside the normal range considered in planning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超出规划中通常考虑范围的可能事件或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avveniment jew ċirkustanza possibbli li taqa' barra mill-firxa normali meqjusa waqt l-ippjanar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 超出既定常规考虑范围的或有情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċirkostanza possibbli li tmur lil hinn mill-firxa normali ta' sitwazzjonijiet li jkunu tqiesu fi pjan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An out-of-range contingency is a possible circumstance beyond the normal limits considered when a plan was prepared.

collocations.en: prepare a plan for an out-of-range contingency
collocations.zh: 为超出常规范围的或有情况制订计划
应对超出常规范围的或有情况的措施

formal.mt: Għall-finijiet ta' dan il-pjan, l-għeluq tal-bini kollu għal xahar jitqies bħala kontinġenza straordinarja, għax jaqbeż il-firxa ta' tfixkil prevista.
formal.en: For the purposes of this plan, closing the entire building for a month is treated as an out-of-range contingency because it exceeds the anticipated range of disruption.
formal.zh: 就本计划而言，整栋大楼关闭一个月被视为超出常规范围的或有情况，因为它超出了预先考虑的运行受扰范围。

colloquial.mt: Lara: U jekk il-bini kollu jingħalaq għal xahar? Pawlu: Dik tkun kontinġenza straordinarja; ikollna nfittxu post ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: And what if the whole building closes for a month? Pawlu: That would be an out-of-range contingency; we'd have to find another place.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那如果整栋楼关闭一个月呢？Pawlu：那就属于超出常规范围的或有情况；我们得另找地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: U jekk il-bini kollu jingħalaq għal xahar?
messages.mt_standard: U jekk il-bini kollu jingħalaq għal xahar?
messages.zh: 那如果整栋楼关闭一个月呢？
messages.en: And what if the whole building closes for a month?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (场地负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik tkun kontinġenza straordinarja; ikollna nfittxu post ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Dik tkun kontinġenza straordinarja; ikollna nfittxu post ieħor.
messages.zh: 那就属于超出常规范围的或有情况；我们得另找地方。
messages.en: That would be an out-of-range contingency; we'd have to find another place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象可能发生的情况越过了计划表的边框：重点是超出常规范围，不只是事情比较麻烦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An institution that stands between the parties to financial trades, becoming the buyer to each seller and the seller to each buyer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在金融交易双方之间介入，分别成为每个卖方的买方和每个买方的卖方的机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istituzzjoni li tidħol bejn il-partijiet fi tranżazzjonijiet finanzjarji u ssir ix-xerrej għal kull bejjiegħ u l-bejjiegħ għal kull xerrej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中央交易对手方，即在金融交易中介入双方之间，并对每一方充当交易对手的机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Istituzzjoni li ssir il-kontoparti taż-żewġ naħat ta' tranżazzjoni finanzjarja, billi tkun ix-xerrej għall-bejjiegħ u l-bejjiegħ għax-xerrej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A central counter party is an institution that interposes itself between trading parties and becomes the counterparty to each side.

collocations.zh: 通过中央交易对手方进行清算

collocations.en: the role of the central counterparty
collocations.zh: 中央交易对手方的作用

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kontoparti ċentrali tidħol bejn ix-xerrej u l-bejjiegħ u ssir il-kontoparti ta' kull wieħed minnhom.
formal.en: In this example, the central counterparty stands between the buyer and the seller and becomes the counterparty to each of them.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，中央交易对手方介入买卖双方之间，成为双方各自的交易对手。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tagħmel il-kontoparti ċentrali f'dan l-eżempju? Mark: Tidħol bejn iż-żewġ naħat: tixtri mingħand il-bejjiegħ u tbigħ lix-xerrej.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does the central counterparty do in this example? Mark: It stands between the two sides: it buys from the seller and sells to the buyer.
colloquial.zh: Nina：中央交易对手方在这个例子中做什么？Mark：它介入双方之间：向卖方买入，再向买方卖出。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tagħmel il-kontoparti ċentrali f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: X'tagħmel il-kontoparti ċentrali f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 中央交易对手方在这个例子中做什么？
messages.en: What does the central counterparty do in this example?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tidħol bejn iż-żewġ naħat: tixtri mingħand il-bejjiegħ u tbigħ lix-xerrej.
messages.mt_standard: Tidħol bejn iż-żewġ naħat: tixtri mingħand il-bejjiegħ u tbigħ lix-xerrej.
messages.zh: 它介入双方之间：向卖方买入，再向买方卖出。
messages.en: It stands between the two sides: it buys from the seller and sells to the buyer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出卖方、中央机构、买方三个位置：中间机构面对卖方是买方，面对买方是卖方，借此记住中央交易对手方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Contrary to the law or forbidden by it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与法律规定相抵触，或属于法律禁止的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jmur kontra dak li tgħid il-liġi jew li jkun ipprojbit minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 违法的，即违反法律规定或为法律所禁止的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx permess mil-liġi jew li jikser dak li tistabbilixxi l-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An action that is kontra l-liġi breaks the law or is forbidden by the law.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-azzjoni deskritta fid-dokument kienet kontra l-liġi.
formal.en: According to the report, the action described in the document was unlawful.
formal.zh: 根据报告，文件中描述的行为违反了法律。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser kontra l-liġi? Mark: Ifisser li l-liġi ma tippermettix dik il-ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does against the law mean? Mark: It means that the law does not allow that thing.
colloquial.zh: Nina：kontra l-liġi 是什么意思？Mark：意思是法律不允许那件事。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser kontra l-liġi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser kontra l-liġi?
messages.zh: kontra l-liġi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does against the law mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-liġi ma tippermettix dik il-ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-liġi ma tippermettix dik il-ħaġa.
messages.zh: 意思是法律不允许那件事。
messages.en: It means that the law does not allow that thing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象某个行为越过了写有“法律”的界线，把 kontra l-liġi 整体记成“违反法律”，并用“这是违法的”反复造句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musician who plays the double bass, or the double bass instrument itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指演奏低音提琴的乐手，也可指低音提琴这种发出低音的大型弦乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mużiċist li jdoqq il-kontrabaxx, jew l-istrument kbir tal-kordi li jagħmel ħsejjes baxxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低音提琴演奏者；或指低音提琴这一大型低音弦乐器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ddoqq il-kontrabaxx, jew l-istrument kbir tal-kordi li jintuża biex jindaqqu noti baxxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kontrabaxx is a musician who plays the double bass, or the large stringed instrument that the musician plays.

collocations.en: the strings of the double bass

formal.mt: Matul il-kunċert, il-mużiċist daqq il-kontrabaxx flimkien mal-bqija tal-orkestra.
formal.en: During the concert, the musician played the double bass with the rest of the orchestra.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，这位乐手与乐团其他成员一起演奏低音提琴。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dak l-istrument kbir x'inhu? Pawlu: Dak kontrabaxx. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
colloquial.en: Marta: What is that big instrument? Pawlu: That's a double bass. Would you like to hear how it sounds?
colloquial.zh: Marta：那个大乐器是什么？Pawlu：那是低音提琴。你想听听它的声音吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-istrument kbir x'inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-istrument kbir x'inhu?
messages.zh: 那个大乐器是什么？
messages.en: What is that big instrument?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (音乐老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kontrabaxx. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
messages.mt_standard: Dak kontrabaxx. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
messages.zh: 那是低音提琴。你想听听它的声音吗？
messages.en: That's a double bass. Would you like to hear how it sounds?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象乐团里有人站着演奏一把高大的低音提琴，把 kontrabaxx 同时连到乐器和演奏者这两个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mortar finish forming a surface layer in roof construction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 屋顶施工中用砂浆做成的表面收面层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff ta' tikħil li jintuża bħala finitura fuq il-wiċċ ta' bejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屋顶施工中的砂浆收面层，即铺设在屋顶表面的砂浆面层。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kisi ta' tikħil li jsir fuq il-wiċċ ta' bejt biex jagħtih finitura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kontrabejt is a layer of mortar applied to a roof to give its surface a finish.

collocations.en: a layer of roof mortar finish
repair of the roof mortar finish

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-bejt jindika li l-kontrabejt għandu bżonn tiswija f'diversi postijiet.
formal.en: The report on the roof indicates that the mortar finish needs repair in several places.
formal.zh: 关于屋顶的报告指出，砂浆面层有几处需要修补。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'qed isewwi fuq il-bejt? Ġużeppi: Il-kontrabejt. Hemm xi xquq fis-saff ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you repairing on the roof? Ġużeppi: The mortar finish. There are some cracks in the top layer.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你在修屋顶上的什么？Ġużeppi：砂浆面层。最上面那一层有些裂缝。

messages.speaker: Marija (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed isewwi fuq il-bejt?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed isewwi fuq il-bejt?
messages.zh: 你在修屋顶上的什么？
messages.en: What are you repairing on the roof?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kontrabejt. Hemm xi xquq fis-saff ta' fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kontrabejt. Hemm xi xquq fis-saff ta' fuq.
messages.zh: 砂浆面层。最上面那一层有些裂缝。
messages.en: The mortar finish. There are some cracks in the top layer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把屋顶想成一块需要抹平表面的板，看到工人铺抹砂浆时，就联想 kontrabejt 这个屋顶面层词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act that breaks a law or regulation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反法律或规章的行为，例如交通违章。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li jikser liġi jew regolament, bħal ksur tar-regoli tat-traffiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 违反法律、规章或规定的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni li tmur kontra liġi, regolament jew regola stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contravention is an action that breaks a law, regulation, or established rule.

formal.mt: Il-parkeġġ f'din iż-żona mingħajr permess jikkostitwixxi kontravenzjoni.
formal.en: Parking in this area without a permit constitutes a contravention.
formal.zh: 未经许可在此区域停车构成违规。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nipparkja hawn? Mark: Le, jekk tipparkja quddiem dan il-bieb tkun qed twettaq kontravenzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I park here? Mark: No, if you park in front of this door, you will be committing a violation.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我能在这里停车吗？马克：不能，在这扇门前停车属于违章。

messages.speaker: Lara (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nipparkja hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nipparkja hawn?
messages.zh: 我能在这里停车吗？
messages.en: Can I park here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jekk tipparkja quddiem dan il-bieb tkun qed twettaq kontravenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jekk tipparkja quddiem dan il-bieb tkun qed twettaq kontravenzjoni.
messages.zh: 不能，在这扇门前停车属于违章。
messages.en: No, if you park in front of this door, you will be committing a violation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontravenzjoni 和禁止停车标志一起记：越过规则界线，就发生了违规行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something used to prevent pregnancy, or referring to a substance or device used for that purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示具有避孕用途的，也可指用于防止怀孕的药物或器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jipprevjeni t-tqala, jew sustanza jew apparat li jintuża għal dan il-għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于避孕的；也可指用于防止怀孕的药物或器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għan li jipprevjeni t-tqala; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal sustanza jew apparat użat għal dan il-għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as contraceptive is intended to prevent pregnancy, and a contraceptive is a substance or device used for that purpose.

formal.mt: It-test jispjega t-tifsira ta' metodu kontraċettiv u jagħti eżempji ta' mezzi użati biex tiġi evitata t-tqala.
formal.en: The text explains the meaning of a contraceptive method and gives examples of means used to prevent pregnancy.
formal.zh: 这篇文章解释了避孕方法的含义，并列举了用于防止怀孕的手段。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser kontraċettiv f'din is-sentenza? Rita: Ifisser li jintuża biex jipprevjeni t-tqala.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does contraceptive mean in this sentence? Rita: It means that something is used to prevent pregnancy.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的 kontraċettiv 是什么意思？Rita：意思是某种东西用于防止怀孕。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser kontraċettiv f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser kontraċettiv f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的 kontraċettiv 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does contraceptive mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Rita (语言老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jintuża biex jipprevjeni t-tqala.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jintuża biex jipprevjeni t-tqala.
messages.zh: 意思是某种东西用于防止怀孕。
messages.en: It means that something is used to prevent pregnancy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontraċettiv 放进 metodu kontraċettiv 整组记忆，想象课本上写着“避孕方法”的标签，用用途帮助记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The power or process of directing, regulating, or checking something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支配、调节或检查人、事物或过程的能力或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-setgħa jew il-proċess li bih persuna tidderieġi, tirregola jew tiċċekkja xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对事物的控制、管理或监督检查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-setgħa li tmexxi jew tirregola xi ħaġa, jew il-ħidma li biha tiċċekkja li kollox ikun kif suppost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Control is the power or activity of directing something, regulating its operation, or checking that it meets requirements.

formal.mt: Il-fabbrika twettaq kontroll tal-kwalità qabel ma tibgħat il-prodotti lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The factory carries out quality control before sending the products to customers.
formal.zh: 工厂在向客户发货前进行质量检查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kollox sew fil-kċina? Pawlu: Iva, kollox taħt kontroll. L-ikel ikun lest dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is everything all right in the kitchen? Pawlu: Yes, everything is under control. The food will be ready soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：厨房里一切顺利吗？保罗：是的，一切都在掌控之中。饭菜很快就好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kollox sew fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: Kollox sew fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 厨房里一切顺利吗？
messages.en: Is everything all right in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox taħt kontroll. L-ikel ikun lest dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox taħt kontroll. L-ikel ikun lest dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 是的，一切都在掌控之中。饭菜很快就好。
messages.en: Yes, everything is under control. The food will be ready soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 kontroll：握住方向盘是控制，检查成品是质量管理；再连读 taħt kontroll，记住“一切在掌控中”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supervision or inspection of goods and baggage by customs authorities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海关对进出境货物、行李等实施的监管或检查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-superviżjoni jew l-ispezzjoni li tagħmel id-dwana fuq merkanzija u bagalji li jidħlu fil-pajjiż jew joħorġu minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由海关当局实施的监管或检查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Superviżjoni jew verifika mwettqa mill-awtoritajiet tad-dwana fuq oġġetti li jidħlu fil-pajjiż jew joħorġu minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Control by the customs authorities is the supervision or checking they carry out on goods entering or leaving a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对进出境货物、行李等的海关监管或查验。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih id-dwana tissorvelja jew tispezzjona merkanzija u bagalji biex tivverifika li jkunu konformi mar-regoli doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs control is the process of supervising or inspecting goods and baggage to check compliance with customs requirements.

collocations.zh: 处于海关监管之下的货物

formal.mt: Il-merkanzija se tibqa' fil-maħżen sakemm jitlesta l-kontroll doganali.
formal.en: The goods will remain in the warehouse until customs control is completed.
formal.zh: 货物将留在仓库内，直到海关检查完成。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex fetħulek il-bagalja? David: Kien hemm kontroll doganali, u l-uffiċjal ried jiċċekkja x'kien hemm ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did they open your suitcase? David: There was a customs inspection, and the officer wanted to check what was inside.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他们为什么打开了你的行李箱？戴维：当时在进行海关检查，工作人员想查看里面有什么。

messages.speaker: Anna (同行旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex fetħulek il-bagalja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex fetħulek il-bagalja?
messages.zh: 他们为什么打开了你的行李箱？
messages.en: Why did they open your suitcase?

messages.speaker: David (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm kontroll doganali, u l-uffiċjal ried jiċċekkja x'kien hemm ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm kontroll doganali, u l-uffiċjal ried jiċċekkja x'kien hemm ġewwa.
messages.zh: 当时在进行海关检查，工作人员想查看里面有什么。
messages.en: There was a customs inspection, and the officer wanted to check what was inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象入境时打开行李箱接受检查，把整个短语 kontroll doganali 与“海关查行李”的场景绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 会计控制；账务核查；审计

teaching_sense.en_definition: The checking or supervision of accounts and financial records to ensure their accuracy and reliability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为确保账目和财务记录准确、可靠而进行的会计控制或账务核查，也可指审计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-verifika jew is-superviżjoni tal-kontijiet u tar-rekords finanzjarji biex jiġi żgurat li jkunu preċiżi u affidabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过会计程序及核查措施，确保账目和财务记录准确、可靠的控制活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċeduri u verifiki fil-qasam tal-kontabilità li jgħinu biex il-kontijiet u r-rekords finanzjarji jinżammu preċiżi u affidabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Accounting control consists of procedures and checks used to keep accounts and financial records accurate and reliable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对账目及相关财务记录进行系统审查，以评估其准确性和可靠性的审计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami sistematiku tal-kontijiet u tar-rekords finanzjarji relatati biex jiġu vvalutati l-preċiżjoni u l-affidabbiltà tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An audit is a systematic examination of accounts and related financial records to assess their accuracy and reliability.

collocations.en: an audit of the company's accounts

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija introduċiet sistema ta' kontroll kontabilistiku biex tivverifika li kull pagament ikun irreġistrat b'mod korrett.
formal.en: The company introduced an accounting control system to verify that every payment is recorded correctly.
formal.zh: 公司引入了一套会计控制系统，以核实每笔付款均得到正确记录。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għandek bżonn dawn il-fatturi kollha? Joseph: Qed nagħmlu kontroll kontabilistiku u rridu nqabblu l-fatturi mal-ħlasijiet.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why do you need all these invoices? Joseph: We are carrying out an audit and need to compare the invoices with the payments.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么需要这些发票？约瑟夫：我们正在进行审计，需要把发票与付款逐一核对。

messages.speaker: Rita (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek bżonn dawn il-fatturi kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek bżonn dawn il-fatturi kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么需要这些发票？
messages.en: Why do you need all these invoices?

messages.speaker: Joseph (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmlu kontroll kontabilistiku u rridu nqabblu l-fatturi mal-ħlasijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmlu kontroll kontabilistiku u rridu nqabblu l-fatturi mal-ħlasijiet.
messages.zh: 我们正在进行审计，需要把发票与付款逐一核对。
messages.en: We are carrying out an audit and need to compare the invoices with the payments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontroll kontabilistiku 配上“发票、付款、账本逐项核对”的画面：日常制度对应会计控制，系统审查对应审计。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical examination carried out to assess a person's health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由医务人员进行、用来评估身体健康状况的检查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami li jagħmel professjonist mediku biex jevalwa l-istat tas-saħħa ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了解或评估健康状况而进行的体检。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami mediku li jsir biex jiġi vvalutat l-istat tas-saħħa ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A checkup is a medical examination in which a health professional assesses your general health.

collocations.en: an appointment for a medical checkup

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta attendiet għal kontroll mediku ta' rutina biex it-tabiba tevalwa l-istat tas-saħħa tagħha.
formal.en: The patient attended a routine medical checkup so that the doctor could assess her health.
formal.zh: 这位女患者接受了常规体检，以便医生评估她的健康状况。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex sejjer għand it-tabib għada? Pawlu: Għandi appuntament għal kontroll mediku ta' rutina.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you going to the doctor tomorrow? Pawlu: I have an appointment for a routine medical checkup.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你明天为什么要去看医生？Pawlu：我预约了一次常规体检。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjer għand it-tabib għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjer għand it-tabib għada?
messages.zh: 你明天为什么要去看医生？
messages.en: Why are you going to the doctor tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi appuntament għal kontroll mediku ta' rutina.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi appuntament għal kontroll mediku ta' rutina.
messages.zh: 我预约了一次常规体检。
messages.en: I have an appointment for a routine medical checkup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontroll mediku 配上医生量血压、检查身体的画面，整组记成“健康检查”；再用“预约体检”的情境帮助回忆。

gloss_zh: 放行后检查；发布后监管

teaching_sense.en_definition: Monitoring or verification carried out after something has been released.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某物获准放行或正式发布之后进行的检查、核验或监督。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verifika jew sorveljanza li ssir wara li xi ħaġa tkun ġiet rilaxxata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在放行或发布之后，为核查相关情况或要求的落实而进行的后续检查与监督。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontroll li jitwettaq wara r-rilaxx biex jiġu vverifikati l-kundizzjonijiet rilevanti jew il-konformità mar-rekwiżiti applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Post-release control is monitoring or checking that takes place after a release to verify relevant conditions or requirements.

collocations.mt: proċedura ta' kontroll ta' wara r-rilaxx
rapport dwar il-kontroll ta' wara r-rilaxx

formal.mt: Wara li l-merkanzija ġiet rilaxxata, sar kontroll ta' wara r-rilaxx biex tiġi vverifikata l-eżattezza tad-dokumenti.
formal.en: After the goods were released, a post-release control was carried out to verify the accuracy of the documents.
formal.zh: 货物放行后，进行了放行后检查，以核实文件的准确性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-merkanzija diġà ġiet rilaxxata; għaliex għadna qed niċċekkjaw id-dokumenti? David: Qed nagħmlu kontroll ta' wara r-rilaxx biex niżguraw li d-dettalji huma korretti.
colloquial.en: Lara: The goods have already been released; why are we still checking the documents? David: We are carrying out a post-release control to make sure the details are correct.
colloquial.zh: Lara：货物已经放行了，为什么我们还在检查文件？David：我们正在做放行后检查，确保各项信息准确。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-merkanzija diġà ġiet rilaxxata; għaliex għadna qed niċċekkjaw id-dokumenti?
messages.mt_standard: Il-merkanzija diġà ġiet rilaxxata; għaliex għadna qed niċċekkjaw id-dokumenti?
messages.zh: 货物已经放行了，为什么我们还在检查文件？
messages.en: The goods have already been released; why are we still checking the documents?

messages.speaker: David (资深同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmlu kontroll ta' wara r-rilaxx biex niżguraw li d-dettalji huma korretti.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmlu kontroll ta' wara r-rilaxx biex niżguraw li d-dettalji huma korretti.
messages.zh: 我们正在做放行后检查，确保各项信息准确。
messages.en: We are carrying out a post-release control to make sure the details are correct.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条时间线：先“放行”，后“检查”。把 wara 与“之后”联系起来，整组记住“放行后仍要核查”的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of measures to reduce risks or limit their possible consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采取措施降低风险，或限制风险可能造成的后果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' miżuri biex jitnaqqsu r-riskji jew jiġu limitati l-konsegwenzi possibbli tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过具体措施降低风险发生的可能性或减轻其后果的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jittieħdu miżuri biex titnaqqas il-probabbiltà li jseħħu avvenimenti ta' ħsara jew biex jiġu limitati l-effetti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Risk control involves taking practical measures to make harmful events less likely or reduce their effects.

formal.mt: Il-pjan għall-kontroll tar-riskji jinkludi taħriġ tal-ħaddiema u spezzjonijiet regolari tat-tagħmir.
formal.en: The risk control plan includes worker training and regular equipment inspections.
formal.zh: 风险控制计划包括员工培训和定期设备检查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex niċċekkjaw it-tagħmir qabel kull użu? Mark: Dan jagħmel parti mill-kontroll tar-riskji, biex innaqqsu ċ-ċans ta' inċident.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do we check the equipment before every use? Mark: This is part of risk control, to reduce the chance of an accident.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么每次使用前都要检查设备？Mark：这是风险控制的一部分，为了降低发生事故的可能性。

messages.speaker: Sara (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex niċċekkjaw it-tagħmir qabel kull użu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex niċċekkjaw it-tagħmir qabel kull użu?
messages.zh: 为什么每次使用前都要检查设备？
messages.en: Why do we check the equipment before every use?

messages.speaker: Mark (主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan jagħmel parti mill-kontroll tar-riskji, biex innaqqsu ċ-ċans ta' inċident.
messages.mt_standard: Dan jagħmel parti mill-kontroll tar-riskji, biex innaqqsu ċ-ċans ta' inċident.
messages.zh: 这是风险控制的一部分，为了降低发生事故的可能性。
messages.en: This is part of risk control, to reduce the chance of an accident.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontroll tar-riskji 想成使用设备前的安全检查：先找危险，再采取措施降低风险，用这个动作顺序记住“风险控制”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A controller that adjusts a system to bring its frequency back to a target value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过调节系统，使其频率恢复到目标值的控制器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontrollur li jaġġusta sistema biex il-frekwenza tagħha terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于调节系统运行，使偏离目标值的频率恢复到目标值的控制器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat jew funzjoni ta' kontroll li tirregola t-tħaddim ta' sistema biex treġġa' l-frekwenza tagħha lejn il-valur ta' referenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A frequency restoration controller adjusts a system's operation to bring its frequency back towards a specified reference value.

collocations.en: the settings of the frequency restoration controller
collocations.zh: 频率恢复控制器的设置

collocations.en: the response of the frequency restoration controller
collocations.zh: 频率恢复控制器的响应

formal.mt: Matul it-test, il-kontrollur tar-restawr tal-frekwenza aġġusta l-output tal-ġeneraturi biex il-frekwenza tan-network tal-elettriku terġa' lura għall-valur ta' referenza.
formal.en: During the test, the frequency restoration controller adjusted the generators' output to bring the electricity network's frequency back to the reference value.
formal.zh: 测试期间，频率恢复控制器调节了发电机的输出，使电网频率恢复到参考值。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-frekwenza niżlet; x'jagħmel il-kontrollur tar-restawr tal-frekwenza? Ġużepp: Jaġġusta l-output tal-ġeneraturi biex il-frekwenza terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.
colloquial.en: Nina: The frequency has dropped; what does the frequency restoration controller do? Ġużepp: It adjusts the generators' output to bring the frequency back to the target value.
colloquial.zh: Nina：频率下降了，频率恢复控制器会做什么？Ġużepp：它会调节发电机的输出，让频率恢复到目标值。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-frekwenza niżlet; x'jagħmel il-kontrollur tar-restawr tal-frekwenza?
messages.mt_standard: Il-frekwenza niżlet; x'jagħmel il-kontrollur tar-restawr tal-frekwenza?
messages.zh: 频率下降了，频率恢复控制器会做什么？
messages.en: The frequency has dropped; what does the frequency restoration controller do?

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaġġusta l-output tal-ġeneraturi biex il-frekwenza terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.
messages.mt_standard: Jaġġusta l-output tal-ġeneraturi biex il-frekwenza terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.
messages.zh: 它会调节发电机的输出，让频率恢复到目标值。
messages.en: It adjusts the generators' output to bring the frequency back to the target value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“控制器—恢复—频率”分块记忆：kontrollur 对应控制器，restawr 对应恢复，frekwenza 对应频率；想象指针回到目标刻度。

gloss_zh: 有争议的；引起意见分歧的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something controversial causes strong disagreement or public debate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某件事会引起强烈的意见分歧或公众争论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem nuqqas qawwi ta' qbil jew dibattitu fost in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有争议的；会引起强烈分歧或争论的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li dwaru n-nies ikollhom opinjonijiet differenti ħafna u li jista' jqajjem diskussjoni jew argumenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is controversial, people disagree strongly about it and often discuss it publicly.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddiskuta proposta kontroversjali li qajmet nuqqas ta' qbil fost il-membri.
formal.en: The committee discussed a controversial proposal that caused disagreement among its members.
formal.zh: 委员会讨论了一项有争议的提案，该提案引起了成员之间的意见分歧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd qed jargumenta dwar dan il-film? Mark: Għax jittratta suġġett kontroversjali u mhux kulħadd jaqbel mal-messaġġ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is everyone arguing about this film? Mark: Because it deals with a controversial subject, and not everyone agrees with its message.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么大家都在争论这部电影？Mark：因为它涉及一个有争议的话题，而且并非所有人都认同它传达的观点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd qed jargumenta dwar dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd qed jargumenta dwar dan il-film?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都在争论这部电影？
messages.en: Why is everyone arguing about this film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jittratta suġġett kontroversjali u mhux kulħadd jaqbel mal-messaġġ tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jittratta suġġett kontroversjali u mhux kulħadd jaqbel mal-messaġġ tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为它涉及一个有争议的话题，而且并非所有人都认同它传达的观点。
messages.en: Because it deals with a controversial subject, and not everyone agrees with its message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一项提案让人分成赞成和反对两派，用 kontroversjali 描述这种引起争议的性质；它不等于“错误的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Convalescence is the period or process of gradually recovering health and strength after an illness or operation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 患病或接受手术后，健康和体力逐渐恢复的过程或时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu jew il-proċess li fih persuna terġa' tikseb saħħitha bil-mod wara marda jew operazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 病后或术后逐渐恢复健康与体力的阶段或过程；休养康复。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żmien wara marda jew operazzjoni li matulu persuna tistrieħ u tirkupra saħħitha gradwalment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Convalescence is the time during which you gradually regain your health and strength after being ill or having an operation.

formal.mt: Wara l-operazzjoni, il-pazjent qatta' perjodu ta' konvalexxenza d-dar qabel reġa' lura għax-xogħol.
formal.en: After the operation, the patient spent a period of convalescence at home before returning to work.
formal.zh: 手术后，患者在家休养了一段时间，之后才重返工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif sejjer missierek wara l-operazzjoni? Ġanni: Aħjar, grazzi. Għadu fil-perjodu ta' konvalexxenza, imma kuljum iħossu ftit aktar b'saħħtu.
colloquial.en: Marta: How is your father doing after the operation? Ġanni: Better, thanks. He is still in his period of convalescence, but he feels a little stronger every day.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你爸爸手术后怎么样了？Ġanni：好多了，谢谢。他还在康复期，不过每天都觉得体力又恢复了一点。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer missierek wara l-operazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer missierek wara l-operazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你爸爸手术后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your father doing after the operation?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar, grazzi. Għadu fil-perjodu ta' konvalexxenza, imma kuljum iħossu ftit aktar b'saħħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar, grazzi. Għadu fil-perjodu ta' konvalexxenza, imma kuljum iħossu ftit aktar b'saħħtu.
messages.zh: 好多了，谢谢。他还在康复期，不过每天都觉得体力又恢复了一点。
messages.en: Better, thanks. He is still in his period of convalescence, but he feels a little stronger every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“病情好转后，体力一天恢复一点”的连续画面记 konvalexxenza，重点是逐渐恢复的过程，也可指这段康复期。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suitable for someone's needs or circumstances and easy to use, reach, or arrange.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合某人的需要或实际情况，使用、到达或安排起来方便的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqbel mal-ħtiġijiet jew maċ-ċirkostanzi ta' xi ħadd u jagħmilha faċli biex wieħed juża xi ħaġa, jasal xi mkien jew jirranġa xi attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适合实际需要，使办事、使用或出行比较省事的；方便的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun adattat għall-ħtiġijiet ta' persuna u jiffaċilita l-użu ta' xi ħaġa jew it-twettiq ta' attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is convenient, it suits your needs or circumstances and makes an activity easier.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, agħżel ħin konvenjenti għal-laqgħa u għarraf lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: Please choose a convenient time for the meeting and inform the participants.
formal.zh: 请选择一个方便的开会时间，并通知与会者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għalik konvenjenti niltaqgħu ħdejn l-istazzjon? Lara: Iva, dak il-post konvenjenti ħafna għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is it convenient for you if we meet near the station? Lara: Yes, that location is very convenient for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在车站附近见面，你方便吗？拉拉：方便，那个地点对我来说很便利。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalik konvenjenti niltaqgħu ħdejn l-istazzjon?
messages.mt_standard: Għalik konvenjenti niltaqgħu ħdejn l-istazzjon?
messages.zh: 我们在车站附近见面，你方便吗？
messages.en: Is it convenient for you if we meet near the station?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak il-post konvenjenti ħafna għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak il-post konvenjenti ħafna għalija.
messages.zh: 方便，那个地点对我来说很便利。
messages.en: Yes, that location is very convenient for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“时间合适、地点省事”一起记：ħin konvenjenti 是方便的时间，post konvenjenti 是便利的地点。

gloss_zh: 订立正式契据的预约协议

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement in which the parties promise to enter into a formal deed at a later stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 当事各方承诺日后订立正式契据的预约协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li bih il-partijiet iwiegħdu li jagħmlu att formali fi stadju aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承诺日后订立正式契据的协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim li jinkludi l-wegħda tal-partijiet li aktar tard jikkonkludu att formali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A promise of deed is an agreement in which the parties undertake to enter into a formal deed later.

collocations.en: to sign an agreement promising a future deed
collocations.zh: 签署订立正式契据的预约协议

collocations.en: the terms of the agreement promising a future deed

formal.mt: Il-partijiet qraw il-kundizzjonijiet tal-konvenju qabel ma ffirmawh.
formal.en: The parties read the terms of the agreement promising a future deed before signing it.
formal.zh: 各方在签署这份订立正式契据的预约协议前，阅读了协议条款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qrajt il-konvenju? Rita: Iva, imma nixtieq nifhem aħjar il-kundizzjonijiet qabel niffirma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you read the agreement promising a future deed? Rita: Yes, but I would like to understand the terms better before I sign.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你读过那份预约协议了吗？丽塔：读过了，但我想在签字前把条款了解得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Mark (协议当事人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-konvenju?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-konvenju?
messages.zh: 你读过那份预约协议了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the agreement promising a future deed?

messages.speaker: Rita (协议当事人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nixtieq nifhem aħjar il-kundizzjonijiet qabel niffirma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nixtieq nifhem aħjar il-kundizzjonijiet qabel niffirma.
messages.zh: 读过了，但我想在签字前把条款了解得更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, but I would like to understand the terms better before I sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先作承诺，后立契据”的两步画面记忆 konvenju，重点记住它包含日后订立正式契据的承诺。

gloss_zh: 已召集的；被召集开会的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Officially called together for a meeting or discussion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已被正式召集起来参加会议或讨论的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie msejjaħ biex jiltaqa' formalment għal laqgħa jew diskussjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为举行会议或进行讨论而被正式召集的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie msejjaħ jew imlaqqa' b'mod formali sabiex jieħu sehem f'laqgħa jew diskussjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A convened group has been officially called together to attend a meeting or discuss a matter.

collocations.en: a council convened for a meeting
collocations.zh: 被召集举行会议的理事会

formal.mt: Il-kumitat konvenut biex jeżamina l-proposta se jippreżenta r-rapport tiegħu nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The committee convened to examine the proposal will present its report on Friday.
formal.zh: 为审议该提案而召集的委员会将于星期五提交报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se jiltaqa' l-kumitat konvenut għal-lum? Pawlu: Fis-sala ta' fuq, fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where will the committee convened for today meet? Pawlu: In the upstairs hall, at ten.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天召集的委员会要在哪里开会？保罗：在楼上的大厅，十点开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (委员会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se jiltaqa' l-kumitat konvenut għal-lum?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se jiltaqa' l-kumitat konvenut għal-lum?
messages.zh: 今天召集的委员会要在哪里开会？
messages.en: Where will the committee convened for today meet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (委员会秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sala ta' fuq, fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sala ta' fuq, fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 在楼上的大厅，十点开始。
messages.en: In the upstairs hall, at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象委员会成员收到通知后集合开会，用“被召集的委员会”这个画面记住 kumitat konvenut。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal agreement between countries or other parties concerning a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国家或其他各方就某一特定事项订立的正式协议；公约。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim formali bejn pajjiżi jew partijiet oħra dwar suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各国或有关各方围绕特定事项达成的正式公约或协定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim uffiċjali bejn pajjiżi jew partijiet oħra li jistabbilixxi regoli jew impenji dwar kwistjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A convention is a formal agreement in which countries or other parties establish rules or commitments on a particular subject.

formal.mt: Il-konvenzjoni tistabbilixxi impenji komuni għall-pajjiżi li jiffirmawha.
formal.en: The convention establishes shared commitments for the countries that sign it.
formal.zh: 该公约为签署国规定了共同的承诺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi konvenzjoni internazzjonali? Daniel: Hija ftehim formali bejn pajjiżi dwar suġġett partikolari.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is an international convention? Daniel: It is a formal agreement between countries on a particular subject.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是国际公约？丹尼尔：就是各国就某一特定事项订立的正式协议。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi konvenzjoni internazzjonali?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi konvenzjoni internazzjonali?
messages.zh: 什么是国际公约？
messages.en: What is an international convention?

messages.speaker: Daniel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ftehim formali bejn pajjiżi dwar suġġett partikolari.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ftehim formali bejn pajjiżi dwar suġġett partikolari.
messages.zh: 就是各国就某一特定事项订立的正式协议。
messages.en: It is a formal agreement between countries on a particular subject.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konvenzjoni 放进“各国代表共同签署公约”的场景记忆，再连着练习 konvenzjoni internazzjonali。

gloss_zh: 皈依者；转而接受某种信仰或观点的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has adopted a different religion, belief, or way of thinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改信另一宗教，或转而接受某种信念、观点的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun bidlet ir-reliġjon tagħha jew bdiet tħaddan twemmin jew fehma differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改信另一宗教或转而接受某种信念、观点的人；皈依者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konvertit huwa persuna li tkun bdiet tħaddan reliġjon, twemmin jew fehma differenti minn dik li kellha qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A convert is someone who has changed their religion or begun to accept a different belief or way of thinking.

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, il-konvertit spjega għaliex għażel li jħaddan ir-reliġjon il-ġdida tiegħu.
formal.en: In the interview, the convert explained why he had chosen to embrace his new religion.
formal.zh: 访谈中，这位皈依者解释了自己为何选择接受新的宗教信仰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ilu jħaddan din ir-reliġjon? Lara: Le, huwa konvertit ġdid. Maja: Issa nifhem għaliex qed jitgħallem dwar it-tradizzjonijiet tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu followed this religion for a long time? Lara: No, he is a new convert. Maja: Now I understand why he is learning about its traditions.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu信这个宗教很久了吗？Lara：没有，他是新近皈依的。Maja：现在我明白他为什么正在学习这个宗教的传统了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ilu jħaddan din ir-reliġjon?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ilu jħaddan din ir-reliġjon?
messages.zh: Pawlu信这个宗教很久了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu followed this religion for a long time?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa konvertit ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa konvertit ġdid.
messages.zh: 没有，他是新近皈依的。
messages.en: No, he is a new convert.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex qed jitgħallem dwar it-tradizzjonijiet tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex qed jitgħallem dwar it-tradizzjonijiet tagħha.
messages.zh: 现在我明白他为什么正在学习这个宗教的传统了。
messages.en: Now I understand why he is learning about its traditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成一个人从旧信仰走向新信仰：konvertit指完成转变的那个人，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Certain that something is true or that a particular decision is right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确信某事属实，或坚信某项判断、决定正确的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jemmen bis-sħiħ li xi ħaġa hija vera jew li deċiżjoni partikolari hija tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事的真实性或正确性深信不疑的；被说服而信服的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tkun konvinta meta temmen bis-sħiħ li xi ħaġa hija vera jew tajba, xi drabi wara li tkun semgħet raġunijiet jew rat provi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are convinced of something, you feel certain that it is true or right.

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina r-riżultati, ir-riċerkatur kien konvint li l-metodu kien effettiv.
formal.en: After examining the results, the researcher was convinced that the method was effective.
formal.zh: 研究人员检查结果后，确信这一方法有效。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int konvint li din hi t-triq it-tajba? Mark: Iva, għadni kif ħarist lejn il-mappa. Lara: Tajjeb, mela nibqgħu sejrin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you convinced this is the right road? Mark: Yes, I have just checked the map. Lara: All right, then let's keep going.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你确信这条路是对的吗？Mark：是的，我刚看过地图。Lara：好，那我们继续走吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int konvint li din hi t-triq it-tajba?
messages.mt_standard: Int konvint li din hi t-triq it-tajba?
messages.zh: 你确信这条路是对的吗？
messages.en: Are you convinced this is the right road?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kif ħarist lejn il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kif ħarist lejn il-mappa.
messages.zh: 是的，我刚看过地图。
messages.en: Yes, I have just checked the map.

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela nibqgħu sejrin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela nibqgħu sejrin.
messages.zh: 好，那我们继续走吧。
messages.en: All right, then let's keep going.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看完证据后点头说“我确信”：konvint描述人的信服状态，可连同konvint li一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A firmly held belief, or a strong feeling that something is true or right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚定持有的信念，或确信某事真实、正确的强烈信心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twemmin sod jew ċertezza qawwija li xi ħaġa hija vera jew tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚定的信念；对某事真实或正确的确信。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konvinzjoni hija fehma jew twemmin li persuna żżomm b'mod sod, jew ċertezza qawwija dwar il-verità jew is-sewwa ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conviction is a belief you hold firmly, or a strong feeling that something is true or right.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-awtur esprima l-konvinzjoni tiegħu li kull tifel u tifla għandhom ikollhom aċċess għall-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: In the report, the author expressed his conviction that every child should have access to education.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中表达了自己的坚定信念：每个孩子都应有机会接受教育。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tkellimt b'tant konvinzjoni fil-laqgħa? Mark: Għax nemmen li kulħadd għandu jkollu ċans jitkellem. Maja: Iva, kien ċar li dan hu importanti għalik.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you speak with such conviction at the meeting? Mark: Because I believe everyone should have a chance to speak. Maja: Yes, it was clear that this matters to you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在会上为什么说得那么坚定？Mark：因为我相信每个人都应该有发言的机会。Maja：是啊，看得出来这对你很重要。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tkellimt b'tant konvinzjoni fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tkellimt b'tant konvinzjoni fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 你在会上为什么说得那么坚定？
messages.en: Why did you speak with such conviction at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nemmen li kulħadd għandu jkollu ċans jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nemmen li kulħadd għandu jkollu ċans jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为我相信每个人都应该有发言的机会。
messages.en: Because I believe everyone should have a chance to speak.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien ċar li dan hu importanti għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien ċar li dan hu importanti għalik.
messages.zh: 是啊，看得出来这对你很重要。
messages.en: Yes, it was clear that this matters to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“心里牢牢握住一个信念”的画面记konvinzjoni；再背b'konvinzjoni，联想到说话时坚定的语气。

gloss_zh: 清醒的；有意识的；意识到的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Awake and able to perceive what is happening, or aware of a particular fact or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于清醒、有知觉的状态的；也指知道或意识到某个事实、情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa mqajjem u kapaċi jħoss x'qed jiġri madwaru, jew li jaf b'fatt jew b'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清醒且有知觉的，能够感知周围情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tkun konxja meta tkun imqajma u kapaċi tħoss u tifhem dak li jkun qed jiġri madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is conscious, they are awake and able to notice and respond to what is happening around them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知道或意识到某个事实、问题或情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tkun konxja ta' fatt jew ta' sitwazzjoni meta tkun taf bihom jew tifhem li jeżistu u x'jistgħu jfissru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are aware of something, you know that it exists or understand that it is happening.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-passiġġier baqa' konxju wara l-inċident u kien kapaċi jwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The report indicates that the passenger remained conscious after the accident and was able to answer questions.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这名乘客在事故发生后仍保持清醒，并且能够回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int konxju li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa? Mark: Iva, naf. Se nitlaq kmieni biex nasal fil-ħin. Lara: Tajjeb, narak hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you aware that the meeting starts at nine? Mark: Yes, I know. I will leave early so I arrive on time. Lara: All right, see you there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你知道会议九点开始吗？Mark：知道。我会早点出发，好准时到。Lara：好，到时见。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Int konxju li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Int konxju li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa?
messages.zh: 你知道会议九点开始吗？
messages.en: Are you aware that the meeting starts at nine?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf. Se nitlaq kmieni biex nasal fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf. Se nitlaq kmieni biex nasal fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 知道。我会早点出发，好准时到。
messages.en: Yes, I know. I will leave early so I arrive on time.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, narak hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, narak hemm.
messages.zh: 好，到时见。
messages.en: All right, see you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把konxju记成两幅画面：睁眼能回应是“清醒”，脑中注意到某个事实是“意识到”；用情境区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 流刺网；随水漂流的渔网

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fishing net that drifts with the water to catch fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种随水流漂移、用来捕捉鱼类的渔网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xibka tas-sajd li titħalla tinġarr mal-kurrent tal-ilma biex taqbad il-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼用的流刺网，随水流漂移以捕获鱼类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xibka li tintuża fis-sajd u titħalla tinġarr mal-kurrent tal-ilma biex taqbad il-ħut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A drift net is a fishing net that moves with the water and catches fish.

collocations.en: cast the drift net into the sea

formal.mt: Is-sajjied tefa' l-konz fil-baħar u ħallieh jinġarr mal-kurrent.
formal.en: The fisherman cast the drift net into the sea and let it drift with the current.
formal.zh: 渔民把流刺网投入海中，让它随水流漂移。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Ħejjejt il-konz? Rita: Iva, lest. Nistgħu nitfgħuh fil-baħar.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Have you prepared the drift net? Rita: Yes, it's ready. We can cast it into the sea.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：你把流刺网准备好了吗？Rita：好了，可以把它放进海里了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħejjejt il-konz?
messages.mt_standard: Ħejjejt il-konz?
messages.zh: 你把流刺网准备好了吗？
messages.en: Have you prepared the drift net?

messages.speaker: Rita (渔业同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lest. Nistgħu nitfgħuh fil-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lest. Nistgħu nitfgħuh fil-baħar.
messages.zh: 好了，可以把它放进海里了。
messages.en: Yes, it's ready. We can cast it into the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konz 和“一张随水流漂移的渔网”画面绑定，联想投网、漂流、收网三个动作来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Worried about something, or directly involved in or affected by a matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事感到担忧的；也指与某事直接有关、参与其中或受到其影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss tħassib dwar xi ħaġa, jew li jkun involut f'xi kwistjoni jew milqut minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某事而担忧的；与某事有关、参与其中或受其影响的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun imħasseb dwar xi ħaġa, jew li jkollu x'jaqsam ma' kwistjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is concerned is worried about something, while a person concerned in a matter is involved in or affected by it.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju għandu jinforma lill-persuni konċernati dwar il-bidla fid-data tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The office should inform the people concerned about the change in the meeting date.
formal.zh: 办公室应将会议日期的变更通知有关人员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk konċernat? Mark: Għax ħija għadu ma wasalx, u ma weġibx it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so concerned? Mark: Because my brother still hasn't arrived, and he hasn't answered the phone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么看起来这么担心？Mark：因为我兄弟还没到，也没接电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher daqshekk konċernat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher daqshekk konċernat?
messages.zh: 你为什么看起来这么担心？
messages.en: Why do you look so concerned?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħija għadu ma wasalx, u ma weġibx it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħija għadu ma wasalx, u ma weġibx it-telefon.
messages.zh: 因为我兄弟还没到，也没接电话。
messages.en: Because my brother still hasn't arrived, and he hasn't answered the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konċernat 和“心里挂着一件事”联系起来，记住“担忧的”；再用 il-persuni konċernati 记“有关人员”，靠上下文区分情绪与涉及关系。

gloss_zh: 特许加盟商；获准经营某品牌业务的人或企业

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company authorized to operate a business using another business's name and system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获得授权，使用另一企业的品牌名称及经营体系开展业务的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tingħata d-dritt tmexxi negozju taħt l-isem u skont is-sistema ta' negozju ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得某企业授权，使用其品牌及经营体系开展业务的加盟经营者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija awtorizzata tmexxi negozju billi tuża l-marka u s-sistema kummerċjali ta' impriża oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A franchisee is a person or company that operates a business using another company's brand and business system under an agreement.

collocations.en: a franchisee of an international brand

formal.mt: Il-konċessjonarju se jiftaħ ħanut ġdid taħt l-isem tal-marka u skont l-istandards tagħha.
formal.en: The franchisee will open a new shop under the brand's name and in accordance with its standards.
formal.zh: 该加盟商将以这一品牌的名义开设新店，并遵循其标准。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħanut hu tiegħek? Mark: Jien il-konċessjonarju; immexxi l-ħanut taħt din il-marka.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this shop yours? Mark: I'm the franchisee; I run the shop under this brand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这家店是你的吗？马克：我是加盟商，以这个品牌经营这家店。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħanut hu tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħanut hu tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这家店是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this shop yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (加盟商)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-konċessjonarju; immexxi l-ħanut taħt din il-marka.
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-konċessjonarju; immexxi l-ħanut taħt din il-marka.
messages.zh: 我是加盟商，以这个品牌经营这家店。
messages.en: I'm the franchisee; I run the shop under this brand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和柜台后经营品牌门店的人联系起来：这里记的是获得加盟授权的经营者。
