teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company granted a concession to carry out works and operate the resulting infrastructure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得工程特许经营权，负责实施工程并经营相关设施的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tingħata konċessjoni biex twettaq xogħlijiet u tħaddem l-infrastruttura li tinbena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根据工程特许经营安排，承担工程实施并取得相关设施经营权的个人或企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew impriża li, taħt konċessjoni, tieħu r-responsabbiltà li twettaq xogħlijiet u tikseb id-dritt li tisfrutta ekonomikament l-infrastruttura relatata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A works concessionaire is a person or company that undertakes construction works under a concession and receives the right to operate the resulting infrastructure.

collocations.en: the selection of the works concessionaire
collocations.zh: 工程特许经营者的遴选

collocations.en: the obligations of the works concessionaire
collocations.zh: 工程特许经营者的义务

formal.mt: Il-konċessjonarju ta' xogħlijiet se jibni l-parkeġġ u jħaddmu għall-perjodu stipulat fil-kuntratt.
formal.en: The works concessionaire will build the car park and operate it for the period specified in the contract.
formal.zh: 工程特许经营者将建设该停车场，并在合同规定的期限内经营。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jibni u jmexxi l-parkeġġ il-ġdid? Pawlu: Il-konċessjonarju ta' xogħlijiet li ntgħażel għall-proġett.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will build and run the new car park? Paul: The works concessionaire selected for the project.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来建设和经营这个新停车场？保罗：为这个项目选定的工程特许经营者。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jibni u jmexxi l-parkeġġ il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jibni u jmexxi l-parkeġġ il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 谁来建设和经营这个新停车场？
messages.en: Who will build and run the new car park?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-konċessjonarju ta' xogħlijiet li ntgħażel għall-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Il-konċessjonarju ta' xogħlijiet li ntgħażel għall-proġett.
messages.zh: 为这个项目选定的工程特许经营者。
messages.en: The works concessionaire selected for the project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“建设停车场，再负责经营”的场景记整条短语；看到 ta' xogħlijiet，就把经营者放进工程项目中理解。

gloss_zh: 特许经营权；特许经营合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: An authorization to operate a business, service, or facility, or the contract setting out that authorization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 授予经营某项业务、服务或设施的许可或权利，也可指规定这种授权的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għoti tad-dritt li jitmexxa negozju, servizz jew faċilità, jew il-kuntratt li jistabbilixxi dan id-dritt u l-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由有关机构或权利人授予的、按约定条件经营某项业务、服务或设施的特许权。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dritt mogħti minn awtorità jew minn min għandu s-setgħa jagħtih, biex persuna jew impriża tmexxi attività, servizz jew faċilità taħt kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concession is a right granted to a person or organization to operate a particular business, service, or facility under agreed conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定特许经营授权、经营条件及各方权利义务的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi l-għoti ta' dritt ta' konċessjoni, il-kundizzjonijiet tat-tħaddim u d-drittijiet u l-obbligi tal-partijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concession contract is an agreement that sets out an operator's authorization and the conditions, rights, and obligations governing the concession.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ngħatat konċessjoni biex tħaddem il-kafetterija tal-mużew; il-konċessjoni ffirmata tispeċifika t-tul tal-ftehim u l-obbligi tal-partijiet.
formal.en: The company was granted a concession to operate the museum café; the signed concession contract specifies the agreement's duration and the parties' obligations.
formal.zh: 该公司获授经营博物馆咖啡馆的特许权；已签署的特许经营合同规定了协议期限及各方义务。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ingħatatilkom il-konċessjoni biex tmexxu l-kafetterija? David: Iva, u ffirmajna l-konċessjoni lbieraħ; nibdew ix-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Were you granted the concession to run the café? David: Yes, and we signed the concession contract yesterday; we start next month.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们获准特许经营那家咖啡馆了吗？戴维：是的，我们昨天签了特许经营合同，下个月开始营业。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ingħatatilkom il-konċessjoni biex tmexxu l-kafetterija?
messages.mt_standard: Ingħatatilkom il-konċessjoni biex tmexxu l-kafetterija?
messages.zh: 你们获准特许经营那家咖啡馆了吗？
messages.en: Were you granted the concession to run the café?

messages.speaker: David (咖啡馆经营者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ffirmajna l-konċessjoni lbieraħ; nibdew ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ffirmajna l-konċessjoni lbieraħ; nibdew ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 是的，我们昨天签了特许经营合同，下个月开始营业。
messages.en: Yes, and we signed the concession contract yesterday; we start next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咖啡馆经营者先“获得经营权”，再“签署合同”：同一个词可指授权本身，也可指承载授权的合同，靠动词辨义。

gloss_zh: 联合特许经营权；共同特许经营安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: A concession held or carried out jointly by two or more persons or organizations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由两个或更多个人或机构共同持有或共同实施的特许经营权或安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konċessjoni li tinżamm jew titwettaq flimkien minn żewġ persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由两个或更多参与方共同取得或实施的特许经营权或特许经营安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' konċessjoni li fih żewġ partijiet jew aktar jaqsmu d-dritt li jmexxu l-attività u jwettqu flimkien ir-responsabbiltajiet miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A joint concession is a concession in which two or more parties share the right to carry out the authorized activity.

collocations.en: a joint concession granted to two companies
collocations.zh: 授予两家公司的联合特许经营权

collocations.en: the management of a joint concession

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ kumpaniji ngħataw konċessjoni konġunta biex iħaddmu ċ-ċentru sportiv, skont it-tqassim tar-responsabbiltajiet stabbilit fil-ftehim.
formal.en: The two companies were granted a joint concession to operate the sports centre, according to the allocation of responsibilities set out in the agreement.
formal.zh: 两家公司获授联合特许经营权，按照协议规定的职责分工共同运营该体育中心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kumpanija tagħkom se tmexxi ċ-ċentru waħedha? Adrian: Le, għandna konċessjoni konġunta ma' kumpanija oħra, u se naqsmu x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will your company run the centre on its own? Adrian: No, we have a joint concession with another company, and we'll share the work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们公司会独自运营这个中心吗？阿德里安：不会，我们和另一家公司共同取得了特许经营权，会分担工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tagħkom se tmexxi ċ-ċentru waħedha?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tagħkom se tmexxi ċ-ċentru waħedha?
messages.zh: 你们公司会独自运营这个中心吗？
messages.en: Will your company run the centre on its own?

messages.speaker: Adrian (公司经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandna konċessjoni konġunta ma' kumpanija oħra, u se naqsmu x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandna konċessjoni konġunta ma' kumpanija oħra, u se naqsmu x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 不会，我们和另一家公司共同取得了特许经营权，会分担工作。
messages.en: No, we have a joint concession with another company, and we'll share the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语画成“两家公司共同经营一座体育中心”：konċessjoni 记特许经营，konġunta 提醒你这里强调共同参与。

gloss_zh: 审慎监管豁免；审慎要求的特定例外

teaching_sense.en_definition: A specific exemption or exclusion from the scope of a prudential requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在审慎监管要求中，为特定情况或主体划定的豁免或不适用范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eċċezzjoni li teskludi ċerti każijiet jew entitajiet mill-kamp ta' applikazzjoni ta' rekwiżit prudenzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审慎监管要求中的特定豁免或适用范围例外。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eċċezzjoni speċifika li tippermetti li rekwiżit prudenzjali ma japplikax għal ċerti każijiet jew entitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prudential carve out is an exception that excludes specified cases or entities from a prudential requirement.

collocations.zh: 适用一项审慎监管豁免

collocations.en: the scope of the prudential carve out
collocations.zh: 该审慎监管豁免的适用范围

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega għal liema entitajiet tapplika l-konċessjoni prudenzjali u liema rekwiżiti jibqgħu fis-seħħ.
formal.en: The report explains which entities the prudential carve out applies to and which requirements remain in force.
formal.zh: 报告说明该审慎监管豁免适用于哪些主体，以及哪些要求仍然有效。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-konċessjoni prudenzjali tfisser li ma japplikawx ir-regoli kollha? Pawlu: Le, hija eċċezzjoni għal rekwiżit speċifiku biss.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does this prudential carve out mean that none of the rules apply? Pawlu: No, it is an exception to just one specific requirement.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这项审慎监管豁免是不是说所有规则都不适用了？Pawlu：不是，它只是针对某一项具体要求的例外。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-konċessjoni prudenzjali tfisser li ma japplikawx ir-regoli kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-konċessjoni prudenzjali tfisser li ma japplikawx ir-regoli kollha?
messages.zh: 这项审慎监管豁免是不是说所有规则都不适用了？
messages.en: Does this prudential carve out mean that none of the rules apply?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (合规专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija eċċezzjoni għal rekwiżit speċifiku biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija eċċezzjoni għal rekwiżit speċifiku biss.
messages.zh: 不是，它只是针对某一项具体要求的例外。
messages.en: No, it is an exception to just one specific requirement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在审慎监管规则表上圈出一个例外格：这里记的是特定要求的豁免，学习时把 prudenzjali 与“审慎监管”一起记。

gloss_zh: 公共特许经营权；公共特许经营安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement through which a public authority grants an operator the right to run a service or use a public asset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共机关授予经营者运营某项服务或使用公共资产之权利的安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li bih awtorità pubblika tagħti lil operatur id-dritt li jmexxi servizz jew juża assi pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由公共机关授予的特许经营权，或据此运营服务、使用公共资产的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dritt mogħti minn awtorità pubblika lil operatur biex imexxi servizz jew juża assi pubbliku skont kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concession is an arrangement under which a public authority allows an operator to run a service or use a public asset.

collocations.zh: 授予一项公共特许经营权

collocations.en: the duration of the public concession

formal.mt: Il-konċessjoni pubblika għall-operat tal-parkeġġ tispeċifika t-tul tal-ftehim u l-obbligi tal-operatur.
formal.en: The public concession to operate the car park specifies the duration of the agreement and the operator's obligations.
formal.zh: 运营该停车场的公共特许经营安排规定了协议期限及经营者的义务。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kumpanija xtrat il-parkeġġ? Mark: Le, għandha konċessjoni pubblika biex tmexxih għal żmien stabbilit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the company buy the car park? Mark: No, it has a public concession to operate it for a set period.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这家公司买下了停车场吗？Mark：没有，它获得了在规定期限内运营停车场的公共特许经营权。

messages.speaker: Nina (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija xtrat il-parkeġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija xtrat il-parkeġġ?
messages.zh: 这家公司买下了停车场吗？
messages.en: Did the company buy the car park?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandha konċessjoni pubblika biex tmexxih għal żmien stabbilit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandha konċessjoni pubblika biex tmexxih għal żmien stabbilit.
messages.zh: 没有，它获得了在规定期限内运营停车场的公共特许经营权。
messages.en: No, it has a public concession to operate it for a set period.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“公共停车场交给经营者运营”的画面记忆整个词组；把 pubblika 与公共机关授予经营权的场景联系起来。

gloss_zh: 保留特许经营；限特定合资格主体参与的特许经营

teaching_sense.en_definition: A concession for which participation is reserved for a specified category of eligible operators.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅允许某一指定类别的合资格经营者参与申请或竞争的特许经营安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konċessjoni li l-parteċipazzjoni fiha tkun limitata għal kategorija speċifika ta' operaturi eliġibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与资格保留给指定类别经营者的特许经营安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' konċessjoni li għalih jistgħu japplikaw biss operaturi li jappartjenu għal kategorija speċifikata u jissodisfaw il-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reserved concession is a concession for which only operators belonging to a specified eligible category may compete.

collocations.zh: 申请参与一项保留特许经营

collocations.en: the eligibility criteria for the reserved concession
collocations.zh: 该保留特许经营的参与资格标准

formal.mt: L-avviż dwar il-konċessjoni riżervata jiddefinixxi l-kategorija ta' operaturi li jistgħu jipparteċipaw u d-dokumenti li għandhom jippreżentaw.
formal.en: The notice concerning the reserved concession defines the category of operators that may participate and the documents they must submit.
formal.zh: 该保留特许经营的公告界定了可参与的经营者类别，以及他们必须提交的文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu napplikaw għal din il-konċessjoni riżervata? Toni: L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw jekk l-organizzazzjoni tagħna tissodisfax il-kriterji ta' eliġibbiltà.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we apply for this reserved concession? Toni: First we need to check whether our organisation meets the eligibility criteria.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们能申请参与这项保留特许经营吗？Toni：我们得先看看自己的机构是否符合参与资格标准。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu napplikaw għal din il-konċessjoni riżervata?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu napplikaw għal din il-konċessjoni riżervata?
messages.zh: 我们能申请参与这项保留特许经营吗？
messages.en: Can we apply for this reserved concession?

messages.speaker: Toni (机构负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw jekk l-organizzazzjoni tagħna tissodisfax il-kriterji ta' eliġibbiltà.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw jekk l-organizzazzjoni tagħna tissodisfax il-kriterji ta' eliġibbiltà.
messages.zh: 我们得先看看自己的机构是否符合参与资格标准。
messages.en: First we need to check whether our organisation meets the eligibility criteria.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象特许经营申请窗口挂着“限指定合资格主体”的牌子，用这幅画面记住 riżervata 所提示的参与资格保留。

gloss_zh: 工程特许经营；工程特许经营权

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement granting an operator the right to carry out works and benefit from their operation under agreed conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照约定条件，授予经营者实施工程并通过运营工程项目获取收益的特许安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li jagħti lil operatur id-dritt li jwettaq xogħlijiet u jibbenefika mit-tħaddim tagħhom skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工程特许经营：授予经营者实施工程及运营相关工程项目以获取收益的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konċessjoni li tippermetti lil operatur iwettaq xogħlijiet u jikseb dħul mit-tħaddim tagħhom skont ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A works concession is an arrangement under which an operator receives the right to carry out works and earn income from operating them.

collocations.en: the granting of a works concession
the conditions of a works concession

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet tal-konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet u r-responsabbiltajiet tal-operatur.
formal.en: The contract sets out the conditions of the works concession and the operator's responsibilities.
formal.zh: 合同规定了工程特许经营的条件及经营者的责任。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhi konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet? Pawlu: Hija arranġament biex operatur iwettaq xogħlijiet u jikseb dħul mit-tħaddim tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is a works concession? Pawlu: It is an arrangement for an operator to carry out works and earn income from operating them.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：什么是工程特许经营？保罗：就是让经营者实施工程，并通过运营工程项目取得收入的一种安排。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet?
messages.zh: 什么是工程特许经营？
messages.en: What is a works concession?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija arranġament biex operatur iwettaq xogħlijiet u jikseb dħul mit-tħaddim tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hija arranġament biex operatur iwettaq xogħlijiet u jikseb dħul mit-tħaddim tagħhom.
messages.zh: 就是让经营者实施工程，并通过运营工程项目取得收入的一种安排。
messages.en: It is an arrangement for an operator to carry out works and earn income from operating them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“授予工程特许经营权”的合同场景记忆，联想经营者既实施工程，又运营项目。

gloss_zh: 公共工程特许经营；公共工程特许经营权

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement granting an operator the right to carry out public works and benefit from their operation under agreed conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照约定条件，授予经营者实施公共工程并通过运营相关项目获取收益的特许安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li jagħti lil operatur id-dritt li jwettaq xogħlijiet pubbliċi u jibbenefika mit-tħaddim tagħhom skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共工程特许经营：授予经营者实施公共工程及运营相关项目以获取收益的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konċessjoni li tippermetti lil operatur iwettaq xogħlijiet pubbliċi u jikseb dħul mit-tħaddim tagħhom skont ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public works concession is an arrangement under which an operator receives the right to carry out public works and earn income from operating them.

collocations.mt: kuntratt għal konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi
collocations.en: a contract for a public works concession
collocations.zh: 公共工程特许经营合同

collocations.mt: l-għoti ta' konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi
collocations.en: the granting of a public works concession
collocations.zh: 授予公共工程特许经营权

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-ambitu tal-konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi u l-kundizzjonijiet marbuta magħha.
formal.en: The report explains the scope of the public works concession and the conditions attached to it.
formal.zh: 报告说明了公共工程特许经营的范围及其附带条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kuntratt dwar xiex inhu? Mark: Dwar konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi. Jispjega x'għandu jagħmel l-operatur u kif jista' jħaddem il-proġett.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this contract about? Mark: A public works concession. It explains what the operator must do and how they may operate the project.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份合同是关于什么的？马克：公共工程特许经营。它说明经营者必须做什么，以及可以怎样运营项目。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kuntratt dwar xiex inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kuntratt dwar xiex inhu?
messages.zh: 这份合同是关于什么的？
messages.en: What is this contract about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi. Jispjega x'għandu jagħmel l-operatur u kif jista' jħaddem il-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar konċessjoni ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi. Jispjega x'għandu jagħmel l-operatur u kif jista' jħaddem il-proġett.
messages.zh: 公共工程特许经营。它说明经营者必须做什么，以及可以怎样运营项目。
messages.en: A public works concession. It explains what the operator must do and how they may operate the project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“工程特许经营”这个整体，再用末尾的 pubbliċi 锁定“公共工程”，读到词尾就补上“公共”。

gloss_zh: 服务特许经营权；服务特许经营安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement that grants an operator the right to provide and operate a specified service under agreed conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 授予经营者按照约定条件提供并运营某项指定服务之权利的安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li jagħti lil operatur id-dritt li jipprovdi u jmexxi servizz speċifikat skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 授予经营者提供并运营指定服务之权利的特许经营安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konċessjoni li permezz tagħha operatur jingħata d-dritt li jipprovdi u jmexxi servizz partikolari skont it-termini tal-ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A services concession is an arrangement that gives an operator the right to provide and run a specified service under agreed conditions.

collocations.en: the award of the services concession
collocations.zh: 服务特许经营权的授予

collocations.en: the conditions of the services concession

formal.mt: Il-ftehim dwar il-konċessjoni tas-servizz jistabbilixxi l-ħinijiet tal-operat u l-livell ta' kwalità li għandu jinżamm.
formal.en: The services concession agreement sets out the operating hours and the level of quality that must be maintained.
formal.zh: 服务特许经营协议规定了运营时间及必须维持的服务质量水平。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jmexxi s-servizz tal-laneċ is-sena d-dieħla? David: Il-kumpanija li ngħatat il-konċessjoni tas-servizz.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will operate the ferry service next year? David: The company that was awarded the services concession.
colloquial.zh: Sara：明年谁来运营渡轮服务？David：获得这项服务特许经营权的那家公司。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jmexxi s-servizz tal-laneċ is-sena d-dieħla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jmexxi s-servizz tal-laneċ is-sena d-dieħla?
messages.zh: 明年谁来运营渡轮服务？
messages.en: Who will operate the ferry service next year?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija li ngħatat il-konċessjoni tas-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija li ngħatat il-konċessjoni tas-servizz.
messages.zh: 获得这项服务特许经营权的那家公司。
messages.en: The company that was awarded the services concession.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tas-servizz 与“这项服务的”连起来记，再想象一份规定渡轮运营时间的协议，帮助记住整个词组表示服务特许经营。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A general idea used to understand or describe something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来理解或描述某种事物的一般性想法或抽象认识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea ġenerali li tintuża biex wieħed jifhem jew jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 概念；用于理解、思考或描述某类事物的概括性认识。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idea ġenerali jew astratta li tirrappreżenta xi ħaġa u tgħin biex wieħed jaħseb dwarha jew jifhimha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concept is a general or abstract idea that helps you understand, describe, or think about something.

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jispjega l-konċett ta' kooperazzjoni permezz ta' eżempji mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: This chapter explains the concept of cooperation through examples from everyday life.
formal.zh: 本章通过日常生活中的例子解释合作这一概念。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-konċett. David: Ejja nieħdu eżempju sempliċi, u mbagħad nerġgħu nħarsu lejn id-definizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: I still haven't understood this concept. David: Let's take a simple example, and then look at the definition again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我还是没理解这个概念。戴维：我们先看一个简单的例子，然后再看看定义。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-konċett.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-konċett.
messages.zh: 我还是没理解这个概念。
messages.en: I still haven't understood this concept.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu eżempju sempliċi, u mbagħad nerġgħu nħarsu lejn id-definizzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu eżempju sempliċi, u mbagħad nerġgħu nħarsu lejn id-definizzjoni.
messages.zh: 我们先看一个简单的例子，然后再看看定义。
messages.en: Let's take a simple example, and then look at the definition again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把许多具体例子归进同一个思想盒子，盒子上的标签就是 konċett，也就是“概念”。

gloss_zh: 简明的；简短生硬的；言简意赅的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing something clearly in few words, or speaking so briefly that the tone can seem abrupt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用少量文字或言语清楚表达意思的；也可指说话过于简短而显得生硬的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi ħsieb b'mod ċar u bi ftit kliem, jew li jitkellem tant fil-qosor li jista' jidher nieqes mill-korteżija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简明的；用较少的文字或言语清楚表达所需意思的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi l-ħsieb b'mod ċar u bi ftit kliem, mingħajr dettalji żejda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is concise expresses its meaning clearly in a small number of words.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简短生硬的；因言语过于简短而显得冷淡或不够礼貌的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juża ftit kliem b'mod li jista' jidher kiesaħ jew nieqes mill-korteżija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is curt, they speak very briefly in a way that can seem unfriendly or impolite.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 言简意赅的；以少量言语准确表达要点而没有赘述的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jwassal il-punti ewlenin b'mod preċiż u bi ftit kliem, mingħajr kliem żejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A succinct statement gives the main points accurately and clearly without using unnecessary words.

formal.mt: L-awtur ippreżenta sommarju konċiż li jinkludi l-punti ewlenin mingħajr dettalji żejda.
formal.en: The author presented a succinct summary containing the main points without unnecessary detail.
formal.zh: 作者提供了一份言简意赅的摘要，涵盖要点而没有多余细节。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex weġibtni b'ton daqshekk konċiż? Kont irrabjat? Leo: Le, kont mgħaġġel. Ridt inwieġeb fil-qosor, imma ma ridtx inkun goff.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you answer me in such a curt tone? Were you angry? Leo: No, I was in a hurry. I wanted to answer briefly, but I didn't mean to be rude.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么回答得这么简短生硬？你生气了吗？莱奥：没有，我当时赶时间。我想简短回答，但并不是想没礼貌。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex weġibtni b'ton daqshekk konċiż? Kont irrabjat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex weġibtni b'ton daqshekk konċiż? Kont irrabjat?
messages.zh: 你为什么回答得这么简短生硬？你生气了吗？
messages.en: Why did you answer me in such a curt tone? Were you angry?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kont mgħaġġel. Ridt inwieġeb fil-qosor, imma ma ridtx inkun goff.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kont mgħaġġel. Ridt inwieġeb fil-qosor, imma ma ridtx inkun goff.
messages.zh: 没有，我当时赶时间。我想简短回答，但并不是想没礼貌。
messages.en: No, I was in a hurry. I wanted to answer briefly, but I didn't mean to be rude.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konċiż 记成“话少”的两种效果：报告话少而清楚是简明，对人话少又冷淡则是生硬；结合语境判断。

gloss_zh: 与马耳他语 konċużjoni 同义的名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun used with the same meaning as the Maltese noun 'konċużjoni'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与马耳他语名词 konċużjoni 表达相同意义的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jintuża bl-istess tifsira tan-nom 'konċużjoni'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与马耳他语名词 konċużjoni 同义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma 'konċiżjoni' għandha l-istess tifsira bħall-kelma 'konċużjoni'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun 'konċiżjoni' is used with the same meaning as the Maltese noun 'konċużjoni'.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, l-istudenti qabblu l-kelma 'konċiżjoni' mal-kelma 'konċużjoni'.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the students compared the word 'konċiżjoni' with the word 'konċużjoni'.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，学生比较了 konċiżjoni 和 konċużjoni 这两个词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kelma għandi nqabbel ma' 'konċiżjoni' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Qabbilha ma' 'konċużjoni', u mbagħad aqra l-eżempju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which word should I match with 'konċiżjoni' in this exercise? Pawlu: Match it with 'konċużjoni', and then read the example.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这道练习里，我该把 konċiżjoni 和哪个词配对？Pawlu：把它和 konċużjoni 配对，然后读例句。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kelma għandi nqabbel ma' 'konċiżjoni' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kelma għandi nqabbel ma' 'konċiżjoni' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里，我该把 konċiżjoni 和哪个词配对？
messages.en: Which word should I match with 'konċiżjoni' in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabbilha ma' 'konċużjoni', u mbagħad aqra l-eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Qabbilha ma' 'konċużjoni', u mbagħad aqra l-eżempju.
messages.zh: 把它和 konċużjoni 配对，然后读例句。
messages.en: Match it with 'konċużjoni', and then read the example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konċiżjoni 与 konċużjoni 写成一对同义词卡片，重点比较两者的拼写；不要只凭字形猜中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Persistent congestion caused by limitations in the layout or capacity of a system or its infrastructure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于系统或基础设施的布局、容量等结构性限制而持续或反复发生的拥堵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konġestjoni li tippersisti jew terġa' sseħħ minħabba limitazzjonijiet fit-tqassim jew fil-kapaċità ta' sistema jew tal-infrastruttura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由设施布局、通行容量或系统结构本身的限制所造成的持续性或反复性拥堵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' konġestjoni kkawżat minn limitazzjonijiet fit-tqassim jew fil-kapaċità tal-infrastruttura jew tas-sistema nnifisha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Structural congestion occurs when the layout or capacity of a system repeatedly prevents traffic or other flows from moving freely.

formal.mt: L-istudju jidentifika l-kapaċità limitata tal-pont bħala kawża tal-konġestjoni strutturali fin-netwerk tat-toroq.
formal.en: The study identifies the bridge's limited capacity as a cause of structural congestion in the road network.
formal.zh: 该研究指出，桥梁通行容量有限是道路网络出现结构性拥堵的一个原因。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dejjem neħlu hawn, anki meta ma jkunx hemm inċident? David: Hawn konġestjoni strutturali: tliet toroq iwasslu għal pont dejjaq wieħed.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do we always get stuck here, even when there isn't an accident? David: There's structural congestion here: three roads lead to a single narrow bridge.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么这里就算没出事故，我们也总是堵住？戴维：这里存在结构性拥堵，三条路都通向同一座窄桥。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem neħlu hawn, anki meta ma jkunx hemm inċident?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem neħlu hawn, anki meta ma jkunx hemm inċident?
messages.zh: 为什么这里就算没出事故，我们也总是堵住？
messages.en: Why do we always get stuck here, even when there isn't an accident?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn konġestjoni strutturali: tliet toroq iwasslu għal pont dejjaq wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn konġestjoni strutturali: tliet toroq iwasslu għal pont dejjaq wieħed.
messages.zh: 这里存在结构性拥堵，三条路都通向同一座窄桥。
messages.en: There's structural congestion here: three roads lead to a single narrow bridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三条宽路汇入一座窄桥：瓶颈来自布局和容量，因而反复堵塞；用这幅图记住“结构性拥堵”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A situation in which market activity exceeds the capacity available to handle it efficiently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 市场中的参与者或交易过于集中，超出市场有效处理能力而造成拥堵或延误的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn l-attività f'suq taqbeż il-kapaċità tiegħu li jaħdem b'mod effiċjenti u toħloq dewmien jew diffikultajiet fit-tranżazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场活动过于集中、处理能力不足而形成的交易拥堵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-konġestjoni tas-suq hija sitwazzjoni fejn għadd kbir ta' parteċipanti jew tranżazzjonijiet jagħmilha diffiċli għas-suq biex jiffunzjona bla dewmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market congestion occurs when concentrated trading activity creates delays or other difficulties within a market.

collocations.mt: il-konġestjoni tas-suq waqt il-ħinijiet l-aktar attivi
collocations.en: market congestion during the busiest periods
collocations.zh: 最繁忙时段的市场拥堵

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jissuġġerixxi sistema aktar effiċjenti għall-ipproċessar tat-tranżazzjonijiet sabiex titnaqqas il-konġestjoni tas-suq.
formal.en: The report proposes a more efficient transaction-processing system to reduce market congestion.
formal.zh: 报告建议采用效率更高的交易处理系统，以缓解市场拥堵。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed idumu daqshekk biex jipproċessaw l-ordnijiet? Mark: Hemm ħafna tranżazzjonijiet fl-istess ħin. Din il-konġestjoni tas-suq qed iddewwem kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they taking so long to process the orders? Mark: There are lots of transactions happening at once. This market congestion is slowing everything down.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们处理这些订单怎么花这么长时间？Mark：同时发生的交易太多了。市场拥堵把一切都拖慢了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed idumu daqshekk biex jipproċessaw l-ordnijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed idumu daqshekk biex jipproċessaw l-ordnijiet?
messages.zh: 他们处理这些订单怎么花这么长时间？
messages.en: Why are they taking so long to process the orders?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħafna tranżazzjonijiet fl-istess ħin. Din il-konġestjoni tas-suq qed iddewwem kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħafna tranżazzjonijiet fl-istess ħin. Din il-konġestjoni tas-suq qed iddewwem kollox.
messages.zh: 同时发生的交易太多了。市场拥堵把一切都拖慢了。
messages.en: There are lots of transactions happening at once. This market congestion is slowing everything down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把市场想成交易车辆经过的路口：交易同时涌入就会堵车，由此记住整个短语表示“市场拥堵”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who coordinates security work within a particular region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责协调某一地区安全事务及相关工作的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkoordina l-ħidma marbuta mas-sigurtà f'reġjun partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地区安全协调员，负责协调特定地区的安全工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli mill-koordinazzjoni tal-ħidma u tal-attivitajiet tas-sigurtà f'reġjun partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A regional security coordinator is someone who organizes and coordinates security work across a particular region.

collocations.en: a meeting with the regional security coordinator
collocations.zh: 与地区安全协调员的会议
地区安全协调员的报告

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur reġjonali tas-sigurtà ħejja rapport dwar il-miżuri tas-sigurtà fir-reġjun.
formal.en: The regional security coordinator prepared a report on security measures in the region.
formal.zh: 地区安全协调员编写了一份关于该地区安全措施的报告。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ma' min għandna l-laqgħa llum? David: Mal-koordinatur reġjonali tas-sigurtà. Se nitkellmu dwar il-pjan il-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who are we meeting with today? David: The regional security coordinator. We're going to discuss the new plan.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们今天要和谁开会？David：地区安全协调员。我们要讨论新计划。

messages.speaker: Marija (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min għandna l-laqgħa llum?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min għandna l-laqgħa llum?
messages.zh: 我们今天要和谁开会？
messages.en: Who are we meeting with today?

messages.speaker: David (安全部门同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-koordinatur reġjonali tas-sigurtà. Se nitkellmu dwar il-pjan il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-koordinatur reġjonali tas-sigurtà. Se nitkellmu dwar il-pjan il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 地区安全协调员。我们要讨论新计划。
messages.en: The regional security coordinator. We're going to discuss the new plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按职责拆记这个词组：koordinatur 是协调员，reġjonali 指地区层面，tas-sigurtà 指安全事务，合起来就是地区安全协调员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small net held in the hand and used to catch or lift fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手握持、用于捕捞或捞起鱼的小型网具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xibka żgħira li tinżamm bl-id u tintuża biex taqbad jew ittella' l-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手持抄网，用于捕捞或从水中捞起鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xibka żgħira li persuna żżomm f'idha biex taqbad il-ħut jew ittellgħu mill-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hand net is a small net that you hold and use to catch or lift fish.

collocations.en: catch a fish with a hand net
lower the hand net into the water

formal.mt: Is-sajjied uża l-kopp biex itella' l-ħuta mill-ilma.
formal.en: The fisherman used the hand net to lift the fish out of the water.
formal.zh: 渔民用抄网把鱼从水中捞了起来。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Tista' tgħaddili l-kopp? Sara: Iva, hawn hu. Il-ħuta qiegħda ħdejn id-dgħajsa.
colloquial.en: Toni: Can you pass me the hand net? Sara: Yes, here it is. The fish is beside the boat.
colloquial.zh: Toni：能把抄网递给我吗？Sara：可以，给你。鱼就在船边。

messages.speaker: Toni (钓鱼者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili l-kopp?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili l-kopp?
messages.zh: 能把抄网递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the hand net?

messages.speaker: Sara (钓鱼同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hu. Il-ħuta qiegħda ħdejn id-dgħajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hu. Il-ħuta qiegħda ħdejn id-dgħajsa.
messages.zh: 可以，给你。鱼就在船边。
messages.en: Yes, here it is. The fish is beside the boat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kopp 时想象一只手握住小网，把船边的鱼捞起来；用“手持、伸入、捞起”的动作串联词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rounded, curved roof over a building or part of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖建筑物或其一部分的圆弧形屋顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saqaf tond u mgħawweġ li jgħatti bini jew parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穹顶，覆盖建筑物整体或局部的圆弧形顶部结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura tonda u mgħawġa li tifforma s-saqaf ta' bini jew ta' parti minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dome is a rounded roof that covers a building or a particular part of it.

formal.mt: Il-koppla tal-ħġieġ tħalli d-dawl naturali jidħol fis-sala.
formal.en: The glass dome allows natural light into the hall.
formal.zh: 玻璃穹顶让自然光照进大厅。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Qed tara l-koppla ta' dik il-knisja? Mark: Iva, tidher minn hawn. Ejja nersqu eqreb.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can you see the dome of that church? Mark: Yes, you can see it from here. Let's get closer.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你看见那座教堂的穹顶了吗？Mark：看见了，从这里就能看到。我们走近一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara l-koppla ta' dik il-knisja?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara l-koppla ta' dik il-knisja?
messages.zh: 你看见那座教堂的穹顶了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the dome of that church?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tidher minn hawn. Ejja nersqu eqreb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tidher minn hawn. Ejja nersqu eqreb.
messages.zh: 看见了，从这里就能看到。我们走近一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, you can see it from here. Let's get closer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 koppla 就想象教堂上方像倒扣半球的圆顶，再用“抬头看穹顶”的场景巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 共同所有人；持份所有人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who owns something together with one or more other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与一个或多个他人共同拥有某项财产的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha proprjetà flimkien ma' persuna oħra jew ma' diversi persuni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与他人共同拥有同一财产的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taqsam il-proprjetà ta' xi ħaġa ma' persuna oħra jew ma' diversi persuni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A joint owner is someone who owns something together with at least one other person.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥有某项财产部分份额的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha sehem fil-proprjetà ta' xi ħaġa, iżda ma tkunx l-uniku sid tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A part owner is someone who owns a share of something rather than the whole of it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li s-Sur Borg huwa koproprjetarju tal-bini flimkien ma' oħtu.
formal.en: The report indicates that Mr Borg is a joint owner of the building together with his sister.
formal.zh: 报告指出，博格先生与其姐妹共同拥有这栋建筑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int is-sid ta' dan il-ħanut? Mark: Jien koproprjetarju; il-ħanut huwa tiegħi u ta' ħija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you own this shop? Mark: I'm a joint owner; the shop belongs to my brother and me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这家店是你的吗？马克：我是共同所有人；这家店是我和我兄弟的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int is-sid ta' dan il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Int is-sid ta' dan il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 这家店是你的吗？
messages.en: Do you own this shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien koproprjetarju; il-ħanut huwa tiegħi u ta' ħija.
messages.mt_standard: Jien koproprjetarju; il-ħanut huwa tiegħi u ta' ħija.
messages.zh: 我是共同所有人；这家店是我和我兄弟的。
messages.en: I'm a joint owner; the shop belongs to my brother and me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张房契上写着两个人的名字：koproprjetarju 强调共同拥有，也可以着重表示其中一人拥有部分份额。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who sing together, often in a performance or religious service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一起演唱的团体，常在演出或宗教仪式中献唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jkantaw flimkien, spiss waqt kunċert jew servizz reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多名成员组成、共同演唱的合唱团。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' kantanti li jkantaw flimkien bħala grupp organizzat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A choir is an organized group of people who sing together.

formal.mt: Il-kor tal-iskola se jiftaħ il-kunċert b'żewġ kanzunetti bil-Malti.
formal.en: The school choir will open the concert with two songs in Maltese.
formal.zh: 学校合唱团将演唱两首马耳他语歌曲，为音乐会开场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejra l-iskola llejla? Nina: Għandi prova mal-kor. Trid tiġi tismagħna? Lara: Iva, niġi!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you going to school tonight? Nina: I have a rehearsal with the choir. Do you want to come and listen to us? Lara: Yes, I'll come!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今晚为什么要去学校？妮娜：我要和合唱团排练。你想来听我们唱歌吗？拉拉：好啊，我来！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejra l-iskola llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejra l-iskola llejla?
messages.zh: 你今晚为什么要去学校？
messages.en: Why are you going to school tonight?

messages.speaker: Nina (合唱团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi prova mal-kor. Trid tiġi tismagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi prova mal-kor. Trid tiġi tismagħna?
messages.zh: 我要和合唱团排练。你想来听我们唱歌吗？
messages.en: I have a rehearsal with the choir. Do you want to come and listen to us?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi!
messages.zh: 好啊，我来！
messages.en: Yes, I'll come!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kor 和一群人站成几排、一起开口唱歌的画面绑定；记住它指整个合唱团。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A length of strong, flexible material used for tying things; also, a combination of musical notes sounded together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捆绑物品的柔韧绳索；也指多个音同时发声构成的和弦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tul ta' materjal b'saħħtu u flessibbli li jintuża biex torbot l-affarijiet; fil-mużika, taħlita ta' noti li jindaqqu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于系紧、捆绑或悬挂物品的绳或细绳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħabel irqiq u flessibbli li jintuża biex torbot, twaħħal jew iddendel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cord is a length of thin rope used for tying or hanging things.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音乐中的和弦，即多个不同音高的音同时发声的组合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħlita ta' diversi noti mużikali ta' għoli differenti li jindaqqu fl-istess ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chord is a group of musical notes of different pitches sounded together.

collocations.en: to play a chord on the piano
collocations.zh: 在钢琴上弹奏一个和弦

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-mużika, kull student għandu jdoqq korda fuq il-pjanu u jidentifika n-noti tagħha.
formal.en: In the music exercise, each student should play a chord on the piano and identify its notes.
formal.zh: 在音乐练习中，每位学生应在钢琴上弹奏一个和弦，并辨认组成它的各个音。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek korda biex norbot din il-kaxxa? Pawlu: Iva, hemm waħda fil-kexxun. Sara: Tajjeb, issa nista' norbotha sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a cord I can use to tie up this box? Pawlu: Yes, there's one in the drawer. Sara: Good, now I can tie it securely.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有绳子让我把这个箱子捆起来吗？保罗：有，抽屉里有一根。萨拉：太好了，现在我可以把它捆牢了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek korda biex norbot din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek korda biex norbot din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你有绳子让我把这个箱子捆起来吗？
messages.en: Do you have a cord I can use to tie up this box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: 有，抽屉里有一根。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the drawer.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa nista' norbotha sew.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa nista' norbotha sew.
messages.zh: 太好了，现在我可以把它捆牢了。
messages.en: Good, now I can tie it securely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 korda 配两张记忆图：一根绳子捆箱子，几个琴键同时按下形成和弦；靠场景区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 韩国的；朝鲜的；朝鲜半岛相关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from or connected with North Korea or South Korea, their people, or their culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自朝鲜或韩国的，或与两国的人民、文化等有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Korea ta' Fuq jew mill-Korea t'Isfel, jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dawn il-pajjiżi, man-nies tagħhom jew mal-kultura tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝鲜的或韩国的；与朝鲜半岛人民、语言或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Korea, man-nies tagħha, mal-lingwa tagħhom jew mal-kultura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Korean is connected with Korea, its people, language, or culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to North or South Korea
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自朝鲜或韩国的，或与这两个国家之一有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Korea ta' Fuq jew mill-Korea t'Isfel, jew li għandu rabta ma' wieħed minn dawn iż-żewġ pajjiżi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described as Korean comes from or is associated with North Korea or South Korea.

collocations.zh: 来自朝鲜或韩国的学生

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi film korean mill-Korea t'Isfel, b'sottotitli bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a Korean film from South Korea, with English subtitles.
formal.zh: 电影节的节目包括一部来自韩国、配有英语字幕的电影。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tipprova ikel korean illejla? Mark: Iva! Taf xi restorant tajjeb? Maja: Hemm wieħed ħdejn l-istazzjon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to try Korean food tonight? Mark: Yes! Do you know a good restaurant? Maja: There's one near the station.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚想尝尝韩餐吗？马克：想！你知道哪家餐馆不错吗？玛雅：车站附近有一家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tipprova ikel korean illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tipprova ikel korean illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚想尝尝韩餐吗？
messages.en: Do you want to try Korean food tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Taf xi restorant tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Taf xi restorant tajjeb?
messages.zh: 想！你知道哪家餐馆不错吗？
messages.en: Yes! Do you know a good restaurant?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wieħed ħdejn l-istazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wieħed ħdejn l-istazzjon.
messages.zh: 车站附近有一家。
messages.en: There's one near the station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 Korean 联想 korean，记住它是修饰人的来源或事物文化归属的形容词；具体指朝鲜还是韩国，要结合上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who creates and arranges dance movements for a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为演出设计舞蹈动作并编排动作顺序的女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li toħloq u torganizza l-movimenti taż-żfin għal wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为演出创作和编排舞蹈动作的女性编舞师。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li tfassal il-passi u s-sekwenzi taż-żfin u torganizzahom għal wirja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A female choreographer is a woman whose work involves creating and arranging dances for performances.

collocations.en: to work as a female choreographer

formal.mt: Il-koreografa ħejjiet sekwenza ġdida ta' movimenti għall-wirja tal-iskola.
formal.en: The female choreographer prepared a new sequence of movements for the school performance.
formal.zh: 女编舞师为学校演出编排了一组新的动作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jurina l-passi l-ġodda? Pawlu: Il-koreografa se tiġi wara nofsinhar biex turihomlna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will show us the new steps? Pawlu: The female choreographer will come this afternoon to show them to us.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁来教我们新的舞步？Pawlu：女编舞师今天下午会来教我们。

messages.speaker: Marija (舞者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jurina l-passi l-ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jurina l-passi l-ġodda?
messages.zh: 谁来教我们新的舞步？
messages.en: Who will show us the new steps?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (舞者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-koreografa se tiġi wara nofsinhar biex turihomlna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-koreografa se tiġi wara nofsinhar biex turihomlna.
messages.zh: 女编舞师今天下午会来教我们。
messages.en: The female choreographer will come this afternoon to show them to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位女性站在排练室前示范舞步，把 koreografa 与“女编舞师”一起记忆；再与表示男性编舞师的 koreografu 对照。

gloss_zh: 经过编舞的；动作经过编排的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a dance or scene whose movements have been planned and arranged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容舞蹈或场景中的动作已经经过设计和编排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi żifna jew xena li l-movimenti tagħha jkunu ġew ippjanati u organizzati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞蹈或场景中的动作已经按一定顺序设计、编排好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tingħad għal żifna jew xena li l-passi u l-movimenti tagħha jkunu ġew imfassla u rranġati minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dance or scene that is choreographed has its movements deliberately planned and arranged.

collocations.zh: 动作经过精心编排的场景

formal.mt: Il-wirja tinkludi żifna koreografata apposta għall-istudenti tal-ewwel sena.
formal.en: The performance includes a dance choreographed specifically for first-year students.
formal.zh: 这场演出包含一支专门为一年级学生编排的舞蹈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din iż-żifna koreografata jew kulħadd jiċċaqlaq kif irid? Mark: Koreografata. Irridu nsegwu l-istess passi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this dance choreographed, or does everyone move however they want? Mark: It's choreographed. We have to follow the same steps.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这支舞是编排好的，还是大家想怎么跳就怎么跳？Mark：是编排好的。我们得跳相同的舞步。

messages.speaker: Lara (舞蹈学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iż-żifna koreografata jew kulħadd jiċċaqlaq kif irid?
messages.mt_standard: Din iż-żifna koreografata jew kulħadd jiċċaqlaq kif irid?
messages.zh: 这支舞是编排好的，还是大家想怎么跳就怎么跳？
messages.en: Is this dance choreographed, or does everyone move however they want?

messages.speaker: Mark (舞蹈学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Koreografata. Irridu nsegwu l-istess passi.
messages.mt_standard: Koreografata. Irridu nsegwu l-istess passi.
messages.zh: 是编排好的。我们得跳相同的舞步。
messages.en: It's choreographed. We have to follow the same steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żifna koreografata 想成一支已有动作顺序表的舞：每一步都事先安排好，用这个画面记住“经过编舞的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The art or process of arranging dance movements, or the arrangement created for a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设计和组织舞蹈动作的艺术或过程，也指为某场演出创作的舞蹈编排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-arti jew il-proċess tat-tfassil u l-organizzazzjoni tal-movimenti taż-żfin, jew l-arranġament li jinħoloq għal wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞蹈动作及其顺序的设计与编排，也指编排完成的动作组合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tfassil u l-arranġament tal-passi u l-movimenti taż-żfin, kif ukoll is-sekwenzi li jinħolqu għal wirja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Choreography is the art of arranging dance movements or the particular arrangement used in a performance.

collocations.zh: 学习编排好的舞蹈动作

formal.mt: Il-koreografija tal-wirja tgħaqqad passi sempliċi ma' movimenti aktar kumplessi.
formal.en: The choreography for the performance combines simple steps with more complex movements.
formal.zh: 这场演出的舞蹈编排将简单舞步与较复杂的动作结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tgħallimt il-koreografija kollha? Ġanni: Kważi. Għad irrid nipprattika l-aħħar parti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you learned all the choreography? Ġanni: Almost. I still need to practise the last part.
colloquial.zh: Sara：整套编排的舞蹈动作你都学会了吗？Ġanni：差不多了。我还得练习最后一部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (舞者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħallimt il-koreografija kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Tgħallimt il-koreografija kollha?
messages.zh: 整套编排的舞蹈动作你都学会了吗？
messages.en: Have you learned all the choreography?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (舞者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad irrid nipprattika l-aħħar parti.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad irrid nipprattika l-aħħar parti.
messages.zh: 差不多了。我还得练习最后一部分。
messages.en: Almost. I still need to practise the last part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 koreografija 想成整套舞蹈的“动作路线图”：何时抬手、何时转身都排好，帮助记住它指编舞或舞蹈编排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man who creates and arranges dance movements for a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为演出设计舞蹈动作并编排动作顺序的男性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li joħloq u jorganizza l-movimenti taż-żfin għal wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为演出创作和编排舞蹈动作的男性编舞师。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raġel li jfassal il-passi u s-sekwenzi taż-żfin u jorganizzahom għal wirja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A male choreographer is a man whose work involves creating and arranging dances for performances.

collocations.en: to work as a male choreographer

formal.mt: Il-koreografu mexxa l-provi u spjega liż-żeffiena kif għandhom jiċċaqalqu flimkien.
formal.en: The male choreographer led the rehearsals and explained to the dancers how they should move together.
formal.zh: 男编舞师主持了排练，并向舞者说明如何协调动作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-koreografu ġej għall-prova llum? David: Iva, se jgħinna bl-aħħar żifna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the male choreographer coming to rehearsal today? David: Yes, he'll help us with the final dance.
colloquial.zh: Nina：男编舞师今天会来排练吗？David：会，他会指导我们练最后一支舞。

messages.speaker: Nina (舞者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-koreografu ġej għall-prova llum?
messages.mt_standard: Il-koreografu ġej għall-prova llum?
messages.zh: 男编舞师今天会来排练吗？
messages.en: Is the male choreographer coming to rehearsal today?

messages.speaker: David (舞者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jgħinna bl-aħħar żifna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jgħinna bl-aħħar żifna.
messages.zh: 会，他会指导我们练最后一支舞。
messages.en: Yes, he'll help us with the final dance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位男性在排练时安排舞步，把 koreografu 与“男编舞师”配对记忆；与 koreografa 对照时，先辨认人物，再回想对应词。

gloss_zh: 团；兵团；有组织的专业队伍

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized group of people who perform a shared military, professional, or public service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为执行共同的军事、专业或公共服务任务而组成的有组织队伍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp organizzat ta' persuni li jaħdmu flimkien biex iwettqu dmirijiet militari, professjonali jew ta' servizz pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为特定军事、专业或公共服务任务组成的团体或队伍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaqda organizzata ta' persuni li għandhom taħriġ jew dmirijiet komuni f'qasam militari, professjonali jew ta' servizz pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corps is an organized group of people who carry out a particular military, professional, or public service.

formal.mt: Il-korp diplomatiku attenda ċ-ċerimonja uffiċjali.
formal.en: The diplomatic corps attended the official ceremony.
formal.zh: 外交使团出席了官方仪式。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħuk għadu fil-korp tal-pulizija? Pawlu: Iva, u din il-ġimgħa qed jagħmel taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is your brother still in the police corps? Pawlu: Yes, and he is doing training this week.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你哥哥还在警队吗？Pawlu：是的，他这周正在参加培训。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk għadu fil-korp tal-pulizija?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk għadu fil-korp tal-pulizija?
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在警队吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still in the police corps?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u din il-ġimgħa qed jagħmel taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u din il-ġimgħa qed jagħmel taħriġ.
messages.zh: 是的，他这周正在参加培训。
messages.en: Yes, and he is doing training this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korp 联想成穿着统一制服、执行共同任务的一整支队伍；搭配 diplomatiku 记外交使团，搭配 tal-pulizija 记警队。

gloss_zh: 受公法规范的机构；公法机构

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organization whose legal status and activities are governed by public law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其法律地位和活动受公法规范的组织或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni li l-istatus legali u l-attivitajiet tagħha huma rregolati mil-liġi pubblika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法律地位和活动受公法规范的机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Korp li l-istatus legali tiegħu u l-mod kif iwettaq l-attivitajiet tiegħu huma rregolati mil-liġi pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A body governed by public law is an organization whose legal status and activities are regulated by public law.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公法机构，即其法律地位和活动由公法规范的组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni li għandha status legali u twettaq l-attivitajiet tagħha skont ir-regoli tal-liġi pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public law body is an organization that operates under the rules of public law.

collocations.mt: l-istatus ta' korp irregolat bil-liġi pubblika
collocations.en: the status of a body governed by public law
collocations.zh: 受公法规范的机构的法律地位

collocations.mt: il-kompiti ta' korp irregolat bil-liġi pubblika
collocations.en: the tasks of a public law body

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istatus legali u l-kompiti tal-organizzazzjoni bħala korp irregolat bil-liġi pubblika.
formal.en: The report describes the organization's legal status and tasks as a body governed by public law.
formal.zh: 报告说明了该组织作为公法机构的法律地位和任务。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser hawn 'korp irregolat bil-liġi pubblika'? Mark: Ifisser organizzazzjoni li l-istatus u l-attivitajiet tagħha huma rregolati mil-liġi pubblika.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'body governed by public law' mean here? Mark: It means an organization whose status and activities are governed by public law.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这里的“受公法规范的机构”是什么意思？Mark：指法律地位和活动受公法规范的组织。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser hawn 'korp irregolat bil-liġi pubblika'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser hawn 'korp irregolat bil-liġi pubblika'?
messages.zh: 这里的“受公法规范的机构”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'body governed by public law' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser organizzazzjoni li l-istatus u l-attivitajiet tagħha huma rregolati mil-liġi pubblika.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser organizzazzjoni li l-istatus u l-attivitajiet tagħha huma rregolati mil-liġi pubblika.
messages.zh: 指法律地位和活动受公法规范的组织。
messages.en: It means an organization whose status and activities are governed by public law.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分块记：korp 是机构，irregolat 表示受规范，bil-liġi pubblika 表示依据公法；把整句想成贴着“受公法规范”标签的机构。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A national organization that formally recognizes the competence of bodies to carry out specified assessment activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在国家层面正式认可有关机构具备开展特定评定活动能力的组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni fil-livell nazzjonali li tirrikonoxxi formalment il-kompetenza ta' korpi biex iwettqu attivitajiet speċifiċi ta' valutazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国家层面的认可机构，负责正式确认有关机构具备开展特定评定活动的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Korp fil-livell nazzjonali li jivvaluta u jirrikonoxxi formalment jekk korpi oħra għandhomx il-kompetenza meħtieġa biex iwettqu attivitajiet speċifiċi ta' valutazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A national accreditation body is an organization that formally recognizes whether other bodies are competent to perform specified assessment activities.

collocations.mt: tapplika għand il-korp nazzjonali ta' akkreditament
collocations.en: apply to the national accreditation body
collocations.zh: 向国家认可机构提出申请

collocations.en: an assessment by the national accreditation body
collocations.zh: 国家认可机构进行的评定

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju ressaq applikazzjoni lill-korp nazzjonali ta' akkreditament biex tiġi vvalutata l-kompetenza tiegħu.
formal.en: The laboratory submitted an application to the national accreditation body to have its competence assessed.
formal.zh: 该实验室向国家认可机构提交了申请，以接受能力评定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min bgħatna l-applikazzjoni tal-laboratorju? David: Lill-korp nazzjonali ta' akkreditament. Issa qed nistennew tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who did we send the laboratory's application to? David: To the national accreditation body. We are waiting for a reply now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们把实验室的申请发给谁了？David：国家认可机构。现在正在等回复。

messages.speaker: Lara (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min bgħatna l-applikazzjoni tal-laboratorju?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min bgħatna l-applikazzjoni tal-laboratorju?
messages.zh: 我们把实验室的申请发给谁了？
messages.en: Who did we send the laboratory's application to?

messages.speaker: David (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lill-korp nazzjonali ta' akkreditament. Issa qed nistennew tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Lill-korp nazzjonali ta' akkreditament. Issa qed nistennew tweġiba.
messages.zh: 国家认可机构。现在正在等回复。
messages.en: To the national accreditation body. We are waiting for a reply now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“国家机构审核能力”的画面记整组词：korp 对应机构，nazzjonali 对应国家层面，ta' akkreditament 对应认可；想象实验室递交能力评定申请。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A company or organization that has a legal identity separate from its members or owners.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有独立于其成员或所有者的法律身份的公司或组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kumpanija jew organizzazzjoni li għandha identità legali separata minn dik tal-membri jew tas-sidien tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依法具有独立法律身份的公司或组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kumpanija jew organizzazzjoni rikonoxxuta mil-liġi bħala entità separata mill-persuni li huma membri jew sidien tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corporation is a company or organization that the law recognizes as having a separate legal identity.

formal.mt: Il-korporazzjoni ppubblikat ir-rapport annwali tagħha wara li ġie approvat mill-bord tad-diretturi.
formal.en: The corporation published its annual report after it was approved by the board of directors.
formal.zh: 该公司的年度报告经董事会批准后予以发布。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn taħdem issa? Ġorġ: Naħdem ma' korporazzjoni multinazzjonali, fl-uffiċċju tagħha f'Malta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where do you work now? Ġorġ: I work for a multinational corporation, at its office in Malta.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你现在在哪里工作？Ġorġ：我在一家跨国公司的马耳他办事处工作。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn taħdem issa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn taħdem issa?
messages.zh: 你现在在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where do you work now?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem ma' korporazzjoni multinazzjonali, fl-uffiċċju tagħha f'Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdem ma' korporazzjoni multinazzjonali, fl-uffiċċju tagħha f'Malta.
messages.zh: 我在一家跨国公司的马耳他办事处工作。
messages.en: I work for a multinational corporation, at its office in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korporazzjoni 与英语 corporation 配对记忆，再想象一家公司以自己的名义发布年报，帮助记住“具有独立法律身份的公司或组织”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Written communication exchanged between people or organisations, or the letters and messages involved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构之间通过信件等书面形式进行的通信，也指这些往来的信件或信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Komunikazzjoni bil-miktub bejn persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet, jew l-ittri u l-messaġġi li jintbagħtu bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通信；个人或机构之间往来的书面信件或信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-komunikazzjoni bil-miktub bejn persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet, kif ukoll il-ġabra ta' ittri u messaġġi li jiskambjaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Correspondence is written communication between people or organisations, or the letters and messages they exchange.

formal.mt: Il-korrispondenza kollha dwar din it-talba għandha tintbagħat lid-dipartiment responsabbli.
formal.en: All correspondence concerning this request should be sent to the responsible department.
formal.zh: 所有涉及此项申请的往来函件均应寄送至负责部门。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn poġġejt il-korrispondenza tal-lum? Pawlu: Fuq l-iskrivanija tiegħek, ħdejn il-kompjuter.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did you put today's correspondence? Pawlu: On your desk, next to the computer.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你把今天的信件放在哪里了？Pawlu：在你的办公桌上，电脑旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (办公室职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt il-korrispondenza tal-lum?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt il-korrispondenza tal-lum?
messages.zh: 你把今天的信件放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put today's correspondence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-iskrivanija tiegħek, ħdejn il-kompjuter.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-iskrivanija tiegħek, ħdejn il-kompjuter.
messages.zh: 在你的办公桌上，电脑旁边。
messages.en: On your desk, next to the computer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korrispondenza 想成办公桌上收进、寄出的一叠信：既可记通信活动，也可记往来信件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest and willing to misuse a position of trust or authority for personal gain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不诚实并利用受托地位或职权谋取私利的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi b'mod diżonest u jabbuża mill-pożizzjoni jew mill-poter tiegħu biex jikseb vantaġġ personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐败的；滥用职权或受托地位谋取私利的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jabbuża mill-fiduċja jew mill-awtorità mogħtija lilu sabiex jikseb flus jew vantaġġi personali b'mod diżonest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is corrupt uses their position or authority dishonestly to obtain money or other personal advantages.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi uffiċjal korrott li aċċetta flus biex jagħti trattament preferenzjali lil kumpanija.
formal.en: The report describes a corrupt official who accepted money to give a company preferential treatment.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名收受钱财、给予某家公司优待的腐败官员。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri uffiċjal korrott? Mark: Ngħidu aħna, uffiċjal li jieħu flus bil-moħbi biex jagħti vantaġġ lil xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a corrupt official mean? Mark: For example, an official who secretly takes money to give someone an advantage.
colloquial.zh: Lara：腐败官员是什么意思？Mark：比如，暗中收钱来给某个人好处的官员。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri uffiċjal korrott?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri uffiċjal korrott?
messages.zh: 腐败官员是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a corrupt official mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu aħna, uffiċjal li jieħu flus bil-moħbi biex jagħti vantaġġ lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu aħna, uffiċjal li jieħu flus bil-moħbi biex jagħti vantaġġ lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 比如，暗中收钱来给某个人好处的官员。
messages.en: For example, an official who secretly takes money to give someone an advantage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korrott 配上官员暗中收钱的画面，记住它描述腐败行为；再与表示受伤的 korrut 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physically hurt as a result of an accident, a fall, or another harmful event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因事故、跌倒或其他造成伤害的事件而身体受伤的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sofra ħsara f'ġismu minħabba inċident, waqgħa jew ġrajja oħra li kkawżatlu ġrieħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受伤的；身体因事故或其他外来伤害而受到损伤的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ġrieħi jew ħsara f'ġismu minħabba inċident jew xi ħaġa li weġġgħetu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person who is injured has suffered physical harm in an accident or another damaging event.

formal.mt: Il-passiġġier korrut ingħata l-ewwel għajnuna qabel ittieħed l-isptar.
formal.en: The injured passenger received first aid before being taken to hospital.
formal.zh: 这名受伤乘客在被送往医院前接受了急救。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex David mhux se jilgħab illum? Luqa: Għadu korrut u għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why isn't David playing today? Luqa: He's still injured and needs to rest.
colloquial.zh: Sara：David 今天为什么不上场？Luqa：他还有伤，需要休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex David mhux se jilgħab illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex David mhux se jilgħab illum?
messages.zh: David 今天为什么不上场？
messages.en: Why isn't David playing today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (球队队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu korrut u għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu korrut u għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他还有伤，需要休息。
messages.en: He's still injured and needs to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korrut 和场边休息的受伤球员联系起来，用 plejer korrut 整块记忆，并留意它与 korrott 的拼写区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest conduct involving the misuse of authority or a position of trust for private benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 滥用职权或受托地位以谋取私利的不诚实行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba diżonesta li tinvolvi l-abbuż mill-poter jew minn pożizzjoni ta' fiduċja biex jinkiseb benefiċċju privat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐败；通过滥用职权、收受贿赂等方式谋取私利的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-abbuż mill-awtorità jew minn pożizzjoni ta' fiduċja għal qligħ personali, pereżempju billi jiġu aċċettati flus biex jingħata trattament preferenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Corruption is dishonest behaviour in which people misuse authority or a position of trust for private benefit.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irrakkomanda kontrolli aktar stretti biex titnaqqas il-korruzzjoni fl-għoti tal-kuntratti pubbliċi.
formal.en: The committee recommended stricter controls to reduce corruption in the awarding of public contracts.
formal.zh: 委员会建议加强监管，以减少公共合同授予过程中的腐败。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq xiex kien il-programm tal-bieraħ? Adam: Fuq il-korruzzjoni u kif wieħed jista' jirrapporta talba għal flus biex jingħata vantaġġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was yesterday's programme about? Adam: Corruption, and how someone can report being asked for money in return for an advantage.
colloquial.zh: Nina：昨天的节目讲什么？Adam：讲腐败，以及有人索要钱财才肯给予好处时，可以怎样举报。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex kien il-programm tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex kien il-programm tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天的节目讲什么？
messages.en: What was yesterday's programme about?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-korruzzjoni u kif wieħed jista' jirrapporta talba għal flus biex jingħata vantaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-korruzzjoni u kif wieħed jista' jirrapporta talba għal flus biex jingħata vantaġġ.
messages.zh: 讲腐败，以及有人索要钱财才肯给予好处时，可以怎样举报。
messages.en: Corruption, and how someone can report being asked for money in return for an advantage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korruzzjoni 放进“反腐败”搭配 kontra l-korruzzjoni 中记忆；它命名腐败行为，korrott 则可用来描述腐败的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The money accepted and used for payments in a particular country or economy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个国家或经济体接受并用于支付的货币。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-flus aċċettati u użati għall-ħlasijiet f'pajjiż jew f'ekonomija partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个国家或经济体中通行、用于支付的货币。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-flus li jintużaw u jiġu aċċettati bħala mezz ta' ħlas f'pajjiż jew f'ekonomija partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A currency is the money that people accept and use for payments in a particular country or economy.

formal.mt: Il-gwida għall-viżitaturi tispjega liema kors tal-flus jintuża fil-pajjiż.
formal.en: The visitors' guide explains which currency is used in the country.
formal.zh: 游客指南说明该国使用哪种货币。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf liema kors tal-flus jużaw hemm? Mark: Le, irridu niċċekkjaw qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know which currency they use there? Mark: No, we need to check before we leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道那里用哪种货币吗？马克：不知道，我们得在出发前查一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf liema kors tal-flus jużaw hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Taf liema kors tal-flus jużaw hemm?
messages.zh: 你知道那里用哪种货币吗？
messages.en: Do you know which currency they use there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irridu niċċekkjaw qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irridu niċċekkjaw qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 不知道，我们得在出发前查一下。
messages.en: No, we need to check before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进旅行付款场景：出发前先问当地用什么货币，借此记住“货币”这一义项。

gloss_zh: 交易成本；办理交易所需费用

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cost incurred in arranging or carrying out a transaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为安排或完成一项交易而产生的成本或费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spiża li ssir biex tiġi organizzata jew titwettaq tranżazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安排或完成某项交易所产生的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ispiża marbuta mal-organizzazzjoni jew mat-twettiq ta' tranżazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The cost of a transaction is an expense involved in arranging or completing that transaction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交易成本，即为促成或执行交易而承担的成本。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spiża li wieħed iġarrab sabiex jorganizza jew iwettaq skambju jew ftehim kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transaction cost is an expense you incur when arranging or carrying out an exchange.

formal.mt: Il-kummissjoni tal-intermedjarju hija kost ta' tranżazzjoni li għandu jitqies meta jiġu mqabbla żewġ offerti.
formal.en: The intermediary's commission is a transaction cost that should be considered when comparing two offers.
formal.zh: 中介佣金属于交易成本，在比较两份报价时应将其考虑在内。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħallast żewġ ewro aktar? Nina: Is-servizz talab ħlas biex iwettaq it-tranżazzjoni. Dak hu kost ta' tranżazzjoni. Mark: Mela d-darba li jmiss inqabbel ukoll il-ħlasijiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you pay two euros more? Nina: The service charged a fee to carry out the transaction. That's a transaction cost. Mark: Then next time I'll compare the fees too.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么多付了两欧元？妮娜：这个服务办理交易要收手续费。那就是交易成本。马克：那我下次也要比较手续费。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallast żewġ ewro aktar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallast żewġ ewro aktar?
messages.zh: 你为什么多付了两欧元？
messages.en: Why did you pay two euros more?

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-servizz talab ħlas biex iwettaq it-tranżazzjoni. Dak hu kost ta' tranżazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Is-servizz talab ħlas biex iwettaq it-tranżazzjoni. Dak hu kost ta' tranżazzjoni.
messages.zh: 这个服务办理交易要收手续费。那就是交易成本。
messages.en: The service charged a fee to carry out the transaction. That's a transaction cost.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela d-darba li jmiss inqabbel ukoll il-ħlasijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela d-darba li jmiss inqabbel ukoll il-ħlasijiet.
messages.zh: 那我下次也要比较手续费。
messages.en: Then next time I'll compare the fees too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把购买商品和办理交易分开想：为撮合、安排或执行交易支付的手续费，是记住“交易成本”的直观例子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The value of the best alternative you give up when you make a choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作出某项选择时，所放弃的最佳替代选择的价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur tal-aħjar alternattiva li wieħed iċedi meta jagħmel għażla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选择某种用途或行动而放弃的最佳替代用途或行动的价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur tal-aħjar użu jew azzjoni alternattiva li wieħed iċedi meta jagħżel użu jew azzjoni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The opportunity cost of a choice is the value of the best alternative that you give up.

formal.mt: Jekk l-aħjar alternattiva għall-istudju hija xogħol bi ħlas, il-paga li l-istudent iċedi tifforma parti mill-kost tal-għażla tal-istudju.
formal.en: If the best alternative to studying is paid work, the wages the student gives up form part of the opportunity cost of studying.
formal.zh: 如果学习之外的最佳选择是有偿工作，那么学生放弃的工资就构成学习机会成本的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' naħdem is-Sibt u naqla' sittin ewro, imma se mmur għall-kors. Lara: Jekk ix-xogħol hu l-aħjar alternattiva tiegħek, dawk is-sittin ewro huma parti mill-kost tal-għażla. Maja: Mela rrid inqis ukoll il-paga li se nitlef.
colloquial.en: Maja: I could work on Saturday and earn sixty euros, but I'm going to the course. Lara: If working is your best alternative, those sixty euros are part of the opportunity cost. Maja: So I also need to consider the wages I'll miss out on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我星期六本来可以工作赚六十欧元，但我打算去上课。拉拉：如果工作是你的最佳替代选择，那六十欧元就是机会成本的一部分。玛雅：那我也得把放弃的工资考虑进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' naħdem is-Sibt u naqla' sittin ewro, imma se mmur għall-kors.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' naħdem is-Sibt u naqla' sittin ewro, imma se mmur għall-kors.
messages.zh: 我星期六本来可以工作赚六十欧元，但我打算去上课。
messages.en: I could work on Saturday and earn sixty euros, but I'm going to the course.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk ix-xogħol hu l-aħjar alternattiva tiegħek, dawk is-sittin ewro huma parti mill-kost tal-għażla.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk ix-xogħol hu l-aħjar alternattiva tiegħek, dawk is-sittin ewro huma parti mill-kost tal-għażla.
messages.zh: 如果工作是你的最佳替代选择，那六十欧元就是机会成本的一部分。
messages.en: If working is your best alternative, those sixty euros are part of the opportunity cost.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid inqis ukoll il-paga li se nitlef.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid inqis ukoll il-paga li se nitlef.
messages.zh: 那我也得把放弃的工资考虑进去。
messages.en: So I also need to consider the wages I'll miss out on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象周六只能选工作或上课：选择上课，就把最佳替代选择中放弃的收入贴上“机会成本”标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trade term indicating that the quoted price includes the cost of the goods and freight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示报价包括货物成本和运费的贸易术语，英文缩写为 CFR。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu kummerċjali li jindika li l-prezz ikkwotat jinkludi l-kost tal-merkanzija u n-nol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: CFR，即“成本加运费”这一贸易术语的英文缩写。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-terminu kummerċjali kost u nol, indikat bl-abbrevjazzjoni Ingliża CFR, li jfisser li l-prezz jinkludi l-kost tal-merkanzija u n-nol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: CFR is the abbreviation for cost and freight, a trade term used in quotations for goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成本加运费，指报价包含货物成本及运费的贸易术语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu fil-kummerċ li jfisser li l-prezz ikkwotat ikopri kemm il-kost tal-merkanzija kif ukoll in-nol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cost and freight is a trade term indicating that a quoted price includes the goods and freight.

collocations.mt: prezz fuq bażi ta' kost u nol
collocations.en: a price on a cost and freight basis
collocations.zh: 按成本加运费条件报出的价格

collocations.mt: kwotazzjoni fuq bażi ta' kost u nol
collocations.en: a quotation on a cost and freight basis
collocations.zh: 按成本加运费条件出具的报价

formal.mt: Il-fornitur ippreżenta kwotazzjoni fuq bażi ta' kost u nol, u indika li l-prezz jinkludi l-merkanzija u n-nol.
formal.en: The supplier submitted a quotation on a cost and freight basis, indicating that the price includes the goods and freight.
formal.zh: 供应商提交了按成本加运费条件出具的报价，并注明价格包括货物和运费。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser CFR f'din il-kwotazzjoni? Paul: Ifisser kost u nol: il-prezz jinkludi l-merkanzija u n-nol. Maja: Tajjeb, issa nifhem x'jinkludi dan il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does CFR mean in this quotation? Paul: It means cost and freight: the price includes the goods and freight. Maja: Good, now I understand what this price includes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份报价里的 CFR 是什么意思？保罗：意思是成本加运费，价格包括货物和运费。玛雅：好的，现在我明白这个价格包含什么了。

messages.speaker: Maja (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser CFR f'din il-kwotazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser CFR f'din il-kwotazzjoni?
messages.zh: 这份报价里的 CFR 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does CFR mean in this quotation?

messages.speaker: Paul (供应商代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser kost u nol: il-prezz jinkludi l-merkanzija u n-nol.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser kost u nol: il-prezz jinkludi l-merkanzija u n-nol.
messages.zh: 意思是成本加运费，价格包括货物和运费。
messages.en: It means cost and freight: the price includes the goods and freight.

messages.speaker: Maja (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa nifhem x'jinkludi dan il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa nifhem x'jinkludi dan il-prezz.
messages.zh: 好的，现在我明白这个价格包含什么了。
messages.en: Good, now I understand what this price includes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把报价想成两个并排的格子：kost 对应货物成本，nol 对应运费，中间的 u 表示“和”，合起来记作 CFR。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The land along the edge of the sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿着海洋边缘延伸的陆地区域，即海岸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-art tul ix-xifer tal-baħar, fejn l-art tiltaqa' mal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陆地与海洋相接的沿海地带；海岸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-art li tinsab tul il-baħar u tifforma t-tarf bejn l-art u l-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The coast is the area of land beside the sea, where the land meets the water.

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi mogħdija ġdida tul il-kosta biex il-pubbliku jkun jista' jimxi qrib il-baħar.
formal.en: The plan proposes a new path along the coast so that the public can walk near the sea.
formal.zh: 该规划提议沿海岸修建一条新步道，方便公众在海边散步。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Immorru nimxu tul il-kosta wara x-xogħol? Pawlu: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-baħar fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we go for a walk along the coast after work? Pawlu: Yes, let's meet by the sea at six.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：下班后我们沿海岸散步好吗？保罗：好，我们六点在海边见。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Immorru nimxu tul il-kosta wara x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Immorru nimxu tul il-kosta wara x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 下班后我们沿海岸散步好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk along the coast after work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-baħar fis-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-baħar fis-sitta.
messages.zh: 好，我们六点在海边见。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet by the sea at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上陆地与大海相接的一条边，再用“沿着海岸散步”的画面记住 kosta。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A named group of stars that appears to form a recognizable pattern in the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从地球上看似乎组成可辨认图形、并有特定名称的一组恒星，即星座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' stilel b'isem partikolari li, meta narawh mid-Dinja, jidher li jifforma figura li tingħaraf fis-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天文学中的星座，指从地球上看形成某种可辨认图形的一组有名称的恒星。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' stilel li għandu isem u li jidher minn fuq id-Dinja bħala figura jew disinn li jista' jingħaraf fis-sema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A constellation is a named group of stars that appears to form a particular pattern when viewed from Earth.

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw mappa tas-sema biex jagħrfu kostellazzjoni u jpinġu l-pożizzjonijiet tal-istilel tagħha.
formal.en: The students used a sky map to identify a constellation and draw the positions of its stars.
formal.zh: 学生们利用星图辨认一个星座，并画出其中各颗恒星的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tara dik il-kostellazzjoni hemm fuq? Adam: Qed nara l-istilel, imma għadni ma nagħrafx il-figura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you see that constellation up there? Adam: I can see the stars, but I don't recognize the shape yet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看见上面那个星座了吗？亚当：我看见那些星星了，但还认不出它们组成的图形。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dik il-kostellazzjoni hemm fuq?
