messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dik il-kostellazzjoni hemm fuq?
messages.zh: 你看见上面那个星座了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that constellation up there?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara l-istilel, imma għadni ma nagħrafx il-figura.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara l-istilel, imma għadni ma nagħrafx il-figura.
messages.zh: 我看见那些星星了，但还认不出它们组成的图形。
messages.en: I can see the stars, but I don't recognize the shape yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把夜空中的几个亮点想象成连点成图的练习，再给图形贴上名字，用这个画面记住“星座”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which passing stools is difficult or happens less often than usual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排便困难或排便次数少于平常的状况，即便秘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna ssibha diffiċli tgħaddi l-ippurgar jew tgħaddih inqas ta' spiss mis-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排便困难或排便频率低于平常的状况，常称为便秘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha l-ippurgar jgħaddi b'diffikultà jew inqas ta' spiss mis-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Constipation is a condition in which you have difficulty passing stools or do so less often than usual.

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta rrappurtat kostipazzjoni u spjegat li kienet ilha tlett ijiem issibha diffiċli tgħaddi l-ippurgar.
formal.en: The patient reported constipation and explained that she had been finding it difficult to pass stools for three days.
formal.zh: 患者报告有便秘，并说明自己已经连续三天排便困难。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi kostipazzjoni u qed insibha diffiċli nagħmel il-bżonn. Rita: Kemm ilek hekk? Sara: Ilni tlett ijiem.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'm constipated and I'm finding it difficult to have a bowel movement. Rita: How long have you been like this? Sara: For three days.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我便秘了，排便很困难。丽塔：这种情况多久了？萨拉：已经三天了。

messages.speaker: Sara (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi kostipazzjoni u qed insibha diffiċli nagħmel il-bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi kostipazzjoni u qed insibha diffiċli nagħmel il-bżonn.
messages.zh: 我便秘了，排便很困难。
messages.en: I'm constipated and I'm finding it difficult to have a bowel movement.

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm ilek hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm ilek hekk?
messages.zh: 这种情况多久了？
messages.en: How long have you been like this?

messages.speaker: Sara (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilni tlett ijiem.
messages.mt_standard: Ilni tlett ijiem.
messages.zh: 已经三天了。
messages.en: For three days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kostipazzjoni 与“排便困难、次数减少”的情境相连，并整句记忆 Għandi kostipazzjoni，表示“我便秘了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of building something, or the way in which it is built.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建造某物的过程，或某物采用的建造方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-bini ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-mod kif din tinbena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建造或构筑某物的行为或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih tinbena xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Construction is the activity or process of building something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物的建造方式，包括各部分如何组合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif xi ħaġa tkun inbniet u kif il-partijiet tagħha jkunu tqiegħdu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The construction of something is the way its parts have been put together.

formal.mt: Il-kostruzzjoni tal-pont se tibda f'Jannar, u r-rapport jispjega l-metodu ta' kostruzzjoni magħżul.
formal.en: Construction of the bridge will begin in January, and the report explains the chosen construction method.
formal.zh: 桥梁将于一月开始建造，报告说明了所选的建造方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadha magħluqa t-triq? Mark: Għax għaddejja l-kostruzzjoni tal-pont il-ġdid. Lara: Allura rridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the road still closed? Mark: Because construction of the new bridge is underway. Lara: Then we need to take another road.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条路为什么还封着？马克：因为新桥正在施工。拉拉：那我们得走另一条路了。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadha magħluqa t-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadha magħluqa t-triq?
messages.zh: 这条路为什么还封着？
messages.en: Why is the road still closed?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għaddejja l-kostruzzjoni tal-pont il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għaddejja l-kostruzzjoni tal-pont il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 因为新桥正在施工。
messages.en: Because construction of the new bridge is underway.

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura rridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Allura rridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 那我们得走另一条路了。
messages.en: Then we need to take another road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一座桥记两个义项：看工人施工时记“建造过程”，看桥的各部分怎样组合时记“建造方式”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kowċ is a bus hired privately for a group journey, or a person who trains people in a sport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指为团体出行而包租的大巴，也指指导运动员训练的体育教练。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kowċ huwa xarabank mikrija għal vjaġġ ta' grupp, jew persuna li tħarreġ lil oħrajn fi sport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由个人或团体包租、用于集体出行的大巴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kowċ huwa xarabank li persuna jew grupp jikri għal vjaġġ privat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coach is a bus that a person or group hires privately for a journey.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教授运动技巧并指导运动员或运动队训练的教练。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kowċ huwa persuna li tgħallem il-ħiliet ta' sport u tiggwida t-taħriġ ta' atleti jew ta' tim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sports trainer is someone who teaches sporting skills and guides the training of athletes or teams.

collocations.en: hire a coach for a group journey

formal.mt: L-iskola se tikri kowċ biex tieħu lit-tim għal-logħba; il-kowċ tat-tim se jakkumpanja lill-istudenti.
formal.en: The school will hire a coach to take the team to the match; the team's coach will accompany the students.
formal.zh: 学校将包租一辆大巴送球队去参加比赛；球队教练将陪同学生前往。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se mmorru għal-logħba? Mark: Se mmorru bil-kowċ. Maja: U l-kowċ tat-tim ġej magħna? Mark: Iva, ġej magħna wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we getting to the match? Mark: We're going by hired coach. Maja: And is the team's coach coming with us? Mark: Yes, he's coming with us too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们怎么去比赛场地？Mark：坐包租大巴去。Maja：球队教练也跟我们一起去吗？Mark：对，他也跟我们一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se mmorru għal-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se mmorru għal-logħba?
messages.zh: 我们怎么去比赛场地？
messages.en: How are we getting to the match?

messages.speaker: Mark (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmorru bil-kowċ.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmorru bil-kowċ.
messages.zh: 坐包租大巴去。
messages.en: We're going by hired coach.

messages.speaker: Maja (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: U l-kowċ tat-tim ġej magħna?
messages.mt_standard: U l-kowċ tat-tim ġej magħna?
messages.zh: 球队教练也跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: And is the team's coach coming with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej magħna wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej magħna wkoll.
messages.zh: 对，他也跟我们一起去。
messages.en: Yes, he's coming with us too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把场景记成“教练带队坐包租大巴”：同一个 kowċ，谈交通时指大巴，谈训练时指教练。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something cosmic relates to the universe as a whole or to phenomena in space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述与整个宇宙或宇宙空间中的现象有关的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kożmiku jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha x'taqsam mal-univers kollu jew ma' fenomeni fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宇宙的；涉及整个宇宙或宇宙空间现象的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa kożmika hija marbuta mal-univers kollu jew ma' dak li jiġri fl-ispazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is cosmic is connected with the universe as a whole or with phenomena in space.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-istrumenti jkejlu r-radjazzjoni kożmika.
formal.en: The report describes how the instruments measure cosmic radiation.
formal.zh: 这份报告说明了仪器如何测量宇宙辐射。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak it-trab fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dak hu trab kożmiku, jiġifieri trab fl-ispazju. Sara: Mela mhux trab minn kamra! Pawlu: Le, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-univers.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that dust in the picture? Pawlu: That's cosmic dust, meaning dust in space. Sara: So it isn't dust from a room! Pawlu: No, we're talking about the universe here.
colloquial.zh: Sara：图片里那些尘埃是什么？Pawlu：那是宇宙尘埃，也就是太空中的尘埃。Sara：所以不是房间里的灰尘呀！Pawlu：对，这里说的是宇宙。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak it-trab fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak it-trab fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图片里那些尘埃是什么？
messages.en: What's that dust in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu trab kożmiku, jiġifieri trab fl-ispazju.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu trab kożmiku, jiġifieri trab fl-ispazju.
messages.zh: 那是宇宙尘埃，也就是太空中的尘埃。
messages.en: That's cosmic dust, meaning dust in space.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela mhux trab minn kamra!
messages.mt_standard: Mela mhux trab minn kamra!
messages.zh: 所以不是房间里的灰尘呀！
messages.en: So it isn't dust from a room!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-univers.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-univers.
messages.zh: 对，这里说的是宇宙。
messages.en: No, we're talking about the universe here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kożmiku 放在“宇宙尘埃”这张画面里记；配合记忆 trab kożmiku、radjazzjoni kożmika，留意形容词随名词变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cosmos is the whole universe, including all space, matter, and energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宇宙，即包含全部空间、物质和能量的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kożmu huwa l-univers kollu, inklużi l-ispazju kollu, il-materja kollha u l-enerġija kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为整体的宇宙，包括全部空间、物质和能量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kożmu huwa t-totalità tal-ispazju, tal-materja u tal-enerġija li jeżistu fl-univers.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The cosmos is the universe considered as a whole, including all the space, matter, and energy within it.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jippreżenta mistoqsijiet dwar l-oriġini u l-istruttura tal-kożmu.
formal.en: The book presents questions about the origin and structure of the cosmos.
formal.zh: 这本书提出了有关宇宙起源与结构的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? David: Dwar il-kożmu, jiġifieri l-univers kollu. Lara: Jitkellem ukoll dwar l-istilel? David: Iva, u dwar il-galassji wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this book about? David: The cosmos, meaning the whole universe. Lara: Does it talk about stars too? David: Yes, and about galaxies as well.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这本书讲什么？David：讲宇宙，也就是整个宇宙。Lara：里面也讲恒星吗？David：讲，也讲星系。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What's this book about?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-kożmu, jiġifieri l-univers kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-kożmu, jiġifieri l-univers kollu.
messages.zh: 讲宇宙，也就是整个宇宙。
messages.en: The cosmos, meaning the whole universe.

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jitkellem ukoll dwar l-istilel?
messages.mt_standard: Jitkellem ukoll dwar l-istilel?
messages.zh: 里面也讲恒星吗？
messages.en: Does it talk about stars too?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u dwar il-galassji wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u dwar il-galassji wkoll.
messages.zh: 讲，也讲星系。
messages.en: Yes, and about galaxies as well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜头从一颗恒星拉远，直到包含所有星系和空间：整个画面叫 kożmu；用“宇宙整体”牢牢记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crater is a large, roughly circular hollow in a surface, such as a volcanic opening or a depression formed by an impact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上大致呈圆形的较大凹陷，例如火山口或撞击形成的坑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Krater huwa ħofra kbira bejn wieħed u ieħor tonda f'wiċċ l-art jew ta' ġisem ċelesti, bħal fetħa ta' vulkan jew ħofra ffurmata minn impatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地面或天体表面大致呈圆形的凹坑，可指火山口或撞击坑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Krater huwa ħofra kbira u ġeneralment tonda f'wiċċ l-art jew ta' ġisem ċelesti, li tista' tkun fetħa ta' vulkan jew ir-riżultat ta' impatt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crater is a large, usually round hollow in a surface, such as the opening of a volcano or a pit left by an impact.

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu l-forma ta' krater vulkaniku ma' dik ta' krater tal-impatt fuq il-Qamar.
formal.en: The students compared the shape of a volcanic crater with that of an impact crater on the Moon.
formal.zh: 学生们比较了火山口与月球撞击坑的形状。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik il-ħofra tonda fl-istampa tal-Qamar? Mark: Dik hi krater tal-impatt. Nina: U l-vulkani għandhom krater ukoll? Mark: Iva, iżda krater vulkaniku għandu oriġini differenti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that round hollow in the picture of the Moon? Mark: That's an impact crater. Nina: And do volcanoes have a crater too? Mark: Yes, but a volcanic crater has a different origin.
colloquial.zh: Nina：月球照片里那个圆形凹坑是什么？Mark：那是撞击坑。Nina：火山也有这种叫 krater 的坑口吗？Mark：有，不过火山口的形成原因不同。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-ħofra tonda fl-istampa tal-Qamar?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-ħofra tonda fl-istampa tal-Qamar?
messages.zh: 月球照片里那个圆形凹坑是什么？
messages.en: What's that round hollow in the picture of the Moon?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi krater tal-impatt.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi krater tal-impatt.
messages.zh: 那是撞击坑。
messages.en: That's an impact crater.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U l-vulkani għandhom krater ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: U l-vulkani għandhom krater ukoll?
messages.zh: 火山也有这种叫 krater 的坑口吗？
messages.en: And do volcanoes have a crater too?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda krater vulkaniku għandu oriġini differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda krater vulkaniku għandu oriġini differenti.
messages.zh: 有，不过火山口的形成原因不同。
messages.en: Yes, but a volcanic crater has a different origin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个圆形凹口：一个在火山顶，一个在月球表面；都标上 krater，再分别搭配 vulkaniku 和 tal-impatt 记住具体类型。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A payment card that allows its holder to borrow money to pay for goods or services and repay it later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持卡人可以在信用额度内借款支付商品或服务费用，并在之后还款的支付卡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kard għall-ħlas li tippermetti lid-detentur jissellef flus sa limitu stabbilit biex iħallas għal prodotti jew servizzi u jħallas lura aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信用卡；允许持卡人在规定额度内先借款消费、之后还款的支付卡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kard li biha d-detentur jista' jħallas għal prodotti jew servizzi permezz ta' flus mislufa u mbagħad iħallas lura l-ammont użat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A credit card is a payment card that lets you buy things with borrowed money and repay the amount later.

formal.mt: Il-klijent jista' juża kredit kard biex iħallas għas-servizz, sakemm l-ammont ma jaqbiżx il-limitu disponibbli.
formal.en: The customer may use a credit card to pay for the service, provided the amount does not exceed the available limit.
formal.zh: 客户可以使用信用卡支付服务费用，前提是金额不超过可用额度。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nħallas bil-kredit kard? Rita: Iva, tista'. Daħħal il-kard hawn, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I pay by credit card? Rita: Yes, you can. Insert the card here, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我可以用信用卡付款吗？丽塔：可以。请把卡插在这里。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nħallas bil-kredit kard?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nħallas bil-kredit kard?
messages.zh: 我可以用信用卡付款吗？
messages.en: Can I pay by credit card?

messages.speaker: Rita (收银员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista'. Daħħal il-kard hawn, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista'. Daħħal il-kard hawn, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 可以。请把卡插在这里。
messages.en: Yes, you can. Insert the card here, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kredit kard 和“刷卡先消费、之后再还款”的收银台画面联系起来，并整句记住 nħallas bil-kredit kard，表示“我用信用卡付款”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Credit provided to finance exports or help buyers pay for exported goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于为出口交易融资，或帮助买方支付出口商品或服务费用的信贷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kreditu mogħti biex jiffinanzja l-esportazzjoni ta' prodotti jew servizzi jew biex jgħin lix-xerrejja jħallsu għalihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口信贷；为出口商品或服务的交易提供资金支持的信用融资。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Finanzjament permezz ta' kreditu li jappoġġa l-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi barra mill-pajjiż, billi jgħin lill-esportatur jew lix-xerrej iħallas l-ispejjeż tat-tranżazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Export credit is financing that helps an exporter or an overseas buyer pay the costs associated with an export transaction.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija applikat għal kreditu għall-esportazzjoni biex tiffinanzja ordni minn xerrej barra mill-pajjiż.
formal.en: The company applied for export credit to finance an order from an overseas buyer.
formal.zh: 该公司申请了出口信贷，以便为海外买家的订单融资。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xerrej se jħallasna wara li nirċievu l-materjal? Pawlu: Le, wara l-kunsinna. Għalhekk qed nistaqsu lill-bank dwar kreditu għall-esportazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will the buyer pay us after we receive the materials? Pawlu: No, after delivery. That's why we're asking the bank about export credit.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们收到材料后，买家就会付款给我们吗？保罗：不是，要交货后才付。所以我们正在向银行了解出口信贷。

messages.speaker: Lara (公司同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xerrej se jħallasna wara li nirċievu l-materjal?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xerrej se jħallasna wara li nirċievu l-materjal?
messages.zh: 我们收到材料后，买家就会付款给我们吗？
messages.en: Will the buyer pay us after we receive the materials?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (出口业务负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara l-kunsinna. Għalhekk qed nistaqsu lill-bank dwar kreditu għall-esportazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara l-kunsinna. Għalhekk qed nistaqsu lill-bank dwar kreditu għall-esportazzjoni.
messages.zh: 不是，要交货后才付。所以我们正在向银行了解出口信贷。
messages.en: No, after delivery. That's why we're asking the bank about export credit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一批货物准备运往国外，企业先获得资金安排生产：把整个短语与“为出口提供信贷”联系起来，重点记住出口交易这一用途。

gloss_zh: 消费信贷；消费贷款业务；消费贷款

teaching_sense.en_definition: Credit made available to individuals to pay for personal goods or services and repay the money later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向个人提供、用于支付个人消费商品或服务费用并在之后偿还的信贷，也可指提供此类贷款的业务或具体贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kreditu mogħti lil individwi biex iħallsu għal prodotti jew servizzi għall-użu personali u jħallsu lura aktar tard; jista' jirreferi wkoll għall-attività ta' self jew għal self partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费信贷；个人为购买消费商品或服务而获得的信用融资。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kreditu disponibbli għal individwu biex jixtri prodotti jew servizzi għall-użu personali u jħallas l-ammont dovut aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer credit is credit that allows individuals to pay for personal goods or services with money they repay later.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费贷款业务；向个人发放用于个人消费的贷款的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha bank jew sellief ieħor jagħti self lil individwi biex jiffinanzjaw xiri jew spejjeż personali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer lending is the activity of providing loans to individuals to finance their personal purchases or expenses.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费贷款；向个人发放、用于支付个人消费支出的一笔贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Self partikolari mogħti lil individwu biex iħallas għal xiri jew spejjeż għall-użu personali, li għandu jitħallas lura skont il-ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer loan is a particular amount lent to an individual for personal purchases or expenses under an agreement to repay it.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega l-kreditu għall-konsumatur u jagħti eżempju ta' self għax-xiri ta' għamara għad-dar.
formal.en: The leaflet explains consumer credit and gives an example of a loan for buying household furniture.
formal.zh: 这份说明册介绍了消费信贷，并以购买家用家具的贷款为例加以说明。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser kreditu għall-konsumatur f'dan il-fuljett? David: Ifisser flus li tista' tissellef għal xiri personali u tħallas lura aktar tard, bħal self biex tixtri friġġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does consumer credit mean in this leaflet? David: It means money you can borrow for personal purchases and repay later, such as a loan to buy a fridge.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这份说明册里的“消费信贷”是什么意思？戴维：就是你可以借来作个人消费、之后再偿还的钱，比如买冰箱的贷款。

messages.speaker: Marija (银行顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser kreditu għall-konsumatur f'dan il-fuljett?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser kreditu għall-konsumatur f'dan il-fuljett?
messages.zh: 这份说明册里的“消费信贷”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does consumer credit mean in this leaflet?

messages.speaker: David (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser flus li tista' tissellef għal xiri personali u tħallas lura aktar tard, bħal self biex tixtri friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser flus li tista' tissellef għal xiri personali u tħallas lura aktar tard, bħal self biex tixtri friġġ.
messages.zh: 就是你可以借来作个人消费、之后再偿还的钱，比如买冰箱的贷款。
messages.en: It means money you can borrow for personal purchases and repay later, such as a loan to buy a fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“个人借钱买冰箱”的画面记住消费用途；再分三层理解：融资安排叫消费信贷，放贷活动叫消费贷款业务，具体借到的一笔钱叫消费贷款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement or set of fundamental beliefs, especially religious beliefs, held by a person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体所持有的一套基本信念，或对这些信念的表述，尤指宗教信条或信经。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni jew ġabra ta' twemmin fundamentali li jħaddan individwu jew grupp, speċjalment fil-qasam tar-reliġjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信条；个人或群体奉行的基本信念或其表述，尤指宗教中的信经。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' twemmin jew prinċipji fundamentali li jħaddan individwu jew grupp, jew dikjarazzjoni li tesprimi dan it-twemmin, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A creed is a statement or set of basic beliefs that a person or group accepts, especially in religion.

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta r-rispett lejn kull persuna bħala parti mill-kredu personali tiegħu.
formal.en: The author presents respect for every person as part of his personal creed.
formal.zh: 作者把尊重每一个人表述为其个人信条的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser kredu hawn? Samwel: Hawn qed jitkellem dwar il-prinċipji li jemmen fihom. F'kuntest reliġjuż, kredu jista' jkun dikjarazzjoni tat-twemmin.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does creed mean here? Samwel: Here he's talking about the principles he believes in. In a religious context, a creed can be a statement of faith.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的“信条”是什么意思？萨姆韦尔：这里说的是他信奉的原则。在宗教语境中，信经可以是对信仰的表述。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser kredu hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser kredu hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“信条”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does creed mean here?

messages.speaker: Samwel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed jitkellem dwar il-prinċipji li jemmen fihom. F'kuntest reliġjuż, kredu jista' jkun dikjarazzjoni tat-twemmin.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed jitkellem dwar il-prinċipji li jemmen fihom. F'kuntest reliġjuż, kredu jista' jkun dikjarazzjoni tat-twemmin.
messages.zh: 这里说的是他信奉的原则。在宗教语境中，信经可以是对信仰的表述。
messages.en: Here he's talking about the principles he believes in. In a religious context, a creed can be a statement of faith.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kredu 放在写着“我相信什么、我坚持什么”的卡片上记忆；个人语境可理解为“信条”，宗教语境可理解为“信经”，共同核心是基本信念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cream applied to the skin to keep insects away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在皮肤上，用来驱避昆虫的乳霜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Krema li tidlek fuq il-ġilda biex iżżomm l-insetti 'l bogħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驱虫剂；此词组具体指涂在皮肤上的驱虫霜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott f'forma ta' krema li jintuża fuq il-ġilda biex iżomm l-insetti 'l bogħod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An insect repellant is a substance that you use to keep insects away from you.

collocations.en: a tube of insect repellent cream

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-krema kontra l-insetti, aqra l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tubu.
formal.en: Before using the insect repellent cream, read the instructions on the tube.
formal.zh: 使用驱虫霜前，请阅读管身上的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek krema kontra l-insetti? Se noqogħdu barra llejla. Lara: Iva, għandi tubu fil-basket. Trid ftit?
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got any insect repellent cream? We're staying outside this evening. Lara: Yes, I've got a tube in my bag. Would you like some?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有驱虫霜吗？我们今晚要待在外面。Lara：有，我包里有一管。你要用一点吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek krema kontra l-insetti? Se noqogħdu barra llejla.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek krema kontra l-insetti? Se noqogħdu barra llejla.
messages.zh: 你有驱虫霜吗？我们今晚要待在外面。
messages.en: Have you got any insect repellent cream? We're staying outside this evening.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi tubu fil-basket. Trid ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi tubu fil-basket. Trid ftit?
messages.zh: 有，我包里有一管。你要用一点吗？
messages.en: Yes, I've got a tube in my bag. Would you like some?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组拆成三块记：krema是乳霜，kontra表示对抗，l-insetti是昆虫；想象出门前涂霜驱虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agricultural spade with two prongs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有两个尖齿、用于农事操作的铲具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda agrikola bħal pala b'żewġ ponot, li tintuża biex taħdem il-ħamrija.

sense_translations.en_definition: A spade with two prongs (agricultural tool)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种具有两个尖齿的农用铲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' pala agrikola b'żewġ ponot minflok xafra waħda sħiħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A krexxun is a farming tool shaped like a spade with two prongs for working the soil.

collocations.en: work the soil with a two-pronged spade
collocations.zh: 用双齿农用铲翻松土壤

collocations.en: the handle of the two-pronged spade

formal.mt: Il-bidwi uża l-krexxun biex iħoll il-ħamrija qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The farmer used the two-pronged spade to loosen the soil before sowing.
formal.zh: 农民在播种前用双齿农用铲松土。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Tgħaddili l-krexxun, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Din l-għodda b'żewġ ponot? Pawlu: Iva, dik. Se nħoll ftit il-ħamrija.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Could you pass me the two-pronged spade, please? Rita: This tool with two prongs? Pawlu: Yes, that one. I'm going to loosen the soil a little.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：请把双齿农用铲递给我，好吗？Rita：是这件有两个尖齿的工具吗？Pawlu：对，就是它。我要稍微松一下土。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħaddili l-krexxun, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tgħaddili l-krexxun, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请把双齿农用铲递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the two-pronged spade, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (农场帮手)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-għodda b'żewġ ponot?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-għodda b'żewġ ponot?
messages.zh: 是这件有两个尖齿的工具吗？
messages.en: This tool with two prongs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik. Se nħoll ftit il-ħamrija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik. Se nħoll ftit il-ħamrija.
messages.zh: 对，就是它。我要稍微松一下土。
messages.en: Yes, that one. I'm going to loosen the soil a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记krexxun：画一把铲，再把铲头画成两个尖齿；看到双齿农具就回想这个词，不作词源联想。

gloss_zh: 刹车装置（尤指大车用）；棘轮机构

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to slow or stop a vehicle, especially a cart; also a ratchet mechanism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使车辆减速或停止的装置，尤指大车的刹车；也指允许逐步单向运动并防止倒转的棘轮机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jnaqqas jew iwaqqaf il-moviment ta' vettura, speċjalment ta' karrettun; ukoll mekkaniżmu bis-snien li jippermetti moviment f'direzzjoni waħda u jwaqqaf il-moviment lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刹车；制动装置，尤指大车上的刹车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex inaqqas il-veloċità jew iwaqqaf vettura, speċjalment karrettun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A brake is a device that slows or stops a vehicle, especially a cart in this sense.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棘轮机构；允许机构沿一个方向逐步运动并阻止反向运动的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mekkaniżmu b'rota bis-snien u biċċa li taqbad magħhom biex tippermetti moviment f'direzzjoni waħda u twaqqaf il-moviment lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ratchet is a mechanism that allows movement in one direction while preventing movement in the opposite direction.

formal.mt: Qabel niżel l-għolja bil-karrettun, is-sewwieq iċċekkja li l-krikk kien jaħdem sew.
formal.en: Before taking the cart down the hill, the driver checked that the brake worked properly.
formal.zh: 驾车人赶着大车下坡前，检查了刹车是否正常工作。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex din ir-rota ddur biss f'direzzjoni waħda? Toni: Għax għandha krikk. Ara kif din il-biċċa taqbad mas-snien u ma tħallihiex iddur lura.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does this wheel turn in only one direction? Toni: Because it has a ratchet. Look how this piece engages with the teeth and stops it turning backwards.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个轮子为什么只能朝一个方向转？Toni：因为它装有棘轮机构。你看，这个部件卡住轮齿，不让它倒转。

messages.speaker: Marta (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din ir-rota ddur biss f'direzzjoni waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din ir-rota ddur biss f'direzzjoni waħda?
messages.zh: 这个轮子为什么只能朝一个方向转？
messages.en: Why does this wheel turn in only one direction?

messages.speaker: Toni (机械师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandha krikk. Ara kif din il-biċċa taqbad mas-snien u ma tħallihiex iddur lura.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandha krikk. Ara kif din il-biċċa taqbad mas-snien u ma tħallihiex iddur lura.
messages.zh: 因为它装有棘轮机构。你看，这个部件卡住轮齿，不让它倒转。
messages.en: Because it has a ratchet. Look how this piece engages with the teeth and stops it turning backwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给krikk配两幅图：大车刹车让车停住，棘轮卡齿阻止倒转；分别记住两个义项，别把两种装置混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Creams: thick, soft preparations that can be spread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乳霜、膏霜，指质地浓稠柔软、可以涂抹的制品，表示复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kremi, jiġifieri preparazzjonijiet ħoxnin u rotob li jistgħu jindilku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳霜；膏霜，复数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Preparazzjonijiet f'forma ta' krema, b'konsistenza ħoxna u ratba li tippermetti li jindilku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Creams are thick, soft preparations that you can spread over a surface, such as your skin.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut joffri tipi differenti ta' krimea għall-kura tal-ġilda.
formal.en: The shop offers different types of creams for skin care.
formal.zh: 这家商店提供不同种类的护肤乳霜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandkom krimea għall-ġilda xotta? Mark: Iva, għandna diversi tipi. Trid tara dawk mingħajr fwieħa?
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have creams for dry skin? Mark: Yes, we have several types. Would you like to see the fragrance-free ones?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你们有适合干燥皮肤的乳霜吗？Mark：有，我们有好几种。你想看看不含香料的吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom krimea għall-ġilda xotta?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom krimea għall-ġilda xotta?
messages.zh: 你们有适合干燥皮肤的乳霜吗？
messages.en: Do you have creams for dry skin?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna diversi tipi. Trid tara dawk mingħajr fwieħa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna diversi tipi. Trid tara dawk mingħajr fwieħa?
messages.zh: 有，我们有好几种。你想看看不含香料的吗？
messages.en: Yes, we have several types. Would you like to see the fragrance-free ones?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把krimea和英文复数creams配对，想象货架上摆着多种乳霜；用一排膏霜罐提醒自己这里表达复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with crime, or involving an act that breaks criminal law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与犯罪有关的，或涉及违反刑事法律的行为的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-reati jew ma' atti li jiksru l-liġi kriminali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯罪的；涉及犯罪活动或刑事法律的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu marbut ma' reat, ma' attività li tikser il-liġi kriminali, jew mal-qasam tal-liġi li jittratta r-reati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An act or activity that is criminal breaks criminal law, while a criminal matter is connected with crime.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-miżuri meħuda biex tiġi miġġielda l-attività kriminali fiż-żona.
formal.en: The report describes the measures taken to combat criminal activity in the area.
formal.zh: 报告描述了为打击该地区犯罪活动而采取的措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi investigazzjoni kriminali? Pawlu: Hija investigazzjoni biex jinstab jekk sarx reat u min għamlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a criminal investigation? Pawlu: It is an investigation to find out whether a crime was committed and who committed it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是刑事调查？保罗：就是调查是否发生了犯罪，以及是谁实施的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi investigazzjoni kriminali?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi investigazzjoni kriminali?
messages.zh: 什么是刑事调查？
messages.en: What is a criminal investigation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija investigazzjoni biex jinstab jekk sarx reat u min għamlu.
messages.mt_standard: Hija investigazzjoni biex jinstab jekk sarx reat u min għamlu.
messages.zh: 就是调查是否发生了犯罪，以及是谁实施的。
messages.en: It is an investigation to find out whether a crime was committed and who committed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kriminali 放在名词后一起记：att kriminali 是“犯罪行为”，investigazzjoni kriminali 是“刑事调查”；用搭配区分“犯罪的”和“刑事的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The criminal nature of conduct, or crime considered as a general social phenomenon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为所具有的犯罪性质，或作为整体社会现象的犯罪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-natura kriminali ta' mġiba, jew ir-reati meqjusa flimkien bħala fenomenu fis-soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯罪性；某种行为具有犯罪性质这一特征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew in-natura ta' att jew ta' mġiba li jagħmluhom kriminali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The criminality of an act is the quality of that act that makes it a crime.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯罪现象；统指某个地区或社会中的犯罪活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività kriminali jew ir-reati li jseħħu f'post jew f'soċjetà, meqjusa bħala ħaġa waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Crime in this sense means criminal activities considered together within a community or society.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-rata ta' kriminalità fil-belt u l-miżuri proposti biex titnaqqas.
formal.en: The study examines the crime rate in the city and the measures proposed to reduce it.
formal.zh: 该研究考察了这座城市的犯罪率，以及为降低犯罪率而提出的措施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq xiex kien il-programm tal-bieraħ? Mark: Fuq il-kriminalità fil-bliet u kif tista' titnaqqas.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was yesterday's programme about? Mark: About crime in cities and how it can be reduced.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天的节目讲什么？马克：讲城市里的犯罪现象，以及怎样减少犯罪。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex kien il-programm tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex kien il-programm tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天的节目讲什么？
messages.en: What was yesterday's programme about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-kriminalità fil-bliet u kif tista' titnaqqas.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-kriminalità fil-bliet u kif tista' titnaqqas.
messages.zh: 讲城市里的犯罪现象，以及怎样减少犯罪。
messages.en: About crime in cities and how it can be reduced.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个镜头记 kriminalità：镜头对准一个行为时，关注“犯罪性”；镜头拉到整座城市时，关注“犯罪现象”。这是语义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An underground room, especially beneath a church, often used for burials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地下的房间，尤指教堂下方常用于安葬死者的地下墓室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra taħt l-art, speċjalment taħt knisja, li spiss tintuża għad-dfin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地下墓室；尤指位于教堂下方、常用于安葬死者的地下空间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra jew spazju taħt l-art, ġeneralment taħt knisja, fejn spiss ikun hemm oqbra jew fejn jindifnu l-mejtin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crypt is an underground room, usually beneath a church, where people may be buried.

collocations.en: to go down into the crypt

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara, il-gwida spjegat li l-kripta tinsab taħt il-knisja u fiha diversi oqbra.
formal.en: During the visit, the guide explained that the crypt lies beneath the church and contains several tombs.
formal.zh: 参观期间，导游解释说，地下墓室位于教堂下方，里面有几座坟墓。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn iwassal dan it-taraġ? Ġużeppi: Għall-kripta taħt il-knisja. Trid tinżel taraha?
colloquial.en: Anna: Where do these stairs lead? Ġużeppi: To the crypt beneath the church. Would you like to go down and see it?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这段楼梯通向哪里？朱塞佩：通向教堂下面的地下墓室。你想下去看看吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn iwassal dan it-taraġ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn iwassal dan it-taraġ?
messages.zh: 这段楼梯通向哪里？
messages.en: Where do these stairs lead?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-kripta taħt il-knisja. Trid tinżel taraha?
messages.mt_standard: Għall-kripta taħt il-knisja. Trid tinżel taraha?
messages.zh: 通向教堂下面的地下墓室。你想下去看看吗？
messages.en: To the crypt beneath the church. Would you like to go down and see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象参观教堂时沿楼梯往下走，来到有石棺的地下房间；把“教堂下面的墓室”这个画面与 kripta 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid with an orderly internal structure, such as quartz or salt; also fine glass used for decorative objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内部结构有规则排列的固体，如石英或盐的晶体；也指用于制作装饰物等的优质水晶玻璃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Solidu li l-partiċelli tiegħu huma rranġati b'mod regolari, bħall-kwarz jew il-melħ; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal ħġieġ fin li jintuża għal oġġetti dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晶体，包括水晶等内部结构有规则排列的固体；也可指制作杯具或装饰品的水晶玻璃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ta' sustanza solida li għandha struttura interna regolari, bħal kristall tal-melħ jew tal-kwarz; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal ħġieġ fin u trasparenti li jintuża għal tazzi u oġġetti dekorattivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crystal is a solid whose particles form a regular structure; crystal can also mean fine glass used for drinking vessels and ornaments.

formal.mt: Fil-laboratorju, l-istudenti osservaw kristall tal-melħ b'lenti u ddeskrivew il-forma tiegħu.
formal.en: In the laboratory, the students observed a salt crystal through a magnifying glass and described its shape.
formal.zh: 在实验室里，学生们用放大镜观察了一颗盐晶体，并描述了它的形状。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din it-tazza tal-kristall nużawha llum? David: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta meta taħsilha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Shall we use this crystal glass today? David: Yes, but be careful when you wash it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：今天我们用这个水晶玻璃杯吗？戴维：用吧，不过洗的时候要小心。

messages.speaker: Marta (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tazza tal-kristall nużawha llum?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tazza tal-kristall nużawha llum?
messages.zh: 今天我们用这个水晶玻璃杯吗？
messages.en: Shall we use this crystal glass today?

messages.speaker: David (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta meta taħsilha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta meta taħsilha.
messages.zh: 用吧，不过洗的时候要小心。
messages.en: Yes, but be careful when you wash it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“实验桌上的盐晶体”和“餐桌上的水晶杯”两个画面记 kristall：前者帮助记科学意义，后者帮助记日常器皿的材料意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Standards used to assess the quality of a frequency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于评估频率质量的一组判断标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' standards li jintużaw biex tiġi evalwata l-kwalità ta' frekwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于评价频率质量的各项标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Standards li fuqhom tkun ibbażata l-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità ta' frekwenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Frequency quality evaluation criteria are the standards used when assessing the quality of a frequency.

collocations.zh: 确定频率质量评估标准
应用频率质量评估标准

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jispeċifika l-kriterji għall-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza u jispjega kif ġew applikati.
formal.en: The report must specify the frequency quality evaluation criteria and explain how they were applied.
formal.zh: 报告必须列明频率质量评估标准，并解释这些标准是如何应用的。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Liema kriterji għall-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza se nużaw? Pawlu: Dawk imniżżla fir-rapport; ejja naqrawhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marta: Which frequency quality evaluation criteria are we going to use? Pawlu: The ones listed in the report; let's read them together.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们要使用哪些频率质量评估标准？Pawlu：报告里列出的那些；我们一起读一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kriterji għall-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza se nużaw?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kriterji għall-evalwazzjoni tal-kwalità tal-frekwenza se nużaw?
messages.zh: 我们要使用哪些频率质量评估标准？
messages.en: Which frequency quality evaluation criteria are we going to use?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk imniżżla fir-rapport; ejja naqrawhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk imniżżla fir-rapport; ejja naqrawhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 报告里列出的那些；我们一起读一遍吧。
messages.en: The ones listed in the report; let's read them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：kriterji 是“标准”，għall-evalwazzjoni 是“用于评估”，tal-kwalità 是“质量的”，tal-frekwenza 是“频率的”；理解时整理成中文顺序“频率质量评估标准”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Standards used to decide which people or things to select.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于决定选择哪些人或事物的一组标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Standards li jintużaw biex jiġi deċiż liema persuni jew affarijiet għandhom jintgħażlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于筛选人员、事物或方案的各项标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjonijiet jew l-istandards li fuqhom tkun ibbażata l-għażla ta' persuni, affarijiet jew proposti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Selection criteria are the standards used to decide which people or things should be chosen.

formal.mt: Il-kriterji tal-għażla għandhom jiġu ppubblikati qabel ma jibda l-proċess tal-għażla.
formal.en: The selection criteria must be published before the selection process begins.
formal.zh: 遴选标准必须在遴选程序开始前公布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taf x'inhuma l-kriterji tal-għażla għal dan il-kors? Mark: Iva, qegħdin fuq is-sit; ejja naraw jekk tissodisfahomx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you know what the selection criteria are for this course? Mark: Yes, they're on the website; let's see whether you meet them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你知道这门课程的录取标准是什么吗？Mark：知道，网站上有；我们看看你是否符合吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请者)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf x'inhuma l-kriterji tal-għażla għal dan il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Taf x'inhuma l-kriterji tal-għażla għal dan il-kors?
messages.zh: 你知道这门课程的录取标准是什么吗？
messages.en: Do you know what the selection criteria are for this course?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qegħdin fuq is-sit; ejja naraw jekk tissodisfahomx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qegħdin fuq is-sit; ejja naraw jekk tissodisfahomx.
messages.zh: 知道，网站上有；我们看看你是否符合吧。
messages.en: Yes, they're on the website; let's see whether you meet them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成筛选清单：kriterji 表示多项“标准”，tal-għażla 指明这些标准用于“选择”；读到它就联想“按清单挑人或挑方案”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A standard used to judge, assess, or choose something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于判断、评估或选择人或事物的一项标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Standard li jintuża biex wieħed jiġġudika, jevalwa jew jagħżel persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出判断、评价或选择时所依据的一项标准或准则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Standard jew prinċipju li fuqu tkun ibbażata deċiżjoni, valutazzjoni jew għażla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A criterion is a standard that you use when judging something or making a choice.

formal.mt: Kull proposta għandha tiġi evalwata skont l-istess kriterju.
formal.en: Each proposal must be assessed against the same criterion.
formal.zh: 每份提案都必须按照同一项标准进行评估。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu l-kriterju ewlieni tiegħek meta tagħżel appartament? David: Għalija, l-aktar importanti hu li jkun qrib ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's your main criterion when choosing an apartment? David: For me, the most important thing is that it's close to work.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你选公寓时最主要的标准是什么？David：对我来说，最重要的是离上班的地方近。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu l-kriterju ewlieni tiegħek meta tagħżel appartament?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu l-kriterju ewlieni tiegħek meta tagħżel appartament?
messages.zh: 你选公寓时最主要的标准是什么？
messages.en: What's your main criterion when choosing an apartment?

messages.speaker: David (租房者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija, l-aktar importanti hu li jkun qrib ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija, l-aktar importanti hu li jkun qrib ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 对我来说，最重要的是离上班的地方近。
messages.en: For me, the most important thing is that it's close to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评选表中的一个打分项目，把 kriterju 记成“一项判断标准”；再与表示多项标准的 kriterji 对照，帮助记住单复数的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A criterion that assesses an aspect other than price, such as quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于评估价格以外因素的标准，例如质量标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Standard li jintuża biex jiġi evalwat aspett għajr il-prezz, bħall-kwalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以成本以外的因素为评价依据的标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Standard ta' evalwazzjoni bbażat fuq fatturi oħra għajr l-ispiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-cost criterion is a standard used to assess factors other than how much something costs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于判断产品、服务或方案质量的标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Standard li jintuża biex tiġi ġġudikata l-kwalità ta' prodott, servizz jew proposta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A quality criterion is a standard used to judge how good a product, service, or proposal is.

collocations.mt: jagħtu piż lil kriterju mhux marbut mal-prezz
collocations.en: assign weight to a non-cost criterion
collocations.zh: 为一项非成本标准分配权重

formal.mt: Il-kwalità tas-servizz għandha tiġi evalwata bħala kriterju mhux marbut mal-prezz meta jitqabblu l-offerti.
formal.en: Service quality must be assessed as a non-cost criterion when comparing the bids.
formal.zh: 比较各份报价时，必须将服务质量作为一项非成本标准进行评估。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se nagħżlu l-orħos offerta? Ġorġ: Il-prezz mhux kollox; għandna wkoll kriterju mhux marbut mal-prezz: il-kwalità tas-servizz.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are we going to choose the cheapest bid? Ġorġ: Price isn't everything; we also have a non-cost criterion: service quality.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们要选最便宜的报价吗？Ġorġ：价格不是全部；我们还有一项非成本标准，就是服务质量。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħżlu l-orħos offerta?
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħżlu l-orħos offerta?
messages.zh: 我们要选最便宜的报价吗？
messages.en: Are we going to choose the cheapest bid?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (采购负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz mhux kollox; għandna wkoll kriterju mhux marbut mal-prezz: il-kwalità tas-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz mhux kollox; għandna wkoll kriterju mhux marbut mal-prezz: il-kwalità tas-servizz.
messages.zh: 价格不是全部；我们还有一项非成本标准，就是服务质量。
messages.en: Price isn't everything; we also have a non-cost criterion: service quality.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语记：kriterju 是“标准”，mhux marbut 是“不关联”，mal-prezz 是“与价格”；联想评选表里的服务质量一栏，记住它评的是价格之外的因素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A standard used to judge whether a person, institution, or decision is independent of outside influence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于判断个人、机构或决定是否不受外部影响、具有独立性的标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Standard li jintuża biex jiġi evalwat jekk persuna, istituzzjoni jew deċiżjoni hijiex ħielsa minn influwenza esterna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 判断某人、某机构或某项决定是否具有独立性的标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tintuża biex jiġi deċiż jekk persuna, istituzzjoni jew deċiżjoni tistax titqies indipendenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A criterion of independence is a standard used to decide whether someone or something is free from outside control or influence.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu japplika kriterju ta' indipendenza meta jagħżel l-esperti li se jevalwaw il-proġett.
formal.en: The committee should apply a criterion of independence when selecting the experts who will evaluate the project.
formal.zh: 委员会在挑选项目评估专家时，应采用一项独立性标准。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma għażiltux lil Pawlu bħala evalwatur? Toni: Ma jissodisfax il-kriterju ta' indipendenza, għax jaħdem mal-kumpanija li se tiġi evalwata.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't you choose Pawlu as an evaluator? Toni: He doesn't meet the criterion of independence because he works for the company that will be evaluated.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你们为什么没选Pawlu担任评估员？Toni：他不符合独立性标准，因为他在将要接受评估的那家公司工作。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma għażiltux lil Pawlu bħala evalwatur?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma għażiltux lil Pawlu bħala evalwatur?
messages.zh: 你们为什么没选Pawlu担任评估员？
messages.en: Why didn't you choose Pawlu as an evaluator?

messages.speaker: Toni (评审协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jissodisfax il-kriterju ta' indipendenza, għax jaħdem mal-kumpanija li se tiġi evalwata.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jissodisfax il-kriterju ta' indipendenza, għax jaħdem mal-kumpanija li se tiġi evalwata.
messages.zh: 他不符合独立性标准，因为他在将要接受评估的那家公司工作。
messages.en: He doesn't meet the criterion of independence because he works for the company that will be evaluated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词记成评审时的一道检查题：“能否独立判断？”用这道题联想“独立性标准”，并搭配“符合标准”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 价格标准；成本评判标准

teaching_sense.en_definition: A standard for comparing or choosing options according to how much they cost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据所需支付的价格或费用来比较、选择不同方案的评判标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Standard li jintuża biex jitqabblu jew jintgħażlu għażliet skont kemm jiswew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以价格或费用为依据，对不同选择进行比较和评估的标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kriterju li jqis l-ispiża ta' prodott, servizz jew għażla meta ssir evalwazzjoni jew għażla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cost criterion is a standard that allows you to compare or select options according to the amount of money they require.

collocations.zh: 采用一项价格评判标准

collocations.en: choose according to a cost criterion
collocations.zh: 按照价格标准进行选择

formal.mt: Meta evalwa l-offerti, il-kumitat applika kriterju ta' prezz flimkien ma' kriterju ta' kwalità.
formal.en: When evaluating the bids, the committee applied a cost criterion alongside a quality criterion.
formal.zh: 委员会在评估各项报价时，同时采用了价格标准和质量标准。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għażilt dan il-lukanda? Mark: Użajt kriterju ta' prezz: kienet l-orħos waħda qrib l-istazzjon.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you choose this hotel? Mark: I used a cost criterion: it was the cheapest one near the station.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么选这家酒店？Mark：我是按价格标准选的：它是车站附近最便宜的一家。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt dan il-lukanda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt dan il-lukanda?
messages.zh: 你为什么选这家酒店？
messages.en: Why did you choose this hotel?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt kriterju ta' prezz: kienet l-orħos waħda qrib l-istazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt kriterju ta' prezz: kienet l-orħos waħda qrib l-istazzjon.
messages.zh: 我是按价格标准选的：它是车站附近最便宜的一家。
messages.en: I used a cost criterion: it was the cheapest one near the station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比较几张价签，再决定选哪一个；把“看价格作选择”的画面与整个词组绑定，记住它表示价格或成本方面的评判标准。

gloss_zh: 批判性的；关键的；危急的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving careful evaluation and judgment, or describing something that is especially important or seriously at risk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示经过审慎分析和判断的，也可形容至关重要的事物或处于严重危险中的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi analiżi u ġudizzju bir-reqqa, jew li jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa ta' importanza kbira jew f'periklu serju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 批判性分析的；对结果具有决定性影响的；处于危急状态的，具体含义由语境决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jeżamina u jiġġudika bir-reqqa; li għandu importanza deċiżiva; jew li jindika qagħda ta' periklu serju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is critical, it involves careful judgment, has a decisive effect on an outcome, or indicates a seriously dangerous situation.

formal.mt: Il-kors jiżviluppa l-ħsieb kritiku billi jitlob lill-istudenti jeżaminaw l-evidenza qabel jaslu għal konklużjoni.
formal.en: The course develops critical thinking by asking students to examine the evidence before reaching a conclusion.
formal.zh: 这门课程要求学生先审查证据再得出结论，以此培养批判性思维。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nieħdu pawża issa? Ben: Stenna ftit, dan hu mument kritiku fil-logħba!
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we take a break now? Ben: Wait a moment, this is a critical moment in the game!
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们现在能休息一下吗？Ben：等一下，现在正是比赛的关键时刻！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nieħdu pawża issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nieħdu pawża issa?
messages.zh: 我们现在能休息一下吗？
messages.en: Can we take a break now?

messages.speaker: Ben (一起看比赛的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit, dan hu mument kritiku fil-logħba!
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit, dan hu mument kritiku fil-logħba!
messages.zh: 等一下，现在正是比赛的关键时刻！
messages.en: Wait a moment, this is a critical moment in the game!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面区分语境：分析证据是“批判性的”，比赛转折是“关键的”，病情严重是“危急的”。同时记住阳性形式kritiku与阴性形式kritika。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period or situation of serious difficulty or danger that requires an important response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现严重困难或危险、需要采取重要应对措施的时期或局面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu jew sitwazzjoni ta' diffikultà jew periklu serju li titlob azzjoni importanti biex tiġi indirizzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重困难或危险集中出现、迫切需要应对的危机局面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qagħda serja ta' diffikultà jew periklu li fiha jkun meħtieġ li jittieħdu deċiżjonijiet u miżuri biex tiġi kkontrollata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crisis is a situation in which serious difficulties or dangers require people to make important decisions and take action.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni ħejjiet pjan biex tipproteġi s-servizzi essenzjali waqt kriżi ekonomika.
formal.en: The organization prepared a plan to protect essential services during an economic crisis.
formal.zh: 该组织制定了一项计划，以便在经济危机期间保障基本服务。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sejjer il-ħanut ta' ħuk? Paul: Għaddej minn kriżi, imma qed naħdmu flimkien biex insibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is your brother's shop doing? Paul: It's going through a crisis, but we're working together to find a solution.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你兄弟的店最近怎么样？Paul：正在经历危机，不过我们正一起想办法解决。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer il-ħanut ta' ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer il-ħanut ta' ħuk?
messages.zh: 你兄弟的店最近怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother's shop doing?

messages.speaker: Paul (店主的兄弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddej minn kriżi, imma qed naħdmu flimkien biex insibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddej minn kriżi, imma qed naħdmu flimkien biex insibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 正在经历危机，不过我们正一起想办法解决。
messages.en: It's going through a crisis, but we're working together to find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kriżi与一张需要立即商量对策的紧急会议桌联系起来，记成“必须认真应对的危机”；再用“面临危机、渡过危机”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure in a cell that contains DNA and carries genetic information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细胞中含有DNA、承载遗传信息的结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kromosoma hija struttura f'ċellola li fiha d-DNA u ġġorr informazzjoni ġenetika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 染色体；细胞内由DNA和蛋白质构成、承载遗传信息的结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kromosoma hija struttura magħmula minn DNA u proteini li tinsab f'ċellola u ġġorr informazzjoni ġenetika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chromosome is a structure within a cell that contains DNA and carries genetic information.

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-istruttura ta' kromosoma u tindika fejn jinsabu xi ġeni.
formal.en: The diagram shows the structure of a chromosome and indicates where some genes are located.
formal.zh: 该图展示了一条染色体的结构，并标示出部分基因的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi kromosoma? Pawlu: Hija struttura f'ċellola li ġġorr informazzjoni ġenetika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a chromosome? Pawlu: It is a structure in a cell that carries genetic information.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是染色体？保罗：它是细胞中承载遗传信息的结构。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi kromosoma?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi kromosoma?
messages.zh: 什么是染色体？
messages.en: What is a chromosome?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (生物老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija struttura f'ċellola li ġġorr informazzjoni ġenetika.
messages.mt_standard: Hija struttura f'ċellola li ġġorr informazzjoni ġenetika.
messages.zh: 它是细胞中承载遗传信息的结构。
messages.en: It is a structure in a cell that carries genetic information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kromosoma 想成细胞里的遗传资料卷轴，看到这个词就联想“染色体承载DNA”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A record of events in the order they happened, or news and discussion of current events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按事件发生顺序写成的记事；也可指近期事件的报道或时事内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kronaka hija rakkont ta' ġrajjiet fl-ordni li seħħew, jew aħbarijiet u diskussjoni dwar ġrajjiet kurrenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编年记事；按时间先后记录事件的文字。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kronaka hija kitba li tirrakkonta ġrajjiet fl-ordni li seħħew matul perjodu ta' żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chronicle is a written account of events presented in the order in which they happened.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时事；近期发生且受到公众关注的事件及其报道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kronaka hija l-ġabra ta' aħbarijiet u rapporti dwar ġrajjiet reċenti li huma ta' interess għall-pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Current affairs are recent events of public interest that are reported and discussed in the media.

formal.mt: Din il-kronaka tirreġistra l-ġrajjiet ewlenin tar-raħal fl-ordni li seħħew.
formal.en: This chronicle records the village's main events in the order in which they happened.
formal.zh: 这部编年记事按发生顺序记录了该村的主要事件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qrajt il-kronaka lokali llum? Mark: Iva, qrajt dwar il-laqgħa tal-kunsill u l-festa tar-raħal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you read the local current affairs coverage today? Mark: Yes, I read about the council meeting and the village feast.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天看本地时事报道了吗？马克：看了，我读了关于议会会议和村里节庆的报道。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kronaka lokali llum?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kronaka lokali llum?
messages.zh: 你今天看本地时事报道了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the local current affairs coverage today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajt dwar il-laqgħa tal-kunsill u l-festa tar-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajt dwar il-laqgħa tal-kunsill u l-festa tar-raħal.
messages.zh: 看了，我读了关于议会会议和村里节庆的报道。
messages.en: Yes, I read about the council meeting and the village feast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kronaka 联想成一本事件记录册：记录往事时是“编年记事”，报道近日事件时是“时事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Continuing for a long time or repeatedly returning, especially when describing an illness or problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容疾病或问题长期持续、反复出现的，即慢性的或长期存在的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kroniku jiddeskrivi mard jew problema li jdumu għal żmien twil jew li jerġgħu jfeġġu ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢性的；长期持续或反复发生的，常用于疾病、疼痛或难以消除的问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kroniku jfisser li marda, uġigħ jew problema jdumu għal żmien twil jew jerġgħu jseħħu ripetutament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An illness or problem that is chronic continues for a long time or keeps returning.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika nuqqas kroniku ta' persunal bħala waħda mill-kawżi tad-dewmien fis-servizz.
formal.en: The report identifies a chronic shortage of staff as one of the causes of delays in the service.
formal.zh: 报告指出，长期人员短缺是服务延误的原因之一。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek tbati minn uġigħ fid-dahar? Ġanni: Iva, it-tabib qal li hu uġigħ kroniku.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still suffering from back pain? Ġanni: Yes, the doctor said it is chronic pain.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还在受背痛困扰吗？詹尼：是的，医生说这是慢性疼痛。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tbati minn uġigħ fid-dahar?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek tbati minn uġigħ fid-dahar?
messages.zh: 你还在受背痛困扰吗？
messages.en: Are you still suffering from back pain?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tabib qal li hu uġigħ kroniku.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tabib qal li hu uġigħ kroniku.
messages.zh: 是的，医生说这是慢性疼痛。
messages.en: Yes, the doctor said it is chronic pain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kroniku 时想象日历连续翻过许多页，疼痛或短缺仍然存在，用“长期持续”抓住慢性的含义。

gloss_zh: 时间顺序；事件年表；年代学

teaching_sense.en_definition: The order in which events happened, a record arranged in that order, or the study of when events occurred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事件发生的时间顺序、按该顺序编排的记录，或研究事件发生年代的学问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kronoloġija hija l-ordni taż-żmien li fiha seħħew il-ġrajjiet, rekord imfassal skont dik l-ordni, jew l-istudju ta' meta seħħew il-ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时间顺序；按事件发生先后编排的年表或记录；研究事件年代及先后关系的年代学。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kronoloġija hija l-arranġament tal-ġrajjiet skont meta seħħew, lista tagħhom f'dik l-ordni, jew l-istudju li jistabbilixxi d-dati u s-sekwenza tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chronology presents events in the order they happened, while chronology also refers to the study of their dates and sequence.

formal.mt: L-istudju jinkludi kronoloġija dettaljata tal-ġrajjiet, b'data u deskrizzjoni qasira għal kull waħda.
formal.en: The study includes a detailed chronology of events, with a date and a brief description for each one.
formal.zh: 该研究附有详细的事件年表，为每件事列出日期和简短说明。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma niftakarx x'ġara l-ewwel. David: Ejja nagħmlu kronoloġija tal-ġrajjiet u npoġġu d-dati ħdejhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: I cannot remember what happened first. David: Let's make a chronology of events and put the dates beside them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我不记得哪件事先发生了。戴维：我们来按时间顺序列出这些事件，再在旁边写上日期。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma niftakarx x'ġara l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Ma niftakarx x'ġara l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我不记得哪件事先发生了。
messages.en: I cannot remember what happened first.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħmlu kronoloġija tal-ġrajjiet u npoġġu d-dati ħdejhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħmlu kronoloġija tal-ġrajjiet u npoġġu d-dati ħdejhom.
messages.zh: 我们来按时间顺序列出这些事件，再在旁边写上日期。
messages.en: Let's make a chronology of events and put the dates beside them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kronoloġija 想成一条贴满日期的时间线：先排事件，再标日期，就能记住“时间顺序”和“事件年表”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crutches are supports that a person uses to help them walk when a leg is injured or weak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腿部受伤或无力时，用来支撑身体、辅助行走的拐杖，常成对使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-krozzi huma għodod ta' appoġġ li persuna tuża biex timxi meta jkollha sieq imweġġgħa jew dgħajfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腿部受伤或无力时辅助行走的拐杖，常指双拐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-krozzi huma għodod li jinżammu bl-idejn biex jgħinu lil persuna timxi mingħajr ma tqiegħed il-piż kollu fuq sieq imweġġgħa jew dgħajfa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Crutches are supports you use when walking is difficult because one of your legs is injured or weak.

formal.mt: Wara l-operazzjoni, il-pazjent kellu juża l-krozzi għal ġimagħtejn biex inaqqas il-piż fuq siequ.
formal.en: After the operation, the patient had to use crutches for two weeks to reduce the weight on his leg.
formal.zh: 手术后，病人需要使用双拐两周，以减轻腿部承受的重量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tuża l-krozzi? Pawlu: Iva, imma issa nista' nimxi ftit aktar. Maja: Ħa nġorrlek il-borża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still using crutches? Pawlu: Yes, but now I can walk a little further. Maja: Let me carry your bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在用双拐吗？保罗：是啊，不过现在能多走一点了。玛雅：我来帮你拿包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tuża l-krozzi?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek tuża l-krozzi?
messages.zh: 你还在用双拐吗？
messages.en: Are you still using crutches?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (康复中的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa nista' nimxi ftit aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa nista' nimxi ftit aktar.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过现在能多走一点了。
messages.en: Yes, but now I can walk a little further.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nġorrlek il-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nġorrlek il-borża.
messages.zh: 我来帮你拿包。
messages.en: Let me carry your bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双拐替受伤的腿分担重量，把 krozzi 和 bil-krozzi（拄着拐杖）一起记，见词就联想到辅助行走。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something cruel causes suffering or shows a lack of concern for the suffering of others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物遭受痛苦，或对他人的痛苦缺乏同情的；残忍的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew imġiba tkun krudili meta tikkawża tbatija lil ħaddieħor jew ma turix ħniena lejn min qed ibati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 残忍的；使他人或动物遭受痛苦，或对其痛苦漠不关心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tkun krudili meta ġġiegħel persuna jew annimal ibati, jew meta ma turi ebda ħniena lejn it-tbatija ta' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is cruel causes suffering or shows no concern when other people or animals suffer.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva t-trattament tal-annimali bħala krudili u talab li jittieħdu miżuri biex jitwaqqaf.
formal.en: The report described the treatment of the animals as cruel and called for measures to stop it.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这种对待动物的方式十分残忍，并要求采取措施予以制止。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil xi ħadd jitfa' ġebla lejn qattus. Pawlu: Dik imġiba krudili. Il-qattus weġġa'? Maja: Le, ħarab fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: I saw someone throw a stone at a cat. Pawlu: That's cruel behaviour. Was the cat hurt? Maja: No, it got away in time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我看到有人朝一只猫扔石头。保罗：这种行为真残忍。猫受伤了吗？玛雅：没有，它及时跑开了。

messages.speaker: Maja (目击事件的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil xi ħadd jitfa' ġebla lejn qattus.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil xi ħadd jitfa' ġebla lejn qattus.
messages.zh: 我看到有人朝一只猫扔石头。
messages.en: I saw someone throw a stone at a cat.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik imġiba krudili. Il-qattus weġġa'?
messages.mt_standard: Dik imġiba krudili. Il-qattus weġġa'?
messages.zh: 这种行为真残忍。猫受伤了吗？
messages.en: That's cruel behaviour. Was the cat hurt?

messages.speaker: Maja (目击事件的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħarab fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħarab fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 没有，它及时跑开了。
messages.en: No, it got away in time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 krudili 时抓住两个画面：让别人受苦，以及看见痛苦却没有怜悯；搭配 imġiba krudili（残忍的行为）反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something crucial is extremely important because the result or success of something depends on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对结果或成败具有决定性影响的；至关重要的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa kruċjali hija importanti ħafna għax ir-riżultat jew is-suċċess jiddependi minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至关重要的；对事情的结果或成败起关键作用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun kruċjali meta jkollha importanza kbira ħafna u tkun tista' tiddetermina r-riżultat ta' sitwazzjoni jew ta' azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is crucial, it is extremely important because the outcome depends on it.

formal.mt: Il-kooperazzjoni bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri għandha rwol kruċjali fl-appoġġ lit-tfal li għandhom diffikultajiet fit-tagħlim.
formal.en: Cooperation between teachers and parents plays a crucial role in supporting children who have learning difficulties.
formal.zh: 教师与家长之间的合作，对支持有学习困难的儿童起着关键作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu nitilqu mingħajr il-mappa? Mark: Aħjar le. Il-mappa hija kruċjali biex insibu t-triq. Sara: Sewwa, se nġibha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we leave without the map? Mark: Better not. The map is crucial for finding our way. Sara: All right, I'll get it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：不带地图也能出发吗？马克：最好别。地图对找到路线至关重要。萨拉：好，我去拿。

messages.speaker: Sara (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitilqu mingħajr il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitilqu mingħajr il-mappa?
messages.zh: 不带地图也能出发吗？
messages.en: Can we leave without the map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le. Il-mappa hija kruċjali biex insibu t-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le. Il-mappa hija kruċjali biex insibu t-triq.
messages.zh: 最好别。地图对找到路线至关重要。
messages.en: Better not. The map is crucial for finding our way.

messages.speaker: Sara (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, se nġibha.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, se nġibha.
messages.zh: 好，我去拿。
messages.en: All right, I'll get it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kruċjali 记成影响成败的那一环：普通重要可以缺少，关键一环缺了就可能失败，用 rwol kruċjali（关键作用）巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 十字军东征；为某项事业开展的积极运动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crusade is a determined campaign for a cause; in a historical religious context, it can refer to a military expedition fought in the name of religion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为支持某项事业或反对某种弊端而开展的坚定运动；在历史宗教语境中，也指以宗教名义进行的军事远征，如十字军东征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kruċjata hija kampanja determinata favur kawża jew kontra xi ħaġa meqjusa ħażina; f'kuntest storiku reliġjuż, tista' tfisser spedizzjoni militari f'isem ir-reliġjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某项事业进行的积极而坚定的运动；在历史宗教语境中，指以宗教名义发动的军事远征，尤指十字军东征。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kruċjata hija kampanja li ssir b'determinazzjoni biex tintlaħaq bidla jew tiġi difiża kawża; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal spedizzjoni militari storika li ssir f'isem ir-reliġjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crusade is a determined campaign for a cause, or a historical military expedition undertaken in the name of religion.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni nediet kruċjata kontra l-korruzzjoni, b'enfasi fuq it-trasparenza u r-responsabbiltà fl-amministrazzjoni pubblika.
formal.en: The organisation launched a crusade against corruption, with an emphasis on transparency and accountability in public administration.
formal.zh: 该组织发起了一场反腐败运动，重点推动公共行政的透明度和问责。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tiġbor dawn il-firem kollha? Nina: Bdejna kruċjata biex insalvaw il-ġnien tal-lokal. Lara: Mela niffirma jien ukoll!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you collecting all these signatures? Nina: We've started a crusade to save the local garden. Lara: Then I'll sign too!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在收集这么多签名？妮娜：我们发起了一场保住社区花园的运动。拉拉：那我也签！

messages.speaker: Lara (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiġbor dawn il-firem kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiġbor dawn il-firem kollha?
messages.zh: 你为什么在收集这么多签名？
messages.en: Why are you collecting all these signatures?

messages.speaker: Nina (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejna kruċjata biex insalvaw il-ġnien tal-lokal.
messages.mt_standard: Bdejna kruċjata biex insalvaw il-ġnien tal-lokal.
messages.zh: 我们发起了一场保住社区花园的运动。
messages.en: We've started a crusade to save the local garden.

messages.speaker: Lara (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela niffirma jien ukoll!
messages.mt_standard: Mela niffirma jien ukoll!
messages.zh: 那我也签！
messages.en: Then I'll sign too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 kruċjata 准备两幅语境图：历史课上的十字军东征，以及社区里为目标奔走的运动；看到 kontra 想反对，看到 favur 想支持。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A holiday voyage on a ship, usually with visits to several places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乘船进行的休闲旅行，通常沿途停靠多个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjaġġ ta' btala fuq vapur, ġeneralment b'waqfiet f'diversi postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乘船进行、以休闲观光为目的的旅行，通常沿途停靠不同地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vjaġġ fuq vapur għall-mistrieħ u t-tgawdija, li spiss jinkludi żjarat f'diversi postijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cruise is a holiday spent travelling on a ship, often stopping at different places.

formal.mt: L-aġenzija organizzat kruż ta' sebat ijiem fil-Mediterran, b'waqfiet fi tliet portijiet.
formal.en: The agency organised a seven-day Mediterranean cruise with stops at three ports.
formal.zh: 旅行社安排了一次为期七天的地中海邮轮旅行，沿途停靠三个港口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tixtieq tagħmel kruż fis-sajf? Mark: Iva, imma nixtieq wieħed b'ħafna waqfiet biex inżuru postijiet differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to go on a cruise in summer? Mark: Yes, but I'd like one with plenty of stops so we can visit different places.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想夏天去坐邮轮旅行吗？马克：想，不过我希望沿途多停几站，这样我们就能游览不同的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tixtieq tagħmel kruż fis-sajf?
messages.mt_standard: Tixtieq tagħmel kruż fis-sajf?
messages.zh: 你想夏天去坐邮轮旅行吗？
messages.en: Would you like to go on a cruise in summer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nixtieq wieħed b'ħafna waqfiet biex inżuru postijiet differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nixtieq wieħed b'ħafna waqfiet biex inżuru postijiet differenti.
messages.zh: 想，不过我希望沿途多停几站，这样我们就能游览不同的地方。
messages.en: Yes, but I'd like one with plenty of stops so we can visit different places.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kruż 和英语 cruise 配对记忆，脑中想象邮轮沿海航行、逐站观光的画面。

gloss_zh: 盖住它；给它蒙上覆盖物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Putting a covering over the particular thing being referred to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布、毯子等覆盖物盖住所指的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqegħid ta' xi ħaġa bħal drapp jew kutra fuq l-oġġett imsemmi sabiex ikun mgħotti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用适当的覆盖物把所指的东西盖住。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tqegħid ta' għata fuq il-ħaġa li qed tissemma, sabiex din tkun mgħottija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression refers to putting a covering over the particular thing being mentioned.

collocations.en: covered it with a clean cloth
collocations.zh: 用干净的布把它盖住了

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem poġġa l-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa u ksieha b'drapp nadif biex jipproteġiha mit-trab.
formal.en: The worker placed the box on the shelf and covered it with a clean cloth to protect it from dust.
formal.zh: 工人把箱子放在架子上，并用干净的布盖住它，以免落灰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-kaxxa tal-ġugarelli? Mark: Fuq l-ixkaffa. Pawlu ksieha b'kutra biex ma taqax trab fuqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the toy box? Mark: On the shelf. Pawlu covered it with a blanket to keep dust off it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：玩具箱在哪儿？马克：在架子上。保罗用毯子把它盖住了，免得落灰。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-kaxxa tal-ġugarelli?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-kaxxa tal-ġugarelli?
messages.zh: 玩具箱在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the toy box?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-ixkaffa. Pawlu ksieha b'kutra biex ma taqax trab fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-ixkaffa. Pawlu ksieha b'kutra biex ma taqax trab fuqha.
messages.zh: 在架子上。保罗用毯子把它盖住了，免得落灰。
messages.en: On the shelf. Pawlu covered it with a blanket to keep dust off it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ksieha 时，想象给箱子盖上一块布；把整个词与“盖住它”的动作画面绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 共用订单簿；共享订单登记簿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book used by several people to record and consult orders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由多人共同使用，用于记录和查阅订单的登记簿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb li jintuża minn diversi persuni biex fih iniżżlu u jikkonsultaw l-ordnijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供多人共同登记、查阅和跟进订单的簿册。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reġistru tal-ordnijiet li jkun disponibbli għal diversi persuni biex jiktbu fih u jiċċekkjaw l-informazzjoni mniżżla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shared order book is a record that several people use to enter and check orders.

collocations.en: to update the shared order book
to record an order in the shared order book
collocations.zh: 在共用订单簿中登记订单

formal.mt: Kull impjegat għandu jirreġistra l-ordnijiet ġodda fil-ktieb komuni tal-ordnijiet sabiex it-tim kollu jkollu l-istess informazzjoni.
formal.en: Every employee should record new orders in the shared order book so that the whole team has the same information.
formal.zh: 每位员工都应把新订单登记在共用订单簿中，以便整个团队掌握相同的信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Niżżilt l-ordni ta' Maria fil-ktieb komuni tal-ordnijiet? David: Iva, u ktibt ukoll meta trid tiġborha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you enter Maria's order in the shared order book? David: Yes, and I also wrote down when she wants to collect it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把玛丽亚的订单记进共用订单簿了吗？戴维：记了，我还写上了她想什么时候来取。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżżilt l-ordni ta' Maria fil-ktieb komuni tal-ordnijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Niżżilt l-ordni ta' Maria fil-ktieb komuni tal-ordnijiet?
messages.zh: 你把玛丽亚的订单记进共用订单簿了吗？
messages.en: Did you enter Maria's order in the shared order book?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ktibt ukoll meta trid tiġborha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ktibt ukoll meta trid tiġborha.
messages.zh: 记了，我还写上了她想什么时候来取。
messages.en: Yes, and I also wrote down when she wants to collect it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“簿册—共用—订单”三个意义块记忆，想象几位店员轮流在同一本订单簿上登记。

gloss_zh: 备忘簿；初步记账簿；草账簿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book for brief reminders or preliminary records, including rough accounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于记录简短备忘或初步资料的簿册，也可指正式入账前使用的草账簿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb għal noti qosra jew tagħrif preliminari, inklużi entrati finanzjarji qabel ma jiġu rreġistrati formalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于随手记录提醒事项、简短信息或待办事项的小簿册。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb żgħir li fih jinkitbu noti qosra, tfakkiriet u affarijiet li jridu jsiru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A memo book is a small book in which you write reminders and brief notes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在正式整理和入账之前，先行记录交易事项的草账簿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb li fih jitniżżlu t-tranżazzjonijiet bħala entrati preliminari qabel ma jiġu organizzati u trasferiti fir-reġistri formali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A waste book is a preliminary accounting book where transactions are noted before being transferred into formal records.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于初步记下交易、随后再转入正式账簿的草账簿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb għal noti inizjali dwar tranżazzjonijiet finanzjarji, li aktar tard jiġu trasferiti fil-kotba formali tal-kontijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A waste-book is a book used to make rough transaction entries before preparing the formal accounts.

collocations.en: to write a reminder in the memo book
collocations.zh: 在备忘簿里写下提醒事项

collocations.en: to transfer entries from the waste book
collocations.zh: 把草账簿中的记录转记到正式账簿

formal.mt: L-iskrivan niżżel it-tranżazzjonijiet fil-ktieb primi noti qabel ma ttrasferihom fir-reġistru formali tal-kontijiet.
formal.en: The clerk entered the transactions in the waste book before transferring them to the formal accounting record.
formal.zh: 办事员先把各笔交易记入草账簿，再将其转记到正式会计账簿中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se tiftakar x'għandek tixtri? Toni: Nikteb lista fil-ktieb primi noti u neħodha miegħi l-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Nina: How will you remember what you need to buy? Toni: I'll write a list in the memo book and take it with me to the shop.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么记住要买什么？托尼：我会在备忘簿里列个清单，去商店时带上。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tiftakar x'għandek tixtri?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tiftakar x'għandek tixtri?
messages.zh: 你怎么记住要买什么？
messages.en: How will you remember what you need to buy?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nikteb lista fil-ktieb primi noti u neħodha miegħi l-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Nikteb lista fil-ktieb primi noti u neħodha miegħi l-ħanut.
messages.zh: 我会在备忘簿里列个清单，去商店时带上。
messages.en: I'll write a list in the memo book and take it with me to the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先记下来，稍后整理”的画面串联两种用途：生活中记备忘，记账时先写草账。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Cuba or relating to its people, culture, or other features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自古巴的，或与古巴及其人民、文化等有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Kuba jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Kuba, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古巴的；与古巴有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Kuba, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Cuban is connected with Cuba, its people, or its culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Cuba
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自古巴的，或属于、涉及古巴的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina minn Kuba jew li għandu rabta ma' dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described as Cuban comes from Cuba or has a connection with that country.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi kunċert minn mużiċist kuban.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a concert by a Cuban musician.
formal.zh: 艺术节的节目安排包括一位古巴音乐家的音乐会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tipprova ikel kuban illejla? Mark: Iva, qatt ma ppruvajtu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to try Cuban food tonight? Mark: Yes, I've never tried it!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚想尝尝古巴食物吗？马克：想啊，我还从来没尝过！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tipprova ikel kuban illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tipprova ikel kuban illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚想尝尝古巴食物吗？
messages.en: Do you want to try Cuban food tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qatt ma ppruvajtu!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qatt ma ppruvajtu!
messages.zh: 想啊，我还从来没尝过！
messages.en: Yes, I've never tried it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuban 放进“古巴食物”和“古巴音乐家”两个短语中记忆，看到它就想到“来自古巴或与古巴有关”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A twentieth-century art movement, especially in painting, that represents subjects through geometric forms and multiple viewpoints.
