teaching_sense.zh_definition: 二十世纪的一种艺术运动，尤见于绘画，以几何形体和多个视角表现对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment artistiku tas-seklu għoxrin, speċjalment fil-pittura, li juri s-suġġetti permezz ta' forom ġeometriċi u minn diversi angoli.

sense_translations.en_definition: Cubism (20th Century movement in art, especially painting)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 立体主义：二十世纪的一种艺术运动，尤其体现在绘画中，常用几何形体及多个视角表现对象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moviment fl-arti tas-seklu għoxrin, l-aktar fil-pittura, li jirrappreżenta s-suġġetti b'forom ġeometriċi u minn diversi angoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cubism is a twentieth-century art movement in which artists, especially painters, represent subjects using geometric forms and different viewpoints.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif il-kubiżmu juża forom ġeometriċi biex jirrappreżenta oġġetti minn diversi angoli.
formal.en: The study examines how Cubism uses geometric forms to represent objects from different viewpoints.
formal.zh: 这项研究探讨立体主义如何运用几何形体，从多个视角表现物体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ jidher minn żewġ naħat fl-istess ħin? Pawlu: Din hi pittura tal-kubiżmu; turi s-suġġett minn diversi angoli.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this face seem to be shown from two sides at once? Pawlu: This is a Cubist painting; it shows the subject from different viewpoints.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这张脸看起来同时展示了两个侧面？保罗：这是立体主义绘画，它从多个视角表现对象。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ jidher minn żewġ naħat fl-istess ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ jidher minn żewġ naħat fl-istess ħin?
messages.zh: 为什么这张脸看起来同时展示了两个侧面？
messages.en: Why does this face seem to be shown from two sides at once?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi pittura tal-kubiżmu; turi s-suġġett minn diversi angoli.
messages.mt_standard: Din hi pittura tal-kubiżmu; turi s-suġġett minn diversi angoli.
messages.zh: 这是立体主义绘画，它从多个视角表现对象。
messages.en: This is a Cubist painting; it shows the subject from different viewpoints.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kubiżmu 时想象一张由几何块面组成、同时展示多个角度的脸，用这幅画面联系“立体主义”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A competition in a village or town square in which participants try to climb a greased pole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在村庄或城镇广场举行的比赛，参赛者尝试爬上涂了油脂的杆子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni li ssir fi pjazza ta' raħal jew belt, fejn il-parteċipanti jippruvaw jitilgħu ma' arblu midluk bix-xaħam.

sense_translations.en_definition: a competiton held in a village or town square requiring participants to climb a greased pole
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在村庄或城镇广场举行、要求参赛者攀爬涂油杆的比赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni fi pjazza ta' raħal jew belt li fiha l-parteċipanti jridu jippruvaw jitilgħu ma' arblu midluk bix-xaħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kukkanja is a competition held in a village or town square where participants attempt to climb a greased pole.

collocations.en: to take part in the greased-pole climbing competition
the pole used in the greased-pole climbing competition
collocations.zh: 攀爬涂油杆比赛所用的杆子

formal.mt: Il-kukkanja se ssir fil-pjazza tar-raħal, fejn il-parteċipanti se jippruvaw jitilgħu ma' arblu midluk bix-xaħam.
formal.en: The greased-pole climbing competition will take place in the village square, where participants will try to climb a pole coated with grease.
formal.zh: 攀爬涂油杆比赛将在村广场举行，参赛者将尝试爬上一根涂了油脂的杆子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tieħu sehem fil-kukkanja llum? Ben: Le, se noqgħod nara; l-arblu jidher jiżloq ħafna!
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you taking part in the greased-pole climbing competition today? Ben: No, I'll just watch; the pole looks very slippery!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天要参加攀爬涂油杆比赛吗？本：不，我看看就好，那根杆子看起来太滑了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fil-kukkanja llum?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fil-kukkanja llum?
messages.zh: 你今天要参加攀爬涂油杆比赛吗？
messages.en: Are you taking part in the greased-pole climbing competition today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se noqgħod nara; l-arblu jidher jiżloq ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Le, se noqgħod nara; l-arblu jidher jiżloq ħafna!
messages.zh: 不，我看看就好，那根杆子看起来太滑了！
messages.en: No, I'll just watch; the pole looks very slippery!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kukkanja 时想象村广场上一根油滑的杆子，参赛者努力往上爬；用“广场、油杆、攀爬”三个画面记住比赛含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whenever means every time that a particular event happens or a particular situation occurs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示每次某件事发生或某种情况出现时，另一件事也随之发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni kull meta tfisser f'kull okkażjoni li fiha sseħħ xi ħaġa jew tinħoloq ċerta sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每当；每次某个事件发生或某种情况出现时。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kull meta tintuża biex torbot xi ħaġa ma' kull okkażjoni li fiha jiġri avveniment ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use whenever to indicate that something happens every time a particular event or situation occurs.

formal.mt: Kull meta tinbidel l-iskeda, l-istudenti jirċievu avviż bil-posta elettronika.
formal.en: Whenever the schedule changes, students receive an email notification.
formal.zh: 每当时间表发生变更，学生都会收到电子邮件通知。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kull meta niġi hawn, insibek taqra! Mark: Iva, inħobb naqra hawn għax hemm il-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Whenever I come here, I find you reading! Mark: Yes, I like reading here because it's quiet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我每次来这里，都看见你在读书！马克：是啊，我喜欢在这里读书，因为这里很安静。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull meta niġi hawn, insibek taqra!
messages.mt_standard: Kull meta niġi hawn, insibek taqra!
messages.zh: 我每次来这里，都看见你在读书！
messages.en: Whenever I come here, I find you reading!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħobb naqra hawn għax hemm il-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħobb naqra hawn għax hemm il-kwiet.
messages.zh: 是啊，我喜欢在这里读书，因为这里很安静。
messages.en: Yes, I like reading here because it's quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每次按下按钮，灯都会亮”的重复画面记 kull meta：它强调每一次发生都对应一个结果，练习套用“每当……，就……”句式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Every year, describing something that happens or is repeated annually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每一年，用来说明某事每年发生或重复进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'kull waħda mis-snin, biex tindika xi ħaġa li sseħħ jew terġa' ssir sena wara sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每年；表示某事一年发生一次或年年发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'kull sena, meta xi ħaġa sseħħ jew tiġi ripetuta sena wara sena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens yearly, it happens every year.

formal.mt: Il-librerija torganizza wirja tal-kotba kull sena biex tħeġġeġ il-qari.
formal.en: The library organises a book exhibition every year to encourage reading.
formal.zh: 图书馆每年举办一次图书展，以鼓励阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tmorru Għawdex kull sena? Mark: Iva, immorru kull sena fis-sajf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you go to Gozo every year? Mark: Yes, we go every year in summer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们每年都去戈佐岛吗？马克：对，我们每年夏天都去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmorru Għawdex kull sena?
messages.mt_standard: Tmorru Għawdex kull sena?
messages.zh: 你们每年都去戈佐岛吗？
messages.en: Do you go to Gozo every year?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, immorru kull sena fis-sajf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, immorru kull sena fis-sajf.
messages.zh: 对，我们每年夏天都去。
messages.en: Yes, we go every year in summer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历连续翻过三年，每一页都圈出同一个活动，用 kull sena 记住“每年都会发生”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collar is the part of a garment around the neck, or a band worn around an animal's neck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣服上围绕颈部的衣领，也指戴在动物颈部的项圈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kullar huwa l-parti ta' libsa li ddur mal-għonq, jew ċinga li titqiegħed madwar għonq annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣领；戴在动物颈部的项圈。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kullar huwa parti minn ilbies li ddur mal-għonq, jew ċinga madwar għonq annimal li magħha tista' titwaħħal ċinga oħra biex jinżamm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A collar is a part of clothing that surrounds the neck, or a band placed around an animal's neck.

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, kun żgur li l-kullar tal-qmis ikun nadif.
formal.en: Before the meeting, make sure that the collar of your shirt is clean.
formal.zh: 开会前，请确保衬衫衣领干净。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-kullar tal-kelb? Pawlu: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the dog's collar? Pawlu: On the table, next to the keys.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狗的项圈在哪里？保罗：在桌上，钥匙旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-kullar tal-kelb?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-kullar tal-kelb?
messages.zh: 狗的项圈在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the dog's collar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 在桌上，钥匙旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kullar 和“围住脖子的一圈”联系起来：衬衫上是衣领，狗脖子上是项圈；用后面的 tal-qmis 或 tal-kelb 判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A college is an educational institution where students follow courses of study or vocational training.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供课程学习或职业培训的教育机构，通常可译为学院或专科学校。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kulleġġ huwa istituzzjoni edukattiva fejn l-istudenti jsegwu korsijiet ta' studju jew taħriġ għal xogħol partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学院；提供专门课程、进一步教育或职业培训的学校。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kulleġġ huwa istituzzjoni li toffri lill-istudenti korsijiet ta' tagħlim jew taħriġ f'suġġetti u oqsma differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A college is an educational institution where students take courses in academic subjects or train for particular occupations.

formal.mt: Il-kulleġġ se joffri kors ġdid fil-fotografija minn Ottubru.
formal.en: The college will offer a new photography course starting in October.
formal.zh: 该学院将从十月起开设一门新的摄影课程。

colloquial.mt: Marija: F'liema kulleġġ qed tistudja? David: F'kulleġġ tal-arti, u qed nitgħallem il-fotografija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which college are you studying at? David: At an art college, and I'm learning photography.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你在哪所学院学习？戴维：在一所艺术学院，我正在学摄影。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema kulleġġ qed tistudja?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema kulleġġ qed tistudja?
messages.zh: 你在哪所学院学习？
messages.en: Which college are you studying at?

messages.speaker: David (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'kulleġġ tal-arti, u qed nitgħallem il-fotografija.
messages.mt_standard: F'kulleġġ tal-arti, u qed nitgħallem il-fotografija.
messages.zh: 在一所艺术学院，我正在学摄影。
messages.en: At an art college, and I'm learning photography.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kulleġġ 放进“在学院学一门课程”的画面里，连着记 f'kulleġġ（在学院）和 kors（课程），帮助区分学校与所学内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Everyone means every person in a group; when followed by a clause, it refers to all people who meet the stated condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个范围内的每个人；后接说明时，指所有符合该条件的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kullmin jirreferi għal kull persuna fi grupp jew għal dawk kollha li jissodisfaw il-kundizzjoni msemmija fis-sentenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每个人；所有人；后接条件说明时表示所有符合条件的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kullmin ifisser kull persuna li tkun inkluża fil-grupp jew fid-deskrizzjoni mogħtija, mingħajr ma titħalla barra xi persuna minn dak il-grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use everyone to refer to all the people in a particular group, without excluding any individual.

formal.mt: Kullmin jixtieq jipparteċipa fil-kors għandu jimla l-formola sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: Everyone who wishes to participate in the course must complete the form by Friday.
formal.zh: 所有希望参加课程的人都必须在星期五之前填好表格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min jista' jiġi għall-piknik? Luqa: Kullmin irid! Ġib lil oħtok ukoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who can come to the picnic? Luqa: Anyone who wants to! Bring your sister too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁可以来参加野餐？卢卡：想来的人都可以！把你姐姐也带来吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jiġi għall-piknik?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jiġi għall-piknik?
messages.zh: 谁可以来参加野餐？
messages.en: Who can come to the picnic?

messages.speaker: Luqa (野餐组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kullmin irid! Ġib lil oħtok ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Kullmin irid! Ġib lil oħtok ukoll.
messages.zh: 想来的人都可以！把你姐姐也带来吧。
messages.en: Anyone who wants to! Bring your sister too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kullmin 想成一张开放报名名单：凡是符合后面条件的人都算在内。连着记 kullmin irid（所有想要的人），抓住“一个也不漏”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of religious beliefs and practices, or intense devotion directed towards a particular person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某种宗教信仰形成的崇奉与仪式体系，也可指对特定人物或事物的强烈崇拜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' twemmin u prattiki reliġjużi, jew devozzjoni qawwija lejn persuna jew ħaġa partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有特定信仰与仪式的宗教崇奉体系；也可指围绕某个人物或事物形成的强烈崇拜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' twemmin u riti reliġjużi, jew qima u devozzjoni qawwija lejn persuna jew ħaġa partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cult is a system of religious beliefs and practices, or strong devotion to a particular person or thing.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina t-twemmin u r-riti ta' kult reliġjuż.
formal.en: The study examines the beliefs and rituals of a religious cult.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察一种宗教崇奉体系的信仰与仪式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser il-kult tal-personalità? Pawlu: Meta n-nies iqimu mexxej u jittrattawh bħallikieku qatt ma jiżbalja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the cult of personality mean? Pawlu: It is when people idolise a leader and treat him as if he never makes mistakes.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：个人崇拜是什么意思？保罗：就是人们把一位领袖当作偶像崇拜，仿佛他从来不会犯错。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser il-kult tal-personalità?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser il-kult tal-personalità?
messages.zh: 个人崇拜是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the cult of personality mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta n-nies iqimu mexxej u jittrattawh bħallikieku qatt ma jiżbalja.
messages.mt_standard: Meta n-nies iqimu mexxej u jittrattawh bħallikieku qatt ma jiżbalja.
messages.zh: 就是人们把一位领袖当作偶像崇拜，仿佛他从来不会犯错。
messages.en: It is when people idolise a leader and treat him as if he never makes mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群人围绕共同信仰举行仪式，把 kult 与“集中崇奉”联系；再用个人崇拜这个搭配扩展记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a colour or colours, including colour that has been added to a material or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有某种颜色或多种颜色的，也可指材料或物体经过着色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur wieħed jew aktar, jew li ngħata l-kulur permezz ta' żebgħa jew proċess ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有颜色的；经染色、涂色等处理而带有颜色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur jew kuluri, sew jekk il-kulur hu naturali u sew jekk ġie miżjud.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is coloured has a colour or colours, either naturally or because colour has been added.

formal.mt: It-twieqi tal-bini fihom ħġieġ kulurit li jħalli d-dawl jgħaddi.
formal.en: The building's windows contain coloured glass that lets light pass through.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑的窗户装有能够透光的彩色玻璃。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid id-drapp abjad jew dak kulurit? Mark: Dak kulurit, jekk jogħġbok. Se nużah għall-purtieri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want the white fabric or the coloured one? Mark: The coloured one, please. I am going to use it for curtains.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要白布还是有颜色的那块？马克：请给我有颜色的那块。我打算用它做窗帘。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid id-drapp abjad jew dak kulurit?
messages.mt_standard: Trid id-drapp abjad jew dak kulurit?
messages.zh: 你要白布还是有颜色的那块？
messages.en: Do you want the white fabric or the coloured one?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kulurit, jekk jogħġbok. Se nużah għall-purtieri.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kulurit, jekk jogħġbok. Se nużah għall-purtieri.
messages.zh: 请给我有颜色的那块。我打算用它做窗帘。
messages.en: The coloured one, please. I am going to use it for curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象透明玻璃与彩色玻璃，指着后者说 ħġieġ kulurit，用视觉对比记住“有颜色的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People who take part in fighting, especially during a war or armed conflict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与战斗的人，尤指战争或武装冲突中的战斗人员；此处为复数用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni li jieħdu sehem fil-ġlied, speċjalment waqt gwerra jew kunflitt armat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战斗人员；参加战争或武装冲突中战斗的人们。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nies li jipparteċipaw fil-ġlied ta' gwerra jew ta' kunflitt armat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Combatants are people who take part in fighting during a war or armed conflict.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-kumbattenti midruba ngħataw kura medika wara l-battalja.
formal.en: The report describes how the wounded combatants received medical care after the battle.
formal.zh: 报告描述了受伤的战斗人员在战斗结束后如何获得医疗救治。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min huma l-kumbattenti f'dan il-film? David: Huma dawk li qed jieħdu sehem fil-ġlied.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who are the combatants in this film? David: They are the people taking part in the fighting.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这部电影里的战斗人员是哪些人？戴维：就是那些正在参加战斗的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min huma l-kumbattenti f'dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min huma l-kumbattenti f'dan il-film?
messages.zh: 这部电影里的战斗人员是哪些人？
messages.en: Who are the combatants in this film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma dawk li qed jieħdu sehem fil-ġlied.
messages.mt_standard: Huma dawk li qed jieħdu sehem fil-ġlied.
messages.zh: 就是那些正在参加战斗的人。
messages.en: They are the people taking part in the fighting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把电影中正在参加战斗的几个人一起圈出，标上 kumbattenti，记住这里指复数的“参战者们”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unexpected connection between events, or an arrangement of things brought together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事件之间意外出现的巧合，或若干事物搭配形成的组合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qbil mhux mistenni bejn ġrajjiet, jew għaqda ta' affarijiet flimkien f'arranġament wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个或多个事件碰巧同时发生或意外吻合的情况；巧合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni fejn żewġ ġrajjiet jew aktar jaqblu jew iseħħu flimkien b'kumbinazzjoni, mingħajr ma dan ikun ippjanat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coincidence is a situation in which events unexpectedly happen together or share a surprising connection.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由两个或多个事物结合、搭配而成的组合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' żewġ elementi jew aktar li jitqiegħdu jew jintużaw flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A combination is an arrangement of two or more things that are brought together.

formal.mt: Il-kumbinazzjoni ta' dawn iż-żewġ kuluri tagħmel it-test aktar faċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: The combination of these two colours makes the text easier to read.
formal.zh: 这两种颜色的搭配使文字更容易阅读。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'kumbinazzjoni! Int ukoll ġejt hawn għall-kafè? Pawlu: Iva! Ma kontx naf li kont se tkun hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: What a coincidence! Have you come here for coffee too? Pawlu: Yes! I didn't know you were going to be here.
colloquial.zh: Marija：真巧！你也来这里喝咖啡吗？Pawlu：是啊！我不知道你会来这里。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kumbinazzjoni! Int ukoll ġejt hawn għall-kafè?
messages.mt_standard: X'kumbinazzjoni! Int ukoll ġejt hawn għall-kafè?
messages.zh: 真巧！你也来这里喝咖啡吗？
messages.en: What a coincidence! Have you come here for coffee too?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Ma kontx naf li kont se tkun hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Ma kontx naf li kont se tkun hawn.
messages.zh: 是啊！我不知道你会来这里。
messages.en: Yes! I didn't know you were going to be here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项都想成“碰到一起”：事件意外碰到一起是“巧合”，颜色或材料搭配到一起是“组合”。用 b'kumbinazzjoni 记“碰巧”，用 kumbinazzjoni ta' kuluri 记“色彩组合”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Free time or an unhurried state in which a person can relax or do something at their own pace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以休息或按照自己的节奏做事的闲暇时间或悠闲状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħin liberu jew stat bla għaġla li fih wieħed jista' jistrieħ jew jagħmel xi ħaġa bil-pass tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不受工作或其他事务催促、可以自由安排活动的闲暇或悠闲状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħin jew stat ta' mistrieħ u nuqqas ta' għaġla, meta wieħed ikun ħieles minn xogħol jew dmirijiet oħra u jista' jagħmel dak li jixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Leisure is time when you are free from work or other duties and can relax or enjoy activities.

collocations.zh: 在你有空时；按你方便的节奏

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jaqraw il-materjal fil-kumdità tagħhom wara ż-żjara.
formal.en: Visitors can read the material at their leisure after the visit.
formal.zh: 参观结束后，访客可以在闲暇时慢慢阅读这些材料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi nirritornalek il-ktieb illum? Luqa: Le, aqrah fil-kumdità tiegħek. M'għandix għaġla.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do I need to return the book to you today? Luqa: No, read it at your leisure. I'm in no hurry.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我今天需要把书还给你吗？Luqa：不用，你有空慢慢看。我不急。

messages.speaker: Anna (借书的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nirritornalek il-ktieb illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nirritornalek il-ktieb illum?
messages.zh: 我今天需要把书还给你吗？
messages.en: Do I need to return the book to you today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (出借书的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, aqrah fil-kumdità tiegħek. M'għandix għaġla.
messages.mt_standard: Le, aqrah fil-kumdità tiegħek. M'għandix għaġla.
messages.zh: 不用，你有空慢慢看。我不急。
messages.en: No, read it at your leisure. I'm in no hurry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象周末坐下来慢慢看书的画面，把 kumdità 和“闲暇、悠闲”相连。整句记 Aqrah fil-kumdità tiegħek，意思是“你有空慢慢读”，借此记住不赶时间的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people chosen to discuss, organise, or make decisions about a particular matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为讨论、组织或决定某一特定事务而选出或设立的人员团体；委员会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' persuni magħżula biex jiddiskutu, jorganizzaw jew jieħdu deċiżjonijiet dwar kwistjoni jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由若干成员组成、负责某项事务的讨论、组织或决策工作的委员会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' membri maħturin jew eletti biex jieħdu ħsieb xogħol partikolari, jiddiskutu kwistjonijiet jew jieħdu deċiżjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A committee is a group of people appointed or elected to carry out a particular task or make decisions.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina l-proposti u qabel dwar il-passi li jmiss.
formal.en: The committee examined the proposals and agreed on the next steps.
formal.zh: 委员会审议了各项提案，并就接下来的步骤达成一致。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int membru tal-kumitat tal-festa? Mark: Iva, u llum għandna laqgħa biex nippjanaw il-programm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you a member of the festival committee? Mark: Yes, and today we have a meeting to plan the programme.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你是节庆委员会的成员吗？Mark：是的，我们今天要开会安排活动。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Int membru tal-kumitat tal-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Int membru tal-kumitat tal-festa?
messages.zh: 你是节庆委员会的成员吗？
messages.en: Are you a member of the festival committee?

messages.speaker: Mark (委员会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u llum għandna laqgħa biex nippjanaw il-programm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u llum għandna laqgħa biex nippjanaw il-programm.
messages.zh: 是的，我们今天要开会安排活动。
messages.en: Yes, and today we have a meeting to plan the programme.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kumitat 放进“一群委员围桌开会”的画面里记。再串起 membru tal-kumitat“委员会成员”和 laqgħa tal-kumitat“委员会会议”，用人物与活动共同巩固词义。

exact_key: kumitat tal-partijiet konċernati dwar l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità
gloss_zh: 远期容量分配利益相关方委员会

teaching_sense.en_definition: A committee of stakeholders concerned with allocating capacity in advance for a future period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由利益相关方组成、讨论未来时段容量预先分配事宜的委员会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kumitat magħmul minn partijiet konċernati li jittratta l-allokazzjoni tal-kapaċità minn qabel għal perjodu futur.

sense_translations.en_definition: stakeholder committee for forward capacity allocation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 就远期容量分配事宜开展讨论或工作的利益相关方委员会；其中远期容量分配指为未来时段预先分配容量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kumitat li jiġbor flimkien il-partijiet konċernati biex jittrattaw kwistjonijiet dwar kif il-kapaċità tiġi allokata minn qabel għal perjodi futuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stakeholder committee for forward capacity allocation brings together interested or affected parties to address how capacity is allocated in advance for future periods.

collocations.mt: laqgħa tal-kumitat tal-partijiet konċernati dwar l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità
collocations.en: a meeting of the stakeholder committee for forward capacity allocation
collocations.zh: 远期容量分配利益相关方委员会会议

collocations.mt: membru tal-kumitat tal-partijiet konċernati dwar l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità
collocations.en: a member of the stakeholder committee for forward capacity allocation
collocations.zh: 远期容量分配利益相关方委员会成员

formal.mt: Il-kumitat tal-partijiet konċernati dwar l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità ddiskuta l-proposti għall-perjodu li jmiss.
formal.en: The stakeholder committee for forward capacity allocation discussed the proposals for the next period.
formal.zh: 远期容量分配利益相关方委员会讨论了下一时段的相关提案。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Ma' liema kumitat għandek laqgħa llum? David: Mal-kumitat tal-partijiet konċernati dwar l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità. Se niddiskutu l-proposti għall-perjodu li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Elena: Which committee are you meeting with today? David: The stakeholder committee for forward capacity allocation. We're going to discuss the proposals for the next period.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你今天要和哪个委员会开会？David：远期容量分配利益相关方委员会。我们要讨论下一时段的相关提案。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' liema kumitat għandek laqgħa llum?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' liema kumitat għandek laqgħa llum?
messages.zh: 你今天要和哪个委员会开会？
messages.en: Which committee are you meeting with today?

messages.speaker: David (参会同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-kumitat tal-partijiet konċernati dwar l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità. Se niddiskutu l-proposti għall-perjodu li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-kumitat tal-partijiet konċernati dwar l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità. Se niddiskutu l-proposti għall-perjodu li jmiss.
messages.zh: 远期容量分配利益相关方委员会。我们要讨论下一时段的相关提案。
messages.en: The stakeholder committee for forward capacity allocation. We're going to discuss the proposals for the next period.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记长词组：kumitat“委员会”、tal-partijiet konċernati“利益相关方的”、dwar“关于”、l-allokazzjoni bil-quddiem tal-kapaċità“容量的预先分配”。先抓住委员会，再补充由谁组成、讨论什么，最后整理成中文“远期容量分配利益相关方委员会”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spoken or written remark that expresses an opinion or observation about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某件事、某个人或某段内容，以口头或书面形式表达的意见、看法或观察。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kumment huwa kliem miktub jew mitkellem li jesprimi opinjoni jew osservazzjoni dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就某件事或某段内容表达的评论、意见或评语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kumment huwa stqarrija qasira, bil-fomm jew bil-kitba, li fiha persuna tagħti l-opinjoni tagħha jew tagħmel osservazzjoni dwar suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A comment is something you say or write to express an opinion or observation about a particular subject.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema kitbet kumment kostruttiv dwar kif l-istudent seta' jtejjeb il-kitba tiegħu.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher wrote a constructive comment on how the student could improve his writing.
formal.zh: 教师在报告中写了一条建设性的评语，说明这名学生可以如何改进写作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qrajt il-kumment tiegħi taħt ir-ritratt? Pawlu: Iva, qrajtu. Grazzi tal-kliem sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you read my comment under the photo? Pawlu: Yes, I did. Thanks for the kind words!
colloquial.zh: Marija：你看了我在照片下面的评论吗？Pawlu：看了。谢谢你说的那些暖心话！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kumment tiegħi taħt ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kumment tiegħi taħt ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 你看了我在照片下面的评论吗？
messages.en: Did you read my comment under the photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajtu. Grazzi tal-kliem sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajtu. Grazzi tal-kliem sabiħ!
messages.zh: 看了。谢谢你说的那些暖心话！
messages.en: Yes, I did. Thanks for the kind words!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kumment 放进“照片下留一句评论”的画面里，再用 tagħmel kumment 练习“发表评论”，把单词和表达动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of buying and selling goods and services between people, businesses, or countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人、企业或国家之间买卖商品和服务的商业活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ huwa l-attività tax-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' oġġetti u servizzi bejn persuni, negozji jew pajjiżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以商品和服务的买卖为核心的商业或贸易活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ huwa x-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' oġġetti u servizzi, kemm f'pajjiż wieħed kif ukoll bejn pajjiżi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling goods and services, especially between businesses or countries.

formal.mt: Il-kummerċ elettroniku jippermetti lin-negozji jbigħu l-prodotti tagħhom lil klijenti f'pajjiżi differenti.
formal.en: Electronic commerce enables businesses to sell their products to customers in different countries.
formal.zh: 电子商务使企业能够向不同国家的客户销售产品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja bħalissa? Mark: Il-kummerċ. Qed nitgħallem kif in-negozji jixtru u jbigħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying at the moment? Mark: Commerce. I'm learning how businesses buy and sell.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你最近在学什么？Mark：商业。我在学习企业如何开展买卖。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tistudja bħalissa?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tistudja bħalissa?
messages.zh: 你最近在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying at the moment?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kummerċ. Qed nitgħallem kif in-negozji jixtru u jbigħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kummerċ. Qed nitgħallem kif in-negozji jixtru u jbigħu.
messages.zh: 商业。我在学习企业如何开展买卖。
messages.en: Commerce. I'm learning how businesses buy and sell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商店里“买进、卖出”的连续动作，把 kummerċ 记作整类商业活动；再联系 kummerċ elettroniku，把网上购物也放进这个概念。

gloss_zh: 对外贸易；外贸；海外贸易

teaching_sense.en_definition: The buying and selling of goods and services between one country and other countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个国家与其他国家之间开展的商品和服务买卖，包括进口和出口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ barrani huwa x-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' oġġetti u servizzi bejn pajjiż u pajjiżi oħra, u jinkludi l-importazzjoni u l-esportazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对外贸易，指从一个国家的角度看，与其境外经济体开展的商品和服务交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ barrani huwa l-iskambju kummerċjali ta' pajjiż ma' pajjiżi oħra, li permezz tiegħu jixtri minn barra u jbigħ lil barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: External trade is the buying and selling of goods and services between a country and economies outside its borders.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外贸，指本国与外国之间的商品和服务买卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ barrani huwa l-attività li biha persuni jew negozji f'pajjiż jixtru oġġetti u servizzi minn pajjiżi oħra jew ibigħuhom lilhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Foreign trade is commercial activity in which a country buys goods and services from other countries or sells to them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海外贸易，指与海外国家或市场开展的商品和服务买卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ barrani jista' jirreferi għax-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' oġġetti u servizzi ma' pajjiżi jew swieq lil hinn mill-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Overseas trade is the buying and selling of goods and services with countries or markets across the sea.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-kummerċ barrani jippreżenta ċifri separati għall-importazzjoni u għall-esportazzjoni tal-oġġetti.
formal.en: The report on external trade presents separate figures for imports and exports of goods.
formal.zh: 这份对外贸易报告分别列出了商品进口和出口的数据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kumpanija tagħkom tbigħ biss hawn Malta? David: Le, taħdem ukoll fil-kummerċ barrani. Nixtru minn barra u nbigħu lil klijenti f'pajjiżi oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your company only sell here in Malta? David: No, it also engages in foreign trade. We buy from abroad and sell to customers in other countries.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你们公司只在马耳他本地销售吗？David：不是，也做外贸。我们从国外采购，再卖给其他国家的客户。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tagħkom tbigħ biss hawn Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tagħkom tbigħ biss hawn Malta?
messages.zh: 你们公司只在马耳他本地销售吗？
messages.en: Does your company only sell here in Malta?

messages.speaker: David (公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, taħdem ukoll fil-kummerċ barrani. Nixtru minn barra u nbigħu lil klijenti f'pajjiżi oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, taħdem ukoll fil-kummerċ barrani. Nixtru minn barra u nbigħu lil klijenti f'pajjiżi oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，也做外贸。我们从国外采购，再卖给其他国家的客户。
messages.en: No, it also engages in foreign trade. We buy from abroad and sell to customers in other countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个代表本国的圆圈，再画进口、出口两支跨越圆圈的箭头，把 kummerċ barrani 与“本国对外做买卖”的视角一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The buying and selling of goods and services among countries throughout the world, considered as a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把世界各国之间的商品和服务买卖作为一个整体来看的全球贸易活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ dinji huwa x-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' oġġetti u servizzi bejn il-pajjiżi madwar id-dinja, meqjus bħala attività globali waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世界贸易，指全球各国之间商品和服务交易的整体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ dinji huwa l-kummerċ bejn il-pajjiżi kollha tad-dinja meqjus flimkien, inkluż il-moviment ta' oġġetti u servizzi minn pajjiż għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: World trade is the total commercial exchange of goods and services among countries across the world.

collocations.en: a country's share of world trade
collocations.zh: 一个国家在世界贸易中所占的份额

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif bidliet fl-ispejjeż tat-trasport jistgħu jaffettwaw il-volum tal-kummerċ dinji.
formal.en: The study examines how changes in transport costs can affect the volume of world trade.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察运输成本的变化如何影响世界贸易量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dik il-mappa? Ġanni: Qed nistudja l-kummerċ dinji. Il-vleġeġ juru kif l-oġġetti jimxu bejn il-pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you looking at that map? Ġanni: I'm studying world trade. The arrows show how goods move between countries.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么在看那张地图？Ġanni：我在学习世界贸易。箭头表示商品如何在各国之间流动。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dik il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dik il-mappa?
messages.zh: 你为什么在看那张地图？
messages.en: Why are you looking at that map?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistudja l-kummerċ dinji. Il-vleġeġ juru kif l-oġġetti jimxu bejn il-pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistudja l-kummerċ dinji. Il-vleġeġ juru kif l-oġġetti jimxu bejn il-pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 我在学习世界贸易。箭头表示商品如何在各国之间流动。
messages.en: I'm studying world trade. The arrows show how goods move between countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把视线拉到整张世界地图，想象各国之间密集的商品流动箭头；用这个全球画面记 kummerċ dinji，突出“世界贸易整体”的观察角度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Commercial activity involving the purchase and sale of goods or services through electronic networks, especially the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子网络，尤其是互联网，购买和销售商品或服务的商业活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività kummerċjali li tinvolvi x-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi permezz ta' netwerks elettroniċi, speċjalment l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子商务，指通过互联网等电子网络买卖商品或服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ elettroniku huwa x-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi fuq l-internet jew fuq netwerks elettroniċi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: E-commerce is business activity in which people buy and sell goods or services through electronic networks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子商务，指借助电子网络开展的商品或服务交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ elettroniku huwa attività ta' xiri u bejgħ li titwettaq permezz ta' netwerks elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic commerce is the use of electronic networks to carry out purchases and sales of goods or services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子贸易，指利用电子网络进行的商品或服务买卖活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ elettroniku huwa l-bejgħ u x-xiri ta' prodotti jew servizzi bl-użu ta' netwerks elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic trade takes place when goods or services are bought and sold through electronic networks.

formal.mt: Il-kors dwar il-kummerċ elettroniku jinkludi tagħlim dwar il-bejgħ fuq l-internet, il-ħlasijiet u s-servizz lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The course on electronic commerce includes instruction on online sales, payments and customer service.
formal.zh: 这门电子商务课程包括网上销售、支付和客户服务方面的教学。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tistudja l-kummerċ elettroniku? Luca: Għax irrid niftaħ ħanut fuq l-internet u nbiegħ ix-xogħol tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you studying e-commerce? Luca: Because I want to open an online shop and sell my work.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么在学电子商务？Luca：因为我想开一家网店，卖自己的作品。

messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistudja l-kummerċ elettroniku?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistudja l-kummerċ elettroniku?
messages.zh: 你为什么在学电子商务？
messages.en: Why are you studying e-commerce?

messages.speaker: Luca (手工艺创作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irrid niftaħ ħanut fuq l-internet u nbiegħ ix-xogħol tiegħi.

messages.zh: 因为我想开一家网店，卖自己的作品。
messages.en: Because I want to open an online shop and sell my work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“商业活动搬到电子网络上”来记忆：kummerċ 对应商业贸易，elettroniku 提醒你交易采用电子方式，整体就是电子商务。

gloss_zh: 烟草制品非法贸易；烟草制品非法贩运

teaching_sense.en_definition: The buying, selling, movement or distribution of tobacco products in violation of the law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反法律进行的烟草制品买卖、运输或分销活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xiri, il-bejgħ, it-trasport jew id-distribuzzjoni ta' prodotti tat-tabakk bi ksur tal-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟草非法贩运，指违反法律运输、流通或交易烟草制品的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ illeċitu tal-prodotti tat-tabakk huwa t-trasport, id-distribuzzjoni jew il-bejgħ ta' dawn il-prodotti bi ksur tal-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Illicit tobacco traffic is the illegal movement, distribution or trading of tobacco products.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟草制品非法贸易，指违反法律进行烟草制品买卖或分销的商业活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ illeċitu tal-prodotti tat-tabakk huwa attività ta' xiri, bejgħ jew distribuzzjoni ta' prodotti tat-tabakk li ssir bi ksur tal-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Illicit trade in tobacco products involves buying, selling or distributing those products in ways that break the law.

collocations.mt: il-ġlieda kontra l-kummerċ illeċitu tal-prodotti tat-tabakk
collocations.en: the fight against illicit trade in tobacco products
collocations.zh: 打击烟草制品非法贸易

collocations.en: the prevention of illicit trade in tobacco products
collocations.zh: 预防烟草制品非法贸易

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-kummerċ illeċitu tal-prodotti tat-tabakk u jipproponi aktar kooperazzjoni bejn l-awtoritajiet biex jiġi miġġieled.
formal.en: The report examines illicit trade in tobacco products and proposes greater cooperation between authorities to combat it.
formal.zh: 报告研究了烟草制品非法贸易，并提出加强有关部门之间的合作以打击这类活动。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-artiklu li qed taqra? David: Il-kummerċ illeċitu tal-prodotti tat-tabakk. Jispjega kif jinbiegħu sigaretti bi ksur tal-liġi.
colloquial.en: Rita: What is the subject of the article you are reading? David: Illicit trade in tobacco products. It explains how cigarettes are sold illegally.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你在看的文章讲什么？David：讲烟草制品非法贸易，解释香烟如何被违法销售。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-artiklu li qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-artiklu li qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在看的文章讲什么？
messages.en: What is the subject of the article you are reading?

messages.speaker: David (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kummerċ illeċitu tal-prodotti tat-tabakk. Jispjega kif jinbiegħu sigaretti bi ksur tal-liġi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kummerċ illeċitu tal-prodotti tat-tabakk. Jispjega kif jinbiegħu sigaretti bi ksur tal-liġi.
messages.zh: 讲烟草制品非法贸易，解释香烟如何被违法销售。
messages.en: Illicit trade in tobacco products. It explains how cigarettes are sold illegally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：kummerċ 是贸易，illeċitu 是非法的，tal-prodotti tat-tabakk 指烟草制品；串起来就是“烟草制品非法贸易”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trade that aims to give producers fair payment and support decent working conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在使生产者获得公平报酬，并支持良好劳动条件的贸易方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kummerċ li għandu l-għan li jiżgura ħlas ġust lill-produtturi u kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公平贸易，指以生产者获得公平报酬和劳动者享有良好工作条件为目标的贸易方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ ġust huwa mod ta' kummerċ li jfittex li l-produtturi jitħallsu b'mod ġust u li l-ħaddiema jkollhom kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol xierqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fair trade is trade intended to provide fair payment for producers and decent conditions for the people doing the work.

formal.mt: Il-politika tax-xiri tal-iskola tagħti preferenza lil prodotti tal-kummerċ ġust biex tappoġġa ħlas ġust lill-produtturi.
formal.en: The school's purchasing policy gives preference to fair trade products to support fair payment for producers.
formal.zh: 学校的采购政策优先选择公平贸易产品，以支持生产者获得公平报酬。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għażilt dan il-kafè tal-kummerċ ġust? Pawlu: Għax irrid nappoġġa ħlas ġust lill-bdiewa li jkabbruh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you choose this fair trade coffee? Pawlu: Because I want to support fair payment for the farmers who grow it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么选这种公平贸易咖啡？Pawlu：因为我想支持种植咖啡的农民获得公平报酬。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt dan il-kafè tal-kummerċ ġust?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt dan il-kafè tal-kummerċ ġust?
messages.zh: 你为什么选这种公平贸易咖啡？
messages.en: Why did you choose this fair trade coffee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irrid nappoġġa ħlas ġust lill-bdiewa li jkabbruh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irrid nappoġġa ħlas ġust lill-bdiewa li jkabbruh.
messages.zh: 因为我想支持种植咖啡的农民获得公平报酬。
messages.en: Because I want to support fair payment for the farmers who grow it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġust 与“公平”联系起来，再想象买咖啡时关心种植者所得的报酬：kummerċ ġust 就是讲求公平的贸易。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The buying and selling of goods or services through electronic networks, especially the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子网络，尤其是互联网，买卖商品或服务的商业活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività ta' xiri u bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi permezz ta' netwerks elettroniċi, speċjalment l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子商务，指通过互联网等电子网络进行的商品或服务交易。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ-e huwa x-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi permezz tal-internet jew ta' netwerks elettroniċi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: E-commerce is the activity of buying and selling goods or services through the internet or other electronic networks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子商务，指利用电子网络开展的商业交易活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ-e huwa attività kummerċjali li fiha x-xiri u l-bejgħ isiru permezz ta' netwerks elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic commerce is commercial activity in which goods or services are bought and sold using electronic networks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子贸易，指通过电子网络进行的商品或服务买卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kummerċ-e huwa l-iskambju kummerċjali ta' prodotti jew servizzi li jsir permezz ta' netwerks elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic trade is the buying and selling of goods or services by means of electronic networks.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-kummerċ-e jgħin lin-negozji żgħar ibigħu l-prodotti tagħhom lil klijenti f'pajjiżi oħra.
formal.en: The report explains how e-commerce helps small businesses sell their products to customers in other countries.
formal.zh: 报告说明了电子商务如何帮助小企业向其他国家的客户销售产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li l-kummerċ-e jgħodd għall-ħanut tagħna? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nibdew billi nbiegħu ftit prodotti fuq l-internet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think e-commerce would suit our shop? Mark: Yes, we can start by selling a few products online.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得电子商务适合我们的店吗？Mark：适合，我们可以先在网上卖几种产品。

messages.speaker: Maja (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li l-kummerċ-e jgħodd għall-ħanut tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li l-kummerċ-e jgħodd għall-ħanut tagħna?
messages.zh: 你觉得电子商务适合我们的店吗？
messages.en: Do you think e-commerce would suit our shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nibdew billi nbiegħu ftit prodotti fuq l-internet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nibdew billi nbiegħu ftit prodotti fuq l-internet.
messages.zh: 适合，我们可以先在网上卖几种产品。
messages.en: Yes, we can start by selling a few products online.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词配上“网上选商品、下单购买”的画面，记住它表示电子商务；也可与较长形式 kummerċ elettroniku 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The potential of a product or service to attract buyers and sell successfully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产品或服务吸引买家并在市场上成功销售的潜力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-potenzjal ta' prodott jew servizz li jiġbed ix-xerrejja u jinbiegħ b'suċċess fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品或服务因符合市场需求而具有的吸引买家和成功销售的潜力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-potenzjal li prodott jew servizz jinbiegħ b'suċċess għax ikun jaqbel mal-ħtiġijiet u max-xewqat tax-xerrejja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The marketability of a product is its potential to attract buyers and achieve sales.

formal.mt: L-istudju jevalwa l-kummerċjabilità tal-prodott billi jqabbel il-prezz tiegħu mal-ħtiġijiet tax-xerrejja.
formal.en: The study evaluates the product's marketability by comparing its price with buyers' needs.
formal.zh: 该研究通过将产品价格与买家的需求相对照，评估其适销性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li dan id-disinn ġdid se jtejjeb il-kummerċjabilità tal-prodott? Pawlu: Iva, għax jagħmlu aktar attraenti għax-xerrejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think this new design will improve the product's marketability? Pawlu: Yes, because it makes it more attractive to buyers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这个新设计会提高产品的适销性吗？保罗：会，因为它让产品对买家更有吸引力。

messages.speaker: Maja (产品设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan id-disinn ġdid se jtejjeb il-kummerċjabilità tal-prodott?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan id-disinn ġdid se jtejjeb il-kummerċjabilità tal-prodott?
messages.zh: 你觉得这个新设计会提高产品的适销性吗？
messages.en: Do you think this new design will improve the product's marketability?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax jagħmlu aktar attraenti għax-xerrejja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax jagħmlu aktar attraenti għax-xerrejja.
messages.zh: 会，因为它让产品对买家更有吸引力。
messages.en: Yes, because it makes it more attractive to buyers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“买家愿不愿买、产品好不好卖”来记适销性；它说的是销售潜力，不是已经卖出的数量。

gloss_zh: 商业的；贸易的；以营利为目的的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to trade, business, or activities intended to make a profit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与贸易、商业或以营利为目的的活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kummerċ, man-negozju jew ma' attivitajiet li jsiru biex isir qligħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与商品或服务的买卖、商业经营或营利活动有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut max-xiri u l-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi, mat-tmexxija ta' negozju jew ma' attivitajiet għall-qligħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Commercial activities involve buying and selling goods or services, usually with the aim of making a profit.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jippermetti l-użu kummerċjali tar-ritratti taħt il-kundizzjonijiet imniżżla fih.
formal.en: The agreement permits commercial use of the photographs under the conditions specified in it.
formal.zh: 该协议允许按照其中列明的条件，将照片用于商业用途。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nuża dan ir-ritratt fir-reklam tal-ħanut? Mark: Iċċekkja l-liċenzja l-ewwel, għax dak ikun użu kummerċjali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I use this photograph in the shop's advertisement? Mark: Check the licence first, because that would be commercial use.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以把这张照片用在店铺广告里吗？马克：先看看许可条款，因为那属于商业用途。

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża dan ir-ritratt fir-reklam tal-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża dan ir-ritratt fir-reklam tal-ħanut?
messages.zh: 我可以把这张照片用在店铺广告里吗？
messages.en: Can I use this photograph in the shop's advertisement?

messages.speaker: Mark (摄影师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċekkja l-liċenzja l-ewwel, għax dak ikun użu kummerċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċekkja l-liċenzja l-ewwel, għax dak ikun użu kummerċjali.
messages.zh: 先看看许可条款，因为那属于商业用途。
messages.en: Check the licence first, because that would be commercial use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“商业活动、商业用途”两组搭配来记；看到它就联想到买卖、经营和营利。

gloss_zh: 依法投放市场的；合法上市销售的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that a product has been placed on the market in accordance with the law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某产品已依照法律规定投放市场的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li prodott tqiegħed fis-suq skont il-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示产品已遵照适用法律规定投放市场或上市销售。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li prodott tqiegħed fis-suq jew ġie offrut għall-bejgħ b'mod li jħares il-liġijiet applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A product described as lawfully marketed has been placed on the market in accordance with applicable laws.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-apparat bħala kummerċjalizzat legalment u jelenka d-dokumenti li jsostnu din id-deskrizzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the equipment as lawfully marketed and lists the documents supporting that description.
formal.zh: 报告将该设备描述为合法上市销售的设备，并列出支持这一描述的文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ifisser li dan il-prodott huwa kummerċjalizzat legalment? David: Ifisser li tqiegħed fis-suq skont il-liġi.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does it mean that this product is lawfully marketed? David: It means that it has been placed on the market in accordance with the law.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：说这个产品是合法上市销售的，是什么意思？戴维：意思是它已按照法律规定投放市场。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser li dan il-prodott huwa kummerċjalizzat legalment?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser li dan il-prodott huwa kummerċjalizzat legalment?
messages.zh: 说这个产品是合法上市销售的，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that this product is lawfully marketed?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tqiegħed fis-suq skont il-liġi.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tqiegħed fis-suq skont il-liġi.
messages.zh: 意思是它已按照法律规定投放市场。
messages.en: It means that it has been placed on the market in accordance with the law.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“产品进入市场，手续符合法律”的画面记住整组表达；重点同时包含上市销售和依法进行。

gloss_zh: 市场营销；产品推广与投放市场

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of promoting products or services and bringing them to buyers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 推广产品或服务，并将其推向买家的市场营销活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha jiġu promossi prodotti jew servizzi u jitwasslu għand ix-xerrejja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为使产品或服务进入市场、吸引买家并促进销售而开展的推广和相关活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħidma biex prodotti jew servizzi jitqiegħdu fis-suq, jiġu promossi u jiġbdu lix-xerrejja sabiex jiżdied il-bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Marketing is the work of promoting products or services and presenting them to potential buyers.

collocations.en: the marketing of a new product

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħejjiet strateġija ta' kummerċjalizzazzjoni biex tippreżenta s-servizz il-ġdid lil klijenti potenzjali.
formal.en: The company prepared a marketing strategy to introduce the new service to potential customers.
formal.zh: 公司制定了一项市场营销策略，向潜在客户介绍这项新服务。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se ngħarrfu lin-nies bil-prodott il-ġdid? Ġużeppi: Għandna bżonn pjan ta' kummerċjalizzazzjoni; nistgħu nibdew b'vidjo qasir.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are we going to let people know about the new product? Ġużeppi: We need a marketing plan; we can start with a short video.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们要怎么让大家知道这个新产品？朱塞佩：我们需要一份市场营销计划，可以先做一个短视频。

messages.speaker: Nina (创业合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se ngħarrfu lin-nies bil-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se ngħarrfu lin-nies bil-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 我们要怎么让大家知道这个新产品？
messages.en: How are we going to let people know about the new product?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (营销同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn pjan ta' kummerċjalizzazzjoni; nistgħu nibdew b'vidjo qasir.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn pjan ta' kummerċjalizzazzjoni; nistgħu nibdew b'vidjo qasir.
messages.zh: 我们需要一份市场营销计划，可以先做一个短视频。
messages.en: We need a marketing plan; we can start with a short video.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“制定策略、介绍产品、吸引买家”的行动顺序记市场营销；把长词与一整套推广活动联系起来。

gloss_zh: 喜剧演员；小丑、滑稽人物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who entertains an audience by telling jokes or performing humorous acts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过讲笑话或进行幽默表演来逗乐观众的人，即喜剧演员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiddeverti lill-udjenza billi tgħid iċ-ċajt jew tagħmel wirjiet umoristiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以讲笑话、表演喜剧等方式逗乐观众的演员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attur jew persuna oħra li tiddeverti lill-udjenza biċ-ċajt u b'wirjiet li jġiegħlu lin-nies jidħku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A comedian is an entertainer who makes people laugh by telling jokes or performing humorous material.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以夸张、滑稽的动作逗人发笑的小丑；也可指行为可笑、令人难以认真看待的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lin-nies jidħku b'ġesti u mġiba esaġerati jew buffi; il-kelma tista' tintuża wkoll għal xi ħadd li jġib ruħu b'mod redikolu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clown is someone who entertains through exaggerated, silly behaviour, or someone whose behaviour seems ridiculous.

formal.mt: Il-kummidjant fetaħ l-ispettaklu b'ċajta dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum u mill-ewwel ġiegħel lill-udjenza tidħaq.
formal.en: The comedian opened the show with a joke about everyday life and immediately made the audience laugh.
formal.zh: 喜剧演员以一个关于日常生活的笑话为演出开场，立刻逗笑了观众。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tara dan il-kummidjant miegħi llejla? Mark: Iva! Rajtu darba u dħakt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come and see this comedian with me tonight? Mark: Yes! I saw him once and laughed a lot.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚你想和我一起去看这个喜剧演员的演出吗？Mark：想！我以前看过他一次，笑得特别开心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara dan il-kummidjant miegħi llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara dan il-kummidjant miegħi llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚你想和我一起去看这个喜剧演员的演出吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come and see this comedian with me tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Rajtu darba u dħakt ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Rajtu darba u dħakt ħafna.
messages.zh: 想！我以前看过他一次，笑得特别开心。
messages.en: Yes! I saw him once and laughed a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kummidjant 配上一幅手拿麦克风、逗得观众大笑的人物图：先记“逗笑的人”，再区分职业喜剧演员和耍宝的小丑。

gloss_zh: 喜剧；闹剧；乱哄哄的场面

teaching_sense.en_definition: A play, film, or other entertainment intended to make people laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以逗人发笑为主要目的的戏剧、电影或其他娱乐作品，即喜剧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dramm, film jew xogħol ieħor ta' divertiment maħsub biex iġiegħel lin-nies jidħku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以幽默的人物、对白或情节引人发笑的喜剧作品；也指喜剧这一类型。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali, film jew tip ta' divertiment li juża l-umoriżmu biex iġiegħel lill-udjenza tidħaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A comedy is a play, film, or other work that uses humour to entertain its audience.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依靠夸张动作、荒诞情节或误会制造笑料的闹剧；也可指荒唐可笑的事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kummiedja b'sitwazzjonijiet assurdi, nuqqas ta' ftehim u mġiba esaġerata; tista' tfisser ukoll ġrajja tant redikola li ma tistax tittieħed bis-serjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A farce is a comedy built around absurd situations, or an event that becomes laughably ridiculous.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比喻乱哄哄、夸张可笑、像在演戏一样的场面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni storbjuża u diżordinata li fiha n-nies iġibu ruħhom b'mod esaġerat jew redikolu, bħallikieku qegħdin jagħtu spettaklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe a situation as a circus, you mean that it has become chaotic and absurdly theatrical.

formal.mt: Il-kummiedja tittratta n-nuqqas ta' ftehim bejn żewġ familji u tuża djalogu umoristiku biex iżżomm lill-udjenza divertita.
formal.en: The comedy deals with misunderstandings between two families and uses humorous dialogue to keep the audience entertained.
formal.zh: 这部喜剧围绕两个家庭之间的误会展开，并通过幽默的对白使观众看得开心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Kummiedja sħiħa! Kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin u ħadd ma sema' lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the meeting go? Pawlu: It was a complete circus! Everyone started talking at the same time, and nobody listened to anyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：会议开得怎么样？Pawlu：简直是一场闹剧！大家同时开始说话，谁也不听谁的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif marret il-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif marret il-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kummiedja sħiħa! Kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin u ħadd ma sema' lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Kummiedja sħiħa! Kulħadd beda jitkellem fl-istess ħin u ħadd ma sema' lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 简直是一场闹剧！大家同时开始说话，谁也不听谁的。
messages.en: It was a complete circus! Everyone started talking at the same time, and nobody listened to anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 kummiedja：影院里的喜剧、舞台上的荒诞闹剧、会议中乱哄哄的场面；共同线索是“让人觉得可笑”。

gloss_zh: 专员；受委任主管某项事务的官员

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official appointed to oversee a particular public service, organization, or area of responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受委任负责监督某项公共服务、机构或特定事务的官员，通常称为专员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal maħtur biex imexxi jew jissorvelja servizz pubbliku, istituzzjoni jew qasam partikolari ta' responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受正式委任，负责管理、监督或处理某个特定领域事务的专员或主管官员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li jingħata kariga biex jamministra, jissorvelja jew jieħu ħsieb qasam speċifiku ta' ħidma pubblika jew istituzzjonali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commissioner is an appointed official with responsibility for administering or supervising a particular service or area of public activity.

formal.mt: Il-kummissarju ppreżenta rapport dwar il-ħidma tal-uffiċċju tiegħu u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-membri tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The commissioner presented a report on the work of his office and answered the committee members' questions.
formal.zh: 专员提交了一份有关其办公室工作的报告，并回答了委员会成员的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jippreżenta r-rapport għada? David: Il-kummissarju stess. Wara nistgħu nistaqsuh xi mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to present the report tomorrow? David: The commissioner himself. Afterwards, we can ask him some questions.
colloquial.zh: Lara：明天谁来介绍这份报告？David：专员本人。之后我们可以向他提些问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jippreżenta r-rapport għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jippreżenta r-rapport għada?
messages.zh: 明天谁来介绍这份报告？
messages.en: Who is going to present the report tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kummissarju stess. Wara nistgħu nistaqsuh xi mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kummissarju stess. Wara nistgħu nistaqsuh xi mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 专员本人。之后我们可以向他提些问题。
messages.en: The commissioner himself. Afterwards, we can ask him some questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kummissarju 和“任命书加职责报告”的画面配对：有人被正式委任，专门主管一项公共事务，就是专员。

gloss_zh: 报关代理人；报关经纪人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or business that handles customs formalities for someone importing or exporting goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受进口商或出口商委托，代为办理货物报关等海关手续的个人或企业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tieħu ħsieb il-formalitajiet tad-dwana f'isem min jimporta jew jesporta l-merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表进口商或出口商准备、提交报关文件并办理相关海关手续的专业代理人或企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li, f'isem importatur jew esportatur, tħejji u tippreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa u tieħu ħsieb il-proċeduri biex il-merkanzija tgħaddi mid-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs broker is a person or business that arranges customs paperwork and clearance on behalf of an importer or exporter.

collocations.en: to send the documents to the customs broker
collocations.zh: 把文件发送给报关代理人

collocations.en: the services of a customs broker

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qabbdet kummissarju tad-dwana biex iħejji d-dokumenti tal-importazzjoni u jieħu ħsieb il-formalitajiet f'isimha.
formal.en: The company hired a customs broker to prepare the import documents and handle the formalities on its behalf.
formal.zh: 公司委托了一名报关代理人准备进口文件，并代表公司办理相关手续。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lil min nibgħat il-fattura tal-merkanzija? Mark: Ibgħatha lill-kummissarju tad-dwana. Hu qed jieħu ħsieb id-dokumenti għalina.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who should I send the invoice for the goods to? Mark: Send it to the customs broker. He is handling the documents for us.
colloquial.zh: Nina：货物的发票应该发给谁？Mark：发给报关代理人。他正在替我们处理这些文件。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nibgħat il-fattura tal-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nibgħat il-fattura tal-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 货物的发票应该发给谁？
messages.en: Who should I send the invoice for the goods to?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibgħatha lill-kummissarju tad-dwana. Hu qed jieħu ħsieb id-dokumenti għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Ibgħatha lill-kummissarju tad-dwana. Hu qed jieħu ħsieb id-dokumenti għalina.
messages.zh: 发给报关代理人。他正在替我们处理这些文件。
messages.en: Send it to the customs broker. He is handling the documents for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语 kummissarju tad-dwana 作为职业名称记忆：想象一位受货主委托、拿着发票办理报关文件的代理人，就能联想到“报关代理”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organization that conducts business, or a group of performers who work together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经营业务的公司；也可指共同排练和演出的剧团或表演团体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni li tmexxi negozju, jew grupp ta' artisti li jaħdmu flimkien biex jagħtu wirjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事商业经营、提供商品或服务的公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni kummerċjali li tbigħ prodotti jew tipprovdi servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A company is a business organization that sells goods or provides services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同排练和演出的演员、舞者等组成的团体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' atturi, żeffiena jew artisti oħra li jippreparaw u jagħtu wirjiet flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A troupe is a group of performers who rehearse and give performances together.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tat-teatru se tippreżenta dramm ġdid fil-festival ta' din is-sena.
formal.en: The theatre company will present a new play at this year's festival.
formal.zh: 该剧团将在今年的艺术节上演出一部新剧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn taħdem issa? Mark: Naħdem ma' kumpanija li tbigħ il-kotba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you work now? Mark: I work for a company that sells books.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你现在在哪里工作？Mark：我在一家卖书的公司工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn taħdem issa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn taħdem issa?
messages.zh: 你现在在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where do you work now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem ma' kumpanija li tbigħ il-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdem ma' kumpanija li tbigħ il-kotba.
messages.zh: 我在一家卖书的公司工作。
messages.en: I work for a company that sells books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：办公室里的一群人对应“公司”，舞台上的一群演员对应“剧团”；结合业务或演出的语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The particular company involved in, affected by, or referred to in the matter being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 当前讨论的事件或事项中涉及、受到影响或被提及的特定公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kumpanija partikolari li hija involuta fil-kwistjoni li qed tiġi diskussa, li tintlaqat minnha jew li qed issir referenza għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某一事项中涉及或被指称的那家公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kumpanija li għandha x'taqsam mal-każ jew mas-suġġett li qed jiġi diskuss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The company concerned is the particular company involved in or referred to in a matter.

collocations.en: the director of the company concerned
the response from the company concerned

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kkonċernata għandha tibgħat risposta bil-miktub fi żmien għaxart ijiem.
formal.en: The company concerned must send a written response within ten days.
formal.zh: 所涉公司须在十天内提交书面回复。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min se nibagħtu dawn id-dokumenti? Pawlu: Lill-kumpanija kkonċernata; l-indirizz tagħha jinsab fl-ittra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who are we sending these documents to? Pawlu: To the company concerned; its address is in the letter.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们要把这些文件寄给谁？Pawlu：寄给所涉公司；信里有它的地址。

messages.speaker: Lara (行政助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min se nibagħtu dawn id-dokumenti?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min se nibagħtu dawn id-dokumenti?
messages.zh: 我们要把这些文件寄给谁？
messages.en: Who are we sending these documents to?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lill-kumpanija kkonċernata; l-indirizz tagħha jinsab fl-ittra.
messages.mt_standard: Lill-kumpanija kkonċernata; l-indirizz tagħha jinsab fl-ittra.
messages.zh: 寄给所涉公司；信里有它的地址。
messages.en: To the company concerned; its address is in the letter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件上用箭头指向某一家公司：整个短语表示“这件事所涉及的公司”，可与“有关公司的回复”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 有限公司；有限责任公司

teaching_sense.en_definition: A company whose members have limited liability for its debts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成员对公司债务承担有限责任的一类公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kumpannija li fiha r-responsabbiltà tal-membri għad-djun tagħha hija limitata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成员就公司债务所承担的责任受到限制的公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' kumpannija li l-membri tagħha għandhom responsabbiltà limitata għad-djun tal-kumpannija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A limited company is a company whose members have limited liability for its debts.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istruttura u l-attivitajiet ta' kumpannija b'responsabbiltà limitata.
formal.en: The report describes the structure and activities of a limited company.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍了一家有限公司的组织结构和经营活动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tip ta' kumpannija għandkom? David: Għandna kumpannija b'responsabbiltà limitata li tipprovdi servizzi tat-tindif.
colloquial.en: Nina: What type of company do you have? David: We have a limited company that provides cleaning services.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们的公司是什么类型的？David：我们有一家提供清洁服务的有限公司。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' kumpannija għandkom?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' kumpannija għandkom?
messages.zh: 你们的公司是什么类型的？
messages.en: What type of company do you have?

messages.speaker: David (公司经营者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna kumpannija b'responsabbiltà limitata li tipprovdi servizzi tat-tindif.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna kumpannija b'responsabbiltà limitata li tipprovdi servizzi tat-tindif.
messages.zh: 我们有一家提供清洁服务的有限公司。
messages.en: We have a limited company that provides cleaning services.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语分成“公司”和“责任有限”两块记忆，想象公司旁有一道标着责任边界的线，帮助联想到“有限公司”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who shares an activity, purpose, or experience with someone and offers companionship or support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人共同参与活动、怀有共同目标或经历相同事情，并相互陪伴或支持的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqsam attività, għan jew esperjenza ma' persuna oħra u toffrilha kumpanija jew appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同工作、行动或追求某种目标的同志或伙伴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem jew tieħu sehem ma' oħrajn f'attività jew f'ħidma għal għan komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A comrade is someone who shares your activities or aims and supports you.

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tiegħu, huwa rringrazzja lil kull kumpannju li kien ħadem miegħu biex jintlaħaq l-għan komuni.
formal.en: In his speech, he thanked every comrade who had worked with him to achieve their shared goal.
formal.zh: 他在讲话中感谢了每一位曾与他一道为实现共同目标而努力的伙伴。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għenek meta x-xogħol sar diffiċli? Toni: Ġużeppi. Hu kumpannju tajjeb u dejjem jgħinni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who helped you when the work became difficult? Toni: Ġużeppi. He's a good comrade and always helps me.
colloquial.zh: Sara：工作变得困难时，是谁帮了你？Toni：Ġużeppi。他是个好伙伴，总是帮助我。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għenek meta x-xogħol sar diffiċli?
messages.mt_standard: Min għenek meta x-xogħol sar diffiċli?
messages.zh: 工作变得困难时，是谁帮了你？
messages.en: Who helped you when the work became difficult?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġużeppi. Hu kumpannju tajjeb u dejjem jgħinni.
messages.mt_standard: Ġużeppi. Hu kumpannju tajjeb u dejjem jgħinni.
messages.zh: Ġużeppi。他是个好伙伴，总是帮助我。
messages.en: Ġużeppi. He's a good comrade and always helps me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人并肩完成艰难任务：身边共同出力、互相支持的那个人就是 kumpannju，可按语境理解为“伙伴”或“同志”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something complex has many connected parts or aspects that make it difficult to understand or deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由许多相互关联的部分或因素构成，因而不容易理解或处理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna partijiet jew aspetti marbutin ma' xulxin u għalhekk mhux faċli tifhmu jew tittrattah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复杂的；包含多个相互关联的部分或因素，理解或处理起来有难度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi ħafna elementi jew aspetti marbutin ma' xulxin u li jeħtieġ ħsieb jew analiżi biex jinftiehem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is complex contains many connected elements and can be difficult to understand or manage.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega proċess kumpless permezz ta' eżempji ċari u dijagrammi sempliċi.
formal.en: The report explains a complex process through clear examples and simple diagrams.
formal.zh: 这份报告通过清晰的例子和简单的图表解释一个复杂的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżerċizzju jidher kumpless. Mark: Ejja naqsmuh f'passi żgħar u nagħmluh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: This exercise looks complex. Mark: Let's break it into small steps and do it together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这道练习看起来很复杂。Mark：我们把它拆成几个小步骤，一起做吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-eżerċizzju jidher kumpless.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-eżerċizzju jidher kumpless.
messages.zh: 这道练习看起来很复杂。
messages.en: This exercise looks complex.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqsmuh f'passi żgħar u nagħmluh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqsmuh f'passi żgħar u nagħmluh flimkien.
messages.zh: 我们把它拆成几个小步骤，一起做吧。
messages.en: Let's break it into small steps and do it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kumpless 联想成一张线路交错的地图：部分多、关系多，所以是“复杂的”；搭配 proċess kumpless 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Complexity is the quality or degree of having many connected parts or aspects that are difficult to understand or manage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物因具有许多相互关联的部分或因素而呈现的复杂性质或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karatteristika jew il-grad ta' kemm xi ħaġa għandha elementi marbutin ma' xulxin u tkun diffiċli biex tinftiehem jew titmexxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复杂性；事物包含多个相互关联的因素而产生的复杂性质或复杂程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li għandha ħafna partijiet jew aspetti marbutin ma' xulxin, jew il-grad ta' kemm tkun diffiċli biex tinftiehem jew tiġi ttrattata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The complexity of something is the extent to which its connected parts make it difficult to understand or deal with.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-kumplessività tal-proġett, it-tim qassam ix-xogħol f'diversi fażijiet.
formal.en: Because of the complexity of the project, the team divided the work into several phases.
formal.zh: 由于项目的复杂性，团队将工作划分为几个阶段。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed idum daqshekk dan ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Minħabba l-kumplessività tiegħu; hemm ħafna dettalji li rridu niċċekkjaw.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this work taking so long? Pawlu: Because of its complexity; there are many details we need to check.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这项工作为什么花这么长时间？Pawlu：因为它很复杂，有很多细节需要检查。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed idum daqshekk dan ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed idum daqshekk dan ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 这项工作为什么花这么长时间？
messages.en: Why is this work taking so long?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-kumplessività tiegħu; hemm ħafna dettalji li rridu niċċekkjaw.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-kumplessività tiegħu; hemm ħafna dettalji li rridu niċċekkjaw.
messages.zh: 因为它很复杂，有很多细节需要检查。
messages.en: Because of its complexity; there are many details we need to check.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kumplessività 放进“问题的复杂性”这个短语里记：kumpless 描述“复杂的”，kumplessività 则用来谈“复杂性或复杂程度”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A compliment is a remark that expresses praise or admiration for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达对某人或某事赞赏、欣赏或肯定的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li jesprimi tifħir jew ammirazzjoni għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞美的话；表达欣赏或肯定的称赞，也可指恭维话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kumment li bih turi li tapprezza jew tammira lil xi ħadd, xi ħaġa li għamel, jew xi kwalità tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you give someone a compliment, you say something that expresses your approval or admiration.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, il-klijenta tat kumpliment lit-tim għas-servizz eċċellenti li rċeviet.
formal.en: In her letter, the customer gave the team a compliment for the excellent service she received.
formal.zh: 这位顾客在信中称赞了团队，感谢他们提供的优质服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm sajjart tajjeb illum! Dan l-ikel tassew tajjeb. Toni: Grazzi tal-kumpliment! Ħadt gost li għoġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: You cooked so well today! This food is really good. Toni: Thanks for the compliment! I'm glad you liked it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天做得真好！这些菜真好吃。Toni：谢谢你的夸奖！你喜欢吃，我很高兴。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm sajjart tajjeb illum! Dan l-ikel tassew tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm sajjart tajjeb illum! Dan l-ikel tassew tajjeb.
messages.zh: 你今天做得真好！这些菜真好吃。
messages.en: You cooked so well today! This food is really good.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi tal-kumpliment! Ħadt gost li għoġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi tal-kumpliment! Ħadt gost li għoġbok.
messages.zh: 谢谢你的夸奖！你喜欢吃，我很高兴。
messages.en: Thanks for the compliment! I'm glad you liked it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友夸你做饭好吃，你回答 Grazzi tal-kumpliment：“谢谢夸奖”。用这一问一答记住它表示赞美的话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe a person, business, or country that buys goods or other things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述购买商品或其他物品、在交易中充当买方的人、企业或国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixtri oġġetti jew affarijiet oħra u jkun in-naħa li tagħmel ix-xiri fi tranżazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购买的；在交易中作为买方、进行购买的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun qed jixtri jew li jkollu r-rwol ta' min jixtri fi ftehim kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or organization described as buying takes the purchaser's role in a transaction.

formal.mt: Il-pajjiż kumpratur talab informazzjoni dettaljata dwar il-kwalità u l-prezz tal-prodotti.
formal.en: The buying country requested detailed information about the quality and price of the products.
formal.zh: 买方国家要求提供有关产品质量和价格的详细信息。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dak in-negozjant kumpratur ġie jara l-prodotti? David: Iva, u talab il-prezz għal mitt kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did that purchasing trader come to see the products? David: Yes, and he asked for the price of a hundred boxes.
colloquial.zh: Marta：那位来采购的商人来看过产品了吗？David：看过了，他还询问了一百箱的价格。

messages.speaker: Marta (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak in-negozjant kumpratur ġie jara l-prodotti?
messages.mt_standard: Dak in-negozjant kumpratur ġie jara l-prodotti?
messages.zh: 那位来采购的商人来看过产品了吗？
messages.en: Did that purchasing trader come to see the products?

messages.speaker: David (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u talab il-prezz għal mitt kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u talab il-prezz għal mitt kaxxa.
messages.zh: 看过了，他还询问了一百箱的价格。
messages.en: Yes, and he asked for the price of a hundred boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用交易画面记 kumpratur：一方挑选商品并询价，这一方承担购买角色；把 pajjiż kumpratur 整体记成“买方国家”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong disapproval of an action, or a punishment imposed by a court on a person found guilty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种行为表示强烈反对的谴责；也指法院对被认定有罪的人所作的刑罚判处或所判刑罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' diżapprovazzjoni qawwija għal xi għemil, jew piena li qorti timponi fuq persuna li tkun instabet ħatja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谴责，指对某种行为或情况表达强烈的不赞同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' diżapprovazzjoni qawwija għal għemil jew sitwazzjoni li titqies ħażina jew inaċċettabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Condemnation is an expression of strong disapproval of something considered wrong or unacceptable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刑事判处；法院对有罪者所判处的刑罚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Piena li qorti timponi fuq persuna wara li tkun sabitha ħatja ta' reat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sentence is the punishment that a court imposes on someone who has been found guilty of a crime.

collocations.en: a sentence of two years in prison

formal.mt: L-istqarrija tinkludi kundanna qawwija tal-vjolenza. F'rapport separat, il-gazzetta tgħid li l-qorti imponiet kundanna ta' sentejn ħabs.
formal.en: The statement includes strong condemnation of violence. In a separate report, the newspaper says that the court imposed a sentence of two years in prison.
formal.zh: 声明中包含对暴力的强烈谴责。在另一篇报道中，该报称法院判处了两年监禁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk, kundanna tfisser li xi ħadd mar il-ħabs? Pawlu: Le, f'din l-aħbar tfisser li l-kunsill wera li hu kontra l-vjolenza. Lara: Mela rrid inħares lejn il-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does kundanna mean here that someone went to prison? Pawlu: No, in this news story it means that the council expressed its opposition to violence. Lara: So I need to look at the context.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 kundanna 是说有人入狱了吗？Pawlu：不是，在这则新闻里，它是说议会表达了对暴力的反对。Lara：那我得看上下文。

messages.speaker: Lara (马耳他语学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, kundanna tfisser li xi ħadd mar il-ħabs?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, kundanna tfisser li xi ħadd mar il-ħabs?
messages.zh: 这里的 kundanna 是说有人入狱了吗？
messages.en: Does kundanna mean here that someone went to prison?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (语言伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din l-aħbar tfisser li l-kunsill wera li hu kontra l-vjolenza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din l-aħbar tfisser li l-kunsill wera li hu kontra l-vjolenza.
messages.zh: 不是，在这则新闻里，它是说议会表达了对暴力的反对。
messages.en: No, in this news story it means that the council expressed its opposition to violence.

messages.speaker: Lara (马耳他语学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid inħares lejn il-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid inħares lejn il-kuntest.
messages.zh: 那我得看上下文。
messages.en: So I need to look at the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kundanna 配两个场景：声明中的强烈谴责、法庭中的刑罚判处。看到 vjolenza 联想谴责暴力，看到 sentejn ħabs 联想两年监禁。

gloss_zh: 单一故障状态；单一故障条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state in which equipment or a system has one fault, considered when assessing its behaviour or safety.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设备或系统出现一项故障时的状态，用于评估其在该情况下的运行表现或安全性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih apparat jew sistema jkollhom ħsara waħda, meqjus meta jiġu evalwati t-tħaddim jew is-sikurezza tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设备或系统存在单个故障时的状态，尤其指评估故障情况下的运行或安全表现时所考虑的条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha jkun hemm ħsara waħda f'apparat jew f'sistema, u li tintuża biex jiġi eżaminat kif jaħdmu jew kemm jibqgħu sikuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single fault condition is a situation in which one fault is present in equipment or a system and its effects are assessed.

collocations.mt: tħaddim taħt kundizzjoni ta' ħsara waħdanija
collocations.en: operation under a single fault condition
collocations.zh: 单一故障条件下的运行

collocations.mt: test taħt kundizzjoni ta' ħsara waħdanija
collocations.en: a test under a single fault condition
collocations.zh: 单一故障条件下的测试
