formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-imġiba tal-apparat taħt kundizzjoni ta' ħsara waħdanija.
formal.en: The report describes the behaviour of the equipment under a single fault condition.
formal.zh: 该报告描述了设备在单一故障条件下的表现。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tittestjaw komponent wieħed biss li ma jaħdimx? David: Qed naraw kif jaħdem l-apparat taħt kundizzjoni ta' ħsara waħdanija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you testing with only one component not working? David: We are checking how the equipment operates under a single fault condition.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么测试时只让一个部件不工作？戴维：我们在检查设备在单一故障条件下如何运行。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tittestjaw komponent wieħed biss li ma jaħdimx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tittestjaw komponent wieħed biss li ma jaħdimx?
messages.zh: 为什么测试时只让一个部件不工作？
messages.en: Why are you testing with only one component not working?

messages.speaker: David (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naraw kif jaħdem l-apparat taħt kundizzjoni ta' ħsara waħdanija.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naraw kif jaħdem l-apparat taħt kundizzjoni ta' ħsara waħdanija.
messages.zh: 我们在检查设备在单一故障条件下如何运行。
messages.en: We are checking how the equipment operates under a single fault condition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象测试记录上只标出一个故障点，再观察整台设备的表现；用这个画面记住 kundizzjoni ta' ħsara waħdanija 的单一故障状态。

gloss_zh: 充分竞争的条件；完全竞争条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: Conditions in which participants compete fully and no participant receives an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各参与者能够充分展开竞争、且没有参与者获得不公平优势的条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjonijiet li fihom il-parteċipanti jistgħu jikkompetu b'mod sħiħ u ħadd ma jingħata vantaġġ inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充分竞争的条件，指参与者能够全面展开竞争，且竞争过程不受不公平优势或限制妨碍的环境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċirkostanzi li fihom il-parteċipanti jistgħu jikkompetu bis-sħiħ mingħajr vantaġġi inġusti jew restrizzjonijiet li jfixklu l-kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fully competitive conditions are circumstances in which participants can compete fully without unfair advantages or restrictions that hinder competition.

collocations.en: to operate under fully competitive conditions
collocations.zh: 在充分竞争的条件下经营

formal.mt: Il-proċedura għandha tiżgura kundizzjonijiet kompletament kompetittivi billi tagħti lill-offerenti kollha l-istess informazzjoni u tapplika l-istess kriterji.
formal.en: The procedure should ensure fully competitive conditions by giving all bidders the same information and applying the same criteria.
formal.zh: 该程序应向所有投标者提供相同的信息，并采用相同的标准，以确保充分竞争的条件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jiġifieri kundizzjonijiet kompletament kompetittivi f'din is-sejħa? Mark: Jiġifieri li kulħadd jista' jikkompeti bis-sħiħ, bl-istess regoli u mingħajr vantaġġi inġusti. Nina: Mela l-informazzjoni trid tasal għand kulħadd fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does fully competitive conditions mean in this call for bids? Mark: It means that everyone can compete fully, under the same rules and without unfair advantages. Nina: So everyone needs to receive the information at the same time.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这次招标中，充分竞争的条件是什么意思？Mark：意思是大家都能充分竞争，遵守相同的规则，而且没有不公平的优势。Nina：那信息就必须同时传达给所有人。

messages.speaker: Nina (新入职采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri kundizzjonijiet kompletament kompetittivi f'din is-sejħa?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri kundizzjonijiet kompletament kompetittivi f'din is-sejħa?
messages.zh: 这次招标中，充分竞争的条件是什么意思？
messages.en: What does fully competitive conditions mean in this call for bids?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li kulħadd jista' jikkompeti bis-sħiħ, bl-istess regoli u mingħajr vantaġġi inġusti.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li kulħadd jista' jikkompeti bis-sħiħ, bl-istess regoli u mingħajr vantaġġi inġusti.
messages.zh: 意思是大家都能充分竞争，遵守相同的规则，而且没有不公平的优势。
messages.en: It means that everyone can compete fully, under the same rules and without unfair advantages.

messages.speaker: Nina (新入职采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-informazzjoni trid tasal għand kulħadd fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-informazzjoni trid tasal għand kulħadd fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 那信息就必须同时传达给所有人。
messages.en: So everyone needs to receive the information at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个意义块记忆：kundizzjonijiet 是“条件”，kompletament 是“完全地”，kompetittivi 是“竞争性的”；把整句联想为所有投标者拿到相同资料、充分竞争的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The economic and commercial circumstances that affect buying, selling, and prices in a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 影响某一市场中买卖活动和价格的经济与商业状况，如供求、竞争及购买力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-ċirkostanzi ekonomiċi u kummerċjali li jinfluwenzaw ix-xiri, il-bejgħ u l-prezzijiet f'suq partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 影响市场交易和价格的整体状况，包括供求关系、竞争程度及购买力等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ġenerali ta' suq, inklużi d-domanda, il-provvista u l-kompetizzjoni, li taffettwa l-kummerċ u l-prezzijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market conditions are the circumstances within a market that influence what people buy or sell and the prices they pay.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tirrevedi l-prezzijiet tagħha fid-dawl tal-kundizzjonijiet tas-suq.
formal.en: The company will review its prices in light of market conditions.
formal.zh: 该公司将根据市场状况重新评估其定价。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għollejtu l-prezzijiet? Pawlu: Il-kundizzjonijiet tas-suq inbidlu, u issa l-materjal jiswa aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why have you raised the prices? Pawlu: Market conditions have changed, and materials now cost more.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么涨价了？保罗：市场状况变了，现在材料更贵了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għollejtu l-prezzijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għollejtu l-prezzijiet?
messages.zh: 你们为什么涨价了？
messages.en: Why have you raised the prices?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kundizzjonijiet tas-suq inbidlu, u issa l-materjal jiswa aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kundizzjonijiet tas-suq inbidlu, u issa l-materjal jiswa aktar.
messages.zh: 市场状况变了，现在材料更贵了。
messages.en: Market conditions have changed, and materials now cost more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把市场想成一张行情看板：供求、竞争和价格共同组成 kundizzjonijiet tas-suq，记住它说的是整体市场状况。

gloss_zh: 自信的；对自身能力有信心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who trusts their own abilities and feels able to deal with a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信自己的能力，并认为自己能够应对某种情况的人；用于表达自信的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li temmen fil-kapaċitajiet tagħha u tħoss li tista' tlaħħaq ma' sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自信的，指相信自己的能力，并有把握采取行动或面对他人的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna kunfidenti temmen fil-ħiliet tagħha u tħossha kapaċi taġixxi jew titkellem mingħajr biża' żejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is self-confident believes in their own abilities and feels able to act or speak in different situations.

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, il-kelliema kienet kunfidenti u wieġbet il-mistoqsijiet b'mod ċar.
formal.en: During the presentation, the speaker was self-confident and answered the questions clearly.
formal.zh: 在演讲过程中，这位女发言人很自信，并清楚地回答了问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok qabel l-intervista? Mark: Inħossni kunfidenti għax ippreparajt sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you feeling before the interview? Mark: I feel self-confident because I have prepared well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面试前你感觉怎么样？马克：我很有信心，因为我准备得很充分。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tħossok qabel l-intervista?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tħossok qabel l-intervista?
messages.zh: 面试前你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling before the interview?

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħossni kunfidenti għax ippreparajt sew.
messages.mt_standard: Inħossni kunfidenti għax ippreparajt sew.
messages.zh: 我很有信心，因为我准备得很充分。
messages.en: I feel self-confident because I have prepared well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己准备充分后挺胸发言，用 Inħossni kunfidenti 配合这个动作，记住它描述人感到自信的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of trust in someone's abilities or in the likelihood that something will succeed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信自己或他人的能力，或相信某件事情能够成功的心理状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' fiduċja fil-kapaċitajiet tiegħek jew ta' ħaddieħor, jew fit-tama li xi ħaġa se tirnexxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信心或自信，即对自己、他人的能力或事情成功的可能性抱有信任的感觉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fiduċja li persuna jkollha fil-ħiliet tagħha stess, fil-kapaċitajiet ta' persuna oħra jew fil-possibbiltà li xi ħaġa tirnexxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Confidence is the feeling that you can do something successfully or that a person or outcome can be trusted.

formal.mt: Il-prattika regolari għenet lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw il-kunfidenza meħtieġa biex jitkellmu quddiem grupp.
formal.en: Regular practice helped the students develop the confidence needed to speak in front of a group.
formal.zh: 经常练习帮助学生建立了在众人面前讲话所需的信心。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni nibża' nitkellem bil-Malti. Rita: Bil-prattika, il-kunfidenza tiegħek tikber.
colloquial.en: Nina: I am still afraid to speak Maltese. Rita: With practice, your confidence will grow.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我还是不敢说马耳他语。丽塔：多练习，你的信心就会增强。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nibża' nitkellem bil-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nibża' nitkellem bil-Malti.
messages.zh: 我还是不敢说马耳他语。
messages.en: I am still afraid to speak Maltese.

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-prattika, il-kunfidenza tiegħek tikber.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-prattika, il-kunfidenza tiegħek tikber.
messages.zh: 多练习，你的信心就会增强。
messages.en: With practice, your confidence will grow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kunfidenza 想成心里的信心储蓄罐：每练习一次就存入一点信心；搭配 b'kunfidenza，记住自信地做某事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree of optimism consumers feel about the economy and their own financial situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消费者对经济状况及自身财务状况的乐观程度，通常影响其消费意愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' ottimiżmu li jħossu l-konsumaturi dwar l-ekonomija u l-qagħda finanzjarja tagħhom, li jista' jinfluwenza kemm ikunu lesti jonfqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者对经济前景及个人财务状况的信心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fiduċja li għandhom il-konsumaturi fil-prospetti tal-ekonomija u fil-qagħda finanzjarja tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer confidence is the degree of optimism people feel about economic conditions and their personal finances.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-kunfidenza tal-konsumatur naqset u li aktar familji qed jipposponu xiri kbir.
formal.en: The report shows that consumer confidence has fallen and that more families are postponing major purchases.
formal.zh: 报告显示，消费者信心下降，更多家庭正在推迟大额购物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fl-aħbarijiet qalu li naqset il-kunfidenza tal-konsumatur. Xi jfisser dan? Mark: Ifisser li n-nies huma inqas fiduċjużi dwar l-ekonomija u l-flus tagħhom, u jistgħu joqogħdu aktar attenti kemm jonfqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: The news said consumer confidence has fallen. What does that mean? Mark: It means people feel less confident about the economy and their finances, and may be more careful about how much they spend.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新闻说消费者信心下降了。这是什么意思？Mark：意思是大家对经济和自己的财务状况没那么有信心了，花钱时可能会更谨慎。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħbarijiet qalu li naqset il-kunfidenza tal-konsumatur. Xi jfisser dan?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħbarijiet qalu li naqset il-kunfidenza tal-konsumatur. Xi jfisser dan?
messages.zh: 新闻说消费者信心下降了。这是什么意思？
messages.en: The news said consumer confidence has fallen. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li n-nies huma inqas fiduċjużi dwar l-ekonomija u l-flus tagħhom, u jistgħu joqogħdu aktar attenti kemm jonfqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li n-nies huma inqas fiduċjużi dwar l-ekonomija u l-flus tagħhom, u jistgħu joqogħdu aktar attenti kemm jonfqu.
messages.zh: 意思是大家对经济和自己的财务状况没那么有信心了，花钱时可能会更谨慎。
messages.en: It means people feel less confident about the economy and their finances, and may be more careful about how much they spend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和“家庭敢不敢花钱”联系起来：对经济和钱包有信心，消费意愿就可能更强。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to be kept private and shared only with authorized people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要保密的，只能向获准知悉的人透露的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu jinżamm sigriet jew privat u jinqasam biss ma' persuni li għandhom il-permess li jkunu jafu bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机密的；须保密且不得随意向他人披露的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma għandux jiġi żvelat lil kulħadd u għandu jkun magħruf biss minn persuni awtorizzati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Information or documents that are confidential must be kept private and shared only with people who are allowed to see them.

formal.mt: Dan id-dokument huwa kunfidenzjali u jista' jinqara biss mill-persuni awtorizzati.
formal.en: This document is confidential and may be read only by authorized people.
formal.zh: 本文件属于机密，仅限获授权人员阅读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nibgħat dan ir-rapport lil ħabib tiegħi? Pawlu: Le, huwa kunfidenzjali. Jista' jinqasam biss mat-tim.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I send this report to a friend of mine? Pawlu: No, it's confidential. It can only be shared with the team.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我能把这份报告发给我的一个朋友吗？Pawlu：不能，这是保密的。只能在团队内部分享。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nibgħat dan ir-rapport lil ħabib tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nibgħat dan ir-rapport lil ħabib tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我能把这份报告发给我的一个朋友吗？
messages.en: Can I send this report to a friend of mine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa kunfidenzjali. Jista' jinqasam biss mat-tim.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa kunfidenzjali. Jista' jinqasam biss mat-tim.
messages.zh: 不能，这是保密的。只能在团队内部分享。
messages.en: No, it's confidential. It can only be shared with the team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件封面盖着“保密”印章：看到 kunfidenzjali，就提醒自己只让获准的人阅读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bottle used to hold a small quantity of liquid or another substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放少量液体或其他物质的小瓶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flixkun żgħir li jintuża biex iżomm fih kwantità żgħira ta' likwidu jew ta' sustanza oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小瓶；容量较小、用于盛放少量物质的瓶子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Flixkun ta' daqs żgħir li jista' jkun fih ftit likwidu jew sustanza oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small bottle is a container that holds a limited quantity of liquid or another substance.

formal.mt: Il-kampjun tqiegħed f'kunjett tal-ħġieġ nadif, li mbagħad ingħalaq sew.
formal.en: The sample was placed in a clean small glass bottle, which was then closed securely.
formal.zh: 样品被放入一个干净的玻璃小瓶中，随后瓶子被盖紧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt il-kunjett tal-fwieħa tiegħi? Marija: Iva, qiegħed fil-borża ż-żgħira ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you seen my small bottle of perfume? Marija: Yes, it's in the little bag next to the mirror.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看见我那小瓶香水了吗？Marija：看见了，在镜子旁边的小包里。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-kunjett tal-fwieħa tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-kunjett tal-fwieħa tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你看见我那小瓶香水了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my small bottle of perfume?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-borża ż-żgħira ħdejn il-mera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-borża ż-żgħira ħdejn il-mera.
messages.zh: 看见了，在镜子旁边的小包里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the little bag next to the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kunjett 配上一幅掌心里的香水小瓶图，记住它强调的是“小瓶”这个容器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Permission or agreement given for something to happen or for someone to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事发生或某人采取某项行动所给予的同意或许可。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permess jew qbil mogħti biex issir xi ħaġa jew biex xi ħadd jieħu azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同意；允许他人进行某项行动或允许某事发生的意思表示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-permess li tagħti lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew il-qbil tiegħek li ssir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you give your consent to something, you agree to it or allow someone to do it.

formal.mt: L-organizzaturi talbu l-kunsens bil-miktub tal-parteċipanti qabel ippubblikaw ir-ritratti tagħhom.
formal.en: The organizers requested the participants' written consent before publishing their photographs.
formal.zh: 主办方在发布参与者的照片之前，征求了他们的书面同意。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tini l-kunsens tiegħek biex naqsam dan ir-ritratt mal-grupp? Nina: Iva, tista' taqsmu mal-grupp.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you give me your consent to share this photo with the group? Nina: Yes, you can share it with the group.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你同意我把这张照片发到群里吗？Nina：同意，你可以发到群里。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tini l-kunsens tiegħek biex naqsam dan ir-ritratt mal-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Tini l-kunsens tiegħek biex naqsam dan ir-ritratt mal-grupp?
messages.zh: 你同意我把这张照片发到群里吗？
messages.en: Do you give me your consent to share this photo with the group?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' taqsmu mal-grupp.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' taqsmu mal-grupp.
messages.zh: 同意，你可以发到群里。
messages.en: Yes, you can share it with the group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kunsens 和“先询问，对方点头同意”的场景绑定，再用“书面同意”巩固它的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A smooth preparation of crushed tomatoes used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把番茄压碎或捣成泥后制成、用于烹饪的番茄泥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni tat-tadam mgħaffeġ li tintuża fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于烹饪的番茄泥。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni magħmula mit-tadam mgħaffeġ li tintuża biex tagħti togħma lill-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tomato puree is a smooth preparation of crushed tomatoes that you use in cooking.

formal.mt: Żid mgħarfa kunserva mal-basal u ħawwad sew qabel iżżid l-ilma.
formal.en: Add a spoonful of tomato puree to the onion and stir well before adding the water.
formal.zh: 在洋葱中加入一勺番茄泥，搅拌均匀后再加水。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm inżid kunserva? Pawlu: Żid mgħarfa għalissa, imbagħad induqu z-zalza.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much tomato puree should I add? Pawlu: Add a spoonful for now, then we'll taste the sauce.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我要加多少番茄泥？保罗：先加一勺，然后我们尝尝酱汁。

messages.speaker: Marija (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm inżid kunserva?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm inżid kunserva?
messages.zh: 我要加多少番茄泥？
messages.en: How much tomato puree should I add?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid mgħarfa għalissa, imbagħad induqu z-zalza.
messages.mt_standard: Żid mgħarfa għalissa, imbagħad induqu z-zalza.
messages.zh: 先加一勺，然后我们尝尝酱汁。
messages.en: Add a spoonful for now, then we'll taste the sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kunserva 和做饭时舀起的一勺红色番茄泥连在一起记，再用 mgħarfa kunserva 练习表达分量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A member of a council who takes part in its discussions and decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 议会或地方议会的成员，参与议事和作出决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru ta' kunsill li jieħu sehem fid-diskussjonijiet u fid-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 议会成员，尤指参与地方公共事务决策的地方议会议员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li hija membru ta' kunsill, speċjalment kunsill lokali, u tieħu sehem fid-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A councillor is a member of a council who takes part in decisions about the matters it manages.

formal.mt: Il-kunsillier ippreżenta proposta biex jittejjeb id-dawl fit-toroq tal-lokalità.
formal.en: The councillor presented a proposal to improve street lighting in the locality.
formal.zh: 这位议员提出了一项改善当地街道照明的建议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min nistgħu nkellmu dwar id-dawl tat-triq? Mark: Nistgħu nkellmu lill-kunsillier lokali wara l-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can we talk to about the street lighting? Mark: We can talk to the local councillor after the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：街道照明的事，我们可以找谁谈？马克：会议结束后，我们可以找地方议员谈。

messages.speaker: Lara (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nistgħu nkellmu dwar id-dawl tat-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nistgħu nkellmu dwar id-dawl tat-triq?
messages.zh: 街道照明的事，我们可以找谁谈？
messages.en: Who can we talk to about the street lighting?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nkellmu lill-kunsillier lokali wara l-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nkellmu lill-kunsillier lokali wara l-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 会议结束后，我们可以找地方议员谈。
messages.en: We can talk to the local councillor after the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象居民向地方议员反映路灯问题，把 kunsillier lokali 与这个具体人物和公共事务场景一起记。

gloss_zh: 词义未明确（所给释义仅为 Manafx）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not established in the supplied packet, which gives only the label 'Manafx'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将其列为名词，但释义栏仅有 Manafx，无法据此确定该词的具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex iċċarata fil-pakkett mogħti, fejn jidher biss 'Manafx' bħala tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义标注为 Manafx；该标注未提供可确定的名词义，因此此处保留词义未明的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pakkett jagħti biss 'Manafx' bħala tifsira għal dan in-nom, għalhekk ma jistax jiġi stabbilit sens speċifiku minn din l-informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label does not establish a specific meaning for this noun, so its sense remains unresolved here.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jelenka 'kuntati' bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira mogħtija, 'Manafx', ma tiċċarax is-sens tal-kelma.
formal.en: The packet lists 'kuntati' as a noun, but the supplied definition, 'Manafx', does not clarify the word's meaning.
formal.zh: 材料把“kuntati”列为名词，但所给释义“Manafx”没有说明这个词的具体含义。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kuntati'? Rita: Hawn hemm biss 'Manafx'. Minn dan il-pakkett ma nistgħux ngħidu xi tfisser.
colloquial.en: Mei: What does the word 'kuntati' mean? Rita: It only says 'Manafx' here. We can't tell what it means from this packet.
colloquial.zh: 梅：“kuntati”这个词是什么意思？丽塔：这里只写了“Manafx”。我们无法从这份材料确定它的意思。

messages.speaker: Mei (马耳他语学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kuntati'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'kuntati'?
messages.zh: “kuntati”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'kuntati' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hemm biss 'Manafx'. Minn dan il-pakkett ma nistgħux ngħidu xi tfisser.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hemm biss 'Manafx'. Minn dan il-pakkett ma nistgħux ngħidu xi tfisser.
messages.zh: 这里只写了“Manafx”。我们无法从这份材料确定它的意思。
messages.en: It only says 'Manafx' here. We can't tell what it means from this packet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kuntati 的学习卡标上“词义待确认”，先记住拼写与名词标注；两个搭配仅用于谈论这个词，不据此猜测其实际含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Communication between people, or a state in which people or things touch or meet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人之间的联系或交流，也可指人或物之间发生接触的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Komunikazzjoni bejn persuni, jew stat li fih persuni jew affarijiet imissu jew jiltaqgħu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人与人之间的联系、交流，或人和物之间的接触。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Komunikazzjoni jew rabta bejn persuni, jew il-fatt li persuni jew affarijiet imissu ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Contact is communication between people, or a situation in which people or things touch one another.

formal.mt: Għal aktar informazzjoni, jekk jogħġbok agħmel kuntatt mal-uffiċċju permezz tal-email.
formal.en: For further information, please contact the office by email.
formal.zh: 如需更多信息，请通过电子邮件与办公室联系。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se nibqgħu f'kuntatt meta tmur barra? David: Żgur! Niktiblek kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Will we stay in contact when you go abroad? David: Of course! I'll write to you every week.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你出国以后，我们还会保持联系吗？戴维：当然！我每周都会给你写消息。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nibqgħu f'kuntatt meta tmur barra?
messages.mt_standard: Se nibqgħu f'kuntatt meta tmur barra?
messages.zh: 你出国以后，我们还会保持联系吗？
messages.en: Will we stay in contact when you go abroad?

messages.speaker: David (即将出国的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur! Niktiblek kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur! Niktiblek kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 当然！我每周都会给你写消息。
messages.en: Of course! I'll write to you every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuntatt 放进“朋友出国后仍保持联系”的画面里，整句记住 nibqgħu f'kuntatt，表示“我们保持联系”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of happiness and satisfaction with your life or circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因生活、处境或某件事情令人满意而产生的幸福、快乐或满足感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' ferħ u sodisfazzjon bil-ħajja, biċ-ċirkustanzi jew b'xi ħaġa li tkun ġrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幸福或快乐的感受，尤其是对生活或当下处境感到满意时的心情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' ferħ u sodisfazzjon li persuna tħoss meta tkun kuntenta b'ħajjitha jew b'xi esperjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Happiness is the pleasant feeling you have when you enjoy your life or feel satisfied with something.

formal.mt: L-attivitajiet fil-komunità jistgħu jsaħħu s-sens ta' kuntentizza fost ir-residenti.
formal.en: Community activities can strengthen residents' sense of happiness.
formal.zh: 社区活动可以增强居民的幸福感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħtik l-aktar kuntentizza? Lara: Li nqatta' ħin mal-familja tiegħi, speċjalment fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What gives you the most happiness? Lara: Spending time with my family, especially at the weekend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么最让你感到幸福？拉拉：和家人共度时光，尤其是在周末。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jagħtik l-aktar kuntentizza?
messages.mt_standard: X'jagħtik l-aktar kuntentizza?
messages.zh: 什么最让你感到幸福？
messages.en: What gives you the most happiness?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Li nqatta' ħin mal-familja tiegħi, speċjalment fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Li nqatta' ħin mal-familja tiegħi, speċjalment fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 和家人共度时光，尤其是在周末。
messages.en: Spending time with my family, especially at the weekend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与全家共度周末的画面绑定：那种心里快乐又满足的感觉，就是 kuntentizza。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A police officer, especially one holding the rank of constable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 执行警务的人员，尤指职级为普通警员的警察。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru tal-pulizija, b'mod partikolari wieħed li jkollu l-grad ta' kuntistabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警员，指警察队伍中的一种基层职级或具有该职级的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Membru tal-korp tal-pulizija li jkollu l-grad ta' kuntistabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A constable is a police officer who holds a basic rank within a police force.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警察；负责维持公共秩序、预防犯罪和执行法律的人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fil-pulizija u li xogħolha huwa li żżomm l-ordni pubbliku, tipprevjeni r-reati u tinforza l-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A police officer is someone whose job involves maintaining public order and enforcing the law.

formal.mt: Il-kuntistabbli ħa d-dettalji tax-xhud u kiteb rapport dwar l-inċident.
formal.en: The constable took the witness's details and wrote a report about the incident.
formal.zh: 警员记录了证人的资料，并就该事件撰写了报告。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Sibt kartiera ħdejn il-ħanut. Lil min nagħtiha? Nina: Agħtiha lill-kuntistabbli li qiegħed ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Mark: I found a wallet near the shop. Who should I give it to? Nina: Give it to the constable standing near the square.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我在商店附近捡到了一个钱包，应该交给谁？妮娜：交给站在广场附近的那位警员。

messages.speaker: Mark (路人)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt kartiera ħdejn il-ħanut. Lil min nagħtiha?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt kartiera ħdejn il-ħanut. Lil min nagħtiha?
messages.zh: 我在商店附近捡到了一个钱包，应该交给谁？
messages.en: I found a wallet near the shop. Who should I give it to?

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħtiha lill-kuntistabbli li qiegħed ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Agħtiha lill-kuntistabbli li qiegħed ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 交给站在广场附近的那位警员。
messages.en: Give it to the constable standing near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“捡到钱包交给巡逻警员”的场景记住 kuntistabbli；它既可指警员职级，也可泛指警察。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that counts passing railway axles or wheels to help determine whether a section of track is occupied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对通过的铁路车辆车轴或车轮进行计数，以辅助判断某段轨道是否被占用的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jgħodd il-fusien jew ir-roti tal-vetturi ferrovjarji li jgħaddu minn punt fuq il-binarju, biex jgħin jiddetermina jekk sezzjoni tal-binarju hijiex okkupata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计轴器；记录经过检测点的铁路车辆车轴数量的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jgħodd il-fusien tal-vetturi ferrovjarji hekk kif jgħaddu minn punt ta' detezzjoni fuq il-binarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An axle-counter is a railway device that counts passing axles to help establish whether a section of track is occupied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车轮计数设备；用于检测并累计经过车轮数量的仪器设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmir li jidentifika r-roti li jgħaddu minn punt partikolari u jirreġistra l-għadd tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wheel-counting apparatus is equipment that detects passing wheels and records how many have passed a particular point.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车轮计数装置；用于统计经过某一位置的车轮数量的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mezz li jgħodd kemm-il rota tgħaddi minn post speċifiku u jirreġistra dak l-għadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wheel-counting device is an instrument that records the number of wheels passing a specified location.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku vverifika li l-kuntjatur tal-fusien kien qed jirreġistra b'mod korrett il-fusien li jgħaddu.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician verified that the axle-counter was correctly recording passing axles.
formal.zh: 检查期间，技术人员核实了计轴器是否正在正确记录经过的车轴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-apparat ħdejn il-binarju? Pawlu: Dak kuntjatur tal-fusien. Jgħodd il-fusien tal-ferrovija meta jgħaddu minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that device beside the track? Pawlu: That's an axle-counter. It counts the train's axles as they pass here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：轨道旁边那个装置是什么？保罗：那是计轴器，用来统计从这里经过的火车车轴。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak l-apparat ħdejn il-binarju?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak l-apparat ħdejn il-binarju?
messages.zh: 轨道旁边那个装置是什么？
messages.en: What is that device beside the track?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (铁路技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kuntjatur tal-fusien. Jgħodd il-fusien tal-ferrovija meta jgħaddu minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kuntjatur tal-fusien. Jgħodd il-fusien tal-ferrovija meta jgħaddu minn hawn.
messages.zh: 那是计轴器，用来统计从这里经过的火车车轴。
messages.en: That's an axle-counter. It counts the train's axles as they pass here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象轨道旁的装置在车轴经过时逐一计数，把整个短语 kuntjatur tal-fusien 与“计轴器”画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods that are brought into or taken out of a country illegally, or that are prohibited by law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被非法运入或运出某国的货物，或法律禁止持有、运输或交易的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jiddaħħlu f'pajjiż jew jinħarġu minnu illegalment, jew li l-liġi tipprojbixxi l-pussess, it-trasport jew il-kummerċ tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 违禁品；法律禁止持有、运输或交易的货物，也指非法进出口的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li huma pprojbiti mil-liġi jew li jkunu ddaħħlu f'pajjiż jew inħarġu minnu illegalment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Contraband consists of goods that are prohibited by law or have been imported or exported illegally.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走私货物；通过逃避海关检查或违反进出口规定而跨境运输的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jkunu ddaħħlu f'pajjiż jew inħarġu minnu bil-moħbi biex jiġu evitati l-kontrolli tad-dwana jew ir-regoli tal-importazzjoni u l-esportazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Smuggled goods are products moved across a border illegally, usually to evade customs controls or import and export rules.

formal.mt: L-uffiċjali tad-dwana sabu oġġetti tal-kuntrabandu moħbija fost il-merkanzija u kkonfiskawhom.
formal.en: Customs officers found contraband concealed among the cargo and confiscated it.
formal.zh: 海关人员在货物中发现了藏匿的违禁品，并予以没收。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex id-dwana żammet dawk il-kaxxi? Sara: Għax sabu sigaretti tal-kuntrabandu fihom.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did customs hold those boxes? Sara: Because they found smuggled cigarettes inside them.
colloquial.zh: 马克：海关为什么扣留了那些箱子？萨拉：因为他们在里面发现了走私香烟。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dwana żammet dawk il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dwana żammet dawk il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 海关为什么扣留了那些箱子？
messages.en: Why did customs hold those boxes?

messages.speaker: Sara (同行旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax sabu sigaretti tal-kuntrabandu fihom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax sabu sigaretti tal-kuntrabandu fihom.
messages.zh: 因为他们在里面发现了走私香烟。
messages.en: Because they found smuggled cigarettes inside them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuntrabandu 与海关从箱子里查出走私香烟的画面相连；记住这里指被查获的货物，可搭配 oġġetti 或 sigaretti。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clear difference between two things, especially when they are considered or shown together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两种事物放在一起观察或比较时呈现出的明显差异或反差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Differenza ċara bejn żewġ affarijiet, speċjalment meta jitqabblu jew jintwerew flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对比；两个事物之间显著的差异或反差。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Differenza li tidher b'mod ċar meta żewġ affarijiet jitqiegħdu ħdejn xulxin jew jitqabblu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contrast is a noticeable difference between two things that you compare or experience together.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-kuntrast bejn iż-żieda fil-prezzijiet u t-tnaqqis fid-dħul tal-familji.
formal.en: The report highlights the contrast between rising prices and falling household incomes.
formal.zh: 报告强调了物价上涨与家庭收入下降之间的反差。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok il-kulur tal-ħajt? Pawlu: Iva, hemm kuntrast sabiħ bejn il-ħajt blu u l-għamara bajda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like the wall colour? Pawlu: Yes, there is a lovely contrast between the blue wall and the white furniture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢墙面的颜色吗？保罗：喜欢，蓝色墙面和白色家具形成了很好看的对比。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġbok il-kulur tal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġbok il-kulur tal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你喜欢墙面的颜色吗？
messages.en: Do you like the wall colour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm kuntrast sabiħ bejn il-ħajt blu u l-għamara bajda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm kuntrast sabiħ bejn il-ħajt blu u l-għamara bajda.
messages.zh: 喜欢，蓝色墙面和白色家具形成了很好看的对比。
messages.en: Yes, there is a lovely contrast between the blue wall and the white furniture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蓝墙旁摆着白色家具：两者一放在一起，明显的反差就是 kuntrast。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract that supports or supplements a main contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为主要合同提供配套安排或补充内容的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jappoġġa jew jissupplimenta kuntratt prinċipali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附属合同；与主要合同相配套、为其提供支持或补充安排的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt marbut ma' kuntratt prinċipali li jipprovdi arranġamenti ta' appoġġ jew servizzi supplimentari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ancillary contract is an agreement that provides support or additional arrangements for a main contract.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt anċillari jispeċifika s-servizzi ta' manutenzjoni marbuta max-xiri tat-tagħmir.
formal.en: The ancillary contract specifies the maintenance services associated with the purchase of the equipment.
formal.zh: 附属合同明确规定了与设备购买相配套的维修保养服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm kuntratt ieħor mal-kuntratt tax-xiri? Mark: Dan huwa kuntratt anċillari għall-manutenzjoni tal-magna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there another contract with the purchase contract? Mark: This is an ancillary contract for maintaining the machine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么购买合同之外还有另一份合同？马克：这是机器维修保养的配套合同。

messages.speaker: Sara (买方同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm kuntratt ieħor mal-kuntratt tax-xiri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm kuntratt ieħor mal-kuntratt tax-xiri?
messages.zh: 为什么购买合同之外还有另一份合同？
messages.en: Why is there another contract with the purchase contract?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa kuntratt anċillari għall-manutenzjoni tal-magna.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa kuntratt anċillari għall-manutenzjoni tal-magna.
messages.zh: 这是机器维修保养的配套合同。
messages.en: This is an ancillary contract for maintaining the machine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把主合同想成购买机器的文件，旁边配套的保养合同就是 kuntratt anċillari，记住其补充和支持作用。

gloss_zh: 混合用途合同；多种目的合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract that serves more than one purpose, such as both personal and business use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同时服务于多种用途或目的的合同，例如兼有个人用途和商业用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jaqdi aktar minn skop wieħed, bħal użu personali u użu għan-negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合用途合同；涵盖多种目的的合同，例如同时涉及私人用途和经营用途。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jiġbor fih skopijiet differenti, pereżempju meta l-istess xiri jkun maħsub kemm għal bżonnijiet personali kif ukoll għal bżonnijiet tan-negozju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mixed-purpose contract is an agreement that serves different purposes, for example both private and business needs.

collocations.mt: kuntratt b'diversi skopijiet għal użu personali u kummerċjali
collocations.en: a mixed-purpose contract for personal and commercial use
collocations.zh: 兼顾个人与商业用途的混合用途合同

formal.mt: L-istudju jippreżenta kuntratt b'diversi skopijiet għax-xiri ta' vettura maħsuba kemm għall-użu personali kif ukoll għall-użu tan-negozju.
formal.en: The study presents a mixed-purpose contract for purchasing a vehicle intended for both personal and business use.
formal.zh: 该研究展示了一份购买车辆的混合用途合同，该车辆计划同时用于个人生活和经营活动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-karozza se tużaha biss għax-xogħol? David: Le, se nużaha wkoll għall-ħarġiet mal-familja. Nina: Mela l-kuntratt tax-xiri huwa eżempju ta' kuntratt b'diversi skopijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will you use the car only for work? David: No, I will also use it for outings with my family. Nina: Then the purchase contract is an example of a mixed-purpose contract.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这辆车你只用来工作吗？戴维：不是，我也会用它带家人出去玩。妮娜：那么，这份购车合同就是混合用途合同的一个例子。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza se tużaha biss għax-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza se tużaha biss għax-xogħol?
messages.zh: 这辆车你只用来工作吗？
messages.en: Will you use the car only for work?

messages.speaker: David (购车者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nużaha wkoll għall-ħarġiet mal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nużaha wkoll għall-ħarġiet mal-familja.
messages.zh: 不是，我也会用它带家人出去玩。
messages.en: No, I will also use it for outings with my family.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-kuntratt tax-xiri huwa eżempju ta' kuntratt b'diversi skopijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-kuntratt tax-xiri huwa eżempju ta' kuntratt b'diversi skopijiet.
messages.zh: 那么，这份购车合同就是混合用途合同的一个例子。
messages.en: Then the purchase contract is an example of a mixed-purpose contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一辆车工作日运货、周末带家人出游：一份合同对应多种目的，就记作 kuntratt b'diversi skopijiet。

gloss_zh: 营业场所以外订立的合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract made with a trader away from the trader's business premises.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在经营者营业场所以外与其订立的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jsir ma' negozjant f'post li mhuwiex il-post tan-negozju tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 营业场所以外订立的合同；在经营者营业地点之外与其达成的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jiġi konkluż bejn klijent u negozjant barra mill-post fejn in-negozjant imexxi n-negozju tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An off-premises contract is an agreement you make with a trader somewhere other than their business premises.

collocations.zh: 订立营业场所以外的合同

collocations.mt: kopja ta' kuntratt barra mill-post tan-negozju
collocations.en: a copy of an off-premises contract
collocations.zh: 营业场所以外订立的合同副本

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tat-taħriġ, il-klijent u l-bejjiegħ iffirmaw kuntratt barra mill-post tan-negozju waqt żjara fid-dar tal-klijent.
formal.en: In the training example, the customer and the salesperson signed an off-premises contract during a visit to the customer's home.
formal.zh: 在培训示例中，顾客和销售员在销售员上门拜访时，于顾客家中签订了营业场所以外的合同。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Iffirmajt il-kuntratt fil-ħanut? Toni: Le, il-bejjiegħ ġie d-dar u ffirmajna hemm. Lara: Mela dan huwa eżempju ta' kuntratt barra mill-post tan-negozju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you sign the contract in the shop? Toni: No, the salesperson came to my home and we signed it there. Lara: Then this is an example of an off-premises contract.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是在店里签的合同吗？托尼：不是，销售员来了我家，我们在那里签的。拉拉：那么，这就是营业场所以外订立合同的一个例子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iffirmajt il-kuntratt fil-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Iffirmajt il-kuntratt fil-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你是在店里签的合同吗？
messages.en: Did you sign the contract in the shop?

messages.speaker: Toni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-bejjiegħ ġie d-dar u ffirmajna hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-bejjiegħ ġie d-dar u ffirmajna hemm.
messages.zh: 不是，销售员来了我家，我们在那里签的。
messages.en: No, the salesperson came to my home and we signed it there.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela dan huwa eżempju ta' kuntratt barra mill-post tan-negozju.
messages.mt_standard: Mela dan huwa eżempju ta' kuntratt barra mill-post tan-negozju.
messages.zh: 那么，这就是营业场所以外订立合同的一个例子。
messages.en: Then this is an example of an off-premises contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用签约地点记忆整句：kuntratt 是合同，barra 表示在外面，想象销售员在你家签约，就能记住营业场所以外合同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract setting out the obligations for carrying out public construction or infrastructure works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定公共建筑或基础设施工程的实施内容及相关义务的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi x-xogħlijiet ta' kostruzzjoni jew infrastruttura pubblika li għandhom jitwettqu u l-obbligi tal-partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共工程合同，即就公共建筑或基础设施工程的实施而订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jirregola t-twettiq ta' xogħlijiet ta' kostruzzjoni jew infrastruttura għall-użu pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public works contract is an agreement covering the execution of construction or infrastructure works for public use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工程合同，即规定施工任务、实施条件及各方义务的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi x-xogħlijiet ta' kostruzzjoni li għandhom isiru, il-kundizzjonijiet tat-twettiq tagħhom u l-obbligi tal-partijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A works contract is an agreement that specifies construction work and the responsibilities of the parties involved.

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt għal xogħlijiet pubbliċi
collocations.en: the terms of a public works contract
be awarded a public works contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt għal xogħlijiet pubbliċi jispeċifika l-materjali li għandhom jintużaw u d-data sa meta għandu jitlesta x-xogħol fit-triq.
formal.en: The public works contract specifies the materials to be used and the deadline for completing the roadworks.
formal.zh: 公共工程合同明确规定了应使用的材料及道路工程的完工期限。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-kumpanija tagħkom iffirmat il-kuntratt għal xogħlijiet pubbliċi? Pawlu: Iva, se nsewwu t-triq ħdejn l-iskola. Marta: U meta tibdew? Pawlu: Nhar it-Tnejn li ġej.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has your company signed the public works contract? Pawlu: Yes, we're going to repair the road near the school. Marta: And when do you start? Pawlu: Next Monday.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你们公司签了公共工程合同吗？Pawlu：签了，我们要修学校附近的那条路。Marta：那什么时候开工？Pawlu：下周一。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tagħkom iffirmat il-kuntratt għal xogħlijiet pubbliċi?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tagħkom iffirmat il-kuntratt għal xogħlijiet pubbliċi?
messages.zh: 你们公司签了公共工程合同吗？
messages.en: Has your company signed the public works contract?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程公司员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nsewwu t-triq ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nsewwu t-triq ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.zh: 签了，我们要修学校附近的那条路。
messages.en: Yes, we're going to repair the road near the school.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U meta tibdew?
messages.mt_standard: U meta tibdew?
messages.zh: 那什么时候开工？
messages.en: And when do you start?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程公司员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar it-Tnejn li ġej.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar it-Tnejn li ġej.
messages.zh: 下周一。
messages.en: Next Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成三个意义块来记：kuntratt 是合同，għal 表示用途或对象，xogħlijiet pubbliċi 是公共工程；联想修建公共道路时签署的合同。

exact_key: kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini
gloss_zh: 建筑物购买或租赁合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract specifying the terms for purchasing or renting a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定购买或租赁建筑物的条件以及各方义务的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini u l-obbligi tal-partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑工程合同，即规定建筑施工内容、条件及相关义务的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi x-xogħol ta' kostruzzjoni li għandu jitwettaq fuq bini, il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu u l-obbligi tal-partijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A building contract is an agreement setting out the work and obligations involved in a building project.

sense_translations.en_definition: contract for the purchase or rental of a building
sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物购买或租赁合同，即规定建筑物买卖或租用条件的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jispeċifika l-kundizzjonijiet li bihom parti tixtri jew tikri bini mingħand parti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract for the purchase or rental of a building sets out the terms under which a building is bought or rented.

collocations.mt: jiffirma kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini
collocations.en: sign a contract for the purchase or rental of a building
collocations.zh: 签署建筑物购买或租赁合同

collocations.mt: jabbozza kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini
collocations.en: draft a contract for the purchase or rental of a building
collocations.zh: 起草建筑物购买或租赁合同

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini
collocations.en: the terms of a contract for the purchase or rental of a building
collocations.zh: 建筑物购买或租赁合同的条款

formal.mt: Qabel jiġi ffirmat il-kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini, il-partijiet għandhom jaqblu dwar il-ħlas u d-data meta l-bini jkun disponibbli.
formal.en: Before the contract for the purchase or rental of a building is signed, the parties should agree on payment and the date when the building will be available.
formal.zh: 在签署建筑物购买或租赁合同之前，各方应就付款安排及建筑物可供使用的日期达成一致。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek l-abbozz tal-kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini? Mark: Iva, iżda aħna se nikru l-bini, mhux nixtruh. Lara: Mela ejja naraw kemm hu l-kera u kemm idum il-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have the draft contract for the purchase or rental of a building? Mark: Yes, but we're going to rent the building, not buy it. Lara: Then let's check the rent and how long the contract lasts.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有建筑物购买或租赁合同的草稿吗？Mark：有，不过我们是要租这栋楼，不是买下来。Lara：那我们看看租金是多少，以及合同期限有多长。

messages.speaker: Lara (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek l-abbozz tal-kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek l-abbozz tal-kuntratt għax-xiri jew għall-kiri ta' bini?
messages.zh: 你有建筑物购买或租赁合同的草稿吗？
messages.en: Do you have the draft contract for the purchase or rental of a building?

messages.speaker: Mark (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda aħna se nikru l-bini, mhux nixtruh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda aħna se nikru l-bini, mhux nixtruh.
messages.zh: 有，不过我们是要租这栋楼，不是买下来。
messages.en: Yes, but we're going to rent the building, not buy it.

messages.speaker: Lara (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja naraw kemm hu l-kera u kemm idum il-kuntratt.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja naraw kemm hu l-kera u kemm idum il-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 那我们看看租金是多少，以及合同期限有多长。
messages.en: Then let's check the rent and how long the contract lasts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“买还是租一栋楼”的场景串联整句：xiri 对应购买，kiri 对应租赁，jew 表示或者，ta' bini 限定对象为建筑物；把两个相似词放在一起对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract combining elements of different types of agreement, such as supplies, services, or works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在同一合同中结合不同合同类型内容的协议，例如同时涉及货物供应、服务或工程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jgħaqqad elementi ta' tipi differenti ta' ftehim, bħal provvisti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合合同，即在同一协议中包含两种或多种合同类型内容的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim wieħed li jinkludi elementi ta' żewġ tipi jew aktar ta' kuntratti, bħal xiri ta' tagħmir flimkien ma' servizzi ta' manutenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mixed contract combines elements of two or more types of agreement within a single contract.

collocations.en: the components of a mixed contract

collocations.mt: kuntratt imħallat għal provvisti u servizzi
collocations.en: a mixed contract for supplies and services
collocations.zh: 兼涉货物供应与服务的混合合同

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt imħallat jinkludi kemm il-provvista tat-tagħmir kif ukoll il-manutenzjoni tiegħu għal sentejn.
formal.en: The mixed contract includes both the supply of the equipment and its maintenance for two years.
formal.zh: 该混合合同既包括设备供应，也包括为期两年的设备维护。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kuntratt hu biss għax-xiri tal-kompjuters? David: Le, jinkludi wkoll it-tiswijiet għal sentejn. Nina: Allura huwa kuntratt imħallat. David: Iva, fih kemm il-provvista kif ukoll is-servizz.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this contract just for buying the computers? David: No, it also includes repairs for two years. Nina: So it's a mixed contract. David: Yes, it covers both the supply and the service.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这份合同只是用来购买电脑的吗？David：不是，还包括两年的维修。Nina：那就是一份混合合同了。David：对，里面既有货物供应，也有服务。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kuntratt hu biss għax-xiri tal-kompjuters?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kuntratt hu biss għax-xiri tal-kompjuters?
messages.zh: 这份合同只是用来购买电脑的吗？
messages.en: Is this contract just for buying the computers?

messages.speaker: David (采购负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jinkludi wkoll it-tiswijiet għal sentejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jinkludi wkoll it-tiswijiet għal sentejn.
messages.zh: 不是，还包括两年的维修。
messages.en: No, it also includes repairs for two years.

messages.speaker: Nina (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura huwa kuntratt imħallat.
messages.mt_standard: Allura huwa kuntratt imħallat.
messages.zh: 那就是一份混合合同了。
messages.en: So it's a mixed contract.

messages.speaker: David (采购负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih kemm il-provvista kif ukoll is-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih kemm il-provvista kif ukoll is-servizz.
messages.zh: 对，里面既有货物供应，也有服务。
messages.en: Yes, it covers both the supply and the service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想“一份合同装进两类内容”：买设备加维护服务，便能记住 imħallat 的“混合”含义；重点是内容类型的结合，而不是合同份数增加。

gloss_zh: 消费者订立的合同；消费者合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract entered into by a consumer to obtain goods or services for personal use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消费者为个人使用而取得商品或服务时订立的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li konsumatur jagħmel biex jikseb oġġetti jew servizzi għall-użu personali tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者合同，即消费者为个人用途向商家购买商品或取得服务时订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt bejn konsumatur u negozjant dwar oġġetti jew servizzi li l-konsumatur jikseb għall-użu personali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer contract is an agreement through which an individual obtains goods or services from a business for personal use.

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt konkluż minn konsumatur
collocations.en: the terms of a consumer contract

collocations.mt: kuntratt konkluż minn konsumatur fuq l-internet
collocations.zh: 消费者在网上订立的合同

collocations.mt: kuntratt konkluż minn konsumatur għall-użu personali
collocations.en: a contract entered into by a consumer for personal use
collocations.zh: 消费者为个人用途订立的合同

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt konkluż minn konsumatur għas-servizz tal-internet jindika l-ħlas ta' kull xahar u t-tul tal-ftehim.
formal.en: The consumer contract for internet service states the monthly charge and the duration of the agreement.
formal.zh: 消费者订立的互联网服务合同列明了月费及协议期限。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan il-ftehim jissejjaħ kuntratt konkluż minn konsumatur? Luqa: Għax qed tixtri s-servizz għad-dar tiegħek, għall-użu personali. Sara: Fhimt. Se naqra l-kundizzjonijiet qabel naċċetta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this agreement called a consumer contract? Luqa: Because you're buying the service for your home, for personal use. Sara: I see. I'll read the terms before I accept.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么这份协议叫作消费者合同？Luqa：因为你买这项服务是给家里用的，属于个人用途。Sara：明白了。我会先读条款再接受。

messages.speaker: Sara (消费者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-ftehim jissejjaħ kuntratt konkluż minn konsumatur?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-ftehim jissejjaħ kuntratt konkluż minn konsumatur?
messages.zh: 为什么这份协议叫作消费者合同？
messages.en: Why is this agreement called a consumer contract?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed tixtri s-servizz għad-dar tiegħek, għall-użu personali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed tixtri s-servizz għad-dar tiegħek, għall-użu personali.
messages.zh: 因为你买这项服务是给家里用的，属于个人用途。
messages.en: Because you're buying the service for your home, for personal use.

messages.speaker: Sara (消费者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fhimt. Se naqra l-kundizzjonijiet qabel naċċetta.
messages.mt_standard: Fhimt. Se naqra l-kundizzjonijiet qabel naċċetta.
messages.zh: 明白了。我会先读条款再接受。
messages.en: I see. I'll read the terms before I accept.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“合同—已订立—由消费者”顺序拆读：kuntratt 是合同，konkluż 在此表示已订立，minn 引出订立者，konsumatur 是消费者；联想为家里办理网络服务的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract concluded through communication at a distance, without the parties being physically present together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 当事人不在同一现场，而通过远程通信方式订立的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jiġi konkluż permezz ta' komunikazzjoni mill-bogħod, mingħajr ma l-partijiet ikunu fiżikament preżenti flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当事人通过远程通信而非共同到场订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li l-partijiet jikkonkludu permezz ta' mezzi ta' komunikazzjoni mill-bogħod mingħajr ma jkunu fiżikament preżenti flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distance contract is a contract that the parties conclude through remote communication without being physically present together.

collocations.en: the terms of a distance contract

formal.mt: Qabel ma jikkonkludi kuntratt mill-bogħod, il-klijent għandu jaqra bir-reqqa l-kundizzjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: Before concluding a distance contract, the customer should read all the terms carefully.
formal.zh: 客户在订立远程合同之前，应仔细阅读所有条款。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-kuntratt nistgħu nagħmluh kollu online? Mark: Iva, ikun kuntratt mill-bogħod. Nibgħatlek il-kundizzjonijiet biex taqrahom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we arrange this whole contract online? Mark: Yes, it will be a distance contract. I'll send you the terms so you can read them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这份合同可以全程在线办理吗？Mark：可以，这属于远程合同。我把条款发给你看。

messages.speaker: Sara (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kuntratt nistgħu nagħmluh kollu online?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kuntratt nistgħu nagħmluh kollu online?
messages.zh: 这份合同可以全程在线办理吗？
messages.en: Can we arrange this whole contract online?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikun kuntratt mill-bogħod. Nibgħatlek il-kundizzjonijiet biex taqrahom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikun kuntratt mill-bogħod. Nibgħatlek il-kundizzjonijiet biex taqrahom.
messages.zh: 可以，这属于远程合同。我把条款发给你看。
messages.en: Yes, it will be a distance contract. I'll send you the terms so you can read them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuntratt 联想为合同，把 mill-bogħod 联系到远距离：双方隔着屏幕订立合同，就是远程合同。

gloss_zh: 公共合同；公共采购合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract under which a public authority obtains goods, services, or works from a supplier or contractor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共机构为取得货物、服务或工程而与供应商或承包商订立的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li permezz tiegħu awtorità pubblika tikseb oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet mingħand fornitur jew kuntrattur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采购合同；此处指公共机构为采购货物、服务或工程而订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt għall-akkwist ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet, f'dan il-kuntest minn awtorità pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procurement contract is an agreement for obtaining goods, services, or works, here for a public authority.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共合同；此处指公共机构与供应商或承包商就提供货物、服务或工程订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt bejn awtorità pubblika u fornitur jew kuntrattur għall-provvista ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public contract is an agreement through which a public authority arranges for goods, services, or works to be provided.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购合同，即公共机构为采购货物、服务或工程而订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li awtorità pubblika tikkonkludi biex takkwista oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet mingħand fornitur jew kuntrattur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public procurement contract is a contract used by a public authority to purchase goods, services, or works.

collocations.en: the award of a public contract

formal.mt: Il-kunsill iffirma kuntratt pubbliku għall-provvista ta' għamara ġdida għall-librerija.
formal.en: The council signed a public contract for the supply of new furniture for the library.
formal.zh: 地方议会签订了一份公共合同，为图书馆采购新家具。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt li l-kumpanija tagħkom ingħatat kuntratt pubbliku. Għal xiex? Pawlu: Se nipprovdu għamara ġdida għal-librerija tal-kunsill.
colloquial.en: Marija: I heard your company was awarded a public contract. What's it for? Pawlu: We'll be supplying new furniture for the council's library.
colloquial.zh: Marija：听说你们公司拿到了一份公共合同。是做什么的？Pawlu：我们会为地方议会的图书馆供应新家具。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li l-kumpanija tagħkom ingħatat kuntratt pubbliku. Għal xiex?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li l-kumpanija tagħkom ingħatat kuntratt pubbliku. Għal xiex?
messages.zh: 听说你们公司拿到了一份公共合同。是做什么的？
messages.en: I heard your company was awarded a public contract. What's it for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nipprovdu għamara ġdida għal-librerija tal-kunsill.
messages.mt_standard: Se nipprovdu għamara ġdida għal-librerija tal-kunsill.
messages.zh: 我们会为地方议会的图书馆供应新家具。
messages.en: We'll be supplying new furniture for the council's library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pubbliku 就联系公共机构：想象地方议会采购图书馆家具，用这个场景记住公共合同的采购含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract under which a public authority purchases services from a service provider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共机构为购买服务而与服务提供方订立的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li permezz tiegħu awtorità pubblika tixtri servizzi mingħand min jipprovdihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务采购合同；此处指公共机构为取得约定服务而订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt għall-provvista ta' servizzi miftiehma, f'dan il-kuntest lil awtorità pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract for services is an agreement under which a provider supplies specified services, here to a public authority.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共服务合同；此处指公共机构购买服务所订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li awtorità pubblika tikkonkludi ma' fornitur biex dan jipprovdilha servizzi miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public service contract is an agreement under which a public authority obtains specified services from a provider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务合同；此处指公共机构与服务提供方就服务内容及条件订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi s-servizzi li fornitur għandu jipprovdi u l-kundizzjonijiet tagħhom, hawnhekk għal awtorità pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A service contract sets out the services a provider will supply and the terms governing that supply.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务合同；此处指为公共机构提供约定服务的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt dwar il-provvista ta' servizzi skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma, f'dan il-kuntest lil awtorità pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A services contract is an agreement covering the provision of services under terms accepted by the parties.

collocations.en: be awarded a public service contract
collocations.zh: 获授公共服务采购合同

collocations.mt: it-tul ta' kuntratt pubbliku għal servizzi
collocations.en: the duration of a public service contract
collocations.zh: 公共服务采购合同的期限

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt pubbliku għal servizzi jispeċifika l-ħinijiet tat-tindif u l-obbligi tal-fornitur.
formal.en: The public service contract specifies the cleaning hours and the provider's obligations.
formal.zh: 该公共服务采购合同明确规定了清洁服务的时段及服务提供方的义务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jinkludi dan il-kuntratt pubbliku għal servizzi? David: It-tindif tal-uffiċċji tal-kunsill, ħames darbiet fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this public service contract cover? David: Cleaning the council offices five times a week.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份公共服务采购合同包括什么？David：每周五次的地方议会办公室清洁服务。

messages.speaker: Lara (采购部门新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jinkludi dan il-kuntratt pubbliku għal servizzi?
messages.mt_standard: X'jinkludi dan il-kuntratt pubbliku għal servizzi?
messages.zh: 这份公共服务采购合同包括什么？
messages.en: What does this public service contract cover?

messages.speaker: David (采购负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tindif tal-uffiċċji tal-kunsill, ħames darbiet fil-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tindif tal-uffiċċji tal-kunsill, ħames darbiet fil-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 每周五次的地方议会办公室清洁服务。
messages.en: Cleaning the council offices five times a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三段记：kuntratt 是合同，pubbliku 提示公共机构，għal servizzi 表示用于服务；联想议会购买办公室清洁服务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement that establishes general terms for later orders or contracts between the parties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先确定双方后续订单或合同所适用的一般条款的协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi kundizzjonijiet ġenerali għal ordnijiet jew kuntratti sussegwenti bejn il-partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 框架协议，即为双方后续订单或合同预先确定一般条款的协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi kundizzjonijiet ġenerali li l-partijiet jużaw bħala bażi għal ordnijiet jew kuntratti sussegwenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A framework agreement establishes general terms that the parties use as a basis for later orders or contracts.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 框架合同，即为后续具体交易预先设定总体条件的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi kundizzjonijiet ġenerali għal tranżazzjonijiet speċifiċi li l-partijiet jagħmlu aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A framework contract sets out general conditions intended to govern specific transactions that the parties arrange later.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt qafas jistabbilixxi l-prezzijiet u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-kunsinna għall-ordnijiet li jsiru matul is-sena.
formal.en: The framework contract establishes the prices and delivery terms for orders placed during the year.
formal.zh: 该框架合同为年内下达的订单确定价格及交付条件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Irridu nerġgħu naqblu fuq il-prezz għal kull ordni? Ġorġ: Le, il-prezzijiet diġà qegħdin fil-kuntratt qafas. Issa nagħżlu l-kwantità li għandna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do we need to agree on the price again for every order? Ġorġ: No, the prices are already in the framework contract. Now we choose the quantity we need.
colloquial.zh: Anna：每下一笔订单都要重新商定价格吗？Ġorġ：不用，价格已经写在框架合同里了。现在选好需要的数量就行。

messages.speaker: Anna (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu nerġgħu naqblu fuq il-prezz għal kull ordni?
messages.mt_standard: Irridu nerġgħu naqblu fuq il-prezz għal kull ordni?
messages.zh: 每下一笔订单都要重新商定价格吗？
messages.en: Do we need to agree on the price again for every order?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (采购主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-prezzijiet diġà qegħdin fil-kuntratt qafas. Issa nagħżlu l-kwantità li għandna bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-prezzijiet diġà qegħdin fil-kuntratt qafas. Issa nagħżlu l-kwantità li għandna bżonn.
messages.zh: 不用，价格已经写在框架合同里了。现在选好需要的数量就行。
messages.en: No, the prices are already in the framework contract. Now we choose the quantity we need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qafas 联系到框架：先搭好价格、交付等总体条件的架子，再把一次次具体订单放进去，帮助记住框架合同。

gloss_zh: 保留合同；限定特定类别经营者参与的合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract for which participation is restricted to a specified category of operators.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将参与资格限定于某一特定类别经营者的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li l-parteċipazzjoni fih tkun limitata għal kategorija speċifika ta' operaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仅允许特定类别经营者参与的保留合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li għalih jistgħu jipparteċipaw biss operaturi li jagħmlu parti minn kategorija speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reserved contract is a contract for which only operators belonging to a specified category may participate.

collocations.en: the conditions of a reserved contract

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispeċifika li dan huwa kuntratt riżervat u jiddeskrivi l-kategorija ta' operaturi li jistgħu jipparteċipaw.
formal.en: The document specifies that this is a reserved contract and describes the category of operators that may participate.
formal.zh: 文件明确指出，这是一份保留合同，并说明了可以参与的经营者类别。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu kuntratt riżervat? Mark: Iva, ejja naraw jekk l-organizzazzjoni tagħna tissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a reserved contract? Mark: Yes, let's see whether our organisation meets the conditions.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这是保留合同吗？Mark：是的，我们看看自己的机构是否符合条件。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu kuntratt riżervat?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu kuntratt riżervat?
messages.zh: 这是保留合同吗？
messages.en: Is this a reserved contract?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja naraw jekk l-organizzazzjoni tagħna tissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja naraw jekk l-organizzazzjoni tagħna tissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 是的，我们看看自己的机构是否符合条件。
messages.en: Yes, let's see whether our organisation meets the conditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语想成贴有“限定参与资格”标签的合同：kuntratt 是合同，riżervat 提醒你先核对参与类别。这里的“保留”不是替人暂存文件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract under which a public authority obtains goods, services, or works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共机构为取得货物、服务或工程而订立的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li bih awtorità pubblika tikseb oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采购合同；在本词条中，指公共机构为取得货物、服务或工程而订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt għax-xiri ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet, f'dan il-każ minn awtorità pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procurement contract sets out the terms for obtaining goods, services, or works, here for a public authority.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共合同；在本词条中，指公共机构采购货物、服务或工程的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt ta' awtorità pubblika li, f'dan il-kuntest, jirrigwarda l-akkwist ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public contract is a contract involving a public authority, here for the purchase of goods, services, or works.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购合同，即公共机构为采购货物、服务或工程而与供应方订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt bejn awtorità pubblika u fornitur għall-akkwist ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public procurement contract records an agreement through which a public authority purchases goods, services, or works from a supplier.

collocations.mt: l-għoti ta' kuntratt ta' akkwist pubbliku
collocations.en: the award of a public procurement contract

collocations.mt: il-valur ta' kuntratt ta' akkwist pubbliku
collocations.en: the value of a public procurement contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' akkwist pubbliku jispeċifika l-għadd ta' kompjuters li għandhom jiġu fornuti lill-iskola u d-data tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The public procurement contract specifies the number of computers to be supplied to the school and the delivery date.
formal.zh: 公共采购合同规定了应向学校供应的电脑数量及交货日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kuntratt ta' akkwist pubbliku għall-kompjuters lest? Pawlu: Kważi. Għad irridu nikkonfermaw id-data tal-kunsinna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the public procurement contract for the computers ready? Pawlu: Almost. We still need to confirm the delivery date.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电脑的公共采购合同准备好了吗？Pawlu：快好了。我们还需要确认交货日期。

messages.speaker: Lara (学校行政人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kuntratt ta' akkwist pubbliku għall-kompjuters lest?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kuntratt ta' akkwist pubbliku għall-kompjuters lest?
messages.zh: 电脑的公共采购合同准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the public procurement contract for the computers ready?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad irridu nikkonfermaw id-data tal-kunsinna.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad irridu nikkonfermaw id-data tal-kunsinna.
messages.zh: 快好了。我们还需要确认交货日期。
messages.en: Almost. We still need to confirm the delivery date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“学校采购电脑”的画面记整组词：kuntratt 对应合同，akkwist pubbliku 对应公共采购，ta' 把两部分连接成“公共采购的合同”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement setting out the terms on which a seller sells something to a buyer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定卖方向买方出售某物的条件的协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet li bihom bejjiegħ ibigħ xi ħaġa lil xerrej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 买卖合同，即约定出售标的、价款及其他买卖条件的协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim bejn bejjiegħ u xerrej li jistabbilixxi x'qiegħed jinbiegħ, il-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract of sale is an agreement that specifies what a seller will sell to a buyer and on what terms.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 销售合同，即载明卖方与买方之间销售交易条件的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jniżżel il-kundizzjonijiet ta' tranżazzjoni ta' bejgħ bejn bejjiegħ u xerrej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sales contract records the terms agreed between a seller and a buyer for a particular sale.

collocations.en: the terms of the sales contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' bejgħ jinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-karozza, il-prezz miftiehem u d-data li fiha x-xerrej se jirċeviha.
formal.en: The sales contract includes a description of the car, the agreed price, and the date on which the buyer will receive it.
formal.zh: 买卖合同包含车辆说明、商定的价格以及买方接收车辆的日期。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' bejgħ? David: Iva, imma rrid niċċekkja l-prezz għal darb'oħra qabel niffirma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you read the sales contract? David: Yes, but I want to check the price again before I sign.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你看过买卖合同了吗？David：看过了，不过签字前我想再核对一下价格。

messages.speaker: Marija (卖方)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' bejgħ?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' bejgħ?
messages.zh: 你看过买卖合同了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the sales contract?

messages.speaker: David (买方)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rrid niċċekkja l-prezz għal darb'oħra qabel niffirma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rrid niċċekkja l-prezz għal darb'oħra qabel niffirma.
messages.zh: 看过了，不过签字前我想再核对一下价格。
messages.en: Yes, but I want to check the price again before I sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“合同里写清卖什么、多少钱”的场景：kuntratt 是合同，bejgħ 是销售或买卖，kuntratt ta' bejgħ 就是约定买卖条件的合同。

gloss_zh: 消费者买卖合同；面向消费者的销售合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sales agreement between a business seller and a consumer buying for personal rather than business purposes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经营性卖方与出于个人生活用途购买商品的消费者之间订立的买卖协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim ta' bejgħ bejn bejjiegħ li jaġixxi fil-kummerċ tiegħu u konsumatur li jixtri għal skopijiet personali u mhux kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者买卖合同，即经营者向消费者出售供个人生活使用的商品时订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jirregola l-bejgħ ta' oġġetti minn bejjiegħ kummerċjali lil konsumatur li jixtrihom għall-użu personali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer sales contract is an agreement under which a business sells goods to a person buying them for personal use.

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt ta' bejgħ lil konsumatur
collocations.en: the terms of a consumer sales contract
collocations.zh: 消费者买卖合同的条款

collocations.mt: kopja tal-kuntratt ta' bejgħ lil konsumatur
collocations.en: a copy of the consumer sales contract
collocations.zh: 消费者买卖合同的副本

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' bejgħ lil konsumatur jiddeskrivi l-friġġ mixtri għall-użu fid-dar u jispeċifika l-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The consumer sales contract describes the refrigerator purchased for home use and specifies the price and delivery terms.
formal.zh: 消费者买卖合同说明了为家庭使用而购买的冰箱，并规定了价格和交货条件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' nieħu kopja tal-kuntratt ta' bejgħ lil konsumatur? Ġużeppi: Żgur. Hawn għandek il-kopja tiegħek, bid-dettalji tal-friġġ u tal-kunsinna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I have a copy of the consumer sales contract? Ġużeppi: Of course. Here is your copy, with the refrigerator and delivery details.
colloquial.zh: Anna：能给我一份消费者买卖合同的副本吗？Ġużeppi：当然。这是您的副本，里面有冰箱和交货的详细信息。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu kopja tal-kuntratt ta' bejgħ lil konsumatur?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu kopja tal-kuntratt ta' bejgħ lil konsumatur?
messages.zh: 能给我一份消费者买卖合同的副本吗？
messages.en: Can I have a copy of the consumer sales contract?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Hawn għandek il-kopja tiegħek, bid-dettalji tal-friġġ u tal-kunsinna.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Hawn għandek il-kopja tiegħek, bid-dettalji tal-friġġ u tal-kunsinna.
messages.zh: 当然。这是您的副本，里面有冰箱和交货的详细信息。
messages.en: Of course. Here is your copy, with the refrigerator and delivery details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 kuntratt ta' bejgħ 是“买卖合同”，再接 lil konsumatur“向消费者”。想象去商店买家用冰箱，就能记住整句强调的是卖给消费者的合同。

gloss_zh: 设计合同；设计服务合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract that sets out the design work to be provided and the conditions agreed by the parties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定所需设计工作及双方约定条件的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi x-xogħol ta' disinn li għandu jsir u l-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma bejn il-partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约定设计工作内容及相关条件的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jiddeskrivi x-xogħol ta' disinn meħtieġ u jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet li jaċċettaw il-partijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract for design is an agreement specifying the design services someone will provide and the conditions under which they will provide them.

collocations.en: the terms of the design contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' disinn jispeċifika li d-disinjatriċi għandha tippreżenta tliet proposti għall-logo sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The design contract specifies that the designer must present three logo proposals by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 设计合同规定，设计师须在月底前提交三个标志设计方案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' disinn? Mark: Iva, imma kemm-il darba nista' nitlob tibdil? Lara: Żewġ darbiet, kif hemm miktub fil-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you read the design contract? Mark: Yes, but how many times can I request changes? Lara: Twice, as stated in the contract.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看过设计合同了吗？马克：看过了，不过我可以要求修改几次？拉拉：两次，合同里写明了。

messages.speaker: Lara (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' disinn?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' disinn?
messages.zh: 你看过设计合同了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the design contract?

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma kemm-il darba nista' nitlob tibdil?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma kemm-il darba nista' nitlob tibdil?
messages.zh: 看过了，不过我可以要求修改几次？
messages.en: Yes, but how many times can I request changes?

messages.speaker: Lara (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ darbiet, kif hemm miktub fil-kuntratt.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ darbiet, kif hemm miktub fil-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 两次，合同里写明了。
messages.en: Twice, as stated in the contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“设计稿旁放着合同”的画面：kuntratt 提醒你想到合同，disinn 提醒你想到设计，一起记住“设计合同”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement setting out the conditions under which a distributor supplies or sells a supplier's products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定分销商供应或销售供应方产品时所遵循条件的协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet li bihom distributur iqassam jew ibigħ il-prodotti ta' fornitur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定供应方与分销商之间产品分销安排及双方责任的协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim bejn fornitur u distributur li jiddeskrivi kif għandhom jitqassmu jew jinbiegħu l-prodotti u x'inhuma r-responsabbiltajiet taż-żewġ partijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution agreement is an arrangement between a supplier and a distributor that sets out how products will be distributed or sold.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载明产品分销条件以及供应方与分销商各自义务的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għad-distribuzzjoni ta' prodotti u l-obbligi tal-fornitur u tad-distributur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution contract is a contract specifying the conditions and responsibilities involved when a distributor handles a supplier's products.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' distribuzzjoni jistabbilixxi ż-żona fejn id-distributur jista' jbigħ il-prodotti u l-iskeda tal-kunsinni.
formal.en: The distribution agreement specifies the area in which the distributor may sell the products and the delivery schedule.
formal.zh: 分销协议规定了分销商可以销售产品的区域以及交货时间表。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Wasallek il-kuntratt ta' distribuzzjoni? Pawlu: Iva. Nistgħu nbigħu l-prodotti f'Għawdex ukoll? Nina: Iva, Għawdex hu inkluż fil-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you received the distribution agreement? Pawlu: Yes. Can we sell the products in Gozo too? Nina: Yes, Gozo is included in the agreement.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你收到分销协议了吗？保罗：收到了。我们也可以在戈佐岛销售这些产品吗？妮娜：可以，协议也涵盖戈佐岛。

messages.mt_standard: Wasallek il-kuntratt ta' distribuzzjoni?
messages.zh: 你收到分销协议了吗？
messages.en: Have you received the distribution agreement?

messages.mt_standard: Iva. Nistgħu nbigħu l-prodotti f'Għawdex ukoll?
messages.zh: 收到了。我们也可以在戈佐岛销售这些产品吗？
messages.en: Yes. Can we sell the products in Gozo too?
