messages.mt_standard: Iva, Għawdex hu inkluż fil-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 可以，协议也涵盖戈佐岛。
messages.en: Yes, Gozo is included in the agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象供应商、分销商和商店之间的产品流转图，旁边放着 kuntratt ta' distribuzzjoni；用“产品如何分销，由协议写清”记住整条短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract recording an agreement to give money, property, or other assets to another person or organization without payment in return.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记载向他人或机构无偿赠送钱款、财产或其他资产之约定的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jirreġistra ftehim biex persuna jew organizzazzjoni tagħti flus, proprjetà jew assi oħra lil ħaddieħor mingħajr ħlas lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约定将钱款、财产或其他资产无偿给予他人或机构的赠与或捐赠合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi x'għandu jingħata bħala donazzjoni, min jagħtih, min jirċevih u l-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract for donation is an agreement recording what someone will give to another person or organization without receiving payment in return.

collocations.en: the terms of the donation contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' donazzjoni jidentifika l-għaxar kompjuters li l-kumpanija se tagħti lill-iskola mingħajr ħlas.
formal.en: The donation contract identifies the ten computers that the company will give to the school free of charge.
formal.zh: 捐赠合同列明了公司将无偿赠予学校的十台电脑。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-kuntratt ta' donazzjoni lest? David: Kważi. Għad irrid inżid il-lista tal-kotba. Rita: Tajjeb, nibgħathielek illum.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the donation contract ready? David: Almost. I still need to add the list of books. Rita: All right, I'll send it to you today.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：捐赠合同准备好了吗？戴维：差不多了。我还得加上书籍清单。丽塔：好的，我今天发给你。

messages.speaker: Rita (捐赠者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kuntratt ta' donazzjoni lest?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kuntratt ta' donazzjoni lest?
messages.zh: 捐赠合同准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the donation contract ready?

messages.speaker: David (图书馆职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad irrid inżid il-lista tal-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad irrid inżid il-lista tal-kotba.
messages.zh: 差不多了。我还得加上书籍清单。
messages.en: Almost. I still need to add the list of books.

messages.speaker: Rita (捐赠者)

messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nibgħathielek illum.
messages.zh: 好的，我今天发给你。
messages.en: All right, I'll send it to you today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuntratt ta' donazzjoni 和“赠送一箱书，并附上书面约定”的场景一起记：合同记录谁赠送、谁接收以及赠送什么。

gloss_zh: 特许经营协议；特许经营合同；加盟合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement allowing a business to use another business's name and operating system under specified conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许一家企业按照约定条件使用另一家企业的商业名称及经营体系的协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jippermetti lil negozju juża l-isem kummerċjali u s-sistema operattiva ta' negozju ieħor skont kundizzjonijiet speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约定加盟经营者使用特许方商业名称及经营体系之条件的特许经营协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim li jagħti lil operatur id-dritt li juża l-isem kummerċjali u s-sistema ta' negozju ieħor skont il-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A franchise agreement is an agreement allowing an operator to run a business using another company's name and business system under agreed conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载明特许经营授权范围以及特许方与加盟经营者各自义务的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi l-limiti tal-permess biex operatur juża l-isem u s-sistema ta' negozju ieħor, kif ukoll l-obbligi taż-żewġ partijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A franchise contract is a contract setting out an operator's permission to use a company's business identity and system, together with each party's obligations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定以特许经营方式使用他人商业名称及经营体系之安排与条件的协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim li jirregola arranġament fejn negozju jippermetti lil operatur ieħor juża l-isem kummerċjali u s-sistema tiegħu skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A franchising agreement is an agreement governing an arrangement in which one business permits another operator to use its name and methods of operation.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' franchising jistabbilixxi kif l-operatur jista' juża l-isem tal-marka u liema standards għandu jsegwi fil-ħanut.
formal.en: The franchise agreement sets out how the operator may use the brand name and which standards must be followed in the shop.
formal.zh: 特许经营协议规定了经营者可以如何使用品牌名称，以及店铺须遵循哪些标准。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' franchising għall-ħanut il-ġdid? Simon: Iva. It-taħriġ hu inkluż? Marta: Iva, il-kumpanija se tagħtina taħriġ qabel niftħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you read the franchise agreement for the new shop? Simon: Yes. Is training included? Marta: Yes, the company will give us training before we open.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看过新店的特许经营协议了吗？西蒙：看过了。里面包括培训吗？玛尔塔：包括，公司会在开业前给我们培训。

messages.speaker: Marta (加盟店合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' franchising għall-ħanut il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kuntratt ta' franchising għall-ħanut il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你看过新店的特许经营协议了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the franchise agreement for the new shop?

messages.speaker: Simon (加盟店合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. It-taħriġ hu inkluż?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. It-taħriġ hu inkluż?
messages.zh: 看过了。里面包括培训吗？
messages.en: Yes. Is training included?

messages.speaker: Marta (加盟店合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kumpanija se tagħtina taħriġ qabel niftħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kumpanija se tagħtina taħriġ qabel niftħu.
messages.zh: 包括，公司会在开业前给我们培训。
messages.en: Yes, the company will give us training before we open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新店挂上品牌招牌，店主正在阅读 kuntratt ta' franchising；把“使用品牌、遵循经营体系、签订加盟合同”连成一个画面来记。

gloss_zh: 特许经营合同；特许权合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract granting a person or organisation the right to operate a service or use a resource under agreed conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 授予个人或机构在约定条件下经营某项服务或使用某项资源的权利的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jagħti lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni d-dritt li tmexxi servizz jew tuża riżorsa skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特许经营安排，即授予一方在规定条件下经营服务或使用资源的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li permezz tiegħu parti tingħata d-dritt li tmexxi servizz jew tuża riżorsa skont kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concession is an arrangement that gives someone the right to operate a service or use a resource under specified conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定特许经营权或特许使用权及相关条件的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jistabbilixxi d-drittijiet u l-kundizzjonijiet biex parti tmexxi servizz jew tuża riżorsa b'konċessjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concession contract sets out the rights and conditions under which a party may operate a service or use a resource.

collocations.en: the terms of the concession contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' konċessjoni jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għat-tmexxija tal-parkeġġ għal għaxar snin.
formal.en: The concession contract sets out the conditions for operating the car park for ten years.
formal.zh: 该特许经营合同规定了为期十年的停车场经营条件。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min se jmexxi l-parkeġġ il-ġdid? Pawlu: Il-kumpanija li ffirmat il-kuntratt ta' konċessjoni.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who will run the new car park? Pawlu: The company that signed the concession contract.
colloquial.zh: Marta：谁来经营新停车场？Pawlu：签了特许经营合同的那家公司。

messages.speaker: Marta (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jmexxi l-parkeġġ il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jmexxi l-parkeġġ il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 谁来经营新停车场？
messages.en: Who will run the new car park?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija li ffirmat il-kuntratt ta' konċessjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija li ffirmat il-kuntratt ta' konċessjoni.
messages.zh: 签了特许经营合同的那家公司。
messages.en: The company that signed the concession contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词组记成“获准经营的合同”：想象停车场经营者拿着合同领取经营许可，借助场景记住特许经营之义。

gloss_zh: 供应合同；公共采购供货合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract under which a supplier agrees to provide specified goods to a buyer on agreed terms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供应商按照约定条件向采购方提供指定货物的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li permezz tiegħu fornitur jaqbel li jipprovdi oġġetti speċifikati lil xerrej skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购供货合同，即供应商向公共机构提供货物的采购合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt ta' akkwist li permezz tiegħu fornitur jipprovdi oġġetti lil entità pubblika skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public supply contract is an agreement under which a supplier provides goods to a public body on agreed terms.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应合同，即规定供应商向采购方提供货物及相关条件的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi liema oġġetti fornitur għandu jipprovdi lil xerrej u taħt liema kundizzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supply contract sets out the goods a supplier will provide to a buyer and the conditions governing their supply.

collocations.en: a contract for the supply of equipment

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' provvista jistabbilixxi l-kwantità tal-oġġetti, il-prezz u d-dati tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The supply contract sets out the quantity of goods, the price and the delivery dates.
formal.zh: 该供应合同规定了货物数量、价格和交货日期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-fornitur se jibgħatilna l-karta kull xahar? David: Iva, hekk jgħid il-kuntratt ta' provvista.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will the supplier send us paper every month? David: Yes, that is what the supply contract says.
colloquial.zh: Nina：供应商会每个月给我们送纸吗？David：会，供应合同就是这么写的。

messages.speaker: Nina (办公室职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fornitur se jibgħatilna l-karta kull xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Il-fornitur se jibgħatilna l-karta kull xahar?
messages.zh: 供应商会每个月给我们送纸吗？
messages.en: Will the supplier send us paper every month?

messages.speaker: David (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk jgħid il-kuntratt ta' provvista.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk jgħid il-kuntratt ta' provvista.
messages.zh: 会，供应合同就是这么写的。
messages.en: Yes, that is what the supply contract says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办公室按月收纸，合同写清“供什么、多少、何时送”；用这三个问题记住供应合同，在公共机构采购场景中再联系公共供货义。

gloss_zh: 公共采购供货合同；公共供应合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract under which a supplier agrees to provide specified goods to a public body on agreed terms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供应商按照约定条件向公共机构提供指定货物的公共采购合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt li permezz tiegħu fornitur jaqbel li jipprovdi oġġetti speċifikati lil entità pubblika skont kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购供货合同，指公共机构为取得货物而与供应商订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt bejn entità pubblika u fornitur għall-akkwist ta' oġġetti skont kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public supply contract is an agreement through which a public body obtains goods from a supplier on specified terms.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应合同；在此词组的公共采购语境中，指向公共机构供货的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt għall-provvista ta' oġġetti lil xerrej, li f'dan il-kuntest ikun entità pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supply contract governs the provision of goods to a buyer, which in this context is a public body.

collocations.en: be awarded a public supply contract
collocations.zh: 获授公共采购供货合同

collocations.en: the conditions of the public supply contract
collocations.zh: 公共采购供货合同的条件

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' provvista pubblika jipprevedi l-kunsinna ta' mitt kompjuter lill-iskejjel tal-istat.
formal.en: The public supply contract provides for the delivery of one hundred computers to state schools.
formal.zh: 该公共采购供货合同规定向公立学校交付一百台电脑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kunsill diġà ordna s-siġġijiet il-ġodda? Toni: Iva, iffirma kuntratt ta' provvista pubblika mal-fornitur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the council already ordered the new chairs? Toni: Yes, it signed a public supply contract with the supplier.
colloquial.zh: Sara：地方议会已经订购新椅子了吗？Toni：是的，已经和供应商签了公共采购供货合同。

messages.speaker: Sara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunsill diġà ordna s-siġġijiet il-ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunsill diġà ordna s-siġġijiet il-ġodda?
messages.zh: 地方议会已经订购新椅子了吗？
messages.en: Has the council already ordered the new chairs?

messages.speaker: Toni (地方议会职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iffirma kuntratt ta' provvista pubblika mal-fornitur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iffirma kuntratt ta' provvista pubblika mal-fornitur.
messages.zh: 是的，已经和供应商签了公共采购供货合同。
messages.en: Yes, it signed a public supply contract with the supplier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把场景固定为“公共机构买货”：学校买电脑、地方议会买椅子。看到词组末尾的 pubblika，就提醒自己这里的采购方是公共机构。

gloss_zh: 服务合同；公共服务合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement setting out the services to be provided and the conditions under which they are provided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定应提供哪些服务及其提供条件的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi liema servizzi għandhom jingħataw u l-kundizzjonijiet li bihom jingħataw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 委托一方提供约定服务的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim li permezz tiegħu parti tintrabat li tipprovdi servizzi miftiehma lil parti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract for services is an agreement under which one party undertakes to provide specified services to another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就提供面向公众的服务而订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim dwar il-provvista ta' servizzi lill-pubbliku, li jistabbilixxi l-obbligi tal-partijiet involuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public service contract sets out the arrangements and obligations for providing a service to the public.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定某项服务的内容及履行条件的服务合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt li jispeċifika servizz li għandu jingħata u l-kundizzjonijiet għall-għoti tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A service contract specifies what service will be provided and the terms that apply to its delivery.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定一项或多项服务的提供安排及双方责任的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim dwar l-għoti ta' servizz wieħed jew aktar u r-responsabbiltajiet tal-partijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A services contract records the agreed services and explains what each party is responsible for.

collocations.en: the terms of the service contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' servizz jistabbilixxi l-ħlas, it-tul tal-ftehim u s-servizzi li għandha tipprovdi l-kumpanija.
formal.en: The service contract specifies the payment, the duration of the agreement, and the services the company must provide.
formal.zh: 服务合同规定了费用、协议期限以及公司应提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Wasallek il-kuntratt ta' servizz? Lara: Iva, se naqrah qabel niffirmah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you received the service contract? Lara: Yes, I'll read it before I sign it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你收到服务合同了吗？拉拉：收到了，我会先读一遍再签。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasallek il-kuntratt ta' servizz?
messages.mt_standard: Wasallek il-kuntratt ta' servizz?
messages.zh: 你收到服务合同了吗？
messages.en: Have you received the service contract?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se naqrah qabel niffirmah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se naqrah qabel niffirmah.
messages.zh: 收到了，我会先读一遍再签。
messages.en: Yes, I'll read it before I sign it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“签服务合同”的场景绑定：kuntratt 对应合同，ta' servizz 提示服务内容；联想签字前核对服务、费用和期限。

gloss_zh: 公共工程合同；工程合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement setting out the construction or other works to be carried out for a public project.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定公共项目中应实施的建筑或其他工程及相关条件的合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li jistabbilixxi x-xogħlijiet ta' kostruzzjoni jew xogħlijiet oħra li għandhom isiru għal proġett pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就道路、公共建筑等公共工程的实施而订立的合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt għall-eżekuzzjoni ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi, bħall-bini ta' toroq jew ta' bini pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public works contract sets out the work and conditions for carrying out a public construction project.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约定实施建筑、修缮等工程的合同；本词条所指为公共工程合同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim għall-eżekuzzjoni ta' xogħlijiet, bħall-bini jew it-tiswija; f'din l-espressjoni, ix-xogħlijiet huma pubbliċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A works contract is an agreement to carry out construction or similar work, here involving a public project.

collocations.en: the value of the public works contract

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi għat-tiswija tal-pont jistabbilixxi meta għandhom jitlestew ix-xogħlijiet.
formal.en: The public works contract for repairing the bridge specifies when the work must be completed.
formal.zh: 该桥梁修缮公共工程合同规定了工程必须完成的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ġie ffirmat il-kuntratt ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi għall-pont? Pawlu: Iva, u x-xogħol se jibda x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the public works contract for the bridge been signed? Pawlu: Yes, and the work will start next month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桥梁的公共工程合同签了吗？保罗：签了，工程下个月开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie ffirmat il-kuntratt ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi għall-pont?
messages.mt_standard: Ġie ffirmat il-kuntratt ta' xogħlijiet pubbliċi għall-pont?
messages.zh: 桥梁的公共工程合同签了吗？
messages.en: Has the public works contract for the bridge been signed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u x-xogħol se jibda x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u x-xogħol se jibda x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 签了，工程下个月开始。
messages.en: Yes, and the work will start next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“修公共桥梁时签的合同”记住整个短语：kuntratt 是合同，xogħlijiet 提示工程，pubbliċi 提示公共；把合同、工程、公共三个意义串起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A financial contract to buy or sell a specified asset at an agreed price on a specified future date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 约定在未来指定日期按商定价格买入或卖出某项资产的金融合约。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuntratt finanzjarju għax-xiri jew il-bejgħ ta' assi speċifikat bi prezz miftiehem f'data futura speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 期货合约，金融语境中指约定未来交易日期与价格的合约。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kuntratt finanzjarju li jistabbilixxi x-xiri jew il-bejgħ ta' assi bi prezz miftiehem f'data futura speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A future is a financial contract to buy or sell an asset at an agreed price on a specified future date.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 期货合约，即规定在未来指定日期按约定价格买卖指定资产的金融合约。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim finanzjarju li jobbliga lill-partijiet jixtru u jbigħu assi speċifikat bi prezz miftiehem f'data futura speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A futures contract commits the parties to a transaction involving a specified asset at an agreed price on a future date.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt tal-futuri jispeċifika l-assi, il-prezz miftiehem u d-data futura tat-tranżazzjoni.
formal.en: The futures contract specifies the asset, the agreed price and the future transaction date.
formal.zh: 该期货合约列明了交易资产、约定价格和未来的交易日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu kuntratt tal-futuri? Mark: Huwa ftehim biex tixtri jew tbigħ assi f'data futura bi prezz miftiehem minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a futures contract? Mark: It is an agreement to buy or sell an asset on a future date at a price agreed in advance.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么是期货合约？Mark：就是约好在未来某个日期，以事先商定的价格买卖某项资产的协议。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu kuntratt tal-futuri?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu kuntratt tal-futuri?
messages.zh: 什么是期货合约？
messages.en: What is a futures contract?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ftehim biex tixtri jew tbigħ assi f'data futura bi prezz miftiehem minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ftehim biex tixtri jew tbigħ assi f'data futura bi prezz miftiehem minn qabel.
messages.zh: 就是约好在未来某个日期，以事先商定的价格买卖某项资产的协议。
messages.en: It is an agreement to buy or sell an asset on a future date at a price agreed in advance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“今天定价，未来交易”的画面记住期货合约；本词条里的英文 future 是金融名词，学习时要与普通的“未来”义分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that agrees to carry out work under a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据合同承接并实施约定工作的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tintrabat b'kuntratt li twettaq xogħol miftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按合同承接工程或其他工作的承包人或承包公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li taċċetta li twettaq xogħol għal ħaddieħor skont kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contractor is a person or company hired to carry out work under an agreed contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组织土地或房产开发，通过建造或改造物业供出售或出租的个人或公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li torganizza l-iżvilupp ta' art jew proprjetà billi tibni jew tirranġa bini għall-bejgħ jew għall-kiri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A property developer organizes the construction or improvement of property intended for sale or rental.

collocations.zh: 从事房地产开发的承包商

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur għandu jlesti t-tiswijiet skont il-kundizzjonijiet u l-iskadenzi stabbiliti fil-kuntratt.
formal.en: The contractor must complete the repairs in accordance with the conditions and deadlines specified in the contract.
formal.zh: 承包商须按照合同规定的条件和期限完成修缮工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sibt kuntrattur biex isewwi s-saqaf? Mark: Iva, se jiġi għada biex jara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you found a contractor to repair the roof? Mark: Yes, he's coming tomorrow to look at the job.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你找到修屋顶的承包商了吗？马克：找到了，他明天来看看要做哪些活。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt kuntrattur biex isewwi s-saqaf?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt kuntrattur biex isewwi s-saqaf?
messages.zh: 你找到修屋顶的承包商了吗？
messages.en: Have you found a contractor to repair the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jiġi għada biex jara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jiġi għada biex jara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 找到了，他明天来看看要做哪些活。
messages.en: Yes, he's coming tomorrow to look at the job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工地门口负责接活的人来记 kuntrattur：谈合同施工时译“承包商”，谈开发房产出售或出租时译“开发商”，依具体活动判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A public performance in which musicians or singers present music to an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 音乐家或歌手向现场观众演奏或演唱音乐的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wirja mużikali li fiha mużiċisti jew kantanti jdoqqu jew ikantaw quddiem udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音乐会，指音乐家或歌手为观众进行现场音乐表演的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avveniment li fih mużiċisti jew kantanti jippreżentaw il-mużika tagħhom quddiem udjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concert is an event at which musicians or singers perform music for an audience.

collocations.zh: 参加音乐会；去听音乐会

formal.mt: Il-kunċert se jsir fit-teatru nhar is-Sibt u se jibda fit-tmienja ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The concert will take place at the theatre on Saturday and will begin at eight in the evening.
formal.zh: 音乐会将于星期六在剧院举行，晚上八点开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-kunċert illejla? Leon: Iva! Għad hemm biljetti? Maja: Iva, nistgħu nixtruhom online.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come to the concert with me tonight? Leon: Yes! Are there still tickets available? Maja: Yes, we can buy them online.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚想和我一起去听音乐会吗？Leon：想！还有票吗？Maja：有，我们可以在网上买。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-kunċert illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi miegħi għall-kunċert illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚想和我一起去听音乐会吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the concert with me tonight?

messages.speaker: Leon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Għad hemm biljetti?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Għad hemm biljetti?
messages.zh: 想！还有票吗？
messages.en: Yes! Are there still tickets available?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nixtruhom online.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nixtruhom online.
messages.zh: 有，我们可以在网上买。
messages.en: Yes, we can buy them online.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kunċert 和“舞台、乐手、门票”三个画面一起记：看到 biljetti għall-kunċert，就想到购买音乐会门票。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An abstract idea used to understand, describe, or organize something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于理解、描述或组织事物的抽象想法或一般性观念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea astratta jew ġenerali li tintuża biex wieħed jifhem, jiddeskrivi jew jorganizza xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 概念，指帮助人们理解某类事物、现象或关系的抽象观念。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idea ġenerali jew astratta li tgħin biex wieħed jifhem xi ħaġa jew jaħseb dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A concept is a general or abstract idea that helps people understand or think about something.

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jispjega l-kunċett ta' ugwaljanza permezz ta' eżempji mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: This chapter explains the concept of equality through examples from everyday life.
formal.zh: 本章通过日常生活中的例子解释平等的概念。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-kunċett. Mark: Trid nispjegah b'eżempju? Sara: Iva, hekk ikun iktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Sara: I still haven't understood this concept. Mark: Would you like me to explain it with an example? Sara: Yes, that would make it clearer.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我还是没理解这个概念。Mark：要我用一个例子来解释吗？Sara：好，那样会更清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-kunċett.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-kunċett.
messages.zh: 我还是没理解这个概念。
messages.en: I still haven't understood this concept.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nispjegah b'eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nispjegah b'eżempju?
messages.zh: 要我用一个例子来解释吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to explain it with an example?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk ikun iktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk ikun iktar ċar.
messages.zh: 好，那样会更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, that would make it clearer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kunċett 想成脑中的“概念卡片”：正面写抽象名称，背面写具体例子。注意它结尾是 tt，与表示音乐会的 kunċert 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Attention and help given to someone or something, especially to protect health or improve a medical condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为照顾某人或某物而给予的关照和帮助，尤指维护健康或改善病情的护理与治疗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attenzjoni u l-għajnuna mogħtija lil persuna jew ħaġa, speċjalment biex titħares is-saħħa jew titjieb kundizzjoni medika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为满足某人或某物的需要、维护其健康或良好状态而给予的照料与关怀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attenzjoni u l-għajnuna mogħtija biex jiġu ssodisfati l-ħtiġijiet ta' persuna jew ħaġa u jinżamm il-ġid tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Care is the attention and help you give someone or something to meet their needs and maintain their wellbeing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够治愈某种疾病或消除某种病症的药物、疗法或办法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rimedju jew mezz li jista' jneħħi marda jew kundizzjoni medika u jwassal għall-fejqan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cure is a medicine or method that can remove a disease or medical condition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为缓解症状、改善病情或促进康复而实施的医疗处置或疗程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' mediċini, terapiji jew proċeduri biex jittaffew is-sintomi, titjieb il-kundizzjoni jew jinkiseb il-fejqan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Treatment is the use of medicines or other medical methods to relieve symptoms or improve a person's condition.

collocations.en: a cure or treatment for the disease
collocations.zh: 针对该疾病的治愈方法或治疗

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kura li rċieva l-pazjent matul iż-żjara tiegħu fl-isptar.
formal.en: The report describes the care the patient received during his stay in hospital.
formal.zh: 该报告描述了患者住院期间接受的照护。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tabib spjegalek il-kura? Pawlu: Iva, spjegali kollox u tani l-istruzzjonijiet bil-miktub.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the doctor explain the treatment to you? Pawlu: Yes, he explained everything and gave me written instructions.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：医生给你解释治疗方案了吗？保罗：解释了，他把所有事项都说清楚了，还给了我书面说明。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabib spjegalek il-kura?
messages.mt_standard: It-tabib spjegalek il-kura?
messages.zh: 医生给你解释治疗方案了吗？
messages.en: Did the doctor explain the treatment to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, spjegali kollox u tani l-istruzzjonijiet bil-miktub.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, spjegali kollox u tani l-istruzzjonijiet bil-miktub.
messages.zh: 解释了，他把所有事项都说清楚了，还给了我书面说明。
messages.en: Yes, he explained everything and gave me written instructions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 kura：照顾植物是“照料”，医生安排疗程是“治疗”，能够消除疾病的方法是“治愈方法”；阅读时根据对象和结果区分三个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin cord, string, ribbon, or narrow tape used for tying, fastening, or decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捆扎、固定或装饰的细绳、线绳、丝带或窄带，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel irqiq, ħajta jew strixxa dejqa ta' materjal li tintuża biex torbot, twaħħal jew iżżejjen xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捆扎或固定物品的细绳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħabel irqiq li jintuża biex jintrabtu jew jinżammu f'posthom oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cord is a thin rope that you use to tie or secure things.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于装饰或系扎的丝带、缎带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa dejqa ta' drapp li tintuża biex iżżejjen jew torbot xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ribbon is a narrow strip of fabric used for decoration or tying things.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由纤维等制成、可用于系扎的细线绳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħajta rqiqa magħmula minn fibri mibrumin flimkien, li tista' tintuża biex torbot xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: String is thin twisted material that you use to tie things together.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捆扎、固定等用途的窄条带子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa dejqa u ċatta ta' materjal li tintuża biex torbot jew iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tape is a narrow flat strip of material used for binding or fastening things.

collocations.en: to tie a parcel with string

formal.mt: Il-pakkett għandu jintrabat b'kurdiċella biex jibqa' magħluq waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The parcel should be tied with string to keep it closed during transport.
formal.zh: 包裹应当用线绳捆好，以便在运输过程中保持封闭。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek kurdiċella biex norbot dan ir-rigal? Nina: Iva, ħu din il-ħamra. Taqbel mal-karta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have a ribbon so I can tie up this present? Nina: Yes, take this red one. It matches the paper.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你有丝带吗？我想把这份礼物扎起来。妮娜：有，拿这条红色的吧，和包装纸很配。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek kurdiċella biex norbot dan ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek kurdiċella biex norbot dan ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你有丝带吗？我想把这份礼物扎起来。
messages.en: Do you have a ribbon so I can tie up this present?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din il-ħamra. Taqbel mal-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din il-ħamra. Taqbel mal-karta.
messages.zh: 有，拿这条红色的吧，和包装纸很配。
messages.en: Yes, take this red one. It matches the paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用 kurdiċella 扎礼物：圆细的可理解为绳或线，扁平的可理解为丝带或窄带；结合材质与用途选择中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long passage inside a building that connects rooms or other areas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物内部连接不同房间或区域的狭长通道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ twil ġewwa bini li jgħaqqad kmamar jew partijiet differenti tal-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物内连接各房间或区域的走廊、过道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Passaġġ ġewwa bini li minnu wieħed jista' jasal fi kmamar jew żoni differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corridor is a passage inside a building with doors leading to different rooms.

collocations.en: at the end of the corridor

formal.mt: Il-kuritur għandu jinżamm ħieles minn kull ostaklu biex ikun hemm aċċess sigur għall-kmamar.
formal.en: The corridor must be kept clear of all obstructions to ensure safe access to the rooms.
formal.zh: 走廊必须保持畅通，不得堆放障碍物，以确保人们能够安全进出各个房间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-kamra tal-laqgħat? Rita: Imxi tul il-kuritur. Hija l-aħħar kamra fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the meeting room? Rita: Walk along the corridor. It is the last room on the left.
colloquial.zh: 马克：会议室在哪里？丽塔：沿着走廊走，就是左边最后一个房间。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-kamra tal-laqgħat?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-kamra tal-laqgħat?
messages.zh: 会议室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the meeting room?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Imxi tul il-kuritur. Hija l-aħħar kamra fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Imxi tul il-kuritur. Hija l-aħħar kamra fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 沿着走廊走，就是左边最后一个房间。
messages.en: Walk along the corridor. It is the last room on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 kuritur 时，想象一条两侧都有房门的长走廊，再配合短语 tul il-kuritur，表示沿着走廊。

gloss_zh: 释义未明；给定英文标签为 calange

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labeled 'calange', with no clear meaning or grammatical category specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英文标签为 calange 的词条，目前无法确定其具体含义和词性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija entrata bit-tikketta 'calange', iżda t-tifsira preċiża u l-kategorija grammatikali tagħha mhumiex speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仅标注为 calange，具体含义不明确，不能据此确定中文对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-entrata għandha t-tikketta 'calange', li waħedha ma tagħtix tifsira ċara biżżejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry carries the label 'calange', which does not establish a clear meaning on its own.

kurjuza 的含义（用于询问词义）

formal.zh: 在句子中使用 kurjuza 这一词形之前，我们需要先弄清它的含义。

colloquial.zh: Maja：kurjuza 是什么意思？Pawlu：我还不知道。我们先弄清词义再使用吧。

gloss_zh: 好奇的；奇怪而引人注意的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wanting to know or learn about something, or unusual enough to attract interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想了解或弄清某件事的；也可形容事物不寻常、令人感到好奇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixtieq ikun jaf jew jitgħallem aktar dwar xi ħaġa, jew li jkun mhux tas-soltu u jqajjem interess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好奇的，想知道更多的；也可指不寻常而引人好奇的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu xewqa li jsir jaf aktar dwar xi ħaġa, jew li jidher stramb u jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is curious, they want to learn more; something curious is unusual and attracts interest.

formal.mt: L-istudent kien kurjuż dwar kif jaħdem il-mikroskopju u talab lill-għalliem jispjegalu.
formal.en: The student was curious about how the microscope worked and asked the teacher to explain it to him.
formal.zh: 这名学生很好奇显微镜是怎样工作的，于是请老师为他讲解。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tistaqsi tant mistoqsijiet? Mark: Għax jien kurjuż! Irrid nifhem kif jaħdem dan l-arloġġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you asking so many questions? Mark: Because I am curious! I want to understand how this clock works.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么问这么多问题？马克：因为我好奇呀！我想弄明白这个钟是怎么工作的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistaqsi tant mistoqsijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistaqsi tant mistoqsijiet?
messages.zh: 你为什么问这么多问题？
messages.en: Why are you asking so many questions?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien kurjuż! Irrid nifhem kif jaħdem dan l-arloġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien kurjuż! Irrid nifhem kif jaħdem dan l-arloġġ.
messages.zh: 因为我好奇呀！我想弄明白这个钟是怎么工作的。
messages.en: Because I am curious! I want to understand how this clock works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kurjuż 配上一个不断问为什么的人来记：形容人时是好奇，形容案例等事物时可以是奇特、令人好奇。

gloss_zh: 衣物搭钩；用于扣合衣服的小钩

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hook used to fasten a garment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装在衣物上、通过钩住相应部件来扣合衣服的小钩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ganċ żgħir li jintuża biex jagħlaq jew iżomm magħluqa biċċa ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于扣合衣物的搭钩或小钩。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ganċ li jitwaħħal ma' biċċa ħwejjeġ u jintuża biex iżommha magħluqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kurkett is a small hook that holds a garment closed.

collocations.en: to fasten the coat with a hook

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat waħħal kurkett żgħir mal-kullar tal-kowt biex iżommu magħluq.
formal.en: The tailor attached a small hook to the coat collar to keep it closed.
formal.zh: 裁缝在外套领口装了一个小搭钩，用来扣住领口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħlaq il-kurkett tal-libsa tiegħi? Lara: Iva, żgur. Żomm ftit, għax hu żgħir ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you fasten the hook on my dress? Lara: Yes, of course. Hold still for a moment; it's very small.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能帮我扣上连衣裙的搭钩吗？Lara：当然可以。先别动，这个钩子很小。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħlaq il-kurkett tal-libsa tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħlaq il-kurkett tal-libsa tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你能帮我扣上连衣裙的搭钩吗？
messages.en: Can you fasten the hook on my dress?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żgur. Żomm ftit, għax hu żgħir ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żgur. Żomm ftit, għax hu żgħir ħafna.
messages.zh: 当然可以。先别动，这个钩子很小。

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kurkett 时想象领口的小搭钩：轻轻一钩，衣服扣好，把词和扣衣动作一起记。

gloss_zh: 妻子有婚外性关系的丈夫；戴绿帽子的男人（贬义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man whose wife has a sexual relationship with someone else, often referred to insultingly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指妻子与他人发生婚外性关系的丈夫，常带有侮辱或嘲弄意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li martu jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' xi ħadd ieħor; il-kelma spiss tintuża bħala insult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妻子与他人发生婚外性关系的丈夫；常用作贬损性的称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raġel li martu jkollha relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ; dan l-isem jista' jintuża biex jinsulta jew iwaqqa' għaċ-ċajt lir-raġel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cuckold is a man whose wife has a sexual relationship with someone else, and the term is often insulting.

collocations.zh: 称某人为戴绿帽子的男人

collocations.mt: tiċċajta fuq xi ħadd għax hu kurnut
collocations.en: to mock someone for being a cuckold
collocations.zh: 因为某人妻子不忠而嘲笑他

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġirien isejħu lir-raġel kurnut wara li jsiru jafu bir-relazzjoni ta' martu ma' raġel ieħor.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbours call the man a cuckold after learning about his wife's relationship with another man.
formal.zh: 故事中，邻居得知这名男子的妻子与另一名男子有私情后，便称他为戴绿帽子的男人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'kurnut'? Pawlu: Raġel li martu jkollha relazzjoni sesswali ma' xi ħadd ieħor. Oqgħod attent, għax tintuża bħala insult.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'kurnut' mean? Pawlu: A man whose wife has a sexual relationship with someone else. Be careful, because it's used as an insult.
colloquial.zh: Maja：kurnut 是什么意思？Pawlu：指妻子与他人有性关系的丈夫。使用时要小心，因为这个词会用来侮辱人。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“戴绿帽子的丈夫”联想 kurnut，同时在词卡上标注贬义，连同说话语气一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose specific meaning is not established by the repeated label 'kurnuta'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个名词；所给释义仅重复 kurnuta 本身，尚不能确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan huwa nom li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu mhix iċċarata, għax it-tikketta tirrepeti biss il-forma 'kurnuta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义仅重复词形 kurnuta，未提供可确定的中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan in-nom għandu tikketta li tirrepeti l-istess kelma, mingħajr ma tispjega xi tfisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun is labeled only with its own form, so its specific meaning remains unspecified.

collocations.zh: 名词 kurnuta（用于讨论词性）
kurnuta 的含义（用于询问词义）

formal.mt: In-nom 'kurnuta' jeħtieġ definizzjoni ċara qabel ma jkun jista' jintuża f'eżempju li juri t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The noun 'kurnuta' needs a clear definition before it can be used in an example illustrating its meaning.
formal.zh: 名词 kurnuta 需要先有明确的定义，才能用在展示其词义的例句中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nafu xi jfisser 'kurnuta'? Pawlu: Nafu li hu nom, iżda t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara. Ejja ma naqtgħux.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A close-fitting garment worn around the torso to support or shape the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贴身穿在躯干部位、用于支撑身体或塑造腰身的衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies issikkat li jintlibes madwar it-tronk biex isostni l-ġisem jew jagħtih forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 围住躯干并收束腰身、用于支撑或塑形的紧身胸衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies li jdawwar it-tronk u jissikka mal-ġisem biex isostnih jew jagħti forma lill-qadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corset is a close-fitting garment that supports the torso or shapes the waist.

formal.mt: Fil-wirja tal-ilbies storiku, il-kurpett jintwera ħdejn il-libsa li kien jintlibes magħha.
formal.en: In the historical clothing exhibition, the corset is displayed beside the dress with which it was worn.
formal.zh: 在历史服饰展中，束身衣陈列在当时与之搭配穿着的连衣裙旁边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kurpett qed jagħfasni wisq. Lara: Trid tipprova wieħed ikbar?
colloquial.en: Maja: This corset is squeezing me too much. Lara: Would you like to try a larger one?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件束身衣勒得我太紧了。拉拉：你想试一件大一点的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kurpett qed jagħfasni wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kurpett qed jagħfasni wisq.
messages.zh: 这件束身衣勒得我太紧了。
messages.en: This corset is squeezing me too much.

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tipprova wieħed ikbar?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tipprova wieħed ikbar?
messages.zh: 你想试一件大一点的吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try a larger one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kurpett 和试衣时收紧腰身的画面联系起来，连着记 tilbes kurpett「穿束身衣」。

gloss_zh: Kurrad（所给释义为翻译指令，词义未明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry supplied as a noun whose lexical meaning is not established by the provided translation instruction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料中标为名词的词项；所给英文内容只是翻译指令，未提供可确定的实际词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mogħtija bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha mhix speċifikata għax id-deskrizzjoni mogħtija hija biss struzzjoni biex issir traduzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原文意为「翻译成英语」，属于操作指令，不能据此确定 Kurrad 的词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-frażi mogħtija titlob traduzzjoni għall-Ingliż; hija struzzjoni u ma tagħtix it-tifsira tal-entrata Kurrad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied phrase requests an English translation and does not establish the meaning of this noun.

formal.mt: L-entrata Kurrad hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-istruzzjoni mogħtija ma tipprovdix definizzjoni tal-kelma.
formal.en: The entry Kurrad is marked as a noun, but the supplied instruction does not provide a definition of the word.
formal.zh: Kurrad 这一词条被标为名词，但所给指令并未提供该词的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi t-tifsira ta' Kurrad hawn? Mark: Ma nafux minn din l-entrata; hemm biss struzzjoni biex nittraduċu għall-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does Kurrad mean here? Mark: We cannot tell from this entry; there is only an instruction to translate into English.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 Kurrad 是什么意思？马克：从这个词条看不出来；这里只有一条翻译成英语的指令。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flow of water or electricity, or a stream of air moving through a space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水或电的流动，也可指流经某处的气流，尤其是从门窗进入的穿堂风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fluss ta' ilma jew elettriku, jew arja li tgħaddi minn post, speċjalment minn bieb jew tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿一定方向流动的水流或电流。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moviment ta' ilma jew elettriku li jgħaddi f'direzzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A current is a flow of water or electricity moving in a particular direction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从门窗等开口流入或流经室内的气流；穿堂风。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arja li tgħaddi minn fetħa, bħal bieb jew tieqa, u tinħass ġewwa post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A draught is a stream of air entering or passing through an enclosed space.

formal.mt: Il-kejl juri li l-kurrent elettriku fiċ-ċirkwit jibqa' stabbli matul l-esperiment.
formal.en: The measurements show that the electric current in the circuit remains stable throughout the experiment.
formal.zh: 测量结果表明，电路中的电流在整个实验期间保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed inħoss kurrent ta' arja minn dik it-tieqa. Mark: Nagħlaqha biex ma tibqax tidħol l-arja.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can feel a draught from that window. Mark: I'll close it to stop the air coming in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我感觉那扇窗户有风灌进来。马克：我把它关上，免得风继续吹进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss kurrent ta' arja minn dik it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss kurrent ta' arja minn dik it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 我感觉那扇窗户有风灌进来。
messages.en: I can feel a draught from that window.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħlaqha biex ma tibqax tidħol l-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħlaqha biex ma tibqax tidħol l-arja.
messages.zh: 我把它关上，免得风继续吹进来。
messages.en: I'll close it to stop the air coming in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用「流动」串联 kurrent：电在电路里流，水在海里流，空气从窗边流进来；看搭配判断是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pirate or corsair, or figuratively a person who is shrewd in practical dealings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指海盗或从事海上劫掠的私掠者，也可比喻处事精明、善于判断和把握机会的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisraq jew tattakka bastimenti fuq il-baħar, jew, f'sens figurattiv, persuna makakka li taf taġixxi b'għaqal biex tikseb dak li trid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在海上袭击船只、抢劫财物的海盗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tattakka bastimenti fuq il-baħar biex tisraq il-merkanzija jew affarijiet oħra ta' valur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pirate is someone who attacks ships at sea in order to steal from them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事海上劫掠的人；私掠者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem f'rejds fuq il-baħar biex taqbad bastimenti jew tisraq il-merkanzija tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corsair is a sea raider who captures ships or takes their cargo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头脑精明、善于审时度势并为自己争取有利结果的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna makakka li tifhem sew is-sitwazzjonijiet u taf tieħu deċiżjonijiet li jkunu ta' vantaġġ għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shrewd person understands situations well and uses that understanding to gain an advantage.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kursar jersaq lejn il-bastiment tal-merkanzija bil-ħsieb li jaħtaf it-tagħbija tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the corsair approaches the merchant ship with the intention of seizing its cargo.
formal.zh: 故事中，私掠者靠近商船，打算夺取船上的货物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' ġab prezz aħjar mingħand il-bejjiegħ. Mark: Dak kursar fin-negozju; jaf jinnegozja tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu got a better price from the seller again. Mark: He's shrewd in business; he knows how to negotiate well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗又从卖家那里谈到了更好的价格。马克：他做生意很精明，很会谈价。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu reġa' ġab prezz aħjar mingħand il-bejjiegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu reġa' ġab prezz aħjar mingħand il-bejjiegħ.
messages.zh: 保罗又从卖家那里谈到了更好的价格。
messages.en: Pawlu got a better price from the seller again.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kursar fin-negozju; jaf jinnegozja tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kursar fin-negozju; jaf jinnegozja tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他做生意很精明，很会谈价。
messages.en: He's shrewd in business; he knows how to negotiate well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kursar 配两幅学习画面：海上劫船的人，以及谈价时很精明的人；用海上语境和生意语境区分字面义与比喻义。

gloss_zh: 苦像；带有耶稣受难像的十字架

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cross bearing a figure of Jesus Christ being crucified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有耶稣被钉在十字架上形象的十字架。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Salib li fuqu hemm xbieha ta' Ġesù Kristu msallab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苦像，即带有耶稣受难形象的十字架。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Salib li juri x-xbieha ta' Ġesù Kristu msallab fuqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crucifix is a cross with a figure of Jesus Christ attached to it.

formal.mt: Fuq l-artal hemm kurċifiss tal-injam.
formal.en: There is a wooden crucifix on the altar.
formal.zh: 祭坛上有一尊木制苦像。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se ndendlu l-kurċifiss? Pawlu: Mal-ħajt, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we hang the crucifix? Pawlu: On the wall, beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们把苦像挂在哪里？保罗：挂在墙上，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se ndendlu l-kurċifiss?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se ndendlu l-kurċifiss?
messages.zh: 我们把苦像挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we hang the crucifix?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-ħajt, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-ħajt, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 挂在墙上，门旁边。
messages.en: On the wall, beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kurċifiss 与墙上带有耶稣受难形象的十字架联系起来；记住这个词强调带有人物形象的苦像。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A desire to discover, learn, or understand something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想要发现、了解或弄懂某事的心理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xewqa li tiskopri, titgħallem jew tifhem xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对未知事物的好奇心或想进一步了解的求知欲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħerqa li tkun taf aktar dwar xi ħaġa li tqanqal l-interess tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Curiosity is the feeling that makes you want to discover or understand something.

formal.mt: L-esperiment qajjem kurżita kbira fost l-istudenti u ħeġġiġhom jistaqsu aktar mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The experiment aroused great curiosity among the students and encouraged them to ask more questions.
formal.zh: 这个实验引起了学生们强烈的好奇心，并鼓励他们提出更多问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'dik il-kaxxa? Għandi kurżita kbira! Pawlu: Ejja niftħuha flimkien u naraw.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in that box? I'm really curious! Pawlu: Let's open it together and see.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个盒子里有什么？我太好奇了！保罗：我们一起打开看看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm f'dik il-kaxxa? Għandi kurżita kbira!
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm f'dik il-kaxxa? Għandi kurżita kbira!
messages.zh: 那个盒子里有什么？我太好奇了！
messages.en: What's in that box? I'm really curious!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niftħuha flimkien u naraw.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niftħuha flimkien u naraw.
messages.zh: 我们一起打开看看吧。
messages.en: Let's open it together and see.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“盯着神秘盒子，忍不住问里面有什么”的画面联系起来，记住它表示好奇心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containers with narrow necks used for holding liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放液体的窄颈瓶类容器，表示复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjenti b'għonq dejjaq li jintużaw biex jinżammu fihom likwidi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛放液体用的瓶类容器，如实验室中的烧瓶；此处为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjenti b'għonq dejjaq għall-ħażna jew l-użu ta' likwidi, pereżempju waqt esperimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Flasks are containers with narrow necks that hold liquids, for example during scientific experiments.

formal.mt: Qabel l-esperiment, l-istudenti ħaslu l-kusien tal-ħġieġ u mlewhom bl-ilma.
formal.en: Before the experiment, the students washed the glass flasks and filled them with water.
formal.zh: 实验开始前，学生们清洗了玻璃烧瓶，并往里面装满了水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kusien? Mark: Poġġihom fuq il-mejda, ħdejn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where should I put these flasks? Mark: Put them on the table, next to the water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些烧瓶放在哪里？马克：放在桌子上，水旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kusien?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kusien?
messages.zh: 这些烧瓶放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these flasks?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġihom fuq il-mejda, ħdejn l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġihom fuq il-mejda, ħdejn l-ilma.
messages.zh: 放在桌子上，水旁边。
messages.en: Put them on the table, next to the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象实验桌上并排放着好几个窄颈烧瓶；用“一排瓶子”的画面提醒自己这个词表示复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The care, safekeeping, or lawful detention of a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或物的照管、保管，或依法对人的拘押状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien jew iż-żamma ta' persuna jew ħaġa taħt ir-responsabbiltà ta' xi ħadd, jew iż-żamma ta' persuna mill-awtoritajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对人或物承担照管和控制责任的状态；可指监护、保管，也可指警方拘押。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' persuna jew ħaġa li tkun taħt il-ħarsien, ir-responsabbiltà jew il-kontroll ta' xi ħadd, inkluża persuna miżmuma mill-pulizija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Custody is the state of being kept under someone's care or control, including detention by the police.

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti oriġinali baqgħu fil-kustodja tal-arkivju sakemm intemmet ir-riċerka.
formal.en: The original documents remained in the custody of the archive until the research was completed.
formal.zh: 这些原始文件一直由档案馆保管，直到研究结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek int id-dokumenti oriġinali? Pawlu: Le, issa qegħdin fil-kustodja tal-arkivju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have the original documents? Pawlu: No, they're now in the custody of the archive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：原始文件还在你那里吗？保罗：不在了，现在由档案馆保管。

messages.speaker: Maja (研究同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandek int id-dokumenti oriġinali?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandek int id-dokumenti oriġinali?
messages.zh: 原始文件还在你那里吗？
messages.en: Do you still have the original documents?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (研究同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa qegħdin fil-kustodja tal-arkivju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa qegħdin fil-kustodja tal-arkivju.
messages.zh: 不在了，现在由档案馆保管。
messages.en: No, they're now in the custody of the archive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“由谁负责看管”来记忆：孩子对应监护，文件对应保管，警方看管的人则对应拘押。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person responsible for protecting or looking after someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责保护或照料他人的人，尤指监护人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha r-responsabbiltà li tħares jew tieħu ħsieb persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承担保护、照料他人责任的监护人或守护者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli għall-ħarsien u l-kura ta' ħaddieħor, speċjalment ta' tifel jew ta' xi ħadd li jeħtieġ l-għajnuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A guardian is someone who is responsible for protecting and looking after another person.

formal.mt: Il-kustodju tat-tifel attenda l-laqgħa mal-għalliema biex jiddiskuti l-progress tiegħu fl-iskola.
formal.en: The child's guardian attended the meeting with the teachers to discuss his progress at school.
formal.zh: 这个男孩的监护人参加了与教师的会面，讨论他在学校的学习进展。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jiġi miegħek għal-laqgħa tal-iskola? Luqa: Il-kustodju tiegħi. Se niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who's coming with you to the school meeting? Luqa: My guardian. We're meeting outside the school.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁陪你参加学校的会面？卢卡：我的监护人。我们约好在学校门口见。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiġi miegħek għal-laqgħa tal-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiġi miegħek għal-laqgħa tal-iskola?
messages.zh: 谁陪你参加学校的会面？
messages.en: Who's coming with you to the school meeting?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kustodju tiegħi. Se niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kustodju tiegħi. Se niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola.
messages.zh: 我的监护人。我们约好在学校门口见。
messages.en: My guardian. We're meeting outside the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位陪孩子见老师、负责照料孩子的大人；把 kustodju 记成承担监护责任的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A movement in which the body turns over completely, or an accidental fall involving a rolling movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体整个翻转的动作，指有意做出的筋斗，也可指失去平衡后的翻滚跌倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment li fih il-ġisem jinqaleb kompletament, jew waqgħa aċċidentali li fiha l-ġisem jinqaleb jew jitgerbeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筋斗；身体向前或向后整个翻转一周的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moviment li fih persuna ddawwar ġisimha kompletament 'il quddiem jew lura, b'rasha tgħaddi minn taħt saqajha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A somersault is a movement in which you turn your whole body over forwards or backwards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻滚跌倒；身体失去平衡后翻倒或滚落。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waqgħa aċċidentali li fiha persuna titlef il-bilanċ u ġisimha jinqaleb jew jitgerbeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tumble is an accidental fall in which your body rolls or turns over.

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja, il-ġinnasta għamlet kutrumbajsa fl-arja u niżlet fuq saqajha mingħajr ma tilfet il-bilanċ.
formal.en: During the performance, the gymnast did a somersault in the air and landed on her feet without losing her balance.
formal.zh: 表演时，体操运动员做了一个空翻，双脚落地，保持了平衡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek it-tajn fuq il-ġakketta? Pawlu: Żlaqt fuq il-ħaxix u ħadt kutrumbajsa. Maja: Weġġajt? Pawlu: Le, jien sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why have you got mud on your jacket? Pawlu: I slipped on the grass and took a tumble. Maja: Did you get hurt? Pawlu: No, I'm fine.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的夹克上怎么有泥？Pawlu：我在草地上滑了一下，翻滚着摔了一跤。Maja：受伤了吗？Pawlu：没有，我没事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek it-tajn fuq il-ġakketta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek it-tajn fuq il-ġakketta?
messages.zh: 你的夹克上怎么有泥？
messages.en: Why have you got mud on your jacket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żlaqt fuq il-ħaxix u ħadt kutrumbajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Żlaqt fuq il-ħaxix u ħadt kutrumbajsa.
messages.zh: 我在草地上滑了一下，翻滚着摔了一跤。
messages.en: I slipped on the grass and took a tumble.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Weġġajt?
messages.mt_standard: Weġġajt?
messages.zh: 受伤了吗？
messages.en: Did you get hurt?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien sew.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien sew.
messages.zh: 没有，我没事。
messages.en: No, I'm fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kutrumbajsa 配上身体翻转的画面：主动翻过去是“筋斗”，失去平衡翻倒是“翻滚跌倒”；结合 tagħmel 和 tieħu 两个搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, flat cut of meat, sometimes with a bone attached, prepared as an individual portion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切成较薄扁平状、供一人食用的小块肉排，有时带骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam żgħira, ċatta u relattivament rqiqa, xi drabi bl-għadma magħha, li titħejja bħala porzjon għal persuna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小肉排；切成薄片或扁平块状的肉，可能带骨，通常作为单人份烹制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam ċatta u relattivament rqiqa, li tista' tkun bl-għadma magħha u li normalment tissajjar bħala porzjon għal persuna waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cutlet is a small, flat piece of meat, sometimes with a bone attached, that is cooked as an individual portion.

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, ġiet servuta kutuletta tal-vitella bil-patata u l-ħaxix.
formal.en: For lunch, a veal cutlet was served with potatoes and vegetables.
formal.zh: 午餐供应了一份小牛肉排，配有土豆和蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq kutuletta tal-vitella, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Tridha bil-patata jew bl-insalata? Mark: Bl-insalata, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a veal cutlet, please. Rita: Would you like it with potatoes or salad? Mark: With salad, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一份小牛肉排。Rita：您想配土豆还是沙拉？Mark：配沙拉，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq kutuletta tal-vitella, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq kutuletta tal-vitella, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一份小牛肉排。
messages.en: I'd like a veal cutlet, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridha bil-patata jew bl-insalata?
messages.mt_standard: Tridha bil-patata jew bl-insalata?
messages.zh: 您想配土豆还是沙拉？
messages.en: Would you like it with potatoes or salad?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Bl-insalata, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Bl-insalata, grazzi.
messages.zh: 配沙拉，谢谢。
messages.en: With salad, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kutuletta 想成餐盘中央的一小块肉排，再用 tal-vitella 记肉类、用 moqlija 记做法，将词义与点餐场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hole or recess cut into a piece of material to receive a projecting part of another piece and form a joint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在木料等材料上凿出的孔槽，用来容纳另一构件突出的榫头，使两者接合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofra jew fetħa maqtugħa f'biċċa materjal, bħal injam, biex tidħol fiha parti li toħroġ minn biċċa oħra u b'hekk iż-żewġ biċċiet jingħaqdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 榫眼；卯眼；为接纳另一构件的榫头而在木料等材料上加工出的孔槽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħofra jew fetħa magħmula f'biċċa injam jew materjal ieħor biex tilqa' parti li toħroġ minn biċċa oħra u tifforma ġonta magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mortise is a hole or recess cut into a piece of wood or other material to receive a projecting part of another piece.

collocations.en: to cut a mortise in wood

formal.mt: Qabel ma waħħal il-qafas, il-mastrudaxxa kejjel il-fond tal-kuxbiena biex jiżgura li l-biċċa l-oħra tidħol sew fiha.
formal.en: Before assembling the frame, the carpenter measured the depth of the mortise to ensure that the other piece would fit properly into it.
formal.zh: 组装框架前，木匠测量了榫眼的深度，以确保另一构件能够妥善嵌入。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-biċċa ma tidħolx fil-kuxbiena. Toni: Ejja nkejlu l-wisa' tagħha qabel inneħħu aktar injam. Lara: Sewwa, għaddili l-ħakkiem.
colloquial.en: Lara: This piece won't fit into the mortise. Toni: Let's measure its width before we remove any more wood. Lara: All right, pass me the ruler.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这块构件嵌不进榫眼。Toni：再削木料之前，先量一下榫眼的宽度吧。Lara：好，把尺子递给我。

messages.speaker: Lara (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa ma tidħolx fil-kuxbiena.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa ma tidħolx fil-kuxbiena.
messages.zh: 这块构件嵌不进榫眼。
messages.en: This piece won't fit into the mortise.

messages.speaker: Toni (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nkejlu l-wisa' tagħha qabel inneħħu aktar injam.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nkejlu l-wisa' tagħha qabel inneħħu aktar injam.
messages.zh: 再削木料之前，先量一下榫眼的宽度吧。
messages.en: Let's measure its width before we remove any more wood.

messages.speaker: Lara (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, għaddili l-ħakkiem.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, għaddili l-ħakkiem.
messages.zh: 好，把尺子递给我。
messages.en: All right, pass me the ruler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kuxbiena 配一幅木工图：突出的榫头插进凹下的孔槽；把标签贴在“孔槽”上，就能记住它指榫眼这一接纳部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft pad with a fabric cover, used to make a seat more comfortable or to support part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外包织物、内有柔软填充物的垫子，用于增加座椅舒适度，或支撑背部等身体部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett artab b'kisja tad-drapp u b'mili ġewwa, li jitqiegħed fuq siġġu jew sufan biex wieħed joqgħod aktar komdu jew biex iserraħ parti minn ġismu fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软垫；靠垫；通常包有织物并填充柔软材料，放在椅子或沙发上供坐靠或支撑身体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett b'kisja tad-drapp mimlija b'materjal artab, li jintuża fuq siġġu jew sufan biex jagħti kumdità jew biex iserraħ id-dahar jew parti oħra tal-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cushion is a soft pad that you sit on or lean against to make yourself more comfortable.

formal.mt: Fuq kull siġġu tqiegħed kuxin artab biex il-mistednin ikunu jistgħu joqogħdu bilqiegħda aktar komdi waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: A soft cushion was placed on each chair so that the guests could sit more comfortably during the meeting.
formal.zh: 每把椅子上都放了一个软垫，让来宾在会议期间坐得更舒适。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaddili dak il-kuxin, jekk jogħġbok. Ben: Tridu wara dahrek? Sara: Iva, hekk noqgħod aktar komda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pass me that cushion, please. Ben: Do you want it behind your back? Sara: Yes, I'll be more comfortable that way.
colloquial.zh: Sara：请把那个靠垫递给我。Ben：你要把它放在背后吗？Sara：对，那样坐着更舒服。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddili dak il-kuxin, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddili dak il-kuxin, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把那个靠垫递给我。
messages.en: Pass me that cushion, please.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridu wara dahrek?
messages.mt_standard: Tridu wara dahrek?
messages.zh: 你要把它放在背后吗？
messages.en: Do you want it behind your back?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk noqgħod aktar komda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk noqgħod aktar komda.
messages.zh: 对，那样坐着更舒服。
messages.en: Yes, I'll be more comfortable that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kuxin 就想象沙发上松软的靠垫：坐下垫一垫，背后靠一靠；再连读 kuxin artab，把“柔软”和实物动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is riding a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑在马背上的人；骑马者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun riekba fuq żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在骑马的人；马背上的骑乘者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna li tkun fuq dahar żiemel u tkun qed tirkbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A kuċċier is the person who is riding on a horse.

formal.mt: Il-kuċċier kien riekeb żiemel kannella u mexa bil-mod tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The rider was on a brown horse and proceeded slowly along the path.
formal.zh: 那位骑马者骑着一匹棕马，沿着小路缓缓前行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tara lil dak il-kuċċier fuq iż-żiemel abjad? Adam: Iva, għadu kif għadda minn ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you see that rider on the white horse? Adam: Yes, he has just gone past the tree.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看见骑着白马的那个人了吗？亚当：看见了，他刚从那棵树旁经过。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tara lil dak il-kuċċier fuq iż-żiemel abjad?
messages.mt_standard: Tara lil dak il-kuċċier fuq iż-żiemel abjad?
messages.zh: 你看见骑着白马的那个人了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that rider on the white horse?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu kif għadda minn ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu kif għadda minn ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.zh: 看见了，他刚从那棵树旁经过。
messages.en: Yes, he has just gone past the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuċċier 与“马背上的人”这一画面绑定，再用 kuċċier fuq żiemel 整组记忆，明确本条指骑马者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The face of a clock or measuring instrument, marked with numbers or divisions that allow a reading to be taken.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钟表或测量仪器上标有数字或刻度、供人读取时间或测量值的盘面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ ta' arloġġ jew ta' strument tal-kejl, b'numri jew marki li minnhom jinqraw il-ħin jew il-valuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟表或测量仪器上用于显示时间或数值的表盘、刻度盘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wiċċ ta' arloġġ jew ta' strument tal-kejl li jkollu numri jew marki biex wieħed ikun jista' jaqra l-ħin jew il-kejl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dial is the marked face of a clock or instrument from which you read the time or a measurement.

formal.mt: L-istrument għandu kwadrant b'marki ċari biex il-kejl ikun jista' jinqara faċilment.
formal.en: The instrument has a dial with clear markings so that the measurement can be read easily.
formal.zh: 该仪器的刻度盘标记清晰，便于读取测量值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu l-ħin? Ma nistax nara n-numri fuq il-kwadrant minn hawn. Mark: Is-sagħtejn. Ejja eqreb u tarahom aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time is it? I can't see the numbers on the dial from here. Mark: Two o'clock. Come closer and you'll see them better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：几点了？我在这里看不清表盘上的数字。Mark：两点。走近一点，你就能看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu l-ħin? Ma nistax nara n-numri fuq il-kwadrant minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu l-ħin? Ma nistax nara n-numri fuq il-kwadrant minn hawn.
messages.zh: 几点了？我在这里看不清表盘上的数字。
messages.en: What time is it? I can't see the numbers on the dial from here.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sagħtejn. Ejja eqreb u tarahom aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sagħtejn. Ejja eqreb u tarahom aħjar.
messages.zh: 两点。走近一点，你就能看得更清楚。
messages.en: Two o'clock. Come closer and you'll see them better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kwadrant 配上钟面图来记：数字围成一圈、指针在盘面移动，读时间时看的就是表盘。

gloss_zh: 配额资格；符合配额分配条件的资格

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eligibility for a quota allocation, based on meeting the requirements of the relevant scheme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因满足有关制度的规定条件而具备的配额分配资格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-eliġibbiltà għal allokazzjoni skont il-kwoti, li tinkiseb meta jiġu ssodisfati r-rekwiżiti tal-iskema rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符合有关配额制度要求、可以参与配额分配的资格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex tkun eliġibbli għal allokazzjoni skont sistema ta' kwoti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Qualification for quotas means meeting the conditions that make a person or organization eligible for an allocation under a quota system.

formal.mt: Il-kwalifika għall-kwoti tiġi vverifikata abbażi tad-dokumenti ppreżentati mill-applikant.
formal.en: Eligibility for quota allocation is verified on the basis of the documents submitted by the applicant.
formal.zh: 配额分配资格根据申请人提交的文件进行审核。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'dokumenti għandi nġib għall-verifika tal-kwalifika għall-kwoti? Pawlu: Ġib il-formola mimlija u d-dokumenti msemmija fil-lista.
colloquial.en: Lara: What documents should I bring for the quota eligibility check? Pawlu: Bring the completed form and the documents mentioned in the list.
colloquial.zh: Lara：审核配额资格时，我应该带哪些文件？Pawlu：带上填好的表格和清单中列出的文件。

messages.speaker: Lara (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'dokumenti għandi nġib għall-verifika tal-kwalifika għall-kwoti?
messages.mt_standard: X'dokumenti għandi nġib għall-verifika tal-kwalifika għall-kwoti?
messages.zh: 审核配额资格时，我应该带哪些文件？
messages.en: What documents should I bring for the quota eligibility check?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib il-formola mimlija u d-dokumenti msemmija fil-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib il-formola mimlija u d-dokumenti msemmija fil-lista.
messages.zh: 带上填好的表格和清单中列出的文件。
messages.en: Bring the completed form and the documents mentioned in the list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先核资格，再分配额”的办事画面记住整个短语；它强调达到配额制度要求的资格。

gloss_zh: 合格的；具备所需资格的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the training, knowledge, skills, or credentials needed to perform a particular job or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备从事某项工作或活动所需的培训、知识、技能或资质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-taħriġ, l-għarfien, il-ħiliet jew il-kwalifiki meħtieġa biex jagħmel xogħol jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有完成特定工作或活动所要求的知识、技能或正式资格的；合格的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-preparazzjoni, il-ħiliet jew il-kwalifiki meħtieġa biex iwettaq xogħol jew attività speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is qualified has the training, skills, or credentials needed to do a particular job.

collocations.zh: 具备从事这项工作的资格

formal.mt: Il-manutenzjoni tat-tagħmir għandha ssir minn tekniku kwalifikat.
formal.en: Maintenance of the equipment should be carried out by a qualified technician.
formal.zh: 设备维护应由合格的技术人员进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jsewwi l-magna? Mark: Ħija. Hu tekniku kwalifikat u diġà ħadem fuq magni bħal din.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to repair the machine? Mark: My brother. He's a qualified technician and has already worked on machines like this one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来修这台机器？Mark：我哥哥。他是合格的技术人员，以前处理过这样的机器。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jsewwi l-magna?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jsewwi l-magna?
messages.zh: 谁来修这台机器？
messages.en: Who's going to repair the machine?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Hu tekniku kwalifikat u diġà ħadem fuq magni bħal din.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Hu tekniku kwalifikat u diġà ħadem fuq magni bħal din.
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他是合格的技术人员，以前处理过这样的机器。
messages.en: My brother. He's a qualified technician and has already worked on machines like this one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象技术人员胸前挂着“培训通过、可以上岗”的牌子，用 kwalifikat 描述这个人的合格状态。

gloss_zh: 资格；资质；取得资格的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: A credential or recognized competence showing that someone meets particular requirements, or the process of reaching that standard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表明某人达到特定要求的资格、资质或获认可的能力，也指达到该要求并取得资格的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwalità, ħila jew ċertifikazzjoni rikonoxxuta li turi li persuna tissodisfa rekwiżiti partikolari, jew il-proċess li bih tilħaq dak il-livell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过学习、培训或考核取得的资格、资质，或证明具备相应能力的学历及证书。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħila jew ċertifikazzjoni miksuba permezz ta' studju, taħriġ jew eżami, li turi li persuna għandha l-livell meħtieġ f'qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A qualification is a recognized skill or credential that shows you have reached a required standard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过学习、培训、实践或考核达到规定标准并取得资格的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' studju, taħriġ, prattika jew valutazzjoni li bih persuna tikseb il-ħiliet u tilħaq l-istandard meħtieġ biex issir kwalifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Qualification is the process through which you gain the skills and meet the requirements needed to become qualified.

formal.mt: Il-proċess ta' kwalifikazzjoni jinkludi taħriġ prattiku u eżami finali; dawk li jgħaddu jingħataw kwalifikazzjoni professjonali.
formal.en: The qualification process includes practical training and a final examination; those who pass are awarded a professional qualification.
formal.zh: 取得资格的过程包括实践培训和最终考试；通过者将获授专业资格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm idum il-proċess ta' kwalifikazzjoni għal dan ix-xogħol? David: Sena. Wara t-taħriġ u l-eżami, tikseb kwalifikazzjoni professjonali.
colloquial.en: Sara: How long does it take to become qualified for this job? David: A year. After the training and the exam, you obtain a professional qualification.
colloquial.zh: Sara：取得这份工作的资格需要多长时间？David：一年。完成培训并通过考试后，你就能取得专业资格。

messages.speaker: Sara (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm idum il-proċess ta' kwalifikazzjoni għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm idum il-proċess ta' kwalifikazzjoni għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 取得这份工作的资格需要多长时间？
messages.en: How long does it take to become qualified for this job?

messages.speaker: David (培训顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Sena. Wara t-taħriġ u l-eżami, tikseb kwalifikazzjoni professjonali.
messages.mt_standard: Sena. Wara t-taħriġ u l-eżami, tikseb kwalifikazzjoni professjonali.
messages.zh: 一年。完成培训并通过考试后，你就能取得专业资格。
messages.en: A year. After the training and the exam, you obtain a professional qualification.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“参加培训→通过考核→拿到资格”的连续画面记忆：kwalifikazzjoni 既可指最后获得的资格，也可指取得资格的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that a choice is unrestricted and that any person, thing, or option may be included.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示选择不受限制，任何人、事物或选项都可以包括在内。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li turi li l-għażla mhix limitata u li tista' tinkludi kull persuna, ħaġa jew possibbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何；表示不限定具体的人、事物或选择。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika persuna, ħaġa jew għażla mingħajr ma tispeċifika waħda partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word when no particular person, thing, or option is specified.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何的；无论哪一种的，表示所描述的对象没有特定限制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jkun ta' kull tip, mingħajr restrizzjoni għal xi tip jew każ partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: It describes something whose particular identity or type does not restrict the choice.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何一个或任何一些；限定名词，表示所属范围内的成员均可。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża ma' nom biex turi li kull membru tal-grupp imsemmi jista' jintgħażel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use it with a noun to indicate that every member of the relevant group is an acceptable possibility.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无论怎样或无论哪一种；表示相关方式或选择不受限定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Użu li jesprimi li l-mod jew l-għażla inkwistjoni mhuwiex limitat għal possibbiltà partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this use, it indicates that the relevant manner or alternative is unrestricted.

formal.mt: Kwalunkwe persuna interessata tista' tibgħat mistoqsija bil-posta elettronika.
formal.en: Any interested person may send a question by email.
formal.zh: 任何感兴趣的人都可以通过电子邮件提出问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ktieb nista' nieħu? Lara: Tista' tieħu kwalunkwe ktieb minn fuq din l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book can I take? Lara: You can take any book from this shelf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以拿哪本书？拉拉：这个书架上的任何一本你都可以拿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ktieb nista' nieħu?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ktieb nista' nieħu?
messages.zh: 我可以拿哪本书？
messages.en: Which book can I take?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tieħu kwalunkwe ktieb minn fuq din l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tieħu kwalunkwe ktieb minn fuq din l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 这个书架上的任何一本你都可以拿。
messages.en: You can take any book from this shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书架上每本书都贴着“任选”标签：kwalunkwe 就是不指定哪一个，任何一个都可以。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number of things or the amount of a substance that is present, needed, or available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物的数目或某种物质的量，可指现有、所需或可供使用的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għadd ta' oġġetti jew il-kejl ta' sustanza li jkun hemm, li jkun meħtieġ jew li jkun disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数量；通过计数或测量确定的事物有多少。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għadd jew il-kejl ta' xi ħaġa, li juri kemm hemm minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The quantity of something is how much of it there is, measured or counted.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 量；某种物质或其他可衡量事物的总量或一部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kemm hemm minn sustanza jew minn xi ħaġa oħra li tista' titkejjel, bħala total jew bħala parti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An amount is a total or portion of something that can be measured.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-kwantità ta' ilma użata mill-iskola matul ix-xahar ta' Ottubru.
formal.en: The report indicates the quantity of water used by the school during October.
formal.zh: 报告列明了学校十月份的用水量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-kwantità ta' ross biżżejjed għalina? Pawlu: Iva, biżżejjed għal erba' persuni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this quantity of rice enough for us? Pawlu: Yes, it is enough for four people.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些米够我们吃吗？保罗：够，足够四个人吃。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kwantità ta' ross biżżejjed għalina?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kwantità ta' ross biżżejjed għalina?
messages.zh: 这些米够我们吃吗？
messages.en: Is this quantity of rice enough for us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biżżejjed għal erba' persuni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biżżejjed għal erba' persuni.
messages.zh: 够，足够四个人吃。
messages.en: Yes, it is enough for four people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kwantità 和厨房量杯联系起来：米可以数或称，水可以量，核心问题都是“有多少”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period or arrangement in which people or animals that may carry an infectious disease are kept apart to prevent its spread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将可能携带传染病的人或动物与其他人或动物分开的检疫隔离措施，也指这种隔离的时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu jew miżura li fiha persuni jew annimali li jistgħu jkunu qed iġorru marda li tittieħed jinżammu separati biex il-marda ma tinfirixx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检疫隔离；为防止传染病传播而对可能携带疾病的人或动物实行的隔离，也指隔离期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żamma ta' persuni jew annimali li jistgħu jkunu qed iġorru marda li tittieħed separati minn oħrajn għal żmien stabbilit biex jitnaqqas it-tixrid tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Quarantine is a period of separation for people or animals that may carry an infectious disease, intended to prevent it from spreading.

formal.mt: L-annimali l-ġodda jinżammu fi kwarantina qabel ma jitħallew jingħaqdu mal-bqija tal-annimali fir-razzett.
formal.en: The new animals are kept in quarantine before they are allowed to join the other animals on the farm.
formal.zh: 新来的动物先接受检疫隔离，之后才获准与农场里的其他动物混养。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kelb il-ġdid għadu waħdu? Mark: Għadu fi kwarantina. Meta jintemm il-perjodu, ikun jista' jingħaqad mal-klieb l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the new dog still on its own? Mark: It is still in quarantine. When the period ends, it will be able to join the other dogs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新来的狗为什么还单独待着？马克：它还在接受检疫隔离。隔离期结束后，它就能和其他狗待在一起了。

messages.zh: 新来的狗为什么还单独待着？
messages.en: Why is the new dog still on its own?
