messages.zh: 它还在接受检疫隔离。隔离期结束后，它就能和其他狗待在一起了。
messages.en: It is still in quarantine. When the period ends, it will be able to join the other dogs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“新来的动物先单独住一阵”记 kwarantina：为防疾病传播而暂时分开，就是检疫隔离。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinct part of a town or a particular geographical area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城镇中可区分的一片街区，或某个特定的地理区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti distinta minn belt jew żona ġeografika partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 街区；城镇内具有一定范围或特色的一片地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti minn belt li tingħaraf mill-bqija minħabba l-post jew il-karatteristiċi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A quarter is a particular part of a town, often recognized by its location or character.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 区域；按位置或共同特征区分出来的一片地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ġeografika li tingħaraf mill-post tagħha jew minn karatteristiċi komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A region is an area identified by its location or by features that its parts share.

collocations.en: the old quarter of the town

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi aktar siġar u bankijiet fil-kwartier residenzjali qrib l-iskola.
formal.en: The plan proposes more trees and benches in the residential quarter near the school.
formal.zh: 该规划建议在学校附近的住宅街区增种树木并增设长椅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn toqgħod issa? Nina: Fi kwartier kwiet qrib il-baħar. Lara: Hemm xi ħwienet fil-qrib? Nina: Iva, hemm ħanut żgħir fit-triq tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where do you live now? Nina: In a quiet neighbourhood near the sea. Lara: Are there any shops nearby? Nina: Yes, there is a small shop on our street.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你现在住在哪里？妮娜：住在海边附近一个安静的街区。拉拉：附近有商店吗？妮娜：有，我们那条街上有一家小店。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containers with wide openings, used for keeping food or other things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放食物或其他物品的广口罐状容器；此处为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjenti b'fetħa wiesgħa li jintużaw biex jinżamm fihom l-ikel jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罐子，通常有较宽开口，用于盛放食物或其他物品；复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjenti, ġeneralment b'fetħa wiesgħa, li fihom jinżammu l-ikel jew affarijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Jars are containers with wide openings in which you keep food or other things.

formal.mt: Aħsel il-kwies tal-ħġieġ u ħallihom jinxfu qabel ma timliehom bil-ġamm.
formal.en: Wash the glass jars and let them dry before filling them with jam.
formal.zh: 清洗玻璃罐并晾干，然后再装入果酱。

colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the empty jars? Mark: On the shelf. Take as many as you need for the jam.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：空罐子在哪儿？马克：在架子上。装果酱需要几个，你就拿几个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short test or game in which people answer questions to show what they know.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过回答问题来检验知识的简短测验或问答游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Test qasir jew logħba li fiha n-nies iwieġbu mistoqsijiet biex juru x'jafu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以回答问题为形式的简短知识测验或问答游戏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Test qasir jew logħba ta' mistoqsijiet u tweġibiet li jkejlu l-għarfien tal-parteċipanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A quiz is a short test or game in which you answer questions about a subject.

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti se jagħmlu kwizz qasir biex juru kemm fehmu s-suġġett.
formal.en: At the end of the lesson, the students will take a short quiz to show how well they have understood the subject.
formal.zh: 课程结束时，学生将完成一份简短测验，以展示他们对所学内容的理解程度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tieħu sehem fil-kwizz illejla? Mark: Iva! Fuq liema suġġett se jkun?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to take part in the quiz tonight? Mark: Yes! What subject will it be on?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想参加今晚的知识问答吗？马克：想！会考什么主题？

teaching_sense.en_definition: An extra quantity of goods that may be imported at a specified preferential customs duty rate, in addition to an existing tariff quota.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在现有关税配额之外增加的进口货物数量额度，额度内适用规定的优惠关税税率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità oħra ta' merkanzija, miżjuda ma' kwota tariffarja eżistenti, li tista' tiġi importata b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在现有关税配额基础上另行增加、供进口货物适用规定优惠税率的数量额度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwota li żżid il-kwantità ta' merkanzija li tista' tiġi importata b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju lil hinn mill-kwota diġà stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An additional tariff quota provides a further quantity of goods that can be imported at a preferential duty rate beyond an existing quota.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija talbet kwota tariffarja addizzjonali minħabba li l-kwota eżistenti ma kinitx biżżejjed għall-importazzjonijiet ippjanati.
formal.en: The company requested an additional tariff quota because the existing quota was insufficient for its planned imports.
formal.zh: 由于现有关税配额不足以满足计划进口量，该公司申请了追加关税配额。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-kwota li għandna mhix biżżejjed għall-ordni l-ġdida. Pawlu: Mela ejja naraw jekk nistgħux nitolbu kwota tariffarja addizzjonali.
colloquial.en: Marta: The quota we have isn't enough for the new order. Pawlu: Then let's see whether we can request an additional tariff quota.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们现有的配额不够用于这笔新订单。保罗：那就看看能不能申请追加关税配额。

messages.speaker: Marta (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kwota li għandna mhix biżżejjed għall-ordni l-ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kwota li għandna mhix biżżejjed għall-ordni l-ġdida.
messages.zh: 我们现有的配额不够用于这笔新订单。
messages.en: The quota we have isn't enough for the new order.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja naraw jekk nistgħux nitolbu kwota tariffarja addizzjonali.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja naraw jekk nistgħux nitolbu kwota tariffarja addizzjonali.
messages.zh: 那就看看能不能申请追加关税配额。
messages.en: Then let's see whether we can request an additional tariff quota.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成“原有额度旁再添一格”：kwota tariffarja 是关税配额，addizzjonali 提醒你这是追加的数量，而不是追加税款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A specified quantity of agricultural goods that may be imported at a preferential customs duty rate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对农产品设定的进口数量额度，额度内适用规定的优惠关税税率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità stabbilita ta' prodotti agrikoli li tista' tiġi importata b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适用于农产品进口的关税配额，即可按规定优惠关税税率进口的农产品数量额度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwota tariffarja għal prodotti agrikoli li tistabbilixxi l-kwantità li tista' tiġi importata b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An agricultural tariff quota specifies how much of an agricultural product can be imported at a preferential customs duty rate.

collocations.en: apply for an agricultural tariff quota
the allocation of an agricultural tariff quota
collocations.zh: 农产品关税配额的分配

formal.mt: Qabel ma timporta l-qamħ, il-kumpanija għandha tivverifika jekk il-kunsinna tistax tidħol taħt kwota tariffarja agrikola.
formal.en: Before importing the wheat, the company should check whether the shipment can enter under an agricultural tariff quota.
formal.zh: 进口小麦之前，公司应核实这批货物能否使用农产品关税配额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal din il-kunsinna ta' qamħ, hemm xi kwota li nistgħu nużaw? David: Ejja niċċekkjaw jekk hemmx kwota tariffarja agrikola disponibbli.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there a quota we can use for this shipment of wheat? David: Let's check whether an agricultural tariff quota is available.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这批小麦有没有可以使用的配额？戴维：我们查查有没有可用的农产品关税配额。

messages.speaker: Lara (粮食采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal din il-kunsinna ta' qamħ, hemm xi kwota li nistgħu nużaw?
messages.mt_standard: Għal din il-kunsinna ta' qamħ, hemm xi kwota li nistgħu nużaw?
messages.zh: 这批小麦有没有可以使用的配额？
messages.en: Is there a quota we can use for this shipment of wheat?

messages.speaker: David (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw jekk hemmx kwota tariffarja agrikola disponibbli.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw jekk hemmx kwota tariffarja agrikola disponibbli.
messages.zh: 我们查查有没有可用的农产品关税配额。
messages.en: Let's check whether an agricultural tariff quota is available.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中把一袋小麦放进“关税配额”框：agrikola 提醒你看商品类别，整个短语指农产品适用的关税配额。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tariff quota established unilaterally by the importing country or customs territory, allowing a specified quantity of goods to enter at a preferential duty rate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由进口国或进口关税区单方面自主设定的关税配额，允许规定数量的货物按优惠关税税率进口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwota tariffarja stabbilita unilateralment mill-pajjiż jew mit-territorju doganali importatur, li tippermetti l-importazzjoni ta' kwantità stabbilita ta' merkanzija b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由进口一方自主决定设立、而非依据与贸易伙伴协商的承诺设立的关税配额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwota tariffarja li l-pajjiż jew it-territorju doganali importatur jistabbilixxi fuq inizjattiva tiegħu stess, aktar milli abbażi ta' impenn innegozjat ma' sieħeb kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An autonomous tariff quota is established by the importing side on its own initiative rather than as a negotiated commitment to a trading partner.

collocations.mt: testendi l-validità ta' kwota tariffarja awtonoma
collocations.en: extend the validity of an autonomous tariff quota
collocations.zh: 延长自主关税配额的有效期

formal.mt: Il-proposta tipprevedi l-ftuħ ta' kwota tariffarja awtonoma biex kwantità limitata ta' materja prima tkun tista' tiġi importata b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju.
formal.en: The proposal provides for opening an autonomous tariff quota so that a limited quantity of raw material can be imported at a preferential duty rate.
formal.zh: 该提案拟开设自主关税配额，使一定数量的原材料能够按优惠关税税率进口。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-kwota ġiet minn ftehim ma' pajjiż ieħor? Mark: Le, hija kwota tariffarja awtonoma; in-naħa importatriċi stabbilietha fuq inizjattiva tagħha stess.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did this quota come from an agreement with another country? Mark: No, it's an autonomous tariff quota; the importing side established it on its own initiative.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个配额是通过与另一个国家签订协议设立的吗？马克：不是，这是自主关税配额，由进口一方自行决定设立。

messages.speaker: Nina (贸易业务学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kwota ġiet minn ftehim ma' pajjiż ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kwota ġiet minn ftehim ma' pajjiż ieħor?
messages.zh: 这个配额是通过与另一个国家签订协议设立的吗？
messages.en: Did this quota come from an agreement with another country?

messages.speaker: Mark (贸易业务导师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija kwota tariffarja awtonoma; in-naħa importatriċi stabbilietha fuq inizjattiva tagħha stess.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija kwota tariffarja awtonoma; in-naħa importatriċi stabbilietha fuq inizjattiva tagħha stess.
messages.zh: 不是，这是自主关税配额，由进口一方自行决定设立。
messages.en: No, it's an autonomous tariff quota; the importing side established it on its own initiative.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awtonoma 与“自主决定”配对记忆：想象进口一方自己设定配额框，记住这里的“自主”描述配额的设立方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A specified quantity of goods that may be imported at a preferential customs duty rate, with a different rate applying beyond that quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对进口货物设定的数量额度，额度内适用优惠关税税率，超出额度的部分适用另一税率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità stabbilita ta' merkanzija li tista' tiġi importata b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju, filwaqt li għall-kwantità li taqbeż il-kwota tapplika rata differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定一定数量进口货物可适用优惠关税税率的配额，超额进口部分适用另一关税税率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwota għall-importazzjoni li tistabbilixxi kemm merkanzija tista' tidħol b'rata preferenzjali ta' dazju, b'rata differenti applikabbli għall-importazzjonijiet li jaqbżu dik il-kwantità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import tariff quota allows a specified quantity of goods to enter at a preferential duty rate, while imports beyond that quantity face a different rate.

collocations.en: apply for an import tariff quota

formal.mt: Qabel ma tikkalkula d-dazju, il-kumpanija għandha tivverifika liema parti tal-kunsinna hija koperta mill-kwota tariffarja tal-importazzjoni.
formal.en: Before calculating the customs duty, the company should check which part of the shipment is covered by the import tariff quota.
formal.zh: 计算关税之前，公司应核实这批货物中有多少属于进口关税配额覆盖范围。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kunsinna kollha tidħol bil-prezz tad-dazju aktar baxx? Toni: Irridu niċċekkjaw kemm fadal mill-kwota tariffarja tal-importazzjoni; jista' jkun li parti taqbiżha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will the whole shipment qualify for the lower duty rate? Toni: We need to check how much of the import tariff quota remains; part of the shipment might exceed it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：整批货物都能适用较低的关税税率吗？托尼：我们得查查进口关税配额还剩多少，可能有部分货物会超出配额。

messages.speaker: Sara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunsinna kollha tidħol bil-prezz tad-dazju aktar baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunsinna kollha tidħol bil-prezz tad-dazju aktar baxx?
messages.zh: 整批货物都能适用较低的关税税率吗？
messages.en: Will the whole shipment qualify for the lower duty rate?

messages.speaker: Toni (报关代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu niċċekkjaw kemm fadal mill-kwota tariffarja tal-importazzjoni; jista' jkun li parti taqbiżha.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu niċċekkjaw kemm fadal mill-kwota tariffarja tal-importazzjoni; jista' jkun li parti taqbiżha.
messages.zh: 我们得查查进口关税配额还剩多少，可能有部分货物会超出配额。
messages.en: We need to check how much of the import tariff quota remains; part of the shipment might exceed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进口货物经过一道计数门：配额内按优惠税率计算，超过额度另算；tal-importazzjoni 提醒你这是用于进口的关税配额。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large waterbird with a long neck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种颈部修长、体形较大的水鸟，即天鹅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir tal-ilma b'għonq twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天鹅，一种颈部修长、体形较大的水鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir li jgħix qrib l-ilma, għandu għonq twil u jgħum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A swan is a large waterbird with a long neck.

collocations.en: a swan swimming in the pond
collocations.zh: 一只在池塘里游泳的天鹅

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara edukattiva, l-istudenti osservaw kżinn jgħum fl-għadira u nnutaw l-għonq twil tiegħu.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the students observed a swan swimming in the pond and noted its long neck.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，学生们观察了一只在池塘里游泳的天鹅，并留意了它修长的颈部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur b'għonqu twil! Leo: Dak kżinn. Qiegħed jgħum bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bird with the long neck! Leo: That's a swan. It's swimming slowly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看那只长脖子的鸟！Leo：那是天鹅。它正在慢慢游泳。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur b'għonqu twil!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur b'għonqu twil!
messages.zh: 看那只长脖子的鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird with the long neck!

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kżinn. Qiegħed jgħum bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kżinn. Qiegħed jgħum bil-mod.
messages.zh: 那是天鹅。它正在慢慢游泳。
messages.en: That's a swan. It's swimming slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kżinn 与池塘里伸着长脖子游泳的天鹅画面绑定，再用“白天鹅”搭配 kżinn abjad 巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 最大的；极度的；尽最大程度的

teaching_sense.en_definition: The greatest degree of strength, ability, or effort possible in a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种情况下，力量、能力或努力所能达到的最大程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ogħla livell ta' saħħa, ħila jew sforz li jista' jintlaħaq f'sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 达到所能达到的最高程度的；最大限度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jilħaq l-ogħla grad possibbli, speċjalment fis-saħħa, fil-ħila jew fl-isforz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use utmost to describe the greatest degree of effort, strength, or ability that is possible.

formal.mt: It-tim wettaq il-ħidma bl-aqwa ħila tiegħu biex itemm il-proġett fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team carried out the work with the utmost skill it could bring to the task in order to finish the project on time.
formal.zh: 团队尽其所能、充分施展本领开展工作，以便按时完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kaxxa għadha ma ċċaqalqitx. Tista' timbotta bl-aqwa saħħa tiegħek? Mark: Iva, ejja nerġgħu nippruvaw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: The box still hasn't moved. Can you push with all your strength? Mark: Yes, let's try again together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：箱子还是没动。你能使出全力推吗？马克：能，我们一起再试一次。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kaxxa għadha ma ċċaqalqitx. Tista' timbotta bl-aqwa saħħa tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kaxxa għadha ma ċċaqalqitx. Tista' timbotta bl-aqwa saħħa tiegħek?
messages.zh: 箱子还是没动。你能使出全力推吗？
messages.en: The box still hasn't moved. Can you push with all your strength?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nerġgħu nippruvaw flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nerġgħu nippruvaw flimkien.
messages.zh: 能，我们一起再试一次。
messages.en: Yes, let's try again together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-aqwa 想成力量刻度升到顶端：配 saħħa 记“使出最大力气”，配 ħila 记“尽最大本领”。

gloss_zh: 阿尔米尔湾（位于梅利哈附近）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a bay situated near Mellieħa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿尔米尔湾的专名，指位于梅利哈附近的一处海湾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' bajja li tinsab fl-inħawi tal-Mellieħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Armier, a bay situated in the environs of Mellieħa
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿尔米尔湾，位于梅利哈附近的一处海湾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Armier huwa l-isem ta' bajja li tinsab fl-inħawi tal-Mellieħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: L-Armier is the name of a bay located in the area around Mellieħa.

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi waqfa fil-bajja tal-Armier, fl-inħawi tal-Mellieħa.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a stop at Armier Bay, near Mellieħa.
formal.zh: 参观行程包括在梅利哈附近的阿尔米尔湾停留。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se mmorru għada? Pawlu: Immorru l-Armier? Sara: Iva, nieħdu xi ħaġa x'nieklu magħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are we going tomorrow? Pawlu: Shall we go to Armier? Sara: Yes, let's take something to eat with us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：明天我们去哪儿？Pawlu：去阿尔米尔湾好吗？Sara：好，我们带点吃的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se mmorru għada?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se mmorru għada?
messages.zh: 明天我们去哪儿？
messages.en: Where are we going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immorru l-Armier?
messages.mt_standard: Immorru l-Armier?
messages.zh: 去阿尔米尔湾好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to Armier?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieħdu xi ħaġa x'nieklu magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħdu xi ħaġa x'nieklu magħna.
messages.zh: 好，我们带点吃的。
messages.en: Yes, let's take something to eat with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 L-Armier 当作地图上的海湾名称来记，在旁边标注 Mellieħa，建立“阿尔米尔湾在梅利哈附近”的位置联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming at the end of a sequence, with no other item following it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于某个顺序或系列的末尾，后面没有其他项目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi fit-tmiem ta' sensiela jew ordni, mingħajr ma jkun hemm ieħor warajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最后的；在一个顺序中处于末位的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fl-aħħar post f'ordni jew f'sensiela u ma jkun hemm xejn ieħor warajh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The last person or thing in a sequence is the one that comes after all the others.

formal.mt: L-aħħar paġna tar-rapport fiha sommarju tar-riżultati.
formal.en: The last page of the report contains a summary of the results.
formal.zh: 报告的最后一页载有结果摘要。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fadal xi biċċa kejk? Mark: Iva, ħu l-aħħar biċċa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any cake left? Mark: Yes, take the last piece.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：还有蛋糕吗？马克：有，拿最后一块吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fadal xi biċċa kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Fadal xi biċċa kejk?
messages.zh: 还有蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Is there any cake left?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu l-aħħar biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu l-aħħar biċċa.
messages.zh: 有，拿最后一块吧。
messages.en: Yes, take the last piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盘子里只剩最后一块蛋糕，用 l-aħħar biċċa 把“最后的”与具体画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The final change in a sequence that significantly alters something's nature or characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一系列变化中最后一次显著改变某事物性质或特征的转变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aħħar bidla f'sensiela ta' bidliet li tbiddel b'mod sinifikanti n-natura jew il-karatteristiċi ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最后一次实质性转变；在一系列变化中，最后一次对事物性质或特征产生显著影响的变化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidla sinifikanti finali f'sensiela ta' bidliet, li permezz tagħha jinbidlu n-natura jew il-karatteristiċi ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The last substantial transformation is the final change that significantly alters the nature or characteristics of something.

collocations.en: the date of the last substantial transformation
collocations.zh: 最后一次实质性转变的日期

collocations.en: the place of the last substantial transformation
collocations.zh: 最后一次实质性转变发生的地点

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-aħħar trasformazzjoni sostanzjali tal-materjal u jispjega kif inbidlu l-karatteristiċi tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the material's last substantial transformation and explains how its characteristics changed.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该材料最后一次实质性转变，并解释了其特征如何发生变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser l-aħħar trasformazzjoni sostanzjali? David: Tfisser l-aħħar bidla kbira li tbiddel in-natura jew il-karatteristiċi ta' xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the last substantial transformation mean? David: It means the final major change that alters something's nature or characteristics.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：最后一次实质性转变是什么意思？戴维：就是最后一次改变某事物性质或特征的重大变化。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser l-aħħar trasformazzjoni sostanzjali?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser l-aħħar trasformazzjoni sostanzjali?
messages.zh: 最后一次实质性转变是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the last substantial transformation mean?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-aħħar bidla kbira li tbiddel in-natura jew il-karatteristiċi ta' xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-aħħar bidla kbira li tbiddel in-natura jew il-karatteristiċi ta' xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 就是最后一次改变某事物性质或特征的重大变化。
messages.en: It means the final major change that alters something's nature or characteristics.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成三块记忆：l-aħħar 是“最后的”，trasformazzjoni 是“转变”，sostanzjali 是“实质性的”；想象加工流程中最后一次使材料明显改变的步骤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wednesday, the day of the week between Tuesday and Thursday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星期三，即星期二之后、星期四之前的一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum tal-ġimgħa li jiġi wara t-Tlieta u qabel il-Ħamis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 星期三；位于星期二和星期四之间的一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem tal-jum tal-ġimgħa li jiġi bejn it-Tlieta u l-Ħamis.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wednesday is the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tal-kumitat se ssir l-Erbgħa li ġej fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The committee meeting will take place next Wednesday at nine in the morning in the main hall.
formal.zh: 委员会会议将于下个星期三上午九点在主厅举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se niltaqgħu għall-kafè? Pawlu: L-Erbgħa filgħodu, jekk jaqbillek.
colloquial.en: Maja: When shall we meet for coffee? Pawlu: Wednesday morning, if that works for you.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：我们什么时候一起喝咖啡？保罗：星期三上午吧，如果你方便的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se niltaqgħu għall-kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se niltaqgħu għall-kafè?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候一起喝咖啡？
messages.en: When shall we meet for coffee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-Erbgħa filgħodu, jekk jaqbillek.
messages.mt_standard: L-Erbgħa filgħodu, jekk jaqbillek.
messages.zh: 星期三上午吧，如果你方便的话。
messages.en: Wednesday morning, if that works for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在周历的星期三格子写上 l-Erbgħa，再配一句“星期三上午喝咖啡”，把词形与固定日程一起记。

gloss_zh: 圣灰星期三；圣灰礼仪日

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ash Wednesday, the Christian observance that marks the beginning of Lent in many Christian traditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣灰星期三，是许多基督宗教传统中标志四旬期开始的宗教纪念日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum reliġjuż li jimmarka l-bidu tar-Randan f'ħafna tradizzjonijiet Insara u li fih isir it-tqegħid tal-irmied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣灰星期三；许多基督宗教传统中四旬期开始的日子，礼仪中会使用圣灰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum tal-Erbgħa li fih jibda r-Randan f'ħafna tradizzjonijiet Insara u jsir rit li jinvolvi t-tqegħid tal-irmied.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ash Wednesday is the day that begins Lent in many Christian traditions and includes the ceremonial use of ashes.

formal.mt: L-avviż tal-parroċċa jindika li l-quddiesa tal-Erbgħa tal-Irmied se tibda fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The parish notice states that the Ash Wednesday Mass will begin at six in the evening.
formal.zh: 堂区公告指出，圣灰星期三弥撒将于傍晚六点开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm l-irmied fuq l-artal illum? Pawlu: Għax illum l-Erbgħa tal-Irmied, il-bidu tar-Randan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there ashes on the altar today? Pawlu: Because today is Ash Wednesday, the beginning of Lent.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：今天祭台上为什么有圣灰？保罗：因为今天是圣灰星期三，是四旬期的开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm l-irmied fuq l-artal illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm l-irmied fuq l-artal illum?
messages.zh: 今天祭台上为什么有圣灰？
messages.en: Why are there ashes on the altar today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax illum l-Erbgħa tal-Irmied, il-bidu tar-Randan.
messages.mt_standard: Għax illum l-Erbgħa tal-Irmied, il-bidu tar-Randan.
messages.zh: 因为今天是圣灰星期三，是四旬期的开始。
messages.en: Because today is Ash Wednesday, the beginning of Lent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-Erbgħa 的星期三日历格与圣灰礼仪画面连起来，再标上“四旬期开始”，整体记住这个节日名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occupying position one in an ordered sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在顺序、次序或排名中处于第一位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi qabel l-oħrajn kollha f'ordni, f'sensiela jew fi klassifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第一，表示在排列、次序或名次中居首的序数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Numru ordinali li juri li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tinsab fil-pożizzjoni ta' qabel l-oħrajn kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is first occupies position one in a sequence or comes before all the others.

formal.mt: L-ewwel kapitlu tar-rapport jippreżenta l-għanijiet tal-proġett.
formal.en: The first chapter of the report presents the project's objectives.
formal.zh: 报告的第一章介绍项目目标。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-ewwel darba li ġejt hawn? Maja: Iva, u diġà jogħġobni l-post. Lara: Mela ħa nurik fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the first time you've been here? Maja: Yes, and I already like the place. Lara: Then let me show you where we can sit.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是你第一次来这里吗？Maja：对，而且我已经喜欢上这个地方了。Lara：那我带你看看我们可以坐哪儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-ewwel darba li ġejt hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-ewwel darba li ġejt hawn?
messages.zh: 这是你第一次来这里吗？
messages.en: Is this the first time you've been here?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u diġà jogħġobni l-post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u diġà jogħġobni l-post.
messages.zh: 对，而且我已经喜欢上这个地方了。
messages.en: Yes, and I already like the place.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħa nurik fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħa nurik fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 那我带你看看我们可以坐哪儿。
messages.en: Then let me show you where we can sit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-ewwel 写在编号一的位置，再搭配 darba 记成第一次、搭配 post 记成第一名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The first dish or stage served in a meal consisting of several courses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一道接一道上菜的餐食中，最先端上的一道菜或第一轮菜品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel platt jew parti minn ikla li fiha jiġu servuti diversi platti wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第一道菜，指由多道菜组成的一餐中最先供应的菜品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-platt li jiġi servut qabel il-platti l-oħra f'ikla magħmula minn diversi korsijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The first course is the dish served at the beginning of a meal that consists of several courses.

formal.mt: Għall-ewwel kors, il-mistednin jistgħu jagħżlu bejn soppa tal-ħaxix u insalata.
formal.en: For the first course, guests may choose between vegetable soup and a salad.
formal.zh: 第一道菜，宾客可选择蔬菜汤或沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nieħdu għall-ewwel kors? Lara: Jien se nieħu s-soppa. U int? Mark: Naħseb nieħu l-insalata.
colloquial.en: Mark: What shall we have for the first course? Lara: I'll have the soup. What about you? Mark: I think I'll have the salad.
colloquial.zh: Mark：第一道菜我们吃什么？Lara：我要汤。你呢？Mark：我想要沙拉。

messages.speaker: Mark (用餐者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nieħdu għall-ewwel kors?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nieħdu għall-ewwel kors?
messages.zh: 第一道菜我们吃什么？
messages.en: What shall we have for the first course?

messages.speaker: Lara (用餐者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nieħu s-soppa. U int?
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nieħu s-soppa. U int?
messages.zh: 我要汤。你呢？
messages.en: I'll have the soup. What about you?

messages.speaker: Mark (用餐者)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb nieħu l-insalata.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb nieħu l-insalata.
messages.zh: 我想要沙拉。
messages.en: I think I'll have the salad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象服务员端来整餐的第一盘菜：l-ewwel 提醒第一，整组 l-ewwel kors 记作第一道菜。

gloss_zh: 首次以低于竞争对手的价格出售

teaching_sense.en_definition: The first instance of selling something at a lower price than a competitor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 首次以低于竞争对手的价格出售商品这一行为或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel każ li fih bejjiegħ ibigħ prodott bi prezz aktar baxx minn dak ta' kompetitur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首次低价竞争出售，指第一次以低于竞争对手的价格出售商品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ewwel okkażjoni li fiha prodott jinbiegħ bi prezz aktar baxx minn dak li jitlob kompetitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A first time undersell occurs when a seller sells something below a competitor's price for the first time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首次以更低价格出售的行为，比较对象是竞争对手的售价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Att ta' bejgħ li jsir għall-ewwel darba bi prezz inqas minn dak ta' bejjiegħ kompetitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A first-time undersell is an initial instance of selling a product for less than a competing seller charges.

collocations.en: to record the first instance of underselling a competitor
collocations.zh: 记录首次以低于竞争对手的价格出售

collocations.en: the company's first instance of underselling a competitor
collocations.zh: 公司首次以低于竞争对手的价格出售

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirreġistra l-ewwel sottokwotazzjoni tal-kumpanija: il-prodott inbiegħ għal tmien ewro, filwaqt li l-kompetitur kien ibigħu għal għaxar ewro.
formal.en: The report records the company's first instance of underselling a competitor: the product sold for eight euros, while the competitor was selling it for ten euros.
formal.zh: 报告记录了公司首次以低于竞争对手的价格出售商品：该商品售价为八欧元，而竞争对手当时的售价为十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din kienet l-ewwel sottokwotazzjoni tagħna? Mark: Iva, għall-ewwel darba biegħna bi prezz inqas mill-ħanut ta' ħdejna. Lara: Sewwa, mela nniżżilha fir-rapport.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was that our first instance of underselling a competitor? Mark: Yes, for the first time we sold at a lower price than the shop next door. Lara: All right, then I'll put it in the report.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是我们第一次以低于竞争对手的价格出售吗？Mark：对，这是我们第一次卖得比隔壁商店便宜。Lara：好，那我把这件事记进报告。

messages.speaker: Lara (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din kienet l-ewwel sottokwotazzjoni tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Din kienet l-ewwel sottokwotazzjoni tagħna?
messages.zh: 这是我们第一次以低于竞争对手的价格出售吗？
messages.en: Was that our first instance of underselling a competitor?

messages.speaker: Mark (店长)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għall-ewwel darba biegħna bi prezz inqas mill-ħanut ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għall-ewwel darba biegħna bi prezz inqas mill-ħanut ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: 对，这是我们第一次卖得比隔壁商店便宜。
messages.en: Yes, for the first time we sold at a lower price than the shop next door.

messages.speaker: Lara (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, mela nniżżilha fir-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, mela nniżżilha fir-rapport.
messages.zh: 好，那我把这件事记进报告。
messages.en: All right, then I'll put it in the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张价签：本店八欧、对手十欧，再标上首次；用这个场景记住整组词，关键是第一次卖得比对手便宜。

gloss_zh: 加迪拉湾（马耳他北部的海湾）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a bay in the northern region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于马耳他北部的一个海湾的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' bajja li tinsab fir-reġjun tat-tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Għadira, a bay in the northern region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加迪拉湾，位于马耳他北部的海湾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Għadira hija bajja li tinsab fir-reġjun tat-tramuntana ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Għadira is the name of a bay situated in the northern region of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-pożizzjoni tal-bajja tal-Għadira fir-reġjun tat-tramuntana ta' Malta.
formal.en: The map shows the location of Għadira Bay in the northern region of Malta.
formal.zh: 地图标出了加迪拉湾在马耳他北部的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd? David: Se mmorru l-Għadira biex inqattgħu ftit ħin ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are we going on Sunday? David: We're going to Għadira to spend some time by the sea.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们星期天去哪里？David：去加迪拉湾，在海边待一会儿。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 我们星期天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going on Sunday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmorru l-Għadira biex inqattgħu ftit ħin ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmorru l-Għadira biex inqattgħu ftit ħin ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 去加迪拉湾，在海边待一会儿。
messages.en: We're going to Għadira to spend some time by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象中的马耳他地图北部画一个海湾，并标注 L-Għadira；把地名、北部位置和海湾景象一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 加尔布（戈佐岛上的小村庄）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a small village on the island of Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于戈佐岛上的一个小村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal żgħir li jinsab fil-gżira ta' Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加尔布，位于戈佐岛上的一个小村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Għarb huwa raħal żgħir li jinsab fil-gżira ta' Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Għarb is the name of a small village situated on the island of Gozo.

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-Għarb, raħal żgħir fil-gżira ta' Għawdex.
formal.en: The guide includes a description of Għarb, a small village on the island of Gozo.
formal.zh: 这本指南介绍了加尔布，一个位于戈佐岛上的小村庄。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn toqgħod? Ġanni: Noqgħod l-Għarb, f'Għawdex. Sara: Nixtieq niġi nżurek xi darba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you live? Ġanni: I live in Għarb, on Gozo. Sara: I'd like to come and visit you sometime.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你住在哪里？Ġanni：我住在戈佐岛的加尔布。Sara：我想找个时间去看你。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn toqgħod?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn toqgħod?
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Noqgħod l-Għarb, f'Għawdex.
messages.mt_standard: Noqgħod l-Għarb, f'Għawdex.
messages.zh: 我住在戈佐岛的加尔布。
messages.en: I live in Għarb, on Gozo.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq niġi nżurek xi darba.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq niġi nżurek xi darba.
messages.zh: 我想找个时间去看你。
messages.en: I'd like to come and visit you sometime.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 L-Għarb 写在一张“戈佐岛小村庄”的地址卡上，再练习 Noqgħod l-Għarb，用“我住在这里”的情境记住地名。

gloss_zh: 加斯里，戈佐岛上的一个小村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: L-Għasri is a small village in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加斯里是戈佐岛上的一个小村庄，其马耳他语地名为 L-Għasri。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-Għasri huwa raħal żgħir fil-gżira ta' Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛上的一个小村庄，名为加斯里。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Għasri huwa raħal żgħir li jinsab f'Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: L-Għasri is the name of a small village on the island of Gozo.

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi mixja qasira fir-raħal tal-Għasri.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a short walk through the village of L-Għasri.
formal.zh: 参观行程包括在加斯里村内短途步行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid iżżur l-Għasri għada? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel mixja fir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to visit L-Għasri tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'd like to take a walk around the village.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天想去加斯里看看吗？马克：想，我想在村里走走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid iżżur l-Għasri għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid iżżur l-Għasri għada?
messages.zh: 你明天想去加斯里看看吗？
messages.en: Do you want to visit L-Għasri tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel mixja fir-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel mixja fir-raħal.
messages.zh: 想，我想在村里走走。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to take a walk around the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 L-Għasri 和“戈佐岛上的小村庄”配成一张地名卡，再用“到村里散步”的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easter is the Christian festival celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 复活节是基督徒庆祝耶稣基督复活的节日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-Għid huwa l-festa Nisranija li fiha jiġi ċċelebrat il-qawmien ta' Ġesù Kristu mill-mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复活节，基督教纪念耶稣基督复活的节日。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Għid huwa festa Nisranija li tfakkar il-qawmien ta' Ġesù Kristu mill-mewt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Easter is the Christian festival at which people celebrate the resurrection of Jesus Christ.

formal.mt: Il-familji se jinġabru għall-ikla tal-Għid il-Ħadd li ġej.
formal.en: The families will gather for the Easter meal next Sunday.
formal.zh: 各家人将于下周日相聚，共进复活节餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel għall-Għid? Mark: Se niekol mal-familja għand in-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to do for Easter? Mark: I'm going to have a meal with the family at Grandma's.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你复活节打算做什么？马克：我要和家人去奶奶家吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tagħmel għall-Għid?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tagħmel għall-Għid?
messages.zh: 你复活节打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do for Easter?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se niekol mal-familja għand in-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Se niekol mal-familja għand in-nanna.
messages.zh: 我要和家人去奶奶家吃饭。
messages.en: I'm going to have a meal with the family at Grandma's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-Għid 写在“复活节”日历格里，再连读 il-Ħadd tal-Għid，用节日和星期日的组合巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Supreme describes someone or something with the highest rank, authority, or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在等级、权威或重要性方面处于最高地位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni tindika lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li għandha l-ogħla grad, awtorità jew importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最高的；在地位、权力或重要性上居于首位的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li tinsab fl-ogħla pożizzjoni f'dak li għandu x'jaqsam ma' grad, setgħa jew importanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is supreme has the highest rank, authority, or importance.

formal.mt: F'din l-organizzazzjoni, il-kunsill huwa l-awtorità l-għola nett.
formal.en: In this organisation, the council is the supreme authority.
formal.zh: 在这个组织中，理事会是最高权力机构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għandu l-aħħar kelma hawn? Mark: Il-kunsill; huwa l-awtorità l-għola nett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who has the final say here? Mark: The council; it is the supreme authority.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里谁有最终决定权？马克：理事会；它是最高权力机构。

messages.speaker: Maja (新成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għandu l-aħħar kelma hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Min għandu l-aħħar kelma hawn?
messages.zh: 这里谁有最终决定权？
messages.en: Who has the final say here?

messages.speaker: Mark (组织成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunsill; huwa l-awtorità l-għola nett.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunsill; huwa l-awtorità l-għola nett.
messages.zh: 理事会；它是最高权力机构。
messages.en: The council; it is the supreme authority.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一座等级金字塔，把 l-għola nett 整体写在塔尖，联系“最高等级、最高权威”两个用法来记忆。

gloss_zh: 下一个；接下来的那个（在顺序语境中）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The next one in a sequence established by the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在上下文已明确的顺序中，指当前这一个之后的那个。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika dak li jiġi wara dak imsemmi f'sekwenza li tkun ċara mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下一个；在已明确的顺序中接着当前项目的那个。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirreferi għal dak li jmiss wara l-oġġett jew l-element li jkun qed jissemma f'sekwenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In an established sequence, the next one is the item that follows the one currently being considered.

collocations.en: move on to the next one

formal.mt: Segwi l-ordni tal-eżerċizzji fuq il-paġna: meta tlesti wieħed, ibda l-ieħor.
formal.en: Follow the order of the exercises on the page: when you finish one, begin the next.
formal.zh: 请按页面上的练习顺序作答：完成一个后，开始下一个。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt l-ewwel eżerċizzju. X'nagħmel issa? Mark: Ibda l-ieħor, dak eżatt taħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've finished the first exercise. What do I do now? Mark: Start the next one, the one directly below it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我做完第一道练习了。现在做什么？马克：开始做下一道，就是它正下方的那道。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt l-ewwel eżerċizzju. X'nagħmel issa?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt l-ewwel eżerċizzju. X'nagħmel issa?
messages.zh: 我做完第一道练习了。现在做什么？
messages.en: I've finished the first exercise. What do I do now?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda l-ieħor, dak eżatt taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda l-ieħor, dak eżatt taħtu.
messages.zh: 开始做下一道，就是它正下方的那道。
messages.en: Start the next one, the one directly below it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象按顺序做练习：做完眼前这个，再指向下一个说 l-ieħor；借助明确的排列顺序记住这里的“下一个”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate the greatest degree, amount, or extent within a comparison.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于比较，表示某种性质、数量或程度达到最高或最大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika l-ogħla grad, l-akbar kwantità jew l-akbar firxa meta jsir paragun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在比较范围内程度最高、数量最多或幅度最大。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tilħaq l-ogħla grad jew l-akbar kwantità fost dawk li jkunu qed jitqabblu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use most to indicate the greatest degree or amount among the things being compared.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Identical to something else, unchanged, or referring to the very person or thing already mentioned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与另一事物相同、没有变化，或指前面已经提及的同一个人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa li ma tkunx differenti minn oħra, li ma tkunx inbidlet, jew li tkun proprju dik li ssemmiet qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在所比较的特征或性质上相同的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuni jew affarijiet li għandhom l-istess karatteristiċi jew kwalitajiet meta jitqabblu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If two things are alike, they share the features or qualities being compared.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与前一项相同的；所指内容同上的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li l-kontenut ta' oġġett jew ta' entrata huwa l-istess bħal dak li ssemma jew inkiteb qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An item described as ditto has the same content or details as the preceding item.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同一个的；与所指对象完全相同的；未改变的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika proprju l-persuna jew il-ħaġa msemmija, jew persuna jew ħaġa li ma nbidlitx jew li ma hijiex differenti minn oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use same to identify one particular person or thing again, or to say that something has not changed.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti kollha rċevew l-istess struzzjonijiet bil-miktub.

formal.zh: 所有参与者都收到了相同的书面说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a later time, in the future, or at a point further along in something.

gloss_zh: 词条标记；所附说明为英语拼写勘误

teaching_sense.en_definition: A headword label accompanied by a note correcting the English spelling 'lenght' to 'length'; the supplied packet does not establish its lexical meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个附有英语拼写勘误说明的词条标记：应将 lenght 改为 length；所给资料未说明该标记本身的词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta ta' entrata b'nota li tikkoreġi l-kelma Ingliża 'lenght' għal 'length'; il-materjal mogħti ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira lessikali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在 https://mlrs.research.um.edu.mt/resources/gabra/lexemes/view/560bfb4c36632b69157e7340 页面中，英语拼写“lenght”应改为“length”。这是勘误说明，未提供该词条的实际词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nota editorjali li tindika li, fil-paġna https://mlrs.research.um.edu.mt/resources/gabra/lexemes/view/560bfb4c36632b69157e7340, il-forma Ingliża 'lenght' għandha tinbidel għal 'length', mingħajr ma tagħti tifsira lessikali għall-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This note tells the reader to replace the misspelling 'lenght' with 'length' on the specified page, rather than providing a lexical definition.

formal.mt: In-nota tal-entrata 'l-w-j' tindika li l-kelma Ingliża 'lenght' għandha tinkiteb 'length'; ma tagħtix definizzjoni tal-entrata.
formal.en: The note for the entry 'l-w-j' states that the English word 'lenght' should be written 'length'; it does not define the entry.
formal.zh: “l-w-j”词条的说明指出，英语单词“lenght”应写作“length”；该说明并未给出词条定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tgħid in-nota dwar 'l-w-j'? Mark: Tgħid li 'lenght' għandha tkun 'length', imma ma tispjegax xi tfisser l-entrata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the note about 'l-w-j' say? Mark: It says 'lenght' should be 'length', but it does not explain what the entry means.
colloquial.zh: Maja：关于“l-w-j”的说明写了什么？Mark：它说“lenght”应改为“length”，但没有解释这个词条的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A complicated arrangement of passages or paths in which it is difficult to find your way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由复杂通道或路径构成、让人难以辨认方向或找到出口的迷宫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' passaġġi jew mogħdijiet imħabbla li fiha jkun diffiċli ssib it-triq jew il-ħruġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迷宫；通道交错、令人难以辨认方向的复杂空间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post b'ħafna passaġġi mħabbla li jagħmluha diffiċli ssib it-triq minn ġo fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A labyrinth is a place with complicated passages where finding your way is difficult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迷宫；由曲折分岔的路径构成、需要寻找正确路线或出口的布局。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' mogħdijiet li jduru u jinfirdu, fejn trid issib it-triq it-tajba sal-ħruġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A maze is an arrangement of paths in which you must find the correct route.

collocations.en: to find the way out of the maze
