messages.zh: 是啊，这个迷宫真难走！我们试试左边那条路吧。
messages.en: Yes, this maze is difficult! Let's try the path on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 labirint 时想象自己站在迷宫岔路口，总绕回原处；把“找出口”与 issib il-ħruġ mil-labirint 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin, hollow needle used with a syringe to inject liquid into the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与注射器配合使用、将液体注入体内的细而中空的针头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Labra rqiqa u vojta minn ġewwa li tintuża ma' siringa biex jiddaħħal likwidu fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 注射针头，用于配合注射器将液体注入体内的中空细针。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Labra rqiqa b'passaġġ minn ġewwa, li titwaħħal ma' siringa u tintuża biex jiddaħħal likwidu fil-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An injection needle is a thin, hollow needle used to introduce liquid into the body.

collocations.en: a packet containing an injection needle

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliema wriet stampa ta' labra tal-injezzjoni u spjegat kif din tintuża ma' siringa.
formal.en: In the lesson, the teacher showed a picture of an injection needle and explained how it is used with a syringe.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师展示了一张注射针头的图片，并讲解了它如何与注射器配合使用。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif ngħidha bil-Malti, dik il-labra li tintuża ma' siringa? Paul: Tgħid labra tal-injezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lina: How do I say the name of that needle used with a syringe in Maltese? Paul: You say labra tal-injezzjoni.
colloquial.zh: Lina：那种配合注射器使用的针，用马耳他语怎么说？Paul：说 labra tal-injezzjoni。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ngħidha bil-Malti, dik il-labra li tintuża ma' siringa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ngħidha bil-Malti, dik il-labra li tintuża ma' siringa?
messages.zh: 那种配合注射器使用的针，用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say the name of that needle used with a syringe in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Paul (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħid labra tal-injezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħid labra tal-injezzjoni.
messages.zh: 说 labra tal-injezzjoni。
messages.en: You say labra tal-injezzjoni.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语 labra tal-injezzjoni 贴在“注射器前端细针头”的图片旁，连同注射场景一起记住其用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pin with a spring mechanism and a clasp that covers its sharp point when closed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有弹性结构和扣合装置、闭合时能遮住尖端的别针，即安全别针。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Labra b'molla u b'għeluq li jgħatti l-ponta tagħha meta tingħalaq, u li tintuża biex iżżomm biċċiet ta' drapp flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安全别针；闭合后尖端收进扣内、常用于固定布料的别针。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Labra b'molla li tista' tinfetaħ u tingħalaq, bil-ponta tidħol f'għeluq li jgħattiha, biex iżżomm drapp jew ħwejjeġ flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A safety pin is a pin whose sharp point is covered by a clasp when closed.

collocations.en: to fasten with a safety pin

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-ħjata, l-għalliema użat labra tal-molla biex iżżomm żewġ biċċiet ta' drapp flimkien.
formal.en: In the sewing lesson, the teacher used a safety pin to hold two pieces of fabric together.
formal.zh: 缝纫课上，老师用一枚安全别针把两块布固定在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek labra tal-molla? Irrid inżomm dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet ta' drapp flimkien. Rita: Iva, hawn waħda żgħira fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a safety pin? I want to hold these two pieces of fabric together. Rita: Yes, there's a small one here in the sewing box.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有安全别针吗？我想把这两块布固定在一起。Rita：有，缝纫盒里这里有一枚小的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek labra tal-molla? Irrid inżomm dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet ta' drapp flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek labra tal-molla? Irrid inżomm dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet ta' drapp flimkien.
messages.zh: 你有安全别针吗？我想把这两块布固定在一起。
messages.en: Do you have a safety pin? I want to hold these two pieces of fabric together.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn waħda żgħira fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn waħda żgħira fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata.
messages.zh: 有，缝纫盒里这里有一枚小的。
messages.en: Yes, there's a small one here in the sewing box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 labra tal-molla，就想象安全别针打开再扣上的动作：尖端扣进小罩里，两块布随之固定，帮助整词记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hairpin with two close arms, used to hold hair in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于固定头发的小型双臂发夹，通常称为一字夹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Labra żgħira b'żewġ dirgħajn qrib xulxin li tintuża biex iżżomm ix-xagħar f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一字发夹；用于夹住并固定头发的小发夹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Labra żgħira b'żewġ dirgħajn qrib xulxin li taqbad ix-xagħar bejniethom u żżommu f'postu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bobby pin is a small hairpin that grips your hair and holds it in place.

collocations.en: hold hair in place with a bobby pin

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, iż-żeffiena użat labra tar-ras biex iżżomm troffa xagħar f'postha.
formal.en: Before the performance, the dancer used a bobby pin to hold a lock of hair in place.
formal.zh: 演出前，舞者用一字发夹固定了一绺头发。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek labra tar-ras? Ix-xagħar qed jaqa' fuq għajnejja. Lara: Iva, ħu din u waħħal it-troffa biha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a bobby pin? My hair keeps falling over my eyes. Lara: Yes, take this one and use it to pin that lock of hair back.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有一字发夹吗？我的头发老是垂到眼前。Lara：有，拿这个，把那绺头发夹好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek labra tar-ras? Ix-xagħar qed jaqa' fuq għajnejja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek labra tar-ras? Ix-xagħar qed jaqa' fuq għajnejja.
messages.zh: 你有一字发夹吗？我的头发老是垂到眼前。
messages.en: Do you have a bobby pin? My hair keeps falling over my eyes.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din u waħħal it-troffa biha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din u waħħal it-troffa biha.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个，把那绺头发夹好。
messages.en: Yes, take this one and use it to pin that lock of hair back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一字发夹夹住额前碎发，把整个短语与“固定头发”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pin with a clasp that covers its sharp point, used to fasten fabric.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有扣合装置、闭合时能遮住尖端的别针，用于固定布料或衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Labra b'għeluq li jgħatti l-ponta tagħha meta tingħalaq, u li tintuża biex taqbad id-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安全别针；尖端可扣入护扣内、用于扣住布料或衣物的别针。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Labra li tintuża biex taqbad biċċiet tad-drapp flimkien u li għandha għeluq biex il-ponta ma tibqax mikxufa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A safety pin fastens pieces of fabric together and has a clasp that covers its sharp point.

collocations.en: secure a piece of fabric with a safety pin
collocations.zh: 用安全别针固定一块布料

formal.mt: Waħħal iż-żewġ biċċiet tad-drapp b'labra tas-sarwal u kun żgur li l-ponta tkun mgħottija.
formal.en: Fasten the two pieces of fabric together with a safety pin and make sure the point is covered.
formal.zh: 用安全别针把两块布料扣在一起，并确保尖端已被护扣遮住。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek labra tas-sarwal? Inqatgħetli l-buttuna. Rita: Iva, ħu din biex iżżomm il-qalziet magħluq għalissa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a safety pin? My button came off. Rita: Yes, take this one to keep your trousers fastened for now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你有安全别针吗？我的纽扣掉了。Rita：有，拿这个，先把裤子扣住。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek labra tas-sarwal? Inqatgħetli l-buttuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek labra tas-sarwal? Inqatgħetli l-buttuna.
messages.zh: 你有安全别针吗？我的纽扣掉了。
messages.en: Do you have a safety pin? My button came off.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din biex iżżomm il-qalziet magħluq għalissa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din biex iżżomm il-qalziet magħluq għalissa.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个，先把裤子扣住。
messages.en: Yes, take this one to keep your trousers fastened for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裤子纽扣掉了，用一枚扣住尖端的安全别针应急，把短语和这个场景绑定。

gloss_zh: 工党支持者；支持工党的；与工党有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports the Labour Party.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持工党的人，不一定具有正式党员身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġa lill-Partit Laburista, kemm jekk tkun membru tiegħu kif ukoll jekk le.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工党支持者；拥护工党的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti l-appoġġ politiku tagħha lill-Partit Laburista.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A labourite is someone who supports the Labour Party and its political aims.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工党的支持者；在政治上支持工党的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taqbel mal-Partit Laburista u tagħtih l-appoġġ tagħha, mingħajr ma bilfors tkun membru tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supporter of the Labour Party gives that party political support without necessarily being a member.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支持工党的；用于描述在政治上拥护工党的人或立场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappoġġa lill-Partit Laburista jew li jesprimi appoġġ għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as labourite supports the Labour Party in their political views or choices.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与工党有关的；属于工党或涉及其组织、活动及事务的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Partit Laburista, mal-organizzazzjoni tiegħu jew mal-attivitajiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as labourite is connected with the Labour Party, its organization, or its activities.

collocations.en: a voter who supports the Labour Party

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, il-parteċipant qal li kien laburist iżda ma kienx membru tal-partit.
formal.en: In the interview, the participant said that he was a Labour Party supporter but was not a party member.
formal.zh: 访谈中，参与者表示自己支持工党，但并不是该党的党员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu laburist? Mark: Iva, jappoġġa lill-Partit Laburista, imma mhux membru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu a Labour Party supporter? Mark: Yes, he supports the Labour Party, but he isn't a member.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu是工党支持者吗？Mark：是，他支持工党，不过不是党员。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu laburist?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu laburist?
messages.zh: Pawlu是工党支持者吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu a Labour Party supporter?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jappoġġa lill-Partit Laburista, imma mhux membru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jappoġġa lill-Partit Laburista, imma mhux membru.
messages.zh: 是，他支持工党，不过不是党员。
messages.en: Yes, he supports the Labour Party, but he isn't a member.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个搭配分清词性：指人时记“工党支持者”，修饰选民或纲领时记“支持工党的／与工党有关的”。

gloss_zh: 我们玩了；我们参加了游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning that we took part in a game or playful activity in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示包括说话者在内的多个人过去玩过或参加过某项游戏的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li aħna ħadna sehem f'logħba jew f'attività ta' logħob fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们玩了；我们进行过游戏或体育活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li aħna konna involuti f'logħba jew f'attività ta' logħob f'ħin li għadda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to say that you and other people took part in a game or playful activity.

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività tal-iskola, lgħabna logħba li għenitna nipprattikaw il-kliem il-ġdid.
formal.en: During the school activity, we played a game that helped us practise the new vocabulary.
formal.zh: 在学校活动中，我们玩了一个帮助我们练习新词汇的游戏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamiltu wara l-iskola? Pawlu: Lgħabna l-futbol fil-park.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you do after school? Pawlu: We played football in the park.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们放学后做了什么？保罗：我们在公园踢了足球。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamiltu wara l-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamiltu wara l-iskola?
messages.zh: 你们放学后做了什么？
messages.en: What did you do after school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lgħabna l-futbol fil-park.
messages.mt_standard: Lgħabna l-futbol fil-park.
messages.zh: 我们在公园踢了足球。
messages.en: We played football in the park.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与一群朋友踢完球后的合照联系起来，整句记成“我们玩了”，同时记住例句中的标准写法 lgħabna。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decorative item used to adorn a Christmas tree or another place at Christmas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣诞节期间用来装饰圣诞树或其他地方的装饰物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett dekorattiv li jintuża biex iżejjen siġra tal-Milied jew xi post ieħor fi żmien il-Milied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞装饰物；在圣诞节期间用来布置环境、增添节日气氛的装饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dekorazzjoni li titqiegħed fuq siġra tal-Milied jew f'post ieħor biex iżżejjen l-ambjent għall-Milied.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A laminetta is a Christmas decoration used to give a tree or another place a festive appearance.

collocations.en: a Christmas decoration on the Christmas tree
collocations.zh: 圣诞树上的圣诞装饰物
我们用圣诞装饰物来布置

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-Milied, l-istudenti poġġew il-laminetta fuq is-siġra fis-sala.
formal.en: For the Christmas event, the students placed the Christmas decoration on the tree in the hall.
formal.zh: 为了准备圣诞活动，学生们把圣诞装饰物放在大厅里的树上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi l-laminetta? Marija: Poġġiha fuq is-siġra tal-Milied, ħdejn l-istilla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall I put the Christmas decoration? Marija: Put it on the Christmas tree, next to the star.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我把这个圣诞装饰物放在哪里？玛丽娅：放在圣诞树上，星星旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi l-laminetta?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi l-laminetta?
messages.zh: 我把这个圣诞装饰物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the Christmas decoration?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fuq is-siġra tal-Milied, ħdejn l-istilla.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fuq is-siġra tal-Milied, ħdejn l-istilla.
messages.zh: 放在圣诞树上，星星旁边。
messages.en: Put it on the Christmas tree, next to the star.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家人布置圣诞树时递来一件装饰物，一边放好一边说 laminetta，把词与圣诞布置的动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, soft fruit, usually red, made up of many tiny rounded parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小而柔软、通常呈红色的水果，由许多细小的圆粒聚合而成，即覆盆子或树莓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta żgħira u ratba, ġeneralment ħamra, magħmula minn ħafna boċċi ċkejknin magħqudin flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 覆盆子，亦称树莓；一种由许多小圆粒聚合而成的柔软水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lampuna hija frotta żgħira u ratba, ġeneralment ħamra, li tittiekel friska jew tintuża fil-ħelu u fil-ġamm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A raspberry is a small, soft fruit that is usually red and consists of many tiny rounded parts.

formal.mt: Qabel isservi d-deżerta, poġġi lampuna friska fuq kull porzjon.
formal.en: Before serving the dessert, place a fresh raspberry on each portion.
formal.zh: 端上甜点前，在每份上放一颗新鲜覆盆子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid lampuna? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Din misjura sew!
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a raspberry? Mark: Yes, thanks. This one is really ripe!
colloquial.zh: Maja：想吃一颗覆盆子吗？Mark：好呀，谢谢。这颗熟得真好！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid lampuna?
messages.mt_standard: Trid lampuna?
messages.zh: 想吃一颗覆盆子吗？
messages.en: Would you like a raspberry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Din misjura sew!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Din misjura sew!
messages.zh: 好呀，谢谢。这颗熟得真好！
messages.en: Yes, thanks. This one is really ripe!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lampuna 和甜点上的一颗红色覆盆子联系起来，边想象边读 lampuna friska，记住它指一颗柔软的小水果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to emphasize that something minimal or expected does not happen or is not true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于强调连最低限度或原本预期会发生的事情都没有发生，表示“甚至不”或“连……都不”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tenfasizza li xi ħaġa ma seħħitx jew mhijiex vera, anki meta kienet mistennija jew kienet l-inqas ħaġa li setgħet issir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甚至不；连某种最低限度、简单或预期的情况都不成立。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni avverbjali li turi b'enfasi li lanqas l-inqas ħaġa mistennija ma saret jew ma hija vera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use not even to emphasize that something minimal or expected does not happen or is not true.

collocations.en: he has not even heard of it

formal.mt: L-applikant lanqas biss ippreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa.
formal.en: The applicant did not even submit the required documents.
formal.zh: 申请人甚至连所需文件都没有提交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt il-messaġġ tiegħi? Mark: Le, lanqas biss ftaħtu. Issa naqrah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you read my message? Mark: No, I have not even opened it. I will read it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看我的消息了吗？Mark：没有，我连打开都还没打开。我现在看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-messaġġ tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-messaġġ tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你看我的消息了吗？
messages.en: Did you read my message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, lanqas biss ftaħtu. Issa naqrah.
messages.mt_standard: Le, lanqas biss ftaħtu. Issa naqrah.
messages.zh: 没有，我连打开都还没打开。我现在看。
messages.en: No, I have not even opened it. I will read it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lanqas biss 整体对应中文“连……都不”：想象消息还没读，甚至连打开这一步都没做，体会它加强否定的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lamp with a protective covering, often designed to be carried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种光源外有保护罩、通常便于携带的灯，如提灯或灯笼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa b'għata li tipproteġi s-sors tad-dawl, ħafna drabi magħmula biex tkun tista' tinġarr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提灯；灯笼；光源外有保护罩、常用于随身携带照明的灯具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-lanterna hija lampa li għandha s-sors tad-dawl protett b'għata u li spiss tista' tinġarr minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lantern is a lamp with a protective covering that can often be carried from place to place.

collocations.en: to light or switch on the lantern

formal.mt: Għall-kampeġġ, ġibu lanterna biex iddawlu t-tinda billejl.
formal.en: For the camping trip, bring a lantern to light the tent at night.
formal.zh: 露营时请带一盏提灯，以便夜间照亮帐篷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-lanterna? Qed jidlam. Mark: Hawn ħdejn it-tinda. Issa nixgħelha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the lantern? It is getting dark. Mark: Here beside the tent. I will switch it on now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：提灯在哪儿？天快黑了。Mark：就在帐篷旁边。我现在打开它。

messages.speaker: Maja (露营伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-lanterna? Qed jidlam.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-lanterna? Qed jidlam.
messages.zh: 提灯在哪儿？天快黑了。
messages.en: Where is the lantern? It is getting dark.

messages.speaker: Mark (露营伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ħdejn it-tinda. Issa nixgħelha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ħdejn it-tinda. Issa nixgħelha.
messages.zh: 就在帐篷旁边。我现在打开它。
messages.en: Here beside the tent. I will switch it on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借助 lanterna 与英语 lantern 的拼写相似来记忆，再想象夜间帐篷旁亮起的提灯，把词形和照明场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stone marking a grave, usually bearing the deceased person's name and dates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标示坟墓的石碑，通常刻有逝者姓名及生卒日期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla li timmarka qabar u li ġeneralment ikollha miktubin fuqha isem il-mejjet u d-dati tat-twelid u tal-mewt tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 墓碑；立于或置于坟墓处、通常刻有逝者姓名和生卒日期的石碑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lapid huwa ġebla fuq qabar jew ħdejh li tfakkar lill-persuna midfuna hemm, ġeneralment b'isimha u bid-dati tat-twelid u tal-mewt tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gravestone, tombstone, or headstone is a stone marking a grave, usually inscribed with information about the person buried there.

formal.mt: Fuq il-lapid hemm imnaqqxin l-isem tal-mejjet u d-dati tat-twelid u tal-mewt tiegħu.
formal.en: The deceased person's name and dates of birth and death are engraved on the gravestone.
formal.zh: 墓碑上刻有逝者姓名及其生卒日期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' taqra x'hemm miktub fuq il-lapid? Mark: Iva, hawn l-isem tan-nannu u d-data tal-mewt tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you read what is written on the gravestone? Mark: Yes, here is Grandpa's name and the date of his death.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能看清墓碑上写的内容吗？Mark：能，这里是爷爷的名字和去世日期。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' taqra x'hemm miktub fuq il-lapid?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' taqra x'hemm miktub fuq il-lapid?
messages.zh: 你能看清墓碑上写的内容吗？
messages.en: Can you read what is written on the gravestone?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn l-isem tan-nannu u d-data tal-mewt tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn l-isem tan-nannu u d-data tal-mewt tiegħu.
messages.zh: 能，这里是爷爷的名字和去世日期。
messages.en: Yes, here is Grandpa's name and the date of his death.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lapid 放进“墓碑上刻着姓名和日期”的画面里，配合 fuq il-lapid（在墓碑上）一起记忆，稳固它与墓地场景的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stone bearing an inscription that commemorates a person or event, or marks a grave.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刻有文字、用来纪念人物或事件，或标示坟墓的石碑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla b'kitba li tfakkar persuna jew ġrajja, jew li timmarka qabar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为纪念某个人物或事件而设置、通常刻有文字的石碑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġebla li titqiegħed biex tfakkar persuna jew ġrajja u li ġeneralment ikollha kitba fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commemorative stone is a stone placed somewhere to preserve the memory of a person or event.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立于或置于坟墓上、通常刻有死者姓名及生卒日期的墓碑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġebla fuq qabar li ġeneralment ikollha isem il-mejjet u d-dati tat-twelid u tal-mewt tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tombstone is a stone marking a grave, usually bearing the dead person's name and dates.

formal.mt: Tqiegħdet lapida kommemorattiva ħdejn id-daħla tal-iskola biex tfakkar lill-ewwel għalliema tagħha.
formal.en: A commemorative stone was placed near the school entrance to honour its first teachers.
formal.zh: 学校入口附近设置了一块纪念石碑，以纪念最早在该校任教的教师。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm miktub fuq dik il-lapida? Pawlu: Hemm isem in-nannu u d-dati tat-twelid u tal-mewt tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is written on that tombstone? Pawlu: It has Grandpa's name and his dates of birth and death.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那块墓碑上写着什么？保罗：上面有爷爷的姓名和生卒日期。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm miktub fuq dik il-lapida?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm miktub fuq dik il-lapida?
messages.zh: 那块墓碑上写着什么？
messages.en: What is written on that tombstone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm isem in-nannu u d-dati tat-twelid u tal-mewt tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm isem in-nannu u d-dati tat-twelid u tal-mewt tiegħu.
messages.zh: 上面有爷爷的姓名和生卒日期。
messages.en: It has Grandpa's name and his dates of birth and death.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lapida 配上一幅刻字石碑的图：放在公共场所纪念人物，放在坟墓上则是墓碑，用位置区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument with a solid core, usually graphite enclosed in wood, used for writing or drawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于书写或绘画的工具，通常由木杆包裹石墨笔芯制成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda għall-kitba jew għat-tpinġija li ġeneralment ikollha qalba tal-grafit magħluqa fl-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常以木杆包裹石墨笔芯、用于书写或绘画且笔迹一般可以擦除的铅笔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex tikteb jew tpinġi, ġeneralment magħmula minn qalba tal-grafit fl-injam, u li l-marki tagħha normalment jistgħu jitħassru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pencil is an instrument used for writing or drawing that usually makes marks you can erase.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jużaw lapis biex jimlew it-tabella, sabiex ikunu jistgħu jħassru kwalunkwe żball.
formal.en: Students should use a pencil to fill in the table so that they can erase any mistakes.
formal.zh: 学生应使用铅笔填写表格，以便擦除任何错误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek lapis żejjed? Tlift tiegħi. Mark: Iva, ħu dan. Għandu ponta tajba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a spare pencil? I lost mine. Mark: Yes, take this one. It has a good point.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有多余的铅笔吗？我的丢了。马克：有，拿这支吧，笔尖挺好。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lapis żejjed? Tlift tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lapis żejjed? Tlift tiegħi.
messages.zh: 你有多余的铅笔吗？我的丢了。
messages.en: Do you have a spare pencil? I lost mine.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan. Għandu ponta tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan. Għandu ponta tajba.
messages.zh: 有，拿这支吧，笔尖挺好。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. It has a good point.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 lapis 就想象铅笔写错后用橡皮擦掉；把“书写、绘画、可擦除”三个画面连起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit another person or object while moving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在移动过程中撞到另一个人或物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabat ma' persuna jew oġġett waqt li kien miexi jew jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在运动中与另一个人或物体发生碰撞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħabat ma' persuna jew ma' xi ħaġa oħra waqt il-moviment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something collides with another person or object, they hit it while moving.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-vann laqat ma' ħajt waqt li kien idur f'triq dejqa.
formal.en: According to the report, the van collided with a wall while turning into a narrow street.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这辆厢式货车在转入一条狭窄街道时撞上了一堵墙。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara minn quddiem tal-vann? Ġużeppi: Lbieraħ laqat ma' arblu waqt li kont qed nipparkja.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to the front of the van? Ġużeppi: Yesterday it hit a pole while I was parking.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：货车前面怎么了？朱塞佩：昨天我停车时，车撞上了一根杆子。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara minn quddiem tal-vann?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara minn quddiem tal-vann?
messages.zh: 货车前面怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the front of the van?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Lbieraħ laqat ma' arblu waqt li kont qed nipparkja.
messages.mt_standard: Lbieraħ laqat ma' arblu waqt li kont qed nipparkja.
messages.zh: 昨天我停车时，车撞上了一根杆子。
messages.en: Yesterday it hit a pole while I was parking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laqat ma' 作为“撞上……”整块记忆：脑中播放车撞到墙的画面，再在 ma' 后接被撞到的物体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A round citrus fruit with a peel and juicy flesh divided into segments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种圆形柑橘类水果，有果皮，内部由多汁的果瓣组成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta taċ-ċitru tonda, b'qoxra minn barra u flieli mimlijin meraq minn ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橙子；一种果肉多汁、分成果瓣的柑橘类水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Larinġa hija frotta taċ-ċitru li għandha qoxra u flieli mimlijin meraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An orange is a round citrus fruit with juicy flesh divided into segments.

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jġib larinġa għal-lezzjoni dwar il-frott.
formal.en: Each student should bring an orange for the lesson about fruit.
formal.zh: 每位学生应带一个橙子来上水果主题课。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid larinġa? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Tista' tqaxxarhieli?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like an orange? Mark: Yes, please. Can you peel it for me?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想吃个橙子吗？Mark：想，谢谢。你能帮我剥皮吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid larinġa?
messages.mt_standard: Trid larinġa?
messages.zh: 你想吃个橙子吗？
messages.en: Would you like an orange?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Tista' tqaxxarhieli?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Tista' tqaxxarhieli?
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。你能帮我剥皮吗？
messages.en: Yes, please. Can you peel it for me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 larinġa 和剥皮、分果瓣、榨汁三个动作一起记：脑中拿起一个橙子，再说出这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stretchy band used to hold things together or keep something in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够拉伸并回缩、用于捆住物品或固定位置的橡皮筋或松紧带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faxxa jew ħolqa elastika li tiġġebbed u terġa' tiċkien, u tintuża biex iżżomm affarijiet flimkien jew f'posthom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橡皮筋；用橡胶制成、可伸缩并用于捆束物品的环状带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħolqa tal-gomma li tiġġebbed u tintuża biex iżżomm oġġetti flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rubber band is a stretchy rubber loop used to hold objects together.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松紧带；能够拉伸并回缩、用于束紧或固定的带子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faxxa elastika li tista' tiġġebbed u terġa' tiċkien, u tintuża biex iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An elastic band is a flexible strip or loop that stretches to secure something in place.

collocations.en: to fasten with a rubber band

formal.mt: Żomm il-karti flimkien b'lasktuwa qabel ma tpoġġihom fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: Hold the papers together with a rubber band before putting them in the box.
formal.zh: 把这些纸放进盒子前，先用橡皮筋将它们捆在一起。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek lasktuwa biex norbot dawn il-karti? Ben: Iva, hawn waħda. Lara: Grazzi, din tajba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a rubber band to hold these papers together? Ben: Yes, here's one. Lara: Thanks, this one will do.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有橡皮筋吗？我想把这些纸捆起来。Ben：有，这里有一根。Lara：谢谢，这根合适。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lasktuwa biex norbot dawn il-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lasktuwa biex norbot dawn il-karti?
messages.zh: 你有橡皮筋吗？我想把这些纸捆起来。
messages.en: Do you have a rubber band to hold these papers together?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn waħda.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一根。
messages.en: Yes, here's one.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, din tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, din tajba.
messages.zh: 谢谢，这根合适。
messages.en: Thanks, this one will do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lasktuwa 时想象拉长再松开一根橡皮筋：用“能伸缩、能束紧”的共同画面串起橡皮筋和松紧带两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long rigid pole, or the shaft attached to a boat's rudder through which the rudder is turned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长而坚硬的杆；在船舶语境中也指与舵相连、传递转动以操纵舵的舵杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga twila u riġida, jew xaft imqabbad mat-tmun ta' dgħajsa li permezz tiegħu jiddawwar it-tmun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舵杆；与船舵相连、用于传递转动并使舵转向的轴杆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xaft imqabbad mat-tmun ta' bastiment li jittrasmetti l-moviment biex idawwar it-tmun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rudderstock is the shaft attached to a vessel's rudder through which turning movement is transmitted.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长杆；通常用于支撑、固定或其他用途的长而坚硬的杆状物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Virga twila u riġida li tintuża biex iżżomm jew issostni xi ħaġa, jew għal skop ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pole is a long rigid object used for support or another practical purpose.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, it-tekniku spezzjona l-lasta tat-tmun biex jiżgura li kienet f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before departure, the technician inspected the rudderstock to ensure that it was in good condition.
formal.zh: 出发前，技术人员检查了舵杆，以确保其状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tgħaddili dik il-lasta tal-injam? Toni: Din it-twila? Nina: Iva, se nużaha biex insostni l-pjanta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you pass me that wooden pole? Toni: The long one? Nina: Yes, I'm going to use it to support the plant.
colloquial.zh: Nina：能把那根木杆递给我吗？Toni：长的这根吗？Nina：对，我要用它支撑这株植物。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili dik il-lasta tal-injam?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili dik il-lasta tal-injam?
messages.zh: 能把那根木杆递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me that wooden pole?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-twila?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-twila?
messages.zh: 长的这根吗？
messages.en: The long one?

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nużaha biex insostni l-pjanta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nużaha biex insostni l-pjanta.
messages.zh: 对，我要用它支撑这株植物。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to use it to support the plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 lasta 配两幅学习图：花园里支撑植物的长杆，以及船上连接舵的轴杆；用所在场景区分“长杆”和“舵杆”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stretchy material, such as elastic or rubber; the supplied senses also include latex.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以拉伸的弹性材料，可指松紧材料或橡胶；所给义项还包括乳胶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jista' jiġġebbed, bħal materjal elastiku jew gomma; it-tifsiriet mogħtija jinkludu wkoll il-lattiċe.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可拉伸并恢复原状的松紧材料，常用于固定物品或制作衣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li jiġġebbed u jerġa' jieħu l-forma tiegħu, u li jintuża biex iżomm affarijiet flimkien jew f'partijiet tal-ħwejjeġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Elastic is a stretchy material used to hold things together or make parts of clothing fit closely.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有弹性、可用于制造多种物品的橡胶材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal flessibbli u elastiku li jintuża biex isiru diversi oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rubber is a flexible, elastic material used to make many everyday objects.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳胶，即可用于制作橡胶制品的乳状液体或以其制成的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Likwidu li jixbah il-ħalib u li jista' jintuża biex isiru prodotti tal-gomma, jew il-materjal magħmul minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Latex is a milky liquid used in making rubber products, or a material made from that liquid.

formal.mt: Meta tnaddaf, ilbes ingwanti tal-lastku biex tipproteġi idejk.
formal.en: When cleaning, wear rubber gloves to protect your hands.
formal.zh: 清洁时，请戴上橡胶手套保护双手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek biċċa lastku biex norbot dawn il-karti? Mark: Iva, ħu din; għandha żżommhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got a piece of elastic so I can tie these papers together? Mark: Yes, take this one; it should hold them together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有一段松紧带吗？我想把这些纸捆起来。Mark：有，拿这段吧，应该能把它们固定在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek biċċa lastku biex norbot dawn il-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek biċċa lastku biex norbot dawn il-karti?
messages.zh: 你有一段松紧带吗？我想把这些纸捆起来。
messages.en: Have you got a piece of elastic so I can tie these papers together?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din; għandha żżommhom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din; għandha żżommhom flimkien.
messages.zh: 有，拿这段吧，应该能把它们固定在一起。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; it should hold them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lastku 和“拉开后回弹”的画面一起记：捆纸时想到松紧材料，戴手套时想到橡胶；乳胶义则结合具体材料语境辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toilet or latrine where people go to pass bodily waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人大小便的厕所或便所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn persuna tmur biex tagħmel il-bżonnijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人大小便的便所，尤指设施较简单或供多人使用的厕所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jagħmlu l-bżonnijiet tagħhom, speċjalment wieħed b'faċilitajiet sempliċi jew li jintuża minn ħafna nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A latrine is a place used as a toilet, especially one with simple facilities or shared by several people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厕所，即供人大小便的设施或场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità jew post li persuna tuża biex tagħmel il-bżonnijiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A toilet is a facility or place where people go to pass bodily waste.

formal.mt: Il-latrina pubblika għandha tinżamm nadifa u jkollha provvista ta' ilma.
formal.en: The public toilet must be kept clean and have a supply of water.
formal.zh: 公共厕所必须保持清洁，并有水供应。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Skużani, fejn hi l-latrina? Pawlu: Hemm wara dik il-bieba, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Anna: Excuse me, where is the toilet? Pawlu: It's behind that door, on the left.
colloquial.zh: Anna：打扰一下，厕所在哪里？Pawlu：就在那扇门后面，左边。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, fejn hi l-latrina?
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, fejn hi l-latrina?
messages.zh: 打扰一下，厕所在哪里？
messages.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wara dik il-bieba, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wara dik il-bieba, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 就在那扇门后面，左边。
messages.en: It's behind that door, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 latrina 放进问路句“Fejn hi l-latrina?”一起记，脑中配上厕所门的位置；再用“公共厕所”和“清洁厕所”两个场景巩固。

gloss_zh: 具体词义待明确（所给释义为“to maltese”）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective whose precise meaning cannot be established from the supplied gloss "to maltese".
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词性为形容词，但释义“to maltese”不足以确定具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-glossa mogħtija "to maltese".

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给释义“to maltese”含义不明确，无法据此提供可靠的形容词义项翻译。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija "to maltese" mhijiex ċara biżżejjed biex tagħti tifsira preċiża u affidabbli ta' dan l-aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not provide enough information to explain this adjective reliably.

formal.mt: L-entrata telenka "latru" bħala aġġettiv, iżda l-glossa "to maltese" mhijiex biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The entry lists "latru" as an adjective, but the gloss "to maltese" is insufficient to establish its meaning.
formal.zh: 该词条将“latru”列为形容词，但释义“to maltese”不足以确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser "latru" f'din il-lista? Lara: Il-lista tgħid li hu aġġettiv, imma t-tifsira mhijiex ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does "latru" mean in this list? Lara: The list says it's an adjective, but the meaning isn't clear.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张表里的“latru”是什么意思？Lara：表里说它是形容词，但含义不清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser "latru" f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser "latru" f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这张表里的“latru”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "latru" mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lista tgħid li hu aġġettiv, imma t-tifsira mhijiex ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lista tgħid li hu aġġettiv, imma t-tifsira mhijiex ċara.
messages.zh: 表里说它是形容词，但含义不清楚。
messages.en: The list says it's an adjective, but the meaning isn't clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 latru 的学习卡暂贴“形容词，词义待明确”：先识别拼写和所给词性，不把含糊的英文标签硬记成确定中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of sugar naturally present in milk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天然存在于乳中的一种糖，称为乳糖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' zokkor li jinsab b'mod naturali fil-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳糖，天然存在于乳及部分乳制品中的一种糖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' zokkor li jinsab b'mod naturali fil-ħalib u f'xi prodotti magħmulin minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lactose is a type of sugar naturally found in milk and some products made from milk.

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika jekk il-prodott fihx il-lattosju.
formal.en: The label indicates whether the product contains lactose.
formal.zh: 标签注明该产品是否含有乳糖。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħalib fih il-lattosju? Mark: Le, fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub "mingħajr lattosju".
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this milk contain lactose? Mark: No, the label says "lactose-free".
colloquial.zh: Sara：这款牛奶含乳糖吗？Mark：不含，标签上写着“无乳糖”。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħalib fih il-lattosju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħalib fih il-lattosju?
messages.zh: 这款牛奶含乳糖吗？
messages.en: Does this milk contain lactose?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub "mingħajr lattosju".
messages.mt_standard: Le, fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub "mingħajr lattosju".
messages.zh: 不含，标签上写着“无乳糖”。
messages.en: No, the label says "lactose-free".

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lattosju 和牛奶标签上的“乳糖”一起记，再成对练习“fih il-lattosju（含乳糖）”与“mingħajr lattosju（无乳糖）”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic plant with small purple flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种开紫色小花、带有芳香的植物，即薰衣草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bi fjuri żgħar vjola li għandha riħa tfuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薰衣草，一种具有芳香、开紫色小花的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li għandha riħa tfuħ u tagħmel fjuri żgħar vjola.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lavender is a plant with small purple flowers and a pleasant, distinctive smell.

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola, l-istudenti ħawlu lavanda u osservaw il-fjuri vjola tagħha.
formal.en: In the school garden, the students planted lavender and observed its purple flowers.
formal.zh: 学生们在学校花园里种下薰衣草，并观察它的紫色花朵。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din ir-riħa tfuħ? Lara: Hija l-lavanda li poġġejt ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that lovely smell? Lara: It's the lavender I put by the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么香味？拉拉：是我放在窗边的薰衣草。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din ir-riħa tfuħ?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din ir-riħa tfuħ?
messages.zh: 这是什么香味？
messages.en: What's that lovely smell?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-lavanda li poġġejt ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-lavanda li poġġejt ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 是我放在窗边的薰衣草。
messages.en: It's the lavender I put by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lavanda 与一盆紫色香花联系起来，同时记住“看见紫花、闻到清香”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat board with a slate surface used for writing with chalk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种表面为石板、可以用粉笔书写并擦除的平板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tavla ċatta b'wiċċ tal-ġebel li fuqu wieħed jista' jikteb bil-ġibs u jħassar il-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石板写字板，供人用粉笔书写、并可擦除字迹的石板。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tavla b'wiċċ ċatt tal-ġebel li tintuża biex wieħed jikteb fuqha bil-ġibs u mbagħad iħassar il-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A slate is a flat writing board on which you write with chalk and can then erase the marks.

formal.mt: L-għalliem kiteb tliet kelmiet fuq il-lavanja u talab lill-istudenti jaqrawhom.
formal.en: The teacher wrote three words on the slate and asked the students to read them.
formal.zh: 老师在石板写字板上写了三个词，并请学生们朗读。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nikteb ismi fuq il-lavanja? Pawlu: Iva, ħu l-ġibs u iktbu hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I write my name on the slate? Pawlu: Yes, take the chalk and write it here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以在石板写字板上写自己的名字吗？保罗：可以，拿粉笔在这里写吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nikteb ismi fuq il-lavanja?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nikteb ismi fuq il-lavanja?
messages.zh: 我可以在石板写字板上写自己的名字吗？
messages.en: Can I write my name on the slate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu l-ġibs u iktbu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu l-ġibs u iktbu hawn.
messages.zh: 可以，拿粉笔在这里写吧。
messages.en: Yes, take the chalk and write it here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lavanja 时想象“粉笔写上去、抹布擦下来”的石板，把词义固定在课堂书写画面中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not tightly fastened or held in place, or fitting with extra room.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物件没有固定紧、容易松动，或衣物穿着不贴身、留有余量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex marbut jew imwaħħal sew, jew li ma joqgħodx issikkat mal-ġisem meta jintlibes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松的；未拧紧、未系紧或未牢固固定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex issikkat, marbut jew imwaħħal sew u għalhekk jista' jiċċaqlaq faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is loose is not firmly fastened or held in position and can move easily.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽松的；指衣物不紧贴身体、穿着留有空间的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li, meta jintlibes, iħalli spazju bejn id-drapp u l-ġisem u ma jkunx issikkat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Clothing that is loose-fitting leaves space around your body instead of fitting tightly against it.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku sab kamin laxk fis-siġġu u ssikkah.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician found a loose screw in the chair and tightened it.
formal.zh: 检查时，技术人员发现椅子上有一颗松动的螺丝，并将它拧紧。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-qalziet laxk wisq għalija. Rita: Ipprova daqs iżgħar; forsi joqgħodlok aħjar.
colloquial.en: Mark: These trousers are too loose for me. Rita: Try a smaller size; it might fit you better.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条裤子对我来说太宽松了。丽塔：试试小一号的，也许会更合身。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qalziet laxk wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qalziet laxk wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 这条裤子对我来说太宽松了。
messages.en: These trousers are too loose for me.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova daqs iżgħar; forsi joqgħodlok aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova daqs iżgħar; forsi joqgħodlok aħjar.
messages.zh: 试试小一号的，也许会更合身。
messages.en: Try a smaller size; it might fit you better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laxk 连到两个“松”的画面：螺丝会晃动，裤子有余量；分别记住物件松动和衣服宽松。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sideways, with the body or an object turned towards one side, or moving to one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示侧向的姿势、朝向或移动方式，即侧着或向侧面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li l-ġisem jew oġġett ikun imdawwar lejn naħa waħda, jew li l-moviment isir lejn il-ġenb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侧着；向侧面；表示身体或物体的侧向姿势、朝向或运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li persuna jew oġġett ikun imdawwar lejn il-ġenb, jew jimxi lejn naħa waħda minflok dritt 'il quddiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you turn or move sideways, you turn or move towards one side.

formal.mt: Biex jgħaddi mill-passaġġ dejjaq, ir-raġel kellu jdur laġenba.
formal.en: To get through the narrow passage, the man had to turn sideways.
formal.zh: 为了穿过狭窄的通道，那名男子不得不侧过身。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kaxxa ma tgħaddix mill-bieb. Mark: Dawwarha laġenba u erġa' pprova.
colloquial.en: Lara: The box won't fit through the door. Mark: Turn it sideways and try again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：箱子过不了门。Mark：把它转成侧向，再试一次。

messages.speaker: Lara (搬家的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kaxxa ma tgħaddix mill-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kaxxa ma tgħaddix mill-bieb.
messages.zh: 箱子过不了门。
messages.en: The box won't fit through the door.

messages.speaker: Mark (帮忙搬家的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawwarha laġenba u erġa' pprova.
messages.mt_standard: Dawwarha laġenba u erġa' pprova.
messages.zh: 把它转成侧向，再试一次。
messages.en: Turn it sideways and try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬箱子过窄门，先把箱子转成侧向；用这个动作记住“侧着、向侧面”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Words expressing a wish that harm or misfortune should happen to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达希望某人遭受伤害或厄运的话语，即诅咒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li bih wieħed jixtieq li jiġri d-deni jew tiġi x-xorti ħażina fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒；以言语表达希望某人遭遇灾祸或不幸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saħta, jiġifieri kliem li jesprimi x-xewqa li xi ħadd ibati jew jgħaddi minn xi sfortuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A curse is an expression of a wish that someone should suffer harm or misfortune.

collocations.en: to put a curse on someone

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, is-saħħara titfa' lagħna fuq il-prinċep, li mbagħad ifittex mod kif jeħles minnha.
formal.en: In the story, the witch puts a curse on the prince, who then seeks a way to free himself from it.
formal.zh: 故事中，女巫对王子施加诅咒，王子随后寻找摆脱诅咒的方法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-prinċep ma jistax jitlaq mill-kastell? Leo: Għax hemm lagħna fuqu; hekk tgħid il-ġrajja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't the prince leave the castle? Leo: Because he's under a curse; that's what the story says.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：王子为什么不能离开城堡？利奥：因为他中了诅咒，故事里是这么说的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-prinċep ma jistax jitlaq mill-kastell?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-prinċep ma jistax jitlaq mill-kastell?
messages.zh: 王子为什么不能离开城堡？
messages.en: Why can't the prince leave the castle?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm lagħna fuqu; hekk tgħid il-ġrajja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm lagħna fuqu; hekk tgħid il-ġrajja.
messages.zh: 因为他中了诅咒，故事里是这么说的。
messages.en: Because he's under a curse; that's what the story says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进童话画面：女巫说出恶意咒语，王子寻找解除办法，由此记住“诅咒”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is loyal continues to support a person, group, or commitment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忠诚的；持续支持某个人或群体，或忠实履行承诺的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' jagħti l-appoġġ tiegħu lil persuna jew grupp, jew iżomm l-impenn tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忠诚的；对某个人、群体或承诺保持忠实的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jżomm il-fiduċja u l-appoġġ tiegħu lejn persuna jew grupp, jew jibqa' jħares impenn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is loyal remains faithful to a person, group, or commitment.

collocations.en: to remain loyal to the team

formal.mt: Membru leali jibqa' jappoġġa lill-grupp anki meta jinqalgħu diffikultajiet.
formal.en: A loyal member continues to support the group even when difficulties arise.
formal.zh: 忠诚的成员即使遇到困难，也会继续支持团队。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tappoġġa lil dan it-tim? Mark: Iva, jien leali lejn it-tim tiegħi, anki meta jitlef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still support this team? Mark: Yes, I'm loyal to my team, even when it loses.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还支持这支球队吗？马克：是啊，我忠于自己的球队，就算它输了也一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tappoġġa lil dan it-tim?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek tappoġġa lil dan it-tim?
messages.zh: 你还支持这支球队吗？
messages.en: Do you still support this team?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien leali lejn it-tim tiegħi, anki meta jitlef.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien leali lejn it-tim tiegħi, anki meta jitlef.
messages.zh: 是啊，我忠于自己的球队，就算它输了也一样。
messages.en: Yes, I'm loyal to my team, even when it loses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leali 和“球队输了仍支持”的画面一起记：形容一个人忠诚，可搭配 leali lejn，表示“忠于……”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loyalty is the quality of remaining faithful and supportive, or the allegiance someone gives to a person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忠诚；持续忠实并给予支持的品质，也可指对某个人或群体的效忠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li wieħed jibqa' fidil u jagħti appoġġ, jew ir-rabta ta' fedeltà tiegħu lejn persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忠诚；对某个人、群体或承诺保持忠实和支持的品质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li wieħed jibqa' fidil lejn persuna, grupp jew impenn u jkompli jagħti l-appoġġ tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Loyalty is the quality of remaining faithful to someone or something you support.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 效忠；对某个人或群体所承担或表达的忠诚关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rabta ta' fedeltà lejn persuna jew grupp li wieħed jagħraf u jagħżel li jappoġġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your allegiance is the loyalty and support you give to a particular person or group.

formal.mt: Il-membri wrew il-lealtà tagħhom lejn il-grupp billi komplew jaħdmu flimkien fi żmien diffiċli.
formal.en: The members showed their loyalty to the group by continuing to work together during a difficult period.
formal.zh: 成员们在困难时期继续共同工作，以此表现出对团队的忠诚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex bqajt mal-grupp? Pawlu: Għax il-lealtà hija importanti għalija, u ridt nibqa' ngħinhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stay with the group? Pawlu: Because loyalty matters to me, and I wanted to keep helping them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么留在这个团队？保罗：因为我很看重忠诚，而且我想继续帮助他们。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bqajt mal-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bqajt mal-grupp?
messages.zh: 你为什么留在这个团队？
messages.en: Why did you stay with the group?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-lealtà hija importanti għalija, u ridt nibqa' ngħinhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-lealtà hija importanti għalija, u ridt nibqa' ngħinhom.
messages.zh: 因为我很看重忠诚，而且我想继续帮助他们。
messages.en: Because loyalty matters to me, and I wanted to keep helping them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文词性对照记忆：leali 是“忠诚的”，lealtà 是“忠诚”这种品质；谈效忠对象时，可记 lealtà lejn。

gloss_zh: 学习障碍；学习方面的困难

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English expression 'Learning disabilities' refers to difficulties affecting learning; the expression itself functions as a noun phrase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语表达“Learning disabilities”，指影响学习的障碍或困难；该表达本身是名词短语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni Ingliża 'Learning disabilities' tirreferi għal diffikultajiet li jaffettwaw it-tagħlim; l-espressjoni nnifisha tintuża bħala frażi nominali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学习障碍；影响学习的困难。此英语表达本身作名词短语使用，所提供的词性标签保留为 verb。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni Ingliża li tindika diffikultajiet li jaffettwaw it-tagħlim. Hija frażi nominali, għalkemm it-tikketta grammatikali mogħtija hija 'verb'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Learning disabilities are difficulties that affect a person's learning.

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, l-espressjoni Ingliża 'learning disabilities' tirreferi għal diffikultajiet li jaffettwaw it-tagħlim.
formal.en: In this text, the English expression 'learning disabilities' refers to difficulties that affect learning.
formal.zh: 在本文中，英语表达“learning disabilities”指影响学习的障碍或困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'learning disabilities'? Rita: Tfisser diffikultajiet li jaffettwaw it-tagħlim.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'learning disabilities' mean? Rita: It means difficulties that affect learning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“learning disabilities”是什么意思？丽塔：指影响学习的障碍或困难。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'learning disabilities'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'learning disabilities'?
messages.zh: “learning disabilities”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'learning disabilities' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser diffikultajiet li jaffettwaw it-tagħlim.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser diffikultajiet li jaffettwaw it-tagħlim.
messages.zh: 指影响学习的障碍或困难。
messages.en: It means difficulties that affect learning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个英语短语与马耳他语 diffikultajiet fit-tagħlim（学习方面的困难）配对记忆；不要把整个短语当作动作动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Leeds is a proper name identifying a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利兹；用于指称特定地点的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jidentifika l-post imsejjaħ Leeds.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利兹；地名，书写时首字母大写。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-post imsejjaħ Leeds, li jinkiteb b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Leeds is a place name written with an initial capital letter.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti se jivvjaġġaw lejn Leeds biex jattendu l-laqgħa.
formal.en: The participants will travel to Leeds to attend the meeting.
formal.zh: 参与者将前往利兹出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn joqgħod ħuk? David: Joqgħod f'Leeds. Se mmur narah il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where does your brother live? David: He lives in Leeds. I'm going to visit him next week.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你兄弟住在哪里？戴维：他住在利兹。我下周要去看他。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn joqgħod ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn joqgħod ħuk?
messages.zh: 你兄弟住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your brother live?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Joqgħod f'Leeds. Se mmur narah il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: Joqgħod f'Leeds. Se mmur narah il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 他住在利兹。我下周要去看他。
messages.en: He lives in Leeds. I'm going to visit him next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Leeds 当作地图上的地名标签记住，首字母大写；再用 lejn Leeds 记“前往利兹”，用 f'Leeds 记“在利兹”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the law, or permitted by the law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与法律有关的，或法律允许的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-liġi, jew li huwa permess mil-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法律的；与法律有关的；法律所允许的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-liġi jew li jista' jsir mingħajr ma tinkiser il-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is legal is connected with the law or is allowed under the law.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija talbet parir legali qabel ma ffirmat il-kuntratt.
formal.en: The company sought legal advice before signing the contract.
formal.zh: 公司在签署合同前征求了法律意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ftehim huwa legali? Mark: Ma nafx; ejja nitolbu parir legali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this agreement legal? Mark: I don't know; let's seek legal advice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份协议合法吗？马克：我不知道，我们去征求法律意见吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ftehim huwa legali?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ftehim huwa legali?
messages.zh: 这份协议合法吗？
messages.en: Is this agreement legal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; ejja nitolbu parir legali.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; ejja nitolbu parir legali.
messages.zh: 我不知道，我们去征求法律意见吧。
messages.en: I don't know; let's seek legal advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 legali 放进两个场景记忆：征求法律意见是 parir legali，询问某事是否合法则用 huwa legali。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is binding books or repairing their bindings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以装订书籍或修复书籍装订部分为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha huwa li torbot il-kotba jew issewwi l-irbit tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装订书籍、修复书籍装订部分的工匠。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li tiġbor u torbot il-paġni ta' ktieb u twaħħal il-qoxra, jew issewwi l-irbit ta' kotba bil-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A book binder is someone who joins the pages and covers of books or repairs their bindings.

formal.mt: Il-legatur sewwa l-irbit tal-ktieb u waħħal mill-ġdid il-qoxra.
formal.en: The book binder repaired the book's binding and reattached its cover.
formal.zh: 装订师修复了这本书的装订部分，并重新装好了封面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qoxra ta' dan il-ktieb inqalgħet. Taf lil xi legatur? Pawlu: Iva, naf legatur tas-sengħa li jista' jsewwih.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cover of this book has come off. Do you know a book binder? Pawlu: Yes, I know a skilled book binder who can repair it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书的封面掉了。你认识装订师吗？保罗：认识，我知道一位手艺很好的装订师，可以把它修好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qoxra ta' dan il-ktieb inqalgħet. Taf lil xi legatur?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qoxra ta' dan il-ktieb inqalgħet. Taf lil xi legatur?
messages.zh: 这本书的封面掉了。你认识装订师吗？
messages.en: The cover of this book has come off. Do you know a book binder?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf legatur tas-sengħa li jista' jsewwih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf legatur tas-sengħa li jista' jsewwih.
messages.zh: 认识，我知道一位手艺很好的装订师，可以把它修好。
messages.en: Yes, I know a skilled book binder who can repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本散页的书交到工匠手里，再变成装订完整的书；把这位装订师与 legatur 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day or evening immediately before a particular day or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个特定日子或事件到来之前的一天或晚上，即其前夕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum jew il-lejla ta' qabel jum jew avveniment partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: the eve of (a day or event)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某个日子或事件的前一天或前一晚；前夕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum jew il-lejla li jiġu minnufih qabel jum jew avveniment partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens on the eve of a day or event, it happens on the day or evening immediately before it.

collocations.en: on the eve of the wedding

formal.mt: Lejlet il-konferenza, l-organizzaturi bagħtu l-programm finali lill-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: On the eve of the conference, the organizers sent the final programme to all participants.
formal.zh: 会议前夕，组织者向所有与会者发送了最终议程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se niltaqgħu mal-familja? Mark: Lejlet il-Milied, għand in-nanna. Maja: Tajjeb, inġib xi ħaġa ħelwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are we meeting the family? Mark: On Christmas Eve, at Grandma's. Maja: Good, I'll bring something sweet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们什么时候和家人聚会？Mark：圣诞前夕，在奶奶家。Maja：好，我带点甜食。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se niltaqgħu mal-familja?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se niltaqgħu mal-familja?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候和家人聚会？
messages.en: When are we meeting the family?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Lejlet il-Milied, għand in-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Lejlet il-Milied, għand in-nanna.
messages.zh: 圣诞前夕，在奶奶家。
messages.en: On Christmas Eve, at Grandma's.

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inġib xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inġib xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.zh: 好，我带点甜食。
messages.en: Good, I'll bring something sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上给节日的前一天画圈，把“lejlet＋节日或事件”作为整体记成“……前夕”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that produces a narrow, concentrated beam of light, or the light produced by such a device.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生狭窄、集中的光束的装置，即激光器；也指这种装置产生的激光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jipproduċi raġġ dejjaq u kkonċentrat ta' dawl, jew id-dawl prodott minn dan l-apparat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激光器；也指其发出的狭窄、集中的激光束。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li joħroġ raġġ dejjaq u kkonċentrat ta' dawl li jista' jintuża, pereżempju, għall-kejl jew għall-qtugħ ta' materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A laser is a device that produces a narrow, concentrated beam of light for uses such as measuring or cutting.

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju juża lejżer biex ikejjel id-distanza bejn żewġ punti bi preċiżjoni għolja.
formal.en: The laboratory uses a laser to measure the distance between two points with high precision.
formal.zh: 实验室使用激光器高精度测量两点之间的距离。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qtajtu din il-forma fl-injam? Pawlu: Użajna lejżer. Maja: Għalhekk it-truf ħarġu daqshekk preċiżi!
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you cut this shape in the wood? Pawlu: We used a laser. Maja: So that's why the edges came out so precise!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们是怎么在木板上切出这个形状的？Pawlu：我们用了激光器。Maja：难怪边缘这么精确！

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qtajtu din il-forma fl-injam?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qtajtu din il-forma fl-injam?
messages.zh: 你们是怎么在木板上切出这个形状的？
messages.en: How did you cut this shape in the wood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajna lejżer.
messages.mt_standard: Użajna lejżer.
messages.zh: 我们用了激光器。
messages.en: We used a laser.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalhekk it-truf ħarġu daqshekk preċiżi!
messages.mt_standard: Għalhekk it-truf ħarġu daqshekk preċiżi!
messages.zh: 难怪边缘这么精确！
messages.en: So that's why the edges came out so precise!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“lejżer”与英文“laser”并排记忆，再想象一束细而集中的光在木板上切出形状。

gloss_zh: 释义为“Saw”，具体名词义未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item labelled as a noun and supplied with the gloss 'Saw', whose intended noun meaning remains unclear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个标注为名词、释义写作“Saw”的词条；该英文释义所表达的具体名词义尚不明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom u mogħtija bit-tifsira 'Saw', iżda li s-sens nominali maħsub tagħha għadu mhux ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “Saw”：具体名词义未明确，不能据此可靠确定中文对应义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'Saw', iżda mhuwiex ċar liema sens ta' nom huwa maħsub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gloss 'Saw' leaves the intended meaning of this noun insufficiently specified.

formal.mt: Qabel ma 'Lemah' jiddaħħal fil-glossarju tal-istudenti, jeħtieġ li t-tifsira tiegħu tiġi ċċarata.
formal.en: Before 'Lemah' is included in the students' glossary, its meaning needs to be clarified.
formal.zh: 将“Lemah”收入学生词汇表之前，需要先明确它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nżid 'Lemah' mal-lista tal-kliem? Rita: Iva, imma ħalli nota li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara. Mark: Tajjeb, nivverifikaha qabel nitgħallimha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I add 'Lemah' to the vocabulary list? Rita: Yes, but leave a note that the meaning is still unclear. Mark: All right, I'll verify it before learning it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我可以把“Lemah”加进词汇表吗？Rita：可以，不过要注明词义还不明确。Mark：好，我先核实，再记忆。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nżid 'Lemah' mal-lista tal-kliem?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nżid 'Lemah' mal-lista tal-kliem?
messages.zh: 我可以把“Lemah”加进词汇表吗？
messages.en: Can I add 'Lemah' to the vocabulary list?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħalli nota li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħalli nota li t-tifsira għadha mhix ċara.
messages.zh: 可以，不过要注明词义还不明确。
messages.en: Yes, but leave a note that the meaning is still unclear.

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nivverifikaha qabel nitgħallimha.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nivverifikaha qabel nitgħallimha.
messages.zh: 好，我先核实，再记忆。
messages.en: All right, I'll verify it before learning it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“Lemah”放进待核实词卡，并分别记录词性与释义；先确认具体含义，再建立中文联想。

gloss_zh: 他看见了他们；他注意到了他们

teaching_sense.en_definition: He noticed them or caught sight of them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他在过去看见或注意到了他们，常用于描述发现某些人出现在视野中的情景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li hu rahom jew induna bil-preżenza tagħhom f'mument fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他看见了他们，或注意到了他们的存在。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hu rahom jew induna li kienu hemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he noticed them, he became aware of their presence, usually by seeing them.

collocations.en: he caught sight of them from a distance
he spotted them among the crowd
collocations.zh: 他在人群中看见了他们

formal.mt: Meta l-għalliem lemaħhom ħdejn il-bieb tal-iskola, talab lill-istudenti jidħlu fil-klassi.
formal.en: When the teacher noticed them near the school entrance, he asked the students to enter the classroom.
formal.zh: 老师看见他们在学校门口附近，便叫这些学生进教室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien jaf Mark li konna fil-pjazza? Rita: Lemaħhom hemm, lil Pawlu u lil Sara, u huma qalulu li konna magħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark know we were in the square? Rita: He spotted Pawlu and Sara there, and they told him we were with them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么知道我们在广场上？丽塔：他在那里看见了保罗和萨拉，他们告诉他我们跟他们在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien jaf Mark li konna fil-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien jaf Mark li konna fil-pjazza?
messages.zh: 马克怎么知道我们在广场上？
messages.en: How did Mark know we were in the square?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lemaħhom hemm, lil Pawlu u lil Sara, u huma qalulu li konna magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Lemaħhom hemm, lil Pawlu u lil Sara, u huma qalulu li konna magħhom.
messages.zh: 他在那里看见了保罗和萨拉，他们告诉他我们跟他们在一起。
messages.en: He spotted Pawlu and Sara there, and they told him we were with them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象他在人群中忽然看见两位朋友，把 lemaħhom 整体记成“他看见了他们”；词尾 -hom 提醒你，看到的对象是“他们”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bowl used for holding or mixing ingredients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可盛放或混合食材的大碗或盆，尤其可用于搅拌配料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir u fond li jintuża biex iżomm jew iħallat ingredjenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大碗或搅拌盆，用于盛放、搅拌食材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir u fond li fih jitqiegħdu jew jitħalltu l-ingredjenti waqt it-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mixing bowl is a large, deep container in which you combine ingredients when preparing food.

collocations.en: mix the ingredients in the bowl

formal.mt: Poġġi d-dqiq fil-lembija, żid l-ilma ftit ftit u ħallat sakemm tifforma għaġina ratba.
formal.en: Put the flour in the mixing bowl, add the water gradually, and mix until a soft dough forms.
formal.zh: 把面粉放入搅拌盆，逐渐加水，搅拌至形成柔软的面团。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se nħallat id-dqiq u l-bajd? Omm: Uża l-lembija l-kbira; hemm biżżejjed spazju fiha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall I mix the flour and eggs? Mum: Use the large mixing bowl; it has enough room.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我用什么来混合面粉和鸡蛋？妈妈：用那个大搅拌盆，里面有足够的空间。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se nħallat id-dqiq u l-bajd?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se nħallat id-dqiq u l-bajd?
messages.zh: 我用什么来混合面粉和鸡蛋？
messages.en: Where shall I mix the flour and eggs?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)

messages.zh: 用那个大搅拌盆，里面有足够的空间。
messages.en: Use the large mixing bowl; it has enough room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lembija 和“面粉、鸡蛋、大盆、搅拌”的厨房画面连在一起记：它是能容下配料并方便搅拌的大碗或盆。

gloss_zh: 词典词目；语言学中的基本词形

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dictionary headword or a basic word form under which related forms are grouped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词典中统领相关词形的词目，或语言学中用来形成其他相关形式的基本词形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kelma ewlenija ta' entrata f'dizzjunarju, jew il-forma bażika ta' kelma li minnha jinħolqu forom oħra skont ir-regoli tal-formazzjoni tal-kliem.

sense_translations.en_definition: the head word in a dictionary, grouping a number of related words
sense_translations.zh_definition: 词典中的词目词，即用于统领若干相关词语或词形的检索词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma li tidher fil-bidu ta' entrata f'dizzjunarju u li taħtha jinġabru għadd ta' kliem jew forom relatati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lemma is the headword of a dictionary entry under which related words or forms are grouped.

sense_translations.en_definition: In Linguistics, a word which is the basic form from which others are derived through the application of word-formation rules
sense_translations.zh_definition: 语言学中的基本词形，其他词语或形式可通过应用构词规则由它派生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-lingwistika, hija kelma fil-forma bażika tagħha li minnha jitnisslu kliem jew forom oħra bl-applikazzjoni tar-regoli tal-formazzjoni tal-kliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In linguistics, a lemma is a basic word form from which other words or forms are derived by applying word-formation rules.

collocations.en: the forms related to the lemma
collocations.zh: 与基本词形相关的各个形式

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi lingwistika, l-istudenti identifikaw il-lemma u spjegaw ir-regoli li bihom ġew iffurmati l-kelmiet relatati.
formal.en: In the linguistic analysis, the students identified the lemma and explained the rules by which the related words were formed.
formal.zh: 在语言学分析中，学生们找出了基本词形，并解释了相关词语形成时所应用的规则。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-lemma f'din l-entrata? Mark: Hija l-kelma fil-bidu; il-forom relatati jinsabu taħtha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the lemma in this entry? Mark: It is the word at the beginning; the related forms are listed beneath it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个词条里的词目词是哪一个？马克：就是开头那个词，相关词形列在它下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-lemma f'din l-entrata?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-lemma f'din l-entrata?
messages.zh: 这个词条里的词目词是哪一个？
messages.en: What is the lemma in this entry?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-kelma fil-bidu; il-forom relatati jinsabu taħtha.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-kelma fil-bidu; il-forom relatati jinsabu taħtha.
messages.zh: 就是开头那个词，相关词形列在它下面。
messages.en: It is the word at the beginning; the related forms are listed beneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lemma 想成相关词形的“总目录入口”：查词典时看它统领的词条，学构词时看它作为基本词形的作用，不要直接把它等同于词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand-held baton with projecting spikes or points that can prick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手握持、带有突出尖端或尖刺的短棍，可用于刺戳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastun li jinżamm fl-id u li għandu ponot li jistgħu jniggżu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手持式带尖刺短棍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastun qasir li jinżamm fl-id u li għandu ponot ħerġin minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hand-held spiked baton is a short stick with projecting points that a person holds in one hand.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于刺戳、使人产生刺痛的棍棒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastun li jintuża biex iniggeż jew jikkawża wġigħ ta' tingiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sting stick is a stick used to prick or cause a sharp stinging sensation.

collocations.en: a spiked baton in the display case
the handle of the spiked baton

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-esibizzjoni tiddeskrivi l-oġġett bħala lenbubi bil-ponot, jiġifieri bastun li jinżamm fl-id u għandu ponot li jistgħu jniggżu.
formal.en: The exhibition label describes the object as a spiked baton, meaning a hand-held stick with points that can prick.
formal.zh: 展品标签将该物件描述为带刺短棍，即用手握持、尖端能够刺戳的棍棒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-bastun fil-vetrina? Pawlu: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub 'lenbubi bil-ponot'. Ara l-ponot li għandu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is that stick in the display case? Pawlu: The label says 'spiked baton'. Look at its points.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：陈列柜里那根棍子是什么？保罗：标签上写着“带刺短棍”。你看它上面的尖刺。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-bastun fil-vetrina?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-bastun fil-vetrina?
messages.zh: 陈列柜里那根棍子是什么？
messages.en: What is that stick in the display case?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub 'lenbubi bil-ponot'. Ara l-ponot li għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub 'lenbubi bil-ponot'. Ara l-ponot li għandu.
messages.zh: 标签上写着“带刺短棍”。你看它上面的尖刺。
messages.en: The label says 'spiked baton'. Look at its points.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“一只手握短棍，棍上突出小尖刺”的画面；bil-ponot 提醒你“带有尖端”，把整组词与带刺短棍的形状联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shaped piece of glass or plastic that directs light to help form a clear or enlarged image.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过特定形状加工、能改变光线方向以成像或放大影像的玻璃或塑料镜片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħġieġ jew plastik b'forma apposta li tbiddel id-direzzjoni tad-dawl biex tifforma jew tkabbar immaġni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透镜；用于眼镜、相机等光学设备中帮助成像的镜片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħġieġ jew plastik li tintuża f'nuċċali, kameras jew strumenti oħra biex tidderieġi d-dawl u tgħin fil-formazzjoni ta' immaġni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lens is a shaped piece of glass or plastic used to direct light and produce an image.

formal.mt: Il-fotografu naddaf il-lenti tal-kamera qabel ma ħa r-ritratt.
formal.en: The photographer cleaned the camera lens before taking the photograph.
formal.zh: 摄影师在拍照前清洁了相机镜头。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ir-ritratt mhux ċar? Mark: Il-lenti maħmuġa. Ħa nnaddafha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't the photo clear? Mark: The lens is dirty. Let me clean it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片为什么不清楚？Mark：镜头脏了。我来擦一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-ritratt mhux ċar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-ritratt mhux ċar?
messages.zh: 照片为什么不清楚？
messages.en: Why isn't the photo clear?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lenti maħmuġa. Ħa nnaddafha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lenti maħmuġa. Ħa nnaddafha.
messages.zh: 镜头脏了。我来擦一下。
messages.en: The lens is dirty. Let me clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lenti 和相机镜头的画面一起记：照片模糊时，先检查镜片是否干净。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, thin lens worn directly on the surface of the eye to help someone see clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接戴在眼球表面、帮助看清事物的小而薄的镜片，即隐形眼镜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lenti żgħira u rqiqa li tintlibes direttament fuq il-wiċċ tal-għajn biex tgħin lill-persuna tara ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐形眼镜；直接贴戴在眼球表面以矫正视力的薄镜片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lenti rqiqa li persuna tilbes fuq il-wiċċ tal-għajn biex tikkoreġi l-vista mingħajr ma tilbes in-nuċċali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contact lens is a thin lens worn directly on the eye to improve a person's vision.

formal.mt: L-istudenta spjegat li kienet tilbes lenti tal-kontakt f'għajn waħda biss.
formal.en: The student explained that she wore a contact lens in only one eye.
formal.zh: 这名女学生解释说，她只在一只眼睛里戴隐形眼镜。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Illum m'intix bin-nuċċali? Lara: Le, qed nilbes lenti tal-kontakt f'kull għajn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Aren't you wearing glasses today? Lara: No, I'm wearing a contact lens in each eye.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你今天没戴框架眼镜吗？Lara：没有，我两只眼睛都戴了隐形眼镜。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum m'intix bin-nuċċali?
messages.mt_standard: Illum m'intix bin-nuċċali?
messages.zh: 你今天没戴框架眼镜吗？
messages.en: Aren't you wearing glasses today?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed nilbes lenti tal-kontakt f'kull għajn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed nilbes lenti tal-kontakt f'kull għajn.
messages.zh: 没有，我两只眼睛都戴了隐形眼镜。
messages.en: No, I'm wearing a contact lens in each eye.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“镜片直接贴着眼睛”的画面，记住 lenti tal-kontakt 表示隐形眼镜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin, strong line used in fishing, usually with a hook attached to its end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钓鱼时使用的细而结实的线，末端通常系有鱼钩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajta rqiqa u b'saħħitha li tintuża għas-sajd, ġeneralment b'ganċ marbut mat-tarf tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钓鱼线；用于连接鱼钩并拉住或收回鱼的细线。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħajta twila u b'saħħitha li magħha jintrabat ganċ u li tintuża biex jinqabad u jinġibed il-ħut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fishing line is a long, thin cord used with a hook to catch fish.

formal.mt: Is-sajjied rabat il-ganċ mat-tarf tal-lenza qabel ma beda jistad.
formal.en: The fisherman tied the hook to the end of the fishing line before he began fishing.
formal.zh: 渔夫开始钓鱼前，把鱼钩系在了鱼线末端。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Il-lenza tħabblet. Tista' tgħinni? Toni: Iva, żomm dan it-tarf u nħollha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: The fishing line has got tangled. Can you help me? Toni: Yes, hold this end and I'll untangle it slowly.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：鱼线缠住了。你能帮我吗？Toni：可以，你拿住这一头，我慢慢把它解开。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (钓鱼伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lenza tħabblet. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.mt_standard: Il-lenza tħabblet. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.zh: 鱼线缠住了。你能帮我吗？
messages.en: The fishing line has got tangled. Can you help me?

messages.speaker: Toni (钓鱼伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żomm dan it-tarf u nħollha bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żomm dan it-tarf u nħollha bil-mod.
messages.zh: 可以，你拿住这一头，我慢慢把它解开。
messages.en: Yes, hold this end and I'll untangle it slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用对比画面记忆：lenti 是圆圆的镜片，lenza 是长长的鱼线；看到 lenza 就想象线头系着鱼钩。

gloss_zh: 笔记本电脑；便携式电脑

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable computer with a screen and keyboard that can be folded together for carrying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 屏幕与键盘连为一体、可以折叠合上并随身携带的电脑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompjuter portabbli bi skrin u tastiera li jista' jingħalaq biex jinġarr faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笔记本电脑；便于携带、通常具有可合拢屏幕和内置键盘的个人电脑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompjuter personali li jinġarr faċilment u li għandu skrin li jingħalaq fuq tastiera integrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A laptop is a portable computer with a built-in keyboard and a screen that folds down.

formal.mt: L-istudent uża l-leptop tiegħu biex jikteb ir-rapport u jibagħtu lill-għalliem.
formal.en: The student used his laptop to write the report and send it to the teacher.
formal.zh: 这名学生用自己的笔记本电脑撰写报告，并将报告发给老师。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ġibt il-leptop miegħek? Adam: Iva, imma nsejt iċ-ċarġer id-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you bring your laptop? Adam: Yes, but I left the charger at home.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你带笔记本电脑来了吗？Adam：带了，不过我把充电器忘在家里了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibt il-leptop miegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Ġibt il-leptop miegħek?
messages.zh: 你带笔记本电脑来了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring your laptop?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nsejt iċ-ċarġer id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nsejt iċ-ċarġer id-dar.
messages.zh: 带了，不过我把充电器忘在家里了。
messages.en: Yes, but I left the charger at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leptop 和英语 laptop 对照着读，再想象合上电脑放进书包；记忆时特别留意本词写作 le 开头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gay man who is romantically or sexually attracted to other men.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在情感或性方面受到其他男性吸引的男性同性恋者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jħoss ġibda romantika jew sesswali lejn irġiel oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男同性恋者；在情感或性方面受到同性吸引的男性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna maskili li tħoss ġibda romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni oħra tal-istess sess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gay is a man who is romantically or sexually attracted to other men.

collocations.zh: 一名马耳他男同性恋者
一名年轻的男同性恋者

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju, il-kelma 'leqaf' hija definita bħala raġel li jħoss ġibda romantika jew sesswali lejn irġiel oħra.
formal.en: In the glossary, the word 'leqaf' is defined as a man who is romantically or sexually attracted to other men.
formal.zh: 在词汇表中，leqaf 一词被定义为在情感或性方面受到其他男性吸引的男性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'leqaf' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser raġel omosesswali.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'leqaf' mean in this list? Pawlu: Here it means a gay man.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：这份词表里的 leqaf 是什么意思？保罗：这里指男同性恋者。

messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'leqaf' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'leqaf' f'din il-lista?
