teaching_sense.en_definition: Written works such as novels, poems, and plays, considered collectively as artistic expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小说、诗歌、戏剧等具有艺术表达性质的文字作品的总称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġabra ta' xogħlijiet miktuba, bħal rumanzi, poeżiji u drammi, meqjusa bħala espressjoni artistika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文学；以语言文字进行艺术表达的作品，如小说、诗歌和戏剧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħlijiet li jużaw il-lingwa għall-espressjoni artistika, fosthom ir-rumanzi, il-poeżiji u d-drammi, meqjusa flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Literature consists of written works such as novels, poems, and plays that are valued as artistic expression.

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għal-letteratura Maltija permezz tal-qari u d-diskussjoni ta' poeżiji u rumanzi.
formal.en: The course introduces students to Maltese literature through the reading and discussion of poems and novels.
formal.zh: 本课程通过阅读和讨论诗歌与小说，向学生介绍马耳他文学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tistudja din is-sena? Pawlu: Qed nistudja l-letteratura Maltija, u bħalissa qed naqra rumanz.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you studying this year? Pawlu: I'm studying Maltese literature, and I'm reading a novel at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：你今年在学什么？保罗：我在学马耳他文学，目前正在读一本小说。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tistudja din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tistudja din is-sena?

messages.en: What are you studying this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistudja l-letteratura Maltija, u bħalissa qed naqra rumanz.

messages.zh: 我在学马耳他文学，目前正在读一本小说。
messages.en: I'm studying Maltese literature, and I'm reading a novel at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 letteratura 与英语 literature 对照着记，再想象书架上并排的小说、诗集和剧本，建立“文学作品总称”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who gives lectures or teaches a subject, especially at a university or college.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过讲课教授某一学科的女性，尤指大学或学院的女讲师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tagħti lekċers jew tgħallem suġġett, speċjalment f'università jew f'kulleġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲授某一学科的女讲师，尤指大学或学院的女性教学人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lettriċi hija mara li tagħti lekċers u tgħallem suġġett lil studenti, speċjalment f'università jew f'kulleġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lecturer is someone who teaches a subject through lectures, especially at a university or college; this Maltese noun refers to a woman.

collocations.en: a female lecturer at the university

formal.mt: Il-lettriċi tal-istorja ppreżentat ir-riżultati tar-riċerka tagħha waqt seminar għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The female history lecturer presented her research findings during a seminar for students.
formal.zh: 这位历史学女讲师在面向学生的研讨课上介绍了自己的研究成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jagħti l-lezzjoni llum? Lara: Il-lettriċi l-ġdida. Tispjega kollox ċar ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is teaching the lesson today? Lara: The new female lecturer. She explains everything very clearly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天谁来上课？Lara：新来的那位女讲师。她什么都讲得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħti l-lezzjoni llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħti l-lezzjoni llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁来上课？
messages.en: Who is teaching the lesson today?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lettriċi l-ġdida. Tispjega kollox ċar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lettriċi l-ġdida. Tispjega kollox ċar ħafna.
messages.zh: 新来的那位女讲师。她什么都讲得很清楚。
messages.en: The new female lecturer. She explains everything very clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lettriċi 放进大学课堂画面：一位女讲师站在讲台前讲解，学生认真记笔记。用“女讲师讲课”的完整场景记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who reads a text, book, or other written material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阅读文字、书籍或其他书面材料的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqra test, ktieb jew materjal ieħor miktub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阅读某篇文字、某本书或其他书面材料的人；读者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lettur huwa persuna li taqra xi ħaġa miktuba, bħal ktieb, artiklu jew gazzetta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reader is a person who reads books, articles, or other written material.

formal.mt: L-awtur jinkludi eżempji ċari biex jgħin lil-lettur jifhem l-argument.
formal.en: The author includes clear examples to help the reader understand the argument.
formal.zh: 作者加入了清楚的例子，以帮助读者理解论点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex tixtri din il-gazzetta kuljum? Pawlu: Jien lettur regolari tagħha. Jogħġbuni l-artikli dwar il-kultura.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do you buy this newspaper every day? Pawlu: I'm a regular reader of it. I like the articles about culture.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么每天都买这份报纸？Pawlu：我是它的常客读者。我喜欢里面介绍文化的文章。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tixtri din il-gazzetta kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tixtri din il-gazzetta kuljum?
messages.zh: 你为什么每天都买这份报纸？
messages.en: Why do you buy this newspaper every day?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien lettur regolari tagħha. Jogħġbuni l-artikli dwar il-kultura.
messages.mt_standard: Jien lettur regolari tagħha. Jogħġbuni l-artikli dwar il-kultura.
messages.zh: 我是它的常客读者。我喜欢里面介绍文化的文章。
messages.en: I'm a regular reader of it. I like the articles about culture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lettur 与“打开书或报纸的人”联系起来，记成阅读场景中的“读者”。和本组 lettriċi 的女讲师课堂场景分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of cancer affecting blood-forming tissues and involving abnormal white blood cells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 累及造血组织、涉及异常白细胞的一类癌症。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' kanċer li jaffettwa t-tessuti li jipproduċu ċ-ċelloli tad-demm u jinvolvi ċelloli bojod tad-demm anormali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白血病：发生于造血组织、涉及异常白细胞的一类恶性疾病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-leukemia hija tip ta' kanċer tat-tessuti li jipproduċu ċ-ċelloli tad-demm, li fih jiżviluppaw ċelloli bojod tad-demm anormali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Leukemia is a type of cancer in which blood-forming tissues produce abnormal white blood cells.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi proġett ta' riċerka dwar il-leukemia u l-appoġġ għall-pazjenti.
formal.en: The report describes a research project on leukemia and support for patients.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了一个关于白血病及患者支持的研究项目。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal xiex qed tiġbru l-flus? Nina: Għar-riċerka dwar il-leukemia u biex ngħinu lill-pazjenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you raising money for? Nina: For research into leukemia and to help patients.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你们在为什么筹款？Nina：为了支持白血病研究，也为了帮助患者。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex qed tiġbru l-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex qed tiġbru l-flus?
messages.zh: 你们在为什么筹款？
messages.en: What are you raising money for?

messages.speaker: Nina (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għar-riċerka dwar il-leukemia u biex ngħinu lill-pazjenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għar-riċerka dwar il-leukemia u biex ngħinu lill-pazjenti.
messages.zh: 为了支持白血病研究，也为了帮助患者。
messages.en: For research into leukemia and to help patients.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leukemia 写在“白血病研究”词卡中央，旁边配上血细胞示意图；再连读“研究、治疗、患者”三个场景，帮助记住疾病名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A charge imposed by an authority on goods exported from a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主管机关对从一国出口的货物征收的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas li awtorità timponi fuq oġġetti li jiġu esportati minn pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口征费：主管机关针对出口货物征收的一项费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Levy ta' esportazzjoni huwa ħlas impost minn awtorità fuq oġġetti li jintbagħtu minn pajjiż biex jinbiegħu barra minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An export levy is a charge that an authority imposes on goods sent out of a country.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-awtorità timponi levy ta' esportazzjoni fuq kull tunnellata ta' qamħ esportat.
formal.en: In this example, the authority imposes an export levy on each tonne of wheat exported.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，主管机关对每出口一吨小麦征收一笔出口征费。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-prezz jinkludi t-trasport biss? Lara: Le, jinkludi wkoll levy ta' esportazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does the price include only transport? Lara: No, it also includes an export levy.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个价格只包含运输费吗？Lara：不是，还包含一笔出口征费。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz jinkludi t-trasport biss?
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz jinkludi t-trasport biss?
messages.zh: 这个价格只包含运输费吗？
messages.en: Does the price include only transport?

messages.speaker: Lara (出口业务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jinkludi wkoll levy ta' esportazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jinkludi wkoll levy ta' esportazzjoni.
messages.zh: 不是，还包含一笔出口征费。
messages.en: No, it also includes an export levy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一批货物出境，费用单上多了一项“出口征费”。把 levy ta' esportazzjoni 整组贴在这一栏，用出境货物与缴费场景共同记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small decorative object with a hole through which a thread can pass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常带有穿线孔、可串成首饰或用作装饰的小珠子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir dekorattiv, ġeneralment b'toqba li minnha tista' tgħaddi ħajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珠子，通常带有小孔，可穿在线上制作首饰或装饰品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li jintuża bħala tiżjin u li ġeneralment ikollu toqba biex jgħaddi minnha ħajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bead is a small decorative object that usually has a hole so that it can be threaded onto a string.

formal.mt: Għaddi l-ħajta mit-toqba tal-lewlu biex tibda tagħmel il-ġiżirana.
formal.en: Pass the thread through the hole in the bead to begin making the necklace.
formal.zh: 将线穿过珠子的小孔，开始制作项链。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema lewlu trid għall-brazzuletta? Lara: Dak il-blu, jekk jogħġbok. Maja: Tajjeb, ħa ngħaddihlek mal-ħajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which bead do you want for the bracelet? Lara: The blue one, please. Maja: All right, let me thread it onto the string for you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想用哪颗珠子做手链？Lara：请给我那颗蓝色的。Maja：好，我帮你把它穿到线上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema lewlu trid għall-brazzuletta?
messages.mt_standard: Liema lewlu trid għall-brazzuletta?
messages.zh: 你想用哪颗珠子做手链？
messages.en: Which bead do you want for the bracelet?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-blu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-blu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我那颗蓝色的。
messages.en: The blue one, please.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ħa ngħaddihlek mal-ħajta.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ħa ngħaddihlek mal-ħajta.
messages.zh: 好，我帮你把它穿到线上。
messages.en: All right, let me thread it onto the string for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一颗蓝色珠子穿过细线，边做串珠动作边读 lewlu，把词音与珠子的小孔联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of teaching in which someone learns about a subject or practises a skill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某个科目或某项技能进行的一次教学活动，即一节课。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' tagħlim li fih persuna titgħallem dwar suġġett jew tipprattika ħila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一节课；学习某个科目或某项技能的一次教学活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sessjoni ta' tagħlim li matulha wieħed jitgħallem dwar suġġett jew jiżviluppa ħila.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lesson is a period of time during which someone is taught a subject or skill.

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tal-Malti tibda fid-disgħa u ddum siegħa.
formal.en: The Maltese lesson starts at nine and lasts an hour.
formal.zh: 马耳他语课九点开始，持续一小时。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek lezzjoni llum? Pawlu: Iva, għandi lezzjoni tal-pjanu fil-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have a lesson today? Pawlu: Yes, I have a piano lesson at five.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你今天有课吗？Pawlu：有，我五点有一节钢琴课。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lezzjoni llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lezzjoni llum?
messages.zh: 你今天有课吗？
messages.en: Do you have a lesson today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi lezzjoni tal-pjanu fil-ħamsa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi lezzjoni tal-pjanu fil-ħamsa.
messages.zh: 有，我五点有一节钢琴课。
messages.en: Yes, I have a piano lesson at five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lezzjoni 与课表上的一个课时格联系起来；再用 lezzjoni tal-Malti 和 lezzjoni tal-pjanu 分别记住语言课与技能课。

gloss_zh: 法律法规；立法机关；立法行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Laws considered collectively, or the process of making and passing laws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 统称的一组法律法规，或制定并通过法律的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-liġijiet meqjusa flimkien, jew il-proċess li bih jitfasslu u jiġu approvati l-liġijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由立法机关制定的法律法规的统称，也可指某一领域的法律法规。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-liġijiet magħmula minn korp leġislattiv, meqjusa flimkien jew bħala sett li jirregola qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Legislation consists of laws made by a legislative body, often concerning a particular area of public life.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依法具有制定和通过法律职权的机关或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-korp jew l-istituzzjoni li għandha s-setgħa li tagħmel u tapprova l-liġijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A legislature is the institution or body that has the authority to make and pass laws.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依照规定程序表决通过一项法律的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li bih liġi tiġi approvata mill-korp kompetenti skont il-proċedura stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The act of passing a law occurs when the competent body formally approves it through the required procedure.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-leġislazzjoni ambjentali u jipproponi bidliet biex il-liġijiet ikunu aktar ċari.
formal.en: The report examines environmental legislation and proposes changes to make the laws clearer.
formal.zh: 报告审视了环境法律法规，并提出使法律更加清晰的修改建议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt dwar il-leġislazzjoni ġdida? Mark: Għadni le. Hemm sommarju li nista' naqra?
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you read about the new legislation? Mark: Not yet. Is there a summary I can read?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你读过有关新法规的介绍吗？马克：还没有。有可以读的摘要吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt dwar il-leġislazzjoni ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt dwar il-leġislazzjoni ġdida?
messages.zh: 你读过有关新法规的介绍吗？
messages.en: Have you read about the new legislation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Hemm sommarju li nista' naqra?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Hemm sommarju li nista' naqra?
messages.zh: 还没有。有可以读的摘要吗？
messages.en: Not yet. Is there a summary I can read?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁制定、做什么、形成什么”三个问题记忆：立法机关实施立法行为，形成法律法规；阅读时按上下文区分所给三义。

gloss_zh: 合法的；正当的；有充分理由的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Allowed by law, or reasonable and justified in the circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合法律规定的，或在具体情况下合理且有正当依据的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu permess mil-liġi, jew li għandu raġuni valida u ġustifikazzjoni fiċ-ċirkostanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到法律认可的；也指诉求、疑问或行为等合理、有正当依据的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu rikonoxxut jew permess mil-liġi, jew li jitqies raġonevoli u bbażat fuq raġuni valida.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is legitimate is allowed by law or can be accepted as reasonable and justified.

formal.mt: L-awtur iqis dan id-dubju bħala leġittimu u jispjega li hemm bżonn aktar evidenza.
formal.en: The author considers this doubt legitimate and explains that more evidence is needed.
formal.zh: 作者认为这一疑问有充分理由，并说明还需要更多证据。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi dubju dwar din it-tweġiba. Luqa: Huwa dubju leġittimu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-kalkolu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have a doubt about this answer. Luqa: It is a legitimate doubt. Let's check the calculation together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我对这个答案有疑问。卢卡：这个疑问有道理。我们一起检查一下计算吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi dubju dwar din it-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi dubju dwar din it-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 我对这个答案有疑问。
messages.en: I have a doubt about this answer.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa dubju leġittimu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-kalkolu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa dubju leġittimu. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-kalkolu flimkien.
messages.zh: 这个疑问有道理。我们一起检查一下计算吧。
messages.en: It is a legitimate doubt. Let's check the calculation together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leġittimu 放进“这个疑问有道理”的场景：dubju leġittimu；再联想法律认可的事物，连接“正当”和“合法”两种用法。

gloss_zh: 共同体协调立法；欧盟协调立法

teaching_sense.en_definition: European Union legislation intended to bring member states' rules in a particular area into alignment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在使成员国在特定领域的规则相互协调的欧盟立法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-liġijiet tal-Unjoni Ewropea maħsuba biex iġibu r-regoli tal-Istati Membri f'qasam partikolari f'konformità ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旨在协调成员国在特定领域规则的共同体立法；此义项使用“共同体”这一称谓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-liġijiet tal-Komunità maħsuba biex jarmonizzaw ir-regoli tal-Istati Membri f'qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Community harmonisation legislation refers to Community laws intended to bring member states' rules into alignment in a particular area.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旨在协调成员国在特定领域规则的欧盟立法；此义项使用“联盟”即欧盟这一称谓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-liġijiet tal-Unjoni Ewropea maħsuba biex jarmonizzaw ir-regoli tal-Istati Membri f'qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Union harmonisation legislation refers to European Union laws intended to align member states' rules in a particular area.

collocations.en: the application of Union harmonisation legislation

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddiskuti l-applikazzjoni tal-leġiżlazzjoni tal-Unjoni dwar l-armonizzazzjoni fil-qasam tas-sikurezza tal-prodotti.
formal.en: The report discusses the application of Union harmonisation legislation in the area of product safety.
formal.zh: 报告讨论了欧盟协调立法在产品安全领域的适用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser il-leġiżlazzjoni tal-Unjoni dwar l-armonizzazzjoni? David: Huma liġijiet tal-Unjoni Ewropea li għandhom l-għan li jġibu r-regoli tal-pajjiżi membri f'konformità ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does Union harmonisation legislation mean? David: It means European Union laws that aim to bring member countries' rules into alignment.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：欧盟协调立法是什么意思？戴维：就是旨在使成员国规则相互协调的欧盟法律。

messages.speaker: Anna (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-leġiżlazzjoni tal-Unjoni dwar l-armonizzazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-leġiżlazzjoni tal-Unjoni dwar l-armonizzazzjoni?
messages.zh: 欧盟协调立法是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Union harmonisation legislation mean?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma liġijiet tal-Unjoni Ewropea li għandhom l-għan li jġibu r-regoli tal-pajjiżi membri f'konformità ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Huma liġijiet tal-Unjoni Ewropea li għandhom l-għan li jġibu r-regoli tal-pajjiżi membri f'konformità ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 就是旨在使成员国规则相互协调的欧盟法律。
messages.en: It means European Union laws that aim to bring member countries' rules into alignment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个意义块记忆：leġiżlazzjoni“立法”、tal-Unjoni“欧盟的”、dwar l-armonizzazzjoni“关于协调的”，再把整组短语连成“欧盟协调立法”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional story about people, places, or events that may contain both factual and imaginary elements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流传下来的、关于人物、地方或事件的故事，其中可能同时包含真实与虚构的成分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Storja tradizzjonali dwar nies, postijiet jew ġrajjiet, li jista' jkollha elementi veri u oħrajn mistħajla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世代流传的故事，常涉及特殊人物、地方或事件，其内容未必完全真实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Storja li tingħadda minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra dwar persuna, post jew ġrajja, u li mhux bilfors tkun vera għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A legend is a traditional story that people pass down, often combining real events with imaginary details.

formal.mt: L-awtur jiġbor diversi verżjonijiet ta' leġġenda antika u jqabbel id-dettalji tagħhom.
formal.en: The author collects several versions of an ancient legend and compares their details.
formal.zh: 作者收集了一个古老传说的多个版本，并比较其中的细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf xi leġġenda dwar dan il-kastell? Pawlu: Iva, in-nanna kienet tirrakkontali waħda meta kont żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know any legends about this castle? Pawlu: Yes, my grandmother used to tell me one when I was little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道关于这座城堡的什么传说吗？保罗：知道，我小时候奶奶常给我讲一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf xi leġġenda dwar dan il-kastell?
messages.mt_standard: Taf xi leġġenda dwar dan il-kastell?
messages.zh: 你知道关于这座城堡的什么传说吗？
messages.en: Do you know any legends about this castle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nanna kienet tirrakkontali waħda meta kont żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nanna kienet tirrakkontali waħda meta kont żgħir.
messages.zh: 知道，我小时候奶奶常给我讲一个。
messages.en: Yes, my grandmother used to tell me one when I was little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leġġenda 与“奶奶讲城堡传说”的画面绑定，再用 leġġenda antika 练习表达“古老的传说”。

gloss_zh: 原释义为 Tiekola；所给材料未明确其具体含义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss Tiekola, whose precise meaning is not established by the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中释为 Tiekola 的名词；材料未提供足以确定其具体含义的信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bit-tifsira Tiekola fil-materjal ipprovdut, mingħajr tagħrif biżżejjed biex jiġi stabbilit is-sens preċiż tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义写作 Tiekola；仅凭所给材料无法确定其确切中文对应义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom li għalih il-materjal ipprovdut jagħti Tiekola bħala tifsira, iżda ma jispjegax x'jirreferi għalih eżattament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun is glossed as Tiekola, but the supplied material does not establish what it specifically denotes.

formal.mt: Fil-materjal ipprovdut, il-kelma Leħem hija mogħtija bħala nom bit-tifsira Tiekola, iżda s-sens preċiż tagħha mhuwiex spjegat.
formal.en: In the supplied material, the word Leħem is listed as a noun with the gloss Tiekola, but its precise meaning is not explained.
formal.zh: 所给材料将 Leħem 列为名词，释义为 Tiekola，但没有解释其确切含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma Leħem hawn? Pawlu: Hawn jagħti Tiekola, imma ma jispjegax it-tifsira eżatta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word Leħem mean here? Pawlu: It gives Tiekola here, but it doesn't explain the exact meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 Leħem 是什么意思？保罗：这里给出的释义是 Tiekola，不过没有解释确切含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma Leħem hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma Leħem hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 Leħem 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word Leħem mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jagħti Tiekola, imma ma jispjegax it-tifsira eżatta.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jagħti Tiekola, imma ma jispjegax it-tifsira eżatta.
messages.zh: 这里给出的释义是 Tiekola，不过没有解释确切含义。
messages.en: It gives Tiekola here, but it doesn't explain the exact meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 暂把 Leħem 与材料中的 Tiekola 配对记忆，并标记为待明确词义；例句只用于练习询问词义，避免记入未经证实的解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The beard belonging to the male person being referred to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所谈到的那名男性的胡须，即“他的胡须”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-leħja tal-persuna maskili li tkun qed tissemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他的胡须；指所谈论的那名男性脸上的胡须。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar li jikber fuq il-geddum u l-ħaddejn tal-persuna maskili li tkun qed tissemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: His beard is the hair growing on the chin and cheeks of the male person being discussed.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ir-raġel jidher b'leħjitu twila u b'kappell skur.
formal.en: In the photograph, the man appears with his long beard and a dark hat.
formal.zh: 照片中的男子留着长胡须，戴着一顶深色帽子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu lil Mark? Qaxxar leħjitu! Pawlu: Iva, kważi ma għaraftux mingħajrha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen Mark? He shaved off his beard! Pawlu: Yes, I almost didn't recognize him without it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你见到马克了吗？他把胡须剃掉了！保罗：见到了，没了胡须，我差点没认出他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu lil Mark? Qaxxar leħjitu!
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu lil Mark? Qaxxar leħjitu!
messages.zh: 你见到马克了吗？他把胡须剃掉了！
messages.en: Have you seen Mark? He shaved off his beard!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kważi ma għaraftux mingħajrha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kważi ma għaraftux mingħajrha.
messages.zh: 见到了，没了胡须，我差点没认出他。
messages.en: Yes, I almost didn't recognize him without it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着一名男子的胡须说 leħjitu，把整个词记成“他的胡须”；再用“他的长胡须”和“他剃胡须”两个画面巩固。

gloss_zh: 释义为“malta”，具体所指未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss 'malta', whose intended referent is not clear enough to define confidently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个释义标作“malta”的名词；该释义的具体所指不明确，暂不能可靠确定其中文词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bit-tifsira 'malta', iżda li r-referent tiegħu mhuwiex ċar biżżejjed biex jingħata definizzjoni preċiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “malta”：具体所指未明确，不能据此可靠确定中文对应义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija 'malta', iżda mhuwiex speċifikat x'tirreferi għalih din il-kelma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gloss 'malta' does not establish a sufficiently clear meaning for this noun.

formal.mt: It-tifsira ta' 'leħnu' għandha tiġi ċċarata qabel ma l-kelma tintuża f'eżerċizzju ta' traduzzjoni.
formal.en: The meaning of 'leħnu' should be clarified before the word is used in a translation exercise.
formal.zh: 在翻译练习中使用“leħnu”之前，应先明确它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'leħnu' hawn? Pawlu: It-tifsira mhix ċara. Ejja niċċarawha qabel nittraduċu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'leħnu' mean here? Pawlu: The meaning is unclear. Let's clarify it before translating.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“leħnu”是什么意思？Pawlu：意思还不明确。我们先弄清楚，再翻译。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'leħnu' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'leħnu' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“leħnu”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'leħnu' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifsira mhix ċara. Ejja niċċarawha qabel nittraduċu.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira mhix ċara. Ejja niċċarawha qabel nittraduċu.
messages.zh: 意思还不明确。我们先弄清楚，再翻译。
messages.en: The meaning is unclear. Let's clarify it before translating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把词形与“词义待明确”的提示一起记在卡片上，避免仅凭含混的英文释义建立错误联想。

gloss_zh: 使人心情沉重的；令人忧郁的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somber in a way that makes you feel sad or emotionally weighed down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容气氛、景象或叙述阴郁沉重，使人感到悲伤或压抑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tqanqal fik dwejjaq u ġġiegħlek tħoss toqol f'qalbek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴郁沉重、使人感到悲伤或压抑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħtik sens ta' dwejjaq u toħloq atmosfera tqila u mingħajr ferħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something somber has a dark or sad quality that can make you feel emotionally weighed down.

collocations.en: gloomy weather that brings your spirits down
collocations.zh: 让人心情低落的阴沉天气

collocations.en: a somber story that leaves you feeling sad

formal.mt: L-awtur joħloq ambjent li jagħmillek qalb sewda permezz ta' deskrizzjonijiet ta' toroq vojta u djar abbandunati.
formal.en: The author creates a somber setting through descriptions of empty streets and abandoned houses.
formal.zh: 作者通过描写空荡的街道和废弃的房屋，营造出令人心情沉重的环境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-temp li jagħmillek qalb sewda ilu sejjer tlett ijiem. Pawlu: Veru. Ejja nagħmlu te u naraw xi ħaġa tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Maja: This gloomy weather has been bringing us down for three days. Pawlu: True. Let's make some tea and watch something funny.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种让人心情低落的天气已经持续三天了。Pawlu：是啊。我们泡点茶，看点好笑的东西吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-temp li jagħmillek qalb sewda ilu sejjer tlett ijiem.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-temp li jagħmillek qalb sewda ilu sejjer tlett ijiem.
messages.zh: 这种让人心情低落的天气已经持续三天了。
messages.en: This gloomy weather has been bringing us down for three days.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru. Ejja nagħmlu te u naraw xi ħaġa tad-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Veru. Ejja nagħmlu te u naraw xi ħaġa tad-daħk.
messages.zh: 是啊。我们泡点茶，看点好笑的东西吧。
messages.en: True. Let's make some tea and watch something funny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成阴雨天让心情蒙上一层黑色：记住它描述的是令人忧郁、心情沉重的感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming immediately after the present or previously mentioned person, thing, or period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在当前或刚提到的人、事物或时间之后紧接着出现的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna, ħaġa jew żmien li jiġi minnufih wara dak preżenti jew dak li jkun issemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在顺序或时间上紧接当前或所述对象之后的；下一个的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġi minnufih wara persuna, ħaġa jew perjodu fil-ħin jew fl-ordni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The next person, thing, or period comes immediately after the one you are considering.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa li jmiss tal-kumitat se ssir it-Tlieta filgħodu fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The committee's next meeting will take place on Tuesday morning in the main hall.
formal.zh: 委员会的下一次会议将于星期二上午在主厅举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tiġi għall-ikla l-ġimgħa li jmiss? Mark: Iva, imma nasal ftit tard għax naħdem sas-sitta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you coming to the meal next week? Mark: Yes, but I'll arrive a little late because I work until six.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你下周会来聚餐吗？Mark：会，不过我要工作到六点，所以会晚一点到。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tiġi għall-ikla l-ġimgħa li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: Se tiġi għall-ikla l-ġimgħa li jmiss?
messages.zh: 你下周会来聚餐吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the meal next week?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nasal ftit tard għax naħdem sas-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nasal ftit tard għax naħdem sas-sitta.
messages.zh: 会，不过我要工作到六点，所以会晚一点到。
messages.en: Yes, but I'll arrive a little late because I work until six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上从本周向后移动一格：把 li jmiss 放在时间或事物后面，记成紧接着的下一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A libbiena is a long period with little or no rain, causing a shortage of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指长时间少雨或无雨、导致水分不足的干旱状态或时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu twil bi ftit xita jew mingħajr xita, li jwassal għal nuqqas ta' ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干旱；因长期少雨或无雨而出现缺水的时期或状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nixfa li sseħħ meta għal żmien twil ma tagħmilx biżżejjed xita u jonqos l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A libbiena is a prolonged shortage of rainfall that leaves land and water supplies unusually dry.

formal.mt: Fi żmien ta' libbiena, il-bdiewa jkollhom bżonn jużaw l-ilma b'aktar għaqal biex jipproteġu l-għelejjel.
formal.en: During a drought, farmers need to use water more carefully to protect their crops.
formal.zh: 干旱期间，农民需要更加谨慎地用水，以保护作物。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-ħamrija daqshekk niexfa? Ġużi: Minħabba l-libbiena; ilna ħafna bla xita. Rita: Nispera li tagħmel ix-xita dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is the soil so dry? Ġużi: Because of the drought; we haven't had rain for a long time. Rita: I hope it rains soon.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：土壤为什么这么干？朱齐：因为干旱，我们已经很久没下雨了。丽塔：希望很快就下雨。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħamrija daqshekk niexfa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħamrija daqshekk niexfa?
messages.zh: 土壤为什么这么干？
messages.en: Why is the soil so dry?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-libbiena; ilna ħafna bla xita.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-libbiena; ilna ħafna bla xita.
messages.zh: 因为干旱，我们已经很久没下雨了。
messages.en: Because of the drought; we haven't had rain for a long time.

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nispera li tagħmel ix-xita dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Nispera li tagħmel ix-xita dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 希望很快就下雨。
messages.en: I hope it rains soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 libbiena 写在一幅久不下雨、田地干裂的图旁；重点记住“长期缺雨”，不要只联想到一天的晴天。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A libbra is a unit of weight called a pound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示重量单位“磅”，可用于说明商品或物品的重量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' piż li tintuża biex jitkejjel kemm tiżen xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磅；一种重量单位，此处不是货币单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura ta' piż li biha jista' jiġi espress il-piż ta' oġġetti jew prodotti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A libbra is a pound used as a unit for measuring how much something weighs.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob libbra dqiq u nofs libbra zokkor.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a pound of flour and half a pound of sugar.
formal.zh: 这份食谱需要一磅面粉和半磅糖。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tagħtini libbra zokkor, jekk jogħġbok? Anna: Iva, niżinhulek issa. Mark: Grazzi, dak kollu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Could you give me a pound of sugar, please? Anna: Yes, I'll weigh it for you now. Mark: Thanks, that's everything.
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我一磅糖，好吗？安娜：好的，我现在给你称。马克：谢谢，就这些。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini libbra zokkor, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini libbra zokkor, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一磅糖，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me a pound of sugar, please?

messages.speaker: Anna (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niżinhulek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niżinhulek issa.
messages.zh: 好的，我现在给你称。
messages.en: Yes, I'll weigh it for you now.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, dak kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, dak kollu.
messages.zh: 谢谢，就这些。
messages.en: Thanks, that's everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 libbra 和秤上的一袋糖绑定记忆，整块练习“libbra zokkor＝一磅糖”，看到这个词先想到称重量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Libell is the publication of false written statements that damage someone's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指发表损害他人名誉的虚假书面陈述，也可指这样的诽谤性文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pubblikazzjoni ta' stqarrijiet foloz bil-miktub li jagħmlu ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' persuna, jew il-kitba li jkun fiha dawn l-istqarrijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书面诽谤；以发表虚假文字的方式损害他人名誉的行为或相关文字。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Malafama bil-miktub permezz ta' stqarrijiet foloz ippubblikati li jagħmlu ħsara lill-fama ta' xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Libell is written material containing false statements that harm a person's reputation, or the act of publishing it.

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, il-kawża ta' libell kienet dwar artiklu li kien fih stqarrijiet foloz dwar is-sid ta' ħanut.
formal.en: In the lesson's example, the libel case concerned an article containing false statements about a shop owner.
formal.zh: 在课堂例子中，这起书面诽谤诉讼涉及一篇文章，其中包含关于一位店主的虚假陈述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu libell? Pawlu: Meta xi ħadd jippubblika kitba falza li tagħmel ħsara lill-fama ta' persuna. Maja: Mela mhux sempliċement kritika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is libel? Pawlu: It's when someone publishes false written material that damages a person's reputation. Maja: So it isn't simply criticism.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是书面诽谤？保罗：就是有人发表虚假文字，损害一个人的名誉。玛雅：所以它不只是批评。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu libell?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu libell?
messages.zh: 什么是书面诽谤？
messages.en: What is libel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta xi ħadd jippubblika kitba falza li tagħmel ħsara lill-fama ta' persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Meta xi ħadd jippubblika kitba falza li tagħmel ħsara lill-fama ta' persuna.
messages.zh: 就是有人发表虚假文字，损害一个人的名誉。
messages.en: It's when someone publishes false written material that damages a person's reputation.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela mhux sempliċement kritika.
messages.mt_standard: Mela mhux sempliċement kritika.
messages.zh: 所以它不只是批评。
messages.en: So it isn't simply criticism.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“写下来、内容假、伤名誉”三个提示记住 libell；再用“kawża ta' libell＝书面诽谤诉讼”巩固搭配。

gloss_zh: 自由主义的；思想开放的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Supporting individual freedom and showing openness to different ideas or ways of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持个人自由，并对不同思想或生活方式持开放态度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jappoġġja l-libertà tal-individwu u juri atteġġjament miftuħ lejn ideat jew modi ta' ħajja differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支持个人自由、尊重不同观点或愿意接受新思想的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti importanza lil-libertà personali, jirrispetta fehmiet differenti jew ikun lest jaċċetta ideat ġodda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is liberal supports personal freedom and is willing to consider different ideas.

collocations.zh: 自由主义观点；开明的看法

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tesprimi fehmiet liberali u tenfasizza r-rispett lejn l-għażliet personali.
formal.en: The author expresses liberal views and emphasises respect for personal choices.
formal.zh: 作者表达了自由主义观点，并强调尊重个人选择。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Missierek jaċċetta li taħseb b'mod differenti minnu? Lara: Iva, għandu atteġġjament liberali u jisma' l-opinjoni tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your father accept that you think differently from him? Lara: Yes, he has a liberal attitude and listens to my opinion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爸爸能接受你和他想法不同吗？拉拉：能，他的态度很开明，也会听我的意见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierek jaċċetta li taħseb b'mod differenti minnu?
messages.mt_standard: Missierek jaċċetta li taħseb b'mod differenti minnu?
messages.zh: 你爸爸能接受你和他想法不同吗？
messages.en: Does your father accept that you think differently from him?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu atteġġjament liberali u jisma' l-opinjoni tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu atteġġjament liberali u jisma' l-opinjoni tiegħi.
messages.zh: 能，他的态度很开明，也会听我的意见。
messages.en: Yes, he has a liberal attitude and listens to my opinion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 liberali 放进“愿意听不同意见”的画面中，联想一个敞开的讨论空间，记住它描述支持自由、思想开放的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of reducing restrictions on trade so that goods and services can be exchanged more freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少贸易限制，使商品和服务能够更自由地交换的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu r-restrizzjonijiet fuq il-kummerċ sabiex l-oġġetti u s-servizzi jkunu jistgħu jiġu skambjati b'aktar libertà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自由化；在本词组中指减少对商业交换的限制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu l-kontrolli jew ir-restrizzjonijiet fuq attività; f'din l-espressjoni, fuq il-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Liberalisation is the process of reducing controls or restrictions on an activity, here specifically trade.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易自由化，即减少贸易壁垒或其他限制，让商品和服务的交换更加自由。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu l-ostakli jew restrizzjonijiet oħra fuq il-kummerċ biex l-iskambju tal-oġġetti u tas-servizzi jsir b'aktar libertà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Trade liberalisation involves reducing barriers that restrict the exchange of goods and services.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif il-liberalizzazzjoni tal-kummerċ tista' taffettwa l-iskambju tal-oġġetti bejn il-pajjiżi.
formal.en: The report examines how trade liberalisation may affect the exchange of goods between countries.
formal.zh: 该报告探讨贸易自由化可能如何影响国家之间的商品交换。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'tfisser il-liberalizzazzjoni tal-kummerċ? Rita: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu r-restrizzjonijiet fuq il-kummerċ, biex ikun aktar faċli li jinbiegħu u jinxtraw oġġetti bejn il-pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does trade liberalisation mean? Rita: It means reducing restrictions on trade so that it is easier to sell and buy goods between countries.
colloquial.zh: 马克：贸易自由化是什么意思？丽塔：就是减少贸易限制，让国家之间买卖商品更方便。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser il-liberalizzazzjoni tal-kummerċ?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser il-liberalizzazzjoni tal-kummerċ?
messages.zh: 贸易自由化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does trade liberalisation mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu r-restrizzjonijiet fuq il-kummerċ, biex ikun aktar faċli li jinbiegħu u jinxtraw oġġetti bejn il-pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li jitnaqqsu r-restrizzjonijiet fuq il-kummerċ, biex ikun aktar faċli li jinbiegħu u jinxtraw oġġetti bejn il-pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 就是减少贸易限制，让国家之间买卖商品更方便。
messages.en: It means reducing restrictions on trade so that it is easier to sell and buy goods between countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组想成“跨国商品通道上的障碍逐渐减少”：重点记住这是贸易限制减少的过程，不表示所有限制都已消失。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The freedom to make choices and act without being forced or unnecessarily restricted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够自主作出选择和采取行动，不受强迫或不必要限制的自由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-libertà li wieħed jagħmel l-għażliet tiegħu u jaġixxi mingħajr ma jkun imġiegħel jew ristrett bla bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自主选择和行动、不受强迫或不必要约束的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda li fiha persuna tista' tagħżel u taġixxi minn rajha mingħajr ma tkun imġiegħla jew marbuta b'restrizzjonijiet bla bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Freedom is the ability to make your own choices and act without being forced or unnecessarily restricted.

formal.mt: Fl-esej tagħha, l-istudenta tiddiskuti l-valur tal-liberiżmu u l-importanza tal-għażla personali.
formal.en: In her essay, the student discusses the value of freedom and the importance of personal choice.
formal.zh: 这名学生在文章中讨论了自由的价值以及个人选择的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġik f'moħħok meta tisma' l-kelma liberiżmu? Pawlu: Li nista' nagħżel jien kif ngħix, mingħajr ma xi ħadd iġegħelni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What comes to mind when you hear the word freedom? Pawlu: Being able to choose how I live without someone forcing me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：听到“自由”这个词，你会想到什么？保罗：我能自己选择怎样生活，不受别人强迫。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġik f'moħħok meta tisma' l-kelma liberiżmu?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġik f'moħħok meta tisma' l-kelma liberiżmu?
messages.zh: 听到“自由”这个词，你会想到什么？
messages.en: What comes to mind when you hear the word freedom?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li nista' nagħżel jien kif ngħix, mingħajr ma xi ħadd iġegħelni.
messages.mt_standard: Li nista' nagħżel jien kif ngħix, mingħajr ma xi ħadd iġegħelni.
messages.zh: 我能自己选择怎样生活，不受别人强迫。
messages.en: Being able to choose how I live without someone forcing me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定的“自由”义学习：想象面前有几条生活道路，由自己选择，把 liberiżmu 与“自主选择、不受强迫”连在一起。

gloss_zh: 放荡者；纵欲之人；挥霍无度者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who indulges freely in sexual pleasure or other excesses, with little regard for moral restraint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沉溺于性享乐或其他无节制享受、不顾道德约束的人，通常带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti ruħha għall-pjaċiri sesswali jew għal eċċessi oħra mingħajr wisq rażan morali; il-kelma ġeneralment tesprimi diżapprovazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放荡者；尤指不受传统道德约束、追逐性享乐的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tfittex il-pjaċiri sesswali u ma tagħtix kas tar-regoli morali tradizzjonali dwar l-imġiba tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A libertine is someone who pursues sexual pleasures with little regard for conventional moral standards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫逸放纵的人；在性行为方面缺乏自我约束者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li turi nuqqas ta' rażan fl-imġiba sesswali tagħha u li l-imġiba tagħha titqies bħala immorali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun sense, the word describes a person whose sexual behaviour is considered uncontrolled or immoral.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥霍无度、生活放纵的人；任意耗费金钱或其他资源者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħix bla rażan u taħli l-flus jew riżorsi oħra mingħajr ħsieb għall-konsegwenzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A profligate is someone who wastes money or resources while living in an extravagant and uncontrolled way.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni huwa deskritt bħala libertin li jfittex il-pjaċir mingħajr ma jqis il-konsegwenzi tal-għażliet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is described as a libertine who pursues pleasure without considering the consequences of his choices.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公被描写成一个追逐享乐、不顾自身选择后果的放荡者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kritiku sejjaħlu libertin? Mark: Għax fil-ktieb jgħix għall-pjaċir u ma jagħtix kas ta' min iweġġa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the critic call him a libertine? Mark: Because in the book he lives for pleasure and does not care whom he hurts.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：评论家为什么称他为放荡者？马克：因为他在书里只顾享乐，也不在乎伤害了谁。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kritiku sejjaħlu libertin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kritiku sejjaħlu libertin?
messages.zh: 评论家为什么称他为放荡者？
messages.en: Why did the critic call him a libertine?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fil-ktieb jgħix għall-pjaċir u ma jagħtix kas ta' min iweġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fil-ktieb jgħix għall-pjaċir u ma jagħtix kas ta' min iweġġa'.
messages.zh: 因为他在书里只顾享乐，也不在乎伤害了谁。
messages.en: Because in the book he lives for pleasure and does not care whom he hurts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 libertin 联想成小说里只顾享乐的人：纵欲对应放荡，乱花钱对应挥霍；三个义项都指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The freedom of parties to choose whether to make a contract, whom to contract with, and what terms to agree on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 当事人自主决定是否订立合同、与谁订立合同以及约定哪些条款的自由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-libertà tal-partijiet li jagħżlu jekk jagħmlux kuntratt, ma' min jagħmluh u liema kundizzjonijiet jiftiehmu fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 契约自由，即合同当事人在订约与约定条款方面享有的自主选择空间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-libertà li jkollhom il-partijiet biex jagħmlu l-għażliet tagħhom dwar jekk jidħlux f'kuntratt u dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Contractual freedom allows the parties to make their own choices about entering a contract and agreeing its terms.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同自由，即自主决定是否订约、选择合同相对方并商定合同内容的自由。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-libertà li wieħed jiddeċiedi jekk jagħmilx kuntratt, jagħżel mal-parti l-oħra ta' min jidħol f'dan il-ftehim u jiftiehem magħha fuq il-kontenut tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Freedom of contract means that people can choose whether to contract, with whom, and on what terms.

collocations.en: the principle of freedom of contract

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega l-libertà kuntrattwali permezz ta' eżempju li fih żewġ partijiet jagħżlu li jagħmlu kuntratt u jiftiehmu fuq il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The chapter explains freedom of contract through an example in which two parties choose to make a contract and agree on its terms.
formal.zh: 这一章通过双方自主选择订立合同并商定条款的例子，解释契约自由。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-libertà kuntrattwali tinkludi li nagħżel ma' min nagħmel kuntratt? Rita: Iva, u tinkludi wkoll li tiddeċiedi jekk tagħmilx kuntratt u li tiftiehem mal-parti l-oħra fuq il-kundizzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does freedom of contract include choosing whom I make a contract with? Rita: Yes, and it also includes deciding whether to make a contract and agreeing its terms with the other party.
colloquial.zh: 马克：契约自由包括选择和谁订立合同吗？丽塔：包括，也包括决定是否订约，以及与对方商定条款。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-libertà kuntrattwali tinkludi li nagħżel ma' min nagħmel kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: Il-libertà kuntrattwali tinkludi li nagħżel ma' min nagħmel kuntratt?
messages.zh: 契约自由包括选择和谁订立合同吗？
messages.en: Does freedom of contract include choosing whom I make a contract with?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tinkludi wkoll li tiddeċiedi jekk tagħmilx kuntratt u li tiftiehem mal-parti l-oħra fuq il-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tinkludi wkoll li tiddeċiedi jekk tagħmilx kuntratt u li tiftiehem mal-parti l-oħra fuq il-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 包括，也包括决定是否订约，以及与对方商定条款。
messages.en: Yes, and it also includes deciding whether to make a contract and agreeing its terms with the other party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用签约前的三个问题记忆 libertà kuntrattwali：“签不签、跟谁签、条款怎样定”，把契约自由与具体选择联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male reproductive cell that can unite with an egg cell during fertilization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雄性生殖细胞，可在受精过程中与卵细胞结合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċellola riproduttiva maskili li tista' tingħaqad ma' ċellola tal-bajd waqt il-fertilizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精子；能够在受精过程中与卵细胞结合的雄性生殖细胞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċellola riproduttiva maskili li ġġorr materjal ġenetiku u tista' tingħaqad ma' ċellola tal-bajd biex isseħħ il-fertilizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sperm cell is a male reproductive cell that carries genetic material and can unite with an egg during fertilization.

collocations.en: the structure of a sperm cell
the movement of a sperm cell

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-istruttura tal-libgha u tispjega r-rwol tagħha fil-fertilizzazzjoni taċ-ċellola tal-bajd.
formal.en: The diagram shows the structure of a sperm cell and explains its role in the fertilization of an egg cell.
formal.zh: 该图展示精子的结构，并说明它在卵细胞受精过程中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi libgha? Pawlu: Hija ċellola riproduttiva maskili li tista' tingħaqad ma' ċellola tal-bajd.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is a sperm cell? Pawlu: It is a male reproductive cell that can unite with an egg cell.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么是精子？保罗：它是一种雄性生殖细胞，可以与卵细胞结合。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi libgha?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi libgha?
messages.zh: 什么是精子？
messages.en: What is a sperm cell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (生物老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ċellola riproduttiva maskili li tista' tingħaqad ma' ċellola tal-bajd.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ċellola riproduttiva maskili li tista' tingħaqad ma' ċellola tal-bajd.
messages.zh: 它是一种雄性生殖细胞，可以与卵细胞结合。
messages.en: It is a male reproductive cell that can unite with an egg cell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 libgha 时画一幅精子与卵细胞的示意图，把词贴在精子旁，牢记它指单个细胞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A booklet of blank cheques that an account holder can complete to make payments from a bank account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装订有空白支票的簿册，银行账户持有人可填写其中的支票，用账户资金付款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktejjeb b'ċekkijiet vojta li d-detentur ta' kont bankarju jista' jimla biex jagħmel pagamenti mill-kont tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支票簿；供银行账户持有人填写并签发支票以支付款项的簿册。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktejjeb li fih ċekkijiet vojta, li d-detentur ta' kont bankarju jimla u jiffirma biex jordna pagament mill-kont tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A check book is a booklet of blank checks that you fill in and sign to make payments from your bank account.

collocations.en: to request a new check book
to take a check out of the check book
collocations.zh: 从支票簿中取出一张支票

formal.mt: Id-detentur tal-kont talab librett tal-bank ġdid sabiex ikun jista' jkompli jagħmel pagamenti permezz ta' ċekkijiet.
formal.en: The account holder requested a new check book so that he could continue making payments by check.
formal.zh: 账户持有人申请了一本新支票簿，以便继续使用支票付款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn qiegħed il-librett tal-bank? Lara: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-pinna; għad fadal xi ċekkijiet fih.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the check book? Lara: In the drawer next to the pen; there are still some checks left in it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：支票簿在哪里？拉拉：在抽屉里，笔的旁边；里面还剩几张支票。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qiegħed il-librett tal-bank?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qiegħed il-librett tal-bank?
messages.zh: 支票簿在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the check book?

messages.speaker: Lara (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-pinna; għad fadal xi ċekkijiet fih.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-pinna; għad fadal xi ċekkijiet fih.
messages.zh: 在抽屉里，笔的旁边；里面还剩几张支票。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the pen; there are still some checks left in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 librett tal-bank 和填写支票的画面一起记：翻开小簿、填写金额、签名付款，就能想起支票簿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An accounting book used to record cash received and cash paid out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来登记现金收入和现金支出的会计账簿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb tal-kontabilità li fih jiġu rreġistrati l-flus kontanti li jidħlu u dawk li joħorġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现金簿；按笔登记现金收入与支出的会计账簿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reġistru tal-kontabilità li fih jitniżżlu t-tranżazzjonijiet tal-flus kontanti, kemm id-dħul kif ukoll il-ħruġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cash book is an accounting record in which a business enters the cash it receives and pays out.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现金收支账簿；用于记录现金收款和付款的账簿，与 cash book 为同一含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb li jintuża biex jinżamm rekord tad-dħul u l-ħruġ tal-flus kontanti; din il-forma bl-Ingliż għandha l-istess tifsira bħal cash book.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cash-book is a book used for recording cash receipts and payments, with the same meaning as cash book.

collocations.en: to record income in the cash book

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-ġurnata, il-kaxxier irreġistra d-dħul u l-ħruġ kollu tal-flus kontanti fil-libro-kassa.
formal.en: At the end of the day, the cashier recorded all cash receipts and payments in the cash book.
formal.zh: 一天结束时，出纳将全部现金收入和支出登记在现金簿中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Niżżilt il-ħlas tal-lum fil-libro-kassa? Toni: Iva, u żidt ukoll l-ispiża tal-karti li xtrajna bi flus kontanti.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you enter today's payment in the cash book? Toni: Yes, and I also added the cost of the paper we bought with cash.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你把今天的付款记进现金簿了吗？托尼：记了，也把我们用现金买纸的费用加进去了。

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżżilt il-ħlas tal-lum fil-libro-kassa?
messages.mt_standard: Niżżilt il-ħlas tal-lum fil-libro-kassa?
messages.zh: 你把今天的付款记进现金簿了吗？
messages.en: Did you enter today's payment in the cash book?

messages.speaker: Toni (出纳)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u żidt ukoll l-ispiża tal-karti li xtrajna bi flus kontanti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u żidt ukoll l-ispiża tal-karti li xtrajna bi flus kontanti.
messages.zh: 记了，也把我们用现金买纸的费用加进去了。
messages.en: Yes, and I also added the cost of the paper we bought with cash.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 libro-kassa 时想象一本分成收入、支出两栏的账簿，每收付一笔现金就记一行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used with a mortar to crush or grind ingredients or other substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与研钵配合使用、用于捣碎或研磨食材等物质的杵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża ma' mehrież biex jitgħaffġu jew jitħnu ingredjenti jew sustanzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在研钵内捣碎或研磨物质用的棒状工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda f'għamla ta' bastun li biha jitgħaffġu jew jitħnu sustanzi ġewwa mehrież.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pestle is a tool used to crush or grind substances inside a mortar.

collocations.en: to crush garlic with a pestle

formal.mt: Poġġi ż-żrieragħ fil-mehrież u għaffeġ bil-lida sakemm isiru trab fin.
formal.en: Place the seeds in the mortar and crush them with the pestle until they become a fine powder.
formal.zh: 将种子放入研钵，用研杵捣至细粉状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-lida? Irrid ngħaffeġ it-tewm. Rita: Ħdejn il-mehrież, fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the pestle? I want to crush the garlic. Rita: Next to the mortar, on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：研杵在哪里？我想捣蒜。丽塔：在桌上，研钵旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-lida? Irrid ngħaffeġ it-tewm.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-lida? Irrid ngħaffeġ it-tewm.
messages.zh: 研杵在哪里？我想捣蒜。
messages.en: Where's the pestle? I want to crush the garlic.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-mehrież, fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-mehrież, fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 在桌上，研钵旁边。
messages.en: Next to the mortar, on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lida 写在研杵的图片旁，想象手握它在研钵里捣蒜；再把 lida u mehrież 成对朗读，记住杵与钵的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term referring to a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一种植物的词，现有释义未指明其具体种类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tirreferi għal pjanta, mingħajr ma tispeċifika liema pjanta hi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物；此处未提供具体植物种类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li l-ispeċi tagħha mhix speċifikata f'din it-tifsira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This term refers to a plant whose particular species is not specified here.

formal.mt: Fil-lista, l-isem Lidna jirreferi għal pjanta, iżda ma tingħatax deskrizzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: In the list, the name Lidna refers to a plant, but no description of it is provided.
formal.zh: 在这份清单中，Lidna 这个名称指一种植物，但未提供其描述。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser Lidna f'din il-lista? Toni: Tirreferi għal pjanta, imma l-lista ma tgħidx liema waħda.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does Lidna mean in this list? Toni: It refers to a plant, but the list doesn't say which one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份清单里的 Lidna 是什么意思？托尼：它指一种植物，但清单没说具体是哪一种。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser Lidna f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser Lidna f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份清单里的 Lidna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Lidna mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirreferi għal pjanta, imma l-lista ma tgħidx liema waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Tirreferi għal pjanta, imma l-lista ma tgħidx liema waħda.
messages.zh: 它指一种植物，但清单没说具体是哪一种。
messages.en: It refers to a plant, but the list doesn't say which one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Lidna 与 pjanta“植物”写成配对卡片，配一张泛指植物的简图；只记已给出的植物义，不自行补记物种、外形或用途。

gloss_zh: 正穿着；正戴着（用于男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indicates that a male person has clothing or an accessory on his body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一名男性身上正穿着某种衣服，或正戴着某种配饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li raġel jew tifel għandu ħwejjeġ jew xi aċċessorju fuq ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正穿着或正戴着，用于描述男性当前的穿戴状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tgħid li raġel jew tifel għandu fuqu ħwejjeġ jew aċċessorju partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a male person is wearing something, he has that item of clothing or accessory on his body.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, id-direttur huwa liebes libsa sewda u qmis bajda.
formal.en: In the photograph, the director is wearing a black suit and a white shirt.
formal.zh: 照片中，这位男主管穿着黑色西装和白衬衫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inti liebes għall-festa? Mark: Jien liebes qmis blu u qalziet iswed.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you wearing to the party? Mark: I'm wearing a blue shirt and black trousers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你穿什么去聚会？马克：我穿着蓝衬衫和黑裤子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inti liebes għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inti liebes għall-festa?
messages.zh: 你穿什么去聚会？
messages.en: What are you wearing to the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien liebes qmis blu u qalziet iswed.
messages.mt_standard: Jien liebes qmis blu u qalziet iswed.
messages.zh: 我穿着蓝衬衫和黑裤子。
messages.en: I'm wearing a blue shirt and black trousers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 liebes 和画面中的男生穿搭绑定记忆：hu liebes 表示“他穿着”，重点是身上的穿戴状态。

gloss_zh: 正穿着；正戴着（用于女性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indicates that a female person has clothing or an accessory on her body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一名女性身上正穿着某种衣服，或正戴着某种配饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li mara jew tifla għandha ħwejjeġ jew xi aċċessorju fuq ġisimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正穿着或正戴着，用于描述女性当前的穿戴状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tgħid li mara jew tifla għandha fuqha ħwejjeġ jew aċċessorju partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a female person is wearing something, she has that item of clothing or accessory on her body.

collocations.zh: 穿着一件绿色夹克（女性）

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-kelliema kienet liebsa ġakketta blu u dublett iswed.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the female speaker was wearing a blue jacket and a black skirt.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，这位女发言人穿着蓝色夹克和黑色裙子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif se nagħrfek fl-istazzjon? Maja: Jien liebsa ġakketta ħadra u kappell abjad.
colloquial.en: Mark: How will I recognize you at the station? Maja: I'm wearing a green jacket and a white hat.
colloquial.zh: 马克：到了车站，我怎么认出你？玛雅：我穿着绿色夹克，戴着白帽子。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nagħrfek fl-istazzjon?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nagħrfek fl-istazzjon?
messages.zh: 到了车站，我怎么认出你？
messages.en: How will I recognize you at the station?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien liebsa ġakketta ħadra u kappell abjad.
messages.mt_standard: Jien liebsa ġakketta ħadra u kappell abjad.
messages.zh: 我穿着绿色夹克，戴着白帽子。
messages.en: I'm wearing a green jacket and a white hat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hi liebsa“她穿着”和 hu liebes“他穿着”并排记忆，看到女性穿搭画面就练习说 liebsa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evergreen climbing plant that can grow over walls, trees, or other supports.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种常绿攀缘植物，能够沿墙壁、树木或其他支撑物生长，即常春藤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tibqa' ħadra matul is-sena u tikber billi titla' ma' ħitan, siġar jew appoġġi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 常春藤，一种叶片常绿、可攀附墙壁或树木生长的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta dejjem ħadra li tista' titla' ma' ħajt jew siġra u tgħatti parti minnhom bil-weraq tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ivy is an evergreen plant that climbs walls or trees and can cover them with its leaves.

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tat-tramuntana tal-ġnien huwa miksi bil-liedna.
formal.en: The garden's north wall is covered with ivy.
formal.zh: 花园北侧的墙上爬满了常春藤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-pjanta li qed titla' mal-ħajt? Pawlu: Dik il-liedna. Qed tgħatti l-ħajt kollu!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that plant climbing the wall? Pawlu: That's ivy. It's covering the whole wall!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那株沿墙往上爬的是什么植物？保罗：那是常春藤。整面墙都快被它盖住了！

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-pjanta li qed titla' mal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-pjanta li qed titla' mal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 那株沿墙往上爬的是什么植物？
messages.en: What's that plant climbing the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-liedna. Qed tgħatti l-ħajt kollu!
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-liedna. Qed tgħatti l-ħajt kollu!
messages.zh: 那是常春藤。整面墙都快被它盖住了！
messages.en: That's ivy. It's covering the whole wall!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一面被绿叶覆盖的墙，把画面与 liedna 一起记住，再用“常春藤的叶子”练习短语 weraq tal-liedna。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Working diligently or paying careful attention to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事勤奋认真，或对某事保持专注的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħdem b'ħila u b'impenn jew li jagħti attenzjoni bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤勉的；持续努力、认真完成工作的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaħdem b'impenn u b'attenzjoni biex iwettaq xogħlu sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A diligent person works carefully and makes a steady effort to complete tasks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专注的；认真留意所听、所看或正在发生之事的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti attenzjoni bir-reqqa għal dak li jisma', jara jew ikun qed jiġri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An attentive person listens or watches carefully and notices what is happening.

formal.mt: L-istudent lieżem qara l-istruzzjonijiet bir-reqqa u temm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The diligent student read the instructions carefully and completed the work on time.
formal.zh: 这名勤勉的学生仔细阅读了说明，并按时完成了作业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark hu lieżem ħafna fil-klassi. Lara: Veru, dejjem jisma' sew u jagħmel ix-xogħol kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark is very attentive and diligent in class. Lara: True, he always listens carefully and does all the work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克上课特别专心，也很勤奋。拉拉：确实，他总是认真听讲，还会完成所有作业。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark hu lieżem ħafna fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Mark hu lieżem ħafna fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 马克上课特别专心，也很勤奋。
messages.en: Mark is very attentive and diligent in class.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, dejjem jisma' sew u jagħmel ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, dejjem jisma' sew u jagħmel ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.zh: 确实，他总是认真听讲，还会完成所有作业。
messages.en: True, he always listens carefully and does all the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lieżem 配上一幅学生认真听讲、按时完成作业的画面，同时记住“专注”和“勤勉”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A snake, a reptile with a long body and no legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蛇，一种身体细长、没有腿的爬行动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rettilu b'ġisem twil u bla saqajn li jitkaxkar mal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛇；身体细长、没有腿、以爬行方式移动的爬行动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rettilu li għandu ġisem twil u bla saqajn u li jimxi billi jitkaxkar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A snake is a reptile with a long body and no legs that moves by slithering.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw lifa twila waqt li kienet titkaxkar qalb il-ħaxix.
formal.en: The students observed a long snake as it slithered through the grass.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一条正在草丛中爬行的长蛇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm lifa ħdejn il-ġebla! Mark: Rajtha! Qed titkaxkar lejn il-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there is a snake beside the stone! Mark: I see it! It is slithering towards the grass.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，石头旁边有条蛇！马克：看到了！它正往草丛里爬。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, hemm lifa ħdejn il-ġebla!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, hemm lifa ħdejn il-ġebla!
messages.zh: 看，石头旁边有条蛇！
messages.en: Look, there is a snake beside the stone!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Qed titkaxkar lejn il-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Qed titkaxkar lejn il-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 看到了！它正往草丛里爬。
messages.en: I see it! It is slithering towards the grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 lifa 就想象蛇形图标，再把画面放进“草丛里有一条蛇”的句子中记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that carries people or goods between floors of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在建筑物的不同楼层之间运送人员或货物的电梯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jġorr nies jew merkanzija minn sular għal ieħor f'bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电梯；在建筑物各楼层之间升降、运送人员或货物的设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat f'bini li jitla' u jinżel biex iġorr nies jew merkanzija bejn is-sulari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An elevator carries people or goods up and down between the floors of a building.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 升降电梯；供人员或货物往返于不同楼层的设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mezz li jittrasporta nies jew merkanzija minn sular għal ieħor billi jitla' jew jinżel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lift is a device that takes people or goods from one floor to another.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jieħdu l-lift biex jaslu fir-raba' sular.
formal.en: Visitors can take the lift to reach the fourth floor.
formal.zh: 访客可以乘电梯前往四楼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nieħdu l-lift? Il-basktijiet tqal. Mark: Iva, agħfas il-buttuna tat-tielet sular.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we take the lift? The bags are heavy. Mark: Yes, press the button for the third floor.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们乘电梯吧？这些袋子很重。马克：好，按三楼的按钮。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħdu l-lift? Il-basktijiet tqal.
messages.mt_standard: Nieħdu l-lift? Il-basktijiet tqal.
messages.zh: 我们乘电梯吧？这些袋子很重。
messages.en: Shall we take the lift? The bags are heavy.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħfas il-buttuna tat-tielet sular.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħfas il-buttuna tat-tielet sular.
messages.zh: 好，按三楼的按钮。
messages.en: Yes, press the button for the third floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lift 和按楼层按钮的动作连起来记：提着重袋子进电梯，再说“乘电梯”tieħu l-lift。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrain something or bring it under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 约束或抑制某事物，使其受到控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żamm xi ħaġa taħt kontroll jew naqqas il-qawwa jew iż-żieda tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抑制、约束或遏制，使某种行为、情绪或增长受到控制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rażżan imġiba, sentiment jew żieda u żammhom taħt kontroll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone curbs something, they restrain it or prevent it from increasing beyond acceptable limits.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat liggem l-infiq billi approva biss ix-xiri meħtieġ.
formal.en: The committee curbed spending by approving only necessary purchases.
formal.zh: 委员会只批准必要的采购，以此控制了开支。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kien irrabjat meta sema' l-aħbar? Lara: Iva, imma liggem ir-rabja tiegħu u tkellem bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Mark angry when he heard the news? Lara: Yes, but he curbed his anger and spoke calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克听到消息时生气了吗？拉拉：生气了，但他克制住怒气，平静地说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark kien irrabjat meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Mark kien irrabjat meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 马克听到消息时生气了吗？
messages.en: Was Mark angry when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma liggem ir-rabja tiegħu u tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma liggem ir-rabja tiegħu u tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 生气了，但他克制住怒气，平静地说话。
messages.en: Yes, but he curbed his anger and spoke calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“给增长或情绪踩刹车”的画面记 liggem：开支太多就控制，怒气上来就克制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet alcoholic drink, often flavoured with fruit, herbs, or other ingredients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通常加入水果、香草或其他原料调味的甜味酒精饮品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika ħelwa, spiss mogħtija togħma ta' frott, ħxejjex aromatiċi jew ingredjenti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利口酒，通常带有甜味，并以水果、香草等原料调味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Likur huwa xarba alkoħolika ħelwa li jista' jkollha togħma ta' frott, ħxejjex aromatiċi jew ingredjenti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A liqueur is a sweet alcoholic drink that is often flavoured with fruit, herbs, or other ingredients.

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, il-mistednin ġew offruti tazza żgħira likur tal-lumi.
formal.en: After the meal, the guests were offered a small glass of lemon liqueur.
formal.zh: 用餐后，主人向宾客提供了一小杯柠檬利口酒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit likur wara l-ikel? Mark: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some liqueur after the meal? Mark: Yes, but just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：饭后要喝一点利口酒吗？马克：好，不过请只倒一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit likur wara l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit likur wara l-ikel?
messages.zh: 饭后要喝一点利口酒吗？
messages.en: Would you like some liqueur after the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好，不过请只倒一点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 likur 和饭后一小杯甜酒的画面绑定，看到小酒杯就回想“利口酒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of selling assets and converting them into money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将资产出售并转为现金的过程，可用于清算和偿还债务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' bejgħ ta' assi biex jinbidlu fi flus, pereżempju sabiex jitħallsu d-djun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售资产以变现的行为或过程，尤其指清算时变卖资产以偿债。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih jinbiegħu l-assi u jinbidlu fi flus, speċjalment biex jitħallsu d-djun waqt għeluq ta' negozju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Liquidating assets involves selling them to obtain money, often so that outstanding debts can be paid.

formal.mt: Il-likwidita tal-assi se tipprovdi l-flus meħtieġa biex jitħallsu d-djun tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The liquidation of the assets will provide the money needed to pay the company's debts.
formal.zh: 将资产清算变现可提供偿还公司债务所需的资金。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi l-likwidita tal-assi? Rita: Tfisser li nbiegħu l-assi biex niksbu l-flus. Mark: Biex inħallsu d-djun? Rita: Iva, f'dan il-każ.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is the liquidation of assets? Rita: It means selling the assets to obtain money. Mark: To pay the debts? Rita: Yes, in this case.
colloquial.zh: 马克：资产清算变现是什么意思？丽塔：就是把资产卖掉换成钱。马克：用来还债吗？丽塔：对，这里就是这个用途。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-likwidita tal-assi?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-likwidita tal-assi?
messages.zh: 资产清算变现是什么意思？
messages.en: What is the liquidation of assets?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li nbiegħu l-assi biex niksbu l-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li nbiegħu l-assi biex niksbu l-flus.
messages.zh: 就是把资产卖掉换成钱。
messages.en: It means selling the assets to obtain money.

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inħallsu d-djun?
messages.mt_standard: Biex inħallsu d-djun?
messages.zh: 用来还债吗？
messages.en: To pay the debts?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'dan il-każ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'dan il-każ.
messages.zh: 对，这里就是这个用途。
messages.en: Yes, in this case.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定词义记住“资产→出售→现金”的三步画面，将 likwidita 与清算变现联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Further away than a particular place, or outside a particular limit, usually followed by minn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示位置在某处更远的一边，或范围超出某个界限；通常后接 minn 引出参照点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika post aktar 'il bogħod minn punt partikolari, jew xi ħaġa li taqbeż limitu; normalment tintuża ma' minn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个地点的另一边或更远处；超出某种范围或限度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tinsab aktar 'il bogħod minn post partikolari jew li taqbeż limitu jew firxa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is beyond a place or limit, it is further away than that place or outside that limit.

formal.mt: Iż-żona protetta testendi lil hinn mill-konfini tar-raħal.
formal.en: The protected area extends beyond the village boundaries.
formal.zh: 保护区延伸到了村庄边界之外。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut jinsab lil hinn mill-pont? Pawlu: Iva, aqsam il-pont u ssibu fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shop beyond the bridge? Pawlu: Yes, cross the bridge and you'll find it on the left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店在桥的另一边吗？保罗：对，过桥后你会看到它在左边。

messages.speaker: Maja (问路者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut jinsab lil hinn mill-pont?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut jinsab lil hinn mill-pont?
messages.zh: 商店在桥的另一边吗？
messages.en: Is the shop beyond the bridge?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aqsam il-pont u ssibu fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aqsam il-pont u ssibu fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 对，过桥后你会看到它在左边。
messages.en: Yes, cross the bridge and you'll find it on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上画着一条界线，lil hinn 指向线外更远的一边；把 lil hinn minn 连起来练习，既能说越过桥，也能说超出预期。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form referring to the person being addressed, meaning you or to you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指向说话对象的形式，表示“你”或“给你、对你”，可明确或强调动作所涉及的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tirreferi lill-persuna li qed nitkellmu magħha u tindika li azzjoni tikkonċerna lil dik il-persuna jew hija indirizzata lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你，或给你、对你；指说话者正在交谈的那个人，具体关系由句子决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forma lilek tindika l-persuna li qed tiġi indirizzata, bħala l-persuna li tirċievi xi ħaġa jew li lejha tkun diretta azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This form identifies the person being addressed as someone an action concerns or as the recipient of something.

formal.mt: Dan iċ-ċertifikat qed jingħata lilek bħala rikonoxximent tal-ħidma tiegħek.
formal.en: This certificate is being awarded to you in recognition of your work.
formal.zh: 现向你颁发此证书，以表彰你的工作。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min se tagħti dan il-ktieb? Maja: Lilek! Mark: Grazzi, kont ilni rrid naqrah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who are you giving this book to? Maja: To you! Mark: Thanks, I've been wanting to read it for a long time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你准备把这本书给谁？玛雅：给你呀！马克：谢谢，我早就想读了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min se tagħti dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min se tagħti dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 你准备把这本书给谁？
messages.en: Who are you giving this book to?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lilek!
messages.mt_standard: Lilek!
messages.zh: 给你呀！
messages.en: To you!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, kont ilni rrid naqrah.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, kont ilni rrid naqrah.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我早就想读了。
messages.en: Thanks, I've been wanting to read it for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友把书递到你手里并说 Lilek!，用“递给你”的动作记住“你、给你”。

gloss_zh: 给他们／她们；他们／她们（作宾语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form referring to several people already mentioned, used for the recipients or objects of an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指前文提到的多个人，表示动作的接受者或对象，可译为“给他们／她们”或作宾语的“他们／她们”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hija forma li tirreferi għal grupp ta' persuni diġà msemmija u tintuża għal min jirċievi xi ħaġa jew għal min tkun diretta azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给他们／她们；向他们／她们，表示多个人是接收者或动作所指向的对象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tingħata, tintbagħat jew tingħad lil grupp ta' persuni diġà msemmija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you send or give something to them, the people already mentioned are its recipients.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们／她们，作动词的宾语，指已经提到的多个人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirreferi għal grupp ta' persuni diġà msemmija meta dawn ikunu l-oġġett ta' azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use them to refer to people already mentioned when they are the object of an action.

formal.mt: L-għalliem bagħat l-istruzzjonijiet lilhom qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The teacher sent the instructions to them before the meeting.
formal.zh: 老师在会议前把说明发给了他们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil Sara u lil Mark illum? Pawlu: Iva, rajt lilhom ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Sara and Mark today? Pawlu: Yes, I saw them near the school.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天看到萨拉和马克了吗？保罗：看到了，我在学校附近看到了他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil Sara u lil Mark illum?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil Sara u lil Mark illum?
messages.zh: 你今天看到萨拉和马克了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Sara and Mark today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajt lilhom ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajt lilhom ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.zh: 看到了，我在学校附近看到了他们。
messages.en: Yes, I saw them near the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lilhom 记在“他们那一组”的人物卡上：寄信时是“给他们”，看见时是“看见他们”；用同一组人物对照练习两种宾语关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pronoun referring to two or more people being addressed as the recipients of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指正在交谈的两个或更多听话人，表示“给你们”或“向你们”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Huwa pronom li jirreferi għal żewġ persuni jew aktar li l-kelliem ikun qed ikellem u li jkunu qed jirċievu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给你们；向你们，所指的听话人是两个或更多人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tingħata, tintbagħat jew tingħad lil żewġ persuni jew aktar li l-kelliem ikun qed ikellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this form when addressing two or more people who receive something or are spoken to.

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur se jibgħat ir-riżultati lilkom għada.
formal.en: The coordinator will send the results to you all tomorrow.
formal.zh: 协调员明天会把结果发给你们。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tibgħat il-messaġġ lilna t-tnejn? Mark: Iva, se nibgħat il-messaġġ lilkom it-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will you send the message to both of us? Mark: Yes, I'll send the message to both of you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你会把消息发给我们两个人吗？马克：会，我会把消息发给你们两个人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tibgħat il-messaġġ lilna t-tnejn?
messages.mt_standard: Se tibgħat il-messaġġ lilna t-tnejn?
messages.zh: 你会把消息发给我们两个人吗？
messages.en: Will you send the message to both of us?

messages.speaker: Mark (班级联络员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nibgħat il-messaġġ lilkom it-tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nibgħat il-messaġġ lilkom it-tnejn.
messages.zh: 会，我会把消息发给你们两个人。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send the message to both of you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师面向全班递出通知，接收者是“你们”：用 lilkom 配合指向多位听众的手势，牢牢记住这里的“你”是复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form referring to the speaker and one or more other people as the objects or recipients of an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指说话人和至少一位其他人，表示作宾语的“我们”，也可表示“给我们”或“向我们”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Hija forma li tirreferi għall-kelliem flimkien ma' persuna oħra jew aktar, meta dawn ikunu l-oġġett ta' azzjoni jew jirċievu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们，指说话人及至少一位其他人，用作动作的对象或接收者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirreferi għall-kelliem u għal persuna oħra jew aktar meta azzjoni tkun diretta lejhom jew meta jingħataw xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use us to refer to yourself and one or more other people as the objects or recipients of an action.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għażel lilna biex nippreżentaw il-proġett.
formal.en: The committee chose us to present the project.
formal.zh: 委员会选择了我们来介绍这个项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min bagħat l-invit Pawlu? Sara: Bagħat l-invit lilna t-tnejn. Trid tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who did Pawlu send the invitation to? Sara: He sent the invitation to both of us. Do you want to come with me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗把邀请发给谁了？萨拉：他发给了我们两个人。你想和我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min bagħat l-invit Pawlu?
