colloquial.zh: Sara：训练时我可以把包放在哪里？Pawlu：放进储物柜，把钥匙带在身上。

messages.speaker: Sara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nħalli l-basket waqt it-taħriġ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nħalli l-basket waqt it-taħriġ?
messages.zh: 训练时我可以把包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where can I leave my bag during training?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih fil-loker u żomm iċ-ċavetta miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih fil-loker u żomm iċ-ċavetta miegħek.
messages.zh: 放进储物柜，把钥匙带在身上。
messages.en: Put it in the locker and keep the key with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用健身房寄存包的画面记 loker：先放包，再锁柜，最后带走钥匙；把“储物柜”和 ċavetta tal-loker 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toilet or a place equipped for people to pass urine and faeces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人大小便的厕所或便所；具体设施可以是冲水式厕所，也可以是较简易的便所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tojlit jew post mgħammar biex in-nies jagħmlu l-bżonnijiet tagħhom, kemm jekk ikun b'sistema tal-ilma kif ukoll jekk ikun aktar sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设有冲水便器的厕所，通常指独立的小厕间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira b'tojlit li juża l-ilma biex ilaħlaħ u jneħħi l-ħmieġ wara l-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A watercloset is a toilet with a flushing system, or a small room containing one.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人大小便的简易便所，尤指营地等处的公共或临时厕所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post sempliċi fejn in-nies jagħmlu l-bżonnijiet tagħhom, speċjalment f'kamp jew f'post b'faċilitajiet limitati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A latrine is a basic toilet, often provided in a camp or used by several people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人大小便的便器，或设有这种便器的厕所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat sanitarju li jintuża biex persuna tagħmel il-bżonnijiet tagħha, jew il-kamra fejn jinsab dan l-apparat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A toilet is a fixture used for passing bodily waste, or the room containing that fixture.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jagħlqu l-bieb tal-loki wara l-użu u jaħslu jdejhom.
formal.en: Visitors are asked to close the toilet door after use and wash their hands.
formal.zh: 请访客使用厕所后关门，并清洗双手。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Skużani, fejn hu l-loki? Toni: Fl-aħħar tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Lara: Excuse me, where is the toilet? Toni: At the end of the corridor, on the left.
colloquial.zh: Lara：打扰一下，厕所在哪里？Toni：在走廊尽头，左手边。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, fejn hu l-loki?
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, fejn hu l-loki?
messages.zh: 打扰一下，厕所在哪里？
messages.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

messages.speaker: Toni (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħħar tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħħar tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 在走廊尽头，左手边。
messages.en: At the end of the corridor, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 loki 放进问路句 Fejn hu l-loki? 来记，想象沿走廊寻找厕所；三个英语释义都围绕如厕设施，具体设备随语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The place or position that belongs to you or has been assigned to you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于你、留给你或安排给你的位置或地方，例如你的座位或站立位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post li hu tiegħek jew li ġie magħżul għalik, bħal fejn għandek toqgħod bilqiegħda jew bilwieqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 属于你或分配给你的位置、座位或地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-post li jappartjeni lilek jew li ġie allokat għalik biex toqgħod fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your place is the position or space that belongs to you or has been set aside for you.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda ċ-ċerimonja, ħu lokok fis-sala u stenna l-istruzzjonijiet tal-organizzaturi.
formal.en: Before the ceremony begins, take your place in the hall and wait for the organisers' instructions.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，请在大厅就位，并等候组织者的指示。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan hu lokok ħdejn it-tieqa? Adam: Iva, ħallejt il-basket hemm biex inżomm il-post.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this your place by the window? Adam: Yes, I left my bag there to save the spot.
colloquial.zh: Nina：窗边这里是你的位置吗？Adam：是的，我把包放在那里占位。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu lokok ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu lokok ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 窗边这里是你的位置吗？
messages.en: Is this your place by the window?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallejt il-basket hemm biex inżomm il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallejt il-basket hemm biex inżomm il-post.
messages.zh: 是的，我把包放在那里占位。
messages.en: Yes, I left my bag there to save the spot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lokok 整体配上“你的位置”来记：想象有人指向留给你的座位，说 ħu lokok；练习时直接联想“请就位”的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement from one place to another, especially by a person or animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物从一个地方移动到另一个地方的运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment li bih persuna jew annimal jgħaddi minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人或动物通过行走、游泳等方式从一处移至另一处的运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment minn post għal ieħor, pereżempju permezz tal-mixi, tal-għawm jew tat-titjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Locomotion is the movement of a person or animal from one place to another.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel il-lokomozjoni tal-ħut fl-ilma ma' dik tal-għasafar fl-ajru.
formal.en: The study compares the locomotion of fish in water with that of birds in the air.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较鱼在水中的移动与鸟在空中的移动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser lokomozjoni? Pawlu: Tfisser li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor, bħal meta timxi jew tgħum.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does locomotion mean? Pawlu: It means moving from one place to another, like when you walk or swim.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：lokomozjoni 是什么意思？保罗：就是从一个地方移动到另一个地方，比如走路或游泳。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser lokomozjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser lokomozjoni?
messages.zh: lokomozjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does locomotion mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor, bħal meta timxi jew tgħum.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor, bħal meta timxi jew tgħum.
messages.zh: 就是从一个地方移动到另一个地方，比如走路或游泳。
messages.en: It means moving from one place to another, like when you walk or swim.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把走路、游泳、飞行想成三幅连续画面：方式不同，都是从甲地到乙地的 lokomozjoni。

gloss_zh: 夏日闷热；热天傍晚不散的暑气

teaching_sense.en_definition: An oppressive summer heat, including heat that lingers towards the end of a hot day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夏季令人难受的闷热，也指炎热一天将尽时仍未消散的热气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħana tqila u soffokanti tas-sajf, li tista' tibqa' tinħass ukoll lejn tmiem ġurnata sħuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夏季令人憋闷、难以舒适活动的暑热。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sħana tas-sajf li tkun tqila u soffokanti u ġġiegħlek tħossok skomdu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A longa is a spell of oppressive summer heat that makes the air feel stifling.

sense_translations.en_definition: a persistent heat at the end of a hot day
sense_translations.zh_definition: 炎热的一天接近尾声时仍然持续、没有散去的热气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sħana li tibqa' tinħass lejn tmiem ġurnata sħuna, meta wieħed ikun qed jistenna li l-arja tiffriska.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Longa also refers to heat that remains towards the end of an already hot day.

formal.mt: Minkejja li niżlet ix-xemx, il-longa baqgħet tinħass fil-kmamar.
formal.en: Although the sun had set, the lingering heat could still be felt in the rooms.
formal.zh: 尽管太阳已经落山，房间里仍然能感到未散的暑气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xemx niżlet, imma din il-longa għadha tinħass! Toni: Iva, ejja niftħu t-twieqi biex tidħol ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Lara: The sun has set, but this heat is still hanging around! Toni: Yes, let's open the windows to let some air in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：太阳都落山了，这股暑气还没散！托尼：是啊，咱们打开窗户透透气吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xemx niżlet, imma din il-longa għadha tinħass!
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xemx niżlet, imma din il-longa għadha tinħass!
messages.zh: 太阳都落山了，这股暑气还没散！
messages.en: The sun has set, but this heat is still hanging around!

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja niftħu t-twieqi biex tidħol ftit arja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja niftħu t-twieqi biex tidħol ftit arja.
messages.zh: 是啊，咱们打开窗户透透气吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's open the windows to let some air in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夏天太阳落山了，屋里却还像蒸笼；用这幅闷热不散的画面记住 longa 的两个热感义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To direct one's gaze towards the person being addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把目光投向正在对话的对象，即朝你看或向你张望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħares lejn il-persuna li tkun qed tkellimha jew titfa' ħarsa fid-direzzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝你看、向你所在的方向张望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħares lejk jew titfa' ħarsa fid-direzzjoni tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To look at you is to direct one's eyes towards you.

collocations.en: looks towards you through the window
looks towards you from the doorway

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifla tittawwalek mit-tieqa hekk kif tasal quddiem id-dar.
formal.en: In the story, the girl looks towards you through the window as you arrive in front of the house.
formal.zh: 在故事中，你刚来到屋前，女孩就从窗户朝你张望。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi Sara? Mark: Hemm, tittawwalek mit-tieqa. Nina: Issa rajtha!
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Sara? Mark: There, she's looking towards you through the window. Nina: I can see her now!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：萨拉在哪里？马克：在那儿，她正从窗户朝你看。妮娜：现在我看见她了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi Sara?
messages.zh: 萨拉在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Sara?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm, tittawwalek mit-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm, tittawwalek mit-tieqa.
messages.zh: 在那儿，她正从窗户朝你看。
messages.en: There, she's looking towards you through the window.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa rajtha!
messages.mt_standard: Issa rajtha!
messages.zh: 现在我看见她了！
messages.en: I can see her now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把英文 look at you 和包中形式 Tittawwalek 配对记忆：想象朋友站在窗边，目光正朝向你。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A smooth surface shine, or polish used to produce that shine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光滑表面的光泽，也指使表面发亮的抛光处理或上光剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra lixxa u tleqq ta' wiċċ, jew l-illustrar jew il-materjal li jintuża biex jagħtih dik id-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物体表面光滑、能反光的光泽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dehra tleqq ta' wiċċ lixx li jirrifletti d-dawl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gloss of a surface is its smooth, shiny appearance when it reflects light.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使表面光滑发亮的抛光处理，或用于这种处理的上光剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-illustrar ta' wiċċ biex isir lixx u jleqq, jew il-materjal użat għal dan l-iskop.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Polish is a treatment or substance used to make a surface smooth and shiny.

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif u l-illustrar, il-mejda reġgħet kisbet il-lostru tagħha.
formal.en: After cleaning and polishing, the table regained its gloss.
formal.zh: 经过清洁和抛光，这张桌子恢复了光泽。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex din il-mejda qed tleqq daqshekk? Ben: Tajtha l-lostru dalgħodu. Anna: Tidher sabiħa ħafna!
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is this table so shiny? Ben: I polished it this morning. Anna: It looks lovely!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这张桌子怎么这么亮？本：我今天早上给它上了光。安娜：看起来真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-mejda qed tleqq daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-mejda qed tleqq daqshekk?
messages.zh: 这张桌子怎么这么亮？
messages.en: Why is this table so shiny?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajtha l-lostru dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajtha l-lostru dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 我今天早上给它上了光。
messages.en: I polished it this morning.

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tidher sabiħa ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Tidher sabiħa ħafna!
messages.zh: 看起来真漂亮！
messages.en: It looks lovely!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给木桌上光后，桌面映出灯光：把上光处理、上光剂和产生的光泽一起联系到 lostru。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance applied to shoes to clean them, protect their surface, and make them shine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在鞋面上，用于清洁、保护鞋面并使其发亮的鞋油或擦鞋膏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tiġi applikata fuq iż-żraben biex tnaddafhom, tipproteġi l-wiċċ tagħhom u tagħtihom it-tleqqija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于擦拭、保养鞋面并使其发亮的鞋油或擦鞋膏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tnaddaf u tipproteġi l-wiċċ taż-żraben u tagħmlu jleqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shoe polish is a substance that you put on shoes to clean and protect them and make them shine.

formal.mt: Applika ftit lostru taż-żraben b'ċarruta ratba, imbagħad illustra ż-żraben b'pinzell nadif.
formal.en: Apply a little shoe polish with a soft cloth, then buff the shoes with a clean brush.
formal.zh: 用软布涂上少量鞋油，然后用干净的鞋刷把鞋擦亮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-lostru taż-żraben? Għandi bżonnu għaż-żraben suwed. Mark: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-bieb. Ħu wkoll il-pinzell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the shoe polish? I need it for my black shoes. Mark: In the drawer by the door. Take the brush too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：鞋油在哪里？我要用它擦我的黑鞋。Mark：在门旁边的抽屉里。也把鞋刷拿上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-lostru taż-żraben? Għandi bżonnu għaż-żraben suwed.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-lostru taż-żraben? Għandi bżonnu għaż-żraben suwed.
messages.zh: 鞋油在哪里？我要用它擦我的黑鞋。
messages.en: Where is the shoe polish? I need it for my black shoes.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-bieb. Ħu wkoll il-pinzell.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-bieb. Ħu wkoll il-pinzell.
messages.zh: 在门旁边的抽屉里。也把鞋刷拿上。
messages.en: In the drawer by the door. Take the brush too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“鞋油罐、软布、鞋刷”一起记忆：看到 lostru taż-żraben，就想象给一双鞋涂油擦亮的动作。

gloss_zh: 有奖抽签；彩票；彩票抽奖

teaching_sense.en_definition: An activity in which people buy tickets and prizes are awarded according to a random draw of tickets or numbers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与者购买彩票或抽奖券，再通过随机抽取票券或号码来决定获奖者的活动，包括有奖抽签和彩票抽奖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività li fiha n-nies jixtru biljetti u jingħataw premjijiet skont tlugħ bix-xorti ta' biljetti jew numri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售抽奖券后随机抽出中奖票券、向持券者颁发奖品的有奖抽签活动，常用于筹款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività li fiha jinbiegħu biljetti u jittellgħu xi wħud minnhom bix-xorti biex is-sidien tagħhom jirbħu premjijiet, spiss biex jinġabru fondi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A raffle is an activity in which people buy tickets and some tickets are then drawn at random to decide who wins the prizes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过购买彩票参与、按随机抽出的号码或票券决定奖金或奖品归属的彩票抽奖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħba tax-xorti li fiha l-parteċipanti jixtru biljetti u jistgħu jirbħu flus jew premjijiet skont in-numri jew il-biljetti li jittellgħu bix-xorti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lottery is a game in which people buy tickets and win money or other prizes if their numbers or tickets are selected at random.

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza lotterija biex tiġbor fondi għall-librerija; il-biljetti rebbieħa se jittellgħu waqt il-festa tal-iskola.
formal.en: The school will hold a raffle to raise funds for the library; the winning tickets will be drawn during the school celebration.
formal.zh: 学校将举办有奖抽签，为图书馆筹款；中奖票券将在校庆活动期间抽出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xtrajt biljett għal-lotterija tal-klabb? Hemm rota bħala premju! Pawlu: Iva, xtrajt wieħed. Forsi nirbaħha!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you buy a ticket for the club raffle? There's a bicycle as a prize! Pawlu: Yes, I bought one. Maybe I'll win it!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你买俱乐部有奖抽签的票了吗？奖品里有一辆自行车！Pawlu：买了，我买了一张。说不定能赢到那辆车！

messages.speaker: Sara (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtrajt biljett għal-lotterija tal-klabb? Hemm rota bħala premju!
messages.mt_standard: Xtrajt biljett għal-lotterija tal-klabb? Hemm rota bħala premju!
messages.zh: 你买俱乐部有奖抽签的票了吗？奖品里有一辆自行车！
messages.en: Did you buy a ticket for the club raffle? There's a bicycle as a prize!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajt wieħed. Forsi nirbaħha!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajt wieħed. Forsi nirbaħha!
messages.zh: 买了，我买了一张。说不定能赢到那辆车！
messages.en: Yes, I bought one. Maybe I'll win it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“买票—抽签—领奖”三个画面记住 lotterija：学校筹款抽奖可译为 raffle，购买彩票参与的抽奖可译为 lottery，具体译法看场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liquid preparation applied to the skin to moisturize, protect, or care for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂抹在皮肤上，用来滋润、保护或护理皮肤的液状制剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni likwida li tintuża fuq il-ġilda biex iżżommha ratba, tipproteġiha jew tieħu ħsiebha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于涂抹皮肤的润肤乳或护肤液。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Likwidu għall-kura tal-ġilda li jiġi applikat fuqha biex iżommha ratba jew jipproteġiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lotion is a liquid preparation that you apply to your skin to moisturize, protect, or care for it.

formal.mt: L-istedina tinforma lill-parteċipanti li kull borża tar-rigali fiha lozjoni għall-ġisem u sapuna.
formal.en: The invitation informs participants that each gift bag contains body lotion and a bar of soap.
formal.zh: 邀请函告知参加者，每个礼品袋内都有身体乳和一块香皂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek lozjoni għall-idejn? Idejja niexfa ħafna. Lara: Iva, hemm waħda fil-basket tiegħi. Tista' tużaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have any hand lotion? My hands are very dry. Lara: Yes, there's some in my bag. You can use it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有护手乳吗？我的手很干。拉拉：有，我包里有一瓶。你可以用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lozjoni għall-idejn? Idejja niexfa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lozjoni għall-idejn? Idejja niexfa ħafna.
messages.zh: 你有护手乳吗？我的手很干。
messages.en: Do you have any hand lotion? My hands are very dry.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda fil-basket tiegħi. Tista' tużaha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda fil-basket tiegħi. Tista' tużaha.
messages.zh: 有，我包里有一瓶。你可以用。
messages.en: Yes, there's some in my bag. You can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lozjoni 和洗手后涂护手乳的画面一起记：lozjoni għall-idejn 是护手乳，lozjoni għall-ġisem 是身体乳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something logical follows clear reasoning or makes sense in the circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指推理清楚、前后符合逻辑，或根据具体情况显得合理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun loġika meta ssegwi raġunament ċar jew tagħmel sens fiċ-ċirkostanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合乎逻辑的；依据清楚的推理或具体情况而合理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsegwi raġunament ċar u konsistenti jew li jagħmel sens meta jitqiesu l-fatti u ċ-ċirkostanzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is logical follows clear reasoning or is sensible when the facts are considered.

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta argument loġiku u jappoġġa kull pass b'evidenza ċara.
formal.en: The author presents a logical argument and supports each step with clear evidence.
formal.zh: 作者提出了合乎逻辑的论证，并用明确的证据支持每一步推理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nixtru l-biljetti qabel nitilqu? Mark: Iva, hekk hu loġiku. Ma jkollniex għalfejn nistennew hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we buy the tickets before we leave? Mark: Yes, that makes sense. We won't have to wait there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们出发前先买票吗？马克：对，这样很合理。我们就不用在那里等了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtru l-biljetti qabel nitilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Nixtru l-biljetti qabel nitilqu?
messages.zh: 我们出发前先买票吗？
messages.en: Shall we buy the tickets before we leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hu loġiku. Ma jkollniex għalfejn nistennew hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hu loġiku. Ma jkollniex għalfejn nistennew hemm.
messages.zh: 对，这样很合理。我们就不用在那里等了。
messages.en: Yes, that makes sense. We won't have to wait there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 loġiku 放进“有理由，所以结论说得通”的推理链中；用 argument loġiku 记“合乎逻辑的论证”。

gloss_zh: 物流的；后勤的；与组织调配有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something logistic concerns the practical organization of transport, supplies, people, or resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指涉及运输、物资供应、人员安排或资源调配等实际组织工作的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun loġistika meta tkun marbuta mal-organizzazzjoni prattika tat-trasport, tal-provvisti, tan-nies jew tar-riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物流或后勤方面的；涉及运输、供应及人员或资源组织调配的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ippjanar u l-organizzazzjoni tat-trasport, tal-provvisti u tat-tqassim ta' nies jew riżorsi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Logistic activities involve organizing the transport, supplies, and resources needed for an operation or event.

formal.mt: Il-pjan loġistiku tal-konferenza jinkludi t-trasport tal-parteċipanti u t-tqassim tat-tagħmir fis-swali.
formal.en: The conference's logistic plan includes participant transport and the distribution of equipment to the halls.
formal.zh: 会议的后勤计划包括参与者的交通安排以及各会场的设备配送。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jieħu l-imwejjed sas-sala? Toni: It-tim loġistiku. Diġà għandu vann lest.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will take the tables to the hall? Toni: The logistics team. It already has a van ready.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：谁把桌子运到会场？托尼：后勤团队。他们已经准备好一辆货车了。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu l-imwejjed sas-sala?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu l-imwejjed sas-sala?
messages.zh: 谁把桌子运到会场？
messages.en: Who will take the tables to the hall?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim loġistiku. Diġà għandu vann lest.
messages.mt_standard: It-tim loġistiku. Diġà għandu vann lest.
messages.zh: 后勤团队。他们已经准备好一辆货车了。
messages.en: The logistics team. It already has a van ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 loġistiku，就想“人怎么到、货怎么运、设备怎么分”；把这三项具体安排与 appoġġ loġistiku“后勤支持”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loġġa is an architectural feature that, depending on context, is a skylight, an arcade, or an arch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑名词，依语境可指屋顶采光用的天窗、由连续拱构成的拱廊，或单个拱形结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Loġġa hija element arkitettoniku li, skont il-kuntest, jista' jkun fetħa fis-saqaf għad-dawl, passaġġ b'sensiela ta' arkati jew struttura fil-forma ta' arkata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设置在屋顶、让自然光进入室内的天窗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fetħa fis-saqaf, ġeneralment magħluqa bil-ħġieġ, li tħalli d-dawl naturali jidħol fil-bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A skylight is a window or glazed opening in a roof that lets daylight into a building.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由一系列拱及其支柱构成的拱廊，常形成有遮蔽的通道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' arkati fuq kolonni jew pilastri li spiss tifforma passaġġ mgħotti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arcade is a series of arches supported by columns or pillars, often forming a covered passage.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跨越开口或通道上方的弯曲拱形建筑结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura mgħawġa li tifforma l-parti ta' fuq ta' fetħa jew passaġġ u tinfirex bejn żewġ naħat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arch is a curved structure that spans an opening such as a doorway or passage.

collocations.en: an arcade with a series of arches

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' restawr jipprevedi t-tindif tal-ħġieġ tal-loġġa fis-saqaf sabiex jidħol aktar dawl naturali.
formal.en: The restoration plan provides for cleaning the glass of the skylight in the roof so that more natural light can enter.
formal.zh: 修复方案计划清洁屋顶天窗的玻璃，以便让更多自然光进入室内。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn dieħel dan id-dawl kollu? Pawlu: Mil-loġġa fis-saqaf. Ħares 'il fuq!
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is all this light coming from? Pawlu: Through the skylight in the roof. Look up!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这么多光是从哪里照进来的？保罗：从屋顶的天窗照进来的。抬头看！

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn dieħel dan id-dawl kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn dieħel dan id-dawl kollu?
messages.zh: 这么多光是从哪里照进来的？
messages.en: Where is all this light coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Mil-loġġa fis-saqaf. Ħares 'il fuq!
messages.mt_standard: Mil-loġġa fis-saqaf. Ħares 'il fuq!
messages.zh: 从屋顶的天窗照进来的。抬头看！
messages.en: Through the skylight in the roof. Look up!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅建筑小图记 loġġa：屋顶透光是“天窗”，连续多个拱是“拱廊”，单个弯曲结构是“拱”；结合语境分别识别。

gloss_zh: 半睡半醒的；睡眼惺忪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Half-asleep and not yet fully alert.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于半睡半醒、尚未完全清醒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab bejn l-irqad u l-qawmien u għadu mhux għalkollox attent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半睡半醒的，尚未完全醒来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għadu kemxejn rieqed u mhux imqajjem għal kollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is half-asleep is still sleepy and only partly aware of what is happening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于部分清醒、部分仍在睡眠中的状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fi stat bejn l-irqad u l-qawmien, b'għarfien parzjali ta' dak li qed jiġri madwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone in this state is partly awake but has not become fully alert.

formal.mt: Meta beda l-vjaġġ kmieni filgħodu, it-tifel kien għadu lubien u bilkemm wieġeb għall-mistoqsijiet ta' missieru.
formal.en: When the journey began early in the morning, the boy was still half-asleep and barely answered his father's questions.
formal.zh: 清晨出发时，男孩仍然半睡半醒，几乎没有回答父亲的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek lubien? Mark: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini ħames minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still half-asleep? Mark: Yes, I've only just got up. Give me five minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还没完全睡醒吗？马克：对，我刚起床。给我五分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek lubien?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek lubien?
messages.zh: 你还没完全睡醒吗？
messages.en: Are you still half-asleep?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini ħames minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini ħames minuti.
messages.zh: 对，我刚起床。给我五分钟。
messages.en: Yes, I've only just got up. Give me five minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lubien 配上闹钟响后睁着眼却还想睡的画面，记住它描述半睡半醒的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong desire or impulse to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想要做某事的强烈愿望或冲动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija jew ħeġġa li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd ikun irid jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使人想采取某种行动的强烈欲望或冲动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija li persuna tħoss biex tagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An urge is a strong desire that makes you want to do something.

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, ħass lublieba li jidħaq, iżda rnexxielu jibqa' serju.
formal.en: During the ceremony, he felt an urge to laugh, but managed to remain serious.
formal.zh: 仪式进行时，他产生了一股想笑的冲动，但还是设法保持了严肃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħriġt mill-kamra? Mark: Ħassejt lublieba li nidħaq u ma ridtx indejjaq lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the room? Mark: I felt an urge to laugh and didn't want to bother anyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么离开房间？马克：我突然很想笑，又不想打扰别人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħriġt mill-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħriġt mill-kamra?
messages.zh: 你为什么离开房间？
messages.en: Why did you leave the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt lublieba li nidħaq u ma ridtx indejjaq lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt lublieba li nidħaq u ma ridtx indejjaq lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 我突然很想笑，又不想打扰别人。
messages.en: I felt an urge to laugh and didn't want to bother anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lublieba 想成心里突然冒出的“好想做！”气泡，用忍不住想笑的情景记住“冲动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pendant that opens to hold a photograph or another keepsake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种可以打开、用来放小照片或其他纪念物的盒式吊坠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġojjell żgħir li jintlibes imdendel ma' katina u jinfetaħ biex iżomm ritratt jew tifkira żgħira ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可开合的小盒式吊坠，通常挂在项链上，内放照片或纪念物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġojjell żgħir imdendel ma' ġiżirana li jista' jinfetaħ biex jitqiegħed fih ritratt jew oġġett żgħir bħala tifkira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A locket is a small piece of jewellery that opens to hold a photograph or keepsake.

collocations.en: a locket with a photograph inside
collocations.zh: 里面放着照片的盒式吊坠

formal.mt: Il-wirja tinkludi lukkett tal-fidda li jinfetaħ biex juri ritratt żgħir tal-familja.
formal.en: The exhibition includes a silver locket that opens to reveal a small family photograph.
formal.zh: 展览中有一枚银制盒式吊坠，打开后可以看到一张小小的全家福。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm ġewwa dak il-lukkett? Mark: Ritratt tan-nanna. Trid tarah?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's inside that locket? Mark: A photograph of my grandmother. Would you like to see it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个盒式吊坠里面有什么？马克：我奶奶的照片。你想看看吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm ġewwa dak il-lukkett?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm ġewwa dak il-lukkett?
messages.zh: 那个盒式吊坠里面有什么？
messages.en: What's inside that locket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ritratt tan-nanna. Trid tarah?
messages.mt_standard: Ritratt tan-nanna. Trid tarah?
messages.zh: 我奶奶的照片。你想看看吗？
messages.en: A photograph of my grandmother. Would you like to see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 lukkett 和英文 locket 的拼写相似处辅助记忆，再想象打开颈间小吊坠看见家人照片的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet orange, a citrus fruit with sweet juice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甜橙，一种果汁味甜的柑橘类水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta taċ-ċitru magħrufa bħala larinġa ħelwa, b'meraq ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜橙，具有甜味果汁的橙类水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' frotta taċ-ċitru li tissejjaħ ukoll larinġa ħelwa u li għandha meraq ħelu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sweet orange is a citrus fruit that is eaten fresh or squeezed for its sweet juice.

formal.mt: Għal din ix-xarba, uża meraq tal-lumi-laring u ilma kiesaħ.
formal.en: For this drink, use sweet orange juice and cold water.
formal.zh: 制作这款饮品时，使用甜橙汁和冷水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid meraq tal-lumi-laring? David: Iva, tazza waħda, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Tridu bis-silġ? David: Le, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like some sweet orange juice? David: Yes, one glass, please. Rita: Would you like it with ice? David: No, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你想喝点甜橙汁吗？David：想，请给我一杯。Rita：要加冰吗？David：不用，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid meraq tal-lumi-laring?
messages.mt_standard: Trid meraq tal-lumi-laring?
messages.zh: 你想喝点甜橙汁吗？
messages.en: Would you like some sweet orange juice?

messages.speaker: David (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tazza waħda, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tazza waħda, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，请给我一杯。
messages.en: Yes, one glass, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridu bis-silġ?
messages.mt_standard: Tridu bis-silġ?
messages.zh: 要加冰吗？
messages.en: Would you like it with ice?

messages.speaker: David (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi.
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢。
messages.en: No, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lumi-laring 整体写在甜橙图片旁，想象点一杯甜橙汁，并用 meraq tal-lumi-laring 连读记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lemon, a citrus fruit with sour juice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 柠檬，一种果汁味酸的柑橘类水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta taċ-ċitru li għandha meraq b'togħma qarsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柠檬，果汁味酸的柑橘类水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta taċ-ċitru b'meraq qares li jintuża fl-ikel u fix-xorb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lemon is a citrus fruit whose sour juice is used in food and drinks.

formal.mt: Żid il-meraq ta' lumija waħda mat-taħlita u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add the juice of one lemon to the mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 将一个柠檬的汁加入混合物中，充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek lumija? Pawlu: Iva, tridha għat-te? Sara: Iva, nixtieq ftit meraq fit-te tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a lemon? Pawlu: Yes, do you want it for tea? Sara: Yes, I'd like a little juice in my tea.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有柠檬吗？Pawlu：有，你要用来泡茶吗？Sara：对，我想在茶里加一点柠檬汁。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lumija?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lumija?
messages.zh: 你有柠檬吗？
messages.en: Do you have a lemon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tridha għat-te?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tridha għat-te?
messages.zh: 有，你要用来泡茶吗？
messages.en: Yes, do you want it for tea?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq ftit meraq fit-te tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq ftit meraq fit-te tiegħi.
messages.zh: 对，我想在茶里加一点柠檬汁。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like a little juice in my tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往茶里挤柠檬汁的画面，把 lumija 与酸味联系起来，再用 meraq tal-lumija“柠檬汁”复习整词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A citrus fruit referred to as a sweet lime or lime.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指甜莱姆或莱姆（青柠）这类柑橘水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta taċ-ċitru magħrufa bħala limetta ħelwa jew limetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜莱姆或莱姆（青柠），均为柑橘类水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem għal frotta taċ-ċitru li tissejjaħ limetta ħelwa jew limetta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A luminċell is a citrus fruit referred to as a sweet lime or lime.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob il-meraq ta' luminċell wieħed u żewġ imgħaref ilma.
formal.en: The recipe calls for the juice of one sweet lime or lime and two tablespoons of water.
formal.zh: 食谱要求使用一个甜莱姆或青柠的汁，以及两汤匙水。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'se żżid mal-ilma? Ben: Ftit meraq tal-luminċell. Anna: Nista' nipprova ftit? Ben: Żgur, hawn tazza għalik.
colloquial.en: Anna: What are you going to add to the water? Ben: A little sweet lime or lime juice. Anna: Can I try some? Ben: Of course, here's a glass for you.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你打算往水里加什么？Ben：一点甜莱姆汁或青柠汁。Anna：我可以尝一点吗？Ben：当然，这杯给你。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se żżid mal-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: X'se żżid mal-ilma?
messages.zh: 你打算往水里加什么？
messages.en: What are you going to add to the water?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit meraq tal-luminċell.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit meraq tal-luminċell.
messages.zh: 一点甜莱姆汁或青柠汁。
messages.en: A little sweet lime or lime juice.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nipprova ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nipprova ftit?
messages.zh: 我可以尝一点吗？
messages.en: Can I try some?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, hawn tazza għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, hawn tazza għalik.
messages.zh: 当然，这杯给你。
messages.en: Of course, here's a glass for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 luminċell 整词配上“甜莱姆／青柠”的词卡，再想象往水里挤汁，用 meraq tal-luminċell 巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very intense heat that makes conditions uncomfortable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人感到难受的强烈热气或酷热。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħana qawwija ħafna li ġġiegħlek tħossok skomdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的暑热；令人难受的酷热。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sħana qawwija ħafna li tkun diffiċli biex wieħed jiflaħ għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word to describe very intense and uncomfortable heat.

collocations.en: to be unable to stand the intense heat

formal.mt: Minħabba l-lupa ta' nofsinhar, il-grupp waqaf jistrieħ fid-dell.
formal.en: Because of the intense midday heat, the group stopped to rest in the shade.
formal.zh: 由于正午酷热，队伍停下来在阴凉处休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma niflaħx għal din il-lupa! Mark: Ejja noqogħdu fid-dell u nixorbu ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't stand this heat! Mark: Let's sit in the shade and drink some water.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这么热，我真受不了了！Mark：我们去阴凉处坐坐，喝点水吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma niflaħx għal din il-lupa!
messages.mt_standard: Ma niflaħx għal din il-lupa!
messages.zh: 这么热，我真受不了了！
messages.en: I can't stand this heat!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu fid-dell u nixorbu ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu fid-dell u nixorbu ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 我们去阴凉处坐坐，喝点水吧。
messages.en: Let's sit in the shade and drink some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lupa 放进“正午热得受不了，赶快找树荫”的画面中，连同 Ma niflaħx għal din il-lupa 一起记，突出强烈而难受的热。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Comfort or enjoyment provided by things that are expensive and not essential.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由昂贵而非必需的事物带来的舒适、享受或奢华。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kumdità jew pjaċir li jiġu minn affarijiet għaljin li mhumiex meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奢华；由昂贵、非必需的事物带来的舒适与享受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kumdità u tgawdija marbuta ma' affarijiet għaljin li wieħed jista' jgħaddi mingħajrhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Luxury is the comfort and enjoyment provided by expensive things that are not essential.

formal.mt: Il-lukanda toffri livell għoli ta' lussu u kumdità lill-klijenti tagħha.
formal.en: The hotel offers its guests a high level of luxury and comfort.
formal.zh: 这家酒店为宾客提供高度奢华而舒适的体验。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid noqogħdu f'lukanda ta' lussu? Mark: Nippreferi post sempliċi u komdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want us to stay in a luxury hotel? Mark: I'd prefer somewhere simple and comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想让我们住豪华酒店吗？Mark：我更想住简单舒适的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid noqogħdu f'lukanda ta' lussu?
messages.mt_standard: Trid noqogħdu f'lukanda ta' lussu?
messages.zh: 你想让我们住豪华酒店吗？
messages.en: Do you want us to stay in a luxury hotel?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nippreferi post sempliċi u komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Nippreferi post sempliċi u komdu.
messages.zh: 我更想住简单舒适的地方。
messages.en: I'd prefer somewhere simple and comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用豪华酒店的画面记 lussu：这个名词指“奢华”，ta' lussu 可放在名词后，像 lukanda ta' lussu 就是豪华酒店。

gloss_zh: 奢华的；豪华的；富丽堂皇的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very rich, elegant, and luxurious in appearance or furnishings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观或陈设十分华丽、精致而奢华的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra jew għamara rikka u eleganti u joffri ħafna lussu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奢华的；陈设华丽、富丽堂皇的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher għani u eleganti ħafna, b'dettalji jew għamara ta' lussu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is sumptuous looks rich and elegant and provides a strong impression of luxury.

formal.mt: Il-palazz għandu salott lussuż b'għamara eleganti u purtieri sbieħ.
formal.en: The palace has a sumptuous sitting room with elegant furniture and beautiful curtains.
formal.zh: 这座宫殿有一间奢华的客厅，配有雅致的家具和漂亮的窗帘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dan is-salott, kemm hu lussuż! Mark: Iva, l-għamara u l-purtieri sbieħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this sitting room; it's so sumptuous! Mark: Yes, the furniture and curtains are beautiful.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看这间客厅，多奢华啊！Mark：是啊，家具和窗帘都很漂亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan is-salott, kemm hu lussuż!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan is-salott, kemm hu lussuż!
messages.zh: 看这间客厅，多奢华啊！
messages.en: Look at this sitting room; it's so sumptuous!

messages.speaker: Mark (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-għamara u l-purtieri sbieħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-għamara u l-purtieri sbieħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，家具和窗帘都很漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, the furniture and curtains are beautiful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lussuż 和具体房间连着记：salott lussuż 是“奢华的客厅”。想象精美家具与华丽窗帘，用整幅画面记住“富丽堂皇的”。

gloss_zh: “English”（英语的／英国的；此处词义待核实）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective labelled 'English', whose intended meaning and application require clarification.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标注为“English”的形容词；该英语标签通常表示“英语的”或“英国的”，但此词的确切含义及用法尚待核实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv immarkat bħala 'English', iżda li t-tifsira preċiża u l-użu tiegħu għad iridu jiġu ċċarati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语的；英国的。此处标签与词形的对应关系尚待核实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta 'English' tista' tfisser relatat mal-lingwa Ingliża jew mal-Ingilterra, iżda t-tifsira maħsuba għal dan l-aġġettiv mhix ċara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An adjective described as English would normally concern England or its language, although the intended application here remains unclear.

formal.mt: Qabel tintuża l-kelma 'lussuża' f'eżerċizzju ta' traduzzjoni, għandha tiġi ċċarata t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: Before the word 'lussuża' is used in a translation exercise, its meaning should be clarified.
formal.zh: 在翻译练习中使用“lussuża”一词之前，应先明确它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'lussuża' hawn? Mark: Mhux ċar. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'lussuża' mean here? Mark: It isn't clear. Let's clarify the meaning before we use it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“lussuża”是什么意思？Mark：还不清楚。我们先弄清意思再用吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'lussuża' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'lussuża' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“lussuża”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'lussuża' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux ċar. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux ċar. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 还不清楚。我们先弄清意思再用吧。
messages.en: It isn't clear. Let's clarify the meaning before we use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词暂放进“待核实”抽认卡，先记字形与疑问，确认含义后再配具体情境。

gloss_zh: 路德宗的；与路德宗有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Lutheran tradition of Christianity, its beliefs, or its churches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于基督教路德宗的，或与路德宗的信仰、教会有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tradizzjoni Luterana tal-Kristjaneżmu, mat-twemmin tagħha jew mal-knejjes tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 路德宗的；与路德宗信仰、传统或教会有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għat-tradizzjoni Luterana tal-Kristjaneżmu jew li għandu rabta mat-twemmin u mal-knejjes tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Lutheran belongs to or is connected with the Lutheran Christian tradition.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi servizz luteran u jispjega kif ħadu sehem fih il-membri tal-kongregazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes a Lutheran church service and explains how members of the congregation participated.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一场路德宗礼拜，并说明会众如何参与其中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa? Mark: Ragħaj luteran. Se jitkellem dwar il-komunità tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to speak at the meeting? Mark: A Lutheran pastor. He'll talk about his community.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁会在聚会上发言？Mark：一位路德宗牧师。他会介绍自己的教会群体。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 谁会在聚会上发言？
messages.en: Who is going to speak at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ragħaj luteran. Se jitkellem dwar il-komunità tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ragħaj luteran. Se jitkellem dwar il-komunità tiegħu.
messages.zh: 一位路德宗牧师。他会介绍自己的教会群体。
messages.en: A Lutheran pastor. He'll talk about his community.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“luteran”放在牧师或礼拜旁边记，看到这个形容词就联想到“路德宗的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large piece of cloth used as a sheet on a bed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺在床上、供睡眠时使用的一大块布，即床单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp kbira li titqiegħed fuq is-sodda biex tintuża waqt l-irqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为床上用品使用的床单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tintuża bħala għata fuq is-saqqu jew bejn il-persuna u l-kutra waqt l-irqad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bedding sheet is a large piece of cloth used on a bed for sleeping.

formal.mt: Qabel jasal il-mistieden, għandu jitqiegħed luzar nadif fuq is-sodda.
formal.en: Before the guest arrives, a clean bedsheet should be placed on the bed.
formal.zh: 客人到达之前，应在床上铺好干净的床单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-luzar nadif? Mark: Fil-gwardarobba. Tridni ngħinek tibdel is-sodda?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the clean bedsheet? Mark: In the wardrobe. Would you like me to help you change the bedding?
colloquial.zh: Maja：干净的床单在哪里？Mark：在衣柜里。要我帮你换床上用品吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-luzar nadif?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-luzar nadif?
messages.zh: 干净的床单在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the clean bedsheet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-gwardarobba. Tridni ngħinek tibdel is-sodda?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-gwardarobba. Tridni ngħinek tibdel is-sodda?
messages.zh: 在衣柜里。要我帮你换床上用品吗？
messages.en: In the wardrobe. Would you like me to help you change the bedding?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从衣柜拿出一条干净床单并铺到床上，把“luzar”与整套铺床动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lucifer or Satan, the devil in Christian belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教信仰中的魔鬼，可指路西法或撒旦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jirreferi għal Luċifru jew Satana, ix-xitan fit-twemmin Nisrani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 路西法，基督教语境中用于指称魔鬼的名字。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem użat fil-kuntest Nisrani biex jirreferi għax-xitan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lucifer is a name used for the devil in Christian belief.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒旦，基督教信仰中代表邪恶的魔鬼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Satana, ix-xitan li jirrappreżenta l-ħażen fit-twemmin Nisrani.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Satan is the devil, understood in Christian belief as a being who represents evil.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-dramm, l-istudenta tiddiskuti kif il-figura ta' Luċifru tirrappreżenta l-ħażen.
formal.en: In her analysis of the play, the student discusses how the figure of Lucifer represents evil.
formal.zh: 这名学生在对该剧的分析中，讨论了路西法这一形象如何代表邪恶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jagħmel ir-rwol ta' Luċifru fid-dramm? Mark: Pawlu. Illum għandu l-ewwel prova.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to play Lucifer in the play? Mark: Pawlu. He has his first rehearsal today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁会在剧中扮演路西法？马克：保罗。他今天第一次排练。

messages.speaker: Maja (戏剧社成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħmel ir-rwol ta' Luċifru fid-dramm?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħmel ir-rwol ta' Luċifru fid-dramm?
messages.zh: 谁会在剧中扮演路西法？
messages.en: Who is going to play Lucifer in the play?

messages.speaker: Mark (戏剧社成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Illum għandu l-ewwel prova.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Illum għandu l-ewwel prova.
messages.zh: 保罗。他今天第一次排练。
messages.en: Pawlu. He has his first rehearsal today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 luċifru 与英文 Lucifer、中文“路西法”放在同一张人物卡上，再加“撒旦”义项帮助对应记忆。

gloss_zh: 活泼的；敏捷的；轻快有活力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of life and energy, or quick and light in movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充满生气和活力的，或动作迅速、轻快敏捷的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna ħajja u enerġija, jew li jiċċaqlaq b'ħeffa u b'aġilità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活泼的；充满生气和活力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri ħafna ħajja, enerġija u ħeġġa fl-imġiba jew fl-attività tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is lively shows plenty of energy and takes an active interest in what is happening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速的；动作敏捷的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiċċaqlaq jew jaġixxi malajr u b'ħeffa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is swift moves or acts very quickly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神饱满的；行动轻快而有活力的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher mimli enerġija u li jiċċaqlaq b'pass ħafif u ħaj.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sprightly is energetic and moves in a light, active way.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神饱满、行动轻快而有活力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd mimli enerġija li jiċċaqlaq b'ħeffa u b'pass ħaj.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person described as sprightly appears full of energy and moves with a light, lively step.

collocations.zh: 一位活泼有精神的年轻男子

formal.mt: Iż-żagħżugħ lvent mexa b'pass ħafif lejn il-palk u sellem lill-udjenza.
formal.en: The lively young man walked lightly towards the stage and greeted the audience.
formal.zh: 那位精神饱满的年轻男子迈着轻快的步伐走向舞台，向观众致意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu lvent ħuk! Għadu kemm wasal u diġà beda jiżfen. Mark: Iva, dejjem mimli enerġija!
colloquial.en: Maja: Your brother is so lively! He's only just arrived and he's already dancing. Mark: Yes, he's always full of energy!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你兄弟真有活力！刚到就已经跳起舞来了。Mark：是啊，他总是精力充沛！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu lvent ħuk! Għadu kemm wasal u diġà beda jiżfen.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu lvent ħuk! Għadu kemm wasal u diġà beda jiżfen.
messages.zh: 你兄弟真有活力！刚到就已经跳起舞来了。
messages.en: Your brother is so lively! He's only just arrived and he's already dancing.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem mimli enerġija!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem mimli enerġija!
messages.zh: 是啊，他总是精力充沛！
messages.en: Yes, he's always full of energy!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个精神十足的人轻快走来、马上跳舞，用“活泼、敏捷、轻快”三个画面串记“lvent”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that a previous state or activity no longer applies to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示复数主语过去处于某种状态或进行某项活动，但现在已经不再如此。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tgħid li huma kienu f'ċertu stat jew kienu jagħmlu xi ħaġa qabel, iżda issa s-sitwazzjoni nbidlet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们、她们或它们已经不再处于原来的状态，或不再进行原来的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li stat jew attività li kienu japplikaw għalihom fil-passat issa waqfu jew inbidlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when their previous situation or activity has come to an end.

collocations.zh: 他们已经不再是学生了

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru aġġornat, dawn il-membri m'għadomx attivi fl-għaqda.
formal.en: According to the updated register, these members are no longer active in the association.
formal.zh: 根据更新后的名册，这些会员已不再参与协会活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu u Rita għadhom jgħixu hawn? Lara: Le, m'għadomx jgħixu hawn. Issa jgħixu l-Mosta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do Pawlu and Rita still live here? Lara: No, they no longer live here. They now live in Mosta.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗和丽塔还住在这里吗？拉拉：不，他们已经不住这里了，现在住在莫斯塔。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu u Rita għadhom jgħixu hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu u Rita għadhom jgħixu hawn?
messages.zh: 保罗和丽塔还住在这里吗？
messages.en: Do Pawlu and Rita still live here?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, m'għadomx jgħixu hawn. Issa jgħixu l-Mosta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, m'għadomx jgħixu hawn. Issa jgħixu l-Mosta.
messages.zh: 不，他们已经不住这里了，现在住在莫斯塔。
messages.en: No, they no longer live here. They now live in Mosta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“他们以前如此，现在不再如此”的时间对比中记忆；用 m'għadomx hawn 联想“他们已经不在这里了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He did not trust someone or something, or did not feel confident in their reliability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他过去没有信任某人或某事，对其可靠性缺乏信心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-forma tindika li raġel ma kellux fiduċja f'xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不信任；怀疑某人或某事是否可靠。此形式表示“他没有信任”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li wieħed ma jkollux fiduċja f'persuna jew f'ħaġa għax jiddubita kemm hi ta' min joqgħod fuqha; hawnhekk il-forma tirreferi għal raġel fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone mistrusts a person or thing, they doubt whether that person or thing can be relied on.

collocations.en: he did not trust the stranger
collocations.zh: 他没有信任那个陌生人

collocations.en: he did not trust the promise

formal.mt: Il-klijent ma fadax lill-bejjiegħ u talab aktar informazzjoni qabel iffirma l-kuntratt.
formal.en: The client did not trust the seller and requested more information before signing the contract.
formal.zh: 客户没有信任卖方，因此在签署合同之前要求提供更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma xtarax il-karozza? Nina: Ma fadax lill-bejjiegħ, għax ma weġibx il-mistoqsijiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't Mark buy the car? Nina: He didn't trust the seller because the seller hadn't answered his questions.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么没买那辆车？Nina：他不信任卖家，因为卖家没有回答他的问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma xtarax il-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma xtarax il-karozza?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么没买那辆车？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark buy the car?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fadax lill-bejjiegħ, għax ma weġibx il-mistoqsijiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma fadax lill-bejjiegħ, għax ma weġibx il-mistoqsijiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他不信任卖家，因为卖家没有回答他的问题。
messages.en: He didn't trust the seller because the seller hadn't answered his questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ma 和词尾的 x 看成否定句的两端，联想“他没有信任”，同时记住这里说的是过去。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that he does not know a fact or is unaware of a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他不知道某件事”或“他对某种情况不知情”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li hu m'għandux tagħrif dwar fatt jew mhuwiex konxju ta' sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不知道某个事实或未察觉某种情况；此表达用于“他”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tgħid li hu ma jkunx jaf b'xi fatt jew ma jkunx konxju ta' xi ħaġa li qed tiġri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he is unaware of something, he does not know about it or has not noticed it.

collocations.en: he is unaware of the change
he does not know what happened

formal.mt: Il-klijent għadu ma jafx bil-bidla fid-data tal-laqgħa u għandu jiġi infurmat illum.
formal.en: The client is still unaware of the change to the meeting date and should be informed today.
formal.zh: 客户仍不知道会议日期已变更，应于今天通知他。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu jaf li l-laqgħa għada? Nina: Le, għadu ma jafx. Sara: Se ngħidlu jien. Nina: Tajjeb, għax għadu qed jaħseb li hi llum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Pawlu know the meeting is tomorrow? Nina: No, he doesn't know yet. Sara: I'll tell him. Nina: Good, because he still thinks it's today.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 知道会议在明天吗？Nina：不知道，他还不知情。Sara：我来告诉他。Nina：好，因为他还以为是今天。

messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jaf li l-laqgħa għada?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jaf li l-laqgħa għada?
messages.zh: Pawlu 知道会议在明天吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu know the meeting is tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu ma jafx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu ma jafx.
messages.zh: 不知道，他还不知情。
messages.en: No, he doesn't know yet.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ngħidlu jien.
messages.mt_standard: Se ngħidlu jien.
messages.zh: 我来告诉他。
