messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, għax għadu qed jaħseb li hi llum.
messages.zh: 好，因为他还以为是今天。
messages.en: Good, because he still thinks it's today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jaf 记作“他知道”，再注意前面的 ma 和末尾的 x 组成否定框架：ma jafx 就是“他不知道”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that someone or something is unable to do a particular action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人或某物无法完成某个动作，通常后接说明具体动作的动词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li persuna jew ħaġa mhijiex kapaċi tagħmel azzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法做某事的；没有能力或条件完成某个动作的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd ma jkunx kapaċi jagħmel xi ħaġa jew iċ-ċirkostanzi ma jħalluhx jagħmilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is unable to do something, they lack the ability or opportunity to do it.

formal.mt: Minħabba problema teknika, is-sistema ma tistax tirċievi applikazzjonijiet ġodda, u l-uffiċċju ma jistax jipproċessahom.
formal.en: Because of a technical problem, the system cannot receive new applications, and the office cannot process them.
formal.zh: 由于技术故障，系统无法接收新申请，办公室也无法处理这些申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ġej magħna? Lara: Le, ma jistax jiġi llum għax għandu x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark coming with us? Lara: No, he cannot come today because he has work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克会跟我们一起去吗？拉拉：不会，他今天要工作，来不了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ġej magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Mark ġej magħna?
messages.zh: 马克会跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is Mark coming with us?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma jistax jiġi llum għax għandu x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma jistax jiġi llum għax għandu x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 不会，他今天要工作，来不了。
messages.en: No, he cannot come today because he has work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ma jistax 和后面的动作一起记：ma jistax jiġi 就是“他来不了”，先记住“不能做”，再替换具体动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something has no value or is worth nothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物没有价值或一文不值，强调其价值为零。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa m'għandha ebda valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无价值的；不值任何钱或没有实际价值的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li m'għandha ebda valur finanzjarju jew prattiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is worthless, it has no financial value or offers nothing of practical value.

collocations.en: an object that is worth nothing

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tal-espert, dan l-oġġett ma jiswa xejn fis-suq attwali.
formal.en: According to the expert's report, this object is worth nothing in the current market.
formal.zh: 根据专家报告，这件物品在当前市场上一文不值。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taħseb li nista' nbigħ dan l-arloġġ miksur? Maja: Le, f'din il-kundizzjoni ma jiswa xejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you think I can sell this broken watch? Maja: No, in this condition it is worth nothing.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得这块坏手表能卖掉吗？玛雅：不能，坏成这样一文不值。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li nista' nbigħ dan l-arloġġ miksur?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li nista' nbigħ dan l-arloġġ miksur?
messages.zh: 你觉得这块坏手表能卖掉吗？
messages.en: Do you think I can sell this broken watch?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din il-kundizzjoni ma jiswa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din il-kundizzjoni ma jiswa xejn.
messages.zh: 不能，坏成这样一文不值。
messages.en: No, in this condition it is worth nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给物品贴上“价值为零”的标签，把整句 ma jiswa xejn 与“一文不值”配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something is of no use or cannot serve a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物没有用处，或不能满足某个具体用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa mhijiex utli jew mhijiex tajba għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有用处的；不能发挥所需作用或实现预定目的的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li ma tagħti ebda għajnuna jew ma taqdix l-iskop li għaliha tkun meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is useless, it cannot help you or do the job for which you need it.

collocations.en: is of no use for this job
is no use for opening the door

formal.mt: Dan it-tagħmir ma jiswiex għal kejl preċiż u għandu jiġi sostitwit.
formal.en: This equipment is of no use for precise measurement and should be replaced.
formal.zh: 这套设备无法用于精确测量，应当更换。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nuża dan il-kejbil biex niċċarġja t-telefon? Mark: Le, ma jiswiex għal dan it-telefon; għandek bżonn kejbil ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I use this cable to charge the phone? Mark: No, it is no use for this phone; you need another cable.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我能用这根线给手机充电吗？马克：不能，这根线不适用于这部手机，你需要另一根。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża dan il-kejbil biex niċċarġja t-telefon?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża dan il-kejbil biex niċċarġja t-telefon?
messages.zh: 我能用这根线给手机充电吗？
messages.en: Can I use this cable to charge the phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma jiswiex għal dan it-telefon; għandek bżonn kejbil ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma jiswiex għal dan it-telefon; għandek bżonn kejbil ieħor.
messages.zh: 不能，这根线不适用于这部手机，你需要另一根。
messages.en: No, it is no use for this phone; you need another cable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着不适配的充电线说 ma jiswiex，记住这里强调“派不上用场”，并用 għal 接出具体用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe fabric or a similar material that resists forming wrinkles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述布料等材料具有抗皱性，不容易产生褶皱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi drapp jew materjal simili li ma jiżviluppax tikmix faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抗皱的；在穿着、折叠或日常使用时不容易出现褶皱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Drapp jew materjal li jirreżisti l-formazzjoni tat-tikmix waqt l-ilbies, it-tiwi jew l-użu ta' kuljum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a fabric is wrinkle resistant, it does not easily develop creases during ordinary use.

collocations.en: material that does not wrinkle easily

formal.mt: Għall-uniformijiet intgħażel drapp li ma jitkemmixx faċilment u li huwa faċli biex jinħasel.
formal.en: A fabric that does not wrinkle easily and is easy to wash was selected for the uniforms.
formal.zh: 制服选用了不易起皱且便于清洗的布料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp tajjeb għal qalziet tal-ivvjaġġar? Lara: Iva, ma jitkemmixx faċilment, anki meta tqiegħdu fil-bagalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this fabric suitable for travel trousers? Lara: Yes, it does not wrinkle easily, even when you put it in a suitcase.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布料适合做旅行时穿的裤子吗？拉拉：适合，即使放进行李箱，也不容易起皱。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp tajjeb għal qalziet tal-ivvjaġġar?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp tajjeb għal qalziet tal-ivvjaġġar?
messages.zh: 这块布料适合做旅行时穿的裤子吗？
messages.en: Is this fabric suitable for travel trousers?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma jitkemmixx faċilment, anki meta tqiegħdu fil-bagalja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma jitkemmixx faċilment, anki meta tqiegħdu fil-bagalja.
messages.zh: 适合，即使放进行李箱，也不容易起皱。
messages.en: Yes, it does not wrinkle easily, even when you put it in a suitcase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从行李箱拿出仍然平整的布料，把 ma jitkemmixx 与“不易起皱”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that an action, remark, or manner of behaving is inappropriate or unbecoming in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种行为、言语或举止不符合特定场合应有的礼貌或规范，即不得体、不合适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tgħid li għemil, kliem jew imġiba mhumiex xierqa f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不得体的；指言行不符合某人的身份或某个场合应有的规范。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad dwar għemil jew imġiba li ma jkunux xierqa għall-persuna jew għall-okkażjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say that something is unbecoming, you mean that it is inappropriate for a person's position or for the occasion.

collocations.en: it is unbecoming to speak like that
it is inappropriate to laugh at other people

formal.mt: Waqt laqgħa uffiċjali, ma jixraqx tinterrompi lil min ikun qed jitkellem.
formal.en: During an official meeting, it is inappropriate to interrupt the person who is speaking.
formal.zh: 在正式会议上，打断正在发言的人是不合适的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' ngħid ċajta dwar l-iżball tiegħu? Rita: Le, ma jixraqx tidħaq bih quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I make a joke about his mistake? Rita: No, it is inappropriate to laugh at him in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能拿他的失误开个玩笑吗？丽塔：别这样，当着大家的面嘲笑他不合适。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ngħid ċajta dwar l-iżball tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ngħid ċajta dwar l-iżball tiegħu?
messages.zh: 我能拿他的失误开个玩笑吗？
messages.en: Can I make a joke about his mistake?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma jixraqx tidħaq bih quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma jixraqx tidħaq bih quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 别这样，当着大家的面嘲笑他不合适。
messages.en: No, it is inappropriate to laugh at him in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句联想到正式场合的礼貌提醒：想插嘴或嘲笑别人时，心里亮起“不得体”的提示牌，记住 ma jixraqx。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that a male person does not want to do something or is unwilling to do it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某位男性不想做某事或不愿意做某事，强调其意愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li raġel jew tifel ma jkunx irid jagħmel xi ħaġa jew ma jkunx lest jagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不愿意的；在此表达中指他没有做某事的意愿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad meta raġel jew tifel ma jkunx jixtieq jew ma jkunx lest jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is unwilling to do something, they do not want to do it or are not prepared to agree to it.

collocations.en: he does not want to come
he is unwilling to take part

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant qal li ma jridx jieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni, iżda huwa lest jaqra r-rapport.
formal.en: The participant said that he was unwilling to take part in the discussion, but that he was prepared to read the report.
formal.zh: 这名参与者表示，他不愿意参加讨论，但愿意阅读报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ben ġej magħna llejla? Nina: Le, ma jridx joħroġ. Għandu aptit jibqa' d-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Ben coming with us tonight? Nina: No, he doesn't want to go out. He feels like staying at home.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本今晚跟我们一起去吗？妮娜：不，他不想出门。他想待在家里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ben ġej magħna llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Ben ġej magħna llejla?
messages.zh: 本今晚跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is Ben coming with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma jridx joħroġ. Għandu aptit jibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma jridx joħroġ. Għandu aptit jibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: 不，他不想出门。他想待在家里。
messages.en: No, he doesn't want to go out. He feels like staying at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友邀请一名男生出门，他摇头表示“我不想”；转述他的意愿时，用 ma jridx 表达“他不愿意”。

gloss_zh: 日出（所给释义）；该马耳他语短语通常意为“不知道”

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sunrise is the appearance of the sun above the horizon in the morning. This supplied noun sense does not match the usual Maltese phrase ma nafx, which means I do not know.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给名词释义为“日出”，即早晨太阳出现在地平线之上的现象。但马耳他语短语 ma nafx 通常表示“我不知道”，不宜将它作为“日出”的表达来学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija bħala nom hija t-tlugħ tax-xemx filgħodu minn fuq ix-xefaq. Madankollu, il-frażi ma nafx normalment tesprimi li l-kelliem ma jkollux tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日出；早晨太阳从地平线升起的现象或时刻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tlugħ tax-xemx huwa l-mument jew il-fenomenu meta x-xemx tibda tidher fuq ix-xefaq filgħodu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sunrise is the time when the sun first appears above the horizon in the morning.

collocations.en: I do not know the answer
I do not know what I should do

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent kiteb: 'Ma nafx liema dokumenti għandi nibgħat mal-applikazzjoni.'
formal.en: In his letter, the student wrote: 'I do not know which documents I should send with the application.'
formal.zh: 学生在信中写道：“我不知道申请时应该一并提交哪些文件。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf fejn qiegħed il-ktieb tiegħi? Mark: Ma nafx. Fittixt fil-borża tiegħek? Maja: Għadni ma fittixtx hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know where my book is? Mark: I don't know. Have you looked in your bag? Maja: I haven't looked there yet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道我的书在哪儿吗？Mark：不知道。你找过自己的包了吗？Maja：我还没找那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf fejn qiegħed il-ktieb tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Taf fejn qiegħed il-ktieb tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你知道我的书在哪儿吗？
messages.en: Do you know where my book is?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Fittixt fil-borża tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Fittixt fil-borża tiegħek?
messages.zh: 不知道。你找过自己的包了吗？
messages.en: I don't know. Have you looked in your bag?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma fittixtx hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma fittixtx hemm.
messages.zh: 我还没找那里。
messages.en: I haven't looked there yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ma nafx 放进“别人提问、自己不知道答案”的对话中记忆；所给“日出”释义与通常用法不符，切勿把两者直接画等号。

gloss_zh: 他没有同意；他持不同意见

teaching_sense.en_definition: He did not agree with a person, opinion, or proposal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他当时没有同意某个人的意见、某种看法或某项提议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li hu ma kellux l-istess fehma bħal xi ħadd ieħor jew ma aċċettax opinjoni jew proposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同意；持有不同看法。此处形式表示“他没有同意”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikollu fehma differenti minn dik ta' persuna oħra jew ma jaċċettax dak li tkun qalet jew ipproponiet; hawnhekk il-forma tindika li hu ma qabilx fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone disagrees, they have a different opinion or do not accept what another person says; this form means that he did not agree.

collocations.en: he did not agree with the proposal

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant ma qabilx mal-proposta u talab aktar żmien biex jiġu eżaminati l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The representative did not agree with the proposal and requested more time to examine the costs.
formal.zh: 该代表没有同意这项提议，并要求更多时间来审查费用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark qabel li niltaqgħu fit-tmienja? Nina: Le, ma qabilx. Qal li d-disgħa jkun aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark agree that we should meet at eight? Nina: No, he didn't agree. He said nine would be better.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark同意我们八点见面了吗？Nina：没有，他没同意。他说九点更好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark qabel li niltaqgħu fit-tmienja?
messages.mt_standard: Mark qabel li niltaqgħu fit-tmienja?
messages.zh: Mark同意我们八点见面了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark agree that we should meet at eight?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma qabilx. Qal li d-disgħa jkun aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma qabilx. Qal li d-disgħa jkun aħjar.
messages.zh: 没有，他没同意。他说九点更好。
messages.en: No, he didn't agree. He said nine would be better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组表达配上“他摇头”的画面：ma在前、词尾x在后共同提示否定，整句记成“他没有同意”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A phrase used to warn that a statement or report has no sound basis and should not be accepted as true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于提醒某种说法或消息缺乏可靠依据，不应信以为真。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex twissi li stqarrija jew aħbar m'għandhiex bażi soda u m'għandhiex titqies bħala vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指说法、传闻或指控缺乏事实依据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi stqarrija, għajdut jew akkuża li ma tkunx ibbażata fuq fatti jew provi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a claim is unfounded, there are no facts or evidence that give you good reason to believe it.

collocations.en: a rumour with no sound basis
statements that should not be taken as established facts
collocations.zh: 不可当作确凿事实的说法

formal.mt: Dan l-għajdut ma toqgħodx fuqu: ma ġiet ippreżentata ebda prova li ssostnih.
formal.en: This rumour should not be accepted as true: no evidence supporting it has been presented.
formal.zh: 这一传闻不可采信：目前没有任何支持它的证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li l-ħanut se jagħlaq. Toni: Dak l-għajdut ma toqgħodx fuqu; ħadd ma kkonfermah.
colloquial.en: Maja: I heard the shop is going to close. Toni: Don't put any stock in that rumour; nobody has confirmed it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我听说那家店要关门了。托尼：那个传闻别信，还没有人证实。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li l-ħanut se jagħlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li l-ħanut se jagħlaq.
messages.zh: 我听说那家店要关门了。
messages.en: I heard the shop is going to close.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-għajdut ma toqgħodx fuqu; ħadd ma kkonfermah.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-għajdut ma toqgħodx fuqu; ħadd ma kkonfermah.
messages.zh: 那个传闻别信，还没有人证实。
messages.en: Don't put any stock in that rumour; nobody has confirmed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句和“传闻没有证据，先别相信”的情景一起记，重点记住不可采信的提醒语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A phrase used to indicate that someone or something cannot be depended on to do what is needed or expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示某人或某事不可靠，不能指望其按需要或预期行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li persuna jew ħaġa mhix ta' min joqgħod fuqha biex tagħmel dak li jkun meħtieġ jew mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指人、事物或服务不能稳定地履行承诺、正常运作或达到预期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna, ħaġa jew servizz li mhux dejjem iżomm kelmtu, jaħdem sew jew jagħmel dak li jkun mistenni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is unreliable cannot be depended on to behave or perform as expected.

collocations.en: a person you cannot depend on

formal.mt: Dan is-servizz ma torbotx fuqu għal kunsinni urġenti, għax spiss jasal tard.
formal.en: This service cannot be relied on for urgent deliveries because it is often late.
formal.zh: 紧急送货不能指望这项服务，因为它经常延误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistennew lil Pawlu biex iwassalna? Mark: Ma torbotx fuqu; aħjar naqbdu tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we wait for Pawlu to give us a lift? Mark: Don't count on him; we'd better take the bus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们等保罗开车送我们吗？马克：别指望他了，我们最好坐公交车。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistennew lil Pawlu biex iwassalna?
messages.mt_standard: Nistennew lil Pawlu biex iwassalna?
messages.zh: 我们等保罗开车送我们吗？
messages.en: Shall we wait for Pawlu to give us a lift?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma torbotx fuqu; aħjar naqbdu tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Ma torbotx fuqu; aħjar naqbdu tal-linja.
messages.zh: 别指望他了，我们最好坐公交车。
messages.en: Don't count on him; we'd better take the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象约好的司机总是迟到，用整句提醒自己“别指望他”，把词义与履约不可靠联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the city Madrid, used when referring to that city as a place or destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市“马德里”的专有名称，用于指称该城市或将其作为目的地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-belt Madrid, użat biex issir referenza għal din il-belt bħala post jew destinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马德里，城市专名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt ta' Madrid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Madrid is the name used to refer to the city, for example when describing where someone lives or travels.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Madrid, u l-parteċipanti għandhom jaslu ġurnata qabel.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Madrid, and participants should arrive a day beforehand.
formal.zh: 会议将在马德里举行，与会者应提前一天抵达。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn sejjer fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? David: Sejjer Madrid biex inżur ħabib.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going this weekend? David: I'm going to Madrid to visit a friend.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你这周末去哪里？David：我去马德里看一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejjer fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejjer fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 你这周末去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going this weekend?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer Madrid biex inżur ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer Madrid biex inżur ħabib.
messages.zh: 我去马德里看一位朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Madrid to visit a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Madrid 想成车票上的目的地“马德里”，练习搭配 lejn Madrid，表示“前往马德里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat piece of material used with others to cover a surface such as a floor or wall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他同类砖片一起铺设在地面、墙面等表面上的扁平材料块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta ta' materjal li titqiegħed ma' oħrajn biex tgħatti wiċċ bħal art jew ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于铺设地面、墙面等表面的砖片或瓷砖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta li tintuża flimkien ma' biċċiet oħra simili biex jinkesa wiċċ, bħall-art jew il-ħajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tile is a flat piece of material that you place beside others to cover a floor, wall or similar surface.

formal.mt: Il-maduma miksura ħdejn il-bieb għandha tinbidel biex l-art tkun sigura.
formal.en: The broken tile near the door should be replaced to make the floor safe.
formal.zh: 应更换门边破损的瓷砖，以确保地面安全。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-maduma miksura. Nistgħu nbiddluha? Ġużeppi: Iva, għandna waħda oħra tal-istess kulur.
colloquial.en: Marija: This tile is broken. Can we replace it? Ġużeppi: Yes, we have another one in the same colour.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这块瓷砖破了。我们能换掉它吗？Ġużeppi：能，我们还有一块同样颜色的。

messages.speaker: Marija (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-maduma miksura. Nistgħu nbiddluha?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-maduma miksura. Nistgħu nbiddluha?
messages.zh: 这块瓷砖破了。我们能换掉它吗？
messages.en: This tile is broken. Can we replace it?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna waħda oħra tal-istess kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna waħda oħra tal-istess kulur.
messages.zh: 能，我们还有一块同样颜色的。
messages.en: Yes, we have another one in the same colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里拿着一块待更换的瓷砖，边指边说 din il-maduma，把单数词形与具体一块砖联系起来。

gloss_zh: 音乐大师；杰出的指挥家

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinguished musician, especially a highly respected conductor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在音乐领域技艺卓越、备受尊敬的人，尤指杰出的指挥家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mużiċist ta' ħila kbira u rispett kbir, speċjalment direttur ta' orkestra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音乐大师，尤指技艺卓越并享有声望的指挥家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mużiċist eċċellenti u magħruf għall-ħila tiegħu, b'mod speċjali direttur ta' orkestra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A maestro is a musician, especially a conductor, who is greatly admired for exceptional skill.

formal.mt: Il-maestro mistieden mexxa l-orkestra b'ħila kbira u kiseb applaws twil mill-udjenza.
formal.en: The guest maestro led the orchestra with great skill and received prolonged applause from the audience.
formal.zh: 受邀的音乐大师娴熟地指挥了乐团，赢得观众长时间的掌声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn l-orkestra? Mark: Hu l-maestro li se jmexxi l-kunċert illejla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that beside the orchestra? Mark: He is the maestro who will conduct tonight's concert.
colloquial.zh: Maja：乐团旁边那个人是谁？Mark：他就是今晚音乐会的指挥大师。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ħdejn l-orkestra?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ħdejn l-orkestra?
messages.zh: 乐团旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that beside the orchestra?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-maestro li se jmexxi l-kunċert illejla.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-maestro li se jmexxi l-kunċert illejla.
messages.zh: 他就是今晚音乐会的指挥大师。
messages.en: He is the maestro who will conduct tonight's concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maestro 和“音乐大师登台、全场鼓掌”的画面连在一起，重点记住技艺与声望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who directs an orchestra, band, or other musical ensemble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在排练或演出中引导管弦乐团、乐队等音乐团体演奏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidderieġi orkestra, banda jew grupp mużikali waqt il-provi jew l-eżekuzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指导乐团排练，并在演出中指示节奏、速度及演奏方式的指挥。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi grupp ta' mużiċisti u tindikalhom ir-ritmu, il-ħeffa u l-mod kif għandhom idoqqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conductor directs a group of musicians during rehearsals and performances, guiding how they play together.

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-prova, il-maestru tal-orkestra spjega lill-mużiċisti kif kellhom idoqqu l-aħħar silta.
formal.en: Before the rehearsal began, the orchestra's conductor explained to the musicians how they should play the final passage.
formal.zh: 排练开始前，乐团指挥向乐手说明了最后一个乐段的演奏方式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta nibdew indoqqu? Pawlu: Stenna s-sinjal tal-maestru, imbagħad nibdew flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: When do we start playing? Pawlu: Wait for the conductor's signal, then we will start together.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们什么时候开始演奏？Pawlu：等指挥发出信号，然后我们一起开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (新乐手)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta nibdew indoqqu?
messages.mt_standard: Meta nibdew indoqqu?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候开始演奏？
messages.en: When do we start playing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (乐队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna s-sinjal tal-maestru, imbagħad nibdew flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna s-sinjal tal-maestru, imbagħad nibdew flimkien.
messages.zh: 等指挥发出信号，然后我们一起开始。
messages.en: Wait for the conductor's signal, then we will start together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 maestru 举起指挥棒，所有乐手同时进入；用“看指挥、齐演奏”的场景记住职业含义。

gloss_zh: 词义待确认；可能涉及雄伟、庄严之意

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry whose precise meaning is unclear; a possible association with grandeur requires confirmation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确切含义尚未明确的名词条目；可能与雄伟、庄严有关，但具体名词义仍须确认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija entrata nominali li t-tifsira preċiża tagħha għadha mhix ċara; rabta possibbli mal-kobor jew mas-solennità teħtieġ konferma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义未说明，暂无法确定具体的名词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhix speċifikata biżżejjed biex tingħata definizzjoni preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun has not been specified clearly enough to explain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能表示与雄伟、庄严有关的概念；具体名词义尚不明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan in-nom jista' jirreferi għal kunċett marbut mal-kobor jew mas-solennità, iżda t-tifsira eżatta tiegħu għadha mhix ċara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun may concern grandeur or solemnity, although its precise meaning remains uncertain.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'Maestuzi' teħtieġ definizzjoni aktar ċara qabel ma tintuża f'eżerċizzju ta' traduzzjoni.
formal.en: The word 'Maestuzi' needs a clearer definition before it is used in a translation exercise.
formal.zh: “Maestuzi”这个词需要有更明确的定义，才能用于翻译练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Maestuzi'? Pawlu: Għad irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Maestuzi' mean? Pawlu: We still need to clarify its meaning before using it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Maestuzi 是什么意思？Pawlu：我们还得先弄清它的意思，再使用它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impressive because of great beauty, grandeur, or dignity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因宏伟、美丽或庄严的气势而令人赞叹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li timpressjona bil-kobor, bis-sbuħija jew bid-dinjità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有雄伟、壮丽或庄严气势，令人敬畏或赞叹的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha dehra grandjuża jew dinjituża li tqanqal ammirazzjoni u rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something majestic impresses you with its great beauty, grandeur, or sense of dignity.

formal.mt: Il-faċċata maestuża tal-palazz tiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-viżitaturi malli jidħlu fil-pjazza.
formal.en: The palace's majestic façade captures visitors' attention as soon as they enter the square.
formal.zh: 游客一走进广场，就会被宫殿雄伟的正面吸引。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara dik il-knisja! Kemm hi maestuża! David: Veru, ejja nieqfu ftit biex inħarsu lejha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at that church! How majestic it is! David: It really is; let's stop for a moment to look at it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看那座教堂！真雄伟啊！David：确实，我们停一会儿看看吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik il-knisja! Kemm hi maestuża!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik il-knisja! Kemm hi maestuża!
messages.zh: 看那座教堂！真雄伟啊！
messages.en: Look at that church! How majestic it is!

messages.speaker: David (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, ejja nieqfu ftit biex inħarsu lejha.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, ejja nieqfu ftit biex inħarsu lejha.
messages.zh: 确实，我们停一会儿看看吧。
messages.en: It really is; let's stop for a moment to look at it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maestuża 配上抬头仰望雄伟宫殿的画面：建筑高大、气势庄严，让人忍不住赞叹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of satisfaction in your achievements or respect for your own worth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自身成就而产生的满足感，或对自身价值的尊重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' sodisfazzjon bil-kisbiet tiegħek jew ta' rispett għall-valur tiegħek innifsek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己的成就感到满意、自豪，或珍视自身价值的情感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' kburija li tħoss minħabba dak li ksibt jew minħabba l-valur li tagħti lilek innifsek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pride is the satisfaction you feel about your achievements or the respect you have for your own worth.

formal.mt: F'din l-entrata, 'Maestużi' tindika kburija, bħas-sodisfazzjon li persuna tħoss wara li tlesti biċċa xogħol diffiċli.
formal.en: In this entry, 'Maestużi' denotes pride, such as the satisfaction a person feels after completing a difficult task.
formal.zh: 在本词条中，“Maestużi”表示自豪，例如一个人完成困难任务后感受到的满足。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'Maestużi' f'din l-entrata? Għalliema Rita: Hawn tfisser kburija, bħal meta tkun kuntenta b'xi ħaġa li rnexxielek tagħmel.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'Maestużi' mean in this entry? Teacher Rita: Here it means pride, like when you feel pleased about something you have managed to do.
colloquial.zh: Nina：“Maestużi”在这个词条里是什么意思？Rita老师：这里表示自豪，就像你成功做成一件事后感到欣慰。

messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'Maestużi' f'din l-entrata?

messages.en: What does 'Maestużi' mean in this entry?

messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser kburija, bħal meta tkun kuntenta b'xi ħaġa li rnexxielek tagħmel.

messages.zh: 这里表示自豪，就像你成功做成一件事后感到欣慰。
messages.en: Here it means pride, like when you feel pleased about something you have managed to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本词条按名词“自豪”记忆：想象完成困难任务后抬头微笑的自己，把 Maestużi 与这份满足感联系起来。

gloss_zh: 玛哈（专名，英语对应 Maha）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Magha is a proper name corresponding to Maha in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Magha 是专名，英语对应形式为 Maha；中文可音译为“玛哈”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magha huwa isem proprju li bl-Ingliż jinkiteb Maha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玛哈，专名 Maha 的对应形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magha huwa isem proprju li l-forma tiegħu bl-Ingliż hija Maha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Magha is a proper name whose English equivalent is Maha.

formal.mt: Fl-istedina, l-isem Magha jidher fil-bidu tal-ittra.
formal.en: In the invitation, the name Maha appears at the beginning of the letter.
formal.zh: 在邀请函中，玛哈的名字出现在信的开头。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Bgħatt il-messaġġ lil Magha? David: Iva, u Magha diġà wieġbet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you send the message to Maha? David: Yes, and Maha has already replied.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你把消息发给玛哈了吗？戴维：发了，玛哈已经回复了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Bgħatt il-messaġġ lil Magha?

messages.en: Yes, and Maha has already replied.

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry classified as a noun whose supplied gloss gives only a grammatical category, without establishing a lexical meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数据包标为名词的词条；所给英文 noun 只说明语法类别，没有提供该词条的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li għandha biss indikazzjoni tal-kategorija grammatikali tagħha, mingħajr tifsira lessikali speċifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词；此处仅为词性提示，不能据此确定 magician 的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom huwa kategorija grammatikali ta' kliem li jista' jsemmi persuni, postijiet, oġġetti jew kunċetti; hawnhekk din it-tikketta ma tispjegax it-tifsira speċifika tal-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied word identifies a grammatical category but does not explain the lexical meaning of this entry.

formal.mt: Għall-entrata 'magician', il-lista tipprovdi t-tikketta Ingliża 'noun'; din tindika l-kategorija grammatikali, iżda ma tagħtix definizzjoni tal-kelma.
formal.en: For the entry 'magician', the list supplies the English label 'noun'; this identifies the grammatical category but does not define the word.
formal.zh: 对于“magician”词条，词表只提供英文标签 noun；它说明语法类别，却没有解释该词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Noun' jispjega xi tfisser 'magician' f'din il-lista? Toni: Jgħid biss li hija nom; it-tifsira speċifika mhix mogħtija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'noun' explain what 'magician' means in this list? Toni: It only says that it is a noun; the specific meaning is not provided.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份词表里的 noun 解释了“magician”的意思吗？Toni：它只说明这是名词，没有给出具体词义。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Noun' jispjega xi tfisser 'magician' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: 'Noun' jispjega xi tfisser 'magician' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份词表里的 noun 解释了“magician”的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'noun' explain what 'magician' means in this list?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid biss li hija nom; it-tifsira speċifika mhix mogħtija.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid biss li hija nom; it-tifsira speċifika mhix mogħtija.
messages.zh: 它只说明这是名词，没有给出具体词义。
messages.en: It only says that it is a noun; the specific meaning is not provided.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magician 词卡上的 noun 放进“词性”格，把“词义”格暂时留空；记住“名词是类别，释义需另给”，避免把标签当翻译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to take photographs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于拍摄照片的设备，即照相机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex jittieħdu ritratti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 照相机；用于拍摄照片的设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magna tar-ritratti hija apparat li bih persuna tista' tieħu ritratti ta' nies, postijiet jew affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A camera is a device that you use to take photographs of people, places, or things.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara edukattiva, l-istudenti użaw magna tar-ritratti biex jieħdu ritratti tal-bini storiku.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the students used a camera to take photographs of the historic building.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，学生们用照相机拍摄了那座历史建筑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ġibt il-magna tar-ritratti? Mark: Iva, qiegħda fil-basket. Trid tieħu ritratt? Maja: Iva, ejja nieħdu wieħed flimkien!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you bring the camera? Mark: Yes, it is in the bag. Do you want to take a photo? Maja: Yes, let's take one together!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你带照相机了吗？Mark：带了，在包里。你想拍张照片吗？Maja：想，我们一起拍一张吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibt il-magna tar-ritratti?
messages.mt_standard: Ġibt il-magna tar-ritratti?
messages.zh: 你带照相机了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the camera?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fil-basket. Trid tieħu ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fil-basket. Trid tieħu ritratt?
messages.zh: 带了，在包里。你想拍张照片吗？
messages.en: Yes, it is in the bag. Do you want to take a photo?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieħdu wieħed flimkien!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieħdu wieħed flimkien!
messages.zh: 想，我们一起拍一张吧！
messages.en: Yes, let's take one together!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出游前把照相机放进包里，一边做动作一边说 magna tar-ritratti；再用“带相机、用相机、拍照片”的连续画面记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A channel or waterway through which water flows or boats travel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供水流通过或船只通行的水道，也可指运河。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ li minnu jgħaddi l-ilma jew li jintuża mid-dgħajjes biex jgħaddu minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供水流通过或船只通行的水道、航道或运河。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Passaġġ naturali jew magħmul mill-bniedem li minnu jgħaddi l-ilma u li jista' jintuża għat-tbaħħir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A channel, waterway, or canal is a passage through which water flows or boats can travel.

formal.mt: Il-magħdija tal-ilma għandha tinżamm ħielsa mill-iskart sabiex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi.
formal.en: The water channel should be kept free of rubbish so that water can flow through it.
formal.zh: 水道应保持无垃圾堵塞，以便水流通过。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Id-dgħajsa tista' tgħaddi minn din il-magħdija? Sara: Iva, imma l-magħdija hi dejqa, allura rridu ngħaddu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can the boat go through this waterway? Sara: Yes, but the waterway is narrow, so we need to go slowly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条船能通过这条水道吗？萨拉：能，不过水道很窄，我们得慢慢通过。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dgħajsa tista' tgħaddi minn din il-magħdija?
messages.mt_standard: Id-dgħajsa tista' tgħaddi minn din il-magħdija?
messages.zh: 这条船能通过这条水道吗？
messages.en: Can the boat go through this waterway?

messages.speaker: Sara (船夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-magħdija hi dejqa, allura rridu ngħaddu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-magħdija hi dejqa, allura rridu ngħaddu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 能，不过水道很窄，我们得慢慢通过。
messages.en: Yes, but the waterway is narrow, so we need to go slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magħdija 写在一幅小船沿水道前进的图旁，连同 magħdija tal-ilma 一起记忆，抓住“水流或船只通过的通道”。

gloss_zh: 和他们一起；和她们一起；与它们一起

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning in the company of, or together with, them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与前文提到的他们、她们或它们在一起，或共同参与某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser flimkien mal-persuni jew mal-affarijiet li jkunu ssemmew qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与他们、她们或它们一起；和前文提到的复数对象相伴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li xi ħadd ikun jew jagħmel xi ħaġa flimkien mal-persuni jew mal-affarijiet imsemmija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are with them, you are together with the people or things already mentioned.

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni tasal għada, u d-direttur se jiltaqa' magħhom filgħodu.
formal.en: The delegation arrives tomorrow, and the director will meet with them in the morning.
formal.zh: 代表团明天抵达，主任将在上午与他们会面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħbieb sejrin il-baħar. Trid tiġi magħhom? Luqa: Iva, niġi magħhom. X'ħin se jitilqu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Our friends are going to the seaside. Do you want to come with them? Luqa: Yes, I'll come with them. What time are they leaving?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：朋友们要去海边。你想和他们一起去吗？卢卡：想，我和他们一起去。他们几点出发？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħbieb sejrin il-baħar. Trid tiġi magħhom?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħbieb sejrin il-baħar. Trid tiġi magħhom?
messages.zh: 朋友们要去海边。你想和他们一起去吗？
messages.en: Our friends are going to the seaside. Do you want to come with them?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi magħhom. X'ħin se jitilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi magħhom. X'ħin se jitilqu?
messages.zh: 想，我和他们一起去。他们几点出发？
messages.en: Yes, I'll come with them. What time are they leaving?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群朋友走在前面，你说 immur magħhom 并加入他们；用这个动作把整个表达记成“和他们一起”。

gloss_zh: 干燥的；瘦削的；憔悴消瘦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A description of something dry or of someone whose face or body looks very thin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述干燥的状态，或形容人的脸部、身体十分瘦削。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa niexfa jew persuna li għandha wiċċ jew ġisem irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥的；没有水分或湿气的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li mhijiex imxarrba jew li ftit li xejn fiha ilma jew umdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is dry is not wet and contains little or no moisture.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘦削的；尤指脸部或身体消瘦而显得憔悴的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tidher irqaq ħafna, speċjalment fil-wiċċ, u li jista' jkollha dehra għajjiena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is gaunt looks very thin, especially in the face, and may appear tired.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri raġel b'wiċċ magħlub u għajnejn għajjenin.
formal.en: The photograph shows a man with a gaunt face and tired eyes.
formal.zh: 照片中是一名脸部瘦削、双眼疲惫的男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu r-raġel magħlub fir-ritratt? Luqa: Hu ħija. Fir-ritratt jidher irqaq milli hu tassew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the gaunt man in the photograph? Luqa: He's my brother. He looks thinner in the photograph than he really is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里那个瘦削的男人是谁？卢卡：是我哥哥。他在照片里显得比实际更瘦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu r-raġel magħlub fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu r-raġel magħlub fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 照片里那个瘦削的男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the gaunt man in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħija. Fir-ritratt jidher irqaq milli hu tassew.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħija. Fir-ritratt jidher irqaq milli hu tassew.
messages.zh: 是我哥哥。他在照片里显得比实际更瘦。
messages.en: He's my brother. He looks thinner in the photograph than he really is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 magħlub 做两张独立图卡：一张画没有水分的物体，另一张画瘦削的脸；分别记住“干燥”和“瘦削”，不要把两义混成一种状态。

gloss_zh: 关闭的；关着的；不开放的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shut, or not open for people to enter or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于关闭状态的，或暂不对人开放、不能进入或使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex miftuħ, jew li ma jħallix lin-nies jidħlu jew jużawh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关闭的；关着的；指入口未打开，或场所不开放、不营业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi bieb jew oġġett li mhuwiex miftuħ, jew post li bħalissa ma jilqax nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is closed, it is shut or is not open for people to enter or use.

formal.mt: Il-mużew se jkun magħluq għall-pubbliku nhar it-Tnejn minħabba xogħol ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The museum will be closed to the public on Monday because of maintenance work.
formal.zh: 由于进行维护工作，博物馆星期一将不对公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħanut għadu miftuħ? Mark: Le, diġà magħluq. Nerġgħu niġu għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the shop still open? Mark: No, it's already closed. We'll come back tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：商店还开着吗？马克：没有，已经关门了。我们明天再来。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut għadu miftuħ?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut għadu miftuħ?
messages.zh: 商店还开着吗？
messages.en: Is the shop still open?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà magħluq. Nerġgħu niġu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà magħluq. Nerġgħu niġu għada.
messages.zh: 没有，已经关门了。我们明天再来。
messages.en: No, it's already closed. We'll come back tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商店门上挂着 magħluq 的牌子，自己把门推不开；再配合 bieb magħluq 朗读，把词义固定为“关着、未开放”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made by hand rather than through an automated manufacturing process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要依靠人的双手制作，而非通过自动化生产过程制造的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sar bix-xogħol tal-idejn aktar milli permezz ta' proċess awtomatizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手工制作的；主要由人用双手加工制成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett magħmul bl-idejn ikun inħadem prinċipalment minn persuna b'idejha aktar milli bi proċess awtomatizzat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is handmade is made mainly by a person using their hands rather than by an automated manufacturing process.

formal.mt: Kull oġġett f'din il-wirja huwa magħmul bl-idejn minn artiġjan lokali.
formal.en: Every object in this exhibition is handmade by a local craftsperson.
formal.zh: 本次展览中的每件物品均由当地工匠手工制作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġugarell magħmul bl-idejn? Toni: Iva, għamiltu jien. Lara: Kemm hu sabiħ! Nieħdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this toy handmade? Toni: Yes, I made it myself. Lara: It's lovely! I'll take it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个玩具是手工制作的吗？托尼：是的，是我亲手做的。拉拉：真漂亮！我要这个。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġugarell magħmul bl-idejn?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġugarell magħmul bl-idejn?
messages.zh: 这个玩具是手工制作的吗？
messages.en: Is this toy handmade?

messages.speaker: Toni (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamiltu jien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamiltu jien.
messages.zh: 是的，是我亲手做的。
messages.en: Yes, I made it myself.

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Nieħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Nieħdu.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！我要这个。
messages.en: It's lovely! I'll take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和工匠双手制作玩具的画面一起记：看到 magħmul bl-idejn，就想到“亲手做出来的”。用 ġugarell magħmul bl-idejn 整组练习，更容易记住用法。

gloss_zh: 结实的；浓稠的；团结的；连接在一起的

teaching_sense.en_definition: United as a group, with members supporting one another and acting together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容群体内部团结一致，成员相互支持并共同行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' flimkien bħala grupp, bil-membri jgħinu lil xulxin u jaħdmu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体格结实的；结构坚实而强健的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem jew struttura soda u b'saħħitha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is sturdy has a strong, solid body or structure.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浓稠的；形容液体或混合物质地稠密、不易流动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu konsistenza densa u ma jiċċirkolax faċilment, bħal brodu jew zalza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A liquid or mixture that is thick has a dense consistency and does not flow easily.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 团结一致的；成员彼此支持、为共同目标合作的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu l-membri tiegħu jaħdmu flimkien u jgħinu lil xulxin għal għan komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A group that is united has members who support one another and work together towards a shared goal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连接在一起的；与另一部分接合或固定在一起的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun imqabbad jew imwaħħal ma' parti jew oġġett ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is joined is connected or attached to another part or object.

collocations.zh: 与另一块连接在一起的

formal.mt: It-tim baqa' magħqud matul il-proġett kollu, u l-membri tiegħu għenu lil xulxin biex jegħlbu d-diffikultajiet.
formal.en: The team remained united throughout the project, and its members helped one another overcome the difficulties.
formal.zh: 团队在整个项目期间始终团结一致，成员相互帮助，共同克服困难。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Il-brodu sar magħqud wisq. Nina: Żid ftit ilma u ħawdu sew. Pawlu: Tajjeb, hekk nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: The broth has become too thick. Nina: Add a little water and stir it well. Pawlu: All right, I'll do that.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：汤变得太稠了。妮娜：加一点水，再充分搅拌。保罗：好，我就这么做。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-brodu sar magħqud wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-brodu sar magħqud wisq.
messages.zh: 汤变得太稠了。
messages.en: The broth has become too thick.

messages.speaker: Nina (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid ftit ilma u ħawdu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Żid ftit ilma u ħawdu sew.
messages.zh: 加一点水，再充分搅拌。
messages.en: Add a little water and stir it well.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk nagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk nagħmel.
messages.zh: 好，我就这么做。
messages.en: All right, I'll do that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅画面分别记义：结实的男子、浓稠的汤、团结的团队、接合的零件。看到 magħqud，先看它修饰的人或物，再选择“结实、浓稠、团结、连接”的对应含义；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 马格里布（非洲西北部地区）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maghreb is a geographical region in northwestern Africa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马格里布是位于非洲西北部的一个地理区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Magħrib huwa reġjun ġeografiku fil-majjistral tal-Afrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马格里布，位于非洲西北部的地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Magħrib huwa reġjun fil-parti tal-majjistral tal-Afrika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Maghreb is the region situated in the northwestern part of Africa.

collocations.zh: 一次前往马格里布的旅行

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport jippreżenta informazzjoni dwar ir-reġjun tal-Magħrib u l-bliet tiegħu.
formal.en: This report presents information about the Maghreb region and its cities.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍马格里布地区及其城市的相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-Magħrib? Mark: Fil-majjistral tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the Maghreb? Mark: In northwestern Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马格里布在哪里？马克：在非洲西北部。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-Magħrib?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-Magħrib?
messages.zh: 马格里布在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the Maghreb?

messages.zh: 在非洲西北部。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In northwestern Africa. Let's find it on the map.

gloss_zh: 杰出的；著名的；名人（名词用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A famous or eminent person is known by many people or respected for important achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人广为人知，或因重要成就而杰出、受人敬重；也可形容事物著名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħruf jiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa li ħafna nies jafu biha, jew persuna li għandha kisbiet importanti u tgawdi rispett fil-qasam tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杰出的；卓越的；因专业成就而享有声望、受人敬重的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna magħrufa f'dan is-sens tkun kisbet pożizzjoni importanti fil-qasam tagħha u tkun rispettata għall-ħila u l-kisbiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An eminent person is highly respected for their ability and achievements in a particular field.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 著名的；出名的；为许多人所知的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa magħrufa tkun waħda li ħafna nies jafu biha jew jagħrfuha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is famous is known by a large number of people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名人；为许多人所知的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bħala nom, magħruf jirreferi għal persuna li ħafna nies jafu biha, pereżempju minħabba x-xogħol jew il-kisbiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A famous person is someone whose name or work is widely recognized by other people.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat stieden xjenzat magħruf biex jippreżenta r-riżultati tar-riċerka tiegħu waqt il-konferenza.
formal.en: The committee invited an eminent scientist to present the results of his research at the conference.
formal.zh: 委员会邀请了一位杰出的科学家在会议上介绍他的研究成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf min hu dak il-kantant? Mark: Iva, hu magħruf ħafna. Spiss nisimgħu l-kanzunetti tiegħu fuq ir-radju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know who that singer is? Mark: Yes, he's very famous. We often hear his songs on the radio.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道那位歌手是谁吗？马克：知道，他很有名。我们经常在广播里听到他的歌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf min hu dak il-kantant?
messages.mt_standard: Taf min hu dak il-kantant?
messages.zh: 你知道那位歌手是谁吗？
messages.en: Do you know who that singer is?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.zh: 知道，他很有名。我们经常在广播里听到他的歌。
messages.en: Yes, he's very famous. We often hear his songs on the radio.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大家认识他”记住 magħruf 的“著名”；再用“同行敬重他”区分“杰出”。搭配歌手想到名气，搭配科学家想到专业声望，名词用法则指名人。

gloss_zh: 肢体残障者；身体受损而行动受限的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose physical impairment substantially limits movement or the use of a limb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因身体损伤或肢体功能障碍而明显行动受限的人；用来称呼他人时应注意表达尊重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha ħsara jew diżabilità fiżika li tillimita l-moviment tagħha jew l-użu ta' xi driegħ jew riġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因肢体损伤或功能障碍而行动受限的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tistax tiċċaqlaq jew tuża xi driegħ jew riġel b'mod sħiħ minħabba ħsara jew diżabilità fiżika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as a cripple has a physical impairment that substantially restricts movement or the use of a limb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体或肢体功能受损、因而行动受限的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ħsara jew diżabilità fiżika li tillimita l-moviment jew l-użu ta' xi parti tal-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person described as crippled has physical damage or impairment that limits movement or the use of a limb.

collocations.en: a man with a physical impairment
collocations.zh: 一名肢体功能受损的男子

collocations.en: impaired by an injury to his leg
collocations.zh: 腿部受损而行动受限的

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma 'magħtub' tintuża bħala nom biex tindika persuna b'diżabilità fiżika.
formal.en: In the text, the word 'magħtub' is used as a noun to refer to a person with a physical disability.
formal.zh: 在这篇文字中，magħtub 用作名词，指一名肢体残障者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'magħtub' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser persuna b'diżabilità fiżika. Maja: U tista' tkun aġġettiv ukoll? Pawlu: Iva, bħal f''raġel magħtub'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'magħtub' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means a person with a physical disability. Maja: Can it also be an adjective? Pawlu: Yes, as in 'a man with a physical impairment'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 magħtub 是什么意思？保罗：这里指一名肢体残障者。玛雅：它也能作形容词吗？保罗：能，比如 raġel magħtub，意思是肢体功能受损的男子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'magħtub' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'magħtub' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 magħtub 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'magħtub' mean here?

messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser persuna b'diżabilità fiżika.
messages.zh: 这里指一名肢体残障者。
messages.en: Here it means a person with a physical disability.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U tista' tkun aġġettiv ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: U tista' tkun aġġettiv ukoll?
messages.zh: 它也能作形容词吗？
messages.en: Can it also be an adjective?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħal f''raġel magħtub'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħal f''raġel magħtub'.
messages.zh: 能，比如 raġel magħtub，意思是肢体功能受损的男子。
messages.en: Yes, as in 'a man with a physical impairment'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同一个词放进两个语法框记忆：名词回答“什么人”，形容词回答“身体状况怎样”；两者都围绕肢体功能受限。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slender rod used in spinning to twist fibres into thread and hold the spun thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纺线时用于捻合纤维并承接纱线的细长杆状工具，即纺锤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda rqiqa bħal virga li tintuża fl-għażil biex iddawwar il-fibri f'ħajt u żżomm il-ħajt mibrum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺锤；纺线时用于捻合纤维及承接纱线的杆状工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Virga rqiqa li tintuża biex il-fibri jitgħawġu flimkien u jsiru ħajt waqt l-għażil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spindle is a slender rod used to twist fibres into thread during spinning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮辐；连接车轮中心与轮圈的杆件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda mill-vireg li jgħaqqdu ċ-ċentru ta' rota maċ-ċirku ta' barra tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spoke is one of the rods connecting the centre of a wheel to its outer rim.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'magħżel' tista' tindika għodda tal-għażil jew waħda mill-vireg li jgħaqqdu ċ-ċentru tar-rota maċ-ċirku ta' barra tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'magħżel' can refer to a spinning tool or to one of the rods connecting a wheel's centre to its outer rim.
formal.zh: magħżel 可以指纺线工具，也可以指连接车轮中心与外侧轮圈的一根轮辐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-magħżel jintuża biex isir il-ħajt? Toni: Iva, dan hu tal-għażil. Lara: U dak tar-rota? Toni: Dak ukoll jissejjaħ magħżel, imma jfisser il-virga bejn iċ-ċentru u ċ-ċirku ta' barra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this spindle used to make thread? Toni: Yes, this one is for spinning. Lara: And the one in the wheel? Toni: That is also called 'magħżel', but it means the rod between the centre and the outer rim.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个纺锤是用来纺线的吗？托尼：对，这个是纺线用的。拉拉：那车轮上的那个呢？托尼：那个也叫 magħżel，不过指的是中心与外侧轮圈之间的杆件。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图并排记忆：一根细杆捻纱线，一根细杆撑车轮；看到纺线语境想“纺锤”，看到车轮语境想“轮辐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A full pardon freely granted to someone for an offence or wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人的过错或罪行给予的完全赦免或无条件宽恕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' maħfra sħiħa li jingħata liberament lil persuna għal xi ħtija jew għemil ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自由给予的完全赦免；对过错或罪行的无条件宽恕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħfra sħiħa mogħtija liberament lil xi ħadd għall-ħtija tiegħu, mingħajr kundizzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A free pardon is complete forgiveness granted to someone for an offence without conditions.

collocations.en: to be granted a full pardon

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju miktub, il-persuna tingħata maħfra sħiħa għall-ħtija tagħha, mingħajr ma jintalbu kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: In the written example, the person is granted a full pardon for their wrongdoing without any conditions being imposed.
formal.zh: 在这个书面例句中，当事人的过错得到完全赦免，且没有附加任何条件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn il-maħfra tingħata b'xi kundizzjoni? Mark: Le, tingħata maħfra sħiħa mingħajr kundizzjonijiet. Sara: Mela l-persuna tinħafer għal kollox? Mark: Iva, hekk ifisser dan l-eżempju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the pardon here granted on any condition? Mark: No, a full pardon is granted without conditions. Sara: So the person is completely forgiven? Mark: Yes, that is what this example means.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的赦免附带什么条件吗？马克：没有，给予的是无条件的完全赦免。萨拉：也就是说，这个人得到了彻底宽恕？马克：对，这个例子就是这个意思。

messages.mt_standard: Hawn il-maħfra tingħata b'xi kundizzjoni?
messages.zh: 这里的赦免附带什么条件吗？
messages.en: Is the pardon here granted on any condition?

messages.zh: 没有，给予的是无条件的完全赦免。

messages.en: So the person is completely forgiven?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk ifisser dan l-eżempju.

messages.en: Yes, that is what this example means.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“过错被彻底放下”的场景记忆：重点是完全赦免、无条件宽恕；把整个意思与词条一起记住。

gloss_zh: 形容词，具体词义未明；所给释义为 b mahmug

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective whose precise meaning cannot be established from the supplied label 'b mahmug'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词性标为形容词，但所给释义 b mahmug 不足以确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mit-tikketta mogħtija 'b mahmug'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为 b mahmug，含义不明确，无法据此确定准确的中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta 'b mahmug' ma tagħtix biżżejjed tagħrif biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira preċiża ta' dan l-aġġettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label does not provide enough information to establish the precise meaning of this adjective.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'mahmug' hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, iżda t-tikketta 'b mahmug' ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira preċiża tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'mahmug' is marked as an adjective, but the label 'b mahmug' does not allow its precise meaning to be established.
formal.zh: mahmug 被标为形容词，但 b mahmug 这一释义标签不足以确定它的具体含义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'mahmug' f'din il-lista? David: Hawn imniżżla bħala aġġettiv, iżda t-tifsira mhix ċara. Nina: Nistgħu nagħtuha traduzzjoni preċiża? David: Għandna bżonn spjegazzjoni aktar ċara qabel nagħmlu dan.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'mahmug' mean in this list? David: It is listed here as an adjective, but the meaning is unclear. Nina: Can we give it a precise translation? David: We need a clearer explanation before doing that.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这份词表里的 mahmug 是什么意思？戴维：这里把它列为形容词，但意思不清楚。妮娜：我们能给出准确译文吗？戴维：要先有更清楚的解释，才能这样做。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impressive because of great beauty, size, dignity, or grandeur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因宏大的规模、壮丽的外观或庄严的气度而令人赞叹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimpressjona bil-kobor, bis-sbuħija, bid-dinjità jew bid-dehra grandjuża tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雄伟壮丽的；庄严而有气势的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra kbira, sabiħa u dinjituża li tqanqal ammirazzjoni u rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something majestic impresses you with its great beauty, size, or dignified appearance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宏伟、庄严或威仪这一特质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' kobor, sbuħija u dinjità li tqanqal ammirazzjoni u rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Majesty is the impressive grandeur or dignity that makes a person or thing inspire admiration.

formal.mt: Il-palazz majestuż jiddomina l-pjazza u jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-viżitaturi bil-faċċata imponenti tiegħu.
formal.en: The majestic palace dominates the square and draws visitors' attention with its imposing facade.
formal.zh: 这座雄伟的宫殿俯临广场，以气势恢宏的正面外观吸引游客的目光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-palazz! Kemm hu majestuż! Toni: Iva, speċjalment minn hawn taħt. Lara: Nieħdu ritratt? Toni: Żgur, minn hawn jidher kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that palace! How majestic it is! Toni: Yes, especially from down here. Lara: Shall we take a photo? Toni: Of course, you can see the whole building from here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看那座宫殿！多雄伟啊！Toni：是啊，尤其是从下面这里看。Lara：我们拍张照吧？Toni：当然，从这里能拍到整座建筑。

messages.zh: 当然，从这里能拍到整座建筑。
messages.en: Of course, you can see the whole building from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用仰望宏大宫殿的画面记忆：形容词义是“雄伟庄严的”，名词义则指这种令人敬叹的“宏伟与威仪”。

gloss_zh: 船肋骨；从龙骨向外延伸的船体肋材

teaching_sense.en_definition: The structural ribs of a boat that extend from the keel and help form and support the hull.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从船的龙骨向外延伸、构成并支撑船体形状的肋骨状结构件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet strutturali ta' dgħajsa li jitilgħu mill-prim u jagħtu forma u appoġġ lill-buq.

sense_translations.en_definition: Boat ribs that run from keel.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由龙骨伸出的船体肋骨，用来构成和支撑船体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kustilji strutturali tad-dgħajsa li jestendu mill-prim u jsostnu l-buq tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The ribs of a boat are structural members that extend from the keel and help support the shape of its hull.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tiswija tal-buq, il-ħaddiema spezzjonaw il-majjieri tad-dgħajsa biex jaraw jekk kellhomx ħsara.
formal.en: Before repairing the hull, the workers inspected the boat's ribs to check whether they were damaged.
formal.zh: 修理船体之前，工人检查了船体肋骨，查看是否有损坏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex neħħejtu t-twavel tad-dgħajsa? Pawlu: Biex niċċekkjaw il-majjieri u nsewwu dawk li għandhom il-ħsara.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you remove the boat's planks? Pawlu: To check the ribs and repair the damaged ones.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们为什么把船板拆下来了？保罗：为了检查船体肋骨，把损坏的修好。

messages.speaker: Mark (船主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex neħħejtu t-twavel tad-dgħajsa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex neħħejtu t-twavel tad-dgħajsa?
messages.zh: 你们为什么把船板拆下来了？
messages.en: Why did you remove the boat's planks?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (修船工)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niċċekkjaw il-majjieri u nsewwu dawk li għandhom il-ħsara.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niċċekkjaw il-majjieri u nsewwu dawk li għandhom il-ħsara.
messages.zh: 为了检查船体肋骨，把损坏的修好。
messages.en: To check the ribs and repair the damaged ones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船底中央的龙骨是一条主轴，两侧伸出一排排肋骨；把这些支撑船壳的骨架整体记作 majjieri。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trained professional who cares for women during pregnancy and childbirth and supports them after the birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受过专业训练，在孕期、分娩期间及产后为妇女提供照护和支持的助产人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Professjonista mħarrġa li tieħu ħsieb in-nisa waqt it-tqala u t-twelid u tagħtihom appoġġ wara t-twelid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 助产士；在孕期、分娩及产后为产妇提供专业照护的人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa fil-qwiebel li tassisti lill-mara waqt il-ħlas u tipprovdi kura u appoġġ matul it-tqala u wara t-twelid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A midwife is a trained professional who helps women during childbirth and provides care during pregnancy and after the birth.

formal.mt: Waqt l-appuntament, il-majjistra spjegat lill-omm x'appoġġ ikun disponibbli waqt it-twelid.
formal.en: During the appointment, the midwife explained to the mother what support would be available during childbirth.
formal.zh: 在预约会面中，助产士向这位母亲解释了分娩期间可以获得哪些支持。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma' min għandek appuntament għada? Anna: Mal-majjistra. Irrid nistaqsiha ftit mistoqsijiet dwar it-twelid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is your appointment with tomorrow? Anna: The midwife. I want to ask her a few questions about childbirth.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你明天约了谁？安娜：助产士。我想问她几个关于分娩的问题。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min għandek appuntament għada?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min għandek appuntament għada?
messages.zh: 你明天约了谁？
messages.en: Who is your appointment with tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Anna (准妈妈)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-majjistra. Irrid nistaqsiha ftit mistoqsijiet dwar it-twelid.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-majjistra. Irrid nistaqsiha ftit mistoqsijiet dwar it-twelid.
messages.zh: 助产士。我想问她几个关于分娩的问题。
messages.en: The midwife. I want to ask her a few questions about childbirth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 majjistra 配上一幅助产士陪伴准妈妈的画面，连着“预约、分娩、照护”三个场景记忆，明确她的专业角色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cosmetic products applied to the face, or the appearance created by using them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在脸上以修饰外貌的化妆品，也指使用这些产品形成的妆容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodotti kożmetiċi li jitqiegħdu fuq il-wiċċ biex isebbħu jew ibiddlu d-dehra tiegħu, jew id-dehra li tinħoloq bihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于修饰面部外貌的化妆品，或由此形成的妆容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodotti kożmetiċi użati fuq il-wiċċ biex jirranġaw jew isebbħu d-dehra tiegħu, kif ukoll ir-riżultat tal-użu tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Make-up consists of cosmetic products that you put on your face to enhance or change your appearance.

formal.mt: Qabel is-sessjoni tar-ritratti, il-mudella applikat make-up ħafif biex tikseb dehra naturali.
formal.en: Before the photo session, the model applied light make-up to achieve a natural look.
formal.zh: 拍摄前，模特化了淡妆，以呈现自然的面貌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit make-up għall-festa? Nina: Iva, imma nixtieq dehra naturali. Lara: Mela nagħmillek make-up ħafif.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some make-up for the party? Nina: Yes, but I'd like a natural look. Lara: Then I'll give you light make-up.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：参加聚会要化点妆吗？妮娜：要，但我想自然一点。拉拉：那我给你化个淡妆。

messages.speaker: Lara (化妆师)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit make-up għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit make-up għall-festa?
messages.zh: 参加聚会要化点妆吗？
messages.en: Would you like some make-up for the party?

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nixtieq dehra naturali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nixtieq dehra naturali.
messages.zh: 要，但我想自然一点。
messages.en: Yes, but I'd like a natural look.

messages.speaker: Lara (化妆师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nagħmillek make-up ħafif.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nagħmillek make-up ħafif.
messages.zh: 那我给你化个淡妆。
messages.en: Then I'll give you light make-up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 make-up 放进镜前化妆的画面：出门前上妆，回家后卸妆；连记 tapplika 和 tneħħi 两个搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Machines considered collectively, especially equipment used for industrial or practical work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对机器设备的统称，尤指用于工业生产或实际作业的一组机械。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-magni meqjusa flimkien, speċjalment dawk użati fl-industrija jew biex isir xogħol prattiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机械设备的总称，尤指工厂、工地等场所使用的机器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' magni jew magni meqjusa bħala grupp, użati biex iwettqu xogħol jew jipproduċu oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Machinery refers to machines considered as a group, especially those used to carry out industrial work.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija waqqfet il-produzzjoni għal ġurnata sabiex issir il-manutenzjoni tal-makkinarju.
formal.en: The company stopped production for one day so that machinery maintenance could be carried out.
formal.zh: 公司停产一天，以便进行机械设备维护。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm daqshekk storbju fil-fabbrika? Rita: Qed jinstallaw makkinarju ġdid. Mark: Allura nerġa' niġi meta jispiċċaw.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there so much noise in the factory? Rita: They're installing new machinery. Mark: Then I'll come back when they've finished.
colloquial.zh: 马克：工厂里怎么这么吵？丽塔：他们正在安装新机械设备。马克：那我等他们装完再来。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk storbju fil-fabbrika?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk storbju fil-fabbrika?
messages.zh: 工厂里怎么这么吵？
messages.en: Why is there so much noise in the factory?

messages.speaker: Rita (工厂员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jinstallaw makkinarju ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jinstallaw makkinarju ġdid.
messages.zh: 他们正在安装新机械设备。
messages.en: They're installing new machinery.

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura nerġa' niġi meta jispiċċaw.
messages.mt_standard: Allura nerġa' niġi meta jispiċċaw.
messages.zh: 那我等他们装完再来。
messages.en: Then I'll come back when they've finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走进工厂，眼前整套机器设备一起叫 makkinarju；把它作为机械设备的总称来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The intention or desire to hurt someone, upset them, or cause them harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想伤害、惹恼或损害他人的意图或心理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-intenzjoni jew ix-xewqa li wieħed iweġġa' lil xi ħadd, idejqu jew jagħmillu l-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望他人受到伤害、痛苦或损失的恶意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rieda ħażina lejn persuna oħra, li twassal lil wieħed biex ikun jixtieq iweġġagħha jew jagħmlilha l-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Malice is the desire to hurt another person or deliberately cause them trouble or distress.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur spjega li l-kumment kien sar mingħajr malizzja u talab skuża għall-weġgħa li kkawża.
formal.en: In his letter, the author explained that the comment had been made without malice and apologised for the hurt it caused.
formal.zh: 作者在信中解释说，那条评论并无恶意，并为其造成的伤害道歉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għedt hekk quddiem kulħadd? Pawlu: Għedtha mingħajr malizzja, imma nifhem li weġġajtek. Sara: Grazzi talli fhimt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you say that in front of everyone? Pawlu: I said it without malice, but I understand that I hurt you. Sara: Thanks for understanding.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么当着大家的面那样说？保罗：我说那话没有恶意，但我明白我伤害了你。萨拉：谢谢你能理解。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għedt hekk quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għedt hekk quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 你为什么当着大家的面那样说？
messages.en: Why did you say that in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtha mingħajr malizzja, imma nifhem li weġġajtek.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtha mingħajr malizzja, imma nifhem li weġġajtek.
messages.zh: 我说那话没有恶意，但我明白我伤害了你。
messages.en: I said it without malice, but I understand that I hurt you.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli fhimt.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli fhimt.
messages.zh: 谢谢你能理解。
messages.en: Thanks for understanding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用说话动机来记 malizzja：故意伤人是有恶意；解释自己没有恶意时，整句记住 mingħajr malizzja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning together with one's family. The packet labels it as a noun and writes 'mall-familja'; the standard expression used in the examples is 'mal-familja'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“与家人在一起”的表达。原包将其标为名词，写作“mall-familja”；下列例句采用标准形式“mal-familja”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li persuna tkun flimkien mal-familja tagħha. Il-pakkett jikklassifikaha bħala nom u jikteb 'mall-familja'; fl-eżempji tintuża l-forma standard 'mal-familja'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与家人在一起；表示有人与自己的家人共同相处或参与某项活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħadd ikun flimkien mal-membri tal-familja tiegħu, waqt attività jew f'ħin ta' mistrieħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you spend time with family, you are together with members of your family.

collocations.en: to spend time with the family

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti huma mistiedna jqattgħu l-Ħadd mal-familja u jieħdu sehem fl-attivitajiet organizzati.
formal.en: Participants are invited to spend Sunday with their families and take part in the organised activities.
formal.zh: 欢迎参加者在星期日与家人共度时光，并参与安排好的活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel il-Ħadd? Mark: Se nqatta' l-ġurnata mal-familja. Maja: Sabiħ! Se tieklu flimkien? Mark: Iva, għandna ikla d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you doing on Sunday? Mark: I'm spending the day with my family. Maja: Lovely! Are you eating together? Mark: Yes, we're having a meal at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你星期日准备做什么？马克：我要与家人共度一天。玛雅：真好！你们会一起吃饭吗？马克：会，我们在家聚餐。

messages.mt_standard: X'se tagħmel il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 你星期日准备做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing on Sunday?

messages.mt_spoken: Se nqatta' l-ġurnata mal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Se nqatta' l-ġurnata mal-familja.

messages.en: I'm spending the day with my family.

messages.mt_standard: Sabiħ! Se tieklu flimkien?
messages.zh: 真好！你们会一起吃饭吗？
messages.en: Lovely! Are you eating together?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna ikla d-dar.
messages.zh: 会，我们在家聚餐。
messages.en: Yes, we're having a meal at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象星期日全家围桌吃饭，把“与家人在一起”和 mal-familja 连起来记；原包词头仍保留 mall-familja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce an event immediately followed by another event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引导时间从句，表示某事一发生，另一件事就立即发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintroduċi ġrajja li malli sseħħ, isseħħ minnufih ġrajja oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一……就……；表示另一动作在所述事件发生后立即进行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad żewġ ġrajjiet biex turi li t-tieni waħda sseħħ minnufih meta sseħħ l-ewwel waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this conjunction to show that one event happens immediately when another event occurs.

collocations.en: as soon as you hear the news
as soon as it is ready

formal.mt: Mallewel jasal ir-rapport, l-uffiċċju jibgħat kopja lill-membri kollha tal-kumitat.
formal.en: As soon as the report arrives, the office will send a copy to every member of the committee.
formal.zh: 报告一到，办公室就会向委员会的每位成员发送一份副本。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Mallewel tasal id-dar, ibgħatli messaġġ. Luqa: Iva, nibgħatlek mallewel nasal. Marija: Grazzi, hekk inkun naf li wasalt.
colloquial.en: Marija: As soon as you get home, send me a message. Luqa: Yes, I'll message you as soon as I arrive. Marija: Thanks, that way I'll know you've arrived.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你一到家就给我发个消息。卢卡：好，我一到就发给你。玛丽亚：谢谢，这样我就知道你到了。

messages.mt_standard: Mallewel tasal id-dar, ibgħatli messaġġ.

messages.en: As soon as you get home, send me a message.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A storm involving severe weather, such as thunder and lightning or very strong winds and heavy rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天气猛烈恶化时出现的风暴，可侧重有雷电的雷暴，也可泛指伴随强风和大雨的暴风雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maltemp qawwi li jista' jkun fih ragħad u sajjetti, jew riħ qawwi u xita qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雷暴；以雷声和闪电为特征、通常伴有降雨的风暴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maltemp li jkun fih ragħad u sajjetti u li ħafna drabi jkun akkumpanjat minn xita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning, usually accompanied by rain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛烈的暴风雨；以强风为突出特征、常伴随大雨的强烈风暴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maltemp vjolenti b'riħ qawwi ħafna, spiss flimkien ma' xita qawwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tempest is a violent storm with very strong winds and often heavy rain.

formal.mt: Minħabba maltempata qalila b'riħ qawwi u xita qawwija, l-attività fil-beraħ ġiet posposta.
formal.en: Because of a fierce storm with strong winds and heavy rain, the outdoor event was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于出现伴随强风和大雨的猛烈风暴，户外活动延期举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak ir-ragħad? Mark: Iva, jidher li ġejja maltempata. Maja: Mela nidħlu ġewwa? Mark: Iva, qabel tibda x-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that thunder? Mark: Yes, it looks like a storm is coming. Maja: Shall we go inside, then? Mark: Yes, before the rain starts.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见刚才的雷声了吗？马克：听见了，看来暴风雨要来了。玛雅：那我们进去吧？马克：好，趁还没开始下雨。

messages.en: Did you hear that thunder?

messages.en: Yes, before the rain starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maltempata 配上一幅雷电交加、树木被狂风吹动的画面：雷电突出时记“雷暴”，强风大雨突出时记“暴风雨”。

gloss_zh: 马耳他语字母（具体义项未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Letters used to write Maltese; the specific noun sense remains unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词条名称指向书写马耳他语所用的字母，但具体名词义项尚未明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-entrata jirreferi għall-ittri użati biex jinkiteb il-Malti, iżda s-sens nominali speċifiku mhuwiex ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体名词含义未明确，无法确定该义项的准确释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira nominali speċifika mhijiex ċara u ma tistax tiġi definita b'mod preċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The intended noun meaning cannot be determined from the information provided.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jiktbu l-ittri Maltin b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should write the Maltese letters clearly.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应把马耳他语字母写清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed titgħallem l-ittri Maltin? Mark: Iva, qed niktebhom waħda waħda fil-pitazz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you learning the Maltese letters? Mark: Yes, I am writing them one by one in my notebook.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在学马耳他语字母吗？马克：是的，我正在笔记本上一个一个地写。

gloss_zh: 义项待核：所给 shun 与 zghar 未能确立词头含义

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as an adjective in the packet, with the selector 'shun'; the supplied information does not establish its intended adjective meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原包将此词条标为形容词，并给出“shun”这一义项标签；现有信息不足以确定该词头在此处的形容词含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata li fil-pakkett hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv bis-selettur 'shun'; l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tistabbilixxix it-tifsira maħsuba tagħha bħala aġġettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 该形容词义待核。“shun”作为英语词通常表示“刻意避开”，但所给信息未说明它如何对应此词头的形容词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira aġġettivali mhijiex stabbilita. Il-kelma Ingliża 'shun' normalment tfisser li tevita lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa apposta, iżda l-pakkett ma jispjegax ir-rabta tagħha ma' din l-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To shun someone or something is to deliberately avoid them, but this does not establish the adjective sense assigned here.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 该名词义待核。原包仅提供“zghar”这一标签，没有说明其所指，无法据此确定此词头的名词含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira nominali mhijiex stabbilita, għax il-pakkett jagħti biss it-tikketta 'zghar' mingħajr spjegazzjoni ta' dak li tirreferi għalih f'din l-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The label 'zghar' is supplied without enough context to establish what this entry means as a noun.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'maltese' għandha żewġ seletturi, 'shun' u 'zghar', iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tistabbilixxix iż-żewġ tifsiriet.
formal.en: The entry 'maltese' has two selectors, 'shun' and 'zghar', but the supplied information does not establish the two meanings.
formal.zh: “maltese”词条有“shun”和“zghar”两个义项标签，但所给信息不足以确定这两个义项的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser 'maltese' hawn? Mark: Mhux ċar; hemm it-tikketti 'shun' u 'zghar'. Maja: Niktibha fin-noti? Mark: Iva, imma immarka t-tifsiriet bħala mhux ikkonfermati.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'maltese' mean here? Mark: It isn't clear; the labels are 'shun' and 'zghar'. Maja: Shall I write it in my notes? Mark: Yes, but mark the meanings as unconfirmed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“maltese”在这里是什么意思？马克：还不清楚，给出的标签是“shun”和“zghar”。玛雅：我要把它记进笔记吗？马克：可以，但要标明这些含义尚未确认。

gloss_zh: 马耳他语—英语词典；所给动词义 tippika 待核

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a verb with the selector 'tippika'. Its English wording names a Maltese–English dictionary, but the packet does not establish a corresponding verbal meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原包将此词条标为动词，义项标签为“tippika”。词头的英语字面意思是“马耳他语—英语词典”，但包中没有确立与之对应的动词含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala verb bis-selettur 'tippika'. Il-kliem Ingliż fit-titlu jindika dizzjunarju Malti-Ingliż, iżda l-pakkett ma jistabbilixxix tifsira verbali korrispondenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词义待核。原包仅提供“tippika”这一形式，未说明它表示的动作，也未说明它与词头“马耳他语—英语词典”的关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira verbali mhijiex stabbilita, għax il-pakkett jagħti biss il-forma 'tippika' mingħajr ma jispjega l-azzjoni maħsuba jew ir-rabta tagħha mat-titlu tal-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The form 'tippika' is listed as a verb selector, but the packet does not explain which action it denotes.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Maltese English dictionary' hija mmarkata bħala verb bis-selettur 'tippika', iżda t-tifsira verbali teħtieġ kjarifika.
formal.en: The entry 'Maltese English dictionary' is labelled as a verb with the selector 'tippika', but its verbal meaning requires clarification.
formal.zh: “Maltese English dictionary”词条被标为动词，义项标签为“tippika”，但其动词含义仍需澄清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex 'Maltese English dictionary' huwa mmarkat bħala verb? Mark: Il-pakkett jagħti 'tippika', imma ma jispjegax it-tifsira. Maja: Allura nħalliha vojta? Mark: Ikteb li t-tifsira għadha mhix ikkonfermata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is 'Maltese English dictionary' labelled as a verb? Mark: The packet gives 'tippika', but it doesn't explain the meaning. Maja: So shall I leave it blank? Mark: Write that the meaning is still unconfirmed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么“Maltese English dictionary”被标成动词？马克：包里给的是“tippika”，但没有解释含义。玛雅：那我要留空吗？马克：写上“含义尚未确认”。
