cognitive_memory_aid: 想象词典封面旁贴着“动词义待核”的便签：封面帮助记住词头字面意思，便签提醒不要擅自给 tippika 编造动作含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lesson in which people learn the Maltese language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教授或学习马耳他语的一节课或课堂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lezzjoni li fiha l-istudenti jitgħallmu l-lingwa Maltija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以学习马耳他语为内容的课程或课堂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lezzjoni jew klassi ddedikata għat-tagħlim tal-lingwa Maltija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Maltese language class is a lesson where students learn to understand and use Maltese.

collocations.en: prepare for the Maltese language class

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tal-Malti tibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu, u l-istudenti għandhom iġibu l-kotba tagħhom.
formal.en: The Maltese language class begins at nine in the morning, and students should bring their books.
formal.zh: 马耳他语课上午九点开始，学生应带上自己的课本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek lezzjoni tal-Malti llum? Mark: Iva, fl-erbgħa. Trid tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a Maltese language class today? Mark: Yes, at four. Would you like to come with me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天有马耳他语课吗？马克：有，四点。你想跟我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lezzjoni tal-Malti llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lezzjoni tal-Malti llum?

messages.en: Do you have a Maltese language class today?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, fl-erbgħa. Trid tiġi miegħi?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“马耳他语课”连成课堂画面：带课本、听老师、练对话；用 lezzjoni tal-Malti 整块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dry, referring to an animal's skin or hide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物的皮失去水分、逐渐变干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirreferi għall-ġilda ta' annimal meta titlef l-umdità u ssir niexfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种动物的皮变干。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġilda ta' xi annimal titlef l-umdità tagħha u ssir niexfa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When an animal's hide dries, it loses moisture and becomes dry.

formal.mt: Il-ġilda tal-annimal titħalla f'post arjuż sakemm tinxef.
formal.en: The animal's hide is left in an airy place until it dries.
formal.zh: 将动物皮放在通风处，直到它变干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ġilda tal-annimal għadha mxarrba? Mark: Iva, ħalliha hawn sakemm tinxef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the animal's hide still wet? Mark: Yes, leave it here until it dries.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张动物皮还湿着吗？马克：是的，放在这里等它变干。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġilda tal-annimal għadha mxarrba?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġilda tal-annimal għadha mxarrba?
messages.zh: 这张动物皮还湿着吗？
messages.en: Is the animal's hide still wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalliha hawn sakemm tinxef.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalliha hawn sakemm tinxef.
messages.zh: 是的，放在这里等它变干。
messages.en: Yes, leave it here until it dries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按给定动词义记住“湿皮逐渐变干”的画面，把 il-ġilda tinxef 连起来读，抓住状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal belonging to the group whose females produce milk to feed their young.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于哺乳动物类的动物，其雌性会产生乳汁来哺育幼仔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li jagħmel parti minn grupp li fih in-nisa jipproduċu l-ħalib biex jitimgħu liż-żgħar tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哺乳动物，所属类群的雌性以乳汁哺育幼仔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal minn grupp li fih in-nisa jitimgħu liż-żgħar tagħhom bil-ħalib li jipproduċu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mammal is an animal belonging to a group whose females produce milk to feed their young.

formal.mt: Id-denfil huwa mammiferu tal-baħar li jitla' fil-wiċċ biex jieħu n-nifs.
formal.en: The dolphin is a marine mammal that comes to the surface to breathe.
formal.zh: 海豚是一种会浮到水面呼吸的海洋哺乳动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus huwa mammiferu? Mark: Iva, il-frieħ tiegħu jixorbu l-ħalib ta' ommhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is a cat a mammal? Mark: Yes, its young drink their mother's milk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫是哺乳动物吗？马克：是的，小猫喝妈妈的奶。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus huwa mammiferu?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus huwa mammiferu?
messages.zh: 猫是哺乳动物吗？
messages.en: Is a cat a mammal?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-frieħ tiegħu jixorbu l-ħalib ta' ommhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-frieħ tiegħu jixorbu l-ħalib ta' ommhom.
messages.zh: 是的，小猫喝妈妈的奶。
messages.en: Yes, its young drink their mother's milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小猫喝母乳”的画面记 mammiferu，再联想英语 mammal，把两词共同对应到“哺乳动物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mandarin is a Chinese official; Mandarin also names the Chinese language variety commonly called Mandarin Chinese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指中国官员；作为语言名称时，指官话或普通话，具体译法取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mandarin jista' jirreferi għal uffiċjal Ċiniż jew għal-lingwa Ċiniża magħrufa bħala l-mandarin, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中国官员；亦指官话或普通话这一汉语语言名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma tirreferi għal uffiċjal Ċiniż jew, f'kuntest lingwistiku, għal-lingwa Ċiniża magħrufa bħala l-mandarin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mandarin is a Chinese official, while Mandarin also refers to a variety of Chinese used as a language.

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-mandarin jinkludi eżerċizzji fil-qari, fil-kitba u fil-konverżazzjoni.
formal.en: The Mandarin course includes exercises in reading, writing, and conversation.
formal.zh: 普通话课程包括阅读、写作和会话练习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Pawlu: Qed nitgħallem il-mandarin. Lara: Tista' tgħid xi ħaġa bil-mandarin?
colloquial.en: Lara: Which language are you learning? Pawlu: I'm learning Mandarin. Lara: Can you say something in Mandarin?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你在学哪种语言？Pawlu：我在学普通话。Lara：你能用普通话说点什么吗？

messages.mt_spoken: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem?
messages.mt_standard: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem?
messages.zh: 你在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem il-mandarin.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem il-mandarin.
messages.zh: 我在学普通话。
messages.en: I'm learning Mandarin.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħid xi ħaġa bil-mandarin?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħid xi ħaġa bil-mandarin?
messages.zh: 你能用普通话说点什么吗？
messages.en: Can you say something in Mandarin?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mandarin 配两张记忆卡：一张画中国官员，一张画普通话课堂；遇到“学习、说话、课程”等搭配时，优先联想到语言义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mandolina is either a small citrus fruit called a tangerine or a stringed musical instrument called a mandolin, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指橘子这种小型柑橘类水果，也可指曼陀林这种弦乐器；需要根据饮食或音乐语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mandolina tista' tkun frotta taċ-ċitru żgħira li titqaxxar biex tittiekel, jew strument mużikali bil-kordi, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橘子；一种通常容易剥皮、果肉分瓣的小型柑橘类水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mandolina hija frotta taċ-ċitru żgħira, ġeneralment b'qoxra li titneħħa faċilment u b'polpa maqsuma fi flieli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tangerine is a small citrus fruit with a skin that is usually easy to peel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 曼陀林；一种通过拨弦发声的弦乐器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mandolina hija strument mużikali bil-kordi li jindaqq billi jitnittfu l-kordi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mandolin is a musical instrument whose strings are plucked to produce sound.

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert, il-mużiċista daqq il-mandolina flimkien ma' grupp żgħir ta' kantanti.
formal.en: During the concert, the musician played the mandolin alongside a small group of singers.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，乐手与一小组歌手合作，弹奏了曼陀林。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid mandolina? Toni: Iva, grazzi. Tista' tqaxxarhieli? Nina: Żgur, nagħtik il-flieli fi platt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like a tangerine? Toni: Yes, thanks. Can you peel it for me? Nina: Sure, I'll give you the segments on a plate.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你想吃个橘子吗？Toni：想，谢谢。你能帮我剥一下吗？Nina：当然，我把橘子瓣放在盘子里给你。

messages.zh: 当然，我把橘子瓣放在盘子里给你。
messages.en: Sure, I'll give you the segments on a plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上放着一个橘子，旁边有人弹曼陀林：同一个 mandolina 对应两幅图；“剥皮”提示水果义，“弹奏”提示乐器义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serrated thumb-cuffs are restraints for the thumbs that have toothed or notched edges or surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来束缚拇指、边缘或表面带有锯齿的铐具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawn huma manetti maħsuba biex iżommu s-swaba' l-kbar marbuta, u li għandhom truf jew uċuħ bis-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锯齿状拇指铐；带有齿状边缘或表面、用于束缚拇指的铐具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Manetti bis-snien għas-saba' l-kbir huma tagħmir li jżomm is-swaba' l-kbar marbuta u li għandu truf jew uċuħ b'forma ta' snien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Serrated thumb-cuffs are devices used to restrain the thumbs and have toothed edges or surfaces.

collocations.en: a description of the serrated thumb-cuffs
collocations.zh: 对带锯齿拇指铐的描述

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-wirja jinkludi ritratt u deskrizzjoni ta' par manetti bis-snien għas-saba' l-kbir.
formal.en: The exhibition catalogue includes a photograph and a description of a pair of serrated thumb-cuffs.
formal.zh: 展览目录收录了一副带锯齿拇指铐的照片和说明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhuma dawk fil-vetrina? David: Dawk huma manetti bis-snien għas-saba' l-kbir. Sara: Fejn nista' naqra aktar dwarhom? David: Hemm deskrizzjoni fil-katalgu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are those in the display case? David: Those are serrated thumb-cuffs. Sara: Where can I read more about them? David: There's a description in the catalogue.
colloquial.zh: Sara：展柜里的那些是什么？David：那些是带锯齿的拇指铐。Sara：我可以在哪里读到更多介绍？David：目录里有说明。

messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' naqra aktar dwarhom?

messages.en: Where can I read more about them?

messages.mt_spoken: Hemm deskrizzjoni fil-katalgu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm deskrizzjoni fil-katalgu.
messages.zh: 目录里有说明。
messages.en: There's a description in the catalogue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成三个画面来记：manetti 是铐具，bis-snien 提示带齿，għas-saba' l-kbir 提示用于拇指；连起来就是带锯齿的拇指铐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A restraint with two linked cuffs that fasten around the thumbs to restrict their movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带有两个相连铐环、扣住双手拇指以限制其活动的束缚器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir b'żewġ ħoloq magħqudin li jingħalqu madwar iż-żewġ swaba' l-kbar biex jirrestrinġu l-moviment tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扣住双手拇指、限制其活动的铐具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Manetti żgħar li jingħalqu madwar iż-żewġ swaba' l-kbar biex iżommuhom flimkien u jillimitaw il-moviment tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Thumb-cuffs are small linked restraints that fasten around a person's thumbs and limit their movement.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi l-manetti tas-saba' l-kbir bħala tagħmir li jirrestrinġi l-moviment taż-żewġ swaba' l-kbar.
formal.en: The catalogue describes thumb-cuffs as equipment that restricts the movement of both thumbs.
formal.zh: 目录将拇指铐描述为限制双手拇指活动的器具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma dawn fil-katalgu? Mark: Dawn huma manetti tas-saba' l-kbir; iżommu ż-żewġ swaba' l-kbar flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these in the catalogue? Mark: These are thumb-cuffs; they hold both thumbs together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：目录里的这些是什么？马克：这些是拇指铐，用来把双手拇指铐在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma dawn fil-katalgu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma dawn fil-katalgu?
messages.zh: 目录里的这些是什么？
messages.en: What are these in the catalogue?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn huma manetti tas-saba' l-kbir; iżommu ż-żewġ swaba' l-kbar flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn huma manetti tas-saba' l-kbir; iżommu ż-żewġ swaba' l-kbar flimkien.
messages.zh: 这些是拇指铐，用来把双手拇指铐在一起。
messages.en: These are thumb-cuffs; they hold both thumbs together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一幅双手拇指被两个小铐环连住的图，记住它指的是拇指铐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or activity of making goods, especially in a factory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产商品的过程或活动，尤其指在工厂中进行的制造生产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-attività ta' produzzjoni ta' oġġetti, speċjalment f'fabbrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造商品的过程或生产活动，尤指工厂生产。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha materjali jinħadmu u jinbidlu f'oġġetti lesti għall-użu jew għall-bejgħ, speċjalment f'fabbrika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Manufacture is the process of making goods from materials, especially through organized production in a factory.

formal.mt: Il-manifattura ta' dawn il-partijiet issir f'fabbrika li tuża magni moderni.
formal.en: The manufacture of these parts takes place in a factory that uses modern machinery.
formal.zh: 这些零件的制造在一家使用现代化机械的工厂中进行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn isiru dawn it-tazzi? Pawlu: Il-manifattura tagħhom issir f'fabbrika żgħira hawn Malta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are these cups made? Pawlu: They are manufactured in a small factory here in Malta.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些杯子是在哪里做的？保罗：它们是在马耳他本地的一家小工厂里制造的。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn isiru dawn it-tazzi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn isiru dawn it-tazzi?
messages.zh: 这些杯子是在哪里做的？
messages.en: Where are these cups made?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-manifattura tagħhom issir f'fabbrika żgħira hawn Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Il-manifattura tagħhom issir f'fabbrika żgħira hawn Malta.
messages.zh: 它们是在马耳他本地的一家小工厂里制造的。
messages.en: They are manufactured in a small factory here in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manifattura 放在工厂生产流程图旁，联想原料变成商品的整个制造过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that makes goods for sale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制造商品以供销售的个人或企业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tipproduċi oġġetti għall-bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产商品并将其出售的个人或企业；制造商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tagħmel prodotti minn materjali jew partijiet sabiex tbigħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods and sells them to other businesses or customers.

formal.mt: Il-manifatturier għandu jipprovdi struzzjonijiet ċari dwar l-użu u l-manutenzjoni tal-prodott.
formal.en: The manufacturer should provide clear instructions on the use and maintenance of the product.
formal.zh: 制造商应提供关于产品使用和维护的清晰说明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-manifatturier jista' jagħmel imwejjed skont il-qies li rridu? David: Iva, imma rridu nibagħtulu l-qisien eżatti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can this manufacturer make tables to the size we want? David: Yes, but we need to send him the exact measurements.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这家制造商能按我们想要的尺寸做桌子吗？戴维：能，不过我们得把准确尺寸发给他。

messages.speaker: Lara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-manifatturier jista' jagħmel imwejjed skont il-qies li rridu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-manifatturier jista' jagħmel imwejjed skont il-qies li rridu?
messages.zh: 这家制造商能按我们想要的尺寸做桌子吗？
messages.en: Can this manufacturer make tables to the size we want?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu nibagħtulu l-qisien eżatti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu nibagħtulu l-qisien eżatti.
messages.zh: 能，不过我们得把准确尺寸发给他。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to send him the exact measurements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manifatturier 写在工厂负责人或生产企业的名牌上，记住它回答的是谁制造商品。

gloss_zh: 海关货物舱单；海关货物清单

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document listing goods being transported for declaration to customs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明所运输货物、供向海关申报使用的清单文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jelenka l-merkanzija li tkun qed tinġarr sabiex tiġi ddikjarata lid-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向海关申报运输货物时使用的货物清单或舱单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument għall-finijiet doganali li jkun fih lista tal-merkanzija li tkun qed tiġi ttrasportata u d-dettalji tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs goods manifest is a document that lists transported goods and their details for declaration to customs authorities.

formal.mt: L-aġent ħejja l-manifest doganali tal-merkanzija u ċċekkja li d-dettalji jaqblu mad-dokumenti tat-trasport.
formal.en: The agent prepared the customs goods manifest and checked that the details matched the transport documents.
formal.zh: 代理人编制了海关货物舱单，并核对其中的详细信息是否与运输单证一致。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ħejjejt il-manifest doganali tal-merkanzija? Mark: Iva, lest; għad irrid niċċekkja n-numru tal-kaxxi qabel nibagħtu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you prepared the customs goods manifest? Mark: Yes, it is ready; I still need to check the number of boxes before sending it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你准备好海关货物舱单了吗？马克：准备好了；发出去之前，我还得核对一下箱数。

messages.speaker: Anna (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħejjejt il-manifest doganali tal-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Ħejjejt il-manifest doganali tal-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 你准备好海关货物舱单了吗？
messages.en: Have you prepared the customs goods manifest?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流文员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lest; għad irrid niċċekkja n-numru tal-kaxxi qabel nibagħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lest; għad irrid niċċekkja n-numru tal-kaxxi qabel nibagħtu.
messages.zh: 准备好了；发出去之前，我还得核对一下箱数。
messages.en: Yes, it is ready; I still need to check the number of boxes before sending it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海关人员拿着一张逐项列出货物的清单核对箱子，用这个场景记住整条货物舱单短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document identified by the title Rhine Manifest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以《莱茵宣言》为名称的文件；学习时应将整个名称作为一个专名理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument magħruf bit-titlu Manifest tar-Renu, li l-isem sħiħ tiegħu jintuża biex jidentifikah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《莱茵宣言》，一个用于指称特定宣言文件的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-titlu ta' dokument li jissejjaħ il-Manifest tar-Renu u li jiġi identifikat permezz ta' dan l-isem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Rhine Manifest is a document referred to by this particular title.

collocations.en: an analysis of the Rhine Manifest

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, aqra s-silta mill-Manifest tar-Renu u ikteb sommarju qasir tagħha.
formal.en: For this exercise, read the passage from the Rhine Manifest and write a short summary of it.
formal.zh: 本练习要求阅读《莱茵宣言》的选段，并写出一份简短摘要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt is-silta mill-Manifest tar-Renu? Mark: Iva, imma rrid naqraha mill-ġdid qabel nikteb is-sommarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you read the passage from the Rhine Manifest? Mark: Yes, but I want to read it again before writing the summary.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你读过《莱茵宣言》的那段选文了吗？马克：读过，但我想再读一遍，然后再写摘要。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt is-silta mill-Manifest tar-Renu?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt is-silta mill-Manifest tar-Renu?
messages.zh: 你读过《莱茵宣言》的那段选文了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the passage from the Rhine Manifest?

teaching_sense.en_definition: An intense enthusiasm for something, or a mental state involving unusually elevated or irritable mood and increased energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指人们对某事物的强烈迷恋或流行热潮；在心理健康语境中，也指情绪异常高涨或易怒、精力明显增加的躁狂状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entużjażmu qawwi jew moda mifruxa għal xi ħaġa; fil-kuntest tas-saħħa mentali, stat ta' burdata għolja jew irritabbli b'mod mhux tas-soltu u żieda fl-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一时风靡的热潮，指许多人在某一时期对某事物产生强烈兴趣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moda jew interess qawwi f'xi ħaġa li jinfirex fost ħafna nies u li spiss idum biss għal żmien qasir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A craze is an activity or interest that becomes extremely popular, often for a short time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躁狂，一种情绪异常高涨或易怒、精力和活动水平明显增加的精神状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat mentali li fih il-persuna jkollha burdata għolja jew irritabbli b'mod mhux tas-soltu, flimkien ma' żieda ċara fl-enerġija u fl-attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mania is a mental state marked by unusually elevated or irritable mood and increased energy and activity.

formal.mt: Fil-kuntest tas-saħħa mentali, il-kelma manija tirreferi għal stat ta' burdata għolja jew irritabbli b'mod mhux tas-soltu u żieda fl-enerġija u fl-attività.
formal.en: In a mental health context, the word mania refers to a state of unusually elevated or irritable mood and increased energy and activity.
formal.zh: 在心理健康语境中，manija 指情绪异常高涨或易怒，同时精力和活动水平增加的状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din il-manija ġdida tal-karti? Ninu: Kulħadd qed jiġborhom u jpartathom mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this new card craze? Ninu: Everyone is collecting them and swapping them with friends.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这股新的卡片热是怎么回事？尼努：大家都在收集卡片，还跟朋友交换。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din il-manija ġdida tal-karti?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din il-manija ġdida tal-karti?
messages.zh: 这股新的卡片热是怎么回事？
messages.en: What's this new card craze?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd qed jiġborhom u jpartathom mal-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd qed jiġborhom u jpartathom mal-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 大家都在收集卡片，还跟朋友交换。
messages.en: Everyone is collecting them and swapping them with friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个语境分别记忆：大家争着收集卡片是“热潮”，心理健康文章中的异常情绪与精力状态是“躁狂”，读句子时先辨语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cosmetic treatment of the hands and fingernails that includes shaping the nails and may include applying nail polish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对双手和手指甲进行的美容护理，包括修整指甲形状，也可包括涂指甲油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament kosmetiku għall-idejn u d-dwiefer tagħhom li jinkludi t-tiswir tad-dwiefer u jista' jinkludi ż-żebgħa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手部及手指甲的美容护理，通常涉及修剪、修形，并可包括涂指甲油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kura kosmetika tal-idejn u d-dwiefer tagħhom, li matulha d-dwiefer jiġu mqassra jew imsawra u jistgħu wkoll jinżebgħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A manicure is a beauty treatment in which your hands and fingernails are cared for and your nails may be polished.

formal.mt: Is-servizz ta' manikjur jinkludi t-tiswir tad-dwiefer u, jekk il-klijent jixtieq, iż-żebgħa tagħhom.
formal.en: The manicure service includes shaping the fingernails and, if the client wishes, applying nail polish.
formal.zh: 手部美甲服务包括修整手指甲形状，并可根据顾客意愿涂指甲油。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nixtieq nagħmel appuntament għal manikjur nhar is-Sibt. Rita: Jaqbillek fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu? Marija: Iva, tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: I'd like to book a manicure for Saturday. Rita: Would ten in the morning suit you? Marija: Yes, that would be great.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我想预约星期六做手部美甲。丽塔：上午十点方便吗？玛丽亚：方便，太好了。

messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nagħmel appuntament għal manikjur nhar is-Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nagħmel appuntament għal manikjur nhar is-Sibt.
messages.zh: 我想预约星期六做手部美甲。
messages.en: I'd like to book a manicure for Saturday.

messages.speaker: Rita (美甲店接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaqbillek fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Jaqbillek fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu?
messages.zh: 上午十点方便吗？
messages.en: Would ten in the morning suit you?

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 方便，太好了。
messages.en: Yes, that would be great.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manikjur 与英语 manicure 并排记，想象双手放在美甲桌上，先修指甲再选颜色，牢牢记住这是手部护理。

gloss_zh: 市场操纵；金融市场操纵

teaching_sense.en_definition: The deliberate use of deceptive trading or misleading information to influence market prices or trading activity artificially.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过欺骗性交易或误导性信息，人为影响市场价格或交易活动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-manipulazzjoni tas-suq hija l-użu intenzjonat ta' kummerċ qarrieqi jew informazzjoni qarrieqa biex jiġu influwenzati artifiċjalment il-prezzijiet jew l-attività fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过欺骗性交易或误导性信息，人为影响证券等金融资产价格或交易活动的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-manipulazzjoni tas-suq finanzjarju hija azzjoni intenzjonata li tuża tranżazzjonijiet jew informazzjoni qarrieqa biex tinfluwenza artifiċjalment il-prezzijiet jew il-kummerċ ta' assi finanzjarji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Financial market manipulation occurs when someone uses deceptive transactions or information to influence financial asset prices or trading activity artificially.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以欺骗手段人为干预市场价格、供求表象或交易活动的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-manipulazzjoni tas-suq hija mġiba qarrieqa maħsuba biex tbiddel artifiċjalment il-prezzijiet, l-attività kummerċjali jew l-impressjoni tad-domanda u l-provvista.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market manipulation is behaviour intended to distort prices or create a misleading impression of supply, demand, or trading activity.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif informazzjoni qarrieqa tista' tintuża għall-manipulazzjoni tas-suq.
formal.en: The report explains how misleading information can be used for market manipulation.
formal.zh: 该报告解释了误导性信息如何被用于操纵市场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jinvestigaw dawk it-tranżazzjonijiet? Pawlu: Għax hemm suspett ta' manipulazzjoni tas-suq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are they investigating those transactions? Pawlu: Because there is a suspicion of market manipulation.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们为什么在调查那些交易？保罗：因为有人怀疑存在市场操纵。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jinvestigaw dawk it-tranżazzjonijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jinvestigaw dawk it-tranżazzjonijiet?
messages.zh: 他们为什么在调查那些交易？
messages.en: Why are they investigating those transactions?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm suspett ta' manipulazzjoni tas-suq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm suspett ta' manipulazzjoni tas-suq.
messages.zh: 因为有人怀疑存在市场操纵。
messages.en: Because there is a suspicion of market manipulation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“有人在幕后拨动市场价格”：记住核心是人为操纵市场，不能只理解为普通交易。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of organizing debts and planning how to repay them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对欠款进行整理、规划和监控，并安排偿还方式的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' organizzazzjoni u kontroll tad-dejn, inkluż l-ippjanar ta' kif u meta jitħallas lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务管理，即整理债务、制定还款安排并监控偿还情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni tad-dejn u t-tfassil ta' arranġamenti għall-ħlas lura tiegħu, flimkien mas-segwitu tal-ħlasijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Debt management is the process of organizing what is owed and planning repayments.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-maniġġjar tad-dejn jgħin lill-organizzazzjoni tippjana l-ħlasijiet tagħha.
formal.en: The report explains how debt management helps the organization plan its payments.
formal.zh: 报告说明了债务管理如何帮助该组织规划还款。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer bil-pjan ta' maniġġjar tad-dejn? Pawlu: Aħjar issa; naf kemm irrid inħallas kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are you getting on with your debt management plan? Pawlu: Better now; I know how much I need to repay each month.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的债务管理计划执行得怎么样？保罗：现在好多了；我知道每个月需要还多少钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer bil-pjan ta' maniġġjar tad-dejn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer bil-pjan ta' maniġġjar tad-dejn?
messages.zh: 你的债务管理计划执行得怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with your debt management plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar issa; naf kemm irrid inħallas kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar issa; naf kemm irrid inħallas kull xahar.
messages.zh: 现在好多了；我知道每个月需要还多少钱。
messages.en: Better now; I know how much I need to repay each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把所有欠款放进一张还款日历：先整理，再安排每月偿还，用这个完整画面记住“债务管理”。

gloss_zh: 有礼貌的；举止有教养的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is polite and well-mannered treats other people respectfully and behaves considerately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容待人有礼、举止得体，并能体谅他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jġib ruħu b'rispett u edukazzjoni u jqis is-sentimenti ta' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有礼貌的；在言语和行为上尊重他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jitkellem u jaġixxi b'rispett lejn nies oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is polite speaks and behaves in ways that show respect for other people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止有教养的；懂得并遵守得体的待人接物礼节的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li għandu manjieri tajbin u jaf kif iġib ruħu b'mod xieraq ma' nies oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is well-mannered behaves considerately and follows accepted conventions of good social behaviour.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema ddeskriviet lil Mark bħala tifel manjeruż li jisma' lill-oħrajn u jitkellem b'rispett.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher described Mark as a well-mannered boy who listens to others and speaks respectfully.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中把马克描述为一个举止有教养、会倾听他人并且说话有礼的男孩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-wejter? Rita: Kien manjeruż ħafna; semagħna bil-paċenzja u rringrazzjana.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the waiter like? Rita: He was very polite; he listened to us patiently and thanked us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个服务员怎么样？丽塔：他很有礼貌，耐心听我们说话，还向我们道谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien il-wejter?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien il-wejter?
messages.zh: 那个服务员怎么样？
messages.en: What was the waiter like?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien manjeruż ħafna; semagħna bil-paċenzja u rringrazzjana.
messages.mt_standard: Kien manjeruż ħafna; semagħna bil-paċenzja u rringrazzjana.
messages.zh: 他很有礼貌，耐心听我们说话，还向我们道谢。
messages.en: He was very polite; he listened to us patiently and thanked us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先倾听、说话客气、最后道谢”这组三连动作记住 manjeruż，把词义牢牢连到有礼貌的举止上。

gloss_zh: 壮丽的；华美的；极其出色的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something magnificent is exceptionally beautiful, grand, or impressive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某物格外美丽、宏伟壮观，或出色得令人赞叹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li hija sabiħa ħafna, grandjuża jew tant impressjonanti li tqanqal l-ammirazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 壮丽的、华美的或极其出色的；因非凡的美感、规模或品质而令人赞叹的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa ta' sbuħija, kobor jew kwalità eċċezzjonali li tħalli impressjoni qawwija u tqanqal l-ammirazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe something as magnificent, you mean that its beauty, grandeur, or exceptional quality impresses you greatly.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jinsab f'palazz manjifiku, b'swali kbar u soqfa mżejna b'dettalji fini.
formal.en: The museum is housed in a magnificent palace, with large halls and ceilings decorated with fine details.
formal.zh: 博物馆设在一座宏伟华丽的宫殿内，那里有宽敞的大厅和装饰精细的天花板。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-palazz waqt il-mawra? Mark: Iva, huwa manjifiku! Għoġobni ħafna s-saqaf tas-sala.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the palace during the tour? Mark: Yes, it is magnificent! I really liked the ceiling in the hall.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你参观时看到那座宫殿了吗？马克：看到了，真是壮丽！我特别喜欢大厅的天花板。

messages.speaker: Nina (同行游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-palazz waqt il-mawra?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-palazz waqt il-mawra?
messages.zh: 你参观时看到那座宫殿了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the palace during the tour?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa manjifiku! Għoġobni ħafna s-saqaf tas-sala.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa manjifiku! Għoġobni ħafna s-saqaf tas-sala.
messages.zh: 看到了，真是壮丽！我特别喜欢大厅的天花板。
messages.en: Yes, it is magnificent! I really liked the ceiling in the hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走进华丽宫殿时抬头惊叹的画面，用 manjifiku 表达“美得壮观、好得令人赞叹”的强烈感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hosepipe is a flexible tube used to carry water, for example when watering plants or washing outdoor surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于输送水的柔性管子，例如浇灌植物或冲洗室外地面时使用的软水管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Manka hija tubu flessibbli li jintuża biex iwassal l-ilma, pereżempju għat-tisqija tal-pjanti jew għall-ħasil ta' uċuħ fuq barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输水用的软管，通常可接在水龙头上，用于浇水或冲洗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Manka hija tubu li jitgħawweġ u li normalment jitqabbad ma' vit biex l-ilma jitwassal fejn ikun meħtieġ għat-tisqija jew għall-ħasil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hosepipe is a long flexible tube that carries water from a tap to where it is needed.

collocations.en: to connect the hosepipe to the tap
collocations.zh: 把软水管接到水龙头上

formal.mt: Qabel tibda t-tisqija, qabbad il-manka mal-vit u kun żgur li l-ilma jgħaddi minnha mingħajr tnixxijiet.
formal.en: Before you begin watering, connect the hosepipe to the tap and make sure water flows through it without leaks.
formal.zh: 开始浇水前，把软水管接到水龙头上，并确认水能流过管子而没有渗漏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi l-manka? Irrid insaqqi l-pjanti. Toni: Qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien; il-vit hemm ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the hosepipe? I want to water the plants. Toni: It is next to the garden door; the tap is there too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：软水管在哪里？我想给植物浇水。托尼：就在花园门旁边，水龙头也在那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-manka? Irrid insaqqi l-pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-manka? Irrid insaqqi l-pjanti.
messages.zh: 软水管在哪里？我想给植物浇水。
messages.en: Where is the hosepipe? I want to water the plants.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien; il-vit hemm ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb tal-ġnien; il-vit hemm ukoll.
messages.zh: 就在花园门旁边，水龙头也在那里。
messages.en: It is next to the garden door; the tap is there too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manka 和花园里盘成圈的软水管联系起来，再顺着“接水龙头、拉开管子、给花浇水”的动作顺序记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A handle is the part of an object that you hold to lift, carry, or operate it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体上供人握住，以便提起、携带或操作的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' oġġett li taqbad b'idek biex terfgħu, iġġorru jew tużah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把手；柄，即物体上供手握持或操作的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' oġġett li tkun magħmula biex taqbadha b'idek u biha ġġorr jew tħaddem l-oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The handle of an object is the part you hold when carrying or using it.

formal.mt: Jekk il-manku tal-bieb ikun miksur, il-bieb għandu jissewwa qabel ma tintuża l-kamra.
formal.en: If the door handle is broken, the door must be repaired before the room is used.
formal.zh: 如果门把手损坏，必须先修好门，再使用房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' ġġorr din il-bagalja? Mark: Iva, imma l-manku miksur. Maja: Mela nġorruha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you carry this suitcase? Mark: Yes, but the handle is broken. Maja: Then let's carry it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能提这个行李箱吗？马克：可以，不过提手坏了。玛雅：那我们一起搬吧。

messages.mt_standard: Tista' ġġorr din il-bagalja?

messages.en: Can you carry this suitcase?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-manku miksur.

messages.zh: 那我们一起搬吧。
messages.en: Then let's carry it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象伸手抓住门把手，再抓住行李箱提手；这两个供手握住的部分都可以用 manku 来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Manoel Island is the name of a small island in an inlet in the Gżira-Xemxija area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马诺埃尔岛，指位于格济拉—谢姆希亚一带某处海湾内的一座小岛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Manoel Island huwa l-isem ta' gżira żgħira f'daħla tal-baħar fiż-żona ta' Gżira-Xemxija.

sense_translations.en_definition: A small island in an inlet in the Gżira-Xemxija area
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马诺埃尔岛，位于格济拉—谢姆希亚一带一处海湾内的小岛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ta' gżira żgħira li tinsab f'daħla tal-baħar fiż-żona ta' Gżira-Xemxija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Manoel Island is a small island situated within an inlet in the Gżira-Xemxija area.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-ġurnata jinkludi żjara fuq Manoel Island, u kull parteċipant se jingħata mappa tal-gżira.
formal.en: The day's programme includes a visit to Manoel Island, and each participant will receive a map of the island.
formal.zh: 当天的活动安排包括游览马诺埃尔岛，每位参加者都会领到一份该岛的地图。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tmur fuq Manoel Island għada? Pawlu: Iva, nieħu mappa miegħi. Sara: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to go to Manoel Island tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, I'll take a map with me. Sara: Good, let's meet in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你明天想去马诺埃尔岛吗？保罗：想，我会带上地图。萨拉：好，我们上午见。

messages.mt_spoken: Trid tmur fuq Manoel Island għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tmur fuq Manoel Island għada?
messages.zh: 你明天想去马诺埃尔岛吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to Manoel Island tomorrow?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħu mappa miegħi.
