formal.en: During the science lesson, the teacher showed the students a clam and explained how its shells protect its soft body.
formal.zh: 科学课上，老师向学生展示了一只蛤蜊，并解释了贝壳如何保护它柔软的身体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan fir-ritratt? Lara: Dik maskla. Tara ż-żewġ qxur tagħha? Maja: Iva, issa narahom!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this in the photo? Lara: That's a clam. Can you see its two shells? Maja: Yes, I can see them now!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里这个是什么？拉拉：那是一只蛤蜊。你看得到它的两片贝壳吗？玛雅：看得到，现在看清了！

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 照片里这个是什么？
messages.en: What is this in the photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik maskla. Tara ż-żewġ qxur tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik maskla. Tara ż-żewġ qxur tagħha?
messages.zh: 那是一只蛤蜊。你看得到它的两片贝壳吗？
messages.en: That's a clam. Can you see its two shells?

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa narahom!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa narahom!
messages.zh: 看得到，现在看清了！
messages.en: Yes, I can see them now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maskla 配上一张双壳贝的图片，想象两片贝壳像小门一样开合，用图像记住“蛤蜊、鸟蛤”。

gloss_zh: 质量；团块；大量聚集的物质

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of matter in an object, or a large quantity of material forming one body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体所含物质的量，即质量；也指聚成一体的一大团物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwantità ta' materja f'oġġett, jew ammont kbir ta' materjal miġbur f'ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 质量，即物体所含物质的量；也指聚集成一体的团块或大量物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwantità ta' materja li jkun fiha oġġett; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ammont ta' materjal li jifforma ħaġa waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The mass of an object is the amount of matter it contains; a mass can also be a quantity of material gathered into one body.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-esperiment, l-istudenti rreġistraw il-massa ta' kull kampjun f'kilogrammi.
formal.en: In the experiment report, the students recorded the mass of each sample in kilograms.
formal.zh: 在实验报告中，学生们以千克为单位记录了每个样本的质量。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex waqafna hawn? Nina: Hemm massa ta' blat f'nofs il-mogħdija. Mark: Mela ejja ngħaddu minn naħa oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why have we stopped here? Nina: There's a mass of rock in the middle of the path. Mark: Then let's go another way.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们为什么停在这里？妮娜：小路中间有一大块岩石。马克：那我们换条路走吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqafna hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqafna hawn?
messages.zh: 我们为什么停在这里？
messages.en: Why have we stopped here?

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm massa ta' blat f'nofs il-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm massa ta' blat f'nofs il-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 小路中间有一大块岩石。
messages.en: There's a mass of rock in the middle of the path.

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja ngħaddu minn naħa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja ngħaddu minn naħa oħra.
messages.zh: 那我们换条路走吧。
messages.en: Then let's go another way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 massa 放进两个画面：实验室里量“质量”，山路上遇到“一大团岩石”。英语 mass 可作拼写提示，不代表词源说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The brutal killing of a large number of people, especially people who cannot defend themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残酷杀害大量人员的行为，尤其指杀害无力自卫的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qtil brutali ta' għadd kbir ta' nies, speċjalment nies li ma jistgħux jiddefendu ruħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屠杀，指以残酷方式大量杀害人或动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qtil brutali ta' ħafna nies jew annimali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Slaughter is the cruel or violent killing of large numbers of people or animals.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大屠杀，指残酷杀害大批人员，尤其是无力自卫者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qtil brutali ta' grupp kbir ta' nies, speċjalment persuni bla difiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A massacre is an event in which many people are killed brutally, especially people who are unable to defend themselves.

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont fittizju, il-ġurnalista tiġbor ix-xhieda ta' dawk li baqgħu ħajjin wara l-massakru.
formal.en: In this fictional story, the journalist collects the testimonies of those who survived the massacre.
formal.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，记者收集了大屠杀幸存者的证词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-film li rajt ilbieraħ kien tqil ħafna. Mark: Fuq xiex kien? Lara: Fuq familja li baqgħet ħajja wara massakru. Mark: Nifhem għaliex ħalliek imdejqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: The film I watched yesterday was very upsetting. Mark: What was it about? Lara: A family that survived a massacre. Mark: I understand why it left you upset.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我昨天看的电影让人很难受。马克：讲什么的？拉拉：一个在大屠杀中幸存下来的家庭。马克：我明白你为什么看完那么难过。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-film li rajt ilbieraħ kien tqil ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-film li rajt ilbieraħ kien tqil ħafna.
messages.zh: 我昨天看的电影让人很难受。
messages.en: The film I watched yesterday was very upsetting.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex kien?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex kien?
messages.zh: 讲什么的？
messages.en: What was it about?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq familja li baqgħet ħajja wara massakru.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq familja li baqgħet ħajja wara massakru.
messages.zh: 一个在大屠杀中幸存下来的家庭。
messages.en: A family that survived a massacre.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhem għaliex ħalliek imdejqa.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhem għaliex ħalliek imdejqa.
messages.zh: 我明白你为什么看完那么难过。
messages.en: I understand why it left you upset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“受害者、幸存者、纪念”三个严肃语境联想 massakru，记住它表示屠杀；拼写可与英语 massacre 对照记忆，不作词源推断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very large, heavy, or solid in size and construction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积很大、重量很重或结构厚实的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu daqs kbir ħafna, piż kbir jew struttura soda u ħoxna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巨大的；厚重结实的，尤指物体体积大、分量重或结构厚实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu kbir ħafna fid-daqs, tqil jew mibni b'mod sod u oħxon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is massive is very large, heavy, or solidly built.

formal.mt: Id-disinn jinkludi ħajt massiv tal-ġebel li jifred il-bitħa mit-triq.
formal.en: The design includes a massive stone wall separating the courtyard from the road.
formal.zh: 该设计包含一道厚重的石墙，将庭院与道路隔开。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak il-bini massiv hemmhekk! Pawlu: Dak il-mużew il-ġdid. Nina: Minn hawn jidher saħansitra akbar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that massive building over there! Pawlu: That's the new museum. Nina: It looks even bigger from here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看那边那座巨大的建筑！保罗：那是新博物馆。妮娜：从这里看，它显得更大了。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-bini massiv hemmhekk!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-bini massiv hemmhekk!
messages.zh: 看那边那座巨大的建筑！
messages.en: Look at that massive building over there!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-mużew il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-mużew il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 那是新博物馆。
messages.en: That's the new museum.

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn hawn jidher saħansitra akbar.
messages.mt_standard: Minn hawn jidher saħansitra akbar.
messages.zh: 从这里看，它显得更大了。
messages.en: It looks even bigger from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 massiv 就想象一堵又高又厚的石墙，把“巨大、厚重、结实”连成一幅图；英语 massive 可辅助记拼写，不代表词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Solid and compact in its physical structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体结构紧密、内部充实而非空心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha struttura kompatta u mhijiex vojta minn ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实心的；结构紧密而非中空的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi oġġett jew materjal li huwa kompatt u mhux vojt minn ġewwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is solid has a compact structure and is not hollow inside.

formal.mt: Il-mejda hija magħmula minn injam mastizz u għandha tinżamm f'post niexef.
formal.en: The table is made of solid wood and should be kept in a dry place.
formal.zh: 这张桌子由实木制成，应放在干燥处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-siġġu magħmul minn injam mastizz? Pawlu: Iva, u għalhekk huwa tqil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this chair made of solid wood? Pawlu: Yes, and that is why it is heavy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这把椅子是实木做的吗？保罗：是的，所以它很重。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-siġġu magħmul minn injam mastizz?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-siġġu magħmul minn injam mastizz?
messages.zh: 这把椅子是实木做的吗？
messages.en: Is this chair made of solid wood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għalhekk huwa tqil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għalhekk huwa tqil.
messages.zh: 是的，所以它很重。
messages.en: Yes, and that is why it is heavy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mastizz 和实木椅子的横截面一起记：切开后里面也是木头，没有空腔，就能联想到“实心、坚实”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with great skill and experience in a craft or art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某门手艺或艺术上具有高超技能和丰富经验的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha ħila kbira u esperjenza f'sengħa jew f'arti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精通某项技艺或艺术的大师；技艺高超的工匠。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaddem sengħa jew arti b'ħila għolja ħafna u b'esperjenza kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A master is someone who has developed exceptional skill in a particular craft or art.

formal.mt: Il-mastru wera lill-apprendisti kif jaħdmu l-injam b'attenzjoni u preċiżjoni.
formal.en: The master craftsman showed the apprentices how to work wood carefully and precisely.
formal.zh: 工匠师傅向学徒们示范了如何细致、精准地加工木材。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex mort għand il-mastru? Mark: Biex nitgħallem kif insewwi l-għamara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you go to the master craftsman? Mark: To learn how to repair furniture.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么去找那位工匠师傅？马克：为了学习怎么修理家具。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex mort għand il-mastru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex mort għand il-mastru?
messages.zh: 你为什么去找那位工匠师傅？
messages.en: Why did you go to the master craftsman?

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nitgħallem kif insewwi l-għamara.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nitgħallem kif insewwi l-għamara.
messages.zh: 为了学习怎么修理家具。
messages.en: To learn how to repair furniture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mastru 时想象一位老师傅带着学徒修家具：重点是他精通一门技艺，把词和“手艺大师”这个人物形象绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of numbers, quantities, shapes, and the relationships between them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究数、数量、形状及其相互关系的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tan-numri, tal-kwantitajiet, tal-forom u tar-relazzjonijiet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数学；研究数、数量、空间形状及其关系的学科。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suġġett li jistudja n-numri, il-kwantitajiet, il-forom u r-relazzjonijiet bejniethom permezz ta' regoli u raġunament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mathematics is the study of numbers, quantities, shapes, and their relationships through rules and reasoning.

formal.mt: Il-matematika tgħin lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw il-ħila li jsolvu problemi u jaħsbu b'mod loġiku.
formal.en: Mathematics helps students develop the ability to solve problems and think logically.
formal.zh: 数学有助于学生培养解决问题和进行逻辑思考的能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna lezzjoni tal-matematika llum? Ben: Iva, u rridu nġibu l-kalkulatur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have a mathematics lesson today? Ben: Yes, and we need to bring a calculator.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今天有数学课吗？本：有，而且我们得带计算器。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna lezzjoni tal-matematika llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna lezzjoni tal-matematika llum?
messages.zh: 我们今天有数学课吗？
messages.en: Do we have a mathematics lesson today?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u rridu nġibu l-kalkulatur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u rridu nġibu l-kalkulatur.
messages.zh: 有，而且我们得带计算器。
messages.en: Yes, and we need to bring a calculator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用数学课堂作记忆画面：黑板上有数字、三角形和一道计算题，把这三样都贴上 matematika 的标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material used to make a product, especially an unprocessed input or material directly attributable to that product.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制造产品的材料，尤其指尚待加工的原料；在直接材料义下，指能直接归属于某项产品的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal użat biex isir prodott, speċjalment materjal li jkun għadu jrid jiġi pproċessat jew li jista' jiġi attribwit direttament lil dak il-prodott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于制造特定产品，并能直接识别和归属于该产品的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal użat fil-manifattura ta' prodott partikolari li jista' jiġi identifikat u attribwit direttament lil dak il-prodott.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Direct material is material used to make a particular product that can be identified and attributed directly to that product.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为生产投入、供进一步加工或制成产品的原料或原材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża bħala bażi fil-produzzjoni u li jiġi pproċessat jew mibdul biex isiru prodotti minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A raw material is a substance or material that is processed or transformed to make a product.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-ispejjeż, id-drapp użat għal kull qmis jitqies bħala materja prima attribwibbli direttament lil dik il-qmis.
formal.en: In the cost report, the fabric used for each shirt is treated as direct material attributable to that shirt.
formal.zh: 在成本报告中，每件衬衫所用的布料被视为可直接归属于该衬衫的直接材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna biżżejjed materja prima biex nagħmlu l-ħobż illum? Toni: Iva, għandna biżżejjed dqiq għall-ġurnata kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have enough raw material to make bread today? Toni: Yes, we have enough flour for the whole day.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们今天做面包的原料够吗？Toni：够，我们的面粉足够用一整天。

messages.speaker: Sara (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biżżejjed materja prima biex nagħmlu l-ħobż illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biżżejjed materja prima biex nagħmlu l-ħobż illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天做面包的原料够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough raw material to make bread today?

messages.speaker: Toni (面包店同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna biżżejjed dqiq għall-ġurnata kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna biżżejjed dqiq għall-ġurnata kollha.
messages.zh: 够，我们的面粉足够用一整天。
messages.en: Yes, we have enough flour for the whole day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布料变成衬衫：从生产过程看，布料是“原材料”；从单件产品的成本归属看，它又是“直接材料”。用同一块布联系两个义项，避免把两者完全等同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance or collection of things used to make something or carry out an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作物品的材料，或开展某项活动所需的一组物料、用品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza jew ġabra ta' affarijiet li jintużaw biex issir xi ħaġa jew titwettaq attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料；用来制作或建造某物的物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex jinħadem oġġett jew tinbena xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A material is a substance that is used to make or build something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物料；用品；某项工作或活动中使用的各种东西的统称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' oġġetti jew affarijiet li jintużaw għal xi xogħol jew attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stuff refers collectively to things or supplies used for a particular purpose or activity.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-attività, l-għalliema għandha tqassam il-materjal meħtieġ lill-istudenti.
formal.en: Before the activity begins, the teacher should distribute the necessary materials to the students.
formal.zh: 活动开始前，教师应把所需材料分发给学生。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ġibt il-materjal għall-proġett? Adam: Iva, ġibt il-karti, il-kolla u l-imqass.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you bring the stuff for the project? Adam: Yes, I brought the paper, glue, and scissors.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你带来做项目要用的东西了吗？亚当：带来了，我带了纸、胶水和剪刀。

messages.speaker: Nina (项目同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibt il-materjal għall-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Ġibt il-materjal għall-proġett?
messages.zh: 你带来做项目要用的东西了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the stuff for the project?

messages.speaker: Adam (项目同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġibt il-karti, il-kolla u l-imqass.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġibt il-karti, il-kolla u l-imqass.
messages.zh: 带来了，我带了纸、胶水和剪刀。
messages.en: Yes, I brought the paper, glue, and scissors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 materjal 记成工作台上“要用的材料”：木板可以是制作材料，纸、胶水和剪刀也可合称活动用品，用同一张工作台画面串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material used directly in making a product, especially material that becomes part of the finished item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接用于制造产品的材料，尤其指构成成品一部分、能够直接归属于该产品的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża direttament biex isir prodott, speċjalment meta jsir parti mill-prodott lest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接材料：构成产品的一部分，且其用量或成本可以直接归属于该产品的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li jsir parti minn prodott u li l-kwantità jew l-ispiża tiegħu tista' tiġi attribwita direttament lil dak il-prodott.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Direct material is material that becomes part of a product and whose cost can be assigned directly to that product.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原材料：用于加工或制造产品的基础材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal bażiku li jintuża bħala punt tat-tluq għall-ipproċessar jew għall-manifattura ta' prodotti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Raw material is a basic substance used to manufacture or process a product.

collocations.en: the quantity of direct material required

formal.mt: Fil-kalkolu tal-ispiża ta' kull mejda, l-injam użat fil-produzzjoni jitqies bħala materjal dirett.
formal.en: When calculating the cost of each table, the wood used in production is treated as direct material.
formal.zh: 计算每张桌子的成本时，生产所用的木材被计为直接材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-injam għal dawn l-ixkafef jgħodd bħala materjal dirett? Mark: Iva, għax isir parti mill-ixkafef li qed nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the wood for these shelves count as direct material? Mark: Yes, because it becomes part of the shelves we are making.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些架子用的木材算直接材料吗？Mark：算，因为它会成为我们正在制作的架子的一部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: L-injam għal dawn l-ixkafef jgħodd bħala materjal dirett?
messages.mt_standard: L-injam għal dawn l-ixkafef jgħodd bħala materjal dirett?
messages.zh: 这些架子用的木材算直接材料吗？
messages.en: Does the wood for these shelves count as direct material?

messages.speaker: Mark (木工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax isir parti mill-ixkafef li qed nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax isir parti mill-ixkafef li qed nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 算，因为它会成为我们正在制作的架子的一部分。
messages.en: Yes, because it becomes part of the shelves we are making.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木板直接变成桌面：进入成品且能归到该产品的材料，就是“直接材料”；强调加工起点时则理解为“原材料”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material that does not qualify as originating in a particular country or area under the relevant origin criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照相关原产地判定标准，不具备某一国家或地区原产资格的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li ma jissodisfax il-kriterji meħtieġa biex jitqies li għandu oriġini f'pajjiż jew żona partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按相关原产地标准认定为不具有原产资格的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li, skont il-kriterji tal-oriġini applikabbli, ma jitqiesx bħala oriġinarju tal-pajjiż jew taż-żona rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Non-originating material is material that does not meet the applicable criteria for originating status in the country or area concerned.

collocations.en: the value of the non-originating material

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija żżomm rekord tal-materjal mhux oriġinarju użat fil-produzzjoni.
formal.en: The company keeps a record of the non-originating material used in production.
formal.zh: 公司记录生产中使用的非原产材料。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-materjal għandu status oriġinarju? Pawlu: Le, fir-rekord tagħna jidher bħala materjal mhux oriġinarju.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does this material have originating status? Pawlu: No, our record lists it as non-originating material.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这种材料具有原产资格吗？Pawlu：没有，我们的记录把它列为非原产材料。

messages.speaker: Marta (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-materjal għandu status oriġinarju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-materjal għandu status oriġinarju?
messages.zh: 这种材料具有原产资格吗？
messages.en: Does this material have originating status?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (生产主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fir-rekord tagħna jidher bħala materjal mhux oriġinarju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fir-rekord tagħna jidher bħala materjal mhux oriġinarju.
messages.zh: 没有，我们的记录把它列为非原产材料。
messages.en: No, our record lists it as non-originating material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 materjal oriġinarju 记成“具有原产资格的材料”，再把中间的 mhux 想成否定标记：加上它就成为“非原产材料”。记忆重点是资格判定，不要只凭运输地点判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material that qualifies as originating in a particular country or area under the relevant origin criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照相关原产地判定标准，具备某一国家或地区原产资格的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jissodisfa l-kriterji meħtieġa biex jitqies li għandu oriġini f'pajjiż jew żona partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按相关原产地标准认定为具有原产资格的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li, skont il-kriterji tal-oriġini applikabbli, jitqies bħala oriġinarju tal-pajjiż jew taż-żona rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Originating material is material that meets the applicable criteria for originating status in the country or area concerned.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-kwantità ta' materjal oriġinarju użat f'kull prodott.
formal.en: The report indicates the quantity of originating material used in each product.
formal.zh: 报告列明每种产品所使用的原产材料数量。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-materjal hu oriġinarju? David: Iva, skont id-dokumenti li għandna, huwa materjal oriġinarju.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this material originating? David: Yes, according to the documents we have, it is originating material.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这种材料具有原产资格吗？David：是的，根据我们持有的文件，它属于原产材料。

messages.speaker: Rita (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-materjal hu oriġinarju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-materjal hu oriġinarju?
messages.zh: 这种材料具有原产资格吗？
messages.en: Is this material originating?

messages.speaker: David (资料管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, skont id-dokumenti li għandna, huwa materjal oriġinarju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, skont id-dokumenti li għandna, huwa materjal oriġinarju.
messages.zh: 是的，根据我们持有的文件，它属于原产材料。
messages.en: Yes, according to the documents we have, it is originating material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“原产资格已符合”的文件标签联系起来：materjal 是材料，oriġinarju 在这里说明原产资格。再与含有 mhux 的否定短语成对记忆。

gloss_zh: 在商业市场上交易的材料

teaching_sense.en_definition: Materials bought and sold through commercial transactions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过商业交易进行买卖的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjali li jinxtraw u jinbiegħu permezz ta' tranżazzjonijiet kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业交易材料：作为商业买卖对象、在市场上流通的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjali li jkunu s-suġġett ta' xiri u bejgħ fis-suq bħala parti minn attività kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Commercially traded materials are materials that businesses or individuals buy and sell in the market.

collocations.en: the prices of commercially traded materials
the supply of commercially traded materials
the quality of commercially traded materials

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-prezzijiet ta' diversi materjali nnegozjati kummerċjalment, fosthom l-injam u l-azzar.
formal.en: The report compares the prices of various commercially traded materials, including wood and steel.
formal.zh: 该报告比较了多种商业交易材料的价格，包括木材和钢材。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhuma dawn il-materjali nnegozjati kummerċjalment li ssemmi l-lista? Pawlu: Huma materjali li jinxtraw u jinbiegħu fis-suq, bħall-injam u l-azzar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are these commercially traded materials mentioned in the list? Pawlu: They are materials bought and sold in the market, such as wood and steel.
colloquial.zh: Lara：清单上说的这些商业交易材料是什么？Pawlu：就是在市场上买卖的材料，比如木材和钢材。

messages.speaker: Lara (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma dawn il-materjali nnegozjati kummerċjalment li ssemmi l-lista?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma dawn il-materjali nnegozjati kummerċjalment li ssemmi l-lista?
messages.zh: 清单上说的这些商业交易材料是什么？
messages.en: What are these commercially traded materials mentioned in the list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma materjali li jinxtraw u jinbiegħu fis-suq, bħall-injam u l-azzar.
messages.mt_standard: Huma materjali li jinxtraw u jinbiegħu fis-suq, bħall-injam u l-azzar.
messages.zh: 就是在市场上买卖的材料，比如木材和钢材。
messages.en: They are materials bought and sold in the market, such as wood and steel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成市场仓库里的木材和钢材：有材料、有买卖、有商业活动，三幅画面合起来就是“在商业市场上交易的材料”。

gloss_zh: 物质至上的；物质主义的；唯物主义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving great importance to money and possessions, or relating to the philosophical view that reality is fundamentally material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容十分看重金钱和财物的态度；也可指与认为现实在根本上是物质的哲学观点有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti importanza kbira lill-flus u lill-ġid materjali, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-fehma filosofika li r-realtà hija fundamentalment materjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物质至上的，过分看重金钱与财物的；在哲学语境中，也指唯物主义的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqis il-flus u l-ġid materjali bħala importanti ħafna, jew li jirrifletti l-fehma filosofika li r-realtà hija fundamentalment materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person or attitude is materialistic, great importance is placed on money and possessions; in philosophy, the word describes views that regard reality as fundamentally material.

collocations.zh: 物质主义思维；唯物主义思想

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika atteġġjament materjalistiku li jkejjel is-suċċess biss skont il-flus u l-proprjetà.
formal.en: The author criticizes a materialistic attitude that measures success solely by money and property.
formal.zh: 作者批评了一种仅以金钱和财产衡量成功的物质至上态度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għalik, li jkollok ħafna flus huwa l-aktar ħaġa importanti? David: Le, dak ikun ħsieb materjalistiku wisq. Is-saħħa u l-ħbieb huma importanti wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is having lots of money the most important thing to you? David: No, that would be too materialistic a way of thinking. Health and friends matter too.
colloquial.zh: Sara：对你来说，有很多钱是最重要的吗？David：不是，那样想就太物质至上了。健康和朋友也很重要。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalik, li jkollok ħafna flus huwa l-aktar ħaġa importanti?
messages.mt_standard: Għalik, li jkollok ħafna flus huwa l-aktar ħaġa importanti?
messages.zh: 对你来说，有很多钱是最重要的吗？
messages.en: Is having lots of money the most important thing to you?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak ikun ħsieb materjalistiku wisq. Is-saħħa u l-ħbieb huma importanti wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak ikun ħsieb materjalistiku wisq. Is-saħħa u l-ħbieb huma importanti wkoll.
messages.zh: 不是，那样想就太物质至上了。健康和朋友也很重要。
messages.en: No, that would be too materialistic a way of thinking. Health and friends matter too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想一个把成功全换算成钱的人，用这个形容词描述他的态度；遇到哲学文章，再按语境切换为“唯物主义的”。

gloss_zh: 物质主义；物质至上观；唯物主义

teaching_sense.en_definition: The attitude that money and possessions are especially important, or the philosophical view that reality is fundamentally material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把金钱与财物看得特别重要的观念；也指认为现实在根本上是物质的哲学观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni li tagħti importanza kbira lill-flus u lill-ġid materjali, jew fehma filosofika li tqis ir-realtà bħala fundamentalment materjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物质主义、物质至上观，即高度重视金钱和财物的价值取向；在哲学中指唯物主义，即认为现实在根本上是物质的观点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fehma li l-flus u l-ġid materjali għandhom importanza kbira fil-ħajja, jew, fil-filosofija, il-fehma li r-realtà hija fundamentalment materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Materialism is an emphasis on money and possessions, or a philosophical position that regards reality as fundamentally material.

formal.mt: Fil-filosofija, il-materjaliżmu jqis ir-realtà bħala fundamentalment materjali.
formal.en: In philosophy, materialism regards reality as fundamentally material.
formal.zh: 在哲学中，唯物主义认为现实在根本上是物质的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar il-materjaliżmu? Adam: Għax kultant nagħtu wisq importanza lil dak li nixtru u ftit wisq lill-ħin li nqattgħu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we talking about materialism? Adam: Because sometimes we give too much importance to what we buy and too little to the time we spend together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们为什么在谈物质主义？Adam：因为有时候我们太看重买了什么，却不够看重一起度过的时间。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar il-materjaliżmu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar il-materjaliżmu?
messages.zh: 我们为什么在谈物质主义？
messages.en: Why are we talking about materialism?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kultant nagħtu wisq importanza lil dak li nixtru u ftit wisq lill-ħin li nqattgħu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kultant nagħtu wisq importanza lil dak li nixtru u ftit wisq lill-ħin li nqattgħu flimkien.
messages.zh: 因为有时候我们太看重买了什么，却不够看重一起度过的时间。
messages.en: Because sometimes we give too much importance to what we buy and too little to the time we spend together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成一个可以讨论的“观念名称”：日常谈消费时是物质至上观，哲学谈现实本质时是唯物主义；先看语境再选中文义。

gloss_zh: 体态丰腴的；体格敦实的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a full, heavy body or a broad, solid build.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人身体丰满厚实，或体格宽厚敦实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem mimli u tqil, jew statura wiesgħa u soda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体态丰满、较为肥硕的，尤指腹部较丰满。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem mimli u pjuttost oħxon, speċjalment madwar iż-żaqq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A portly person has a full, rather heavy body, especially around the stomach.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体格宽厚敦实的；身躯粗壮结实的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem wiesa', kompatt u sod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A thick-set person has a broad, solid body with a compact build.

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-kittieb jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala raġel matnazz b'wiċċ ferrieħi.
formal.en: In the story, the writer describes the character as a portly man with a cheerful face.
formal.zh: 在故事中，作者把这个人物描写成一位体态丰腴、面容开朗的男子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema wieħed hu zijuk? Mark: Dak ir-raġel matnazz ħdejn il-bieb, bil-ġakketta blu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which one is your uncle? Mark: That thick-set man by the door, wearing the blue jacket.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哪一位是你叔叔？Mark：门旁边那位体格敦实、穿蓝色夹克的男子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema wieħed hu zijuk?
messages.mt_standard: Liema wieħed hu zijuk?
messages.zh: 哪一位是你叔叔？
messages.en: Which one is your uncle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel matnazz ħdejn il-bieb, bil-ġakketta blu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel matnazz ħdejn il-bieb, bil-ġakketta blu.
messages.zh: 门旁边那位体格敦实、穿蓝色夹克的男子。
messages.en: That thick-set man by the door, wearing the blue jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张人物轮廓卡记忆 matnazz：一张突出丰满腹部，对应 portly；一张突出宽厚敦实的身躯，对应 thick-set。共同画面是身体厚实，具体侧重点由语境决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A target that someone tries to hit, or an aim that someone tries to achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人瞄准并尝试击中的靶子，也指努力实现的目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li wieħed jipprova jolqot, jew għan li wieħed jagħmel sforz biex jilħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供射击、射箭或投掷等活动瞄准并击中的靶子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li lejh wieħed jimmira waqt l-isparar, il-qwas jew it-tfigħ, bil-ħsieb li jolqtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A target is an object that you aim at and try to hit during shooting or similar activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过行动或努力希望实现的目的或目标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għan jew riżultat li wieħed jixtieq jilħaq permezz tal-ħidma jew tal-isforz tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aim is a result that you intend to achieve through your actions or efforts.

formal.mt: Il-matra tal-programm hija li kull parteċipant jitgħallem juża l-għodod bażiċi b'mod sigur.
formal.en: The aim of the programme is for every participant to learn to use the basic tools safely.
formal.zh: 该课程的目标是让每位参与者学会安全使用基本工具。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn għandi nimmira? Karl: Lejn iċ-ċentru tal-matra; ipprova tolqtu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I aim? Karl: At the centre of the target; try to hit it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我应该瞄准哪里？卡尔：瞄准靶子中心，试着击中它。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn għandi nimmira?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn għandi nimmira?
messages.zh: 我应该瞄准哪里？
messages.en: Where should I aim?

messages.speaker: Karl (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Lejn iċ-ċentru tal-matra; ipprova tolqtu.
messages.mt_standard: Lejn iċ-ċentru tal-matra; ipprova tolqtu.
messages.zh: 瞄准靶子中心，试着击中它。
messages.en: At the centre of the target; try to hit it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象眼前要击中的靶子，再联想到计划中要实现的目标，用“瞄准同一个终点”串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a surface without a shiny finish, or a colour or appearance that lacks brightness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容表面呈哑光、不显光泽，或颜色与外观缺乏明亮感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi wiċċ mingħajr tleqqija, jew kulur jew dehra li jonqoshom il-qawwa u d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指表面不显光泽、不会形成明显亮光反射的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi wiċċ li ma jleqqx u li ma jirriflettix id-dawl b'mod qawwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A matte surface has a finish that does not look shiny when light falls on it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指颜色或外观暗淡、不鲜亮的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi kulur jew dehra li ma tkunx qawwija, ċara jew mimlija ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dull colour or appearance lacks brightness and does not look vivid or lively.

formal.mt: Għall-qoxra tal-katalgu ntgħażel kartun matt biex jitnaqqas ir-rifless tad-dawl.
formal.en: Matte card was chosen for the catalogue cover to reduce light reflection.
formal.zh: 目录封面选用了哑光卡纸，以减少光线反射。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid il-qafas ileqq jew matt? Ben: Matt, jekk jogħġbok; ma rridx li jleqq ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want the frame glossy or matte? Ben: Matte, please; I don't want it to shine beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想要亮面的相框还是哑光的？本：哑光的，谢谢，我不想让它放在窗边时反光。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid il-qafas ileqq jew matt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid il-qafas ileqq jew matt?
messages.zh: 你想要亮面的相框还是哑光的？
messages.en: Do you want the frame glossy or matte?

messages.speaker: Ben (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Matt, jekk jogħġbok; ma rridx li jleqq ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Matt, jekk jogħġbok; ma rridx li jleqq ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 哑光的，谢谢，我不想让它放在窗边时反光。
messages.en: Matte, please; I don't want it to shine beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可借英语 matte 的相似拼写记忆：表面不发亮是“哑光”，颜色不鲜亮则是“暗淡”。

gloss_zh: 在金枪鱼捕捞中宰杀金枪鱼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kill tuna as part of a tuna-fishing technique.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在金枪鱼捕捞过程中，按相关捕捞方法宰杀金枪鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqtol it-tonn bħala parti minn teknika tas-sajd għat-tonn.

sense_translations.en_definition: To kill, related to Tuna fishing. Tuna fising technique
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指在金枪鱼捕捞中宰杀金枪鱼的动作，与一种金枪鱼捕捞方法有关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Toqtol it-tonn waqt is-sajd, bħala parti minn teknika użata biex jinqabad it-tonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: To perform this action is to kill tuna as part of a technique used in tuna fishing.

collocations.en: 'mattanza' in the context of tuna fishing
collocations.zh: 金枪鱼捕捞语境中的 mattanza

formal.mt: F'dan il-glossarju, il-verb 'mattanza' jirreferi għall-qtil tat-tonn bħala parti minn teknika tas-sajd.
formal.en: In this glossary, the verb 'mattanza' refers to killing tuna as part of a fishing technique.
formal.zh: 在本词汇表中，动词 mattanza 指作为一种捕捞方法组成部分的金枪鱼宰杀动作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'mattanza' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn qed nitkellmu dwar is-sajd għat-tonn; il-kelma tirreferi għall-qtil tat-tonn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'mattanza' mean here? Pawlu: Here we are talking about tuna fishing; the word refers to killing tuna.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 mattanza 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里说的是金枪鱼捕捞，这个词指宰杀金枪鱼。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'mattanza' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'mattanza' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 mattanza 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mattanza' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed nitkellmu dwar is-sajd għat-tonn; il-kelma tirreferi għall-qtil tat-tonn.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed nitkellmu dwar is-sajd għat-tonn; il-kelma tirreferi għall-qtil tat-tonn.
messages.zh: 这里说的是金枪鱼捕捞，这个词指宰杀金枪鱼。
messages.en: Here we are talking about tuna fishing; the word refers to killing tuna.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mattanza 与“捕捞金枪鱼时的宰杀动作”整幅场景一起记忆，特别保留金枪鱼这一语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or quality of being fully developed, including being sensible and responsible in behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充分发展或趋于完善的状态，也指思想、情绪和行为上的成熟稳重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-kwalità li tkun żviluppat sew, inkluża l-ħila li taħseb u taġixxi b'għaqal u responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成熟的状态或程度，尤其指发展充分，或思想与行为稳重、有判断力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni li tkun laħaq żvilupp sħiħ jew li turi għaqal, bilanċ u responsabbiltà fil-ħsieb u fl-imġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Maturity is the state of being fully developed, or the ability to behave sensibly and responsibly.

formal.mt: L-istudenta wriet maturità meta semgħet il-kritika u wieġbet b'rispett.
formal.en: The student showed maturity when she listened to the criticism and responded respectfully.
formal.zh: 这名学生认真听取批评并礼貌回应，表现出了成熟稳重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irnexxielek tibqa' kalm waqt id-diskussjoni? Mark: Ridt nisma' lil kulħadd; naħseb li dik hi parti mill-maturità.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you manage to stay calm during the discussion? Mark: I wanted to listen to everyone; I think that is part of maturity.
colloquial.zh: Maja：讨论时你怎么能一直保持冷静？Mark：我想听听每个人的意见；我觉得这也是成熟的一部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek tibqa' kalm waqt id-diskussjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek tibqa' kalm waqt id-diskussjoni?
messages.zh: 讨论时你怎么能一直保持冷静？
messages.en: How did you manage to stay calm during the discussion?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt nisma' lil kulħadd; naħseb li dik hi parti mill-maturità.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt nisma' lil kulħadd; naħseb li dik hi parti mill-maturità.
messages.zh: 我想听听每个人的意见；我觉得这也是成熟的一部分。
messages.en: I wanted to listen to everyone; I think that is part of maturity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maturità 记成“听完批评再冷静回应”的成熟表现，用具体行为帮助记住这个抽象名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to England or to the English language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与英格兰或英语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ingilterra jew mal-lingwa Ingliża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英格兰的，或与英语有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għall-Ingilterra jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-lingwa Ingliża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as English is connected with England or with the English language.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista ta' kliem, l-aġġettiv 'mazetta' għandu t-tifsira 'Ingliż'.
formal.en: In this vocabulary list, the adjective 'mazetta' has the meaning 'English'.
formal.zh: 在这份词汇表中，形容词 mazetta 的含义是“英格兰的；英语的”。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tifsira għandha 'mazetta' f'din il-lista? David: Hawn tfisser 'Ingliż'; hija mniżżla bħala aġġettiv.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'mazetta' mean in this list? David: Here it means 'English'; it is listed as an adjective.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这份词表里的 mazetta 是什么意思？David：这里的意思是“英格兰的；英语的”，列为形容词。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tifsira għandha 'mazetta' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: X'tifsira għandha 'mazetta' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份词表里的 mazetta 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mazetta' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'Ingliż'; hija mniżżla bħala aġġettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'Ingliż'; hija mniżżla bħala aġġettiv.
messages.zh: 这里的意思是“英格兰的；英语的”，列为形容词。
messages.en: Here it means 'English'; it is listed as an adjective.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张配对卡：正面写 mazetta，背面写 English，并标注“形容词”，把词形、词义和词性一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small pieces or fragments of stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积较小的石头碎块，可统称为碎石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet żgħar tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小块的石头或石头碎片，即碎石。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġebel magħmul minn biċċiet żgħar jew frak tal-ġebel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mazkal consists of small pieces of stone that may be scattered or gathered together.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema neħħew il-mazkal mill-mogħdija biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jgħaddu mingħajr xkiel.
formal.en: The workers removed the small stones from the path so that people could pass without obstruction.
formal.zh: 工人清除了小路上的碎石，让行人能够顺畅通行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Oqgħod attent, hemm il-mazkal mal-art. Toni: Rajtu; se niġbru biex ħadd ma jiżloq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Be careful, there are small stones on the ground. Toni: I saw them; I will gather them up so that nobody slips.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小心，地上有碎石。Toni：我看见了，我会把它们收起来，免得有人滑倒。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent, hemm il-mazkal mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent, hemm il-mazkal mal-art.
messages.zh: 小心，地上有碎石。
messages.en: Be careful, there are small stones on the ground.

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu; se niġbru biex ħadd ma jiżloq.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu; se niġbru biex ħadd ma jiżloq.
messages.zh: 我看见了，我会把它们收起来，免得有人滑倒。
messages.en: I saw them; I will gather them up so that nobody slips.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鞋底踩到一堆细小碎石，把这幅触感鲜明的画面与 mazkal 配对，记住它指小块石头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Broken pieces of stone, brick, or other building material left after damage or demolition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物受损或拆除后留下的碎石、碎砖等瓦砾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet miksura ta' ġebel, briks jew materjal ieħor tal-bini li jibqgħu wara ħsara jew twaqqigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物损毁或拆除后留下的碎石、碎砖等瓦砾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fdalijiet ta' ġebel, briks u materjal ieħor miksur li jibqgħu wara li bini ssirlu ħsara jew jitwaqqa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rubble consists of broken stones, bricks, and other pieces left when a building is damaged or demolished.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema neħħew il-mazkan qabel ma bdew ix-xogħol ta' tiswija.
formal.en: The workers removed the rubble before beginning the repair work.
formal.zh: 工人在开始修缮前清除了瓦砾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn? Mark: Hemm ħafna mazkan fit-triq. Ejja ngħaddu minn naħa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we go through here? Mark: There's a lot of rubble in the road. Let's go another way.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我们不能从这里过去？Mark：路上有很多瓦砾。我们走另一边吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 为什么我们不能从这里过去？
messages.en: Why can't we go through here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħafna mazkan fit-triq. Ejja ngħaddu minn naħa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħafna mazkan fit-triq. Ejja ngħaddu minn naħa oħra.
messages.zh: 路上有很多瓦砾。我们走另一边吧。
messages.en: There's a lot of rubble in the road. Let's go another way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mazkan 与拆楼后满地碎砖的画面相连，再用 munzell ta' mazkan 记住“一堆瓦砾”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insect with a long, slender body and two pairs of long wings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体细长、具有两对长翅的昆虫，即蜻蜓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett b'ġisem twil u rqiq u b'żewġ pari ġwienaħ twal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜻蜓，一种身体细长、具有两对长翅的昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insett li għandu ġisem twil u rqiq u żewġ pari ġwienaħ twal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dragonfly is an insect with a long, slender body and two pairs of long wings.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜻蜓，身体细长并有两对长翅的昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insett b'żewġ pari ġwienaħ twal u b'ġisem twil u rqiq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dragonfly is a flying insect that has a slender body and two pairs of long wings.

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni tal-ġnien, l-istudenti raw mazzarel itir fuq l-għadira.
formal.en: During their observation of the garden, the students saw a dragonfly flying over the pond.
formal.zh: 学生们在观察花园时，看见一只蜻蜓在池塘上方飞行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-mazzarel fuq il-werqa! Pawlu: Rajtu! Għandu ġwienaħ sbieħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that dragonfly on the leaf! Pawlu: I see it! It has really beautiful wings.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看叶子上那只蜻蜓！Pawlu：我看见了！它的翅膀真漂亮。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-mazzarel fuq il-werqa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-mazzarel fuq il-werqa!
messages.zh: 看叶子上那只蜻蜓！
messages.en: Look at that dragonfly on the leaf!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Għandu ġwienaħ sbieħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Għandu ġwienaħ sbieħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 我看见了！它的翅膀真漂亮。
messages.en: I see it! It has really beautiful wings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 mazzarel，就想象池塘边一只细长身体、两对翅膀的蜻蜓，用完整画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sausage made with blood mixed with other ingredients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以血液混合其他配料制成的香肠，即血肠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Zalzett magħmul bid-demm imħallat ma' ingredjenti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 血肠，以动物血混合其他配料制成的香肠。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' zalzett li jsir bid-demm tal-annimali mħallat ma' ingredjenti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Blood sausage is a type of sausage made by combining animal blood with other ingredients.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi porzjon mazzita moqlija servuta mal-ħobż.
formal.en: The menu includes a portion of fried blood sausage served with bread.
formal.zh: 菜单上有一份配面包的煎血肠。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom mazzita llum? Rita: Iva, għandna. Trid porzjon mal-ħobż?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have blood sausage today? Rita: Yes, we do. Would you like a portion with bread?
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们今天有血肠吗？Rita：有。你要一份配面包的吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom mazzita llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom mazzita llum?
messages.zh: 你们今天有血肠吗？
messages.en: Do you have blood sausage today?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna. Trid porzjon mal-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna. Trid porzjon mal-ħobż?
messages.zh: 有。你要一份配面包的吗？
messages.en: Yes, we do. Would you like a portion with bread?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mazzita 放进餐馆点餐场景，记住 porzjon mazzita 是“一份血肠”，用食物画面辅助记忆。

gloss_zh: 什锦水果；混合水果甜点

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mixture of pieces of different fruits, served together as a snack or dessert.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将多种水果切成小块混合在一起，作为点心或甜点食用的什锦水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita ta' biċċiet ta' frott differenti li jittieklu flimkien bħala ikla ħafifa jew deżerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多种水果小块混合而成的什锦水果，可作点心或甜点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deżerta jew ikla ħafifa magħmula minn biċċiet ta' diversi tipi ta' frott imħallta flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fruit cocktail is a mixture of small pieces of different fruits that you eat together as a snack or dessert.

formal.mt: Bħala deżerta, se tiġi servuta maċedonja tal-frott magħmula minn tuffieħ, lanġas u larinġ.
formal.en: A fruit cocktail made with apples, pears and oranges will be served for dessert.
formal.zh: 甜点将供应由苹果、梨和橙子制成的什锦水果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit maċedonja tal-frott? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Poġġili ftit fi skutella.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some fruit cocktail? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. Put some in a bowl for me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想吃点什锦水果吗？Pawlu：想，谢谢。帮我盛一点到碗里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit maċedonja tal-frott?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit maċedonja tal-frott?
messages.zh: 你想吃点什锦水果吗？
messages.en: Would you like some fruit cocktail?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Poġġili ftit fi skutella.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Poġġili ftit fi skutella.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。帮我盛一点到碗里。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Put some in a bowl for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一碗五颜六色的水果块，整组短语对应“什锦水果”；这里的 cocktail 指水果混合食品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supposed use of supernatural powers to cause events, or the performance of tricks that appear to use such powers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为能借助超自然力量使事情发生的魔法，也指以技巧制造类似神奇效果的魔术表演。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-maġija hija l-użu maħsub ta' setgħat sopranaturali biex iseħħu affarijiet, jew l-arti li jsiru trikki li jidhru bħallikieku jużaw dawn is-setgħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔法，指想象中或信仰中运用超自然力量的能力或做法；也指制造神奇假象的魔术。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-maġija tirreferi għal setgħat jew prattiċi meqjusa sopranaturali, kif ukoll għal trikki ta' divertiment li joħolqu dehra ta' ġrajjiet impossibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Magic is the supposed ability to make things happen through supernatural powers, or the art of performing tricks that create a similar impression.

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, it-tifla tuża l-maġija biex tiftaħ bieb li ħadd ma seta' jiftaħ.
formal.en: In the story, the girl uses magic to open a door that nobody could open.
formal.zh: 在这个故事里，小女孩用魔法打开了一扇谁也打不开的门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt it-trikk tal-maġija bil-karti? Mark: Iva! Kif sab il-karta li għażilt?
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the magic trick with the cards? Mark: Yes! How did he find the card I chose?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到那个纸牌魔术了吗？Mark：看到了！他怎么找出我选的那张牌的？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt it-trikk tal-maġija bil-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt it-trikk tal-maġija bil-karti?
messages.zh: 你看到那个纸牌魔术了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the magic trick with the cards?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Kif sab il-karta li għażilt?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Kif sab il-karta li għażilt?
messages.zh: 看到了！他怎么找出我选的那张牌的？
messages.en: Yes! How did he find the card I chose?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maġija 配上两幅画：故事里施法开门，舞台上变出纸牌；分别记住“魔法”和“魔术”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Magic is the use of imagined supernatural powers or entertaining tricks that appear to achieve impossible results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 魔法指想象中的超自然力量，也可指通过技巧制造不可思议效果的魔术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-maġik huwa l-użu ta' setgħat sopranaturali immaġinati jew ta' trikki li jidhru li jagħmlu affarijiet impossibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔法；也指以技巧造成超乎常理效果的魔术。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-maġik huwa setgħa sopranaturali immaġinata jew attività ta' divertiment li tuża trikki biex toħloq effetti li jidhru impossibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Magic involves supernatural powers in imagined situations, or tricks that make apparently impossible things seem to happen.

collocations.zh: 一本关于魔法或魔术的书

formal.mt: Il-librerija organizzat spettaklu tal-maġik għat-tfal u għall-ġenituri tagħhom.
formal.en: The library organized a magic show for children and their parents.
formal.zh: 图书馆为孩子及其家长举办了一场魔术表演。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tara spettaklu tal-maġik miegħi? Toni: Iva! Inħobb nipprova nifhem kif isiru t-trikki.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come and watch a magic show with me? Toni: Yes! I like trying to understand how the tricks are done.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我一起去看魔术表演吗？托尼：想！我喜欢试着弄懂那些魔术是怎么变的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara spettaklu tal-maġik miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara spettaklu tal-maġik miegħi?
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去看魔术表演吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come and watch a magic show with me?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Inħobb nipprova nifhem kif isiru t-trikki.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Inħobb nipprova nifhem kif isiru t-trikki.
messages.zh: 想！我喜欢试着弄懂那些魔术是怎么变的。
messages.en: Yes! I like trying to understand how the tricks are done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maġik 放进“魔术表演”的画面中记忆：它是名词，表示魔法或魔术本身；再与形容词 maġiku 配对练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something magical involves magic or feels unusually wonderful, beautiful, or enchanting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物具有魔力、涉及魔法，或美妙迷人得仿佛有魔法一般。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun maġika meta tkun marbuta mal-maġik jew meta tkun tant sabiħa u speċjali li tqanqal sens ta' għaġeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有魔力的；与魔法有关的；也形容美妙迷人、令人惊叹的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv maġiku jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha x'taqsam mal-maġik jew li tidher sabiħa u meraviljuża b'mod straordinarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something magical is connected with magic or gives you a strong feeling of wonder and delight.

formal.mt: Id-dawl artab ħoloq effett maġiku fil-ġnien waqt il-kunċert.
formal.en: The soft lighting created a magical effect in the garden during the concert.
formal.zh: 音乐会期间，柔和的灯光在花园里营造出魔法般的效果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt il-ġnien bid-dwal mixgħula? Mark: Iva, deher maġiku! Qisna konna f'ħolma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the garden with the lights on? Mark: Yes, it looked magical! It felt as though we were in a dream.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你看到花园亮灯的样子了吗？马克：看到了，简直像有魔法一样！我们仿佛置身梦中。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-ġnien bid-dwal mixgħula?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-ġnien bid-dwal mixgħula?
messages.zh: 你看到花园亮灯的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the garden with the lights on?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, deher maġiku! Qisna konna f'ħolma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, deher maġiku! Qisna konna f'ħolma.
messages.zh: 看到了，简直像有魔法一样！我们仿佛置身梦中。
messages.en: Yes, it looked magical! It felt as though we were in a dream.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一个魔法般的时刻”记住 mument maġiku：maġiku 是描述事物的形容词，可联想到灯光亮起时令人惊叹的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A magistrate is a judicial official who hears cases and makes decisions in court.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 裁判官是在法庭上审理案件并作出司法决定的官员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maġistrat huwa uffiċjal ġudizzjarju li jisma' kawżi u jieħu deċiżjonijiet fil-qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裁判官；在法庭上负责审理案件和作出司法决定的司法官员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maġistrat huwa persuna b'kariga ġudizzjarja li tisma' l-provi u l-argumenti f'kawżi u tieħu deċiżjonijiet skont il-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A magistrate is an official who hears court cases and makes judicial decisions according to the law.

collocations.zh: 在裁判官面前；出庭接受裁判官审理

formal.mt: Il-maġistrat sema' x-xhieda u eżamina d-dokumenti qabel ħa d-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The magistrate heard the witnesses and examined the documents before making the decision.
formal.zh: 裁判官在作出决定前听取了证人的证言并审查了文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jisma' l-kawża għada? Pawlu: Il-maġistrat. L-avukata qaltli nkun il-qorti kmieni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will hear the case tomorrow? Pawlu: The magistrate. The lawyer told me to be at court early.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：明天由谁审理这个案子？保罗：裁判官。律师叫我早点到法院。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jisma' l-kawża għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jisma' l-kawża għada?
messages.zh: 明天由谁审理这个案子？
messages.en: Who will hear the case tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当事人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maġistrat. L-avukata qaltli nkun il-qorti kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maġistrat. L-avukata qaltli nkun il-qorti kmieni.
messages.zh: 裁判官。律师叫我早点到法院。
messages.en: The magistrate. The lawyer told me to be at court early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maġistrat 与“法庭里听证言、看文件、作决定的人”绑定记忆，再用 quddiem il-maġistrat 练习出庭场景。

gloss_zh: 相对多数；票数最多但未必过半

teaching_sense.en_definition: The largest number of votes among competing candidates or groups, without necessarily exceeding half of all votes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在多个候选人或团体中获得最多票数的情况；票数可以不超过总票数的一半。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda fejn kandidat jew grupp jikseb aktar voti minn kull kandidat jew grupp ieħor separatament, mingħajr ma jkun meħtieġ li jikseb aktar minn nofs il-voti kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相对多数，指得票多于其他任何一个竞争者，但不一定超过总票数的一半。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maġġoranza relattiva tinkiseb meta kandidat jew grupp ikollu aktar voti minn kull wieħed mill-kompetituri l-oħra, anki jekk il-voti tiegħu ma jaqbżux nofs it-total.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A candidate or group has a relative majority when it receives more votes than any individual rival, even if it receives no more than half of all votes.

collocations.en: he won with a relative majority

formal.mt: L-ewwel kandidat kiseb 40 fil-mija tal-voti, filwaqt li t-tnejn l-oħra kisbu 35 u 25 fil-mija rispettivament; għalhekk kellu maġġoranza relattiva.
formal.en: The first candidate received 40 percent of the votes, while the other two received 35 and 25 percent respectively; he therefore had a relative majority.
formal.zh: 第一位候选人获得了百分之四十的选票，另外两位分别获得百分之三十五和百分之二十五，因此第一位候选人取得了相对多数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kiseb 40 vot minn mija. Kellu maġġoranza relattiva? Pawlu: Iva, għax iż-żewġ kandidati l-oħra kisbu 35 u 25 vot.
colloquial.en: Maja: He received 40 votes out of a hundred. Did he have a relative majority? Pawlu: Yes, because the other two candidates received 35 and 25 votes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：一百票里他拿了四十票。他算取得相对多数了吗？Pawlu：算，因为另外两位候选人分别只拿了三十五票和二十五票。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kiseb 40 vot minn mija. Kellu maġġoranza relattiva?
messages.mt_standard: Kiseb 40 vot minn mija. Kellu maġġoranza relattiva?
messages.zh: 一百票里他拿了四十票。他算取得相对多数了吗？
messages.en: He received 40 votes out of a hundred. Did he have a relative majority?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax iż-żewġ kandidati l-oħra kisbu 35 u 25 vot.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax iż-żewġ kandidati l-oħra kisbu 35 u 25 vot.
messages.zh: 算，因为另外两位候选人分别只拿了三十五票和二十五票。
messages.en: Yes, because the other two candidates received 35 and 25 votes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住四十、三十五、二十五的票数画面：四十票比每位对手都多，即使不过半，也叫相对多数。

gloss_zh: 磨碎的；擦成细丝的；磨碎的食材

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reduced to small pieces or thin shreds by grating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用擦碎器等工具磨成小颗粒或细丝的，常用来描述食材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sar biċċiet żgħar jew strixxi rqaq permezz ta' ħakk, speċjalment meta jkun ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨碎的；擦成小颗粒或细丝的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun tħakkek sabiex isir biċċiet żgħar jew strixxi rqaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food that is grated has been rubbed against a grater to produce small pieces or thin shreds.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过磨擦处理而成为碎粒或细丝的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magħmul fi frak jew fi strixxi rqaq permezz ta' ħakk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as grated has been reduced to small pieces by rubbing it against a grating surface.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨碎的东西；语境中所指的碎粒状或细丝状食材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel jew materjal li jkun sar frak jew strixxi rqaq permezz ta' ħakk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In noun use, this refers to material or food that has already been reduced to small pieces by grating.

formal.mt: Żid il-ġobon maħkuk mal-għaġin qabel isservih.
formal.en: Add the grated cheese to the pasta before serving it.
formal.zh: 上桌前，把磨碎的奶酪加到意大利面上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ġobon maħkuk fuq l-għaġin? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Agħtini ftit aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some grated cheese on your pasta? Mark: Yes, thanks. Give me a little more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的意大利面上要加点奶酪碎吗？马克：要，谢谢。再给我加一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit ġobon maħkuk fuq l-għaġin?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit ġobon maħkuk fuq l-għaġin?
messages.zh: 你的意大利面上要加点奶酪碎吗？
messages.en: Would you like some grated cheese on your pasta?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Agħtini ftit aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Agħtini ftit aktar.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。再给我加一点。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Give me a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擦碎器下落下一小堆奶酪丝，把 maħkuk 和“已经擦碎的状态”一起记；再用 ġobon maħkuk 巩固搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling surprised by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因遇到意料之外的事情而感到吃惊或惊讶的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss sorpriża minħabba xi ħaġa li ma kienx qed jistenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃惊的；对出乎意料的消息、事件或情况感到惊讶的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ħass sorpriża meta jara, jisma' jew jesperjenza xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are surprised, you feel that something is unexpected and react with a sense of astonishment.

formal.mt: Id-direttur baqa' maħsud meta sar jaf li l-proġett kien tlesta qabel iż-żmien.
formal.en: The director was surprised to learn that the project had been completed ahead of schedule.
formal.zh: 得知项目提前完成，主任感到很惊讶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk maħsud? Mark: Għadni kif sirt naf li rbaħt premju!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so surprised? Mark: I have just found out that I won a prize!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么一脸吃惊？马克：我刚知道自己得奖了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher daqshekk maħsud?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher daqshekk maħsud?
messages.zh: 你怎么一脸吃惊？
messages.en: Why do you look so surprised?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kif sirt naf li rbaħt premju!
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kif sirt naf li rbaħt premju!
messages.zh: 我刚知道自己得奖了！
messages.en: I have just found out that I won a prize!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħsud 配上一张听到意外消息后睁大眼睛的脸；练读 baqa' maħsud，记住“吃惊得愣住”的画面。

gloss_zh: 虚弱、无力或身心受挫的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is broken, powerless, or weak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体虚弱、缺乏力量，或因遭受打击而身心受挫的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun bla saħħa, dgħajfa jew imkissra fiżikament jew moralment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚弱无力者；身体衰弱或精神受到打击、难以支撑的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna dgħajfa jew bla saħħa, jew persuna li tkun imkissra minħabba tbatija jew esperjenza diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In noun use, this describes someone who lacks strength or feels physically or emotionally broken.

collocations.en: the weak person with no strength

formal.mt: Il-maħsus kellu bżonn il-mistrieħ u l-għajnuna biex jerġa' jikseb saħħtu.
formal.en: The weakened person needed rest and assistance to regain his strength.
formal.zh: 这位虚弱者需要休息和帮助，才能恢复体力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħin lill-maħsus iqum mis-siġġu? Mark: Jien ngħinu. Ħallih jieħu l-ħin tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will help the weak man get up from the chair? Mark: I will help him. Let him take his time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来扶那位虚弱的人从椅子上起来？马克：我来扶他。让他慢慢来。

messages.speaker: Maja (照护员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħin lill-maħsus iqum mis-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħin lill-maħsus iqum mis-siġġu?
messages.zh: 谁来扶那位虚弱的人从椅子上起来？
messages.en: Who will help the weak man get up from the chair?

messages.speaker: Mark (照护员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ngħinu. Ħallih jieħu l-ħin tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ngħinu. Ħallih jieħu l-ħin tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我来扶他。让他慢慢来。
messages.en: I will help him. Let him take his time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħsus 想成一位需要扶持和休息的虚弱者；本条按名词记成“无力的人”，与 maħsud“吃惊的”分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person officially chosen to hold a position or perform a duty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经正式指定而担任某个职位或履行某项职责的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna magħżula uffiċjalment biex tokkupa kariga jew twettaq dmir partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获任命者；被正式指定担任某职或执行某项任务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun intgħażlet uffiċjalment għal kariga jew għal xogħol partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In noun use, this refers to someone officially selected to take a position or carry out a particular duty.

formal.mt: Il-maħtur għall-kariga se jibda jaqdi dmirijietu fil-bidu tax-xahar li ġej.
formal.en: The appointee to the position will begin performing his duties at the start of next month.
formal.zh: 该职位的获任命者将于下月初开始履行职责。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iltqajt mal-maħtur il-ġdid? Mark: Iva, dalgħodu. Se jibda magħna nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you met the new appointee? Mark: Yes, this morning. He will start with us on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你见过新获任命的那位了吗？马克：见过，今天早上见的。他星期一开始和我们一起工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iltqajt mal-maħtur il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Iltqajt mal-maħtur il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你见过新获任命的那位了吗？
messages.en: Have you met the new appointee?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dalgħodu. Se jibda magħna nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dalgħodu. Se jibda magħna nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 见过，今天早上见的。他星期一开始和我们一起工作。
messages.en: Yes, this morning. He will start with us on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħtur 和一位拿到任命书、准备上任的人连在一起；本条按名词记作“获任命者”，用 il-maħtur il-ġdid 练习。

gloss_zh: 私人海关仓库；私人仓库

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warehouse used for private storage of goods under customs supervision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供私人经营者使用、存放海关监管货物的仓库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen għall-użu ta' operatur privat fejn tinżamm merkanzija taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供私人经营者使用、存放海关监管货物的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen għall-użu ta' operatur privat fejn il-merkanzija tinżamm taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A private customs warehouse is a warehouse used by a private operator to store goods under customs supervision.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供私人或特定企业使用的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen li jintuża minn persuna privata jew minn impriża partikolari biex jinħażnu oġġetti jew merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A private warehouse is a building used by a private person or a particular business to store goods.

collocations.en: to store goods in a private customs warehouse
collocations.zh: 将货物存放在私人海关仓库

collocations.mt: tittrasporta merkanzija lejn maħżen doganali privat
collocations.en: to transport goods to a private customs warehouse
collocations.zh: 将货物运往私人海关仓库

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija indikat fir-rapport li l-merkanzija kienet maħżuna f'maħżen doganali privat.
formal.en: The company stated in the report that the goods were stored in a private customs warehouse.
formal.zh: 该公司在报告中说明，货物存放在私人海关仓库。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn se nħallu l-merkanzija? Rita: F'maħżen doganali privat; nibgħatlek l-indirizz.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are we going to leave the goods? Rita: In a private customs warehouse; I'll send you the address.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们要把货物放在哪里？Rita：放在私人海关仓库；我会把地址发给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (货运司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se nħallu l-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se nħallu l-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 我们要把货物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to leave the goods?

messages.speaker: Rita (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: F'maħżen doganali privat; nibgħatlek l-indirizz.
messages.mt_standard: F'maħżen doganali privat; nibgħatlek l-indirizz.
messages.zh: 放在私人海关仓库；我会把地址发给你。
messages.en: In a private customs warehouse; I'll send you the address.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组顺序记：maħżen是仓库，doganali表示海关相关，privat表示私人。想象仓库门牌写着“海关监管、私人使用”，帮助记住完整词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warehouse available to different users for storing goods under customs supervision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可供不同使用者存放海关监管货物的公共仓库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen disponibbli għal utenti differenti biex iżommu merkanzija taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供不同使用者存放海关监管货物的公共海关仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen li joffri ħażna ta' merkanzija taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana lil utenti differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public customs warehouse is a warehouse where different users can store goods under customs supervision.

collocations.en: to store goods in a public customs warehouse
collocations.zh: 将货物存放在公共海关仓库

collocations.en: to book space in a public customs warehouse
collocations.zh: 预订公共海关仓库的仓储空间

formal.mt: L-impriża bbukkjat spazju f'maħżen doganali pubbliku għall-ħażna tal-merkanzija tagħha.
formal.en: The business booked space in a public customs warehouse to store its goods.
formal.zh: 该企业在公共海关仓库预订了空间，用于存放其货物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Sibt post għall-merkanzija tagħna? Pawlu: Iva, ibbukkjajt spazju f'maħżen doganali pubbliku.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you find somewhere for our goods? Pawlu: Yes, I booked space in a public customs warehouse.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你找到存放我们货物的地方了吗？Pawlu：找到了，我在公共海关仓库预订了空间。

messages.speaker: Anna (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt post għall-merkanzija tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt post għall-merkanzija tagħna?
messages.zh: 你找到存放我们货物的地方了吗？
messages.en: Did you find somewhere for our goods?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ibbukkjajt spazju f'maħżen doganali pubbliku.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ibbukkjajt spazju f'maħżen doganali pubbliku.
messages.zh: 找到了，我在公共海关仓库预订了空间。
messages.en: Yes, I booked space in a public customs warehouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个词连成画面：maħżen是仓库，doganali提示海关，pubbliku提示公共。想象不同公司的货物分别入库，记住“公共海关仓库”的使用场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warehouse in which goods are stored under a free warehousing arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照自由仓储安排存放货物的仓库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen fejn il-merkanzija tinżamm taħt arranġament ta' ħażna libera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于按照自由仓储安排存放货物的自由仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen użat biex tinżamm merkanzija skont arranġament ta' ħażna libera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A free warehouse is a warehouse used to store goods under a free warehousing arrangement.

collocations.en: to store goods in a free warehouse
collocations.zh: 将货物存放在自由仓库

collocations.en: to transfer goods to a free warehouse
collocations.zh: 将货物转移至自由仓库

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-ħażna jipprevedi li l-merkanzija tinżamm f'maħżen liberu qabel tintbagħat lejn id-destinazzjoni finali.
formal.en: The storage plan provides for the goods to be kept in a free warehouse before being sent to their final destination.
formal.zh: 仓储计划安排将货物先存放在自由仓库，再运往最终目的地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kaxxi fejn se jmorru? Toni: Se neħduhom f'maħżen liberu; l-indirizz qiegħed fuq il-lista.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are the boxes going? Toni: We're taking them to a free warehouse; the address is on the list.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些箱子要送到哪里？Toni：我们会把它们送到自由仓库；地址在清单上。

messages.speaker: Lara (仓库助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kaxxi fejn se jmorru?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kaxxi fejn se jmorru?
messages.zh: 这些箱子要送到哪里？
messages.en: Where are the boxes going?

messages.speaker: Toni (货运司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Se neħduhom f'maħżen liberu; l-indirizz qiegħed fuq il-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Se neħduhom f'maħżen liberu; l-indirizz qiegħed fuq il-lista.
messages.zh: 我们会把它们送到自由仓库；地址在清单上。
messages.en: We're taking them to a free warehouse; the address is on the list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把maħżen liberu作为完整仓储术语记忆：maħżen对应仓库，liberu在这里帮助联想“自由仓储”。想象货物标签写着“自由仓库”，不要将它理解为免费存放。

gloss_zh: 私人仓库；私人海关仓库

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warehouse used by a private person or a particular business to store goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供私人或特定企业存放物品或货物的仓库；也可指私人海关仓库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen għall-ħażna ta' oġġetti jew merkanzija minn persuna privata jew impriża partikolari; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal maħżen doganali privat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供私人经营者使用、存放海关监管货物的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen għall-użu ta' operatur privat fejn il-merkanzija tinżamm taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A private customs warehouse is a warehouse used by a private operator to keep goods under customs supervision.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供私人或特定企业使用、存放物品或货物的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen li jintuża minn persuna privata jew impriża partikolari biex jinżammu oġġetti jew merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A private warehouse is a storage building used by a private person or a particular business for its goods.

collocations.en: to keep stock in a private warehouse
collocations.zh: 将库存存放在私人仓库

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kriet maħżen privat biex iżżomm l-istokk tagħha qrib il-ħanut.
formal.en: The company rented a private warehouse to keep its stock close to the shop.
formal.zh: 该公司租用了私人仓库，以便将库存存放在靠近商店的地方。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għad hemm kaxxi fil-ħanut? David: Le, ħadniehom kollha fil-maħżen privat li krejna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are there still boxes in the shop? David: No, we took them all to the private warehouse we rented.
colloquial.zh: Marta：店里还有箱子吗？David：没有，我们已经把箱子全搬到租来的私人仓库了。

messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm kaxxi fil-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm kaxxi fil-ħanut?
messages.zh: 店里还有箱子吗？
messages.en: Are there still boxes in the shop?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“仓库加私人”记住maħżen privat，想象一家店把库存搬进专用仓库。再记一张海关场景卡：这个词组也有“私人海关仓库”义，阅读时根据上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warehouse where goods are stored under tax supervision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放受税务监管货物的仓库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen fejn jinżammu oġġetti taħt is-superviżjoni tal-awtoritajiet tat-taxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存放受税务监管货物的仓库。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħżen użat biex jinżammu fih oġġetti li jkunu taħt kontroll fiskali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tax warehouse is a place where goods are stored under the supervision of tax authorities.

collocations.zh: 税务监管仓库内的货物

collocations.en: the operator of the tax warehouse
collocations.zh: 税务监管仓库的运营方

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-oġġetti jinsabu f'maħżen tat-taxxa u li l-kwantitajiet ġew irreġistrati.
formal.en: The report indicates that the goods are in a tax warehouse and that the quantities have been recorded.
formal.zh: 报告指出，货物存放于税务监管仓库内，数量已登记。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn qegħdin il-kaxxi? Rita: Għadhom fil-maħżen tat-taxxa. Mark: U min għandu ċ-ċavetta? Rita: Il-persuna responsabbli mill-maħżen.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are the boxes? Rita: They are still in the tax warehouse. Mark: And who has the key? Rita: The person responsible for the warehouse.
colloquial.zh: Mark：箱子在哪里？Rita：还在税务监管仓库里。Mark：那钥匙在谁手里？Rita：在仓库负责人手里。

messages.mt_standard: Il-persuna responsabbli mill-maħżen.
messages.zh: 在仓库负责人手里。
messages.en: The person responsible for the warehouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一幅“仓库门口有税务监管标牌”的画面，记住它指受税务监管的货物仓库。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Written or marked with hurried, untidy handwriting or strokes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用匆忙、凌乱的笔迹或线条写画出来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miktub jew immarkat b'kitba jew b'linji mgħaġġla u mhux puliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被潦草书写或随手涂画的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miktub jew impinġi b'mod mgħaġġel u diżordinat, b'kitba jew b'linji li mhumiex puliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is scribbled is written or drawn quickly with untidy letters or marks.

collocations.en: a message scribbled on a piece of paper

formal.mt: Fuq wara tad-dokument hemm numru maħżuż bil-lapes li diffiċli jinqara.
formal.en: On the back of the document there is a number scribbled in pencil that is difficult to read.
formal.zh: 文件背面有一个用铅笔潦草写下的数字，很难辨认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-isem maħżuż tiegħek? Karl: Iva, ktibtu malajr qabel ħriġt. Maja: Ma nistax naqrah. Karl: Nerġa' niktbu aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this scribbled name yours? Karl: Yes, I wrote it quickly before I went out. Maja: I can't read it. Karl: I'll write it again more clearly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个潦草写下的名字是你的吗？Karl：是的，我出门前匆忙写的。Maja：我看不清。Karl：我再写一遍，写清楚些。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely angry, especially after something has upset or provoked someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到刺激或遇到令人恼火的事情而极其愤怒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab irrabjat ħafna, speċjalment wara xi ħaġa li tkun dejqitu jew ipprovokatu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴怒的；被激怒而极其愤慨的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fi stat ta' rabja kbira minħabba xi ħaġa li tkun dejqitu jew ipprovokatu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is enraged or infuriated, they feel extremely angry about something that has happened.

formal.mt: Wara li sar jaf bl-iżball, il-klijent kien mdagħdagħ u talab spjegazzjoni bil-miktub.
formal.en: After learning about the mistake, the customer was furious and requested a written explanation.
formal.zh: 得知这个错误后，顾客怒不可遏，要求对方作出书面解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark jidher daqshekk mdagħdagħ? Lara: Xi ħadd ħadlu r-rota mingħajr ma staqsieh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Mark look so furious? Lara: Someone took his bike without asking him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 怎么看起来这么愤怒？Lara：有人没问过他就拿走了他的自行车。

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark jidher daqshekk mdagħdagħ?
messages.zh: Mark 怎么看起来这么愤怒？
messages.en: Why does Mark look so furious?

messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd ħadlu r-rota mingħajr ma staqsieh.

messages.en: Someone took his bike without asking him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mdagħdagħ 与一个人得知坏消息后怒不可遏的表情相连，记住它表示强烈愤怒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The mother of someone's husband or wife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配偶的母亲，即丈夫的母亲或妻子的母亲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-omm tar-raġel jew tal-mara li persuna tkun miżżewġa magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配偶的母亲；从妻子的角度称婆婆，从丈夫的角度称岳母。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mdanna ta' persuna hija l-omm tar-raġel jew tal-mara li dik il-persuna tkun miżżewġa magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your mother-in-law is the mother of your husband or wife.

formal.mt: Il-mdanna tiegħi se tattendi ċ-ċerimonja flimkien mal-bqija tal-familja.
formal.en: My mother-in-law will attend the ceremony with the rest of the family.
formal.zh: 我的婆婆或岳母将与其他家人一起出席典礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġej għall-ikel il-Ħadd? Rita: Il-mdanna tiegħi. Se nsajjar xi ħaġa li tħobb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's coming for lunch on Sunday? Rita: My mother-in-law. I'll cook something she likes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：星期天谁来吃午饭？Rita：我婆婆。我会做点她喜欢吃的。

messages.mt_standard: Min ġej għall-ikel il-Ħadd?

messages.en: Who's coming for lunch on Sunday?

teaching_sense.en_definition: Set firmly within or into another material or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牢固嵌入另一种材料或另一个物体内部的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun imdaħħla u mwaħħla sew ġewwa materjal jew oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嵌入其他材料或物体之中并固定在其中的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun mdeffsa meta tkun imdaħħla u mwaħħla sew ġewwa materjal jew oġġett ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is embedded is fixed firmly within another material or object.

collocations.en: a stone embedded in the wall
a piece of glass embedded in the wood
collocations.zh: 嵌在木头里的玻璃碎片

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instabet biċċa metall mdeffsa fil-konkos.
formal.en: During the inspection, a piece of metal was found embedded in the concrete.
formal.zh: 检查期间，发现一块金属嵌在混凝土中。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma tistax toħroġ dik il-ġebla? Lara: Għax hi mdeffsa fil-ħajt. Ma tiċċaqlaqx.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't you get that stone out? Lara: Because it's embedded in the wall. It won't move.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么拿不出那块石头？Lara：因为它嵌在墙里，动不了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verbal form expressing the state of material that has melted and become liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示材料已经熔化并成为液态的动词形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma verbali li tesprimi l-istat ta' materjal li sar likwidu minħabba s-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因受热而熔化、处于液态；本词条按所给词性标为动词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din il-forma tesprimi li materjal ikun sar likwidu minħabba s-sħana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A material described as molten has become liquid because it has been heated.

formal.mt: Il-metall mdewweb jitferra' fil-forma u jitħalla jiksaħ sakemm jibbies.
formal.en: The molten metal is poured into the mould and left to cool until it hardens.
formal.zh: 将熔融金属倒入模具，然后静置冷却，直至凝固。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-metall għadu solidu? Mark: Le, issa mdewweb. Tersaqx qrib, għax jaħraq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that metal still solid? Mark: No, it's molten now. Don't get close, because it's very hot.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那块金属还是固体吗？Mark：不是，现在已经熔化了。别靠近，它非常烫。
