colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nista' niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'mghadda'? Ben: Aħseb fi sponża li tkun qagħdet fl-ilma u tkun xorbitu. Sara: Tajjeb, se norbot il-kelma mal-qagħda tagħha wara li tkun qagħdet fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I remember the meaning of 'mghadda'? Ben: Think of a sponge that has been sitting in water and has soaked it up. Sara: Good, I'll connect the word with its state after it has been sitting in water.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我怎么记住“mghadda”的意思呢？Ben：想象一块在水里泡过、吸了水的海绵。Sara：好，我就把这个词和海绵泡过水后的状态联系起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'mghadda'?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'mghadda'?
messages.zh: 我怎么记住“mghadda”的意思呢？
messages.en: How can I remember the meaning of 'mghadda'?

messages.speaker: Ben (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb fi sponża li tkun qagħdet fl-ilma u tkun xorbitu.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb fi sponża li tkun qagħdet fl-ilma u tkun xorbitu.
messages.zh: 想象一块在水里泡过、吸了水的海绵。
messages.en: Think of a sponge that has been sitting in water and has soaked it up.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se norbot il-kelma mal-qagħda tagħha wara li tkun qagħdet fl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se norbot il-kelma mal-qagħda tagħha wara li tkun qagħdet fl-ilma.
messages.zh: 好，我就把这个词和海绵泡过水后的状态联系起来。
messages.en: Good, I'll connect the word with its state after it has been sitting in water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块海绵在水中浸泡后吸满了水，把注意力放在“已经泡过的状态”。本条按名词记忆这种状态，保留 mghadda 的原有拼写，不用拼写猜测词根或历史。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Creased and no longer smooth because it has been crushed or squeezed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到揉捏或挤压而出现褶皱、不再平整的；本词形用于修饰阴性单数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi ħaġa li tilfet il-wiċċ lixx jew il-forma tagħha għax ġiet magħfusa jew imkemmxa; tintuża ma' nom femminili singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被揉捏或挤压得起皱、变形的，常用于纸张等物品；此处为阴性单数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi ħaġa, bħal karta, li ġiet magħfusa jew imkemmxa u m'għadhiex lixxa jew ċatta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is crumpled has been crushed or squeezed so that it is covered in creases.

formal.mt: Il-folja kienet mgħafġa wisq biex tidħol sew fl-istampatur.
formal.en: The sheet was too crumpled to feed properly into the printer.
formal.zh: 这张纸皱得太厉害，无法正常送入打印机。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nuża din il-karta għall-ittra? Nina: Aħjar tieħu oħra. Din mgħafġa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I use this paper for the letter? Nina: You'd better take another sheet. This one is very crumpled.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我可以用这张纸写信吗？妮娜：你最好另拿一张，这张皱得很厉害。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża din il-karta għall-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża din il-karta għall-ittra?
messages.zh: 我可以用这张纸写信吗？
messages.en: Can I use this paper for the letter?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tieħu oħra. Din mgħafġa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tieħu oħra. Din mgħafġa ħafna.
messages.zh: 你最好另拿一张，这张皱得很厉害。
messages.en: You'd better take another sheet. This one is very crumpled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从口袋里掏出一张皱巴巴的纸，配着画面说 karta mgħafġa；把“纸不平整”的触感和词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a sky covered with clouds or containing a noticeable amount of cloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天空被云层覆盖而显得阴沉，或天气有较多云的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi sema jew temp b'ħafna sħab, li jista' jgħatti s-sema kollu jew parti kbira minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴天的；天空全部或几乎全部被云层覆盖的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi sema mgħotti kollu jew kważi kollu bis-sħab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When the sky is overcast, clouds cover all or nearly all of it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多云的；天空中有较多云的，但不一定完全被云层覆盖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi temp jew sema li fih ħafna sħab, mingħajr ma bilfors ikun mgħotti kollu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If the weather is cloudy, there are many clouds in the sky, though some clear areas may remain.

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni ta' filgħodu, is-sema kien mgħajjeb u x-xemx ma dehritx.
formal.en: During the morning observation, the sky was overcast and the sun was not visible.
formal.zh: 在上午的观测期间，天空阴云密布，看不见太阳。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu t-temp barra? Toni: It-temp mgħajjeb, imma bħalissa mhux qed tagħmel ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's the weather like outside? Toni: It's cloudy, but it isn't raining at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：外面天气怎么样？托尼：多云，不过现在没下雨。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu t-temp barra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu t-temp barra?
messages.zh: 外面天气怎么样？
messages.en: What's the weather like outside?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-temp mgħajjeb, imma bħalissa mhux qed tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: It-temp mgħajjeb, imma bħalissa mhux qed tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.zh: 多云，不过现在没下雨。
messages.en: It's cloudy, but it isn't raining at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一幅天空图分辨两个英语义项：云层铺满天空对应 overcast，天空有较多云对应 cloudy；都可结合 mgħajjeb 记忆。

gloss_zh: 被扼颈窒息的；被勒死的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having had the neck compressed so that breathing was prevented, possibly causing death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颈部受到扼压或勒紧而无法呼吸的，也可指因此死亡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ma setgħetx tieħu n-nifs minħabba pressjoni fuq għonqha, u li setgħet mietet b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扼住或勒紧颈部而窒息的；也可指被勒死的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għonqha ġie magħfus jew issikkat b'mod li ma setgħetx tieħu n-nifs jew mietet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who has been strangled has had their neck squeezed or tightened around so that they could not breathe.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力掐住喉部而无法呼吸的；也可指被掐死的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ġiet maħnuqa bi pressjoni qawwija fuq għonqha, speċjalment bl-idejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who has been throttled has had their throat squeezed, usually by another person's hands, preventing them from breathing.

collocations.zh: 一名遭扼颈窒息的男子

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-rapport tal-investigatur jgħid li r-raġel instab mgħallaq fil-kamra tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the investigator's report states that the man was found strangled in his room.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，调查员的报告称，该男子被发现勒死在自己的房间里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lir-raġel fl-aħħar kapitlu? Mark: Instab mgħallaq, u d-ditektiv għadu qed ifittex min qatlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the man in the last chapter? Mark: He was found strangled, and the detective is still looking for his killer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：上一章里的那个男子怎么了？马克：他被发现遭勒死，侦探还在寻找凶手。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lir-raġel fl-aħħar kapitlu?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lir-raġel fl-aħħar kapitlu?
messages.zh: 上一章里的那个男子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the man in the last chapter?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Instab mgħallaq, u d-ditektiv għadu qed ifittex min qatlu.
messages.mt_standard: Instab mgħallaq, u d-ditektiv għadu qed ifittex min qatlu.
messages.zh: 他被发现遭勒死，侦探还在寻找凶手。
messages.en: He was found strangled, and the detective is still looking for his killer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进侦探小说句子 instab mgħallaq 中记忆，抓住“颈部受压、无法呼吸”的共同语义，再区分英语 strangled 与 throttled 的侧重点。

gloss_zh: 配备好的；已装备的（所给名词标签及“Idk”义项未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry associated with having the necessary equipment; the supplied noun classification does not establish a separate noun meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与具备所需设备有关的词条；所给材料将其标为名词，但未明确独立的名词义。教学例句展示“配备好的、已被装备”的用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata tindika li xi ħaġa għandha t-tagħmir meħtieġ; il-pakkett jimmarkaha bħala nom, iżda ma jiċċarax tifsira nominali distinta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 义项未明确；原始释义“Idk”未提供可确定的词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tikketta 'Idk' fil-pakkett ma tagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira ta' dan is-sens.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label leaves this noun sense unspecified, so its meaning cannot be established from the packet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配备有所需设备的；原包标为名词，但未明确相应的独立名词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika xi ħaġa li għandha t-tagħmir meħtieġ; il-pakkett jagħtiha t-tikketta ta' nom mingħajr ma jiċċara tifsira nominali separata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as equipped has the necessary equipment, although the packet does not clarify a separate noun meaning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被配备或装备；表示某物已经获得所需设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa ngħatat it-tagħmir meħtieġ biex tkun tista' tintuża għal skop partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something has been equipped, it has been provided with the equipment needed for a particular purpose.

collocations.en: a room equipped with a computer

formal.mt: Il-kċina l-ġdida ġiet mgħammra b'forn u friġġ għall-użu tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The new kitchen was equipped with an oven and a refrigerator for students to use.
formal.zh: 新厨房配备了烤箱和冰箱，供学生使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kċina mgħammra tajjeb? Mark: Iva, għandha forn, friġġ u dak kollu li għandna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the kitchen well equipped? Mark: Yes, it has an oven, a refrigerator, and everything we need.
colloquial.zh: Maja：厨房设备齐全吗？Mark：齐全，有烤箱、冰箱，还有我们需要的所有东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kċina mgħammra tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kċina mgħammra tajjeb?
messages.zh: 厨房设备齐全吗？
messages.en: Is the kitchen well equipped?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha forn, friġġ u dak kollu li għandna bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha forn, friġġ u dak kollu li għandna bżonn.
messages.zh: 齐全，有烤箱、冰箱，还有我们需要的所有东西。
messages.en: Yes, it has an oven, a refrigerator, and everything we need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房里的烤箱、冰箱全部配齐，用“kċina mgħammra tajjeb”整块记忆；原包名词义未明，不另造名词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spoon used to measure a specified quantity of an ingredient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于量取指定分量食材的勺子，常用于烹饪或烘焙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħarfa li tintuża biex jitkejjel ammont speċifiku ta' ingredjent waqt it-tisjir jew il-ħami.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 量匙；用于量取规定分量食材的计量勺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mgħarfa magħmula biex tkejjel kwantità speċifika ta' ingredjent, bħal melħ, zokkor jew żejt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A measuring spoon is a spoon used to measure a particular quantity of an ingredient when preparing food.

collocations.en: to measure sugar with a measuring spoon

formal.mt: Uża mgħarfa għall-qies biex tkejjel l-ammont ta' melħ indikat fir-riċetta.
formal.en: Use a measuring spoon to measure the amount of salt specified in the recipe.
formal.zh: 请用量匙量取食谱注明分量的盐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-mgħarfa għall-qies? Pawlu: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn. Tridha għaz-zokkor?
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the measuring spoon? Pawlu: In the drawer beside the oven. Do you need it for the sugar?
colloquial.zh: Lara：量匙在哪里？Pawlu：在烤箱旁边的抽屉里。你要用它量糖吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-mgħarfa għall-qies?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-mgħarfa għall-qies?
messages.zh: 量匙在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the measuring spoon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn. Tridha għaz-zokkor?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn. Tridha għaz-zokkor?
messages.zh: 在烤箱旁边的抽屉里。你要用它量糖吗？
messages.en: In the drawer beside the oven. Do you need it for the sugar?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把量匙想成“每勺都有规定分量”的厨房工具，边想象量糖动作，边整体记住 mgħarfa għall-qies。

gloss_zh: 浸透的；被液体湿透的（如被血浸透）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Soaked through with a liquid, such as blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被液体充分浸湿、浸透，尤其可描述布料等被血液浸透的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa tkun imxarrba għalkollox b'likwidu, bħad-demm, li jkun daħal fil-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被液体浸透、湿透，例如被血液浸透。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li materjal ikun assorba tant likwidu, bħad-demm, li jkun sar imxarrab għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a material is soaked, liquid such as blood has penetrated it and made it thoroughly wet.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jsib drapp mgħargħar bid-demm fuq l-art.
formal.en: In the story, the character finds a cloth soaked with blood on the floor.
formal.zh: 故事中，人物在地板上发现了一块被血浸透的布。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-drapp mgħargħar bl-ilma. Fejn inpoġġih? Toni: Poġġih fil-barmil, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: This cloth is soaked with water. Where should I put it? Toni: Put it in the bucket, please.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这块布被水浸透了。我该把它放在哪里？Toni：请放进桶里。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp mgħargħar bl-ilma. Fejn inpoġġih?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp mgħargħar bl-ilma. Fejn inpoġġih?
messages.zh: 这块布被水浸透了。我该把它放在哪里？
messages.en: This cloth is soaked with water. Where should I put it?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih fil-barmil, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih fil-barmil, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请放进桶里。
messages.en: Put it in the bucket, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块布吸满液体、拿起来仍在滴水，用 mgħargħar 记住“彻底浸透”，再搭配 bid-demm 记“被血浸透”。

gloss_zh: 已获告知的；知悉情况的（所给名词用法未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry meaning informed, describing someone who has received information; its independent noun meaning is not specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人已获告知、已经知悉有关情况；原包标为名词，但没有明确给出独立的名词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ngħata informazzjoni dwar xi ħaġa; il-pakkett jimmarkaha bħala nom, iżda ma jiċċarax tifsira nominali distinta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已获告知、知悉有关情况的；原包标为名词，但独立名词义未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi lil persuna li tkun irċeviet informazzjoni dwar fatt jew sitwazzjoni; l-użu tagħha bħala nom mhuwiex iċċarat fil-pakkett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as informed has received relevant information, although the packet does not clarify a separate noun use.

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ġie mgħarraf bil-bidla fil-ħin tal-laqgħa permezz ta' ittra uffiċjali.
formal.en: The manager was informed of the change in the meeting time by an official letter.
formal.zh: 经理通过正式信函获知了会议时间的变更。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int mgħarraf bil-bidla fil-ħin tal-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, ġejt mgħarraf dalgħodu. Issa tibda fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you been informed of the change in the meeting time? Mark: Yes, I was informed this morning. It now starts at ten.
colloquial.zh: Sara：有人通知你会议时间变了吗？Mark：有，我今天早上收到通知。现在改为十点开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Int mgħarraf bil-bidla fil-ħin tal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Int mgħarraf bil-bidla fil-ħin tal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 有人通知你会议时间变了吗？
messages.en: Have you been informed of the change in the meeting time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġejt mgħarraf dalgħodu. Issa tibda fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġejt mgħarraf dalgħodu. Issa tibda fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 有，我今天早上收到通知。现在改为十点开始。
messages.en: Yes, I was informed this morning. It now starts at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同事递来会议改期通知，你点头表示“已经获知”，把 mgħarraf 与收到消息后的知悉状态联系起来；名词标签保留待明确。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Known to people or recognized by them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们已经知道、了解或能够辨认的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li n-nies diġà jafu bih jew jistgħu jagħrfuh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被人知道、了解或辨认的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa diġà fil-għarfien tan-nies jew li n-nies jistgħu jagħrfuh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is known, people are already aware of it or recognize it.

formal.mt: Dan il-fatt huwa mgħaruf, iżda xorta għandu jiġi spjegat b'mod ċar fir-rapport.
formal.en: This fact is known, but it should still be explained clearly in the report.
formal.zh: 这个事实已为人所知，但仍应在报告中加以清楚说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf min hu dan il-kittieb? Mark: Iva, ismu mgħaruf, imma għadni ma qrajt ebda ktieb tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know who this writer is? Mark: Yes, his name is known, but I haven't read any of his books yet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道这位作家是谁吗？Mark：知道，他的名字我听说过，但我还没读过他的任何一本书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf min hu dan il-kittieb?
messages.mt_standard: Taf min hu dan il-kittieb?
messages.zh: 你知道这位作家是谁吗？
messages.en: Do you know who this writer is?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ismu mgħaruf, imma għadni ma qrajt ebda ktieb tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ismu mgħaruf, imma għadni ma qrajt ebda ktieb tiegħu.
messages.zh: 知道，他的名字我听说过，但我还没读过他的任何一本书。
messages.en: Yes, his name is known, but I haven't read any of his books yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mgħaruf 和“已知事实”搭配记忆：看到 fatt mgħaruf，就想到这个事实已经有人知道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Interest that has been earned and is owed to a person or organization but has not yet been received.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构已经赚取、享有收取权利但尚未实际收到的利息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imgħax li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tkun diġà kisbet id-dritt li tirċievi, iżda li jkun għadu ma tħallasx lilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经赚取但尚未收到、应由他方支付的利息款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont ta' mgħax li jkun dovut lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni u li jkun għadu jrid jiġi riċevut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Interest receivable is interest that a person or organization has earned but has not yet received.

formal.mt: Fi tmiem ix-xahar, il-kumpanija rreġistrat €200 bħala mgħax riċevibbli, għax kienet kisbet id-dritt għal dan l-imgħax iżda kienet għadha ma rċevietx il-ħlas.
formal.en: At the end of the month, the company recorded €200 as interest receivable because it had earned that interest but had not yet received payment.
formal.zh: 月末，公司将200欧元记为应收利息，因为这笔利息已经赚取，但款项尚未收到。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn il-mitejn ewro diġà daħlu fil-kont? Pawlu: Le, għadhom mgħax riċevibbli; se nirċevuhom ix-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have these two hundred euros already reached the account? Pawlu: No, they are still interest receivable; we'll receive them next month.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这两百欧元已经到账了吗？Pawlu：还没有，目前还是应收利息；我们下个月才会收到。

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-mitejn ewro diġà daħlu fil-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-mitejn ewro diġà daħlu fil-kont?
messages.zh: 这两百欧元已经到账了吗？
messages.en: Have these two hundred euros already reached the account?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadhom mgħax riċevibbli; se nirċevuhom ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadhom mgħax riċevibbli; se nirċevuhom ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 还没有，目前还是应收利息；我们下个月才会收到。
messages.en: No, they are still interest receivable; we'll receive them next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mgħax riċevibbli 想成账本上“已经赚到、还没到账”的利息；用“应收”提醒自己款项尚待收取。

gloss_zh: mhuwa（材料列为名词，未提供具体释义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item supplied as a noun under the form mhuwa, without a specified lexical meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中以 mhuwa 形式列出的名词条目；材料未说明其具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mogħtija fil-materjal bħala nom bil-forma mhuwa, mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira lessikali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料仅给出 mhuwa 这一形式并标为名词，未提供可确定的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma elenkata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, iżda li t-tifsira speċifika tagħha mhijiex spjegata hemmhekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry lists mhuwa as a noun but does not explain its lexical meaning.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jelenka l-entrata 'mhuwa' bħala nom, iżda ma jagħtix definizzjoni li tispjega t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The material lists the entry 'mhuwa' as a noun but gives no definition explaining its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将“mhuwa”词条列为名词，但没有给出解释其词义的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'mhuwa' f'din il-lista? Rita: Il-lista tgħid biss li hi nom; ma tispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'mhuwa' mean in this list? Rita: The list only says that it is a noun; it doesn't explain its meaning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份表里的“mhuwa”是什么意思？Rita：表里只说它是名词，没有解释具体词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'mhuwa' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'mhuwa' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份表里的“mhuwa”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mhuwa' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lista tgħid biss li hi nom; ma tispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lista tgħid biss li hi nom; ma tispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 表里只说它是名词，没有解释具体词义。
messages.en: The list only says that it is a noun; it doesn't explain its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mhuwa 做一张“词义待补”卡片：先记住所给拼写和名词标签，具体含义留空，不凭相似形式猜译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not suitable for a particular purpose, activity, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不符合某种用途、活动或情境的要求，因而不适合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx tajjeb jew xieraq għal skop, attività jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因条件或性质不符合要求而不适合某种用途、活动或情境的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkollux il-kwalitajiet jew il-kundizzjoni meħtieġa biex ikun tajjeb għal skop jew attività partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is unfit for a purpose or activity, they do not meet the conditions needed for it.

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal mhux adattat għall-użu barra, għax ma jiflaħx għax-xita.
formal.en: This material is unfit for outdoor use because it cannot withstand rain.
formal.zh: 这种材料不适合在户外使用，因为它经受不住雨淋。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Naraw dan il-film mat-tfal illejla? Lara: Aħjar nagħżlu ieħor; dan mhux adattat għat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we watch this film with the children tonight? Lara: We'd better choose another one; this one is unsuitable for children.
colloquial.zh: Mark：今晚和孩子们一起看这部电影好吗？Lara：我们最好换一部；这部不适合儿童。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Naraw dan il-film mat-tfal illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Naraw dan il-film mat-tfal illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚和孩子们一起看这部电影好吗？
messages.en: Shall we watch this film with the children tonight?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nagħżlu ieħor; dan mhux adattat għat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nagħżlu ieħor; dan mhux adattat għat-tfal.
messages.zh: 我们最好换一部；这部不适合儿童。
messages.en: We'd better choose another one; this one is unsuitable for children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mhux adattat 放进“这件东西不适合这个用途”的句框中记忆，再替换成儿童、户外等具体对象来练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling physically unwell or not in one's usual state of health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体感觉不舒服，或健康状况不如平常的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi raġel jew tifel li ma jkunx qed iħossu tajjeb fiżikament jew li ma jkunx fl-istat ta' saħħa tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体不适的；感觉生病或健康欠佳的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tkun qed tħossha ma tiflaħx jew li saħħitha ma tkunx tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is unwell, they feel ill or are not in their normal state of physical health.

formal.mt: Pawlu mhux f'siktu u għalhekk mhux se jattendi l-laqgħa ta' dalgħodu.
formal.en: Pawlu is unwell and will therefore not attend this morning's meeting.
formal.zh: 保罗身体不适，因此不会参加今天上午的会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark ġej magħna għall-ikel? Nina: Le, illum mhux f'siktu. Se jibqa' d-dar jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Mark coming to eat with us? Nina: No, he's unwell today. He's staying home to rest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克会和我们一起吃饭吗？妮娜：不会，他今天身体不舒服，会留在家里休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ġej magħna għall-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Mark ġej magħna għall-ikel?
messages.zh: 马克会和我们一起吃饭吗？
messages.en: Is Mark coming to eat with us?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum mhux f'siktu. Se jibqa' d-dar jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum mhux f'siktu. Se jibqa' d-dar jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 不会，他今天身体不舒服，会留在家里休息。
messages.en: No, he's unwell today. He's staying home to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Pawlu mhux f'siktu 整句配上“保罗请假在家休息”的画面，记住它表示“他身体不舒服”。

gloss_zh: 不新鲜的；放久变味或变干的

teaching_sense.en_definition: No longer fresh because it has been kept for too long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物因存放较久而失去原有的新鲜口感、味道或质地的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi ikel li tilef il-freskezza, it-togħma jew in-nisġa oriġinali tiegħu għax ilu maħżun għal żmien twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不新鲜的；指食物因放置较久而失去原有风味或口感的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi ikel li m'għadux frisk minħabba li għadda ż-żmien minn meta sar jew infetaħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food that is stale has lost its original freshness or pleasant texture because it has been kept too long.

formal.mt: Il-ħobż mhux frisk u tilef in-nisġa ratba tiegħu wara diversi jiem fil-borża.
formal.en: The bread is stale and has lost its soft texture after several days in the bag.
formal.zh: 面包在袋子里放了几天，已经不新鲜，也失去了原本松软的口感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħobż mhux frisk; sar iebes. Pawlu: Għandek raġun. Se nixtri ħobż frisk għall-kolazzjon.
colloquial.en: Lara: This bread is stale; it's gone hard. Pawlu: You're right. I'll buy fresh bread for breakfast.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这面包不新鲜了，都变硬了。保罗：你说得对。我去买新鲜面包当早餐。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħobż mhux frisk; sar iebes.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħobż mhux frisk; sar iebes.
messages.zh: 这面包不新鲜了，都变硬了。
messages.en: This bread is stale; it's gone hard.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se nixtri ħobż frisk għall-kolazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se nixtri ħobż frisk għall-kolazzjon.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我去买新鲜面包当早餐。
messages.en: You're right. I'll buy fresh bread for breakfast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包放了几天、摸起来变硬：用 ħobż mhux frisk 记“不新鲜的面包”；饼干复数可记 mhux friski。

gloss_zh: 无担保；未以抵押物作保障

teaching_sense.en_definition: The status of a loan or financial obligation that is not backed by collateral.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贷款或其他债务没有抵押物作为偿付保障的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' self jew obbligu finanzjarju li ma jkunx sostnut b'assi bħala garanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无担保状态，指贷款或债务没有以抵押资产保障偿还。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' self jew dejn li għalih ma jitqiegħdu ebda assi bħala garanzija tal-ħlas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unsecured loan or debt is not backed by assets pledged as collateral.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn self garantit b'assi u self mhux garantit.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between loans secured by assets and unsecured loans.
formal.zh: 该报告区分了以资产作担保的贷款和无担保贷款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan is-self mhux garantit? Lara: Iva, m'għandekx bżonn tqiegħed assi bħala garanzija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this loan unsecured? Lara: Yes, you don't need to pledge assets as collateral.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这笔贷款是无担保的吗？拉拉：是的，你不需要拿资产作抵押。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-self mhux garantit?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-self mhux garantit?
messages.zh: 这笔贷款是无担保的吗？
messages.en: Is this loan unsecured?

messages.speaker: Lara (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, m'għandekx bżonn tqiegħed assi bħala garanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, m'għandekx bżonn tqiegħed assi bħala garanzija.
messages.zh: 是的，你不需要拿资产作抵押。
messages.en: Yes, you don't need to pledge assets as collateral.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和“借款时没有抵押物”的画面绑定，搭配 self 一起记住“无担保贷款”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not costing much money and therefore relatively cheap to buy or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购买或使用所需的钱不多，价格不高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jiswiex ħafna flus biex tixtrih jew tużah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不贵的；购买或使用成本较低的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu prezz baxx jew raġonevoli u ma jeħtieġx ħafna flus biex tixtrih jew tużah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is inexpensive costs relatively little money to buy or use.

formal.mt: Il-ktejjeb jirrakkomanda tagħmir mhux għali għall-istudenti li għadhom jibdew.
formal.en: The booklet recommends inexpensive equipment for students who are just starting out.
formal.zh: 这本小册子为刚入门的学生推荐价格不高的设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed infittex rigal mhux għali. Nina: Dan il-ktieb jiswa biss ħames ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm looking for an inexpensive gift. Nina: This book costs only five euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在找一份不贵的礼物。妮娜：这本书只要五欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex rigal mhux għali.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex rigal mhux għali.
messages.zh: 我在找一份不贵的礼物。
messages.en: I'm looking for an inexpensive gift.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb jiswa biss ħames ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb jiswa biss ħames ewro.
messages.zh: 这本书只要五欧元。
messages.en: This book costs only five euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 għali 想到“贵”，前面加上否定词 mhux，就像给高价标签画叉：不贵、买得起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Modest in manner and not trying to seem important or attract attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人谦逊自然，不刻意显示自己的重要性，也不张扬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod modest u ma jipprovax jidher importanti jew jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谦逊低调的；不自视甚高、不摆架子的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jiftaħarx bih innifsu u jittratta lill-oħrajn b'mod sempliċi u modest, mingħajr ma jippretendi li hu aqwa minnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is unassuming behaves modestly and does not try to impress other people.

collocations.zh: 一位不摆架子的领导者

formal.mt: Minkejja s-suċċess tiegħu, id-direttur baqa' bniedem mhux imkabbar li jisma' l-ideat tal-kollegi.
formal.en: Despite his success, the director remained an unassuming person who listens to his colleagues' ideas.
formal.zh: 尽管事业有成，这位主管仍然为人谦逊，愿意倾听同事的想法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sibt lill-maniġer il-ġdid? Pawlu: Huwa mhux imkabbar; qagħad jisma' lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you think of the new manager? Pawlu: He's unassuming; he took the time to listen to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得新经理怎么样？保罗：他很谦逊，专门花时间听了每个人的意见。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt lill-maniġer il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt lill-maniġer il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你觉得新经理怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the new manager?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mhux imkabbar; qagħad jisma' lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mhux imkabbar; qagħad jisma' lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他很谦逊，专门花时间听了每个人的意见。
messages.en: He's unassuming; he took the time to listen to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位有成就却不摆架子的经理，坐下来认真听大家说话，把整组词记成“谦逊低调”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not yet paid, or done without receiving payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指款项尚未付清，也可指工作或活动不提供报酬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għadu ma tħallasx, jew li jsir mingħajr ma jingħata ħlas għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未支付的、未结清的；也指工作没有报酬的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li l-ħlas tiegħu għadu ma sarx, jew li jitwettaq mingħajr ma l-persuna tirċievi flus għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something unpaid has not been paid for, while unpaid work is done without receiving money.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rekords tal-uffiċċju, il-kont ta' Settembru għadu mhux imħallas.
formal.en: According to the office records, the September bill is still unpaid.
formal.zh: 根据办公室的记录，九月份的账单仍未支付。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ix-xogħol huwa mhux imħallas? Mark: Iva, huwa xogħol volontarju ta' sagħtejn fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this work unpaid? Mark: Yes, it's voluntary work for two hours a week.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份工作没有报酬吗？马克：是的，这是每周两小时的志愿工作。

messages.speaker: Lara (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ix-xogħol huwa mhux imħallas?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ix-xogħol huwa mhux imħallas?
messages.zh: 这份工作没有报酬吗？
messages.en: Is this work unpaid?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa xogħol volontarju ta' sagħtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa xogħol volontarju ta' sagħtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，这是每周两小时的志愿工作。
messages.en: Yes, it's voluntary work for two hours a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：账单上没盖付款章是“未支付”，志愿者工作不领工资是“无报酬”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not known or identified, or lacking available information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未被知道、辨明或了解的，或缺乏相关信息的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li n-nies ma jafux min jew x'inhu, jew li ma jkollhomx informazzjoni dwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未知的；身份、性质或相关情况尚不清楚的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għadu ma ġiex identifikat jew li ma jkunx hemm informazzjoni dwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is unknown, people do not know their identity or do not have information about them.

formal.mt: L-awtur ta' dan il-manuskritt għadu mhux magħruf.
formal.en: The author of this manuscript is still unknown.
formal.zh: 这份手稿的作者身份仍不清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma weġibtx it-telefon? | Mark: In-numru mhux magħruf, u kont qed insuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you answer the phone? | Mark: The number is unknown, and I was driving.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么没接电话？ | Mark：是个陌生号码，而且我当时正在开车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma weġibtx it-telefon?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma weġibtx it-telefon?
messages.zh: 你为什么没接电话？
messages.en: Why didn't you answer the phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-numru mhux magħruf, u kont qed insuq.
messages.mt_standard: In-numru mhux magħruf, u kont qed insuq.
messages.zh: 是个陌生号码，而且我当时正在开车。
messages.en: The number is unknown, and I was driving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magħruf 记作“已知的”，前面加表示否定的 mhux，就像给资料卡盖上“未知”印章；用陌生来电号码的画面记住整组表达。

gloss_zh: 未煮够火候的；尚未熟透的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not cooked long enough to reach the required degree of doneness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物烹煮的时间或程度不足，尚未达到所需的熟度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx issajjar għal żmien biżżejjed biex jilħaq il-grad ta' tisjir meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指食物未煮够火候、未达到所需熟度的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun għadu jeħtieġ aktar tisjir għax ma jkunx laħaq il-grad ta' tisjir mixtieq jew meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If food is underdone, it has not been cooked enough to reach the required or desired degree of doneness.

formal.mt: Jekk it-tiġieġ ikun mhux misjur biżżejjed, kompli sajru qabel isservih.
formal.en: If the chicken is undercooked, continue cooking it before serving.
formal.zh: 如果鸡肉尚未熟透，应继续烹煮后再上桌。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-laħam mhux misjur biżżejjed għalija. | Sara: Tridni nħallih ftit ieħor fil-forn?
colloquial.en: Mark: This meat isn't cooked enough for me. | Sara: Would you like me to leave it in the oven a little longer?
colloquial.zh: Mark：这肉对我来说还不够熟。 | Sara：要我把它放在烤箱里再烤一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-laħam mhux misjur biżżejjed għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-laħam mhux misjur biżżejjed għalija.
messages.zh: 这肉对我来说还不够熟。
messages.en: This meat isn't cooked enough for me.

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridni nħallih ftit ieħor fil-forn?
messages.mt_standard: Tridni nħallih ftit ieħor fil-forn?
messages.zh: 要我把它放在烤箱里再烤一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to leave it in the oven a little longer?

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“否定＋煮熟＋足够”来记：mhux 是否定，misjur 在这里表示煮熟，biżżejjed 表示足够；想象切开食物后发现还需要再煮一会儿。

gloss_zh: 意料之外的；未预料到的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening or appearing without having been anticipated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先没有预料到而发生或出现的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri jew jidher mingħajr ma wieħed ikun bassru jew stennieh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未曾预料到的；出乎意料的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed ma jkunx ħaseb minn qabel li kien se jiġri jew jidher.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an event or result is unexpected, you did not think it would happen or turn out that way.

formal.mt: Minħabba tibdil mhux mistenni fl-iskeda, il-laqgħa se ssir għada.
formal.en: Because of an unexpected change to the schedule, the meeting will take place tomorrow.
formal.zh: 由于日程出现了未预料到的变化，会议将于明天举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ġie jżurna llum! | Sara: Kemm hu sabiħ! Dan kien mhux mistenni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu came to visit us today! | Sara: How lovely! That was unexpected.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 今天来看我们了！ | Sara：真好！这可真没想到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ġie jżurna llum!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ġie jżurna llum!
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天来看我们了！
messages.en: Pawlu came to visit us today!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Dan kien mhux mistenni.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Dan kien mhux mistenni.
messages.zh: 真好！这可真没想到。
messages.en: How lovely! That was unexpected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mistenni 和“预料之中”联系起来，加上 mhux 就变成“意料之外”；想象没有提前约好的朋友突然来访，惊喜也可以是 mhux mistenni。

gloss_zh: 非强制的；可自行选择的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Available as a choice rather than required by a rule or obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有规定必须做、可以由个人自行选择是否参与或完成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jista' jagħżel jekk jagħmlux jew le, għax ma jkunx meħtieġ minn regola jew obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可选择的；并非必须参与、完成或采用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitħalla għall-għażla tal-persuna u li mhuwiex meħtieġ li jsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is optional, you can choose whether to do or use it because it is not required.

collocations.zh: 可自行选择是否完成的练习

formal.mt: Dan il-modulu mhux obbligatorju; l-istudenti jistgħu jagħżluh skont l-interessi tagħhom.
formal.en: This module is optional; students may choose it according to their interests.
formal.zh: 本课程单元为选修，学生可根据自己的兴趣选择。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Irrid nagħmel ukoll l-aħħar eżerċizzju? | Anna: Le, dak mhux obbligatorju, imma tista' tagħmlu jekk trid tipprattika aktar.
colloquial.en: Luca: Do I have to do the last exercise too? | Anna: No, that one is optional, but you can do it if you want more practice.
colloquial.zh: Luca：最后一道练习也必须做吗？ | Anna：不用，那道是选做的，不过想多练习的话可以做。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nagħmel ukoll l-aħħar eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nagħmel ukoll l-aħħar eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 最后一道练习也必须做吗？
messages.en: Do I have to do the last exercise too?

messages.speaker: Anna (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak mhux obbligatorju, imma tista' tagħmlu jekk trid tipprattika aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak mhux obbligatorju, imma tista' tagħmlu jekk trid tipprattika aktar.
messages.zh: 不用，那道是选做的，不过想多练习的话可以做。
messages.en: No, that one is optional, but you can do it if you want more practice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 obbligatorju 记成“必须做的”，加上否定词 mhux 就成为“不强制、可选择”；联想作业旁边标着“选做”，做不做由你决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: If something is not dangerous, it is not likely to cause harm in the situation being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事物在所讨论的情境下不容易造成伤害或危险。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li, fis-sitwazzjoni msemmija, x'aktarx ma tikkawżax ħsara jew korriment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安全的；在相关情境下不易造成伤害或危险的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li ma tippreżentax periklu fis-sitwazzjoni li tkun qed tiġi diskussa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is safe, it is unlikely to cause harm in the circumstances being discussed.

collocations.en: a product that is not dangerous
an animal that is not dangerous

formal.mt: Skont l-istruzzjonijiet, dan il-prodott mhux perikoluż meta jintuża kif suppost.
formal.en: According to the instructions, this product is not dangerous when used correctly.
formal.zh: 根据使用说明，本产品在正确使用时没有危险。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-annimal mhux perikoluż? Pawlu: Le, mhux perikoluż, imma aħjar tħallih bi kwietu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Isn't this animal dangerous? Pawlu: No, it isn't dangerous, but it's better to leave it alone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这只动物不危险吗？Pawlu：不，它不危险，不过最好别打扰它。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-annimal mhux perikoluż?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-annimal mhux perikoluż?
messages.zh: 这只动物不危险吗？
messages.en: Isn't this animal dangerous?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, mhux perikoluż, imma aħjar tħallih bi kwietu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, mhux perikoluż, imma aħjar tħallih bi kwietu.
messages.zh: 不，它不危险，不过最好别打扰它。
messages.en: No, it isn't dangerous, but it's better to leave it alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mhux 记作否定提示，把 perikoluż 联系到“危险的”：两部分合起来就是“不危险的”。可用“这个产品正确使用时不危险”的场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: If something is untidy, it is not neat or properly arranged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某处或某物不整洁，物品没有妥善整理或摆放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post jew ħaġa li mhix irranġata sew jew li fiha hemm affarijiet imħawdin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不整洁的；物品摆放杂乱、没有整理好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li mhix f'ordni, bħalma jkun skrivan jew post fejn l-affarijiet ma jkunux irranġati sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a place or object is untidy, its contents are not arranged neatly.

formal.mt: Skrivan mhux pulit jista' jagħmilha aktar diffiċli li ssib id-dokumenti li għandek bżonn.
formal.en: An untidy desk can make it harder to find the documents you need.
formal.zh: 凌乱的书桌会使所需文件更难找到。

colloquial.mt: Marija: L-iskrivan tiegħek mhux pulit illum. Ġanni: Naf, għadni kif spiċċajt naħdem. Issa nirranġah.
colloquial.en: Marija: Your desk is untidy today. Ġanni: I know, I've just finished working. I'll tidy it now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你的书桌今天有点乱。Ġanni：我知道，我刚忙完，现在就整理。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-iskrivan tiegħek mhux pulit illum.
messages.mt_standard: L-iskrivan tiegħek mhux pulit illum.
messages.zh: 你的书桌今天有点乱。
messages.en: Your desk is untidy today.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf, għadni kif spiċċajt naħdem. Issa nirranġah.
messages.mt_standard: Naf, għadni kif spiċċajt naħdem. Issa nirranġah.
messages.zh: 我知道，我刚忙完，现在就整理。
messages.en: I know, I've just finished working. I'll tidy it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书桌上的纸张散成一片：pulit 对应“整洁的”，前面加上表示否定的 mhux，就得到“不整洁的”。本词条用书桌场景记住“凌乱”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: If a demand, decision, or person is unreasonable, they do not show fair or sensible judgment in the circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示要求、决定或人的态度缺乏公平或理性的判断，超出情境下可以合理接受的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi talba, deċiżjoni jew persuna li ma turix ġudizzju ġust jew sens tajjeb fiċ-ċirkostanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不合理的；要求、判断或行为不公平、不合情理的；形容人时也可指不讲道理的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew xi ħaġa li mhix ġusta jew sensata, jew li titlob aktar milli wieħed jista' raġonevolment jaċċetta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is unreasonable, their demands or judgments are unfair or lack good sense.

formal.mt: It-terminu ta' żmien propost mhux raġonevoli, għax ma jħallix biżżejjed żmien biex ix-xogħol jitlesta sew.
formal.en: The proposed time limit is unreasonable because it does not allow enough time for the work to be completed properly.
formal.zh: 所提议的时限不合理，因为它没有留出足够时间来妥善完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Iridu mitt ewro għal din it-tiswija żgħira. Mark: Dan il-prezz mhux raġonevoli. Ejja nistaqsu xi mkien ieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: They want a hundred euros for this small repair. Mark: That price is unreasonable. Let's ask somewhere else.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这么小的维修，他们要收一百欧元。Mark：这个价格不合理。我们去别处问问吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iridu mitt ewro għal din it-tiswija żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Iridu mitt ewro għal din it-tiswija żgħira.
messages.zh: 这么小的维修，他们要收一百欧元。
messages.en: They want a hundred euros for this small repair.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prezz mhux raġonevoli. Ejja nistaqsu xi mkien ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prezz mhux raġonevoli. Ejja nistaqsu xi mkien ieħor.
messages.zh: 这个价格不合理。我们去别处问问吧。
messages.en: That price is unreasonable. Let's ask somewhere else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“维修很小，收费却高得离谱”的画面记忆：raġonevoli 表示“合理的”，加上 mhux 就成为“不合理的”。还可把画面换成无法完成的时限，练习迁移使用。

gloss_zh: 一次性用品；不可退还的物品

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item that is intended to be discarded after use or that cannot be returned to its supplier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指使用后即丢弃的用品，或按供应、销售安排不能退还给供应方的物品；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett maħsub biex jintrema wara l-użu, jew oġġett li ma jistax jingħata lura lill-fornitur, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次性用品；设计为使用后丢弃而非反复使用的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett maħsub biex jintuża darba u mbagħad jintrema minflok jerġa' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disposable is an item designed to be thrown away after a single use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可退还的物品；按相关销售或供应安排，不能交还给卖方或供应方的商品或容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett, prodott jew kontenitur li ma jistax jingħata lura lill-bejjiegħ jew lill-fornitur skont il-kundizzjonijiet tal-bejgħ jew tal-provvista.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-returnable is an item that cannot be returned to the seller or supplier under the applicable terms.

formal.mt: Il-kontenitur mhux ritornabbli u huwa maħsub għal użu wieħed biss; wara l-użu għandu jintrema skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: The container is non-returnable and intended for a single use only; after use, it should be disposed of according to the instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 该容器不可退还，且仅供一次性使用；使用后应按照标签上的说明处理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nġib dan il-kontenitur lura meta jkun vojt? David: Le, dan mhux ritornabbli. Huwa għal użu wieħed biss.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I bring this container back when it's empty? David: No, this one is non-returnable. It's for a single use only.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个容器用空后可以拿回来退还吗？David：不，这个不能退还，而且只能使用一次。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nġib dan il-kontenitur lura meta jkun vojt?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nġib dan il-kontenitur lura meta jkun vojt?
messages.zh: 这个容器用空后可以拿回来退还吗？
messages.en: Can I bring this container back when it's empty?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan mhux ritornabbli. Huwa għal użu wieħed biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan mhux ritornabbli. Huwa għal użu wieħed biss.
messages.zh: 不，这个不能退还，而且只能使用一次。
messages.en: No, this one is non-returnable. It's for a single use only.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象容器上分别贴着“不可退还”和“仅用一次”两张标签，帮助区分本词条的两个名词义项。“不可退还”说明退回安排，“一次性用品”说明使用次数，理解时要看具体语境。

gloss_zh: 一次性用品；不可退回的物品

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item intended for one use rather than repeated use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 只供使用一次、使用后通常丢弃的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett maħsub biex jintuża darba biss u normalment jintrema wara l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次性用品，指使用一次后通常丢弃的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li huwa maħsub għal użu wieħed u li normalment jintrema wara li jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A disposable is an item that is intended to be used once and then thrown away.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可退回的物品，尤指使用后不接受退还的容器或包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett, speċjalment kontenitur jew imballaġġ, li ma jiġix aċċettat lura wara l-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-returnable is an item or container that cannot be returned after use.

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju juża ingwanti mhux riutilizzabbli u jarmihom wara kull użu.
formal.en: The laboratory uses disposable gloves and discards them after each use.
formal.zh: 实验室使用一次性手套，并在每次使用后将其丢弃。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dawn it-tazzi huma mhux riutilizzabbli? Pawlu: Iva, għalhekk aħjar nużaw it-tazzi taċ-ċeramika.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are these cups disposable? Pawlu: Yes, so we'd better use the ceramic cups.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这些杯子是一次性的吗？保罗：是的，所以我们最好用陶瓷杯。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn it-tazzi huma mhux riutilizzabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn it-tazzi huma mhux riutilizzabbli?
messages.zh: 这些杯子是一次性的吗？
messages.en: Are these cups disposable?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk aħjar nużaw it-tazzi taċ-ċeramika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk aħjar nużaw it-tazzi taċ-ċeramika.
messages.zh: 是的，所以我们最好用陶瓷杯。
messages.en: Yes, so we'd better use the ceramic cups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这组表达放进“一次性杯子、一次性手套”的场景记忆；另用“包装不可退回”的场景单独记住第二义，不把不能重复使用和不能退还混为一谈。

gloss_zh: 被认为不够男子气概的；不像男子汉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing behaviour judged to lack qualities traditionally expected of a man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某种行为被认为不符合传统上对男子气概的期待，带有评价性和性别刻板印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi mġiba meqjusa nieqsa mill-kwalitajiet tradizzjonalment mistennija minn raġel, skont ġudizzju jew sterjotip.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不够男子气概的；指按传统性别观念被认为不像男子汉的行为或表现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jitqies li ma jaqbilx mal-imġiba jew mal-kwalitajiet li tradizzjonalment huma mistennija minn raġel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls behaviour unmanly, they believe it lacks qualities traditionally associated with men.

collocations.zh: 被认为缺乏男子气概的态度
被认为不像男子汉的举动

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkritika l-idea li l-biki huwa mġiba mhux ta' raġel.
formal.en: The report criticizes the idea that crying is unmanly behaviour.
formal.zh: 报告批评了把哭泣视为缺乏男子气概的行为这一观念。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taħseb li mhux ta' raġel tibki? Lara: Le, kulħadd jista' jibki meta jkun imdejjaq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you think it's unmanly to cry? Lara: No, anyone can cry when they're upset.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得哭泣不像男子汉吗？拉拉：不觉得，任何人难过时都可以哭。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li mhux ta' raġel tibki?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li mhux ta' raġel tibki?
messages.zh: 你觉得哭泣不像男子汉吗？
messages.en: Do you think it's unmanly to cry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kulħadd jista' jibki meta jkun imdejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kulħadd jista' jibki meta jkun imdejjaq.
messages.zh: 不觉得，任何人难过时都可以哭。
messages.en: No, anyone can cry when they're upset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有人拿男子汉标准评价一种行为”的场景记忆整句；记住它表达说话者的传统期待，不是对男性行为的客观规定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to reject a statement as untrue or dismiss it as nonsense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于否定某种说法，表示“不是真的”，也可用来斥为“胡说”或“无稽之谈”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni użata biex tiċħad stqarrija bħala falza jew biex twarrabha bħala diskors bla sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡说；无稽之谈，用于否定没有事实根据或荒谬的说法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diskors bla sens jew stqarrija mingħajr bażi fil-verità, li wieħed jiċħad b'din l-espressjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to reject something someone has said as false or nonsensical.

formal.mt: L-awtur jiċħad l-għajdut bil-kliem «mhux veru» u jippreżenta l-fatti.
formal.en: The author rejects the rumours with the words 'not true' and presents the facts.
formal.zh: 作者用“不是真的”来否定传言，并列出事实。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qaluli li l-ħanut għalaq għal dejjem. Ġanni: Mhux veru! Kont hemm dalgħodu u kien miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: I was told the shop had closed for good. Ġanni: Nonsense! I was there this morning and it was open.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：有人告诉我那家店永久关门了。詹尼：胡说！我今天早上还去了，店开着呢。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li l-ħanut għalaq għal dejjem.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li l-ħanut għalaq għal dejjem.
messages.zh: 有人告诉我那家店永久关门了。
messages.en: I was told the shop had closed for good.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux veru! Kont hemm dalgħodu u kien miftuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux veru! Kont hemm dalgħodu u kien miftuħ.
messages.zh: 胡说！我今天早上还去了，店开着呢。
messages.en: Nonsense! I was there this morning and it was open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到错误传言时立即说“这不是真的”；语气平和时是否认，语气强烈时可对应“胡说”，把事实判断与说话语气一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing language, behaviour, or material that offends accepted standards of decency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言语、行为或内容不符合公认的得体标准，令人觉得不雅或有失体统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi kliem, imġiba jew materjal li jmur kontra l-istandards aċċettati tad-deċenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不雅的；有伤风化的，指言语、行为或内容违反公认的得体或端庄标准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joffendi s-sens tad-deċenza minħabba kliem, imġiba jew kontenut meqjus oxxen jew mhux rispettabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Language, behaviour, or material is indecent if it offends accepted standards of decency.

formal.mt: Skont ir-regoli tal-iskola, lingwaġġ mhux xieraq fil-klassi mhuwiex aċċettabbli.
formal.en: Under the school rules, indecent language in the classroom is unacceptable.
formal.zh: 根据校规，在课堂上使用不雅言语是不可接受的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-filmat fih kliem mhux xieraq għat-tfal? David: Iva, aħjar nagħżlu filmat ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this video contain language that's inappropriate for children? David: Yes, we'd better choose another video.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个视频里有不适合儿童听的不雅言语吗？戴维：有，我们最好选另一个视频。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-filmat fih kliem mhux xieraq għat-tfal?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-filmat fih kliem mhux xieraq għat-tfal?
messages.zh: 这个视频里有不适合儿童听的不雅言语吗？
messages.en: Does this video contain language that's inappropriate for children?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aħjar nagħżlu filmat ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aħjar nagħżlu filmat ieħor.
messages.zh: 有，我们最好选另一个视频。
messages.en: Yes, we'd better choose another video.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组表达联想到“课堂上的不雅言语”和“不适合儿童的内容”；用场合是否得体来记忆，遇到较强语境时理解为不雅或有伤风化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not expressed or explained precisely enough to be easily understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达或说明不够清楚、具体，使人难以确定其意思的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi kliem jew tagħrif li ma jesprimix it-tifsira b'mod preċiż biżżejjed biex jinftiehem faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含糊的；意思或细节不够明确的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li t-tifsira jew id-dettalji tagħha mhumiex speċifikati biżżejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a statement or description is vague, it does not give enough clear or precise information.

formal.mt: Il-pjan mhux ċar dwar min se jkun responsabbli għal kull attività.
formal.en: The plan is vague about who will be responsible for each activity.
formal.zh: 这份计划没有明确说明各项活动由谁负责。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-messaġġ mhux ċar. Se niltaqgħu fl-erbgħa jew fil-ħamsa? Mark: Se nistaqsi lil Sara biex tikkonferma l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: The message is vague. Are we meeting at four or five? Mark: I'll ask Sara to confirm the time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条信息说得不清楚。我们四点见还是五点见？马克：我会请萨拉确认一下时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-messaġġ mhux ċar. Se niltaqgħu fl-erbgħa jew fil-ħamsa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-messaġġ mhux ċar. Se niltaqgħu fl-erbgħa jew fil-ħamsa?
messages.zh: 这条信息说得不清楚。我们四点见还是五点见？
messages.en: The message is vague. Are we meeting at four or five?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nistaqsi lil Sara biex tikkonferma l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Se nistaqsi lil Sara biex tikkonferma l-ħin.
messages.zh: 我会请萨拉确认一下时间。
messages.en: I'll ask Sara to confirm the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mhux ċar 和一条没写清见面时间的信息联系起来：读完还要追问，就是“含糊、不明确”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing a lack of politeness or consideration towards other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言语或行为缺少应有的礼貌，没有顾及他人感受的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi kliem jew imġiba li ma jurux il-kortesija jew il-konsiderazzjoni mistennija lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失礼的；对他人缺乏礼貌或应有尊重的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna, kliem jew imġiba li ma jurux rispett u manjieri tajbin lejn ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is discourteous, they speak or behave without showing the politeness and respect expected towards others.

formal.mt: L-impjegat uża ton mhux ġentili meta wieġeb il-mistoqsija tal-klijent.
formal.en: The employee used a discourteous tone when answering the customer's question.
formal.zh: 那名员工回答顾客的问题时，语气不礼貌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kumment mhux ġentili. Tista' tgħidha b'aktar rispett? Mark: Għandek raġun. Se nitlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: That comment is discourteous. Can you say it more respectfully? Mark: You're right. I'll apologize.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那句话不礼貌。你能说得更尊重人一些吗？马克：你说得对。我会道歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment mhux ġentili. Tista' tgħidha b'aktar rispett?
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment mhux ġentili. Tista' tgħidha b'aktar rispett?
messages.zh: 那句话不礼貌。你能说得更尊重人一些吗？
messages.en: That comment is discourteous. Can you say it more respectfully?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会道歉。
messages.en: You're right. I'll apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mhux ġentili 配上“说话失礼后需要道歉”的场景，再用 ton mhux ġentili 记住“不礼貌的语气”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sold; transferred to a buyer in exchange for money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经卖出或被出售，指物品以收取金钱为条件转交给买方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa ngħatat lil xerrej bi skambju għal flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖出了；被出售了，指物品已经通过交易转交给买方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li saret bejgħa u li l-oġġett għadda għand ix-xerrej bi skambju għal flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something has been sold, a buyer has obtained it in exchange for money.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb ġie mibjugħ għal għoxrin ewro waqt il-fiera.
formal.en: The book was sold for twenty euros during the fair.
formal.zh: 这本书在展销会上以二十欧元售出。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb għadu għall-bejgħ? Rita: Le, diġà mibjugħ, imma għandi kopja oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this book still for sale? Rita: No, it is already sold, but I have another copy.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书还在出售吗？丽塔：不了，已经卖出了，不过我还有另一本。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb għadu għall-bejgħ?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb għadu għall-bejgħ?
messages.zh: 这本书还在出售吗？
messages.en: Is this book still for sale?

messages.speaker: Rita (书摊摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà mibjugħ, imma għandi kopja oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà mibjugħ, imma għandi kopja oħra.
messages.zh: 不了，已经卖出了，不过我还有另一本。
messages.en: No, it is already sold, but I have another copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书摊上的书贴着“已售出”标签，用 diġà mibjugħ 对应“已经卖出”，把词义和交易完成的场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe something that was constructed, especially a building or structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物已经被建造，尤其用于描述建筑物或其他结构的建成状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li nbniet, speċjalment bini jew struttura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被建造了；已经建成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa, bħal dar jew pont, inbniet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something was built, people constructed it by putting materials together.

formal.mt: Il-pont kien mibni mill-ġebel biex jgħaqqad iż-żewġ naħat tal-wied.
formal.en: The bridge was built of stone to connect the two sides of the valley.
formal.zh: 这座桥用石头建成，用来连接山谷两侧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħajt kien mibni mill-ġebel? Mark: Iva, kien mibni mill-ġebel, bħad-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this wall built of stone? Mark: Yes, it was built of stone, like the house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这堵墙是用石头建的吗？马克：对，和房子一样，都是用石头建的。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħajt kien mibni mill-ġebel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħajt kien mibni mill-ġebel?
messages.zh: 这堵墙是用石头建的吗？
messages.en: Was this wall built of stone?

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien mibni mill-ġebel, bħad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien mibni mill-ġebel, bħad-dar.
messages.zh: 对，和房子一样，都是用石头建的。
messages.en: Yes, it was built of stone, like the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象石块已经垒成一座桥，把 mibni 和“已经建成”的画面相连；用 kien mibni 练习“过去被建造”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small metal object awarded to someone for an achievement, service, or success in a competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因竞赛成绩、个人成就或服务贡献而授予某人的小型金属奖章。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir tal-metall li jingħata lil xi ħadd bħala premju għal kisba, servizz jew suċċess f'kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为表彰成绩、成就或贡献而颁发的奖牌或勋章。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Premju żgħir tal-metall li jingħata bħala rikonoxximent ta' kisba jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A medal is a small metal award given to recognize achievement or service.

formal.mt: L-atleta ngħatat midalja tad-deheb wara li rebħet it-tellieqa.
formal.en: The athlete was awarded a gold medal after winning the race.
formal.zh: 这位运动员赢得比赛后获颁了一枚金牌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irbaħt xi midalja fit-tellieqa? Lara: Iva, irbaħt midalja tal-fidda!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you win a medal in the race? Lara: Yes, I won a silver medal!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在比赛中拿到奖牌了吗？拉拉：拿到了，我赢了一枚银牌！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irbaħt xi midalja fit-tellieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Irbaħt xi midalja fit-tellieqa?
messages.zh: 你在比赛中拿到奖牌了吗？
messages.en: Did you win a medal in the race?

messages.speaker: Lara (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irbaħt midalja tal-fidda!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irbaħt midalja tal-fidda!
messages.zh: 拿到了，我赢了一枚银牌！
messages.en: Yes, I won a silver medal!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 midalja 想成挂在运动员胸前的奖牌，再连读 midalja tad-deheb“金牌”，用领奖画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has suffered a physical injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体受到伤害的人，即伤者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li sofriet ġrieħi jew ħsara fiżika f'ġisimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受伤的人；在本名词义项中指伤者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġarrbet ġrieħi, pereżempju f'inċident jew waqt attività fiżika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun sense, the word refers to a person who has been physically hurt.

collocations.en: assistance is given to the injured person

formal.mt: Il-midrub ittieħed l-isptar wara li ngħata l-ewwel għajnuna fuq il-post.
formal.en: The injured person was taken to hospital after receiving first aid at the scene.
formal.zh: 伤者在现场接受急救后被送往医院。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-midrub? Pawlu: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb; l-infermiera qiegħda miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the injured person? Pawlu: He is next to the door; the nurse is with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：伤者在哪里？保罗：他在门边，护士正陪着他。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-midrub?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-midrub?
messages.zh: 伤者在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the injured person?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (现场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb; l-infermiera qiegħda miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb; l-infermiera qiegħda miegħu.
messages.zh: 他在门边，护士正陪着他。
messages.en: He is next to the door; the nurse is with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 il-midrub 就想象一位正在接受照顾的伤者；本条按名词学习，先记“受伤的人”，再记 midrub gravi“重伤者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied form is given the meaning of being a long distance away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条给定词形的释义为“远”，表示相隔很大的距离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, il-forma 'Miebgheda' tingħata bit-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa li tinsab bogħod, f'distanza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 远；处于较远的位置或相隔很大的距离。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, it-tifsira mogħtija hija li xi ħaġa tinsab f'distanza kbira minn post jew persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is far is a long distance from a particular place or person.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'Miebgheda' tingħata bit-tifsira 'bogħod'; pereżempju, il-villaġġ jinsab bogħod mill-belt.
formal.en: In this list, 'Miebgheda' is given the meaning 'far'; for example, the village is far from the town.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，Miebgheda 的给定释义是“远”；例如，村庄离城镇很远。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'Miebgheda' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawn tfisser 'bogħod', bħal meta ngħidu li d-dar tinsab bogħod mill-iskola.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'Miebgheda' mean in this list? Mark: Here it means 'far', as when we say that the house is far from the school.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份词表里的 Miebgheda 是什么意思？马克：这里是“远”的意思，比如说房子离学校很远。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'Miebgheda' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'Miebgheda' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份词表里的 Miebgheda 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Miebgheda' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'bogħod', bħal meta ngħidu li d-dar tinsab bogħod mill-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'bogħod', bħal meta ngħidu li d-dar tinsab bogħod mill-iskola.
messages.zh: 这里是“远”的意思，比如说房子离学校很远。
messages.en: Here it means 'far', as when we say that the house is far from the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将本条给定的 Miebgheda 与英文 far、中文“远”联成一幅远方村庄的画面；搭配和例句通过 bogħod 练习这一距离概念。

gloss_zh: 和我一起；随身在我这里

teaching_sense.en_definition: With me, expressing someone's company or something being carried by the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人与说话者在一起，或某物由说话者随身携带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika li xi ħadd ikun fil-kumpanija tiegħi jew li xi ħaġa tkun fuq il-persuna tiegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和我一起；在我身边；由我随身携带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li persuna tkun flimkien miegħi jew li oġġett ikun fuq il-persuna tiegħi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use miegħi when someone accompanies you or when you have something with you.

collocations.en: I have my passport with me

formal.mt: Nikkonferma li se nġib id-dokumenti oriġinali miegħi għall-appuntament.
formal.en: I confirm that I will bring the original documents with me to the appointment.
formal.zh: 我确认会在赴约时随身携带文件原件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tiġi miegħi sal-ħanut? Pawlu: Iva, niġi miegħek. Għandi l-flus miegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to come with me to the shop? Pawlu: Yes, I'll come with you. I have money with me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想和我一起去商店吗？保罗：好，我跟你去。我身上带着钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi miegħi sal-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi miegħi sal-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你想和我一起去商店吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come with me to the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi miegħek. Għandi l-flus miegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi miegħek. Għandi l-flus miegħi.
messages.zh: 好，我跟你去。我身上带着钱。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come with you. I have money with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miegħi 记成画面：朋友跟着我走，护照也随身带着；两种情况都围绕“和我在一起”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tend towards something or come close to a particular quality or condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 趋向某种性质或状态，接近达到某种程度；可用于表示言语或行为近乎过分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun aktar qrib ta' kwalità jew stat partikolari, jew juri tendenza lejhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接近某种状态或程度；近乎，濒于。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jersaq qrib stat jew livell partikolari, b'mod li kważi jilħqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something verges on a particular quality or state, it comes close to having that quality or reaching that state.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie osservat li t-ton tal-kumment miel lejn l-insult.
formal.en: The report noted that the tone of the comment verged on being insulting.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该评论的语气近乎侮辱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak li qal miel lejn l-insult. Mark: Naqbel, seta' qalha b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Maja: What he said verged on being insulting. Mark: I agree; he could have said it more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他说的那番话近乎侮辱。马克：我同意，他本来可以说得更尊重人一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li qal miel lejn l-insult.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li qal miel lejn l-insult.
messages.zh: 他说的那番话近乎侮辱。
messages.en: What he said verged on being insulting.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel, seta' qalha b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel, seta' qalha b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 我同意，他本来可以说得更尊重人一些。
messages.en: I agree; he could have said it more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指针逐渐偏向“荒谬”或“侮辱”的区域，用 miel lejn 记住“已经接近那个程度”的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be walking, moving from one place to another on foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在步行，以双脚行走，从一个地方向另一个地方移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun qed jimxi minn post għal ieħor fuq saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走路；步行，以双脚交替迈步前进。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor fuq saqajh billi jagħmel pass wara ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone walks, they move on foot by taking one step after another.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher raġel miexi lejn id-daħla tal-bini.
formal.en: The photograph shows a man walking towards the entrance of the building.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到一名男子正朝大楼入口走去。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn int bħalissa? David: Jien miexi lejn id-dar. Nasal dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you right now? David: I'm walking home. I'll arrive soon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在在哪儿？戴维：我正走路回家，很快就到。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn int bħalissa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn int bħalissa?
messages.zh: 你现在在哪儿？
messages.en: Where are you right now?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien miexi lejn id-dar. Nasal dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Jien miexi lejn id-dar. Nasal dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 我正走路回家，很快就到。
messages.en: I'm walking home. I'll arrive soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miexi 和手机报平安的画面连起来：一边迈步一边说“我正在走回家”，突出行走正在进行。

gloss_zh: 筋疲力尽的；疲惫不堪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely tired and left with very little physical or mental energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因劳累或精神消耗而极度疲惫，几乎没有体力或精力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajjien ħafna u kważi bla saħħa jew enerġija minħabba sforz fiżiku jew mentali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精疲力竭的；体力或精力几乎耗尽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tant għajjien li kważi ma jkun fadallu ebda saħħa jew enerġija biex ikompli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are exhausted, you are extremely tired and have very little energy left.

formal.mt: Wara sigħat twal ta' xogħol fiżiku, il-ħaddiem ħassu mifni u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: After long hours of physical work, the worker felt exhausted and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 经过长时间的体力劳动，那名工人感到精疲力竭，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid toħroġ magħna llejla? Mark: Illum le, jien mifni bix-xogħol. Għandi bżonn norqod.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you want to go out with us tonight? Mark: Not today; I'm worn out by work. I need to sleep.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今晚想和我们一起出去吗？马克：今天不去了，工作把我累坏了。我需要睡觉。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid toħroġ magħna llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid toħroġ magħna llejla?

messages.mt_spoken: Illum le, jien mifni bix-xogħol. Għandi bżonn norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Illum le, jien mifni bix-xogħol. Għandi bżonn norqod.
messages.zh: 今天不去了，工作把我累坏了。我需要睡觉。
messages.en: Not today; I'm worn out by work. I need to sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“电量几乎归零”的画面记 mifni：下班后连出门的力气都没有，表达的是疲惫不堪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have been weaned from milk feeding and introduced to other food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示已经断奶，即已经停止吃奶，转而进食其他食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun waqaf jixrob il-ħalib bħala tarbija u jkun beda jiekol ikel ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已断奶；已经从吃奶过渡到进食其他食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi tarbija jew annimal żgħir li jkun waqaf jitredda' u jkun beda jiekol ikel ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A baby or young animal that has been weaned has stopped feeding on its mother's milk and begun eating other food.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-ħaruf huwa miftum u diġà jiekol ikel solidu.
formal.en: The report indicates that the lamb has been weaned and already eats solid food.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这只羔羊已经断奶，并且已经开始吃固体食物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħaruf għadu jixrob il-ħalib ta' ommu? Pawlu: Le, issa miftum u jiekol waħdu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this lamb still drink its mother's milk? Pawlu: No, it has been weaned now and eats on its own.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这只羔羊还在吃母羊的奶吗？保罗：不吃了，现在已经断奶，能自己吃东西了。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħaruf għadu jixrob il-ħalib ta' ommu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħaruf għadu jixrob il-ħalib ta' ommu?
messages.zh: 这只羔羊还在吃母羊的奶吗？
messages.en: Does this lamb still drink its mother's milk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa miftum u jiekol waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa miftum u jiekol waħdu.
messages.zh: 不吃了，现在已经断奶，能自己吃东西了。
messages.en: No, it has been weaned now and eats on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miftum 和“羔羊离开奶源、开始自己吃食”的画面绑定，记住它表示已经断奶的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to understand something clearly or to think about it in an orderly way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不理解情况或思路不清而感到困惑、混乱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jifhimx sew xi ħaġa jew ma jkunx jista' jaħseb b'mod ċar u ordnat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困惑的；不明白情况或无法理清思路的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun inċert dwar dak li qed jiġri jew li ma jkunx jista' jifhem u jaħseb b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are confused, you cannot understand something clearly or work out what you should think or do.

formal.mt: L-istudent kien mifxul dwar l-istruzzjonijiet u talab spjegazzjoni oħra qabel beda l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The student was confused about the instructions and requested another explanation before starting the exercise.
formal.zh: 这名学生对指示感到困惑，因此在开始练习前请求再作解释。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għadni mifxul. Fejn irrid nikteb ismi? Lara: Hawn fuq, fl-ewwel kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm still confused. Where should I write my name? Lara: Up here, in the first box.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我还是没弄明白。我该在哪里写名字？拉拉：在这上面，第一个框里。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni mifxul. Fejn irrid nikteb ismi?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni mifxul. Fejn irrid nikteb ismi?
messages.zh: 我还是没弄明白。我该在哪里写名字？
messages.en: I'm still confused. Where should I write my name?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fuq, fl-ewwel kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fuq, fl-ewwel kaxxa.
messages.zh: 在这上面，第一个框里。
messages.en: Up here, in the first box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面对一张看不懂的表格，脑中线索打结；用“我很困惑”这幅场景记住 mifxul。

gloss_zh: 企业迁移；企业经营活动迁移

teaching_sense.en_definition: The relocation of companies or their business activities from one place or country to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业或其经营活动从一个地点或国家迁往另一个地点或国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' impriżi jew tal-attivitajiet kummerċjali tagħhom minn post jew pajjiż għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公司迁移，即公司将所在地或经营活动转移到另一地点或国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpanija tittrasferixxi s-sede jew l-attivitajiet tagħha minn post jew pajjiż għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Company migration occurs when a company moves its location or business activities to another place or country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经营活动异地转移，通常指将生产或其他业务迁往另一地区或国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' produzzjoni jew ta' attivitajiet kummerċjali lejn reġjun jew pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delocalisation is the process of moving production or other business activities to a different region or country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公司的异地迁移，即将公司的全部或部分经营活动转移到另一地区或国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment tal-attivitajiet kollha jew ta' parti mill-attivitajiet ta' kumpanija lejn reġjun jew pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The delocalisation of a company involves moving all or part of its business activities to another region or country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业迁移，即企业或其经营活动在不同地点或国家之间转移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċaqliq ta' impriżi jew tal-attivitajiet ekonomiċi tagħhom minn post jew pajjiż għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The migration of undertakings is the movement of business enterprises or their economic activities between locations or countries.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-kawżi tal-migrazzjoni ta' impriżi u l-effetti tagħha fuq l-impjiegi fir-reġjun.
formal.en: The study examines the causes of company migration and its effects on employment in the region.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察企业迁移的原因及其对该地区就业的影响。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jiġifieri migrazzjoni ta' impriżi? Toni: Meta kumpaniji jittrasferixxu n-negozju tagħhom minn post għal ieħor, pereżempju lejn pajjiż ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does company migration mean? Toni: It's when companies move their business from one place to another, for example to another country.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：企业迁移是什么意思？托尼：就是公司把业务从一个地方转移到另一个地方，比如迁往另一个国家。

messages.en: What does company migration mean?

messages.en: It's when companies move their business from one place to another, for example to another country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“企业搬家”的画面记整组词：地图上的公司和业务一起移动，对应 migrazzjoni ta' impriżi。

gloss_zh: 企业迁移；公司迁址或业务外迁

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of companies or their business activities from one location to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公司或其经营活动从一个地点迁往另一个地点的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpaniji jew l-attivitajiet kummerċjali tagħhom jiċċaqilqu minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公司从原所在地迁往另一地点的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kumpanija tittrasferixxi s-sede jew l-operazzjonijiet tagħha minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Company migration occurs when a company moves its base or operations from one location to another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将原在某地开展的经营或生产活动转移到其他地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment ta' attivitajiet kummerċjali jew ta' produzzjoni mill-post fejn kienu jsiru għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delocalisation is the process of moving business or production activities away from their existing location.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一家公司的经营或生产活动从原所在地向其他地区转移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasferiment tal-attivitajiet kummerċjali jew tal-produzzjoni ta' kumpanija mill-post oriġinali tagħhom għal post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The delocalisation of a company involves moving its business or production activities to a different location.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业经营实体从一个地区或国家迁往另一个地区或国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċaqliq ta' impriżi minn reġjun jew pajjiż għal reġjun jew pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The migration of undertakings occurs when business enterprises relocate from one region or country to another.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-effetti tal-migrazzjoni ta' kumpaniji fuq l-impjiegi fir-reġjun.
formal.en: The report examines the effects of company migration on employment in the region.
formal.zh: 该报告考察企业迁移对该地区就业的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tikteb għall-kors? Mark: Qed nikteb dwar il-migrazzjoni ta' kumpaniji u għaliex xi kumpaniji jmorru f'pajjiż ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you writing for the course? Mark: I'm writing about company migration and why some companies move to another country.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在写什么课程作业？马克：我在写企业迁移，以及为什么有些公司会迁往另一个国家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a wounded or injured state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于身体受到伤害或创伤的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi stat li fih persuna tkun ġarrbet ġerħa jew ħsara f'ġisimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于身体受伤、有创伤的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fi stat ta' feriment, b'ġerħa jew bi ħsara fil-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone in this state has suffered a physical injury.

collocations.zh: 被发现时处于受伤状态

formal.mt: Ir-raġel instab migruh ħdejn it-triq u ttieħed l-isptar għall-kura.
formal.en: The man was found wounded beside the road and was taken to hospital for treatment.
formal.zh: 该男子被发现时受了伤，位于路边，随后被送往医院接受治疗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mar l-isptar? Mark: Waqa' bir-rota u spiċċa migruh, iżda issa qed jirkupra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu go to hospital? Mark: He fell off his bicycle and ended up wounded, but he's recovering now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么去医院了？马克：他骑自行车摔倒受伤了，不过现在正在康复。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mar l-isptar?

messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to hospital?

teaching_sense.en_definition: Constructed by putting materials or structural parts together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过组合建筑材料或结构部件而建造完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmula billi jitqiegħdu flimkien materjali jew partijiet strutturali biex tinħoloq struttura.
