sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经通过施工或组装建造完成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magħmula jew imtellgħa permezz ta' xogħol ta' kostruzzjoni u t-tqegħid ta' materjali flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that was built was made by joining materials or structural parts together.

formal.mt: L-iskola kienet miibnija bil-ġebel u kellha bitħa kbira għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The school was built of stone and had a large courtyard for the students.
formal.zh: 这所学校由石头建成，并设有供学生使用的大庭院。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din id-dar kienet miibnija bil-ġebel? Mark: Iva, u n-nannu jgħid li l-ħitan tagħha huma ħoxnin ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this house built of stone? Mark: Yes, and Grandpa says its walls are very thick.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这座房子是用石头建成的吗？马克：是的，而且爷爷说它的墙非常厚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-dar kienet miibnija bil-ġebel?
messages.mt_standard: Din id-dar kienet miibnija bil-ġebel?
messages.zh: 这座房子是用石头建成的吗？
messages.en: Was this house built of stone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u n-nannu jgħid li l-ħitan tagħha huma ħoxnin ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u n-nannu jgħid li l-ħitan tagħha huma ħoxnin ħafna.
messages.zh: 是的，而且爷爷说它的墙非常厚。
messages.en: Yes, and Grandpa says its walls are very thick.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象石块一层层垒成一座完整房屋，把“材料组合后已经建成”的画面与这个词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling anxious or troubled about something that may happen or go wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因担心某事可能发生或出现问题而感到不安的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss tħassib jew ansjetà dwar xi ħaġa li tista' tiġri jew tmur ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某件事情或可能出现的不利情况而担忧、不安的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun imħasseb u ma jħossux kwiet minħabba problema jew xi ħaġa li jibża' li tista' sseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is worried, they feel anxious about a problem or an uncertain outcome.

formal.mt: L-istudent kien mikdud dwar ir-riżultat tal-eżami u talab lill-għalliem għal parir.
formal.en: The student was worried about the exam result and asked the teacher for advice.
formal.zh: 这名学生担心考试结果，便向老师寻求建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tidher mikdud illum? Mark: Għandi eżami għada u nibża' li ma niftakarx kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look worried today? Mark: I have an exam tomorrow, and I'm afraid I won't remember everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天为什么看起来忧心忡忡的？马克：我明天有考试，担心自己记不住所有内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tidher mikdud illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tidher mikdud illum?
messages.zh: 你今天为什么看起来忧心忡忡的？
messages.en: Why do you look worried today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi eżami għada u nibża' li ma niftakarx kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi eżami għada u nibża' li ma niftakarx kollox.
messages.zh: 我明天有考试，担心自己记不住所有内容。
messages.en: I have an exam tomorrow, and I'm afraid I won't remember everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象考试前皱着眉头反复翻书的人，用“心里放不下，所以很担忧”的情景记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Microorganisms are living things so small that a microscope is usually needed to see them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微生物，指通常需要借助显微镜才能看见的微小生物；本词是复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejjaq tant żgħar li normalment ikun meħtieġ mikroskopju biex tarahom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微生物（复数），指体积极小、通常需要用显微镜观察的生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organiżmi żgħar ħafna li normalment ma jkunux jidhru mingħajr mikroskopju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Microorganisms are extremely small living things that usually cannot be seen without a microscope.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw kampjun ta' ilma taħt il-mikroskopju biex ifittxu mikro-organizmi.
formal.en: The students observed a water sample under the microscope to look for microorganisms.
formal.zh: 学生们用显微镜观察一份水样，寻找其中的微生物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm mikro-organizmi fil-ħamrija? Ġużeppi: Iva, u ħafna minnhom jgħinu biex jitkisser il-materjal organiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are there microorganisms in the soil? Ġużeppi: Yes, and many of them help break down organic material.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：土壤里有微生物吗？朱塞佩：有，而且其中很多能帮助分解有机物。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm mikro-organizmi fil-ħamrija?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm mikro-organizmi fil-ħamrija?
messages.zh: 土壤里有微生物吗？
messages.en: Are there microorganisms in the soil?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħafna minnhom jgħinu biex jitkisser il-materjal organiku.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħafna minnhom jgħinu biex jitkisser il-materjal organiku.
messages.zh: 有，而且其中很多能帮助分解有机物。
messages.en: Yes, and many of them help break down organic material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象显微镜视野里有许多小生命，把 mikro-organizmi 整体记成复数“微生物”，并搭配 tarahom“看见它们”练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A microbe is a very small organism; when described as a germ, it is associated with causing disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微生物，指极其微小的生物；用于“病菌”义时，强调其可能引起疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organiżmu żgħir ħafna; meta l-kelma tintuża fis-sens ta' ġerm, tirreferi għal wieħed li jista' jikkawża l-mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 病菌，指可能引起疾病的微生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organiżmu żgħir ħafna li jista' jikkawża l-mard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A germ is a very small organism that can cause disease.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微生物，指通常需要借助显微镜才能看见的微小生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organiżmu tant żgħir li normalment ikun meħtieġ mikroskopju biex tarah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A microbe is a very small organism that you usually need a microscope to see.

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema spjegat li mhux kull mikrobu jikkawża l-mard.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher explained that not every microbe causes disease.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师解释说，并非每一种微生物都会引起疾病。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nista' nara mikrobu mingħajr mikroskopju? Pawlu: Ġeneralment le, għax ikun żgħir wisq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can I see a microbe without a microscope? Pawlu: Generally not, because it is too small.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：不用显微镜能看见微生物吗？保罗：一般不能，因为它太小了。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nara mikrobu mingħajr mikroskopju?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nara mikrobu mingħajr mikroskopju?
messages.zh: 不用显微镜能看见微生物吗？
messages.en: Can I see a microbe without a microscope?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġeneralment le, għax ikun żgħir wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Ġeneralment le, għax ikun żgħir wisq.
messages.zh: 一般不能，因为它太小了。
messages.en: Generally not, because it is too small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mikrobu 配上一张显微镜观察卡：先记“微生物”，遇到致病语境再理解为“病菌”。

gloss_zh: 显微的；微小到需用显微镜观察的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something microscopic is so small that you need a microscope to see it clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体极其微小，需要借助显微镜才能清楚看见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa tant żgħira li jkun meħtieġ mikroskopju biex taraha sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显微的；小到需要借助显微镜才能清楚观察的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tant żgħir li ma jkunx jidher sew mingħajr l-għajnuna ta' mikroskopju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is microscopic is too small to be seen clearly without a microscope.

collocations.zh: 微小到需用显微镜观察的生物
显微镜下才能看清的细节

formal.mt: L-istudent uża mikroskopju biex josserva organiżmu mikroskopiku fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The student used a microscope to observe a microscopic organism in the sample.
formal.zh: 这名学生用显微镜观察样本中的一种微小生物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma nistax nara dan l-organiżmu? Mark: Għax hu mikroskopiku. Ħares mill-mikroskopju u tarah.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why can't I see this organism? Mark: Because it is microscopic. Look through the microscope and you will see it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我为什么看不见这个生物？马克：因为它微小到需要用显微镜看。透过显微镜看，你就能看见了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nara dan l-organiżmu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nara dan l-organiżmu?
messages.zh: 我为什么看不见这个生物？
messages.en: Why can't I see this organism?

messages.speaker: Mark (实验课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu mikroskopiku. Ħares mill-mikroskopju u tarah.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu mikroskopiku. Ħares mill-mikroskopju u tarah.
messages.zh: 因为它微小到需要用显微镜看。透过显微镜看，你就能看见了。
messages.en: Because it is microscopic. Look through the microscope and you will see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“肉眼看不清，显微镜里看”这幅画面记 mikroskopiku，并整组朗读 organiżmu mikroskopiku。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is coated or covered has a layer of another substance or material over its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示物体表面涂有、裹有或覆盖着一层其他物质的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha saff ta' sustanza jew materjal ieħor fuq il-wiċċ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂有一层的；被某种物质覆盖或包裹的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu saff ta' xi sustanza jew materjal fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu, jew li hu mgħotti b'xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is coated or covered, a layer of another substance or material lies over its surface.

formal.mt: Il-pannell tal-injam huwa miksi b'saff protettiv biex il-wiċċ tiegħu ma ssirlux ħsara.
formal.en: The wooden panel is coated with a protective layer to prevent damage to its surface.
formal.zh: 这块木板涂有一层保护涂层，以防表面受损。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-gallettin miksi biċ-ċikkulata? Toni: Iva, u hemm ieħor mingħajr ċikkulata jekk tippreferi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this biscuit coated in chocolate? Toni: Yes, and there is another one without chocolate if you prefer.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块饼干裹着巧克力吗？托尼：是的，如果你更喜欢，也有一块不带巧克力的。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-gallettin miksi biċ-ċikkulata?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-gallettin miksi biċ-ċikkulata?
messages.zh: 这块饼干裹着巧克力吗？
messages.en: Is this biscuit coated in chocolate?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u hemm ieħor mingħajr ċikkulata jekk tippreferi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u hemm ieħor mingħajr ċikkulata jekk tippreferi.
messages.zh: 是的，如果你更喜欢，也有一块不带巧克力的。
messages.en: Yes, and there is another one without chocolate if you prefer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miksi 想成物体表面“披了一层”：饼干披巧克力，旧物蒙灰尘，都突出表面被覆盖的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose lexical meaning remains unspecified in this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条中尚未确定具体词义的名词；不应把“no idea”直接当作该词的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira lessikali tiegħu għadha mhijiex stabbilita f'din l-entrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义尚不明确；此处无法据此确定该名词具体指什么。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom għadha mhijiex magħrufa biżżejjed biex tingħata definizzjoni preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun has not been established, so a specific lexical interpretation cannot be taught reliably.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tan-nom 'miksura' trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma nagħtu eżempju tal-użu tiegħu.
formal.en: The meaning of the noun 'miksura' must be clarified before we provide an example of its use.
formal.zh: 在提供名词“miksura”的用法例句之前，必须先明确其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser in-nom 'miksura'? Mark: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawh.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the noun 'miksura' mean? Mark: I don't know yet. Let's clarify its meaning before using it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：名词“miksura”是什么意思？马克：我还不知道。我们先弄清词义再使用它吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser in-nom 'miksura'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser in-nom 'miksura'?
messages.zh: 名词“miksura”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the noun 'miksura' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawh.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们先弄清词义再使用它吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's clarify its meaning before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把此词先放进“待确认词义”卡片：记住拼写和名词标签，不把英语备注“no idea”背成词义。

gloss_zh: 写下的；已登记、已入册的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Written down, or entered on a list or register as enrolled or enlisted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指内容已经写下，或某人的姓名已经登记入册，表示其已报名、注册或入伍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie espress bil-kitba, jew li ddaħħal f'lista jew reġistru bħala persuna rreġistrata jew rekluta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已写下的；已报名或注册的；已登记入伍的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab imniżżel bil-kitba, jew li ġie rreġistrat f'lista ta' studenti, parteċipanti jew rekluti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as miktub is recorded in writing, while a person so described is enrolled or enlisted on a relevant register.

collocations.zh: 写在名单上的；已列入名单的

formal.mt: L-isem tal-parteċipant huwa miktub fir-reġistru tal-kors, u l-indirizz tiegħu huwa miktub fuq il-formola.
formal.en: The participant's name is entered in the course register, and his address is written on the form.
formal.zh: 该参加者的姓名已登记在课程名册中，其地址也已写在表格上。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ismi miktub fil-lista tal-kors? Mark: Iva, hawn qiegħed. In-numru tiegħek ukoll miktub ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is my name on the course list? Mark: Yes, here it is. Your number is written next to it too.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我的名字在课程名单上吗？马克：在，就在这里。你的号码也写在旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ismi miktub fil-lista tal-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Ismi miktub fil-lista tal-kors?
messages.zh: 我的名字在课程名单上吗？
messages.en: Is my name on the course list?

messages.speaker: Mark (课程工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn qiegħed. In-numru tiegħek ukoll miktub ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn qiegħed. In-numru tiegħek ukoll miktub ħdejh.
messages.zh: 在，就在这里。你的号码也写在旁边。
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Your number is written next to it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象纸上写着一句话，名单上写着一个名字：前者帮助记“写下”，后者帮助记“登记入册”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Openly apparent rather than concealed, or physically left without a cover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指行为、态度等公开显露、毫不掩饰，或指物体没有遮盖、处于裸露状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher jew jintwera bla ħabi, jew li ma jkunx mgħotti b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开显露的；不加掩饰的，尤指行为、态度或意图。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsir jew jintwera b'mod ċar u bla ħabi, bħalma jiġri fil-każ ta' aġir jew intenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An overt action or attitude is expressed openly, so other people can readily recognize it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未被遮盖的；裸露在外的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkollux għata jew xi ħaġa oħra fuqu biex tgħattih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is uncovered has no covering over it and is therefore exposed to view or contact.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kliem tiegħu bħala theddid mikxuf kontra l-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report describes his words as overt threats against the workers.
formal.zh: 报告将他的话描述为针对工人的公然威胁。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex ħallejt l-ikel mikxuf? Mark: Għadni kemm lestejt. Issa ngħattih.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did you leave the food uncovered? Mark: I've only just finished. I'll cover it now.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你怎么把食物敞着没盖？马克：我刚弄好，现在就盖上。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt l-ikel mikxuf?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt l-ikel mikxuf?
messages.zh: 你怎么把食物敞着没盖？
messages.en: Why did you leave the food uncovered?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kemm lestejt. Issa ngħattih.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kemm lestejt. Issa ngħattih.
messages.zh: 我刚弄好，现在就盖上。
messages.en: I've only just finished. I'll cover it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“无遮掩”串联两幅画面：食物没有盖子是具体裸露，威胁毫不隐藏是公开显露。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Milan, a city in Italy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 米兰，意大利的一座城市；作为城市名称使用的专有名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt ta' Milan fl-Italja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 米兰，意大利城市名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Belt fl-Italja li hija magħrufa bl-isem Milan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Milan is an Italian city whose name is used when referring to that particular place.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti se jivvjaġġaw lejn Milan għalaqgħa u se joqogħdu f'lukanda qrib iċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The participants will travel to Milan for the meeting and stay in a hotel near the centre.
formal.zh: 参加者将前往米兰开会，并入住市中心附近的一家酒店。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Meta sejjer Milan? Mark: Nhar il-Ġimgħa. Se noqgħod hemm għal jumejn.
colloquial.en: Lina: When are you going to Milan? Mark: On Friday. I'll stay there for two days.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你什么时候去米兰？马克：星期五。我会在那里待两天。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta sejjer Milan?
messages.mt_standard: Meta sejjer Milan?
messages.zh: 你什么时候去米兰？
messages.en: When are you going to Milan?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar il-Ġimgħa. Se noqgħod hemm għal jumejn.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar il-Ġimgħa. Se noqgħod hemm għal jumejn.
messages.zh: 星期五。我会在那里待两天。
messages.en: On Friday. I'll stay there for two days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Milan 和地图上的“米兰”配成一张卡：再用 lejn Milan 记“去米兰”，用 f'Milan 记“在米兰”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The regular rise and fall of sea level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海水水位有规律地上升和下降的现象，即涨潮与退潮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidla regolari fil-livell tal-baħar meta l-ilma jogħla u jinżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潮汐，即海水水位周期性升降的现象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment regolari tal-baħar li bih il-livell tal-ilma jogħla u jinżel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The tide is the regular rise and fall of the level of the sea.

collocations.en: the rise and fall of the tide

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-mili u t-tifrigħ tal-baħar u rreġistraw il-bidliet fil-livell tal-ilma.
formal.en: The students observed the tides and recorded changes in the water level.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了海水的潮汐，并记录了水位变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawn il-blat kienu taħt l-ilma dalgħodu u issa jidhru? Pawlu: Minħabba l-mili u t-tifrigħ tal-baħar; issa l-livell tal-ilma niżel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why were these rocks underwater this morning, but visible now? Pawlu: Because of the tides; the water level has now fallen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这些岩石早上还在水下，现在却露出来了？保罗：因为潮汐，现在水位下降了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dawn il-blat kienu taħt l-ilma dalgħodu u issa jidhru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dawn il-blat kienu taħt l-ilma dalgħodu u issa jidhru?
messages.zh: 为什么这些岩石早上还在水下，现在却露出来了？
messages.en: Why were these rocks underwater this morning, but visible now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-mili u t-tifrigħ tal-baħar; issa l-livell tal-ilma niżel.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-mili u t-tifrigħ tal-baħar; issa l-livell tal-ilma niżel.
messages.zh: 因为潮汐，现在水位下降了。
messages.en: Because of the tides; the water level has now fallen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上岸边水位一升一降的画面，成对记住“涨潮与退潮”，就能联想到潮汐。

gloss_zh: 水飞蓟（一种带刺的植物）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A prickly plant with purple flowers and leaves marked with white.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带刺的植物，开紫色花，叶片上有白色斑纹，中文称水飞蓟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tax-xewk bi fjuri vjola u weraq b'marki bojod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水飞蓟，一种开紫色花、叶片有白色斑纹的带刺植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li għandha x-xewk, fjuri vjola u marki bojod fuq il-weraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Milk thistle is a prickly plant with purple flowers and distinctive white markings on its leaves.

collocations.en: the leaves of the milk thistle plant
the seeds of the milk thistle plant

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenta ddeskriviet il-fjuri vjola u l-marki bojod fuq il-weraq tal-pjanta Milkthistle.
formal.en: In the report, the student described the purple flowers and white markings on the leaves of the milk thistle plant.
formal.zh: 这名学生在报告中描述了水飞蓟的紫色花朵及其叶片上的白色斑纹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din il-pjanta bil-fjuri vjola? Nina: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Milkthistle. Ara l-marki bojod fuq il-weraq!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this plant with purple flowers? Nina: The label says Milkthistle. Look at the white markings on the leaves!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株开紫色花的是什么植物？妮娜：标签上写着 Milkthistle，也就是水飞蓟。看叶片上的白色斑纹！

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din il-pjanta bil-fjuri vjola?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din il-pjanta bil-fjuri vjola?
messages.zh: 这株开紫色花的是什么植物？
messages.en: What is this plant with purple flowers?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Milkthistle. Ara l-marki bojod fuq il-weraq!
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Milkthistle. Ara l-marki bojod fuq il-weraq!
messages.zh: 标签上写着 Milkthistle，也就是水飞蓟。看叶片上的白色斑纹！
messages.en: The label says Milkthistle. Look at the white markings on the leaves!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“紫花、白纹、带刺叶”的植物图像记住水飞蓟，再把图像与标签 Milkthistle 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Immediately, without waiting or allowing time to pass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个动作立即发生，不等待，也不耽搁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li azzjoni ssir minnufih, mingħajr stennija jew dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立刻；马上；不作任何等待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li xi ħaġa ssir minnufih, mingħajr ma wieħed jistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something at once, you do it immediately without waiting.

formal.mt: Jekk tinnota żball fid-dokument, jekk jogħġbok għarraf lill-uffiċċju mill-ewwel.
formal.en: If you notice an error in the document, please inform the office at once.
formal.zh: 如果发现文件有错误，请立即通知办公室。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' ċċempel lil ommok? Ben: Iva, se nċemplilha mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you call your mother? Ben: Yes, I'll call her right away.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能给你妈妈打个电话吗？本：可以，我马上给她打。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ċċempel lil ommok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ċċempel lil ommok?
messages.zh: 你能给你妈妈打个电话吗？
messages.en: Can you call your mother?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nċemplilha mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nċemplilha mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 可以，我马上给她打。
messages.en: Yes, I'll call her right away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mill-ewwel 和“马上回复、立刻打电话”一起记：听到请求就行动，用来强调不耽搁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to state the minimum number, amount, or extent of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于说明数量、程度或范围的最低限度，表示实际情况可以更多或更高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika l-iżgħar numru, ammont jew grad possibbli, filwaqt li jista' jkun hemm aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至少；不少于所说的数量或程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li n-numru, l-ammont jew il-grad mhuwiex inqas minn dak imsemmi, iżda jista' jkun akbar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use at least to indicate that a number or amount is the minimum possible.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jaslu mill-inqas għaxar minuti qabel il-bidu tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: Participants should arrive at least ten minutes before the meeting begins.
formal.zh: 与会者应至少提前十分钟到达。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ħobż għandna nixtru? Mark: Ixtri mill-inqas żewġ ħobżiet, għax se jiġu l-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much bread should we buy? Mark: Buy at least two loaves, because our friends are coming.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们该买多少面包？马克：至少买两个，因为朋友们要来。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm ħobż għandna nixtru?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm ħobż għandna nixtru?
messages.zh: 我们该买多少面包？
messages.en: How much bread should we buy?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ixtri mill-inqas żewġ ħobżiet, għax se jiġu l-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ixtri mill-inqas żewġ ħobżiet, għax se jiġu l-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 至少买两个，因为朋友们要来。
messages.en: Buy at least two loaves, because our friends are coming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mill-inqas 想成数字前的一条最低线：说“至少两个”，两个够线，三个也符合。

gloss_zh: 衷心地；真诚地；发自内心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: With sincere feeling, especially when expressing thanks, affection, or welcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示言语或行为出于真诚感情，常用于表达感谢、关爱或欢迎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li kliem jew għemil jesprimi sentimenti sinċieri, speċjalment meta wieħed jirringrazzja, juri mħabba jew jilqa' lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衷心的；真挚的；发自内心、带有真诚感情的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi kliem jew għemil li ġej minn sentimenti profondi u sinċieri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A heartfelt expression shows feelings that are deeply and sincerely felt.

formal.mt: Nirringrazzjaw mill-qalb lill-voluntiera kollha għall-ħidma u d-dedikazzjoni tagħhom.
formal.en: We sincerely thank all the volunteers for their work and dedication.
formal.zh: 我们衷心感谢所有志愿者的工作与奉献。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ġibtlek ftit ikel biex ma jkollokx għalfejn issajjar illum. Pawlu: Grazzi mill-qalb! Kemm int ħanina!
colloquial.en: Nina: I brought you some food so you won't have to cook today. Pawlu: Thank you from the heart! You're so kind!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我给你带了点吃的，这样你今天就不用做饭了。保罗：衷心谢谢你！你真体贴！

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibtlek ftit ikel biex ma jkollokx għalfejn issajjar illum.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibtlek ftit ikel biex ma jkollokx għalfejn issajjar illum.
messages.zh: 我给你带了点吃的，这样你今天就不用做饭了。
messages.en: I brought you some food so you won't have to cook today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi mill-qalb! Kemm int ħanina!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi mill-qalb! Kemm int ħanina!
messages.zh: 衷心谢谢你！你真体贴！
messages.en: Thank you from the heart! You're so kind!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mill-qalb 放进“衷心感谢”的场景：想象双手放在胸前道谢，用动作帮助记住真诚的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of one thousand years.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续一千年的时间段，也可指按纪年划分的一个千年期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' elf sena, li jista' jkun ukoll wieħed mill-perjodi ta' elf sena li bihom jinqasam il-kalendarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 千年，即一千年的时间段或纪年单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda ta' żmien li fiha elf sena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A millennium is a period of one thousand years, especially one used to divide historical time.

collocations.en: the beginning of a new millennium

formal.mt: Il-wirja tippreżenta l-bidliet fil-ħajja tal-belt matul millenju sħiħ.
formal.en: The exhibition presents changes in the life of the city over an entire millennium.
formal.zh: 这场展览呈现了整整一千年间这座城市生活的变迁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm-il sena hemm f'millenju? Mark: Elf sena. Imma din il-kju diġà tidher twila daqs millenju!
colloquial.en: Maja: How many years are there in a millennium? Mark: A thousand years. But this queue already feels as long as a millennium!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：一个千年有多少年？马克：一千年。不过排这条队已经让人觉得像过了一千年！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm-il sena hemm f'millenju?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm-il sena hemm f'millenju?
messages.zh: 一个千年有多少年？
messages.en: How many years are there in a millennium?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Elf sena. Imma din il-kju diġà tidher twila daqs millenju!
messages.mt_standard: Elf sena. Imma din il-kju diġà tidher twila daqs millenju!
messages.zh: 一千年。不过排这条队已经让人觉得像过了一千年！
messages.en: A thousand years. But this queue already feels as long as a millennium!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 millenju 写在标有“一千年”的长时间轴旁，朗读时联想十个百年首尾相接的长度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of one thousand years.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一千年构成的时间段，也可指历史纪年中的一个千年期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu magħmul minn elf sena, li jista' jintuża wkoll biex jinqasam iż-żmien fl-istorja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 千年，即包含一千年的时期或纪年单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' żmien li jdum elf sena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A millennium is a span of one thousand years that can be used when describing long periods of history.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi l-iżvilupp tal-biedja fir-reġjun matul millennju.
formal.en: The chapter describes the development of agriculture in the region over a millennium.
formal.zh: 这一章描述了该地区农业在一千年间的发展。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Millennju huwa mitt sena? Luqa: Le, elf sena. Mitt sena huma seklu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is a millennium a hundred years? Luqa: No, a thousand years. A hundred years is a century.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：一个千年是一百年吗？卢卡：不是，是一千年。一百年是一个世纪。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Millennju huwa mitt sena?
messages.mt_standard: Millennju huwa mitt sena?
messages.zh: 一个千年是一百年吗？
messages.en: Is a millennium a hundred years?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, elf sena. Mitt sena huma seklu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, elf sena. Mitt sena huma seklu.
messages.zh: 不是，是一千年。一百年是一个世纪。
messages.en: No, a thousand years. A hundred years is a century.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“十个世纪等于一个千年”的等式记住 millennju，抄写时特别留意词中的连续两个 n。

gloss_zh: 受到接纳的；受欢迎的（阳性单数形容词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Received or accepted willingly, or welcomed with a friendly attitude; masculine singular.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人或某事物受到接纳、欢迎或友好接待；此形式为阳性单数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa li tiġi aċċettata jew tintlaqa' b'rieda tajba; din hija l-forma maskili singular.

sense_translations.en_definition: received, accepted, welcomed. (Part of speech - masculine singular adjective)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被接收的、被接受的或受到欢迎的；阳性单数形容词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li tkun ġiet irċevuta, aċċettata jew milqugħa; jintuża fil-maskil singular.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as milqi is received, accepted, or welcomed by others.

formal.mt: Kull suġġeriment li jgħin biex jitjieb is-servizz ikun milqi.
formal.en: Any suggestion that helps improve the service will be welcome.
formal.zh: 任何有助于改善服务的建议都将受到欢迎。

colloquial.mt: David: Nista' nġib lil ħija għall-ikla? Rita: Dażgur! Ħuk dejjem milqi għandna.
colloquial.en: David: Can I bring my brother to the meal? Rita: Of course! Your brother is always welcome at our place.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：我能带我哥哥一起来吃饭吗？丽塔：当然！我们随时欢迎你哥哥来。

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nġib lil ħija għall-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nġib lil ħija għall-ikla?
messages.zh: 我能带我哥哥一起来吃饭吗？
messages.en: Can I bring my brother to the meal?

messages.speaker: Rita (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dażgur! Ħuk dejjem milqi għandna.
messages.mt_standard: Dażgur! Ħuk dejjem milqi għandna.
messages.zh: 当然！我们随时欢迎你哥哥来。
messages.en: Of course! Your brother is always welcome at our place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“哥哥来做客，始终受欢迎”记住 milqi；把它与阳性单数的“哥哥”或“建议”一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a sleek surface or feeling smooth when touched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面光滑，或用手触摸时感觉平滑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ lixx jew li jinħass lixx meta tmissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面光滑平整、显得顺滑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ lixx u dehra pulita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is sleek has a smooth, neat appearance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 触摸时感觉平滑、不粗糙的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinħass lixx u mhux aħrax meta tmissu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something smooth to the touch feels even rather than rough.

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-injam għandu jkun mils, mingħajr partijiet li jinħassu ħorox.
formal.en: The wooden surface should be smooth, without any areas that feel rough.
formal.zh: 木材表面应当光滑，不能有摸起来粗糙的部位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Miss dan l-injam. Kemm hu mils! Mark: Veru, ma jinħass aħrax xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Feel this wood. It's so smooth! Mark: Yes, it doesn't feel rough at all.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：摸摸这块木头，真光滑！马克：确实，一点也不粗糙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Miss dan l-injam. Kemm hu mils!
messages.mt_standard: Miss dan l-injam. Kemm hu mils!
messages.zh: 摸摸这块木头，真光滑！
messages.en: Feel this wood. It's so smooth!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, ma jinħass aħrax xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, ma jinħass aħrax xejn.
messages.zh: 确实，一点也不粗糙。
messages.en: Yes, it doesn't feel rough at all.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象手掌轻轻滑过磨好的木板，把 mils 同时连到“看着顺滑”和“摸着光滑”两个感觉。

gloss_zh: 弯曲的；已弯折的；已屈曲的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bent or flexed, describing the result of bending something or a body part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示物体或身体部位经过弯折、弯曲或屈曲后所处的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tgħawweġ jew intewa, bħal wajer jew parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.en_definition: bent, flexed (cf. Aquilina: Concise MT-EN EN-MT Dictionary, 2006, midseabooks Ltd)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已弯曲、弯折或屈曲，指物体或身体部位处于弯曲后的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun tgħawweġ jew intewa u ma jkunx f'pożizzjoni dritta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is bent or flexed has been curved or folded from a straight position.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, żomm il-minkeb milwi u mexxi d-driegħ bil-mod.
formal.en: During the exercise, keep your elbow bent and move your arm slowly.
formal.zh: 练习时保持手肘弯曲，并缓慢移动手臂。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-wajer ma jidħolx fit-toqba? Pawlu: Għax hu milwi. Iddrittah ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why won't the wire go into the hole? Pawlu: Because it's bent. Straighten it a little.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这根金属丝怎么穿不进孔里？保罗：因为它弯了，稍微弄直一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-wajer ma jidħolx fit-toqba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-wajer ma jidħolx fit-toqba?
messages.zh: 这根金属丝怎么穿不进孔里？
messages.en: Why won't the wire go into the hole?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu milwi. Iddrittah ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu milwi. Iddrittah ftit.
messages.zh: 因为它弯了，稍微弄直一点。
messages.en: Because it's bent. Straighten it a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 milwi 就在脑中画一根弯曲的金属丝，再弯一下手肘，用两个动作记住“已经弯曲”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term referring to something that is full of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物充满了水，强调其中满是水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tirreferi għal xi ħaġa li tkun mimlija bl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充满了水，内部满是水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun hemm ħafna ilma f'xi ħaġa, tant li tkun mimlija bih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way is filled with water.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, il-kelma 'milwiema' hija marbuta ma' xi ħaġa mimlija bl-ilma.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the word 'milwiema' is associated with something full of water.
formal.zh: 在这项词汇练习中，“milwiema”与某物充满水的情形相联系。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif niftakar il-kelma 'milwiema'? Toni: Aħseb f'barmil mimli bl-ilma sa fuq.
colloquial.en: Lina: How can I remember the word 'milwiema'? Toni: Think of a bucket filled with water right to the top.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我怎么记住“milwiema”这个词？托尼：想象一个水一直装到顶的桶。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niftakar il-kelma 'milwiema'?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niftakar il-kelma 'milwiema'?
messages.zh: 我怎么记住“milwiema”这个词？
messages.en: How can I remember the word 'milwiema'?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'barmil mimli bl-ilma sa fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'barmil mimli bl-ilma sa fuq.
messages.zh: 想象一个水一直装到顶的桶。
messages.en: Think of a bucket filled with water right to the top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 milwiema 配一张水桶装满水的记忆图，重点看水面已经到顶，把整个词与“满是水”直接配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who likes or loves someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容对某人或某事怀有喜爱或爱意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa u jkollu sentiment ta' mħabba jew għoġba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人或某事有所喜爱，或怀有爱意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu mħabba għal xi ħadd jew għoġba għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described this way feels liking or love for someone or something.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'milwieni' hija marbuta mas-sentiment ta' mħabba jew għoġba għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'milwieni' is associated with a feeling of love or liking for someone or something.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，“milwieni”与对某人或某事的爱意或喜爱之情相联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' xiex norbot il-kelma 'milwieni' biex niftakarha? Mark: Ma' persuna jew ħaġa li tħobb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I connect the word 'milwieni' with to remember it? Mark: With a person or thing you love.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为了记住“milwieni”，我该把它和什么联系起来？马克：和你喜爱的人或事物联系起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' xiex norbot il-kelma 'milwieni' biex niftakarha?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' xiex norbot il-kelma 'milwieni' biex niftakarha?
messages.zh: 为了记住“milwieni”，我该把它和什么联系起来？
messages.en: What should I connect the word 'milwieni' with to remember it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' persuna jew ħaġa li tħobb.
messages.mt_standard: Ma' persuna jew ħaġa li tħobb.
messages.zh: 和你喜爱的人或事物联系起来。
messages.en: With a person or thing you love.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 milwieni 写在一张爱心卡片上，旁边画自己喜爱的人或事物，用这个画面记住“喜爱、有爱意”。

gloss_zh: 通过添加 m- 前缀由词根派生的（指名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a noun derived from a root by adding an m- prefix in a Semitic language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容闪米特语中通过给词根添加 m- 前缀而派生出的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi nom li jkun derivat minn għerq permezz taż-żieda tal-prefiss m- f'lingwa Semitika.

sense_translations.en_definition: mimated (grammatical operation in Semitic languages, whereby a noun is derived from a root via an m- prefix)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经由添加 m- 前缀从词根派生的；用于描述闪米特语中以这种构词方式形成的名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom mimmat huwa nom li jitnissel minn għerq biż-żieda tal-prefiss m- f'lingwa Semitika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In Semitic grammar, a mimated noun is formed from a root by adding an m- prefix.

collocations.zh: 通过添加 m- 前缀派生的名词
通过添加 m- 前缀形成的形式

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi grammatikali, it-terminu 'mimmat' jiddeskrivi nom derivat minn għerq permezz tal-prefiss m-.
formal.en: In grammatical analysis, the term 'mimated' describes a noun derived from a root by means of the prefix m-.
formal.zh: 在语法分析中，“mimmat”用于描述通过 m- 前缀从词根派生出的名词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'mimmat' f'din in-nota? Pawlu: Ifisser li n-nom hu derivat minn għerq biż-żieda tal-prefiss m-.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'mimated' mean in this note? Pawlu: It means that the noun is derived from a root by adding the prefix m-.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这条笔记里的“mimmat”是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是这个名词通过添加 m- 前缀从词根派生而来。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'mimmat' f'din in-nota?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'mimmat' f'din in-nota?
messages.zh: 这条笔记里的“mimmat”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mimated' mean in this note?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li n-nom hu derivat minn għerq biż-żieda tal-prefiss m-.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li n-nom hu derivat minn għerq biż-żieda tal-prefiss m-.
messages.zh: 意思是这个名词通过添加 m- 前缀从词根派生而来。
messages.en: It means that the noun is derived from a root by adding the prefix m-.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mimmat 做成语法卡片：词根前加 m-，得到派生名词。用这个构词示意记术语，不必猜测具体词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not permitted under a rule, instruction, or restriction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因规则、指示或限制而不被允许的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa mhijiex permessa minħabba regola, struzzjoni jew restrizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被禁止的；规则或有关指示明确不允许的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mimnugħa hija xi ħaġa li regola jew struzzjoni ma tippermettix li ssir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is prohibited, a rule or instruction does not allow you to do it.

formal.mt: Id-dħul f'din iż-żona huwa mimnugħ mingħajr permess.
formal.en: Entry into this area is prohibited without permission.
formal.zh: 未经许可，禁止进入该区域。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nipparkja hawn? Rita: Le, hemm tabella li tgħid 'Par سkeġġ mimnugħ'.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I park here? Rita: No, there is a sign saying 'Parking prohibited'.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我可以在这里停车吗？Rita：不可以，那里有块牌子写着“禁止停车”。

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nipparkja hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nipparkja hawn?
messages.zh: 我可以在这里停车吗？
messages.en: Can I park here?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm tabella li tgħid 'Parkeġġ mimnugħ'.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm tabella li tgħid 'Parkeġġ mimnugħ'.
messages.zh: 不可以，那里有块牌子写着“禁止停车”。
messages.en: No, there is a sign saying 'Parking prohibited'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口和路边的禁止标志，把 mimnugħ 与“规则不允许”绑定，再用“禁止进入、禁止停车”两个场景复习。

gloss_zh: 横过；从一边穿到另一边

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses movement across something or through it from one side to the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示横过某个地方，或穿过某个物体，从一边到达另一边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi moviment minn naħa ta' post jew oġġett għan-naħa l-oħra, billi wieħed jaqsam jew jgħaddi minn ġo fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 横过某个地方，从一边到另一边。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jaqsam post biex jasal minn naħa għan-naħa l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you move across a place, you go from one side of it to the other.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿过某物的内部，从一边进入并从另一边出来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jgħaddi minn ġo oġġett jew spazju u jasal fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something passes through an object, it enters one side and comes out on the other.

collocations.en: cross from one side of the road to the other
collocations.zh: 从道路的一边走到另一边

collocations.en: pass the needle through the fabric to the other side
collocations.zh: 把针从布料的一面穿到另一面

formal.mt: Il-pont jippermetti lin-nies jgħaddu min-naħa għall-oħra tax-xmara mingħajr periklu.
formal.en: The bridge allows people to cross safely from one side of the river to the other.
formal.zh: 这座桥让人们能够安全地从河的一岸到达另一岸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut qiegħed hawn? Pawlu: Le, irridu naqsmu min-naħa għall-oħra tat-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shop here? Pawlu: No, we need to cross to the other side of the road.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店在这里吗？保罗：不，我们得过到马路另一边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut qiegħed hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut qiegħed hawn?
messages.zh: 商店在这里吗？
messages.en: Is the shop here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irridu naqsmu min-naħa għall-oħra tat-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irridu naqsmu min-naħa għall-oħra tat-triq.
messages.zh: 不，我们得过到马路另一边。
messages.en: No, we need to cross to the other side of the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一支箭头从左边指到右边：过马路是横过，针穿布是穿过，共同抓住“从一边到另一边”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses passage through the middle of a place, space, or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示经过某个地方、空间或群体的中间部分而穿过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi mogħdija li tgħaddi mill-parti tan-nofs ta' post, spazju jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿过，尤其指从某个地方或群体的中间经过。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jgħaddi mill-parti tan-nofs ta' post jew grupp biex jasal aktar 'il quddiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you go through the middle of something, your route passes within its central part.

collocations.en: pass through the middle of the garden
a road that runs through the middle of the village
collocations.zh: 一条穿过村庄中部的道路

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi min-nofs tal-ġnien u twassal sal-bieb prinċipali.
formal.en: The path runs through the middle of the garden and leads to the main gate.
formal.zh: 这条小路穿过花园中间，通往正门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn se ngħaddu? Mark: Se ngħaddu min-nofs tal-ġnien; dik hi l-iqsar triq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which way are we going? Mark: We will go through the middle of the garden; that is the shortest route.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们走哪条路？马克：我们从花园中间穿过去，那是最近的路。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn se ngħaddu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn se ngħaddu?
messages.zh: 我们走哪条路？
messages.en: Which way are we going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ngħaddu min-nofs tal-ġnien; dik hi l-iqsar triq.
messages.mt_standard: Se ngħaddu min-nofs tal-ġnien; dik hi l-iqsar triq.
messages.zh: 我们从花园中间穿过去，那是最近的路。
messages.en: We will go through the middle of the garden; that is the shortest route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个花园，再画一条穿过正中央的小路；把 min-nofs 和“从中间穿过去”的路线一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement of intended harm, or something that presents a danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示将要伤害或惩罚他人的言语，也可指可能造成损害的事物或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li juri intenzjoni li ssir ħsara lil xi ħadd, jew ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni li tista' ġġib ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威胁；表示要伤害或惩罚他人的言语，或可能造成危害的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Minaċċa hija dikjarazzjoni li xi ħadd biħsiebu jagħmel ħsara, jew xi ħaġa li toħloq periklu għal persuna jew għal xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A threat is a statement that someone may cause harm, or something that could cause damage or danger.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika t-tniġġis tal-ilma bħala minaċċa serja għas-saħħa pubblika.
formal.en: The report identifies water pollution as a serious threat to public health.
formal.zh: 该报告将水污染列为对公共健康的严重威胁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qalli li jkisser il-karozza tiegħi jekk nerġa' nipparkja hemm. David: Dik minaċċa serja. Żomm il-messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: He told me he would smash my car if I parked there again. David: That is a serious threat. Keep the message.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他对我说，如果我再把车停在那里，他就砸我的车。David：这是严重的威胁。把那条消息保存好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li jkisser il-karozza tiegħi jekk nerġa' nipparkja hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li jkisser il-karozza tiegħi jekk nerġa' nipparkja hemm.
messages.zh: 他对我说，如果我再把车停在那里，他就砸我的车。
messages.en: He told me he would smash my car if I parked there again.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik minaċċa serja. Żomm il-messaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik minaċċa serja. Żomm il-messaġġ.
messages.zh: 这是严重的威胁。把那条消息保存好。
messages.en: That is a serious threat. Keep the message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 minaċċa：一条恐吓消息，一处污染水源。前者是言语威胁，后者是现实危害，都可用这个名词表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Positioned horizontally or lying flat rather than standing upright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于水平方向或平放状态的，而非直立的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'pożizzjoni orizzontali jew ċatt fuq wiċċ, minflok wieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水平的；横放或平放的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'pożizzjoni orizzontali, minflok f'pożizzjoni wieqfa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is horizontal lies flat or extends across rather than standing upright.

collocations.en: a panel lying horizontally on the table
collocations.zh: 水平放在桌上的一块板

formal.mt: Waqt il-kejl, il-pannell għandu jinżamm mindud fuq wiċċ ċatt.
formal.en: During measurement, the panel should be kept horizontal on a flat surface.
formal.zh: 测量时，应将板水平放置在平整表面上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inpoġġi l-ktieb, wieqaf jew mindud? Mark: Poġġih mindud fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How should I put the book, upright or flat? Mark: Put it flat on the table.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书该怎么放，竖着还是平放？Mark：把它平放在桌上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inpoġġi l-ktieb, wieqaf jew mindud?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inpoġġi l-ktieb, wieqaf jew mindud?
messages.zh: 这本书该怎么放，竖着还是平放？
messages.en: How should I put the book, upright or flat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih mindud fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih mindud fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 把它平放在桌上。
messages.en: Put it flat on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一本书从竖立改成平放，边做动作边说 mindud，用水平姿态记住词义。

gloss_zh: 水平的；平放的（复数，通用于阴阳性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Positioned horizontally or lying flat, used to describe plural nouns of either gender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示多个事物处于水平或平放状态的形容词复数形式，通用于阴阳性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma fil-plural tal-aġġettiv li tiddeskrivi affarijiet f'pożizzjoni orizzontali, kemm fil-maskil kif ukoll fil-femminil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水平的；平放的，形容词复数形式，通用于阴阳性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsabu f'pożizzjoni orizzontali; din il-forma tintuża fil-plural kemm għall-maskil kif ukoll għall-femminil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this plural adjective for things that lie flat or extend horizontally, regardless of grammatical gender.

collocations.en: panels lying horizontally on the floor

formal.mt: Qabel l-installazzjoni, il-pannelli għandhom jinżammu mindudin fuq wiċċ ċatt.
formal.en: Before installation, the panels should be kept horizontal on a flat surface.
formal.zh: 安装前，应将这些板水平放置在平整表面上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn huma l-kotba li ġibt? Pawlu: Qegħdin mindudin fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are the books I brought? Pawlu: They are lying flat on the table, next to the bag.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我带来的那些书在哪里？Pawlu：平放在桌上，就在包旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn huma l-kotba li ġibt?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn huma l-kotba li ġibt?
messages.zh: 我带来的那些书在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the books I brought?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qegħdin mindudin fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin mindudin fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża.
messages.zh: 平放在桌上，就在包旁边。
messages.en: They are lying flat on the table, next to the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象多本书一起平放：一本用 mindud，多本用 mindudin，把复数形式和多个物件绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A naturally occurring solid substance with a characteristic chemical composition and internal structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自然形成、具有特定化学组成和内部结构的固体物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza solida li tifforma fin-natura u għandha kompożizzjoni kimika u struttura interna karatteristiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矿物；自然形成并具有特定化学组成和内部结构的固体物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza solida naturali b'kompożizzjoni kimika u struttura interna karatteristiċi, li tista' tkun parti mill-blat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mineral is a naturally occurring solid substance with a characteristic chemical composition and internal structure.

collocations.en: the chemical composition of the mineral

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiddeskrivu l-kulur u l-istruttura tal-mineral qabel ma jippruvaw jidentifikawh.
formal.en: Students should describe the mineral's colour and structure before attempting to identify it.
formal.zh: 学生应先描述该矿物的颜色和结构，再尝试鉴定它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan il-kampjun? David: Huwa mineral. Ejja naqraw it-tikketta biex naraw x'jismu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this sample? David: It is a mineral. Let's read the label to see what it is called.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是什么样品？David：是一种矿物。我们读读标签，看看它叫什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan il-kampjun?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan il-kampjun?
messages.zh: 这是什么样品？
messages.en: What is this sample?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mineral. Ejja naqraw it-tikketta biex naraw x'jismu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mineral. Ejja naqraw it-tikketta biex naraw x'jismu.
messages.zh: 是一种矿物。我们读读标签，看看它叫什么。
messages.en: It is a mineral. Let's read the label to see what it is called.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 mineral 与英语同形词 mineral 对照记忆，再联想博物馆里标有名称的矿物样品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Minerals whose extraction or trade helps finance armed conflict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其开采或贸易为武装冲突提供资金的矿产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minerali li l-estrazzjoni jew il-kummerċ tagħhom jgħinu biex jiffinanzjaw kunflitt armat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲突矿产；开采或交易所得被用于资助武装冲突的矿产。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mineral li l-estrazzjoni jew il-bejgħ tiegħu jipprovdu fondi li jgħinu biex ikompli kunflitt armat; l-espressjoni mogħtija hija fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conflict mineral is a mineral whose extraction or sale helps provide funding for armed conflict.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina jekk il-katina tal-provvista tal-kumpanija tinkludix minerali ta' kunflitt.
formal.en: The report examines whether the company's supply chain includes conflict minerals.
formal.zh: 该报告审查公司的供应链是否涉及冲突矿产。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed nistaqsu minn fejn ġejjin dawn il-minerali? Mark: Biex niċċekkjaw jekk humiex minerali ta' kunflitt u jekk il-bejgħ tagħhom jgħinx biex jiffinanzja gruppi armati.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we asking where these minerals come from? Mark: To check whether they are conflict minerals and whether their sale helps finance armed groups.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们为什么要问这些矿产来自哪里？Mark：为了查明它们是不是冲突矿产，以及销售所得是否帮助资助武装团体。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nistaqsu minn fejn ġejjin dawn il-minerali?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nistaqsu minn fejn ġejjin dawn il-minerali?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要问这些矿产来自哪里？
messages.en: Why are we asking where these minerals come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niċċekkjaw jekk humiex minerali ta' kunflitt u jekk il-bejgħ tagħhom jgħinx biex jiffinanzja gruppi armati.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niċċekkjaw jekk humiex minerali ta' kunflitt u jekk il-bejgħ tagħhom jgħinx biex jiffinanzja gruppi armati.
messages.zh: 为了查明它们是不是冲突矿产，以及销售所得是否帮助资助武装团体。
messages.en: To check whether they are conflict minerals and whether their sale helps finance armed groups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记忆：minerali 是矿物的复数，ta' 表示关联，kunflitt 表示冲突；联想矿产销售资金流向武装冲突。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Larger than usual because of swelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因肿胀而比平常显得更大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu nefħa u jidher akbar mis-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀的；因出现肿胀而增大的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li żdied fid-daqs minħabba nefħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is swollen has become larger than usual because of swelling.

formal.mt: Wara li ħabat subgħajh mal-bieb, kellu subgħa minfugħ.
formal.en: After he knocked his finger against the door, he had a swollen finger.
formal.zh: 他的手指撞到门后肿了起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek subgħajk minfugħ? Mark: Ħbattu mal-bieb dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is your finger swollen? Mark: I knocked it against the door this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的手指怎么肿了？马克：今天早上撞到门了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek subgħajk minfugħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek subgħajk minfugħ?
messages.zh: 你的手指怎么肿了？
messages.en: Why is your finger swollen?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħbattu mal-bieb dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħbattu mal-bieb dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 今天早上撞到门了。
messages.en: I knocked it against the door this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指撞门后肿起来的画面，把 minfugħ 和“肿胀的”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used or paid out, especially when describing money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经花掉或支付出去的，尤其用于描述钱款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ntużaw biex jitħallsu affarijiet jew servizzi, speċjalment meta wieħed jitkellem dwar flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已花掉的；已用于支付费用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li diġà ntużaw jew tħallsu għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Money that has been spent has already been used to pay for something.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri l-fondi minfuqin fuq il-proġett matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report shows the funds spent on the project during the year.
formal.zh: 报告列出了本年度用于该项目的资金。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn il-flus kollha minfuqin fuq il-kotba? Pawlu: Iva, xtrajt il-kotba kollha għall-kors.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was all this money spent on books? Pawlu: Yes, I bought all the books for the course.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些钱全都花在书上了吗？保罗：是的，我买齐了这门课的所有书。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-flus kollha minfuqin fuq il-kotba?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-flus kollha minfuqin fuq il-kotba?
messages.zh: 这些钱全都花在书上了吗？
messages.en: Was all this money spent on books?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajt il-kotba kollha għall-kors.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajt il-kotba kollha għall-kors.
messages.zh: 是的，我买齐了这门课的所有书。
messages.en: Yes, I bought all the books for the course.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账本中已经付出去的一笔笔钱，用 flus minfuqin 记住“已花费的钱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item whose meaning remains unconfirmed and cannot yet receive a definite translation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词义尚未确认的词项，暂不能赋予确定的中文或英文译义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li t-tifsira tagħha għadha mhix ikkonfermata u li għalissa ma tistax tingħata traduzzjoni definita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未明确，须核实后才能确定译义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din il-kelma għadha mhix stabbilita u teħtieġ verifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this item remains uncertain and requires verification before a translation is assigned.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-kelma 'mingħalik' teħtieġ verifika qabel ma tingħata traduzzjoni definita.
formal.en: The meaning of the word 'mingħalik' requires verification before a definite translation is given.
formal.zh: 在给出确定译文之前，需要核实“mingħalik”这个词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'mingħalik'? Rita: Għadni ma nafx żgur; irrid nivverifika t-tifsira tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the word 'mingħalik' mean? Rita: I am not sure yet; I need to verify its meaning.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：“mingħalik”这个词是什么意思？丽塔：我还不能确定，需要核实它的含义。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'mingħalik'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'mingħalik'?
messages.zh: “mingħalik”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'mingħalik' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx żgur; irrid nivverifika t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx żgur; irrid nivverifika t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 我还不能确定，需要核实它的含义。
messages.en: I am not sure yet; I need to verify its meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mingħalik 暂放入“待核实词卡”，先认清拼写，确认词义后再建立语义联想。

gloss_zh: 从……那里；另有未明确义项

teaching_sense.en_definition: From a person or other source, indicating where something is obtained or received.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物来自谁或从哪个来源取得，相当于“从……那里”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Turi l-persuna jew is-sors li minnu wieħed jieħu jew jirċievi xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此义项的含义未明确，暂不能确定具体译义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan is-sens għadha mhix stabbilita u teħtieġ verifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This particular sense has not been identified clearly enough to receive a definite translation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从……那里；表示取得或接收某物的来源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika l-persuna jew is-sors li minnu tinkiseb jew tasal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word to indicate the person or source from which something is obtained or received.

formal.mt: L-istudenta rċeviet ittra mingħand l-għalliema tagħha.
formal.en: The student received a letter from her teacher.
formal.zh: 这名女学生收到了她的女老师寄来的信。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġibt dan il-ktieb? Mark: Ġibtu mingħand ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you get this book? Mark: I got it from a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书你是从哪里弄来的？马克：我从一个朋友那里拿来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġibt dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġibt dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书你是从哪里弄来的？
messages.en: Where did you get this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibtu mingħand ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibtu mingħand ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我从一个朋友那里拿来的。
messages.en: I got it from a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友把书递给你，用 mingħand ħabib 记住“从朋友那里”；未明确义项另留待核实。

gloss_zh: 我不是；我不处于某种状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: A first-person singular negative form meaning that I am not someone or am not in a particular state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 第一人称单数的否定形式，表示“我不是某种身份”或“我不处于某种状态”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma negattiva tal-ewwel persuna singular li biha min jitkellem jiċħad identità, kwalità jew stat tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我不是；我并非；我不处于所述状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża minn min jitkellem biex jgħid li identità, kwalità jew stat ma japplikawx għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this form to say that a particular identity, quality, or state does not apply to you.

formal.mt: Miniex responsabbli għall-organizzazzjoni ta' din il-laqgħa.
formal.en: I am not responsible for organizing this meeting.
formal.zh: 我不负责组织这次会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int lest biex nitilqu? Mark: Le, miniex lest. Agħtini żewġ minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you ready for us to leave? Mark: No, I am not ready. Give me two minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你准备好出发了吗？马克：没有，我还没准备好。给我两分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int lest biex nitilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Int lest biex nitilqu?
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready for us to leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, miniex lest. Agħtini żewġ minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, miniex lest. Agħtini żewġ minuti.
messages.zh: 没有，我还没准备好。给我两分钟。
messages.en: No, I am not ready. Give me two minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miniex 整体记为“我不是／我并不”，再接状态词；用 miniex lest 记住“我还没准备好”。

gloss_zh: 会死的；不能永生的（给定义项，词形对应待核实）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied sense describes someone or something that can die; its correspondence to this entry requires verification.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给定义项描述人或生物终有一死、不能永生；该义项与本条词形的对应关系需要核实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija tiddeskrivi bniedem jew ħlejqa li tista' tmut; ir-rabta bejn din it-tifsira u l-forma tal-entrata teħtieġ verifika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会死的；终有一死而不能永生的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi bniedem jew ħlejqa li tista' tmut u li ma tgħixx għal dejjem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or creature that is mortal can die and does not live forever.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'minix cert' għandha t-tifsira Ingliża 'mortal', iżda r-rabta bejn il-forma u t-tifsira teħtieġ verifika.
formal.en: The entry 'minix cert' has the English sense 'mortal', but the correspondence between the form and the meaning requires verification.
formal.zh: 词条“minix cert”给出的英语义项是“mortal”，但词形与含义之间的对应关系需要核实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'mortal' ħdejn 'minix cert'? Mark: Tfisser li xi ħadd jista' jmut. Imma rridu nivverifikaw l-entrata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'mortal' beside 'minix cert' mean? Mark: It means that someone can die. But we need to verify the entry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“minix cert”旁边的“mortal”是什么意思？马克：意思是人会死。不过，我们需要核实这个词条。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'mortal' ħdejn 'minix cert'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'mortal' ħdejn 'minix cert'?
messages.zh: “minix cert”旁边的“mortal”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mortal' beside 'minix cert' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħadd jista' jmut. Imma rridu nivverifikaw l-entrata.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd jista' jmut. Imma rridu nivverifikaw l-entrata.
messages.zh: 意思是人会死。不过，我们需要核实这个词条。
messages.en: It means that someone can die. But we need to verify the entry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“生命有终点”记住给定的 mortal 义项；本条词形对应待核实，先勿将二者直接背成固定翻译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mine where coal is extracted from the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从地下开采煤炭的矿场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn il-faħam jiġi estratt mill-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煤矿；开采煤炭的矿场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Minjiera fejn il-ħaddiema joħorġu l-faħam minn taħt l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coalmine is a place where coal is dug out of the ground.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol f'minjiera tal-faħam.
formal.en: The report describes working conditions in a coalmine.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一座煤矿的工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn kien jaħdem in-nannu tiegħek? Mark: Kien jaħdem f'minjiera tal-faħam.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did your grandfather work? Mark: He worked in a coalmine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爷爷以前在哪里工作？马克：他以前在煤矿工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn kien jaħdem in-nannu tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn kien jaħdem in-nannu tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你爷爷以前在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where did your grandfather work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien jaħdem f'minjiera tal-faħam.
messages.mt_standard: Kien jaħdem f'minjiera tal-faħam.
messages.zh: 他以前在煤矿工作。
messages.en: He worked in a coalmine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“矿工从地下运出煤炭”的画面，再用“在煤矿工作”这一搭配反复记忆。

gloss_zh: 按自己的意愿行事的；出于本人意愿

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone acting deliberately according to his own wishes or choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述一个人按照自己的意愿或选择，有意作出某种行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jaġixxi apposta skont ix-xewqa jew l-għażla tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执意按照自己的意愿行事的；有意凭自己的主张行事的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħadd li jagħżel li jaġixxi skont ir-rieda tiegħu stess, anki meta oħrajn jixtiequ li jagħmel mod ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is wilful deliberately follows their own wishes, even when others want something different.

collocations.en: he did this of his own accord
collocations.zh: 他出于自己的意愿做了这件事

collocations.en: he left of his own accord

formal.mt: Minkejja l-parir tal-kollegi, id-direttur biddel il-pjan minn rajh.
formal.en: Despite his colleagues' advice, the director changed the plan of his own accord.
formal.zh: 尽管同事们提出了劝告，主管仍按自己的意愿更改了计划。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għedtlu jitlaq? Mark: Le, telaq minn rajh, għalkemm tlabtu jibqa'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you tell him to leave? Mark: No, he left of his own accord, although I asked him to stay.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你叫他走的吗？马克：没有，是他自己要走的，虽然我请他留下。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlu jitlaq?
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlu jitlaq?
messages.zh: 你叫他走的吗？
messages.en: Did you tell him to leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, telaq minn rajh, għalkemm tlabtu jibqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Le, telaq minn rajh, għalkemm tlabtu jibqa'.
messages.zh: 没有，是他自己要走的，虽然我请他留下。
messages.en: No, he left of his own accord, although I asked him to stay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家劝他留下，他却说“我自己决定”：用这个小场景记住 minn rajh，重点是行动出于本人的意愿。

gloss_zh: 人不错的；亲切好相处的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a person who is pleasant, friendly, and easy to get along with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人亲切友好，让人觉得相处愉快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna simpatika u dħulija li jkun pjaċevoli tqatta' l-ħin magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为人亲切、讨人喜欢、容易相处的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jittratta lill-oħrajn b'mod sabiħ u jġiegħelhom iħossuhom komdi fil-kumpanija tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nice person is friendly and pleasant to spend time with.

collocations.zh: 一个亲切好相处的男人
一位亲切、容易接近的老师

formal.mt: Il-kollegi ddeskrivew lill-għalliem bħala raġel minn tagħna, dejjem lest li jisma' u jgħin.
formal.en: His colleagues described the teacher as a nice, approachable man, always ready to listen and help.
formal.zh: 同事们形容这位老师为人亲切、容易相处，总是愿意倾听并提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid? Lara: Hu minn tagħna; ilbieraħ għenni nġorr il-basktijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the new neighbour like? Lara: He is a nice guy; yesterday he helped me carry the bags.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新邻居人怎么样？拉拉：他人挺好的，昨天还帮我提袋子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 新邻居人怎么样？
messages.en: What is the new neighbour like?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu minn tagħna; ilbieraħ għenni nġorr il-basktijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hu minn tagħna; ilbieraħ għenni nġorr il-basktijiet.
messages.zh: 他人挺好的，昨天还帮我提袋子。
messages.en: He is a nice guy; yesterday he helped me carry the bags.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新邻居主动帮你提袋子，你笑着说“这人真好相处”；把 minn tagħna 整体放进这个友善的场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without delay, at the moment something happens or is requested.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情发生或收到要求后不作耽搁，马上行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla dewmien, fil-ħin stess li jiġri xi ħaġa jew issir talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立即；马上；不经过等待或拖延。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bla ma jgħaddi żmien u mingħajr ebda dewmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something immediately, you do it without waiting or delaying.

formal.mt: Meta rċieva t-talba, l-uffiċjal wieġeb minnu fih.
formal.en: When he received the request, the official answered immediately.
formal.zh: 收到请求后，那位工作人员当即作了答复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta weġibek Mark? Rita: Min 鹏nu fih, malli bgħattlu l-messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: When did Mark answer you? Rita: Immediately, as soon as I sent him the message.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark什么时候回复你的？Rita：马上就回了，我刚把消息发给他，他就回复了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta weġibek Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Meta weġibek Mark?
messages.zh: Mark什么时候回复你的？
messages.en: When did Mark answer you?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min 鹏nu fih, malli bgħattlu l-messaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Min 鹏nu fih, malli bgħattlu l-messaġġ.
messages.zh: 马上就回了，我刚把消息发给他，他就回复了。
messages.en: Immediately, as soon as I sent him the message.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“消息刚发出，回复就到了”的画面绑定，整体记作“立即”，不要逐词硬译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Selected from available people or things for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从可供选择的人或事物中，为某种目的挑选出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħżula minn fost persuni jew affarijiet oħra għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被选中；从若干可选对象中挑选出来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magħżula minn fost għażliet oħra biex tintuża jew tieħu sehem f'xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something chosen has been selected from the available alternatives.

formal.mt: L-istorja minqija għal din il-lezzjoni għandha lingwa ċara u suġġett adattat għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The story chosen for this lesson has clear language and a subject suitable for the students.
formal.zh: 为这节课选出的故事语言清晰，题材也适合学生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema storja se naqraw illum? Pawlu: Din hi l-istorja minqija għal-lum. Lara: Tajjeb, nibdew biha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which story are we going to read today? Pawlu: This is the story chosen for today. Lara: Good, let's start with it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们今天要读哪个故事？Pawlu：这就是今天选定的故事。Lara：好，我们开始读吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema storja se naqraw illum?
messages.mt_standard: Liema storja se naqraw illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天要读哪个故事？
messages.en: Which story are we going to read today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi l-istorja minqija għal-lum.
messages.mt_standard: Din hi l-istorja minqija għal-lum.
messages.zh: 这就是今天选定的故事。
messages.en: This is the story chosen for today.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nibdew biha.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nibdew biha.
messages.zh: 好，我们开始读吧。
messages.en: Good, let's start with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师从一叠故事中抽出今天要读的一篇，用“已经选出来”的结果画面记住 minqija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Joined or held together so that separate parts form a connected whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各个部分已经接合或被固定在一起，形成相连的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħqud jew miżmum flimkien sabiex il-partijiet jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经接合；各部分被连住或固定在一起。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magħqud b'mod li l-partijiet jibqgħu mwaħħlin jew miżmumin flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When something is joined or held together, its separate parts remain connected as a whole.

formal.mt: Il-qafas għandu jkun minsus sew sabiex il-partijiet tiegħu jibqgħu f'posthom waqt l-użu.
formal.en: The framework must be securely held together so that its parts remain in place during use.
formal.zh: 框架必须接合牢固，确保各部分在使用时保持在原位。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-qafas minsus sew issa? Toni: Iva, il-partijiet kollha qed iżommu flimkien. Mark: Tajjeb, nistgħu nużawh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the framework securely held together now? Toni: Yes, all the parts are holding together. Mark: Good, we can use it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：框架现在接牢了吗？Toni：是的，各部分都连牢了。Mark：好，我们可以用了。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qafas minsus sew issa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qafas minsus sew issa?
messages.zh: 框架现在接牢了吗？
messages.en: Is the framework securely held together now?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-partijiet kollha qed iżommu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-partijiet kollha qed iżommu flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，各部分都连牢了。
messages.en: Yes, all the parts are holding together.

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nistgħu nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nistgħu nużawh.
messages.zh: 好，我们可以用了。
messages.en: Good, we can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 minsus 配上“零散部件接成牢固框架”的画面，重点记住各部分已经连在一起的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A naturally raised area of land that is smaller than a mountain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自然隆起、通常比山岳低小的一片地形，即小山或山丘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolja naturali fl-art li tkun iżgħar minn muntanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山丘；周围地面之上自然隆起、通常比山岳低小的高地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa art għolja b'mod naturali, li titla' 'l fuq mill-art ta' madwarha u tkun iżgħar minn muntanja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hill is a naturally raised area of land that is usually smaller than a mountain.

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija titla' lejn il-quċċata tal-mintba, minn fejn wieħed jista' jara l-wied.
formal.en: The path climbs towards the top of the hill, from which one can see the valley.
formal.zh: 小径向山丘顶部延伸，从那里可以看见山谷。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nitilgħu fuq il-mintba? David: Iva, minn hemm naraw il-wied. Anna: Ejja nimxu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: Shall we climb the hill? David: Yes, we can see the valley from there. Anna: Let's walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们爬上那座山丘好吗？David：好，从那里可以看见山谷。Anna：我们慢慢走吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nitilgħu fuq il-mintba?
messages.mt_standard: Nitilgħu fuq il-mintba?
messages.zh: 我们爬上那座山丘好吗？
messages.en: Shall we climb the hill?

messages.speaker: David (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn hemm naraw il-wied.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn hemm naraw il-wied.
messages.zh: 好，从那里可以看见山谷。
messages.en: Yes, we can see the valley from there.

messages.speaker: Anna (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nimxu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nimxu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我们慢慢走吧。
messages.en: Let's walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条通往小山顶的步道，在山丘旁标上 mintba，把“爬上去看山谷”的场景和词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small reel or cylinder around which thread is wound, especially for sewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于缠绕线的小筒或小轴，尤其指缝纫时使用的绕线筒或梭芯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rukkell jew ċilindru żgħir li madwaru jitkebbeb il-ħajt, speċjalment għall-ħjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绕线筒；梭芯；供缝纫等用途缠绕线的小筒或小轴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Minċott huwa rukkell żgħir li jżomm il-ħajt imkebbeb madwaru sabiex ikun jista' jintuża fil-ħjata jew f'xogħol ieħor bil-ħajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bobbin is a small reel that holds thread wound around it for sewing or similar work.

collocations.en: to wind thread onto the bobbin

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-ħjata, iċċekkja li l-ħajt ikun imkebbeb sew madwar il-minċott.
formal.en: Before you begin sewing, check that the thread is wound properly around the bobbin.
formal.zh: 开始缝纫前，请检查线是否已整齐地绕在梭芯上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn qiegħed il-minċott bil-ħajt abjad? Marija: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata, ħdejn l-imqass.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the bobbin with the white thread? Marija: In the sewing box, next to the scissors.
colloquial.zh: Anna：绕着白线的梭芯在哪里？Marija：在针线盒里，剪刀旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qiegħed il-minċott bil-ħajt abjad?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qiegħed il-minċott bil-ħajt abjad?
messages.zh: 绕着白线的梭芯在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bobbin with the white thread?

messages.speaker: Marija (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata, ħdejn l-imqass.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata, ħdejn l-imqass.
messages.zh: 在针线盒里，剪刀旁边。
messages.en: In the sewing box, next to the scissors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 minċott 写在一张绕着白线的小梭芯图片旁，记住“线绕在小轴上”的形状，再配合“给梭芯绕线”这个动作复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce the reason or cause of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出某件事发生的原因，表示“因为、由于”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika r-raġuni jew il-kawża ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因为；由于，表示原因。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tagħti r-raġuni għaliex jiġri jew isir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to introduce the reason why something happens or is done.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ġiet posposta minħabba t-temp ħażin.
formal.en: The meeting was postponed because of the bad weather.
formal.zh: 会议由于恶劣天气而延期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalt tard? Mark: Minħabba t-traffiku. Kien hemm ħafna karozzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you arrive late? Mark: Because of the traffic. There were a lot of cars.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么迟到了？马克：因为堵车，路上车很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex wasalt tard?
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-traffiku. Kien hemm ħafna karozzi.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-traffiku. Kien hemm ħafna karozzi.
messages.zh: 因为堵车，路上车很多。
messages.en: Because of the traffic. There were a lot of cars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 minħabba 想成“原因箭头”：箭头后接下雨、堵车等原因，前面说明发生了什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An extraordinary event that people may believe is caused by divine power, or a wonderfully unexpected result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为可能由神力造成的非凡事件，也可指令人惊喜、出乎意料的好结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miraklu huwa ġrajja straordinarja li n-nies jistgħu jattribwixxu lil qawwa divina, jew riżultat tajjeb li jidher kważi impossibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奇迹；常被归因于神力的非凡事件，也可比喻极难发生却出现的美好结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miraklu huwa avveniment straordinarju li xi nies iqisu bħala xogħol ta' qawwa divina; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal riżultat tajjeb u tassew mhux mistenni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A miracle is an extraordinary event that people may attribute to divine power, or a very welcome result that seemed almost impossible.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-fejqan tat-tifel huwa deskritt bħala miraklu li ta tama lill-familja kollha.
formal.en: In the account, the boy's recovery is described as a miracle that gave hope to the whole family.
formal.zh: 文中将男孩的康复描述为一个奇迹，给全家带来了希望。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Sibt iċ-ċavetta li tlift ilbieraħ? Pawlu: Iva, taħt is-sufan! Miraklu li sibtha daqshekk malajr!
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you find the key you lost yesterday? Pawlu: Yes, under the sofa! It's a miracle I found it so quickly!
colloquial.zh: Marija：你找到昨天丢的钥匙了吗？Pawlu：找到了，在沙发下面！这么快就找到了，真是奇迹！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt iċ-ċavetta li tlift ilbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt iċ-ċavetta li tlift ilbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你找到昨天丢的钥匙了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the key you lost yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, taħt is-sufan! Miraklu li sibtha daqshekk malajr!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, taħt is-sufan! Miraklu li sibtha daqshekk malajr!
messages.zh: 找到了，在沙发下面！这么快就找到了，真是奇迹！
messages.en: Yes, under the sofa! It's a miracle I found it so quickly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miraklu 记成一个可以讲述的“奇迹”：想象丢失的钥匙突然出现，再说“发生了一个 miraklu”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: So extraordinary or unexpectedly successful that it seems to involve a miracle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非凡或成功得令人难以置信，仿佛奇迹发生了一样的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mirakoluża hija tant straordinarja jew mhux mistennija li tidher bħallikieku seħħet b'miraklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奇迹般的；非凡得仿佛由奇迹促成的，尤其形容令人意外的康复、获救或成功。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tkun mirakoluża, tkun tant straordinarja jew diffiċli biex titwemmen li n-nies jistgħu jqisuha bħala riżultat ta' miraklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe an event or result as miraculous, you mean that it is so extraordinary or unexpectedly successful that it seems like a miracle.

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi s-salvataġġ bħala mirakoluż, għax deher impossibbli li xi ħadd jibqa' ħaj f'dawk il-kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: The author describes the rescue as miraculous because it seemed impossible for anyone to survive in those conditions.
formal.zh: 作者将这次营救形容为奇迹般的，因为在那样的条件下，似乎不可能有人生还。
