colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nannu reġa' beda jimxi waħdu? Mark: Iva! Wara dak kollu li għadda minnu, l-irkupru tiegħu jidher mirakoluż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Grandpa started walking on his own again? Mark: Yes! After everything he went through, his recovery seems miraculous.
colloquial.zh: Sara：爷爷又能自己走路了吗？Mark：是啊！经历了那么多，他的康复简直像奇迹一样。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu reġa' beda jimxi waħdu?
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu reġa' beda jimxi waħdu?
messages.zh: 爷爷又能自己走路了吗？
messages.en: Has Grandpa started walking on his own again?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Wara dak kollu li għadda minnu, l-irkupru tiegħu jidher mirakoluż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Wara dak kollu li għadda minnu, l-irkupru tiegħu jidher mirakoluż.
messages.zh: 是啊！经历了那么多，他的康复简直像奇迹一样。
messages.en: Yes! After everything he went through, his recovery seems miraculous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mirakoluż 放在“康复”旁边记：miraklu 指一个奇迹，rkupru mirakoluż 则是在说“奇迹般的康复”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a lot of wind, especially when describing the weather or a day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 风较大或经常有风的，常用来描述天气或某一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temp mirjieħ huwa temp li fih ikun hemm ħafna riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多风的；风大的，形容有较多或较强风的天气、日子等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta t-temp jew jum ikun mirjieħ, ikun hemm ħafna riħ li jinħass b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If the weather or a day is windy, there is a lot of wind.

formal.mt: F'jum mirjieħ, il-bandiera tibqa' tperper u l-friegħi tas-siġar jiċċaqalqu kontinwament.
formal.en: On a windy day, the flag keeps fluttering and the tree branches move continuously.
formal.zh: 在风大的一天，旗帜不停飘动，树枝也不断摇摆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nieklu barra llum? David: It-temp mirjieħ wisq; aħjar nieklu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we eat outside today? David: It's too windy; we'd better eat inside.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天我们在外面吃饭好吗？David：风太大了，还是在里面吃吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieklu barra llum?
messages.mt_standard: Nieklu barra llum?
messages.zh: 今天我们在外面吃饭好吗？
messages.en: Shall we eat outside today?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-temp mirjieħ wisq; aħjar nieklu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: It-temp mirjieħ wisq; aħjar nieklu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 风太大了，还是在里面吃吧。
messages.en: It's too windy; we'd better eat inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mirjieħ 时想象旗帜被风吹得不停飘动，并连读 temp mirjieħ，把这个形容词和“风大的天气”绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The unauthorized taking or use of money or property, especially assets entrusted to someone's care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经授权而占有或使用资金、财物的行为，尤其指侵占或挪用受托管理的资产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-misapproprjazzjoni hija t-teħid jew l-użu ta' flus jew proprjetà mingħajr awtorizzazzjoni, speċjalment meta dawn ikunu fdati fil-kura ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侵占；挪用；未经授权而占有他人财物，或将受托管理的资金、财物用于不获准的用途。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-misapproprjazzjoni sseħħ meta xi ħadd jieħu jew juża flus jew proprjetà li ma għandux dritt jieħu jew juża għal dak l-iskop, b'mod partikolari meta jkunu fdati lilu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Misappropriation occurs when someone takes or uses money or property without authorization, especially when it has been entrusted to their care.

collocations.zh: 有关侵占或挪用的指控
对侵占或挪用行为的调查

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda investigazzjoni dwar allegazzjoni ta' misapproprjazzjoni ta' fondi tal-assoċjazzjoni.
formal.en: The report recommends an investigation into an allegation of misappropriation of the association's funds.
formal.zh: 报告建议调查一项有关挪用协会资金的指控。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser misapproprjazzjoni ta' fondi? Mark: Pereżempju, meta xi ħadd juża flus fdati lilu biex iħallas l-ispejjeż personali tiegħu mingħajr permess.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does misappropriation of funds mean? Mark: For example, when someone uses money entrusted to them to pay their personal expenses without permission.
colloquial.zh: Nina：挪用资金是什么意思？Mark：比如，有人未经允许，把交给自己管理的钱拿去支付个人开销。

messages.speaker: Nina (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser misapproprjazzjoni ta' fondi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser misapproprjazzjoni ta' fondi?
messages.zh: 挪用资金是什么意思？
messages.en: What does misappropriation of funds mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pereżempju, meta xi ħadd juża flus fdati lilu biex iħallas l-ispejjeż personali tiegħu mingħajr permess.
messages.mt_standard: Pereżempju, meta xi ħadd juża flus fdati lilu biex iħallas l-ispejjeż personali tiegħu mingħajr permess.
messages.zh: 比如，有人未经允许，把交给自己管理的钱拿去支付个人开销。
messages.en: For example, when someone uses money entrusted to them to pay their personal expenses without permission.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misapproprjazzjoni 和“受托保管的钱被擅自拿去私用”这一画面绑定，整组记住 misapproprjazzjoni ta' fondi 表示“挪用资金”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very unhappy or suffering considerable emotional distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人非常不快乐、难过或内心痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imdejjaq ħafna jew iħoss tbatija kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常难过或痛苦的；处于很不愉快的情绪状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss dwejjaq kbar jew li jkun fi stat ta' tbatija u nuqqas ta' ferħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is miserable feels very unhappy or experiences considerable distress.

formal.mt: Wara ġranet ta' solitudni, ir-raġel ħassu miserabli u talab l-għajnuna ta' ħabib.
formal.en: After days of loneliness, the man felt miserable and asked a friend for help.
formal.zh: 独自度过几天后，这名男子感到十分难过，于是向一位朋友寻求帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk miserabli llum? Mark: Qattajt il-ġurnata waħdi u ma kelli lil ħadd ma' min nitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so miserable today? Mark: I spent the day alone and had nobody to talk to.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天怎么看起来这么难过？马克：我一整天都独自待着，连个说话的人都没有。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher daqshekk miserabli llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher daqshekk miserabli llum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么看起来这么难过？
messages.en: Why do you look so miserable today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qattajt il-ġurnata waħdi u ma kelli lil ħadd ma' min nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Qattajt il-ġurnata waħdi u ma kelli lil ħadd ma' min nitkellem.
messages.zh: 我一整天都独自待着，连个说话的人都没有。
messages.en: I spent the day alone and had nobody to talk to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miserabli 和一个垂头丧气的人联系起来，连读 iħossu miserabli，记住它描述非常难过的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Broken into small pieces or a softer mass by pressing or pounding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因挤压、碾压或捣击而变成碎块或软烂状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tkisser f'biċċiet żgħar jew sar artab billi ġie magħfus jew imfarrak.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到压力或捣击而被压碎、碾碎或捣烂的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie magħfus jew imfarrak sakemm inqasam f'biċċiet żgħar jew sar massa ratba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is crushed has been pressed or pounded until it breaks into smaller pieces or becomes a soft mass.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li t-tewm mishuq jitħallat maż-żejt qabel ma jiżdied mat-tadam.
formal.en: The recipe calls for the crushed garlic to be mixed with the oil before being added to the tomatoes.
formal.zh: 食谱要求先将捣碎的蒜与油混合，再加入番茄中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tewm diġà mishuq? Pawlu: Iva, tista' żżidu maz-zalza issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the garlic crushed already? Pawlu: Yes, you can add it to the sauce now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：蒜已经捣碎了吗？保罗：是的，现在可以把它加进酱汁里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tewm diġà mishuq?
messages.mt_standard: It-tewm diġà mishuq?
messages.zh: 蒜已经捣碎了吗？
messages.en: Is the garlic crushed already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' żżidu maz-zalza issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' żżidu maz-zalza issa.
messages.zh: 是的，现在可以把它加进酱汁里了。
messages.en: Yes, you can add it to the sauce now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蒜瓣被压成碎末后的样子，把这个结果画面配上 tewm mishuq，记住 mishuq 描述已经压碎的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman or girl who follows Islam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信奉伊斯兰教的女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara jew tifla li tħaddan ir-reliġjon Iżlamika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穆斯林；此词形指信奉伊斯兰教的女性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara jew tifla li temmen fl-Iżlam u tħaddan din ir-reliġjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Muslim woman is a woman who follows the religion of Islam.

collocations.zh: 遵行宗教习俗的穆斯林女性

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, il-misilma spjegat xi tfisser għaliha l-fidi tagħha.
formal.en: In the interview, the Muslim woman explained what her faith means to her.
formal.zh: 在采访中，这位穆斯林女性解释了她的信仰对她意味着什么。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Sara qaltli li hi misilma. Marija: Iva, ilbieraħ tkellimna dwar xi tfisser għaliha r-reliġjon tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lina: Sara told me she is Muslim. Marija: Yes, yesterday we talked about what her religion means to her.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：萨拉告诉我她是穆斯林。玛丽亚：是的，昨天我们聊了她的宗教对她意味着什么。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sara qaltli li hi misilma.
messages.mt_standard: Sara qaltli li hi misilma.
messages.zh: 萨拉告诉我她是穆斯林。
messages.en: Sara told me she is Muslim.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilbieraħ tkellimna dwar xi tfisser għaliha r-reliġjon tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilbieraħ tkellimna dwar xi tfisser għaliha r-reliġjon tagħha.
messages.zh: 是的，昨天我们聊了她的宗教对她意味着什么。
messages.en: Yes, yesterday we talked about what her religion means to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misilma 放进介绍女性身份的句子 hi misilma（她是穆斯林）中记忆，同时记住它指女性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cooked thoroughly, especially describing meat that is cooked all the way through.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物充分煮熟，尤其指肉类内部也已熟透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imsajjar għalkollox, speċjalment laħam li jkun sar minn ġewwa wkoll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全熟的；尤指肉类已完全熟透的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun imsajjar sew minn barra u minn ġewwa, speċjalment meta jingħad għal-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Meat that is well-done has been cooked thoroughly all the way through.

formal.mt: Il-klijent talab steak misjur sewwa, u l-kok ħejjieh skont it-talba tiegħu.
formal.en: The customer requested a well-done steak, and the chef prepared it according to his request.
formal.zh: 顾客要求牛排全熟，厨师按照他的要求进行了烹制。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif tixtiequ l-isteak? Mark: Misjur sewwa, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How would you like your steak? Mark: Well-done, please.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：您的牛排要几分熟？马克：请做成全熟。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tixtiequ l-isteak?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tixtiequ l-isteak?
messages.zh: 您的牛排要几分熟？
messages.en: How would you like your steak?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Misjur sewwa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Misjur sewwa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请做成全熟。
messages.en: Well-done, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象点牛排时说 misjur sewwa，把整句和切开后内部也熟透的画面联系起来，记住“全熟”。

gloss_zh: 沟通失误；信息传达不畅

teaching_sense.en_definition: A failure to communicate information clearly or correctly, often resulting in misunderstanding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息没有被清楚或准确地传达或理解的情况，常因此产生误会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas fil-mod kif jitwassal jew jinftiehem messaġġ, li jista' jwassal għal fehim ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟通失误；因信息传达或理解不准确、不清楚而产生的沟通问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni li fiha l-informazzjoni ma titwassalx jew ma tinftiehemx b'mod ċar u korrett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Miscommunication occurs when people fail to convey or understand information clearly and correctly.

formal.mt: Minħabba miskomunikazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ uffiċċji, il-laqgħa bdiet siegħa tard.
formal.en: Because of miscommunication between the two offices, the meeting began an hour late.
formal.zh: 由于两个办公室之间沟通失误，会议晚了一小时才开始。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Jien fhimt li kellna niltaqgħu fl-erbgħa. David: Jien fhimt fil-ħamsa. Kien hemm miskomunikazzjoni; ejja nikkonfermaw il-ħin bil-miktub.
colloquial.en: Anna: I understood that we were meeting at four. David: I understood five. There was a miscommunication; let's confirm the time in writing.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我理解的是我们四点见面。戴维：我理解的是五点。沟通出了差错，我们用文字确认一下时间吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien fhimt li kellna niltaqgħu fl-erbgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien fhimt li kellna niltaqgħu fl-erbgħa.
messages.zh: 我理解的是我们四点见面。
messages.en: I understood that we were meeting at four.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien fhimt fil-ħamsa. Kien hemm miskomunikazzjoni; ejja nikkonfermaw il-ħin bil-miktub.
messages.mt_standard: Jien fhimt fil-ħamsa. Kien hemm miskomunikazzjoni; ejja nikkonfermaw il-ħin bil-miktub.
messages.zh: 我理解的是五点。沟通出了差错，我们用文字确认一下时间吧。
messages.en: I understood five. There was a miscommunication; let's confirm the time in writing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一人听成四点，一人听成五点”的画面记住 miskomunikazzjoni：信息传了，却没有正确对上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an unpleasant smell or taste because fats or oils have deteriorated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指油脂或含油脂的食物因变质而产生难闻气味或哈喇味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu riħa jew togħma ħażina għax ix-xaħam jew iż-żejt li fih ikun tħassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸败的；尤指油脂或含油食物变质后有哈喇味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun żviluppa riħa jew togħma ħażina minħabba li ż-żejt jew ix-xaħam ikun tħassar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food that is rancid smells or tastes unpleasant because its fats or oils have deteriorated.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-kċina, instab żejt misnieħ f'kontenitur li kien ilu miftuħ.
formal.en: During the kitchen inspection, rancid oil was found in a container that had been open for a long time.
formal.zh: 检查厨房时，发现一个开封已久的容器里装着酸败的油。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-butir għandu riħa stramba. Toni: Naħseb li hu misnieħ. Aħjar ma nużawhx.
colloquial.en: Rita: This butter smells strange. Toni: I think it's rancid. We'd better not use it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这黄油闻起来怪怪的。托尼：我觉得它有哈喇味了。我们最好别用了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-butir għandu riħa stramba.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-butir għandu riħa stramba.
messages.zh: 这黄油闻起来怪怪的。
messages.en: This butter smells strange.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li hu misnieħ. Aħjar ma nużawhx.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li hu misnieħ. Aħjar ma nużawhx.
messages.zh: 我觉得它有哈喇味了。我们最好别用了。
messages.en: I think it's rancid. We'd better not use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misnieħ 和打开旧黄油时闻到哈喇味的画面绑定，记住它强调油脂酸败后的异味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building where Muslims gather to pray and worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穆斯林聚集祈祷和进行宗教礼拜的建筑，即清真寺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini fejn il-Musulmani jinġabru biex jitolbu u jqimu lil Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清真寺；供穆斯林祈祷及举行宗教活动的场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post ta' qima fejn il-Musulmani jitolbu u jieħdu sehem f'attivitajiet reliġjużi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mosque is a building where Muslims meet for prayer and worship.

formal.mt: Il-grupp żar il-misġed u sema' spjegazzjoni dwar it-talb u l-użu tal-bini.
formal.en: The group visited the mosque and listened to an explanation about prayer and the use of the building.
formal.zh: 参观团到访清真寺，聆听了关于祈祷和建筑用途的讲解。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer wara x-xogħol? Omar: Se mmur fil-misġed biex nitlob.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going after work? Omar: I'm going to the mosque to pray.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：下班后你要去哪里？奥马尔：我要去清真寺祈祷。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejjer wara x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejjer wara x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 下班后你要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going after work?

messages.speaker: Omar (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur fil-misġed biex nitlob.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur fil-misġed biex nitlob.
messages.zh: 我要去清真寺祈祷。
messages.en: I'm going to the mosque to pray.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一座清真寺，给它贴上 misġed 标签，再用 fil-misġed 记住“在清真寺里”的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water that has a high temperature, often used for washing or bathing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度较高的水，常用于清洗或洗浴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma li għandu temperatura għolja u li spiss jintuża għall-ħasil jew għall-għawm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热水；经过加热或本身温度较高的水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilma li jkun issaħħan jew li jkollu temperatura għolja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hot water is water whose temperature is high, often because it has been heated.

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet jgħidu li d-drapp għandu jinħasel bil-misħun u jitħalla jinxef fl-arja.
formal.en: The instructions say that the cloth should be washed with hot water and left to air-dry.
formal.zh: 说明要求用热水清洗这块布，然后让它自然晾干。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandna misħun biex nieħu doċċa? Pawlu: Iva, għadni kemm xgħelt il-ħiter, imma stenna ftit minuti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we have hot water so I can take a shower? Pawlu: Yes, I've just switched on the water heater, but wait a few minutes.
colloquial.zh: 马克：有热水可以让我洗个澡吗？保罗：有，我刚打开热水器，不过还要等几分钟。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna misħun biex nieħu doċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna misħun biex nieħu doċċa?
messages.zh: 有热水可以让我洗个澡吗？
messages.en: Do we have hot water so I can take a shower?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm xgħelt il-ħiter, imma stenna ftit minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm xgħelt il-ħiter, imma stenna ftit minuti.
messages.zh: 有，我刚打开热水器，不过还要等几分钟。
messages.en: Yes, I've just switched on the water heater, but wait a few minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开热水龙头后冒出水汽，把 misħun 直接记成一份“热水”；本条作名词，词里已经包含“水”的意思。

gloss_zh: 神话；流传甚广的错误观念

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional story about gods or extraordinary beings, or a widely accepted belief that is not true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 讲述神灵或非凡人物的传统故事；也指被许多人信以为真的错误观念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mit huwa rakkont tradizzjonali dwar allat jew ħlejjaq straordinarji; jista' jkun ukoll twemmin mifrux li mhuwiex veru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神话，通常讲述神灵、英雄或非凡事件；也可指广为流传但并不真实的观念。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mit huwa rakkont tradizzjonali dwar allat, eroj jew ġrajjiet straordinarji, jew twemmin li ħafna nies jaċċettaw minkejja li mhuwiex veru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A myth is a traditional story about gods or extraordinary events, or a belief that many people accept although it is untrue.

collocations.zh: 广为流传的神话或错误观念

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw mit antik biex jifhmu kif in-nies kienu jispjegaw il-fenomeni naturali.
formal.en: The students analysed an ancient myth to understand how people used to explain natural phenomena.
formal.zh: 学生们分析了一则古老的神话，以了解过去的人们如何解释自然现象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb dwar xiex inhu? Mark: Dwar mit antik li fih eroj jiġġieled ma' mostru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Mark: About an ancient myth in which a hero fights a monster.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书讲什么？马克：讲一则古老的神话，里面有一位英雄与怪物搏斗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb dwar xiex inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb dwar xiex inhu?
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar mit antik li fih eroj jiġġieled ma' mostru.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar mit antik li fih eroj jiġġieled ma' mostru.
messages.zh: 讲一则古老的神话，里面有一位英雄与怪物搏斗。
messages.en: About an ancient myth in which a hero fights a monster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mit 放在一本神话故事书的封面上记忆；再联想“大家都相信的故事未必真实”，帮助记住它也可指流传甚广的错误观念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Produced on paper or another surface by a printing process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过印刷或打印过程呈现在纸张或其他表面上的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mitbugħa jkollha kliem jew stampi trasferiti fuq karta jew wiċċ ieħor permezz ta' proċess ta' stampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷或打印出来的，指文字、图像或载有这些内容的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem, stampi jew materjal mitbugħ ikunu ġew prodotti fuq karta jew wiċċ ieħor permezz ta' proċess ta' stampar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is printed has been produced on paper or another surface using a printing process.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant se jirċievi programm mitbugħ qabel il-bidu tal-konferenza.
formal.en: Each participant will receive a printed programme before the conference begins.
formal.zh: 每位参会者都将在会议开始前收到一份印刷版议程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek il-programm fuq il-mowbajl? Mark: Iva, imma nippreferi programm mitbugħ biex inkun nista' nikteb noti fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have the programme on your phone? Mark: Yes, but I prefer a printed programme so I can write notes on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你手机上有议程吗？马克：有，不过我更喜欢纸质打印版，这样可以在上面做笔记。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek il-programm fuq il-mowbajl?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek il-programm fuq il-mowbajl?
messages.zh: 你手机上有议程吗？
messages.en: Do you have the programme on your phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nippreferi programm mitbugħ biex inkun nista' nikteb noti fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nippreferi programm mitbugħ biex inkun nista' nikteb noti fuqu.
messages.zh: 有，不过我更喜欢纸质打印版，这样可以在上面做笔记。
messages.en: Yes, but I prefer a printed programme so I can write notes on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打印机吐出一本 ktieb mitbugħ：把“纸上已经印好文字”的画面与 mitbugħ 绑定，记住它表示印刷或打印出来的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing in or belonging to myths, especially traditional stories about extraordinary beings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在于神话中或属于神话的，尤用于描述神话中的非凡人物或生物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mitika teżisti fil-miti jew tagħmel parti minn rakkonti tradizzjonali dwar ħlejjaq jew ġrajjiet straordinarji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神话中的；属于神话传说、其存在不作为现实事实来陈述的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna, ħlejqa jew ħaġa mitika tagħmel parti minn mit jew minn rakkont tradizzjonali u ma tiġix ippreżentata bħala fatt tar-realtà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something mythical belongs to a myth or traditional story rather than being presented as an established fact.

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi eroj mitiku li jipproteġi lill-abitanti tal-gżira minn mostru.
formal.en: The story describes a mythical hero who protects the island's inhabitants from a monster.
formal.zh: 这个故事描写了一位保护岛上居民免受怪物侵害的神话英雄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-annimal fl-istampa jeżisti tassew? Mark: Le, huwa annimal mitiku li jidher fi stejjer antiki.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this animal in the picture really exist? Mark: No, it is a mythical animal that appears in old stories.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里的这种动物真的存在吗？马克：不存在，它是出现在古老故事中的神话动物。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-annimal fl-istampa jeżisti tassew?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-annimal fl-istampa jeżisti tassew?
messages.zh: 图片里的这种动物真的存在吗？
messages.en: Does this animal in the picture really exist?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa annimal mitiku li jidher fi stejjer antiki.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa annimal mitiku li jidher fi stejjer antiki.
messages.zh: 不存在，它是出现在古老故事中的神话动物。
messages.en: No, it is a mythical animal that appears in old stories.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mit 与 mitiku 配对记忆：mit 是“一则神话”，mitiku 用来描述“神话中的英雄或动物”；这是词义对照记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crushed or milled into small particles or powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过碾磨或研磨，变成细小颗粒或粉末的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal mitħun ikun ġie mfarrak fi frak żgħir jew fi trab permezz tat-tħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨碎的；经过研磨而成为细颗粒或粉末的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mitħuna tkun ġiet ipproċessata bit-tħin sakemm saret frak żgħir jew trab, bħall-kafè jew il-bżar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substance that is ground has been crushed or milled into small particles or powder.

formal.mt: Żid kuċċarina bżar mitħun mat-taħlita u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add a teaspoon of ground pepper to the mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 在混合物中加入一茶匙胡椒粉，并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna kafè mitħun id-dar? Mark: Le, għandna biss kafè fiż-żerriegħa. Irridu nitħnuh l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have ground coffee at home? Mark: No, we only have whole coffee beans. We need to grind them first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：家里有咖啡粉吗？马克：没有，只有整粒咖啡豆。我们得先把它们磨碎。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna kafè mitħun id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna kafè mitħun id-dar?
messages.zh: 家里有咖啡粉吗？
messages.en: Do we have ground coffee at home?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandna biss kafè fiż-żerriegħa. Irridu nitħnuh l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandna biss kafè fiż-żerriegħa. Irridu nitħnuh l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 没有，只有整粒咖啡豆。我们得先把它们磨碎。
messages.en: No, we only have whole coffee beans. We need to grind them first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“整粒咖啡豆进入磨豆机，出来成为 kafè mitħun”的画面记忆；这里的英语 ground 表示磨碎的，不是地面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Brought together or gathered from one or more places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个或多个地方收集、聚拢到一起的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inġieb jew tqiegħed flimkien wara li nġabar minn post wieħed jew minn diversi postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此义项未提供可确定的词义；“不知道”是未知义项标记，不作为 miġbur 的词义教授。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din it-tikketta tindika li t-tifsira ta' dan is-sens mhijiex magħrufa; ma tagħtix tifsira lessikali għall-kelma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This label indicates that the meaning of this particular sense is unknown and supplies no usable lexical definition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经收集或汇集到一起的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun inġabar u tqiegħed flimkien, bħal materjal jew tagħrif minn sorsi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Material that is collected has been gathered together from one or more places or sources.

formal.mt: It-tagħrif miġbur matul l-istħarriġ ġie inkluż fir-rapport finali.
formal.en: The information collected during the survey was included in the final report.
formal.zh: 调查期间收集的信息已纳入最终报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-materjal miġbur għall-proġett? David: Qiegħed kollu f'din il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the material collected for the project? David: It's all in this box.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为这个项目收集的材料在哪里？戴维：全都在这个箱子里。

messages.speaker: Nina (项目组员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-materjal miġbur għall-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-materjal miġbur għall-proġett?
messages.zh: 为这个项目收集的材料在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the material collected for the project?

messages.speaker: David (项目组员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed kollu f'din il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed kollu f'din il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 全都在这个箱子里。
messages.en: It's all in this box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把散落的资料装进同一个箱子，箱中的资料就是 miġbur，表示已经收集到一起；未知义项标记另行保留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a plant whose branches or shoots have been cut back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物的枝条或嫩枝已经经过修剪的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xitla jew siġra li xi friegħi jew rimjiet tagħha jkunu nqatgħu biex titnaqqas jew tingħata forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修剪过枝条的；经过剪枝的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkunu nqatgħulu xi friegħi jew rimjiet biex jingħata forma jew jitneħħew partijiet mhux mixtieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pruned plant has had some branches or shoots cut back to control its growth or shape.

formal.mt: L-arbuxxell miżbur ħdejn id-daħla għandu forma aktar regolari.
formal.en: The pruned shrub beside the entrance has a more regular shape.
formal.zh: 入口旁修剪过的灌木形状更加规整。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-arbuxxell jidher iżgħar illum. Pawlu: Iva, issa hu miżbur u ma jagħlaqx il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Maja: This shrub looks smaller today. Pawlu: Yes, it is pruned now and does not block the path.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这棵灌木今天看着小了一些。保罗：是啊，现在修剪过了，不会挡住小路。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-arbuxxell jidher iżgħar illum.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-arbuxxell jidher iżgħar illum.
messages.zh: 这棵灌木今天看着小了一些。
messages.en: This shrub looks smaller today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa hu miżbur u ma jagħlaqx il-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa hu miżbur u ma jagħlaqx il-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在修剪过了，不会挡住小路。
messages.en: Yes, it is pruned now and does not block the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miżbur 和灌木剪枝后的整齐轮廓一起记：重点是已经修剪过的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Severe unhappiness or suffering, especially in very difficult living conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深重的痛苦或不幸，尤其指生活条件恶劣时的悲惨处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' tbatija kbira jew dwejjaq profondi, speċjalment meta l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħajja jkunu ħżiena ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深重的痛苦、不幸或悲惨生活状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tbatija kbira jew nuqqas qawwi ta' ferħ li persuna tesperjenza minħabba ċirkustanzi diffiċli jew kundizzjonijiet ħżiena tal-ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Misery is great suffering or unhappiness, often caused by extremely difficult circumstances.

formal.mt: L-għajnuna bl-ikel u b'akkomodazzjoni sigura tista' ttaffi l-miżerja tal-familji milquta mill-għargħar.
formal.en: Assistance with food and safe accommodation can alleviate the misery of families affected by the floods.
formal.zh: 提供食物和安全住所，可以减轻受洪灾家庭的苦难。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejra l-familja wara l-għargħar? Mark: Għadha fil-miżerja, imma qed ngħinuha ssib post sigur fejn toqgħod.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is the family doing after the floods? Mark: They are still living in misery, but we are helping them find a safe place to stay.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那家人洪灾后过得怎么样？马克：他们的处境仍然很悲惨，不过我们正在帮他们找安全的住处。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejra l-familja wara l-għargħar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejra l-familja wara l-għargħar?
messages.zh: 那家人洪灾后过得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the family doing after the floods?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadha fil-miżerja, imma qed ngħinuha ssib post sigur fejn toqgħod.
messages.mt_standard: Għadha fil-miżerja, imma qed ngħinuha ssib post sigur fejn toqgħod.
messages.zh: 他们的处境仍然很悲惨，不过我们正在帮他们找安全的住处。
messages.en: They are still living in misery, but we are helping them find a safe place to stay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miżerja 放进“生活在苦难中”的画面记忆，区别于一时的小烦恼或普通不开心。

gloss_zh: 大量存在的状态；充满……的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state in which something is widespread or present in great quantities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种事物广泛存在或数量很多的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih xi ħaġa tkun mifruxa ħafna jew tkun preżenti fi kwantità kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种事物普遍存在、大量出现的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' preżenza mifruxa jew abbundanti ta' xi ħaġa f'post jew f'sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to a state in which something occurs widely or in great abundance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充满……的；含有大量……的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fih ikun hemm ħafna nies, oġġetti jew elementi ta' tip partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a place or thing is full of something, it contains a large amount of it.

formal.mt: It-test kien miżgħud bl-iżbalji u kellu jiġi rivedut qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The text was full of mistakes and had to be revised before publication.
formal.zh: 这篇文字错误百出，必须修改后才能发表。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Insibu mejda f'dan il-kafetterija? Toni: Diffiċli, il-post miżgħud bin-nies; ejja nippruvaw ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we find a table in this café? Toni: That will be difficult; the place is full of people. Let's try another one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这家咖啡馆能找到桌子吗？托尼：很难，这里挤满了人；我们换一家试试吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Insibu mejda f'dan il-kafetterija?
messages.mt_standard: Insibu mejda f'dan il-kafetterija?
messages.zh: 这家咖啡馆能找到桌子吗？
messages.en: Can we find a table in this café?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diffiċli, il-post miżgħud bin-nies; ejja nippruvaw ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Diffiċli, il-post miżgħud bin-nies; ejja nippruvaw ieħor.
messages.zh: 很难，这里挤满了人；我们换一家试试吧。
messages.en: That will be difficult; the place is full of people. Let's try another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咖啡馆里满满都是人：miżgħud 突出数量多、到处可见，也可用错误很多的文章帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a manner featuring decoration or ornamental details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以带有装饰或点缀的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jinkludi tiżjin jew dettalji ornamentali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以经过装饰、带有点缀的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li jkun fih ornamenti jew elementi oħra miżjuda għat-tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense describes something presented with ornaments or other decorative details.

formal.mt: Għaċ-ċerimonja, l-ispazju ġie ppreżentat miżmum bil-fjuri u b'ornamenti żgħar.
formal.en: For the ceremony, the space was presented decorated with flowers and small ornaments.
formal.zh: 举行仪式时，场地以鲜花和小饰物装点后呈现。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se nippreżentaw l-ispazju għall-festa? David: Miżmum bil-fjuri u b'xi ornamenti żgħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: How shall we present the space for the party? David: Decorated with flowers and a few small ornaments.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：聚会场地要布置成什么样？戴维：用鲜花和一些小饰物装点。

messages.speaker: Nina (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nippreżentaw l-ispazju għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nippreżentaw l-ispazju għall-festa?
messages.zh: 聚会场地要布置成什么样？
messages.en: How shall we present the space for the party?

messages.speaker: David (活动助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Miżmum bil-fjuri u b'xi ornamenti żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Miżmum bil-fjuri u b'xi ornamenti żgħar.
messages.zh: 用鲜花和一些小饰物装点。
messages.en: Decorated with flowers and a few small ornaments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在本词条的给定义项中，把 miżmum 与鲜花、饰物装点场地的画面一起记，抓住呈现方式。

gloss_zh: 状况不佳的；不稳当的；醉酒的

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a bad or unsteady condition, or affected by alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或物状况不佳、处于不稳当的状态；也可形容人喝醉了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'qagħda ħażina jew mhux stabbli; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi persuna li tkun fis-sakra.

sense_translations.en_definition: in a bad or unsteady state
sense_translations.zh_definition: 状况不佳的；处于不稳当或不稳定状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'kundizzjoni ħażina jew f'qagħda li mhijiex stabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is mġandar, they are in poor condition or are not steady.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝醉的；因饮酒而失去正常清醒或平稳状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun xorob biżżejjed alkoħol biex ikun fis-sakra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is mġandar has drunk enough alcohol to become intoxicated.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab siġġu mġandar, u għalhekk tneħħa mill-kamra sakemm jissewwa.
formal.en: During the inspection, an unsteady chair was found and was therefore removed from the room until it could be repaired.
formal.zh: 检查时发现了一把不稳当的椅子，因此先将它搬出了房间，等修好后再使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jimxi hekk Pawlu? Mark: Qed jimxi hekk għax hu mġandar; xorob wisq. Lara: Mela ejja nċemplulu taxi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Pawlu walking like that? Mark: He's walking like that because he's drunk; he drank too much. Lara: Then let's call him a taxi.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu怎么走成这样？Mark：因为他喝醉了，喝得太多了。Lara：那我们给他叫辆出租车吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jimxi hekk Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jimxi hekk Pawlu?
messages.zh: Pawlu怎么走成这样？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu walking like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jimxi hekk għax hu mġandar; xorob wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jimxi hekk għax hu mġandar; xorob wisq.
messages.zh: 因为他喝醉了，喝得太多了。
messages.en: He's walking like that because he's drunk; he drank too much.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nċemplulu taxi.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nċemplulu taxi.
messages.zh: 那我们给他叫辆出租车吧。
messages.en: Then let's call him a taxi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“不稳”作为记忆画面：椅子摇摇晃晃是状态不稳，人喝醉后走路摇晃也是不稳。用这两个场景分别记住两个义项；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having knowledge or skill gained through doing something or encountering situations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过实际做事或经历各种情况而积累了知识、技能和判断力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għarfien jew ħila miksuba permezz ta' xogħol, prattika jew sitwazzjonijiet li għadda minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有经验的；因实际实践或亲身经历而熟悉某种工作或情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li kiseb esperjenza minn dak li għamel jew għadda minnu u għalhekk jaf kif jaġixxi f'sitwazzjonijiet simili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is mġarrab has gained useful knowledge or skill through practical experience.

formal.mt: Il-proġett se jitmexxa minn ħaddiem mġarrab li għandu ħafna snin ta' esperjenza f'dan il-qasam.
formal.en: The project will be led by an experienced worker who has many years of experience in this field.
formal.zh: 该项目将由一位经验丰富的工作人员负责，他在这一领域已有多年的工作经验。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lil min se nitolbu jgħinna? David: Lil Ġużeppi. Hu ħaddiem mġarrab u jaf dan ix-xogħol sew. Nina: Tajjeb, inkellmu llum.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who shall we ask to help us? David: Ġużeppi. He's an experienced worker and knows this work well. Nina: Good, we'll speak to him today.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们找谁来帮忙呢？David：找Ġużeppi吧。他是个有经验的工人，很熟悉这项工作。Nina：好，我们今天就跟他说。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min se nitolbu jgħinna?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min se nitolbu jgħinna?
messages.zh: 我们找谁来帮忙呢？
messages.en: Who shall we ask to help us?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil Ġużeppi. Hu ħaddiem mġarrab u jaf dan ix-xogħol sew.
messages.mt_standard: Lil Ġużeppi. Hu ħaddiem mġarrab u jaf dan ix-xogħol sew.
messages.zh: 找Ġużeppi吧。他是个有经验的工人，很熟悉这项工作。
messages.en: Ġużeppi. He's an experienced worker and knows this work well.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inkellmu llum.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inkellmu llum.
messages.zh: 好，我们今天就跟他说。
messages.en: Good, we'll speak to him today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位做过很多次同类工作的老师傅：遇到问题，他凭经验就知道怎么办。把“亲手做过，所以熟练”这个画面与 mġarrab 联系起来，不必猜测词根。

gloss_zh: 把……逼入角落；使……无路可退

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forces someone or something into a corner or a position from which escape is difficult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物逼到角落，或使其陷入难以逃脱、无路可退的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa jispiċċa f'rokna jew f'qagħda li minnha jkun diffiċli jaħrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把……逼入角落；使……陷入难以脱身的处境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa jidħol f'rokna, jew iħallih mingħajr triq faċli biex jaħrab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone corners another person, they force that person into a place or situation that is difficult to escape.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, il-verb 'mġiddmien' huwa spjegat bħala azzjoni li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jispiċċa f'rokna mingħajr triq faċli biex jaħrab.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the verb 'mġiddmien' is explained as an action that forces someone into a corner with no easy way to escape.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，动词“mġiddmien”被解释为把某人逼入角落、使其难以逃脱的动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser il-verb 'mġiddmien'? Paul: Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jġiegħel lil persuna oħra tispiċċa f'rokna u ma tkunx tista' taħrab faċilment. Maja: Mela niftakru bl-istampa ta' persuna maqbuda f'rokna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb 'mġiddmien' mean? Paul: Think of someone forcing another person into a corner so that they cannot easily escape. Maja: Then I'll remember it through the image of a person trapped in a corner.
colloquial.zh: Maja：动词“mġiddmien”是什么意思？Paul：想象有人把另一个人逼到角落，让对方很难逃脱。Maja：那我就用一个人被困在角落的画面来记住它。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser il-verb 'mġiddmien'?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser il-verb 'mġiddmien'?
messages.zh: 动词“mġiddmien”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'mġiddmien' mean?

messages.speaker: Paul (辅导老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jġiegħel lil persuna oħra tispiċċa f'rokna u ma tkunx tista' taħrab faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jġiegħel lil persuna oħra tispiċċa f'rokna u ma tkunx tista' taħrab faċilment.
messages.zh: 想象有人把另一个人逼到角落，让对方很难逃脱。
messages.en: Think of someone forcing another person into a corner so that they cannot easily escape.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela niftakru bl-istampa ta' persuna maqbuda f'rokna.
messages.mt_standard: Mela niftakru bl-istampa ta' persuna maqbuda f'rokna.
messages.zh: 那我就用一个人被困在角落的画面来记住它。
messages.en: Then I'll remember it through the image of a person trapped in a corner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两面相交的墙，再画一个被逼到墙角的人，重点记住“逼入角落”这个动作。英语 Corners 在这里按动词理解；这个画面只是释义记忆，不表示词源关系。

gloss_zh: 挖掘过的；开凿出的；钻出的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dug into, hollowed out, or made by excavation or drilling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过挖掘、开凿或钻孔而形成，或表面、内部已被挖开的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li saret jew infetħet billi tneħħiet il-ħamrija jew il-blat permezz tat-tħaffir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过采掘、挖掘或钻孔的；通过这些作业开凿出来的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tneħħiet minnha l-ħamrija jew il-blat, jew li saret permezz ta' xogħol ta' tħaffir jew titqib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is described as mħaffra has been dug into, excavated, or opened by drilling.

collocations.en: a cistern excavated in the rock
collocations.zh: 在岩石中开凿的蓄水池

collocations.en: a hole drilled in the wall

formal.mt: Il-ġiebja mħaffra fil-blat kienet tintuża biex jinġabar l-ilma tax-xita.
formal.en: The cistern excavated in the rock was used to collect rainwater.
formal.zh: 这个在岩石中开凿的蓄水池过去用于收集雨水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm dik it-toqba mħaffra fil-ħajt? Pawlu: Biex ngħaddu l-kejbil minnha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there that hole drilled in the wall? Pawlu: So we can pass the cable through it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么墙上钻了那个孔？保罗：为了把电缆穿过去。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dik it-toqba mħaffra fil-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dik it-toqba mħaffra fil-ħajt?
messages.zh: 为什么墙上钻了那个孔？
messages.en: Why is there that hole drilled in the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħaddu l-kejbil minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħaddu l-kejbil minnha.
messages.zh: 为了把电缆穿过去。
messages.en: So we can pass the cable through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把墙上钻出的孔和岩石中挖出的蓄水池连成画面，记住 mħaffra 描写挖掘或钻孔后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing different things or types combined together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由不同事物、材料或类别混合在一起构成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih affarijiet, materjali jew tipi differenti magħqudin flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合的；包含两种或多种不同成分或类型的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx magħmul minn tip wieħed biss, iżda minn affarijiet jew elementi differenti flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is mixed contains different things or types that have been brought together.

collocations.zh: 由不同类型成员组成的群体

formal.mt: Il-kors huwa maħsub għal grupp imħallat ta' studenti u ħaddiema.
formal.en: The course is intended for a mixed group of students and workers.
formal.zh: 这门课程面向由学生和在职人员共同组成的群体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-ross imħallat mal-ħaxix? Mark: Iva, fih piżelli u karrotti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the rice mixed with vegetables? Mark: Yes, it has peas and carrots in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：米饭里拌了蔬菜吗？马克：对，里面有豌豆和胡萝卜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ross imħallat mal-ħaxix?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ross imħallat mal-ħaxix?
messages.zh: 米饭里拌了蔬菜吗？
messages.en: Is the rice mixed with vegetables?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih piżelli u karrotti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih piżelli u karrotti.
messages.zh: 对，里面有豌豆和胡萝卜。
messages.en: Yes, it has peas and carrots in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一碗米饭里拌进不同颜色的蔬菜，用这个混合画面记住 mħallat；例句中的 imħallat 也表达这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shellfish with two hinged shell halves that often lives buried in sand or mud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蛤蜊，一种具有两片相连贝壳、常埋栖于沙或泥中的贝类软体动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mollusk b'żewġ qxur magħqudin li jgħix fl-ilma, spiss midfun fir-ramel jew fit-tajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛤蜊，具有两片相连贝壳、常生活在水底沙泥中的软体动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal artab tal-ilma protett minn żewġ qxur li jinfetħu u jingħalqu, u li spiss jgħix fir-ramel jew fit-tajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clam is a shellfish with two hinged shell halves, often found buried in sand or mud.

formal.mt: Il-mħara għandha żewġ qxur li jipproteġu l-ġisem artab tagħha.
formal.en: The clam has two shell halves that protect its soft body.
formal.zh: 蛤蜊有两片贝壳，用于保护其柔软的身体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din mħara? Pawlu: Iva, ara ż-żewġ qxur tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a clam? Pawlu: Yes, look at its two shell halves.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是一只蛤蜊吗？保罗：是的，看看它的两片贝壳。

messages.speaker: Lara (海边游玩的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din mħara?
messages.mt_standard: Din mħara?
messages.zh: 这是一只蛤蜊吗？
messages.en: Is this a clam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (海边游玩的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara ż-żewġ qxur tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara ż-żewġ qxur tagħha.
messages.zh: 是的，看看它的两片贝壳。
messages.en: Yes, look at its two shell halves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沙里藏着一只两片壳合拢的蛤蜊，把这个形象与 mħara 配对记忆，不必拆词猜词源。
